He provides practice problems during lectures, which are helpful to check your understanding. He gives a lot of homework, but it all is really helpful for the exams. If you try in this class you will succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This is the man of men. He is the best calculus professor and as an added bonus he entertains those who love cats (even though he doesnt own one). He will come to class every day with a new psychedelic cat shirt which is the highlight of every class. Dont let his homeless appearance fool you though this man is a genius in the field of math.

Very friendly and he is really helpful during office hours. MATH 140 itself is a weed out class so the tests are sometimes tricky. The written homework and WebAssign really helps you understand the material and prepares you for the tests. Would definitely recommend taking him.

Great Professor. He makes things very clear and teaches in vert east ways. He doesn't take attendance and doesn't have clickers. But if you miss class, you won't do well. Work hard inside and outside class. And go to his office hour and ask things. He helps students very well.

Worst professor ever! DO NOT take his class, avoid it at all costs. He laughs at the students if you ask a question and doesn't prepare you at ALL for the exams. There's two exams plus the final that accounts for your grade. Homework doesn't help you for the exams either, so if you haven't taken calc before you're screwed.

MATH 140 is a very difficult class, and he does not make the exams. HE DOES NOT MAKE QUIZZES which is very good, but send double homework. This homeworks are complicated but theyll teach you and prepare you very well for the exams. because you do not have quizzes, that 20% will be a good grade, the rest depends in the exams. I recomend his class.

I took calc in high school and did extremely well, but when I took this course it was the worst experience. This prof is extremely confusing and very condescending. He did not prepare us at all for the exams and the homework was not helpful. If you don't want to fail a class or be laughed at when you have a question DO NOT TAKE HIS COURSE.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: If you didn't take Calc before and you're taking it for the first time, DO NOT TAKE IT WITH HIM. I was lucky enough to have a solid foundation in high school, and I would definitely be failing right now if I didn't have it. He's super condescending and laughs at kids when they ask simple questions. He is very "my way or the highway" with everything
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Knows his stuff. Extremely unorganized, both in and out of the lecture hall (where Canvas quizzes?). Would learn concepts from him over a coffee, but definitely not from a classroom. He's funny and pretty new to teaching. Unfortunately, that's his greatest weakness. Hopefully, he gets better over time. Don't expect it to be exactly like 311.
Has made massive strides. W Axten.
chris your class is my son
Caxten is a diddy blud and needs to get way better at teaching

His lectures are often fill in the blanks and does a problem or two at end of the lectures. He's a great individual but an okay teacher. However, he is very lenient with partial credit for the exams (just write something down).

Chris is a great guy, but while he definitely knows the material, he struggles to explain it to the class. A lot of the lectures are just filling in blank notes, and it's obvious he's new to teaching. That being said, he curves exams by a decent amount and isn't against extending deadlines if you email him. Gives tangerines for answering questions.

Axtens lectures arent very good in my opinion as its fill in the blank slides and i personally dont learn well that way. His exams are very tpugh but he curves very well which is nice. I just wish the lectures were more useful i feel like i learned almost nothing and got a b- in the class

Axten is a very great dude to talk with in office hours love to make jokes with students.He gotta learn how to teach half the time a student ask him a question he ask it back or I'll get back to you and just zooms through lectures slides very disengaging and don't know what's going on half the semester . This class is exam heavy but he curves a lot

Dr. Axten is an interesting guy, and this is the very first class that he teaches in his career. He's pretty generous with homework and exam grades. He always gives good homework grades, and the craziest thing is that he gives crazily big curves on all the exams and the final, which is a lifesaver. I believe he's trying very hard to improve.

Dr. Axten is a good dude, but not a good professor. Lectures are not helpful; fill-in-the-blank notes. He makes too many mistakes in explaining his notes. Has not figured out how to create good exams, and uses a curve (15%) on every exam. He is trying to improve as a professor and is willing to take feedback. Exam review sessions are ineffective.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I like Chris I think he is a good dude, that being said he is a terrible lecturer. Lectures are useless , he just does fill in the blank slides and he has not quite figured out how to make fair exams yet, there has been a heavy curve on every exam. Exams will have questions from one random slide on the lectures which is extremely annoying..

Hes a nice guy and somewhat charismatic, but isn't good at teaching. At least not yet.... 
Final was 35% which is just crazy, filled in slides for the whole semester, can't correctly do an example. Exam review sessions are a waste of time, spends more time on one problem than the time given on the  exam with multiple problems. class is a drag
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Solid course, professor was chill and gave good feedback, held online classes at times but overall a positive experience

Absentee but has the gall to be a tough guy to BFA students. Doesn't care about students, just scolds. He must get paid peanuts for how little he engages. Doesn't even live in State College, just swoops in from NY once in a while. Joke program.

He is such a chill, cool professor. He is great professor who always gave us good feedback, and no pressure to you. Just that showing up to class, and "make some work" (in his words :D). I was sad that his class was over now.
Gave me some good insight into the drug world in which I knew very little about.

She teaches you more than what's in a textbook, but also how to critically think & apply the fundamentals to their real life applications. Tests are challenging, but if you can explain your thought process in a way that shows you understand metabolism, she will give you credit where due. Visit office hours and she always awards points if deserving.

Dr. B is one of the most brilliant professors at PSU. Not only does she teach the nitty gritty details of metabolism, but she teaches you how to synthesize the material in a meaningful way. I would highly recommend attending lecture... ALWAYS. There is so much material in this course you will have to study your butt off.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The best professor i've ever had!

I loved her lectures. She gives 10 extra credit points out throughout the entire semester. However, they are in class activity points during random classes. She is really funny and is able to use her humor to relate nutrition to real life. Exams are really tough, but she lets students pick 10 questions that will show up throughout the exam.

Dr. B was great. She made the class very interesting and was able to put the material into terms that you could understand. The class was hard but she did a great job of making us part of our success. She let us as a class write 10 questions on the exams. She also gave you the chance to earn extra points just by coming to class and reading .
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She's really funny and loves feedback from students. DO THE STUDY GUIDES.

Dr. B is easily my favorite teacher I've ever had at Penn State. It was a big class, but  she always recognized me walking down the street & said hello! Truly cares about her students. Tough class, but Dr. B knows her stuff & is so good at putting it in basic terms. Clear about what she expects. Exams are tough, but easy to do well in this class.

Dr. B is super interesting to learn nutrition from. This class isn't the most basic, and there is some science, but she's very available to answer any questions. She keeps lectures fun, makes jokes about herself, and always applies topics to its real world impact. This isn't the easiest GHA but it's definitely useful knowledge for the future.

Dr. B is hilarious. Before exams, she has students come up 10 questions that will be on the exam, you can only get these questions in class! Having a science background (organic chemistry, molecular biology) makes her class easy easy easy! Otherwise, it can be tough for those who haven't seen a lick of either of those subjects.

Favorite professor of this semester. It is extremely important to pay attention to what is on her slides AND her commentary to each slide. She is very thorough in her curriculum, which is wonderful for a nutrition major to learn from. She not only explains the "what" but also the "how and why" of topics. Use study guides! (the book actually helps!)

She's a really nice professor and talks about nutrition in a real life application that we use everyday, but those conversations tend to be tangents in class that aren't on the exam,she dedicates more time talking about what should be office hour chit chat in class and zooms through the lecture slides, Your so busy filling in blanks you don't learn

She came into the final exam and told us she forgot to tell us to study a section. All the exams are extremely difficult, and PowerPoints are incredibly extensive and don't really help. She tells you to focus on the study guide, but hardly anything from the study guide is on the exams.

The PowerPoint slides have barely any information and aren't cohesive at all. The exams are extremely difficult and include information you've never covered. The class as a whole lacks cohesion and it's very unclear what you need to know for the exams (notes, study guide, and what she says don't align).

Dr. B is by far my favorite professor i've had. She's really funny and tries her hardest to make sure everyone understands the material. She is always willing to meet with students outside of class. Exams are a little tough but she'll try and nudge you in the right direction if you're having trouble on a question. Definitely would take her again!
Worst nutrition professor ever!!!!! Very sarcastic! If you go to her office hour, she will make you feel like worthless!!!! Run away from her!!! Run never look back!!!!

She made an intro course insanely difficult. Her tests were really, really hard and it felt like she went way too in-depth for just an intro course. Questions could be super technical, and lecture felt like it didn't prepare me well for exams. Try to find another prof to take this if you need it, as you'll struggle to earn a good grade with her.

I really liked Dr. B. She is really enthusiastic about the subject and knows it in great detail, and she encourages students to come talk to her outside of class. The class is very fast-paced and the exams are very tough, but I learned a lot. Her lectures are good but it is absolutely necessary to read the book and keep up with the material.

Dr. B is pretty good given the level of difficulty in this class. I expected an essay style exam process as described from previous students in 446, so it was not a surprise. The class is difficult, but if you go to her office she will help you in any way that she can. Very easy to talk to and very knowledgeable about the material.

Dr. B is an overall really nice lady. She is very sarcastic and you can tell she loves nutrition. On the other hand, exams are really tough-especially with 40% of exams being free response.  She does allow for ten points extra credit though and a project worth an exam grade. Definitely be ready to work, it is not an easy intro class.

So the first week of class- you will think "she's pretty cool" but then you take the first test and you will think "this is too hard for a beginner level nutrition class and no other nutrition professor gives short answer." You don't know a short question on the test- you go from an A to a B in one question. choose wisely

Professor Johnson is a great professor. His exams are application based, so you need to understand the material, not just memorize it. He tests what he talks about, so pay attention in class. Get the course packet, it helps a lot. He also has great connections. Go to office hours!!
The goat. Go to his office hours for anything. He knows so many people and has a lot of knowledge. Tests r being moved to the testing center so watch out for that.
he has god complex lectures seem interesting but they are mandatory

Johnson is playful and interactive. He plays music and gives prizes to excite students. The course is overall pretty manageable. The only annoying part is the exam because Johnson likes to add irrelevant details in each question, which is distracting. Do the extra credits and follow the instructions of each assignment!

Professor Johnson is easily one of the best Professors at PSU. If you really think about it, this guy is the definition of walking knowledge. He gives great advice and has great lectures. Exams are tough... BUT, if you review a week in advance, and REALLY understand the concepts, you will do good. His lectures are awesome.

Second time taking a class with him. BA is literally very similar to mgmt, however DO THE EXTRA CREDIT it boosted me up from a b to an a-. Guy is probably the most iconic professor in Smeal and there are 3 tests all on canvas and 3 projects and that is it
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Listen to him. Study exactly how he says. Please trust me. If you do bad on the first exam you'll see. Go and talk to him too.

Ron jon was a great professor. One of my only classes this semester that I enjoyed going too. He has a no technology rule but the class goes by so fast you barely notice. His exams are all online and easy but the questions are vey wordy and filled with random information not pertaining to the questions.

Class was relatively easy, exams are super wordy and throw you off. Between extra credit and assignments for mastery, you can get a 10-12% boost on your grade. Exams are about 60-65% of the class. Nice guy, lectures get slightly boring with no tech.

Ron John made class fun. 4 exams, the "final" only has stuff covered in the 4th module. Exam questions are tough. Read them from the bottom to the top!  Study the exam review video he creates. One easy project and no hw. A lot of what he talks about in class will be on exams. Take great notes. Do extra credit, it's an easy 5% added to your grade.

People will say hes a good prof bc hes funny + class is pretty easy but if you actually wanna learn this content take a diff prof. His exams make no sense and everyone uses AI on them. No hw but his riddle questions on the exams will tank your grade. I honestly learned nothing all year. His class is the epitome of a "business" class. We do nothing

Love this guy. He is so silly and always tries to engage students in the lectures since he does not allow electronics. Notes are fill in the blank and if you study and go to lectures you will do well in the class. Definitely recommend him for MGMT 301.

Love Ron John! Great lectures, even without electronics. Notes are practically fill in the blank with his course packet. Dont buy the book its useless. The 4 tests are pretty easy since they are open note. 1 project that is also easy. I would take this class every semester if I was allowed to thats how great Ron John is. Fridays are asynchronous.

Ron Jon is super silly and is very upbeat. It is a joy to be in his class daily, as he starts his lectures with some type of dancing/fun/singing video to lighten the mood- and it does. He doesn't allow electronics in class which can be annoying but lowkey is nice to disconnect and helps me lock in. His exams are so hard tho-lots of mumbo jumbo.
As long as you play the game right, you will do great

Professor Johnson is amazing and if you have the option take him for MGMT 301. Attendance is necessary and mandatory because he doesn't post the lecture notes online, but he keeps class super engaging and it goes by fast. Take advantage of the extra credit. All tests are open note. He is the absolute best.

Great guy, terrible teacher. Does not connect the material from the book to his classes well enough for you to understand. His lectures are literally just a bunch of random stuff from the world and he tries to connect it back to management but it doesnt make sense most of the time. The test are very hard for no reason

If Ron John has a million fans, I am one of those fans. If Ron John has one fan, I am that one fan. If Ron John has no fans, I am dead. I think it's time we start putting Ron John in the GOAT debate, and I don't mean the greatest teacher ever. We should strongly consider Ron John as the greatest human ever. Get ready for the time of your life.

Prof Johnson was a great professor. Be ready to take lots of notes because the course content is heavy. As long as you attend and participate in class you will be fine. Exams are content heavy but the extra credit makes up for it. Technology isn't allowed, but his course packet with slides helps lot with the note taking.
Professor Ron runs a fun, engaging class with open-note exams. Though lectures can be tangential, the study guide and extra credit make up for it. Unstuck AI was a game-changer for preparing.
Had him for 301 and 342. As long as you go to class and take notes in the packet you will be fine. You won't remember anything from these courses when your done so just get through them.

He doesn't teach you anything, he legit just yaps. MGMT 301 is the most usleless class you will ever take. I got an A in this class but omg it is a huge waste of time. This guy will yap the entire class about things that aren't on the exam i swear to god he really does. Ron jon is a great guy but this class will seriously not teach you anything

Late review, but this class is easy to do well in if you come to class with the note packet he suggests at the beginning of the semester, and take notes in it. You have three projects and exams online, but you have ample time to prepare for them. If you don't go to class, you will struggle to do well on the exams not to mention attendance is taken.

The material is easy to understand, not much studying needed. Ron Jon is very energetic and keeps class interesting. He gives a lot of real-world advice. You have 3 projects which take some time to do. Exams are taken online and open-note. No phones in class, handwritten notes only. Type your notes before exams and you'll do fine.

Ron Jon is the absolute GOAT. All exams are online and open note, he provides a detailed study guide covering all exam topics, if you study that you will get a good grade. Class sessions are engaging and fun. The guided notes simplify comprehension. There are numerous extra credit chances. Attend class!! Friday classes are online.
Would not recommend if you are bad at comprehending confusing questions on exams. Offers easy extra credit, and has engaging lectures, but the exams ruined the whole class for me.

Professor Johnson's classes are usually entertaining, and his interview and job tips are quite helpful, but you need to attend every class or else you will miss A LOT. His tests are honestly harder than my 400-level classes, and they are extremely detailed and memorization-centered. Be prepared to study.
love Ron Jon! 3 essays, and 3 exams, all pretty easy.

this class was pretty difficult but as long as you pay attention, take notes, read the book, and do the online videos you should be good. The first exam was a little difficult because i didnt know what i was excpecting the questions are written in a openended format so be prepared. The lectures were good though pretty entertaing.

Ron Jon is seriously awesome. I was NEVER bored once in his lectures. Super engaging and funny. Exams can be difficult but make sure to take good notes and you will be fine. Flashcards help. He is a right of passage for PSU business students.

He is a great guy, very personable. Exams are solely based on class so if you dont go your guessing on the tests. Only reason I didnt do as well was because I didnt attend all classes and his tests are weird wording. He writes them like a story. Many in class examples on the test. 3 projects, very easy, bring up your grade.

all exams are online and open-note. he posts a study guide before exams and tells you basically everything that will be on them. he makes class fun with lots of videos and has guided notes to make it easy to follow along. there are also a ton of extra credit opportunities. attending class is important but he does online class on fridays!!

RonJon was AMAZING! He was funny and interesting so you will be engaged in his lectures. His exams can be a little tricky, but you will pass. I recommend reading/skimming the textbook! You will also want to make a friend or two in class because he encourages you to talk to your classmates.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: If you have at least one brain cell, you'll be able to pass and even ace Professor Johnson's class. He very clearly lays out the course format and his lectures are very engaging and help you remember a lot of the material.

Humorous guy that always has interesting stories during his lectures. his exams cover every single topic that is covered in class so you either need to take really good notes or have really good memory because his lecture slides are not posted until before the exam. His papers are relatively easy and he provides a lot of extra credit opportunities.

Ron Jon is overall a great professor at Smeal. He is a LITERAL game show host. He gives students so many opportunities for extra credit. You have to take handwritten notes. He makes you get the course packet.  His exams are open notes. His class lectures are fun and required, but he usually wastes about 20 minutes talking about random things.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment:
This is class consists of 4 exams which are not too hard if you go to the lectures, take good notes, and spend a decent time studying. There are PackBack assingments and few other grades that are beneficial in getting your grade up. 

Johnson is a cool guy who is truly passionate about what he does. Perfect professor to take for MGMT 301.

He is only grading you with 4 exams (80% of your grade), 1 research project, packback questions every week (impossible to get full credit) and attandance. If you fail one of the tests, impossible to pass this class. Also, tests are online, but if you do not know the answer (really specific) you cannot find anything on quizlet or google.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Take notes on the examples he gives during class and be able to tie them to the appropriate topics. Not terrible for a 300 level class. Exams online and open book/notes. Four exams make up most of your grade. Extra credit opportunities up to 30 points when each exam is 200 points. Introduce yourself to him at the beginning of the class.

I don't understand some of the hate he is getting on here. I took him last semester and it was one of the easiest classes ever. There were four tests including the final, and they were all multiple choice and open book/note. There was one project where you have to research a business, but it was not very challenging or time consuming.

The easiest smeal class I have taken so far and barely put time in. Pay attention in class and put some effort in and you will be fine. He didn't curve every exam, but he did when needed. Use all the opportunities for extra credit and take notes on the videos in class!! Exam questions are worded weirdly but he practically gives the answers in class

Ron Jon really cares about what he teaches. The problem is that he cares a little too much and makes the exams very difficult. Exams are super wordy and have very specific questions that are said maybe one time in a lecture and never again. Hes a nice guy but he spends too much time talking about how great of a person he is which is very annoying.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof. Johnson's lectures were great, you can tell he truly cares about the topics he teaches. Sometimes his goofy mannerisms and jokes get to be too much, but he knows what he talks about. His tests can be hard, but as long as you write down examples and watch his review video, you'll do fine. He also offers a ton of extra credit--50+ points.

He really loves himself. A lot of the lectures were him talking about how great of a person he is which is annoying. The class was easy though and exams were online. You get extra credit for attendance, and there were papers but you basically get 100% if you put in any effort at all.

He reminds me of Micheal Scott, he cracks jokes constantly throughout lectures. He does a really good job with lectures and everything you learn is common sense. The exams though are pretty difficult because almost all the answers could work for the question. There were 3 papers, averaging 2 pages, and mandatory attendance.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Tests are nearly impossible to do well on. Class is way too hard.
Class is way too hard. Tests are impossible to do well on.
I recommend taking his class. Lots of extra credits and also he's very passionate.

Prof. Johnson was hands down my favorite professor this year. He offers a ton of extra credit opportunities. If you watch the lectures and take his exam reviews seriously, you will get A's. He makes it easy to know what to expect on the exams. He gives you a note guide which also makes it so easy to follow along with the lectures.

This class asynchronous is a breeze if youre willing to put the time in and watch the classes etc. Tests are a lot but always curved. Extra credit is easy and puts a big buff to your grade (30 points).

Guy is a gem. Loves Penn State and tries his best to make lectures interesting. Guided notes packet makes it super easy to follow along and his exam prep materials make it super know what to expect on the exams. Tons of extra credit too. Only downside is you don't see your grade until the end of the semester. Overall, amazing guy and great class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Prof. Johnson makes the class as easy as he can for you while still teaching you. He offers guided notes for each lecture that make the exams pretty easy. Good guy who loves PSU.
I don't know why this guy gets so much hate he is the man. The class is not hard and he makes the lectures enjoyable. Don't be afraid to take this guy because of his rating, the class is a fun time.

I have had Prof Johnson for both MGMT 301 and BA 342. Material in both classes is not difficult. Taking time to memorize for the exams is what is difficult. I recommend... 1. summarize notes 2. watch exam review and read the parts of the book specifically mentioned in this Weekly quizzes (easy), packback post, 4 project, 3 exams and extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: The exams feel easy when youre taking them but then never turn out well. You dont know your grade the entire semester. Super funny guy, fun to watch, but the exams ruin the entire experience. Took it online & he was always late to post lectures (either a day late or posted 10:30 pm). Theyre unrealistic & this class was not an easy GPA booster.
Ron Jon is hilarious. He thinks he is starting in a movie every class. He means well and is a good teacher. Tests are hard.

I had Professor Johnson in person for a previous class and hated him in my very core. BA 342 online was actually not bad, mostly because I could put lectures on 2x speed. He gives very clear grading criteria and an appropriate amount of assignments. Just do the work and study for exams and the class will be easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof Johnson is honestly an amazing professor but I barely paid attention in class and managed to get a 98%. He gives so much easy extra credit so make sure to do them. His exams are all pure memorization , so buying the liontutors practice exams and notes and turning them into flashcards a week out is all you need to average an A on the exams.

This class boils down to pointless, constant memorization and attendance. You don't need to pay attention in class just show up for clicker points. Grind for his exam 4-6 days prior and you'll be fine. It's all about straight memorization and taking advantage of his extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: BEST PROFESSOR AT PENN STATE! If you get a chance to take any of his classes, DO IT! He is very clear, gives TONS of extra credit, is willing to work with you during office hours, and gives very entertaining lectures. There isn't really homework but you have to keep up with textbook reading. Tests are hard but very doable if you study in advance

This class is not as difficult as many say it is. Granted, it is pointless memorization of material that isn't necessarily inspirational, so it can be tough to sit down and prep for. If you are worried about getting an A, don't be, if you work hard, you will likely get an A. My tip: watch the recordings and retake notes based on what he stresses.

A demanding but very doable class. Attend class, the lecture slides are the majority of the test. Book is mainly used for the side terms. Take advantage of extra credit (he offers up to 5%). Tests are tricky for some questions, but most are straight forward. Overall, a great professor and class that gets a bad rap. Dont be daunted by his rating.

Exams are hard, to pass them you must definitely attend class and read the chapters for the text book. The study guides that he gives out are really helpful and cover everything that is on the exam. I can not stress the importance of doing all the extra credit or else you will probably end up with a C or lower
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Exams are more difficult than they should be and the material isn't very useful at all. However, he makes the class entertaining and enjoyable to attend.

Anyone who gave Prof. Johnson a bad review does not know how to study. Entertaining class, uses great examples. Definitely read and study for the exams. Great guy that really cares. Sometimes is a showoff, but that makes class entertaining.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: classes mandatory every monday and wednesday, then fridays were mostly screencasts. You must study to do well. There is one easy project and easy attendance and pop quiz clicker points. exams were HARD. one of those teachers you just kind of have to take bc the course is mandatory

Exams are hard & there are only 3, so if you mess up on 1 you have to dig yourself out of a hole for sure. He gives a ton of extra points &clicker points so make sure you go to class. Projects were super easy just follow the guidelines. Overall liked the class but I feel like he made it hard for no reason, study at least a week in advance for exams
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Really nice guy, class is super easy 5 exams, 1 guaranteed A bonus project, and up to 30 points in extra credit. Nearly every Friday is screencast you watch online. He is the only teacher but as long as you study its a great class.

Ron John is the best. He gets a bad rap from his tests but I loved his class and his teaching style. Exams are hard and heavy on material, but if you put in the effort studying even a week in advance you'll do great. Not a great test taker and still survived them all. No class on Friday's and minimal outside of class work with lots of extra credit.
Just be ready for the most pointless class ever
This is the type professor that when he says "Read the textbook", IT'S GOING TO BE ON THE EXAM!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I highly recommend to all business students that have to take mgmt 301, to take it in the summer. If you mess up in on exam you are done, forget the A.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He is super full of himself. He loves to make sure everyone in the audience knows that hes better than you. I highly doubt he could manage a company on his own. He loves talking about businesses hes went and spoken too. The tests are worded like riddles and super in-depth when he is very vague in lectures.

Ron might be the biggest fraud I've ever encountered at PSU. He'll throw "frameworks" and acronyms at you for days and once you've finally memorized them you'll realize they don't actually mean anything and are utterly useless. Have to give him credit for being able to look at himself in the mirror (quite fondly) after teaching such nonsense.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Yes, his classes are difficult. However, Professor Johnson is willing to help his students succeed along with providing a fun learning environment. He's a great guy!

MGMT 301 really isn't that bad if you put forth some minimal effort. Yes, there's  lot of vocabulary, but making flashcards or study guides will help a ton. Studying for his exams at least a week ahead just an hour or two a day helped me. Also, the textbook really helps and isn't difficult to read. Ron Jon is a cool dude and is open to help you.

Ron Jon gets a bad rap for no reason. Yes, you have to get used to his exam wording for questions, but they really aren't that hard. If you put the time into studying for his exams and you understand basic business knowledge, you can easily get an A. He said that you need an 85% average on exams to get an A, if you have an 100 on everything else.
His exams were not hard at all lol. Pretty easy professor
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Exam wording is tricky but he has a bunch of other points to boost your grade up. If you study the guide word for word you'll be fine.  A very engaging class and fun class, that applies the lectures to real life.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Exams are all lengthy, and extremely hard. Professor Johnson uses rather strange diction in the exam questions, and asks about some very obscure and minute details that are not always very relevant. His lectures are interesting, but he usually wastes 10-15 minutes every class plugging Smeal. Also his exam study guides are helpful most of the time.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Professor Johnson's class is interesting. It's required for all business majors, and I know people complain a lot about his class. He gives a lot of extra credit. His exams are a bit tricky, but you need to put the work in to even obtain a B on his exams. If you pull out an 85 average on exams and projects and do all the extra credit, you get A-.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This class isn't exceptionally hard but you do have to put in an unnecessary amount of studying into his tests to succeed. Nothing you learn will be applicable to your career or life. Its priceless listening to some of the nonsense he teaches and takes pride in during lectures. You are stuck with him though !

Ron's lectures are very vague and unclear, he spends very minimal time in class to discuss about the more important ethics concepts which means you will have to read on your own. Also his exam questions are just ridiculous, he tests you on very trivial and insignificant facts, which just makes it more of a memorization test. Get ready to work hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Although you do have to put in a bulk of studying for this class. Ron is very clear in how to do well on his exams and offers many free points that consist of projects, clicker, and pop quizzes. He is too often criticized by students but he really does seem to care about us succeeding. Offers great career tips in class as well! Read the textbook!

2nd time I've had Ron Jon. I like the topic of BA but he uses so many of the same examples from 301 and it's boring. He just comes off so cocky which is annoying. I will say he is passionate about the topic and about people and he is a great resource to have but this class was bleh. Either way, you don't have another option for this class:)
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Hardest course ever. He really messed up the exam questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: RON JOHNSON IS THE MAN! I love this guy! Every day i was so excited to come to that class! We all gotta PLAY BETTER and he rocks that motto. Great guy that you'd love to have as an uncle. Tests are tough but point scale keeps you at a good grade anyway. Enjoy him!
Ron Jon is a respectable man but is one of the worst lecturers I've ever experienced in my short career as a college student.

To that "smart kid" that wrote before me: Yea, tell me how his exam materials are more than two of my 400 level classes combine. Studied two times as much as those 400 level classes and still got a B. Oh by the way, this is the first B I am getting in Penn State. Ron Jon basically talks like he live in a Utopia. You learn nothing but random facts.

If you did poorly in this class, then switch majors. Don't look back. I've heard Penn State has an excellent Art History program. Or maybe Psychology would interest you.  If you're not an idiot, don't be afraid to take this class. Study 10 hours per exam, pay attention to what he says in class, and you'll get an A.

This class  isn't hard as long as you actually go and pay attention. I would say the actual information in management is not very practical or informative, but I would not blame the professor for that. He attempts to make it as engaging as possible with videos, and mini discussions. As he always says, "play the game" - that's all you have to do.
I took it twice and I really hate it . Hardest course until I get into major.

Lectures aren't bad, because he's fairly entertaining. Does offer some extra credit. Exams are about 70% fair questions and the rest you can limit it to 2 choices, but just have to guess. Class is an easy B, but a very difficult A.

Professor Johnson has mixed reviews among students, but he's a great guy to get to know.  Exams are tough but he hands you everything to succeed if you put in max effort.  Lectures are really easy to listen to because he keeps it interesting and moving along at just the right speed. Go in ready to work and you'll get an A.

Professor Johnson (Ron John) knows his stuff. He offers a lot of help (TA's, office hours, email) but this class isn't easy. The good thing is, he offers clicker points and assignments outside of class along with four exams. This means there are opportunities to gain points.

Ron Jon is a teacher that some people will like and some people will absolutely hate.  He really cares about his students and wants them to succeed, but really makes you work hard for your grade.  You will have to fight tooth and nail to get an A in the class, but you will leave the class learning a lot about professionalism.

Just finished the class with an A due to a decent amount of work put in, but largely I'm embarrassed for PSU that this is an actual class and that Ron is a professor at here. Completely subjective and arbitrary material written and taught by academics that are somehow supposed to know how to manage a business. Felt dumber after studying for hours.

Ron John was a nice professor in the beginning and everything was fine but then you realize how stupid his exams are. The material is super easy but he turns it into application questions that don't make sense half the time. He puts questions on 15 sec irrelevant videos we watched in class. Study the notes inside out and know every detail

No idea why people give Ron a bad rating. He is an awesome professor, and his class is something to look forward to. His exams are pretty difficult, but he gives opportunities to earn 5% extra credit. Put in the work and there's no reason you should get less than a B+.

Ron can definitely be arrogant, but it sometimes makes the class entertaining.  However, his tests are basically impossible, even if you read the class material and the book.  You watch YouTube videos for a majority of class which don't usually pertain to anything you are learning and it make things more confusing.  Do ALL of the extra credit.
Go to class and you will do fine

"RonJohn" can be pretty annoying. He's very arrogant and believes that he is the greatest professor that ever lived. That being said, he will tell you exactly what is on each exam. Watch his screen casts and go to class - you'll do fine. It's required for Smeal students and A is definitely attainable.

He spends 15 min of every class to talk nonsense stuff. If you use your phone, he will bust on you. If you use it again, you will have a private meeting with him. 3rd time, you will go see the dean. If you make the same mistake, you don't have to do anything else. You will definitely be kicked out as a withdrawn failing. BRUTAL PROFESSOR :(
Tests are really really difficult. Lectures do not help much. Hardest class. Not recommended class.

Um I think Ron himself wrote the review before mine, because only a handful of people think that. Ron makes up his own words, terms, and "frameworks" that will never be used outside that class. Teaches practical material in a confusing, opinionated way. Very difficult to study for tests.  Good news: grades are inflated bc many people do poorly

It's a required class and the subject matter can be boring but he definitely tries to keep students engaged and is a good guy. catches a ton of flack from students mostly undeserved in my opinion. If you have a  question you can go ask him, people just don't want to study for it. tests have a lot of material but are generally fair.

Terrible at explaining things.  Spent an entire day going over maps of locations of ethnic minorities for literally no reason at all.  None of what he talks about appears on the test without him distorting the wording so you have no idea what he is asking.  Probably the worst professor I have ever had.

Overall nice guy, but so annyoying. His tests have these application questions which have nothing to do with the material. Tests are kinda hard but project is easy 100% if you do it. If you get B's on test and do all the HW A/A- is very doable.
His class is "doable" and yes that is the exact way he described it. He is very vague on his exams and his applied questions can be very confusing. I had to work very hard to get an A-

This class has a lot of easy material, however Ron tries to make it more difficult by making his exams mostly application questions.  He is very engaging and although his exams are a bit difficult as long as you do the extra credit you'll be guaranteed a B.  Many ppl here say he is arrogant and self-centered but i personally think its hilarious!

His lectures are interesting but filled with endless amounts of fluff and useless material.  His study guides basically, know everything, so ignore whatever he says and focus on the things in the book first, then move onto the in class stuff.  Good Luck.

Terrible at speaking to students like a professor. Doesn't ever really have anything important to say but goes on and on about meaningless information which he says will be on the test but it really will not.

Literally the easiest class you will take on your way to getting into Smeal. Ron is a great guy and although he may stray off topic at times, he always makes sure you have all you need for exams. As long as you study the note packet and look over the book you should get an A considering he offers you 5% extra credit and gives you exam questions.

Ron Johnson is the most obnoxious, annoying professor I know in Smeal. He spends more time bragging about everything he's done and everyone he knows than he does on actual class material. On top of that, mgmt and ba 342 are in huge lecture halls. Just the most dreadful scenario at PSU.
It's so sad that Smeal students have to take two of his classes
You need his class to get into Smeal. Don't be afraid. Read the chapters, go to class, and do the extra credit. you will be ok.
Ron is a character. His tests are pretty straightforward as long as you study.  Put in an average amount of work and you will do fine in this class.
Ron Johnson is the man!
class is mandatory and you need to know his lecture slides to do well on the exams. the TA's are very helpful with material and study help

Ron John seems like a nice guy, and he very well might be, but after the first 20 minutes of class one you will want to smack  him and his giant ego. The material itself is very easy and all about memory but he will make certain test questions wordy and impossible because he doesn't want the test to be easy. Technology and phones are prohibited.

Read the textbook and review your slides when studying for the exam. I highly encourage reading through the book it helped me a lot. Ron is a great guy that wants you to learn his material rather than just memorize it. Exams can be a little tricky but overall a great professor.

The first time you walk into class you will think 2 things: 1) This guy looks like Coach Gordon Bombay from the Mighty ducks, and 2) He seems really nice and chill. FALSE. He stands at a whopping 5'5" with a 10 foot ego and makes the class unnecessarily difficult. Its all models and steps to processes that you MUST memorize to pass.

Really dry class.  Each class period drags on and on, and his lectures get more condescending and less interesting every time.  Heavy use of arbitrary youtube videos and websites for the unnecessarily difficult exams.  Too bad he's your only professor choice for this required-to-graduate class.

He's a nice guy, but has a pretty big ego and tends to brag.  Easy, easy class though.  Definitely read the textbook and take notes, but the reading is very clear, and the chapters are all pretty short.  Go to class, pay attention to what he says, he gives exam hints, and there are participation points and extra credit.  Pretty good class.

he's pretty friendly, but very into himself and all that he's done. He does clicker questions, so going to class is recommended. Should definitely read the textbook. His exams are worded in the most awkward ways possible and by the time you finish reading through the useless stuff, you forget what the question is actually trying to ask.

Ron is a pretty good teacher.  He posts all of his slides online, but I would still recommend going to class just as a way to better understand the material.  He keeps class interesting with videos and clicker questions throughout his slideshows.

He does his best to keep the class interesting but half the stuff he presents during the lecture is completely pointless and unrelated to management, I barely learned anything in that class. If you want to pass the tests, just read the book.

Funny guy and friendly, but really hard exams. If you want to get good grades you need to really read textbook carefully and watch all videos in class. But he will post his ppt online. After all, I think he is good.

He is a good guy, but his test are extremely tricky and unclear. I read the book and went to every class and still only pulled off a b with the extra credit. It'd be better if it was a small class rather than a large lecture.
I don't understand what everyone is talking about. The tests were easy. Right out of the book. There's also a 5% extra credit bonus for your overall grade!

Doesn't teach. For the exam, requires you to watch countless youtube videos and go to websites to memorize the tabs at the top of the page. You won't learn anything, and it's a required course with mandatory attendance and he's the only one who teaches it.

This guy is a moron. So unhelpful, dumb, and gives the stupidest lectures ever. Just study the book and look over the lectures and hope his tests don't unnecessarily trick you like they usually do. Do all the extra credit. Again he is a moron can't stress that enough. Not helpful at all and doesn't acknowledge he is either.
He's a nice guy but his tests are extremely unfair. There is bonus that helps your grade a lot though.
Cool guy.Keeps class interesting with lots of videos. People complain about his tests but they are actually very easy if you go to class or just read the book
Very friendly guy, reminds me of MichaelScott from the office, but his tests are extremely hard.
class is pretty straight forward and you do have to pay attention when he explains how to use certain formulas.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: the course keeps getting difficult with every week, just attend the zoom class he'll explain everything in detail on what has to be done

Class consists of 9 HW's and 3 labs, pop quizzes and extra credit, all pretty easy. He is impossible to reach, emails go to TA's and they either don't respond or don't have an answer for you. If you have a grading problem you'll just have to take that L bc he likely will never get to changing it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Homework assignments due every week, and zoom classes are in the morning. I stopped going to zoom classes unless the zoom focused on hw questions. Labs are relatively hard and very timed. There is a lot of extra credit, so do those!! You can only talk to him during his office hours. Overall he's a great, funny, teacher. Take him for this class!

Zooms are essential to know what you're doing, he did well at explaining concepts for the homeworks. However, it is impossible to message him directly, without reaching all the TA's first (and most of the time they tell you they can't answer your question)... Homeworks are easy, but excel labs are 75 min timed and are very overwhelming.

Good professor, very good at explaining touch concepts. Homework is a bit tough but if your go to class and go to office hours (he is very generous with them) then you should be fine. Textbook is annoying since it's outdated. Overall, he is a pretty great teacher and if you put in the work, it should be an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Solid class, if you put in the time you'll learn what you'll need to. Usually one HW per week, takes about 1-2 hours. Definitely lock in during class and you get what you need for the most part.

Class is relatively easy, but he is not good at communicating with students. There is no way to directly contact him because his email goes to his TAs who tell you to go to office hours which was when I had class. Halfway through the semester half of our grades for homeworks and labs got dropped, and he would not allow students to redo them.

It's not that the class is too hard. He just makes it hard. He doesn't teach a lot in lecture and expects you to struggle on the homework and just figure it out. He is mean to students in front of the whole class who ask questions. He tells you to use chat gpt to figure out everything because he is too lazy to teach.

The absolute goat, attendance not mandatory but definitely go. Homework is tough but lectures teach you everything you need to know and he holds attention easily. Super funny and chill, office hours are a blast and super helpful. Learned a lot from him, my favorite class.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr… sorry, Coach Jones is a great teacher to have for this class. If you pay attention, everything he teaches is so easy to understand.The only slightly confusing thing is the homework that comes from the book, but that's pretty easy to figure out eventually.I feel bad for the amount of incompetent students he has to deal with.Great guy great class
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: He was great, I had him in the summer and all we did was joke around and have class at the creamery 2 twice a week. He grades really hard on the exams and homework, but he curves everyone up to at least a -A also long as you submit everything.

Dr. Jones is an amazing professor! He is very chill. The class mainly consists of homework, which are very similar to the lab exercises. If you can do the homework, the lab exercises will be very easy. He does go fast when explaining things during class, so going to his office hours will be very useful for the one-on-one help. He curves at the end.

I took this course over the summer and it was my favorite class by far. In the summer he does not require a textbook and attendance is not mandatory. I still would recommend going to every class. He is extremely helpful and cares about his students. He is also a pretty funny and chill guy. He will curve a ton at the end of the semester.

Professor Jones is a nice guy, and if you take the effort to pay attention and stay on top of the coarse you will pass with flying colors. I can say this was my favorite coarse this semester. His lectures can be filled with tangents and he moves through the steps a bit too quickly, but that's really my only complaint. He also curves a lot

Force you to purchase his textbook. The excel homework gradings do not make any sense even if you did it right using taught formula. Learn yourself, textbook and his teaching not helping at all. If you want to learn excel, LinkedIn may be a better place.
Best excel coach out there

Professor JONES is great at teaching. At first his class was hard for me as I didn't have the skills in excel. I attended his office hours with  and the TA and they did a great job at teaching and explaining the content. My recommendation is to attend the office hours that are offered in this course in order to succeed. Don't miss troll pop quizes.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Tough class but the professor wants you to succeed. If you go to the lectures which are on zoom you should be fine just try and do the work with a friend. Tests are very difficult but there is always a curve and at the end of the semester he bumps your grade up a letter grade or two.

Dr. Jones has a structured teaching style, but engaging with it pays off. Homeworks can be tough, so work with classmates and use unstuck study for study prep. Overall, a helpful course for business majors.

He can be unnecessarily disrespectful. I never had this problem, but I know people who did all the work, he gave them zeroes, blamed it on them, and never fixed it. Homework is manageable, just don't wait forever. Do w/ friends. NOT enough time at ALL on exams. Book is mandatory and expensive. Useful? NO. But did he write it? Yeah... More $ for him
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Unfortunately this delinquent is the only professor who teaches this class. Get ready to waste $100 on a useless textbook, that he wrote, just to complete a few graded exercises. Lectures are useless, only go for pop quizzes, he'll mention it in announcements. Find others taking the class and work through hw together, and teach yourself everything.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: u have to go to lectures to do well in this class!! HW's and Labs have to be done in his way, but if u go to class & follow his instructions, you will do good! take advantage of TA office hours with HW's they're super helpful. Also an opportunity to redo every homework for up to a 90% if u get lower than that initially. great class if u put work in

Great experience! Class is set up to have a lecture day and a hw day where he is available in person and on zoom for questions. He is helpful and approachable. Cares ab his students and provides options to redo hw to help you earn an A. Curve at the end to give a final boost. If you do fine on the hw then you will do fine on the exams too.

Dr. Jones is a good prof. You can tell he cares about his students. The homework and Lab assignments(tests) are kind of daunting and can be hard. Make friends in the class and help eachother with the homeworks. A very helpful class for any business major.

He does not grade assignments. I would talk to him in office hours about making sure my grades would be acceptable. After he assures me that I would be able to dispute grades. HE NEVER RELEASES GRADES ON ASSIGNMENTS, SO NO DISPUTING OR EVEN SEEING WHAT YOU DID WRONG. I doubt he even graded the assignments, and just gave students a grade he saw fit.

The classes were boring and most assignments were in groups that would change each time which meant it was harder to learn the skills of the team around you. It was easy enough to self teach and make it through but he doesn't grade you throughout the semester so you have no clue how well you are doing.
Weekly homeworks and 3 lab exercises. TA office hours help a lot. practice hws for the lab and work with ppl on hws. he's chill and offers extra credit. always answers every questions
LOVE DR. JONES. He is very kind and tries hard to make sure all of his students will succeed. Doing the bare minimum will allow you to pass this class. Hope to have Doctor Jones in the future!
He's amazing.He's so good at teaching this course it's crazy. Literally the most I've ever taken away from a college course.

Wasn't particularly hard. Just make sure to pay attention during class and you'll do fine. Anything graded is open note/online so you can always google certain functions if stuck. There were only 3 or 4 pop quizzes during the year, and they counted for extra credit if you got them right. Overall funny guy and always makes time to answer questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: curves so heavily that you could go from a 75 to a 95. with that being said, the hw's can be very tedious. you can have the right answer but the grader will mark you wrong if your formula isn't "efficient" enough. assignments due at 6pm friday ... no not midnight ... lectures rarely help w the hw, go to the discussion boards instead. boooooo.

The class was super easy but his voice was grating. All he did was talk about how you could not use chatgpt on his assignments. if you put in a minuscule amount of effort you will get an A.  he spends half of the class time talking about how smart he is for the way he structured the questions.

Overall, the class isn't that difficult. Attendance isn't required unless he has pop-quizzes (he will let you know if there will be one that day). There are 3 lab exercises and about 1 homework a week. The homework don't take too much time and aren't that difficult if you read/ pay attention in class. Has EC opportunities and curves at the end.

Class is a waste of time. You can learn all the material in the class in 2 weeks, he just makes class super pointless on Zoom. His homework is just tedious and the exams are long and can be difficult. You need to buy the textbook for $100 for a few assignments that will take you 15 minutes, and it is 10% of your grade.

This professor is one of the worst professors I've ever had. His homeworks are graded on if you do everything the exact way that he wants it(without any kind of guide on how to do them exactly how he wants). Attendance is necessary but he could give all the information in an short email. I was pretty good at excel before, but I think I'm worse now.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Honestly one of my favorite professors ever! He is always willing to help although intimidating at first. The class is neatly structured with 10 HW and 3 labs. The labs are hard but you can use all the HWs and the internet. Definitely get a friend to work with. I learned so much and he's hilarious. Just ask him about his day or weekend!!

Probably one of the easiest classes I've taken at Penn State. Most of the course is graded between lab exercises and homework (with a little bit of participation/pop quizzes). Lab exercises are open note but have a time limit and involve past lectures, and homework is pretty simple as long as you pay attention and go to TA office hours.

Curve is generous and he's a pretty funny guy. This class tests if you have common sense. If you watch the videos he posts or go to Tuesday classes, the homeworks should be easy. TAs and Thursday classes are useful if you're struggling. Exams are harder in terms of time than content, but if you know how to use the formulas it isn't difficult.

Easy class if you have common sense.I ended with a 97.5% even after not doing the last homework.The curve at the end is pretty insane.Never listened to anything in the lecture because I recorded the zoom sessions all the time and only looked back at it when doing the homework.Textbooks were waste of money since they were useless but are mandatory.

I found this class to be fairly easy. There are only 3 labs that act as the exams. They are pretty much replicas of the hw but a bit harder. I recommend you redo the hws before the labs and you should do just fine. Really nice guy! Its more of a teach-yourself kind of class but still very useful. He curves at the end which raised my grade a lot

Good professor. Expects you to read textbook & watch videos he makes so you teach yourself, then uses class time for demonstrations. Goes over the weekly HWs on Thursdays. Definitely work w/ a friend on the HWs. Pop quizzes sometimes. Exams called "labs" are timed HWs basically. Utilize his + TAs' office hours. Definitely a manageable class.
Class is pretty useless, work with other people in your class and you'll be fine. He curves the grade at the end of the semester so that's a pretty huge advantage.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took MIS-250 as a course in summer session. He is a really funny guy but sometimes it felt like he was there more to be our friend rather than a professor. You could miss every class if you wanted to because he doesn't take attendance. Labs are kinda difficult w/ the time limit sometimes so just prepare.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Took MIS250 in summer session. Talks about nonsense all the time. I had to teach myself everything. Tests can be tough. Homeworks are easy usually. Weird dynamic with his class he usually said nothing of value for all of class except for the last 10-15 minutes. You can skip almost every class. Grade went up to an A- from B range last week of class.
Great guy, if ur not an idiot you will do well in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Probably has never answered a single email in his life, but is an awesome Professor. I had no prior knowledge of Excel, but the HWs helped me prepare for the labs. I feel so much more comfortable with Excel now!
This dude sucks. Class is easy but if you have any questions at all do not expect them to be answered. He doesn't answer emails and is always pissed off about something in class, going on rants.

This class seems more daunting than it actually is, but there is a lot of hw. The professor is great, & is always willing to help. Make sure to start the hw early & attend office hours for homework help. TA's are very helpful. Also, make sure to check the grading corrections, because they're sometimes wrong, & follow up on grade corrections.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: The class itself is alright I guess. Would not take his class again because way too often for no reason he gets irritated. Puts me in a bad mood just from simply attending class a lot of the time.

No prior Excel knowledge needed fr. Thursday classes are Zoom. Labs (AKA exams) must be taken in a computer lab on campus. Listen to him in class. On Thursdays of HW weeks, he basically gives answers to the HW. TA office hours are great, will tell you if your answer is right. He's only scary if you ask questions that he literally just answered
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Ask questions, participate, and practice practice practice. It gets harder as you continue, but it is mainly comment sense. He is a funny guy, great with explanations, but can get sidetracked with his rants. Pop-quizzes are based only on participation with extra-credit for correct answers. If you pay attention, you will do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Jones is great. As long as your start the homeworks a day or two before they are due, you will be all good. Literally gives most of the homework answers away the day before each one is due. Wish I would have taken this class earlier, it would have helped in others. Overall, go to class and pay attention and it will be pretty easy.

Awesome teacher. He has so many great TA'S to quickly answer all questions and go over the homework. Almost 50% of your grade is HW's which you have a week to do with open notes and friends. By the end of the semester you will have the opportunity to earn around a 6% curve to your final grade. I'm also much better at excel now.

Dr. Jones was probably my favorite teacher I've had at Penn State so far. Class isn't mandatory, but if you go and just follow what he's doing on excel you will succeed. The homework and labs are pretty much replicas of what he shows in the lectures. He also changes your lowest homework grade to the average of the other 8.

Do not understand some of the harsh reviews on here at all, Dr.Jones is the man. MIS250 was an amazing time and I actually learned so much useful stuff about excel. Dr.Jones has a hilarious personality and his homework assignments felt more like a mind game almost rather than any other old hw. Defnitely reccomend, think outside the box on the hw!
Show up to all your classes and you will succeed. He is really good at what he does you just have to get past his hatred for computers. Do all assignments and you will do great.

The class was easy. I would attend class or watch online lectures. Every week you will have one homework assignment, and if there wasn't homework, there was a lab. Not sure why students are complaining about the homework as you can get a perfect score by attending Friday homework parties. The labs are similar to the homework assignments.
He was honestly great. Loved that I could watch on zoom. The homework could be tough but tons of office hours available. Would definitely take again.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I don't really understand the poor reviews left on here. His class was pretty easy if you just paid attention at all during the lectures. You could watch the lectures on zoom or occasionally in person when he was having in person class. The exams are lab exercises that use stuff directly from the HW and are open note. I had no excel experience.

My experience doesnt match most of these reviews. Prof. Jones posts plenty of resources attached on the class CANVAS page (linkedin learning lessons, Prof.s videos, TA office hours). Prof. Jones also holds homework parties where you can just go and ask about the homework. Even if he rambles from time to time, hes a good prof.

Class attendance is important cause he shows how to solve stuff in the homeworks. Homeworks are long, taking 1-1.5 hours each. Redoing the homework is the best strategy to prepare for the labs imo. The class involves a lot of busy work, rather than hard work. He also never directly answers questions about the home work in class, so rely on TAs.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: I took this course over the summer, and even though we had to do more work in a shorter amount of time, it was still very easy to get done. I would recommend watching the excel videos he has posted, especially in the beginning if you have never used excel before. Only 9 HWs and 3 Labs, overall not terrible.

Worst professor experience I have ever had. He is not accessible outside class, his exams have a very strict time constraint, and he does not grade based on a rubric, but rather just a number he thinks sounds about right

I had Jones in 250 and 432. He's way more fun in 432! It's more of a discussion class than anything. The only thing is he doesn't grade any assignments during the semester. You just get a letter at the end. But he doesn't seem like a harsh grader at that. Jones is the man.

Dr. Jones is a very kind and funny professor! He really knows what he's talking about and teaching, he makes it very easy to understand the material as long as you pay attention. He is also very accommodating when it comes to inaccurate grades.

He seemed very sarcastic when answering students questions and sometimes never gave a full answer. Information taught in class can be looked up online, however there were 3 pop quizzes where you had to go to class. Class was very boring.

Honestly one of the worst professors you can get at Smeal. Even if you are in class and you ask a question about the material, him and his TA will refuse to answer, and say to pay attention. Impossible to learn the material outside of class. Even students who show up everyday struggle. 10/10 do no recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Go to class and office hours. All you have to do is know when and how to use certain formulas in excel.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Jones was an amazing professor that I would recommend. If you go to class and pay attention to half the stuff he says you should be fine. My only complaint is that he is hard to reach via email so make sure you find some classmates who know what they are doing as well. At the end of the semester he curves grades heavily which really helps.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Jones is not a bad professor, it is just he is impossible to get ahold of. If you send him an email about meeting for office hours, or a question about some of the course material, do not expect a response. The class is not hard thankfully, and when he teaches he's actually a solid professor. It was just brutal the communication
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: As long as you attend the classes and pay attention you will be fine. He is very slow at grading and hard to get in contact with. Although, he is also very easy going when it comes to grading. I had a concussion my for my last assignment so he waited until I recovered, met with me 1 on 1 about the materiel, and was very understanding about it.

If you already have a strong understanding of Excel, this class is not a problem. If you don't have that strong understanding, the lectures are very helpful. On top of that, Dr. J went over how to do a large portion of the homework assignments in class before they were due so it was not an issue either. The labs/tests were a bit of time crunch.

Easily one of the best teachers in Smeal. Funny, respectful, knowledgeable, and capable of delivering online content in a way that makes MIS enjoyable for everyone despite the circumstances. Might be a somewhat tough grader but gives plenty of time and room to perfect your HWs and Lab Exercises. There is no better MIS professor out there. Sign up!!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I thought this class was pretty easy. You have to go to class and follow along in your own excel file. He gives so much extra credit and curves at the end of the semester that you'll be fine even if you don't do well on some assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Go to class and read the book. If you do this, the class is super easy. Homework assignments and labs are a breeze if you stay on pace.

I did not enjoy his teaching style at all, it made it very difficult to learn. I had to learn a lot on my own and teach myself. It was even worse because he does not record lectures. I pay a lot of money to go here, and I feel that I should not have to teach myself.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This class is pretty simple. If you go to class, it's a relatively easy A. If you don't go to class, it will be more difficult because he does not record the lectures. Also, it's college, not pre-school, so don't expect Professor Jones to hold your hand at all times when doing assignments.

Had Dr. Jones in person, and I feel ambivalent towards the experience. On one hand, the in person lectures may have increased retention of course material. On the other, I was normally fighting the urge to zone out due to a lack of student engagement. Take good notes and do your best, Dr. Jones will usually curve grades by a reasonable amount.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: As long as you go to class and pay attention you should be fine. One homework assignment a week and there are three labs which are the exams. I thought that the homework was pretty easy and finished it in a day most times. The lectures are not recored though and doing the homework could be difficult if you miss the in class demonstration.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Honestly, if you go to class you should be fine. Not having prior excel experience does not matter as long as you follow along. HW/labs require you to apply some critical thinking above what he teaches in class. Overall, this class has been one of the most fulfilling classes Ive taken because you learn so much about excel.

Hard to reach, and does not teach very well. He will show a very basic concept in class, and expect you to take it to a completely different level. It is very difficult for those who have never used excel before. Also, his lectures not being recorded does not help at all.

He does not record lectures, which puts students at a bigger disadvantage than they already are with online school. If you miss a crucial part in a class you won't be able to do the assignment because you can not go back and watch the lecture. He is rude and does not really care about his students. Do not recommend.

I really did not like his teaching style at all, and neither did my classmates. He had us read long articles and graded us on small parts of the articles. I felt that I learned nothing from the class, except for how to lower my GPA. I do well in all my classes but with him, I just can not seem to do well.

Would not recommend him. He makes the class extremely difficult, and hard to learn. He shows a very basic example in excel and expects you to be able to take it to a completely different level. For first-time users of excel, good luck! I hired tutors for myself to learn excel because he is not helpful. He needs a different teaching style.

His class featured weekly homework to help you learn that week's material (which I found very helpful), as well as homework based on the book's readings (which feels like busy work). Has a good sense of humor, which is nice when in class. Also posts videos about material to help you with the weekly homework, so don't stress if you miss a class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Jones is really smart and knows a lot about excel, however he seems to be overworked. Constantly behind on grading, anytime you have an issue with a test (lab) or homework grade, expect it to never get looked at again, regardless of how many times you email him about it. Its the end of the semester and I still have missing grades.

MIS250 teaches you a skill. Dr. Jones is extremely knowledgeable and clearly is an excel pro. The only negative is that he comes across as if he has a bad attitude 24/7 in the live lectures. Homeworks are due every Friday, which usually take a couple hours, and the labs are an hour and a half. These make up your whole grade pretty much.

He seems like a cool guy, but I was constantly confused. He doesn't really answer questions and is very confusing about the text book work. The grading is also very weird and he doesnt fix stuff even after you email him However, I learned a lot and did well on his exams.

Do NOT take it with him. He does not answer well to emails even if you follow his protocol. His zoom sessions are boring and NOT helpful. He and his "super TA" have poor attitudes towards students. The prof just decided to stop uploading the only helpful videos for the hw/labs halfway through the semester. Required expensive book that is never used

Okay I know Zoom is hard on lots of professors. However, this man uses the class sessions to simply review and talk about homework or one little aspect. Much of it is learning on your own and with excel, it's very hard to do. Another thing that is ridiculous is he claims the homework isn't supposed to "drag" you down but it is graded very heavily

Not hard, but definitely need to put in a little bit of work to do well in this class. I had no excel background and did fine.
