I was engaged but I can see how it would be easy to space out if you're not interested. The exams were fine and you can boost your grade with other assignments, attend class if you want an A.

Professor Bundro was amazing! His lectures were funny but he related everything to real world scenarios. He gives example problems in class which helps a lot when it comes time for exams and homework. 3 overall tests that were relatively easy. 6 homework's online. A weekly podcast quiz that takes 30 minutes out of your day to complete.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Richard Bundro is the funniest professor I've ever had here. You might not find him funny if you don't get his sarcasm, though. The class consists of 3 noncumulative exams (including the final), easy homeworks on pearson, and daily podcasts plus a weekly podcast quiz. Do the work, pay attention in class, and you'll be fine.

Rich is a very good professor and teaches the material very clearly. He is a funny and cool guy that wants the best for you. No textbook required, only a paid online access code that allows you to do the homework. I enjoy going to his class and would take him again.

Bundro is a great professor who is very knowledgeable about personal finance. This class covers the basics and some interesting things about stocks, annuities, etc. Lectures are pretty easy and notes from lectures are necessary to do well on the exams. Easy A if you study the notes and how to solve problems in class.

Easiest class I've taken in college. I know some people have trouble with the math but the class moves very slowly so you have plenty of time to learn what you're supposed to do. Knows how to speak; lectures were entertaining even though material is kind of dry. Laid back guy. Textbook is pointless if you go to class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: One of the best professors I've had. I was dreading taking this class because I'm horrible at business related classes but he was able to explain super clearly. Attendance isn't mandatory but if you go, it's an easy A. Exams are the bulk of the class so make sure you study well for those.

I took this class through World Campus.  If you do your work, it is super easy, you'll get an A.  You have to work with Excel & Access through SimNet, but if you pay attention you'll be fine! He also makes you create a blog, which I loved because I will use later in life! Seriously, if you do your work, on time & right, you'll be fine!

Professor Bundro makes finance very interesting. He relates just about everything he talks about to real world scenarios, so you can see why it is useful. You memorize short formulas for exams, but he gives a ton of partial credit. One group project that was fairly easy.

Considering finance is a pretty dry subject, I enjoyed his teaching style and his attempt to make things more interesting or relatable. Even though attendance isn't mandatory it is worth it to show up for notes as he discusses a lot of topics with more detail than the book. The tests are hard but he prepares you pretty well for them.
Very vague grading policy, steer clear of this class

Mr Bundro is hilarious, he has this knack for self-deprecating humour. Yes he looks like he doesn't really care about his students but its okay because his lectures are super clear you probably wont need to ask him for help. The book is really helpful too. The tests are super easy. Excellent professor for you if you're a business minor.
Great teacher. There is a quiz, hands on project and discussion each week. It isn't hard to keep pace. Direction is clear and the material is interesting.
He's extremely helpful. Very laid back. I enjoy going to class. I'm not a business major but he makes Finance enjoyable.

Doesn't hand out candy, doesn't give gold stars, no pizza parties or pats on the back. If you actually want to learn about finance in a way that you can apply to real life, take him. And if you just want to cushion your GPA...stay clear. Kind of a hard class, just study his examples that he gives in class. Book is rather useless.
Prof. Bundro is amazing. Extremely helpful. He makes finance easy to understand. Quizzes and exams are tough but if you attend class regularly and note down everything, you'll do well.
He is a cool guy. Although he requires a lot from the students, but if you work hard, this class is not that hard.

This course was defiantly challenging but I learned a ton from Bundro. He's a sarcastic guy but he knows what he's talking about, you will laugh a a lot. A tip, right down everything he says, not just what he puts on the board. The tests are really hard, rely on his examples to study, not so much the book.
If you really want a teacher who is motivated, clean shaven, well groomed and dedicated to providing top qualitiy instructing, look elsewhere. Fear the beard.
the hardest teacher in the smeal college of business. tests are impossible
Very solid knowledge and clear explanation. Nice to students

Overall a good class. First two midterms were easy and the final was definitely cranked up to get a better grade distribution as the averages of the first two exams were about 30-40 percent higher than the final. Doesn't try to make the class awful, very easy class to pass.

Dr. Chu is easily one of the the best professors I've had at Penn State. The coursework is definitely challenging but he does a very good job at explaining it in a way that is approachable. One of my favorite professors, extremely smart and passionate. Lectures can be hard to follow because of his accent but recitation and office hours are extremely useful. This guy rocks. I like him. Go to his office hour. He is more hilarious and very helpful during office hour.

Coutu as always enthusiastic in class and gave help and explanations when needing. The course is hard and is primarily run by the department, not the individual lecturer. Tests are hard, but the homework is harder. If you can take this class with Coutu over Pfau, definitely do so.

Amazing teacher!

Definitely invest in lion tutors for this class. I stopped going to lectures midway through the semester because I did not feel them helping me at all and just used lion tutors instead. This got me above 90% on every exam. The homework is time consuming and nothing like the exams. He is very nice and cares a lot about physics and teaching.

Definitely the best option for phys 211, he was easy to understand and kept the classes engaging with the demos and his Hollywood Physics examples. Expert TA HW sucks but the practice exams are helpful for studying for the midterms so prepare with those 100%.

Though he is nice, this is a very difficult course. You will learn nothing in labs and recitations. GET CHEGG FOR HOMEWORK (Expert TA), it saved my life.

reviews.comment: PHYS 211 is an easy class. I had Coutu at 9:05 AM Monday morning and still went to class every time because he made it entertaining. Not too much work and all of it was helpful. Hollywood Physics and other in class demonstrations were very helpful.
Overall great professor! He plays music right before class starts, which really helped set the mood. He was very understanding of any conflicts.

This course is atrocious but Coutu is the best option. You will learn nothing in labs or recitations, and lectures can be hard to follow because they're SO quick. The structure of PHYS 211 is honestly terrible...homework, labs, and recitations are very time-consuming and are completely unrelated to the exam questions. Exams are multiple-choice, have no partial credit, and oftentimes include trick questions.
Coutu teaches as well as he can, it's the physics dept at PSU's fault for making this course so damn hard. Go to class, take notes, exams are multiple choice but hard.

He would be a good Bill Nye actor and his lectures are fun in the sense that he shows Hollywood clips and applies physics to them. This class is also very tough for people who have no experience with introductory physics in high school.

But the options on the test are very broad.

He makes lectures interesting with the Hollywood Physics examples, and does cool demonstrations. He's also pretty funny, and you can tell he's an expert in the field. The exams are hard and there is a lot of work outside of class to understand the material but that's really not his fault. Overall good experience.
Good teacher and makes class fun. He sometimes flies through examples but with only two lectures a week, it is hard to fit in all the content.

Coutu always made lectures interesting with fun demos and Hollywood Physics movie clips. However, it's hard to extract much from only two 50-minute lectures a week. reviews.comment: Physics at penn state sucks no matter what. And to be fair i did not try at all. Contu was great and he made physics less miserable. If ur like me and u don't care about physics, or unlike me and really want to do great, take it with him. Hes chill, funny, interesting lectures, and a genius.

Prof Coutu is a great teacher and a mastermind. He is so intelligent and always makes class lectures fun by implementing scenes in movies with what we're learning. He also does lots of exam problems in class, and while attendance isn't mandatory, he takes tophat questions for participation points and the lectures are extremely helpful.

Coutu seems like a nice guy but i learned next to nothing in his lectures. there was also a ton of difficult homework each week, and he expects you to watch a lecture-length video before each class. Overall i was saved by the curve and the the practice problems for the exams.

Everyone says he is the best but I learned nothing in that class. I got lucky that I took physics in high school that taught me most of the stuff because I would be completely lost. His lectures go over irrelivent things. He saves a last exam problem for the end of class and we never had time to go over how to actually do it.

PHYS 211 is a hard course, especially if you're new to college-level physics in its entirety. Coutu at least tries to make his lectures interesting, which I can really appreciate. However, be prepared to do a lot of self-teaching and problem-solving.

I learned nothing from lectures, so if you have not taken a previous physics course, get ready for a lot of self-teaching. He made lectures incredibly fun and interesting through clips and many demos. I enjoyed him, but would have probably failed if I had not taken ap physics because he doesn't teach much.

You will struggle if you have minimal physics experience. The class is designed to be a weed-out, but Coutu tried to make lectures entertaining even though they were a waste of time as we only did practice problems and he barely actually taught the material. You really have to self-teach and read the textbook to understand concepts.
The course itself is designed in a bad way. We barely learn anything in the lectures. they are a waste of time. Professor Coutu was an okay, but he was definitely better than other professors.

This guy is amazing! The lectures are fun and clear, and even though I didn't always do the reading, that was OK since the lectures and personality of this guy were so good. I was this close to being put with Keim, I'm so thankful to God that I got put here instead of with Kiem! Just show up, do the reading, and do the HW and you should get an A

Pretty easy class. Exams are like algebra if you use the formula sheet as it is supposed to. Just put yout effort on understanding the concepts, maybe watch some youtube videos if you find lectures hard to follow.
This class is very easy, you could get an A if you spend more than 3 hrs each week.
Professor Couto is a fine teacher although the physics curriculum here is adequate at best. If you have taken any high school physics courses, you will most likely receive a B or higher.

Coutu is the best professor option for PHYS 211. The physics department as a whole is not overly-reliant on lectures to teach material, but Coutu's interesting, fun lectures essentially review material from the "Pre-Lecture" assignments and help gain a deeper understanding. He is super available through Piazza. Class is extremely exam heavy.
reviews.rating_tags: Hilarious--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Coutu is amazing. His lectures are fun and interesting. The class can be difficult depending on your commitment to do the work and attend lectures as well as your past physics/Calc experience. I took this concurrently with Math251 and EMCH210, so it was easy work, but managing it with a lot of credits can be difficult.

Such a hard class but Dr. Coutu is the best option for PHYS 211 because apparently the other teachers are not good. Hes a very nice guy who is trying is best. The physics department is just completely a mess.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Prof Coutu is definitely the way to go for phys 211. The course is set up pretty badly, but he tries to make the lectures as interesting as possible. He also has a great sense of humour (and a new music playlist lined up every lecture before class starts). The homeworks made me want to tear my hair out though, so definitely go to office hours.

The class is difficult, but his pre-lecture videos and the homework were helpful. He is very kind. Office hours are frustrating because he takes extremely long to answer questions, but he is always willing to help.

Coutu is the best option for 211 and he does the best he can. The physics department is just trash in general so its going to be awful with whoever u take it with but Coutu is a good option. Tests are really rough. Participation in lectures is 2% of final grade. Averages of midterms were <70. All I gotta say for this class is good luck Charlie.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: PHYS 211 is a very tough course regardless but Professor Coutu made his lectures helpful and interesting. The exams on the other hand were very difficult so make sure to attend all review sessions and start studying at least a week ahead. Overall, I'm glad to have had him as my prof for 211.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Coutu is a nice teacher. His lectures contain interesting movie clips. His explanations are detailed and easy to understand. Although the content of this course is hard, he still puts lots of effort into pre-lecture videos and review sessions and trying to help students with complex questions. All in all, he is a good choice.

Physics is hard, so it will be hard to find a physics professor with a high rating. Out of the two available 211 professors, I am really glad that I chose Coutu, because I have heard not so great things about the other options. Coutu is very knowledgeable, but my only complaint is that he moves very fast in class. Besides that he is decent.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This class is HARD, not going to lie, but Coutu is a good teacher. He does his best to explain everything really well and he does care about his students. He's not super accessible out of class, but he has like a million students so that's understandable. MyLab is AWFUL and nothing like the exam questions, but besides that, Coutu is a good teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: PHYS211 is a hard course and its difficult no matter what. Coutu tries at giving help, advice, and to prepare you for lecture. But to be honest, lectures don't help. You'll better just reading the textbook and studying off the practice exams and practice exam problems. MyLab hw is a pain and is NOTHING like the exams until the prac. exam questions

You can tell he really cares about the subject and teaching. He does his best to keep it lighthearted and I honestly think he's doing his best. The class is really tough, but I don't think that's his fault. He puts in a lot of time outside of class pre-recording videos and helping students, so take advantage of it!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: The lectures are kind of useless, but that's less Dr. Coutu's fault and more the fault of the class itself. Hollywood physics examples tended to help understanding some during lectures. Definitely go to his "office hours" tho. It's basically a class room q&a setting where he can work thru any questions you could possibly have on homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: The physics department is kind of a mess, but Dr. Coutu was fine. Go to class for the clicker questions, and just do your English homework or something (that's what I did). The homework wasn't awful but its a lot of "teach yourself and hope for the best". Lab and recitation was taught by TAs and they were not very helpful though.

It really doesn't matter who you choose as your professor for Phys 211 or 212. It's only two lectures per week (Lab and recitation are with TAs). Professor Coutu is good at lecturing and will give a you a good grasp on basic concepts. Homework was THE WORST. Tests were easier than assigned homework.

PHYS 211 is a tough class. You will have to work hard for a good grade in it. Dr. Coutu's lectures are informative and helpful. The demos he does in class are good to see physics in a "real" manner. There is a ton of HW and the 4 MC tests(15 Questions) throughout the semester will make or break your grade. He is a good choice.

Definitely a strange character. Didn't see much of him after remote learning commenced, but the time spent before then was well-spent. HW was time-consuming, and went over a lot of concepts; lectures helped to condense the material into digestible chunks. Easily the worst part of the class is the 4 MC exams where the margin for error is very slim.
Professor Coutu's a really good professor and he does his best to make it interesting. It doesnt really matter which physics professor you get, the class is going to be really hard no matter what.
If you go to his office hours you will get an A in his class. He will redo lecture and go over subjects as much as you need. So helpful

Doesn't really matter which professor you take, you're still screwed. Honestly the smarter option is to take PHYS121 from bucks county over the summer. It's expensive if you don't live in-county but you will thank yourself that you didn't have take the class at PSU just to fail it. Otherwise Coutu makes lecture as interesting as possible.

Hollywood physics was really fun and helpful. Dr. Coutu cares and is very accessible outside of class and good at explaining concepts. One of the better professors. The course is difficult, not him. Go to all the reviews even if you think you know the material because it helps hearing problems explained. Learn the practice tests by heart.

Overall an amazing lecturer; his Hollywood physics and demos are always entertaining. You MUST take each sample exam seriously, they help to gauge the actual exams difficulty. Don't lose easy points with Mastering physics, labs, or recitations. Skim the textbook, review lecture slides, and do extra homework problems (know your formulas) works best.

Dr. Coutu is a great teacher, it's just that Physics in itself can be a difficult subject. The tests are difficult, but are truly an indicator of how prepared you were for it. Do the practice tests, breathe the practice tests, be the practice tests. They are your lifeline for this class
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Recitations, labs are easy. Clickers are tricky. Homework takes a lot of time, cheating on it screws you over for exams. Lectures don't help as the homework and exams are much harder than what is taught, do NOT count on them. READ THE TEXTBOOK. The average for exams was in the 60s and 70s. The best way to prepare is to do tons of practice problems.
reviews.rating_tags: Tests? Not many--Tests are tough--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Physics here is in itself a hard class and these lectures did not help.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests are tough--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Mechanics can be tough in a large lecture type setting but Coutu was definitely one of the better professors to take it with. Did a good job of explaining the material and was willing to answer questions. Probably one of the better 211 professors to end up with.

Physics 211 is going to suck no matter who you take it with. But I enjoyed Dr. Coutu's lectures because he always tried to make connections to real life, but sometimes that stopped him from really emphasizing the material needed for the exams. He's really nice, always willing to answer questions, and his Hollywood Physics is pretty interesting.
Demos are really interesting

He's awesome in all ways I can find. His demos are amazing. No stupid focusing on calculating details. In short, he's wonderful in all words I can find. So sad I cannot take Phys 212 with him because he doesn't teach that class. I can't tell how much I want my 212 professor to be him.

Physics was by far the hardest class I took my first semester. The tests were only 15 questions which made it hard to get an A. I studied extremely hard for this class and still was unable to do well. Physics is not my strong side but they made it much more difficult and confusing than they needed it. Coutu was okay but better than others Ive heard
Tests are hard but extremely short, so be careful! He is not to be blamed about the test.
I enjoyed his lectures. He was entertaining and includes things to help keep your attention.
You should not be in college if you cannot appreciate PHYS211!
fabulous

Hollywood Physics really makes lectures interesting, and Coutu does his best to get through the ridiculous amount of material (we covered Chapter 13 in one lecture). Sometimes he'd run out of time, though, leaving the harder example problems for you to look at on your own. Do the assigned reading. Bring your clicker.

Here's the deal: EVERYONE who takes PHYS 211 at Penn State does the exact same assignments and takes the exact same exams. So no matter who you pick, the class won't be any harder or easier. But, Dr. Coutu is definitely one of the better lecturers. He's very clear and dynamic, and has a couple of fun lecture segments that are actually interesting.
I loved his lectures, made passing easier and he is very good at speaking and keeping a class engaged!
He balls instead of teaching  "Steph Coutu with the Shot Boi"

Obviously he is not going to be able to cover all of the material presented in the book, but it seamed he chose to discuss material that was harder to understand from reading the book. I took this class with a regular high school physics course as my background. AP physics would have helped, but I was still able to get an A with a lot of studying.

You'll learn almost nothing practical in the lectures that you can't learn with the terrible textbook. Worked out mathematical examples are unheard of in class. Lectures are forced with clickers. The lectures are good for enjoying some videos and conceptual learning, but that's it. You won't be prepared for exams just by going to class. Good luck.

He is a good professor even though I do not like physics at all he's lectures were interesting, he had a segment called hollywood physics where you would watch parts of movies and examine the physics of it. he's office hours got crowed but he answered everyones questions with detail. Also a very nice guy who cares about his students

Everything I learned about physics, I learned through Youtube and the homework assignments.  His lectures or the associated labs and recitations were pretty pointless and full of trick questions that confused more than inspired.
He is the man. I like the way he keeps the class in action. Take him and you will not regret. PHYS 211 at PSU is Hard but the professors are not to be blamed.

Alot of people seem to blame the difficulty of the exams on Coutu, but really its just the physics department. Multiple professors make up the tests.  Its a weed out course, meant to be difficult.  As far as his teaching, hes pretty much the best youll get for Physics. GO TO OFFICE HOURS. Theyre EXTREMELY helpful. He'll really help you understand

Physics at PSU is hard no matter who you take it from, but Coutu's class is at least interesting. He's put real effort into preparing interesting lecture slides and it shows. I've never laughed so much in a STEM class
Great Lecturer as far as physics goes. He had mp3 and notes for classes except for mp3 for review. Review classes were enough to get a B on exams. Office Hours = WebAssign hours. Very passionate.

Eh... you don't learn a whole lot in lecture. Most of your learning will come from doing the homework. Do it with friends, it helps a lot. Lecture was good to reinforce topics and for sample exam problems. Some of the problems are put straight onto exams. Got an A- but studied a ton. Really try to do homeworks on your own first. Rotation sucks.

He is a great guy at explain problems and most concepts. He class was always interesting and his HOLLYWOOD PHYSICS videos always kept me focused. Physics is going to be hard no matter who you have, especially if you havent seen it before.

Ok Penn State physics is going to be hard. As far as giant lecture hall teachers go, Coutu was pretty good. Obviously you have to put in a lot of work and many people did receive bad grades, but you just have to take responsibility and study. Coutu is pretty entertaining and he does care about his students.

Yes, his lectures were a little bit of a skim over what you really had to know, and he does go through example problems in class too quickly. However, I think that he's great in office hours. Do EVERYTHING you're told. Read the book, go to lectures/office hours, do extra problems/homework. He even does audio commentary on lectures. Just work hard.

I dont see why people dont like him here. Hes honestly the most fun and interesting teacher I have here.  The tests arent too hard, but there are lots of trick questions. Just do the homework and take the tests carefully and youll be fine.  Hes a good guy, trust me. everyone else here probably just hates physics in general, no him.

I did not have a good experience with Coutu's physics class.  The physics itself is not hard, but the way he teaches and tests it is extremely difficult.  Exam practices are not representative of what will actually be on the exam.  The only way to pass this class is to form a study group with friends and work on homework and study with them.

I have never hated a person more than this.  Exams were impossible.  The book was a summary of what it should have said.  Lectures do not help you do the homework or exams.    If you don't know physics going in then you probably won't know it going out.  There is only 1 211 professor per semester so you won't have a choice anyway.  Have Fun!!!
The professor himself sticks to his note too much and sometimes doesn't explain concepts clearly.

Professor Coutu isn't suited for teaching physics. He may be an intelligent physicists, but he  doesn't break down the information to make it comprehendable. The only students I know that does very well in his class are those who took years of physics in high school. This man is highly unrecommended. Take at another university if possible.

Professor Coutu is the worst professor @ penn state. The material he teaches isn't difficult, the way he teaches it is dificult. The exams are extremely difficult, definitely doesn't correspond with the lectures or homework for that matter. I highly suggest this course be taken at another university possibly during the summer time.

Mr. Coutu is a Caltech alumni and should be teaching there or at MIT, not at Penn State...and I'm guessing that less than 10% PSU students can actually fully comprehend what this man is saying during his lectures. Also note that Mr. Coutu's exams are fricking un-"infinitesmally", his favorite word, IMPOSSIBLE!!!

This professor is the worst man ever to teach physics at PSU.  His lectures are horrible and his TA's will not help you whatsoever in recitations.  My TA has the highest voice and refuses to let me know if I am on the right track.  His tests are extremely impossible and if I were you, I would jump off Old Main before you took this man's class.
My grades went up when I stopped going to class.
Not a very good lecturer. Slides are usually not comprehensive. Tests are harder than necessary. Very helpful in office hours, but not so much during lecture. If possible, I'd take someone else.

He is one of the professore that I really admire. He is excellent as far as you come to class and have an idea about the lecture prior to class. If you one of those who gets things quickly, you will love him. Also, he is very helpful and want you to do well.

While an overall nice guy who is willing to help a student out during office hours, his lectures feel rushed without giving sufficient time to process them and leave no wiggle room for questions.  You have to attend to solve the examples, but after another professor stepped in one day I realized that Coutu doesn't really teach in an understable way

He's very helpful but gives an attitude like your not worth his time. Second and Final Exam were Brutal. Don't use facebook to help you cause it wont teach you anything and then you'll fail the exams. Lectures boring, and never seemed to use applicable examples in class. Taught how to manipulate formulas(easy)instead of which formulas to use(hard).

He's a good lecturer, and explains things quite clearly. Many people say he is boring, but I think that is only because they don't enjoy the subject.  So, if you are taking a physics course, I would recommend him.
The lectures are highly uninteresting and really do not help at all on the homework, but he does cool demonstrations.  The tests are rough.

Ok, time to put things in perspective. The majority of 'impossible homework and exam problems' come straight from the book, meaning they're not any more difficult than they're SUPPOSED to be. If you want to be prepared for exams, do some of the triple dotted problems from the book. Also, this is Penn State, expect a class like physics to be hard...

he's a nice guy and helpful when you go for help, but his tests are VERY hard.  There's no use going to lecture because it wouldn't help much on the test or homework.  Just read the book and do all the sample tests.

Don't let the first exam fool you. The 2nd exam and final just come out of nowhere. His lectures are so simple you'll come under the impression he can't possibly make the exams bad, and the first exam seems to prove that. I've heard he's, comparitively, a very good Physics prof as opposed to some others. Take his class at your own risk.
His lectures are for 5 year olds, his tests will make you cry. The TA's are useless, but the labs are easy.
he is very knowledgleable about physics but his test are impossible. i repeat: IMPOSSIBLE! other than that hes pretty cool

Dr. Coutu is very intelligent, however, he makes everything sound as easy as elementary school math. Interesting class, but, be prepared for no-partial credit tests, annoying labs, and TA's that don't feel like helping you with recitations. It's not as bad as I make it sound, but if you think you're a physics whiz from high school, guess again.

Coutu sucks at lecturing. He makes everything seem so easy, when in reality, the tests and homework are absurdly difficult. The lectures are pretty much useless since all the learning in the class is done on your own. The only reason to go to lecture is to see hollywood physics. He's a nice guy who tries to make lectures cool, but the class sucks.
dude, it's physics by Werid Al!

Until Coutu, I had never slept through a lecture. I really do want to stay awake--I want to learn and all that. I have tried caffeine, I have tried extra sleep, I have tried taking down EVERY word he says, but no dice. Lectures are DECEPTIVELY EASY. Coutu makes it seem like physics is a piece of cake, then he blindsides you with tests and homework.
great teacher, explains concepts very well.  if you go to lecture, you will get a good grade in the class

He cannot lecture to save his life.  He gives simple examples in class and then the homework problems are  tougher than should be expected.  He also likes to make his exams impossible, further perpetuating the reputation of the class as being a weed-out course.

Stephane Coutu is a great lecturer. He is so quirky and puts himself out there with funny demos that are interesting. He also incorporates a "Hollywood Physics" section that is really fun. The tests aren't easy, and neither is the homework, but I at least enjoyed the lectures.
Damn French People!
best physics lecturer i've had, exams a little hard but managable

Hollywood Physics was great. The power point show was well prepared and he worked hard on it. When he went over problems it could have been clearer, but its a hard subject. Also he made sure to tell us what was going on, like if a problem was deleted.
this class was cake...coutu hooked it up and hollywood physics was awesome
Only goes over formulas not very many examples dealing with HW and Exams.
I love the hollywood phyics.  It makes class worth going to.

Dr. Coutu is very unique. His lectures are ok, he isn't very clear when helping with homework, but the exams are all right. For one of the few profs who teach Physics 211 (if there are any others), the class is decent.

3 weeks left in the semester and I don't even know what my grade is. She will grade things in the submission box on assignments and just give you a letter grade. Also, assignments are not graded by the rubric, but rather how much she likes you. Avoid if you can.

This course was frustrating due to poor organization and unclear expectations. Lectures were often confusing, Canvas was not consistently updated, and assignment directions were unclear. Grades were rarely posted, making it difficult to know my standing in the class. Questions asked are extremely vague.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I somehow came out of a class worse at English than when I entered. Aside from the fact that she asks questions that make no sense, gives a million confusingly vague assignments, calls on you if you even make eye contact with her, questions you until you say something wrong, and DOESN'T HAVE INTERNET AT HOME... she tries to be nice, I guess.

She's very sweet but asks questions that barely make sense and expects answers immediately. She doesn't actually grade the poetry but will leave comments on your work that also don't make sense. I made really good friends in this class though because we trauma bond through the poetry she has us write.
She was the most organized and caring teacher. You will be so glad that you took this class. It was my favorite.

I reached out to her multiple times to set up a meeting because ALL of her office hours were during class time (for multiple people), but she never reached out. Her comments make no sense and very confusing. She is the lowest grader out of all this class's professors. She seems to only give better grades and bonus to those who go to office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Took 202A She is clearly very knowledgeable about her field and for that I give her credit. However, I think she expects her students to be on her level and we clearly arent. Calls you out in class randomly, expects in depth work, and attendance is mandatory you lose grade percentage for skipping. She is super nice though and always there to help
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I took ENG 202A with Prof. Ketz. She's a tough, grader —I got a C on a presentation because she said I lacked background, even though the topic overlapped with her research. She calls on students randomly and doesn't post grades on Canvas, just attendance. Grades drop 3% per absence or tardy.

The class was ok. she would give us a writing assignment without a rubric so I didnt know what I was supposed to do. But she is an easy grader and will give you credit as long as you participate in class. But dont skip, my grade went from a 100 to an 87 because I missed a class because I was sick. Your grade is your attendance.

Is a very tough grader, the grade goes down very quickly with every class missed. I got an A on every project, except for a B on one and still had a final grade of a B. Likes to call on people randomly, and will continue to ask them questions until they say something wrong.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: While the class may start very rough, it does get easier. I found it hard to believe it myself but I earned that this professor really does just want to help students so if you need help just ask.

Don't get me wrong Prof. Ketz clearly knows a lot about the material we are learning but it's a tough class if you don't participate or pay attention. Attendance is mandatory. The amount of work we did was awful with hundreds of different readings on top of 3 essays, a podcast, and the final. She expects WAY too much for being an intro class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Prof. Ketz clearly knows a lot about the material she teaches, but I feel like she expected us to keep up with her levels of analysis which is nearly impossible for non-English majors. That said, she is an understanding person who values the opinions of her students. She truly wants you to do well, so maintain communication during the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Ketz is overall a good professor, she is clearly extremely intelligent and loves what she teaches. Her class focuses more on the philosophy side of English. Liked this class because it involved a lot of group lead discussions. However, the main thing I didn't like was that she didn't grade anything until the end of the year.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Shes nice but she has strange prefrences like we never had small groups (strange not to have for an English class) and she would make people talk instead of just moving on. She's grades well and everything its just one or two things that bring her down to not being good.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Don't take this class if you're broke because you WILL have to spend money to bring print copies of 20+ page articles to class almost daily, which you will use for maybe 1 class. She's a sweet woman who obviously cares about her students, but she overestimates the prior context these students have, considering this is a freshman level course.

Prof. Ketz seems to be a nice caring person. For Engl50, workshops(discussions of peers pieces) was a big portion of the class. Even though I dont like writing, the class was good overall and my grade is higher than what I expected.

Dr. Ketz is overall not out to get you. The class is just difficult if you are not prepared to pay attention. There is A LOT of reading due. 3 essays, 1 podcast piece, and 1 final presentation. Overall, the class was definitely not my favorite, There are quizzes on the readings occasionally, but most importantly, be ready to participate.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: LOTS OF POLITICAL PHILOSOPHY READINGS!!!! if you don't like reading about old political philosophers, this class isn't for you. However, she is a very nice person if you show that you are working at the class. She gave me a week extension for a paper, and tbh it was a B at best, but she saw how great I was working so she gave me an A
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Overall, she treated this intro class as if we were all majoring in cultural sciences and honestly thought this was the only class all year. There were readings about 30 pages long which their would be a test on with the answers needing to so specific everyone would fail. The essays have the fastest turn around of any class with a week to do it.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Ketz is a lovely person. She is one of the most understanding and caring professors I have ever come across. English 50 is an easy A with only three assignments and one final revision. As long as you complete them and participate in class you'll get an A. She truly is an amazing person who is passionate, you can't help but love her.

Dr Ketz is really nice and she actually cares. She was always changing the class based on our input, which I appreciated. Still, it was maybe the most challenging class I had that semester. Be ready to read lots of political theory and write long papers. I had no interest in the subject, but I still really enjoyed the class from how she ran it
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: This class is easy if you show up, occasionally participate, and complete the essays. The only grades are the five essays (no final), attendance, and participation. I never bought the textbook or read the readings & I received an A. Also, talk to her after class/office hours & make her like you. That's half the battle with professors.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Basically, if you can write a good essay and hit all the requirements on it, you'll get A's on all the papers. I did not participate in class and got 50% in that category but got A's on all the required essays which is why I did so well. No final. Only essays and a multimedia project. Charity is a tad annoying but what prof isn't??
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Prof. Coll teaches some pretty difficult subjects, but keep in mind she is a also very tough grader. This combo is not particularly great for your GPA if you care about that sort of thing. I had her for 2 courses this semester and they both took up most of my time.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Game Theory is a tough class, but Professor Coll is helpful and understanding. Stay on top of the material and use resources like unstuck AI along with the textbook to do well.

Game theory is a very hard class, and Coll's lectures were hard, but she is willing to take time out of her day to help you. Her course relied heavily on quizzes, so if you fail one, you don't end up doing well. Good thing was that her tests were open notes, so you can use your notes, even on the final. The projects she assigned were fun.

Don't take this class. Excessive amounts of reading. Exams include frivolous specific questions on article reading. Goffe voices lectures, dreadful to watch, boring, time-consuming. The class is basically the Solow model and then specific development factors. Boring and useless unless you want to work for a foreign aid org.
Good course overall. Do the workbook practice type problems and you will be okay for exams. The homework answer keys are really brief but if you email the professor she will help.
reviews.rating_tags: Caring--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Game Theory is an extremely hard class. I was doing okay until halfway through the course. The material seems easy in the lessons but the test questions are very different and much harder from the practice problems she gives. Weekly quizzes are no help. Accessible teacher is understanding and willing to help. The class itself is super hard.
Great lessons, but lacking in consistent real-world examples. Very rigid with rules, no exceptions for anything.

Be aware she will ask you questions on the midterm that you will not be able to solve even if you have studied, even if you have memorised the textbook. Its unfortunate but unless you can spot the trick to the problem you will miss a question. That to me seems very unfair and if I could drop the class I would. I have never been more disappointed.

This class was very difficult, but Professor Coll was willing to help out as she could - often answering questions in a lot of depth to make sure we all understood. This was a class that you could easily get lost - it's really up to you to ask for help, but as long as you asked, Professor Coll was always willing.
Decent Professor but shes not very interesting in her teaching style. Not a tough grader

I took game theory with Professor Coll online. I very much enjoyed the class. It was tough, although she went easy on me with grading, and was very accommodating when I was going through a tough time with my medical condition. Prof. Coll is a wonderful professor, Id take another class with her except Im graduating this fall!

I've had Professor Coll for a couple of classes. She's a solid professor and is easily reachable. This particular course was one of the toughest I've taken. It's a heavy subject but extremely interesting.

Great class. Weekly quizzes on the book so unfortunately you need to do the reading. Homework every two weeks based on the lecture videos. Exams were long but the questions were similar to the homework. Professor was helpful when I emailed with questions on the homework but she was very strict on deadlines.

Get ready for the most mind-numbing class ever. The prof doesn't even attempt to actually teach. It's nothing more than an expensive Khan academy class. Watch a few videos & take a test. No real thought or work put into this class, you will prob get nothing out.
Pretty easy to get an A, if you do the work.
Really interesting class but hard. You definitely need the book.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Excellent Professor She cares about her students.

You can definitely do better. Course is loaded with 6 hw assignments which is 20% of your grade, weekly quizzes is 20% of your grade, and 3 exams that are worth 60% of your grade. Concepts are challenging and not explained well. I would say shop around for a more reasonable econ 102 course.
The class is tough but I learned a lot. Prof. Coll was really helpful via email when I got stuck on some homework problems.

The class was easy enough but the few times that you actually require the instructor's input, she doesn't help at all. If you get something wrong on the exam and ask why, she tells you to figure it out and ask again. Uh, that's what I attempted on the exam... No discussions, all weekly quizzes, homework every other week + midterm and final.

I took this class through World Campus. I'm an A-B student. This class there's no way I could get an B. She tries to trick you on the quizzes. Her questions are very wordy so you get lost in translation. I know the material but the wordiness of the questions really tripped me up. There was no fluff work. All quizzes, homework and exams. No forums.

I had Prof. Coll for intermediate microeconomics online. She was very understanding when it came to the one late assignment I had, which I appreciated. She's a pretty easy grader in my opinion, as long as you pay attention to the online lectures. Overall, no complaints. I enjoyed her class.
really good prof. really responsive via email. material is a bit dense but she tries hard to help where she can.
I really liked the course and the professor. She's super smart but makes everything easy to understand. She's one of the nicest professors I've ever had, she was always willing to help when needed.
She was very very easy and gave you just enough time to complete assignments. I definitely recommend her.
Mrs. Coll is awesome! She explains things very well. I highly recommend her. She now teaches at CSN. If you need Economics, she is the teacher you want!

She is such a good professor! She isn't out to get you for the exams. She gives us review sheets which are quite helpful and the exam questions are pretty much straight out of it. plus, she plays fun videos in class which are related to the topics. She makes things easy for us! PICK HER!

Literally this class, she gives you all the problems and everything ahead of time. It's extremely simple and the final exam is based off of old exams. If you put in the effort you'll get a good grade. And don't buy the book it confuses you.

This is by far the best class I've taken, and Coll is definitely my favorite professor. We focused on Health Care Economics the whole semester, and the course grade consisted of 2 fairly easy papers, 2 essay exams with the questions given beforehand, and a group speech. If you need to take 404W, I would highly recommend taking it with Coll. No book

practice problems are the same on homeworks and exams from class. that being said the multiple choice part of the exams are really hard. there's no extra credit just hw and exams as your grade. dont buy the book it confuses you.

Easy class. Most of the questions on exams are previous questions you went over in class or very similar. She is always willing to help if you have any trouble and she shows a lot of videos to illustrate economic concepts. She is very attractive as well! Take this class with her.

In my opinion, the class was pretty difficult. Exams were difficult (especially the multiple choice). There was no EC, just 3 HWs (of which lowest is dropped), 2 exams, and a final. Professor Coll tries to keep the class interesting with films/videos but the overall structure of the course wasn't the best (Bookstore slides as notes).

She's really easy for this class. She explains clearly what will be on the test, and the homeworks and assignments are fair and graded easily. Don't treat the class as a joke, but if you do the homework and study reasonably for the tests its an easy A.

I don't know why people are saying she's a bad teacher. She really isn't. I thought she was very clear in her lectures and was very fair. Knew the material and helped students when they asked questions. Having said that, the TA was a complete idiot.. took off points of your homework and tests if the answer wasn't word for word with what he had..

I had her for econ 2 and 333 and they were night and day. Econ 2 was fun and extremely easy. I needed a 52% on the final for an A. Econ 333 however completely different story there was never enough time for the short answer part off the test meaning massive points were taken off because no one ever finished. This really hurt final grades.

McCann was a great professor. She was easy to understand and follow. Her exams were easy. Shes fun and likes to show funny clips in class. I liked the econ related videos she showed, they really helped for the exam. Don't buy the textbook, its unnecessary. I'm a totally straight girl, but I was borderline attracted to her. She's smokin' HOT!!!!!!!!

Everything she went through in class was dry and boring. She reads from her slides and does not seem to know the material. The material she goes over is easy to understand but the test questions do not relate to the material in class and are worded tricky. I am an econ major and I did not enjoy her class. Mediocre to poor teacher at best.
we never watched any colbert report clips or did anything fun in SP10 semester. lots of ec if you come to class. not bad she makes it easy to understand. dont bother buying the book
Best Econ teacher! VERY EASY CLASS... she gives out tons of EC which helps A LOT! EASY A... Highly recommended .. >.<

Prof McCann teaches everything crystal clear. She gives extra credit out almost every day so go to class to take advantage of this. The exams were straight from notes, homework, and class examples. You do not need to buy the textbook for this class. We watched movies and clips often that weren't always relevant to the material. Got an A. Loved her!

This class didn't seem like a 3rd level class at all. She did problems in class very similar to the hw and exams and Gave tons of extra credit. I easily got an A in the class, just review her notes, practice problems, and homework. Even showed Jay leno once in a while to keep it entertaining. Recommend this class
i loved this class. very interesting and lots of easy extra credit if you go to class. exams were pretty easy and she shows some really good movies. would def recommend taking her class

I don't know why everyone says McCann is so hard, this class was a joke.  Extra credit accounted to ~4% on my overall grade...the class is a breeze, and after every exam you get to watch a movie for extra credit

I loved this class. She was really nice and very helpful. I found the material interesting for the most part. Attendance is not mandatory, but she tells you everything on the exams. DONT get the textbook, not needed at all. Material itself not too difficult. Gives a ton of extra credit. Overall, it was a good, easy class. (got an A)

Class is boring and she takes attendance, but going to class and a little studying gets you an A. She can be a little unclear at times. Take notes when she tries to teach about current events because they will be on the exams.

after not having passed this class the first time, i didn't want to go through it again. but she restored my faith. very easy to understand, very well paced. we also watched clips, but not always on econ, which gave our brains a break. take her if you really want to learn econ. and the t.a. was helpful, too.

Classes were generally boring but very straightforward and clear. Midterms were difficult, but homeworks and the final were easy. Lots of extra credit opportunities to balance out toughness of tests. McCann is also very nice and willing to talk and explain things in more detail. Overall good class, if a bit dry at times.

Class wasn't bad at all.  She gave lots of E.C. and over-accommodated on things people thought weren't fair (take-home portions of exams, homeworks, E.C. added to exams, etc.).  Also, she is super nice if you actually talk to her and wants people to do well. Pay attention in class and you should be fine.

This teacher is even dumber than she looks. Her class is painfully boring and dumb-minded. Concepts are extremely easy and tests questions are ridiculous hard. They are broad and wordy and meant to trick you. You will walk away from this class learning absolutely nothing. Waste of time.
Very helpful and gives lots of extra credit.  Showing up to class and paying attention will get you an easy a
class is a joke with tons of extra credit.  if you dont get an A you're mentally handicapped.  You watch a lot of movie clips, colbert report, etc.  and she's hot.
Very easy class. Very slow-paced. Easy exams. Explains materials multiple times and thoroughly.
Loved her class! Made the concepts very clear and gave a TON of extra credit.  Lots of fun activities in class, very easy homework, and easy exams if you study!
Learning alot and not working hard to do so... fun class... actually look forward to it.

She talks fast. Basically read throught the powerpoint + little explanation. Don't buy the text, but you defenitely need the note. She'll give you lots of extra credits and tests are not bad. Attendance is not recorded but you'd better come to the class due to many extra credits

This class is not hard, but she is very strict in grading our work.(and that's my only complaint) she's very helpful in office hours. I think she's a nice person, a fair grader and knows what shes talking about + explains it well. I liked her, and if were to offered this class again, I would take it with her
not a bad teacher but who makes attendence manditory with 600 students in it

Took her as a new prof to PSU. At the time, she read off the powerpoint and didn't explain very well. Going up after class for 1:1 was very helpful. I think she's doing better now and would recommend her.
terrible.
Does not respond to e-mails...very unhelpful.
it's a great class,
she knows her stuff, great class

Good Teacher, gave a lot of extra credit.  The first exam was a bit over our heads but she made up for it later in the semester.  I learned a lot.  Take this class if you want to learn about Economics.
Very hard, do not take a class with this teacher!

worst teacher ever! DO NOT TAKE!!! i took econ 002 with mateer, loved it and got an A... figured i would take econ 004 with mccann after hearing she wasn't that bad last semester only to find out that she is possibly one of the worst teachers at penn state, her exams are 400 level and her wording of questions are ment to only confuse you... terribl

AVOID AT ALL COSTS!!! Exams were BRUTAL, 14 POINT CURVE on the 1st. Asked a 14 point essay question about a curret event she BRIEFLY explained. All she does in class is fly through the Powerpoints. Book was expensive and pretty much useless since her notes were taken directly from it. DO NOT TAKE ECON 004 WITH HER!
Awful teacher. One of the worst I've ever had in my life. She is truly, truly terrible. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS WITH HER.

Apparently she was very easy at UD and teaching Econ 4 first semester. Her Econ 4 class this semster was a nightmare.  14 point curve on first exam.  I expect the class to be moderate next year because she will certainly be reprimanded for its difficulty level by the Econ department but I would still avoid this professor

HW is easy and good amount of extra credit, but EXAMS ARE VERY DIFFICULT! This isn't a 400 level course, this is ECON 004, but the exams are ridiculous. The first exam had to be curved by *10 POINTS* it was so bad. Do not take! TAs for the GenEd project also grade hard!

she is a horrible teacher. tests were impossible and so far related from what we learned in class. questions were also worded with intentions of tricking you. do not take this class!! if you need to take econ 4, take it with ANY other teacher. i know so many people who dropped this over the course of the semester to take it with someone else again!
dude she knows whats shes talkin bout but she treats people like their in kindergarten stone didnt do that but yea she should lighten up and she would be fine and make the tests not so ridic
Let's just say this teacher will not be teaching Econ 004 next semester and has been redirected to another department... took the class because of the teacher's physical features

Did not like this class. She dwelled and reviewed so much on the same subject, that half the material was never even covered. Very bad for anyone with interest in taking int'l finance. She is somewhat attractive, but her smug arrogant tone takes care of that quick. Tests didn't seem as hard as her 004 class. Book isn't needed at all.

This woman is horrible. As if her 200+ page course pack wasn't enough, you need to read the book and memorize little details. She kicks people out of class for reading newspapers, and her tests are for Harvard Graduates. She is outrageously unfair. Love econ, dont like her.

Prof. McCann really knows her stuff. OK that's all for the good. Her exams are truly ridiculous. There is no study guide. She purposely words questions harder and makes them trickier than need be. I studied the most for these exams and this class is my worst grade so far this year. Don't avoid this class just definitely avoid this teacher.

She spends way to much class time telling people to be quiet.  She spent the whole first week kicking kids out of class for whistling at her.  On the other hand she is really hot, so that needs to be taken into consideration when choosing this class.

I have never expected econ 004 to be this hard.Her clicer questions are super easy and the slides as well... I have studied soooo hard before each of her tests, however, her test questions are totally tricky and misleading.2/5 of the students couldn't finish the exam on time. Last exam the class average was below 60. Just dropped it.
Probably the worst college professor I have ever had. Exams are completely incomprehensible and do not relate to class notes whatsoever. Do not take this class.
She is an OK teacher but her exams are extremely hard, and questions are purposely made very tricky and misleading.

probably the worst and most annoying professor i ever had.  she made me HATE econ after this class.  and before you think she is "hot" go stand a little closer to her and take a look at her face.. not to mention the mens clothes she wears on a daily basis
hardest teacher, she is not nice nor helpful do not take econ 4 with her

Seriously? I picked her because she was supposed to be easy. I took her practice test before the first exam, got 2 wrong without studying. Studying VERY hard, and got a 50% on her test, a 64 after a 14 pt curve. I got a 3.7 last semester. With A's in econ and calc. Went to her office hours and said it was possible to get an A still. Dropping now.

I dont understand what happened this semester.  i hear she was so easy in earlier semesters.  tests are hard and have irrelevant materials. dont take if you can help it. assigned seats at a 100thomas classroom, stupid clicker questions, does not tolerate talking and kicks people out. not supposed to be a hard gened, but she makes it hard.
AVOID AT ALL COST!!!!!!!!!
Please do NOT take her class. Her exams are not related to her notes or the practise exam she gave to us at all! Most people did really poor on her exams.

Honestly, the worst teacher I have EVER had. She is absolutely incapable of teaching economics let alone controlling a class of 760. Nothing we talk about is on the exam and they are not a fair respresentation of what we should be learning in the class.also, class is the most boring experience ever. Do not take!
She is the worst teacher I've ever had.Exam is extremely hard and most of the questions is not relative to the slide and textbook.

Horrible teacher. Completely changed exams and course from last semester. The first test average without a 14 point curve was 56. She does not care about the students and is very stubborn, usually kicking multiple students out of class each day for basically doing nothing.
Her class seemed easy.  Yet when the exam rolls around, at least 1/3 of the material was stuff that was not discussed in class.  If your goal is to do well/pass, don't take McCann.
Worst teacher ever. The first exam had nothing to do with the class notes and slides. An entire section was dedicated to current events not discussed in class. Don't take her class...
The tests have nothing to do with the notes.  Read a newspaper everyday and stay up on current events and you will be better off.  Should never have been hired.

She's horrible. I just took an exam and it has no accordance to the class notes and lectures whatsoever. A whole section was based on the current business crisis which is barely discussed in class. BS

Not a very good teacher. Like others have said, it seems like she does about 40 mins of review to 10 mins of class. Tests aren't bad, as long as you study, which I did not. She is attractive, but her constant pauses to stare down people who are talking, get really annoying very fast. GenEd project is a cool assignment, but the grading system stinks
she's very unreasonable, very strict. Materials are clear and organized but boring to get through. this class is not worth it.
great class

Average class. Don't even bother buying the book, you don't use it. The only bad thing is she begins every class with a review, which u would think would be helpful (but it's not). You end up getting only about 10 minutes of notes from the entire class period.

People, just because shes good looking does not make her a good teacher (and she is quite good looking).  Moves too fast with powerpoint slide and doesnt do a lotta teaching. Tests are fair, but the class is boring. Not one of the better econ teachers.
easy class, kind of annoying to get through. Mccann is ok overall but she made me feel like I was back in high school....

The GenEd project was not as bad as other people make it sound. It is the only real work you have to do in the course and it only screwed a few people who cannot follow directions, my group got a 100. That being said McCann is hot and gives a lot of extra credit. Don't bother with the book.

If you want an econ class with a SEXY teacher this is the one to take.  She is very attractive and was the main reason i attended class.  The class itself is really not that difficult of material, and the course pack has all the slides.  It helps to go to class but again i just went to look at her.  She played a lot of funny clips in class too.
best econ class ever
She is a great young prof. She does a lot of examples to make sure that everyone gets the material perfect. Exams are mult choice and very fair. Shes very helpful and nice.
Easiest Teacher I have ever had.  You don't have to do any work out of class except study for tests. Her Gen Ed Project is real easy- A simple Power Point. Easy A or A- for any type of student

Worst teacher I've ever had! She's snotty and condesending. She says "ask me if you have any questions" but when you ask her she says "look in your notes we went over this." Stops class to yell at students who are talking. . .class of 300+. . .grow up McCann. If you have a class with her. . .drop it! Gen Ed project screwed a lot of people.

lectures are clear,basically go through slides,2 or more times for the same materials.exams are fair.but the project is ridiculous and ruined my final grade,it is 20% of the final grade,same as final exam, and i lost about 30 points for not using the correct fomat for citation,while the actual econ concepts in the project is only weighed 50%.
Mad easy

Good teacher.  She knows her stuff and the material really isn't that hard.  She does go through the slides pretty fast but if you read the material before class it's easy to follow.  She doesn't require students to attend her class but offers extra credit frequently for students who do attend.  Also, hard to concentrate since she is so cute.
She's actually a really good teacher.  she spends soo much time on each chapter and goes straight from the book- that way if you don't understand something you can go back to the book and clarify.
she is enthusiastic but in a class of 300+ i don't feel the need to pay any attention. the course is really easy, compared to some of the other ECON4 classes taught by other profs
worst professor i've ever had. never got anything below an A on a econ test and i get a 64 with her first test. absolutely terrible. flies through PP slides and teaches nothing

What a mistake.. I saw the ratings for Prof McCann at UD.  She must have decided to step it up at PSU. I'd rather watch a Russian soap opera than attend McCann's class and I'd probably understand it better. Flies through PP slides like its her job (because apparently her job isn't to teach).. No joke, I'm a 4.0 student that had to drop this class!
No Comments

Exams used to be online but she just changed them to in person. They are all cumulative and honestly super hard for no reason. She is so so nice, but also tends to get ridiculously political on certain topics, and shuts everyone down if they raise an opposing viewpoint. She is a good professor, but some things are iffy.

Coolest teacher ever ,she loves her job, the class is super easy to understand, the exam are a little confusing though no matter how good you take notes. Attendance is mandatory you get 3 days off no penalty

Genuinely the best professor I've had at Penn State thus far. She made the class very interesting and fun. I took the online version, which was definitely much easier, but I would take the in-person version if I were to take it again. Definitely a great class and professor!

Great professor who is very passionate. No phones or laptops in class, but can use ipad for notes. Go to class for attendance. 3 exams including final, which are taken online, not in class. They are not the easiest exams, but not bad either. Do not buy Kritik. We used it once for a 5 point assignment, but never again and it was $50. Some extra cred
"Technology Free" classroom until it conveniences her. Attendance is mandatory. Exam averages are low for a class of this nature. All exams are cumulative. I do not recommend.

Had her spring 2025 and she was amazing! Loved her personality and how she related a lot to her family! For future students taking her class, those meditations in the beginning of class will make a difference. During rough weeks of exams, just being in the present moment helped me calm myself and be less stressed out about an exam. Highly recommend

Molly Countermine is truly one of the best professors at Penn State. She is one of those people who, no matter how many people are in the room, makes you feel like you matter. She is so funny and makes every class interesting. Attendance is mandatory but don't miss class anyways because she is the best!!!!

Molly was a great professor, and she clearly is passionate about teaching and making sure everyone has a good experience in her class. You read 3 books throughout the semester, and have the chance to meet the authors which is cool. She also offers some extra credit which is nice, but as long as you do the assignment you should get a good grade.
She's a very friendly lady and although I had her via zoom she was always very enthusiastic and excited to teach.

She is the best. She is meant to be a teacher. So loving and caring. Class is very interesting and straightforward, mine was on zoom. I loved the writing assignments it felts good to write about myself sometimes. Exams were easy and straightforward. best class ever, im now taking another class w her next semester. 10/10!
Favorite teacher ever
Tests are all take-home and open notes, she is so nice and cares about her students, and she gives a lot of extra credit during and after the semester.

I really loved Professor Countermine's class. She really shows how much she cares about her students with meditation practices before classes and canceling classes before break. She requires handwritten notes and doesn't tolerate people who disrespect that. Exams are open-note and taken on your own time.
Lecture heavy, lots of note taking and the classes are long. BUT she is a very good teacher and the topics are interesting. The tests are open notes and online!
BEST PROFESSOR EVER. Ive taken 129 and 254N with her and I cannot recommend her enough. Super caring, amazing personality, and brings so much energy and life to class.

Such an amazing Professor, class is super interesting. The only annoying thing is handwritten notes or notes on iPad. Class attendance codes and weekly reflection papers that are super easy. All exams are online too. Overall, such an easy class and she is so caring.

this class is such an easy A. as long as you go to class (canvas attendance codes) and try a little on the reflection papers, you'll get 100% on them. molly is so nice and caring. she does not like electronics in class and asks notes to be taken by hand (or ipad is fine, but no laptops or phones out)

Lecture-heavy and tests are easy if the notes are studied. Take notes. Attendance is required and there is an attendance code. Sometimes she has the class write short papers at the end for grading. Gives extra credit. Personally this class was not for me but Professor Countermine is nice and caring.

BEST PROF EVER TAKE HER IF YOU GET THE CHANCE!!!!! 2 point quizzes after each lecture but you need to attend to be able to open them. A total of 3 exams taken online in your own space. Really nice and caring prof!!
AMAZING CLASS AND AN EVEN MORE AMAZING PROFESSOR!!!!

BEST PROFESSOR I HAVE EVER HAD. Truly enjoyed this class and think she is an amazing person. I have never met a professor who cared so much about her students. She is awesome! Her lectures are so engaging and she always connects it to her life. This is my favorite class I have ever taken, I highly recommend. Super easy a!

One of the best professors at Penn State. She is compassionate and truly cares about each and every one of her students. She made the lectures interesting and would tell her own personal stories that applied to the material. If you have the chance, definitely take a class with her.

Professor Countermine is one of the best professors I've taken since I've been here. She gives an attendance code at the end of most lectures, so make sure to be there. There are three books to read throughout the semester, and several writing pieces. There are also two exams, but if you take notes, they are very simple. Take her!

Molly is amazing! Honestly my favorite professor that I have had so far, especially since her classes are massive and you don't get much one on one time with her. Her lectures were engaging and always tied them into her life. Exams were difficult but she always curved them and let our final be open note and at home!

Molly is a great professor. She includes a lot of personal stories in her lectures that make the class more fun and interesting. All exams are online, at home and open note. Attendance is taken with a code in class. She teaches things that can be used in your everyday life, loved this class!

By far my favorite class at PSU. She is so knowledgeable and kind and a great professor. I took this class for a gen ed, but it made me rethink my major. The lectures are easy to follow and very informative. The exams are pretty easy, and the classwork is a breeze.
I literally love Molly so much. She makes this course so easy by telling us tales from her life, or having us apply the information to ours. Such an easy course, open note exams.

molly is the best. I'm taking 129 with her on zoom, it is so easy. does canvas surveys WITH CODE for attendance, so make sure you log on to class to at least get the code for easy participation. online tests/midterms, gives curves, so good at her job, made me actually interested to learn about human development. 10/10

A professor who knows what it is like, and acknowledges that students are students. She takes into account that her class is not the only class that you are taken. Makes every student feel heard and respected. Her class is one of very few that I can say actually brought light to real life matters. She is awesome and everyone should take her!
Best professor here. Probably going to minor in HDFS just so i can have more classes with her. TAKE 129!!!!!!

Molly is the best professor at Penn State. If you get the chance to take her class, do it. It is also an easy A. She is so passionate and cares deeply about making a difference and seeing her students succeed. She is unlike an other professor I have had. I have taken three of her classes and I would take more.
I love taking classes with Molly. She understands her students and is very flexible with grading and due dates. Exams are open note, and she allows retakes. Shes also super fun.

MOLLY IS AMAZING!!!!! Please PLEASE take any HDFS class with her. She is my favorite professor of all time. Molly is considerate, makes lectures awesome, and really connects with her students. I am incredibly grateful to have her as my professor. She seriously brightens students days and puts a smile on my face. Her stories are great as well!!!! :)

I loved taking this class. Probably one of the only classes I looked forward to going to last semester. She teaches the basics of HDFS and compares things in class to her own life experiences too. Great person, always taking feedback from students. Would definitely take any of her classes. The work load is also pretty light. Weekly papers.
Molly is great. She made sure you didn't stress about your grade and just focusing on you actually learning.

Countermine is very kind and introspective. Took this class as a gen ed but I learned a lot from her this semester. Be sure you can commit to reading 4 novels (1 a month), as the written discussion questions for them require genuine understanding and are a large part of your grade.
Best Gen ed Ive taken, super easy and even more interesting. I loved the class. And shes an amazing Professor!!

Molly is such a genuine professor!! her lectures are very interesting, and she actually cares about you. She assigns a paper a week and there are 3 exams which are pretty hard. I would 100% recommend taking this course with her!!

Molly is the best. In a huge lecture hall, she managed to make every lecture interesting.She doesn't post the notes and there aren't many tests so you have to go to class. There are also surveys every class to count attendance/participation. Generally a very easy class: lots of extra credit. Molly is always doing things to make it easier, she cares

molly is so chill and sweet. assigned 4 books to read with reflection papers and discussion questions. the books are actually interesting and they can help u in ur personal life as well. u get to meet the authors too which was cool. def take for gen ed

SHE IS AMAZING!! enjoyed her lectures I had this class my freshman year and wished I was on her in class lecture but instead got stuck with the web it wasn't bad but I enjoyed hearing her rants. Her lectures also used to be recorded but I heard their not.
Tough for an introduction class. Make sure you study hard for the exams! Lectures were interesting and Molly was always very kind. Love her!

There are weekly-ish papers but they're pretty easy and canvas surveys at the end of every class for attendance. She's also a gem and gives lots of extra credit opportunities. She doesn't post lecture slides, but the lectures are great which is motivating to show up to class. Don't buy the textbook either, you don't need it.

such an easy class and the best professor. she gives such interesting lectures and gives personal experience to most of the topics in lectures. curved our exams which are in class and made final open notes. class itself is interesting and consists of 3 exams and a 1 page reflection paper each week.

Molly is an amazing professor! She truly cares about the well-being of her students. Surveys at the end of every lecture that are graded for attendance. Exams are online, in class & cumulative. Reflection papers due every Sunday & grades depend on which TA you get, some grade stricter than others. Overall, great professor and interesting class!
Best professor I have had at PSU. You can tell she truly cares about her students and she is very easy going and gives you so many opportunities to get a high grade.
She is the best ever. Interesting and easy class.

Molly is definitely one of the best professors at Penn State. She is such a cool human in general and genuinely care about her students. Attendance is mandatory but she gives extra credit and makes lecture engaging by sharing personal anecdotes and stories. If you have the chance to take her, you 100% should!
Molly's class is a blast - her lectures are engaging and she makes the material super accessible. Attendance is mandatory but it's worth it. Unstuckstudy AI was a lifesaver for prepping those exams!
