There's a reason her ratings are all 5 star. Best professor I have ever had. The lectures were actually interesting, and she related everything back to her life and told stories. She is also just one of the coolest people alive like performing at THON and all. She is also super understanding take a class with her.

Great professor, took online but it's not asynchronous, it's a live stream and attendance is required. Easy gened and she offers extra credit. I will say the exams weren't super easy but you have two attempts and unlimited time. Highly recommend!
SHES JUST THE BEST

Such an amazing professor! She genuinely care about her students and care about what she teaches. This class is not only an easy & enjoyable gen ed, but also helpful in terms of you can apply what you learn to your personal life. Highly recommend her and her class!

An amazing class!!! All exams are open-note and untimed. Our only assignments are reflection papers and in-class surveys. There are a few extra credit assignments throughout the semester. Attendance is heavily encouraged as all of the content we learn for the exams is taught in class! All of the content we learned was helpful and eye-opening.
She is amazing, super nice, and super respected. You read 4 books and meet the authors too. There isn't a lot of work for this class. Great class to take if you want an easy gen-ed.

Very nice and so super easy. Finished with a 106%. Gave extra credit randomly and multiple attempts on each test. She was a little too political in lecture and it made some uncomfortable, including myself.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Always so helpful and cares about her students

I absolutely loved her so much, she finds a way to make the class fun and entertaining. Although I was online she still acknowledged us and gave us opportunities for extra credit etc. Also would recommend taking this gen ed course love
HDFS129 might be the easiest class on campus. Molly does a great job teaching it, and does a lot of it through personal experience.
Best professor I've ever had
Loved Molly. I took the web section of HDFS 129 and had a great experience. Genuinely such a good person, I would recommend this class for anybody (I took as a GenEd).

Dr Countermine is super nice and her class was always very interesting . Attendance was mandatory because she did do daily top hats but there was no homework. Weekly discussion posts were always easy to complete. Her exams were hard despite having the notes and being in class but I still ended the class with a good grade.

Molly is a wonderful professor, her class is very enjoyable. The assignments are made clear from the beginning of the semester, and everything is very manageable. The exams are cumulative, but they are online and you have a week or more to complete them, with no time limit. I loved this class and would recommend it to everyone!

Very nice professor. The exams are cumulative so beware. Lectures were interesting, but the exam questions were often application-based instead of term-based. I wouldn't suggest this class unless you're interested in learning about the life span of humans from infancy to late adulthood. It was a filler class for me, so I found it rather boring.

The best proff ever at Penn State. very sweet and entertaining proff. she is the best the class was so easy exams were all online and open note. such a good class to take too very interesting I learned a lot about myself in this class. 100% take this class again.

Molly is a fantastic professor here at Penn State. All exams are online and you're allowed two attempts to complete them. She provides all notes for all of the lectures so that you can sit back and soak in the content of the course. 10/10 recommend HDFS 129 and all of Molly's courses!

She is a great professor, very passionate about what she is teaching ! Lectures are easy to understand, exams are open note and 2 attempts are available, there are about 12 discussion questions based on lectures throughout the semester.

This class will change the way you view the world. Molly is inspirational, caring, and deeply respected at Penn State. There are no exams in this class. You will just read 4 books and even get to meet the authors. The lectures are fascinating and you don't need to have taken HDFS 129 to take this course. Always recommend any class with Molly!

Professor countermine was one of the best professors I've taken, I wish she had more classes. All exams are online and taken at home, she gives 2 tries per exam. No other homework is given, but attendance is mandatory and taken during each lecture
Best professor I have had and genuinely cares about her students even if it is a big class. I wish I could have her as a professor for every class

Loved Professor Molly. She was super down to earth, and went into detail with examples when giving lectures. She does tophats at the end of every class but they are super easy. The class itself isn't hard and honestly pretty interesting just take notes. The exams are open notes too. Definitely recommend taking her to anyone.

I wish I could take Countermine for every class, by far my favorite college professor I've ever had. Just a great person and her lectures were enthralling and entertaining. She's very fun and is a performer. Grading was very easy and she loves interacting with her students. Just a damn near perfect professor, would recommend her for anyone.
I love this woman. She's the best professor at Penn state and if anyone says otherwise they're lying.

Easy A. I was in this class so I could get a gen ed credit out of the way but Molly had such interesting lectures and you could tell she really cared about everyone learning and understanding the content. You can do bad on the exams and still end up with an A, just take advantage of the extra credit she provides.

Molly is genuinely so sweet and kind. Lectures are interesting and apply to us, even if you have taken other HDFS courses before. You have some leeway with attendance, but there are tophat questions to record it. 3 exams given and the TA review sessions weren't helpful to me, but never studied and got an A in the class. Exams online and open note!

She is the best. I got an 80% on the first two exams and still ended with a 97%. She just wants people to learn and gain new perspectives. Who class is telling her stories which are super entertaining. Super nice lady and I am glad I took this as a Gen Ed. I'm a guy and class was mostly girls and I loved it.

I took Molly's class as a gen ed and absolutely loved the class! The lectures are interesting and Molly is a great professor. She cares for her students and don't want them to stress over her class so she offers a ton of extra credit. There are only 3 exams (all online, open note, and done at your own time) and a easy discussion post once a week.

Molly is AMAZING!! She is so funny and sweet!! I had her in Thomas 100 and she is the only teacher that I saw to be able to get the whole lecture hall actively listening and paying attention to her! She is so understanding and one of the best professors I have ever had!! If you have the chance to have her as a teacher TAKE THE COURSE!! The BEST!!

She gives 2 exams and a final (all cumulative) online (on your own time) + open note. Molly is the reason I am now minoring in HDFS and I have never had a professor so invested and knowledgeable about their course as she is. You definitely won't regret taking a class with her!!

Hands down, best professor at PSU! If u can take a class with Molly, do it. She's so caring about us not only as students, but as people. She is really passionate about teaching and wants everyone to get an A! The exams are online and if u take notes, you'll be fine. She gives a ton of extra credit. I would recommend Molly to everyone, she's great!

Molly is my favorite professor at PSU. She really values teaching and gives amazing lectures. In 129, there is a discussion post once a week, 3 exams (including the final), a World in Conversation, and a ton of extra credit available. I could not recommend this class and Molly more, I learned so much!

I could not recommend professor Countermine more. She is the best professor I have ever had. She is so funny, caring, and is very enthusiastic about the things she teaches. She knows we are students and have lives, the exams are online and she posts the slides on canvas. Take a class with her if you can!! You will not regret it!

Molly is the best professor I have taken a class with at Penn State. She is so fun and very down to earth. She really cares about her students and is super understanding. Easy discussion post every week and 3 open note online exams. No final exam. Offers opportunities for extra credit.

Great professor. Lectures are interesting and engaging. Only weekly discussion post for HW. Test is online. Tophat attendence. Only one problem, she doesn't allow electronic so get ready for a notebook to write down all the notes.

One of the best and most memorable profs I've had in my 4 years (and I had her in the first fall semester here). Ended up making my minor HDFS. She truly wanted everyone to get an A and also enjoy class. Lectures were educational and authentic.
Loved her lectures. She has a way of speaking that really keeps you invested. I took her course a few years ago as a GE and I still refer to things I learned from her.

Molly really cares about her students and provides a lot of opportunities to receive an A. Lectures are interesting and she always has stories and videos that are engaging and relate to the lecture. There are so many ways to get extra credit, and tests are taken on your own time but you should still study. I loved this class and highly recommend.

Molly is such a cool person to learn from. Lectures were really interesting, easy to pay attention and be engulfed by her stories. Tons of extra credit, but study for exams if you want to really understand info. Sometimes her opinions were a little too biased for me, would have liked to see less opinion & more research. Overall great class.

Best professor ever. Truly cares about her students. Makes it very easy to get an A. If you are just taking this class for an easy A then you really don't even need to pay attention to the lectures and can still do well.

Molly's the best I can't recommend her class enough. Everything is open note, there's barely any homework, she posts all the slides, and she gives a ton of extra credit opportunities. The lectures are really interesting and a lot of it is just her telling stories about her life. It's clear she really cares about her students and they all love her.

Molly genuinely changed my life. Stuff she talked about in this class will stick with me forever. Do the extra credit and go to class and it's impossible to fail. Only way you don't get an A is if you're trying not to on purpose.

I only took her class because she's the top-rated prof at Penn State. I can see why now. Even if you bomb the exams, you can improve your grade with extra credit opportunities. Anyways, the class is worth taking. Easy A gen-ed.
She really cares about everyone and gives lots of extra credit opportunities. I honestly think it is impossible to fail her class. She wants everyone to pass and do good. Very lecture heavy.

I could not think of a sweeter lady. She genuinely loves her job and everyone there. If you don't do too well on the online exams, you'll get your grade up. She is really caring towards her students and does an arrival practice everyday to clear your mind. I can't think of any other teachers that gets applause when she ends the last class.

I absolutely LOVE Molly! She is the best. She's so genuine and cares about every single one of her students. She has the best sense of humor and the class flys by because I'm so intrigued by her stories and lectures. I would take her again 100 times if I could!

best professor I have ever had. She's is absolutely hilarious and tells great stories in lecture. super relatable and is easy. she doubles highest exam score and gives little homework. She loves her students and they love her for good reason. Must take her before you leave PSU. Awesome woman!!!
She is so amazing! class is so fun and interesting. I definitely recommend her as a teacher!

Dont get me wrong shes very nice but a majority of this class was her talking about her family and life. I also didnt find this class that interesting. The exams are heavily based on the lectures and slides but they are all different scenarios so its kind of hard. She does offer extra credit though

Molly is amazing. She focuses so much on how YOU are feeling, which is great. She is a great lecturer and you learn so much by just listening to her. Would 100% take her again, and will be looking for more classes that she teaches.

Molly is the best professor I've ever had at Penn State. HDFS 129 is essentially a class about how to be a good person in the world and how to be a good parent. She uses personal examples from her life and makes the material really interesting. Couldn't recommend her more

I loved Molly. She is a wonderful professor and this class really was a breeze. You only have to do discussion posts, TopHat questions in class, exams, and then a World in Conversation. I would 100% recommend this class with Molly.

Molly is easily one of the best professors I have had! Her lectures are always enjoyable and even though attendance is mandatory, her lectures are also livestreamed and she creates attendance quizzes on Canvas in case you missed the tophat for that day. There are only 3 exams and she doubles your best exam score for your final exam! overall, great

Overall Molly is a kindhearted person, When it comes to lectures she often times gets sidetracked on political biases, which don't make sense for a human development class. For tests, they're pretty difficult because the notes aren't detailed enough to study from and the answers for questions are typically "best answer" not the correct answer!!

This professor is one of the most kind and empathetic people in general that I have ever met. Her lectures were really interesting but not hard to understand. The only homework is discussion posts each week and her tests are open notes. There is one participation question per lecture but it can be done in person or on canvas.
PSU is lucky to have Professor Countermine.

this woman is so personable and lovely. to me shes the perfect professor! even tho theres 300+ people in the class she cares about every student and her teaching doesnt even take a backseat to that. I was genuinely interested because the way she teaches feels engaging. take this class if you can i am loving it!
Fairly easy grader as long as you follow directions. Tests were open note.
Very sweet and understanding professor. Tries to make course as easy as possible.

Professor Countermine is a great professor and I really enjoyed her class. Class is pretty easy 2 exams that were online and homework assignments were pretty light. I would take a class with Molly again.

Professor Countermine is both informative and inspirational. Her lectures are always interesting as she uses real life stories to connect topics and takes feedback from the classroom. Even in a large lecture class she is able to keep us all engaged. Her tests can be challenging, but are all online and open notes. Just show up or join on Zoom!

I LOVE her. Easily best professor I have had so far. Material and lectures are so interesting. Live streamed class so you don't even have to go in. Definitely take this class with her if you have the chance!

Professor Molly is an absolute angel. The lectures are extremely informative and inspirational, she shares stories that go along with the lectures and she is always radiating positivity. She understand her students and is willing to do anything for them. The exams can be tricky but if you take notes you will be fine. 11/10

Dr. Countermine was the kindest professor I've ever had. She enjoys interacting with her students and always encourages people to share during class and she is very funny. Dr. Countermine also offers extra credit, the assignments are easy, and the exams are open note and online.

i've only heard good things about molly and hope it continues that way. she is kind, charismatic, and open. her class is very easy, all you do is take notes and listen. i watch the live stream from my dorm at times. make sure you do the tophat if you want attendance credit. her tests are tricky (more application-based) but they're all open notes

Dr. Countermine is hands down the best professor I have ever had. She is one of the kindest, funniest, most understanding people I have ever met. Classes consist of taking notes and sometimes open class discussion. Exams can be a little tricky but are always open note. This class was very interesting and fun, I always looked forward to it!
Molly is so kind and has amazing lectures. The class is easy and the tests are all open note and on canvas, definetly take her.

So, Molly is a wonderful professor. She's very caring and is very flexible with due dates. However, she often talks about politics and gets sidetracked easily. She talks about white privilege a lot which is just odd in my opinion. This is a class about family relationships, not social justice. Very liberal bias. good grader. should be an easy A
Molly is amazing!!! Would 100% recommend taking this class with her.

This has been my favorite class I have taken at PSU. Molly is so great and is very understanding. She shares a lot of personal stories which makes class so interesting and I like that she can open up to the class. This semester, attendance was taken on top hat in class and there was a option to watch the recorded lecture online with a 2 point quiz.

Molly is the best!!! If you can take a class with her, 100% do it. I never dread going to class, I love listening to her stories and how childhood experiences shape us. This class is so fun to attend and makes you think about your life experiences. Take a class with her you wont regret it!!
Probably one of the best teachers I've had in my lifetime. So sweet and the class is so interesting. Mom vibes but in the best way. Exams aren't easy but are always open note.

I took this class as part of my LEAP program, and what a way to start college! Molly is extremely sweet, and completely understanding when you need extra time with an essay or assignment. All assignments are based on your thoughts, so no need to research. I will definitely be keeping in touch with this professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Inspirational--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I love Molly!!! Take this class with her 100%. Although the exams can be a little tricky, if you study the powerpoints and actively pay attention in class, you should do fine. There is lots of extra credit as well in case you need it. Her life story is so interesting and I think this is the most useful class I will have ever taken.

Molly's class was definitely my favorite and I actually enjoyed going. Lectures were engaging, and she related things we were learning to her personal life. Exams were pretty difficult, but there was extra credit offered. Otherwise, the workload isn't too bad. I really, really, enjoyed having Molly as a professor.

Literally love her. Best gen ed at PSU and really an easy class because the material is interesting. Exams can be sort of difficult if you don't study but she gave so much extra credit that made up for any points you missed. I recommend her 100%!!!!!!!!!

Molly is the best Professor I had ever had. She really cares about her students. Her tests are not difficult if you study and she gives many extra credit opportunities. I would 100% recommend! Its not that hard to get an A.
Molly is such a great professor and Im so glad I took HDFS129 with her this past semester! She is very relatable and understands us !

Molly is a real gem! I loved her so much and she really knew how to keep her class entertained. She is such a caring person and she does have a textbook but I would only use that for her exams which were open notes. She offers a bunch of extra credit points which really boost your grade. I will miss her class a lot!!

Molly literally changed my life as a professor. If you have the option to be taught by her, DO IT. She is incredible and very understanding. She hands out well over 25 points of extra credit that can boost your grade immensely and she is so inclusive

THE BEST PROF at Penn State. This class was so interesting and keeps students engaged. She gives lots of extra credit opportunities. Definitely study for the exams and you'll be in great shape. She wants you to succeed so badly be sure to engage! She's the "mom" teacher you loved growing up but better.

Molly's one of the sweetest and smartest people I've ever met and cares deeply for all of her students. The person who said the class gets off track because she talks about her family too much is wrong; her family is incorporated into discussions relevant to class. The tests can be difficult but if you study and go to office hours you should be ok.

I'm going to get downvoted, but I'm being honest. She spends most of her lectures talking about her family or politics, and we are pretty far behind in lecture material because she gets off on tangents so easily. Exams are difficult for a class of this nature and may have a "most correct answer" which gets tricky. There's definitely better quality.

She is awesome!! I absolutely loved this class. Instead of HDFS 129 it should be called "how to live a happy life 101". Seriously, it should be a PSU requirement to enroll in this class. Definitely study for the exams as they can be tricky but nothing too crazy. I highly reccomend this course to everyone.
Molly is just the best professor!! I wish she could be my life coach.
All I can say is, you will not find a better professor on campus.
Molly is the most caring professor I have had at PSU. I plan on taking every class she offers as she knows how to engage the class and teach efficiently.

The greatest Professor I have ever taken. She is also a magnificent human being. The lectures are so amazing that it is truly a loss if you miss any. Molly is kind and just gets it. I plan on taking every other course she offers. There are not enough positive adjectives to describe her. The class is awesome as well.

Molly is the best professor Ive had at Penn State. Her lectures are fun, shes a very open and genuine professor. The class had almost 600 kids in it but you feel this sense of care from here. I wish I could take this class again with her. Upset the school year had to end early with her as my professor

Molly was the best professor I had while at PSU. She is so caring towards her students, and makes a large lecture class seem so personal and comfortable for everyone. If you get the chance to have her as a professor and take this course, 100% do it! I wish this class didn't have to end, as she really made waking up and walking to Thomas so worth it

Molly is THE best professor PSU has, and everyone needs to take HDFS 129. Her lectures are AMAZIN, you will learn so much about yourself. She does a lot of story telling in class that relate to topics you talk about which I loved. She does clicker points for attendance. If you pay attention in class and read over notes the tests are really easy.

Molly is THE BEST. Her lectures are so engaging because she tells a lot of personal stories that help connect the material you're learning to real life situations. She is so laid back and relaxed (you start every class with a meditation session) and really cares about the well being of her students. Don't need to buy textbook.

Love Molly! she is so kind, personable, and funny. Her lectures are interesting and fun to attend. She is understanding and although she has many students, you can meet with her if you reach out and schedule a time. You learn a lot in this class. Tests are kinda hard, I studied so much and didn't do very well, so make sure to study and write notes

Molly is so engaging and fun to listen to during lectures! You leave class feeling like you've just learned so much, and the notes translate exactly to what's going to be on the exams. The tests aren't difficult, you just have to actually review all the concepts and make sure you're paying attention in class. Loved how she used real life examples.
I LOVE MOLLY. If you have the opportunity to take her, DO IT. You WILL NOT regret it. I wish she could teach the rest of my classes at PSU.

love molly! she's a really open person and her lectures are engaging. if you study from the notes, you'll be fine for exams. she also gives extra credit which i think really helped my grade from a B+ up to an A. attendance isn't mandatory, but i believe its definitely helpful for content and to up your grade (iclicker points!)

Molly is an awesome professor. She posts her lecture slides online, but she does such a great job explaining concepts and making her lectures interesting. The tests require you to apply the concepts you learn in class to possible scenarios. Some of the questions can be a little tricky, but overall it's not too bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Molly is great, I've had her twice and she's honestly the best professor I've had. She's super lenient and caring. She's willing to change contents of the syllabus if needed. She's always willing to have a discussion and let students share their opinion. She's not uptight at all. She's also not exam heavy and gives extra credit if needed.
I love her!! Favorite class this semester!
I love her!! Take this class if you can
go to test reviews they help u pass big time

Molly is the best professor I have had, she loves being involved with her students and cracks jokes all the time. She actually cares how you are doing which is so important. Clicker questions are every class and count as one point for attendance. Thought papers are randomly given in class so dont skip, the exams are mostly all situational based.

she is such an amazing teacher, she is so nice, accessible outside class and only real grades are exams but you also have some fluff points and chances for extra credit! if you have the chance to take her class you 100% should!!
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I love her, 10/10 great course.

Very invested in her students and makes lectures fun through sharing personal stories and cracking jokes. Also lets students share their experiences as well and is very open and accepting to new ideas and ways of thinking.
clicker points for attendance every class, 3 exams and a final with plenty of extra credit at the end of semester, also no homework outside of class besides studying for exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Molly is the best professor at Penn State. Take this class if you have the chance, truly amazing.

Everyone should take this class! Not only is Molly an incredible professor but the material she teaches will be extremely helpful throughout your life. The exams are most of your grade but everything you're tested on is presented in lecture.

The only class I always wanted to show up for. Tests are definitely harder than you always expect them to be but I'm ending with an A- because of class attendance grades and last minute extra credit opportunities. You need to take this class!!

Easily one of my favorite professors ever. Attendance is mandatory but her lectures are interesting and she is so funny! She is so sweet and makes the class interactive, so those who want to share their thoughts can do so. Exams can be a bit confusing; it's easy when you take it but when you get your grade back you may be surprised.

Honestly one of the best professors at PSU. She is so caring and dedicated to the class and allows you to learn about yourself as a person. Lecture slides may seem easy but STUDY STUDY STUDY if you want to do well on her exams. They are not hard if you put in the work and she is overall amazing. Take this class.
My favorite professor

Literally the greatest class I've ever taken. Basically teaches people how to be a decent human being. You can tell Molly loves her job and it's really nice that she takes the time to make sure all of our questions are answered. This course should be a requirement for everyone.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Molly Countermine is hands down the greatest professor I have had the pleasure of learning from. It is clear she cares about her classes' success and never fails to deliver an interesting and fun lecture. Truly a blessing to take so many classes with her, including HDFS 129, a groundbreaking lecture with her.

Molly is an angel. Her lectures are amazing and even though attendance is required she makes you want to come to class. Tests are a little difficult, but not impossible if you study and go to her for help. She is hilarious and wants everyone to feel comfortable. By far the best professor I have ever had at Penn State.... Molly is amazing!!!!

Molly was my favorite professor and encouraged me to double major in HDFS. I loved the class and the information was useful and super interesting. Her lectures are funny and relatable. She was super cool and nice and i definitely recommend her as a professor!!!

Molly is a great professor, do not take anyone else for this class. BUT, the exams are slightly challenging. The class is so fun, and she makes lectures interesting with putting her personal story into it. You definitely have to work to get an A in the class since the exams require so much thought and understanding of the material.
Very relatable, honest, down to earth. Tells you what is expected.

I loved this class so much. Molly is incredible. She not only taught the material but allowed other students to give their input on the material to make it more relatable. She uses a lot of her family as examples and some people don't like that but for me it made it easier to remember. DON"T GET THE TEXTBOOK and go to class for thought papers!

Molly is such a great human and I think everyone should take this class with her. The material in lectures isn't hard but for tests, you need to understand the topics pretty deeply and be able to apply it all. She is super helpful and insanely nice. great class

Molly is an extremely nice lady and I wish she was my aunt. Her class is lecture heavy and there are 6 in class easy thought papers and three exams and one final cumulative exam. I did not do very well on any of the exams but attendance and thought papers boosted my grade. This class is amazing and everyone should take it.

very interesting class and Molly makes it fun by talking about her personal life. the exams were kind of hard for me, but if you don't do well on the first one, go talk to her b/c she is helpful. I did way better on the other exams so don't get discouraged. attendance 7 thought papers will help boost your grade, but the class was mostly exam based

If you have the chance to take a class with Molly, do it. She is honestly so inspirational and is amazing at giving lectures. She keeps me so interested by telling personal stories, and showing videos. She is such a gem and i can't say enough good things about her. Her exams are example based, so know the material.

She is the best professor I've had so far. She is always passionate about what she teaches and she uses great examples from her real life to help you understand the topics more. The tests are difficult but manageable if you but the time into the class.

Great teacher (had her for HDFS129 and HDFS428), however, this class was not one I would take again. Reading quizzes were HARD- you were allowed to use a notecard but it didn't help much since there we were tested on little details. She didn't keep up with grades, final paper was graded harsh, and exams were challenging. Love her, not this class.

The class was pretty difficult. Depends on your TA. My TA was a harsh grader and came up with the quiz questions for the articles which were pretty challenging. I feel like the exam questions weren't straight forward from the notes which made it more complicated. Seems like the TA grades everything & graded harshly on my class paper. Not an easy A.

Molly is a truly great professor for this course. I wasn't too interested in the material at the start, but she found a way to keep us entertained with it. I didn't use the textbook once though. Everything you need is in the lectures. Tests are a major part of your grade in this class.

Definitely recommend this course even if it's not a requirement for your major. Molly gives really interesting lectures and examples to help you understand. Grades consist of exams and thought papers. If you study, exams will be easy.

Molly is easily one of the best professors at Penn State, and I had her for HDFS129 too! The class is easy, I only studied like an hour for each exam, but she puts some trick questions on so be careful. Graded on attendance, exams, thought papers in class (completion), and pop quizzes that are very easy. Most lectures feel like a conversation!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: No txtbk use. Exams can be challenging at times. Very interesting class & a lot of discussions. Easy gets off topic but is super nice. talks a lot abt her personal life. One huge paper & random thought papers that count 4 attendance. Attendance sheet passed around @ start of every class. Did reading quizzes from peer review articles w/ notecards.

Molly is the best professor you could ask for. She is very caring and passionate about what she does and is so open with her students. Her tests are fairly easy as long as you come to class and pay attention. I really enjoyed this class and would recommend it as an elective even if you don't need it for your major!

Molly is amazing. So so caring and engaging in her lectures. HDFS 129 is a very interesting class and really teaches you a lot about yourself. Tests are easy if you pay attention, minimal studying needed. Theres also lots of easy buffer points if you don't do well on the test. Would recommend to any major.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Molly is AMAZING. She incorporates so many of her life stories into her lectures making them even more interesting and sometimes hilarious. The content is extremely interesting and useful and I think that everyone should experience this class. I will definitely be taking another class with Molly in the future!

the BEST professor out there. the lectures are so interesting and she goes at a really easy to understand pace. I recommend this course and prof to EVERYONE I know! just put in the work (the content is actually really interesting too) and you'll do fine :)
Best professor at PSU! Listen to her stories and lectures, many examples she gives are questions on exams. Pay attention & it is an easy A

Molly is easily one of the best professors at Penn State! She makes the lectures so interesting by adding in stories of her own which makes the material easy to understand. I would recommend this class to anyone because it's so relatable and you can apply it to your life. The tests aren't extremely easy but just study well and you'll be good.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She loves her job and you can really see it in her lectures. Molly is always giving real-life examples and making sure that her lectures are easy to understand and interactive.
Molly is so chill and relates to young people well.

Attendance is mandatory and none of the notes are online, so you have to go to class and write them down if you want to do well on the exams. I got high Bs and low As on the exams and had a 91 going into the last few weeks and got a ton of points from doing the out of class assignments and got bumped to a 98 by not using all of my skips.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Molly is a fantastic professor. She thoroughly explains all of the material and she relates to students very well. She's also hilarious and tells us lots of stories about herself and her family. The class itself is good and Molly really knows the material and does a good job teaching it. Highly recommend 129 with Molly!

She's excellent, the tests are a bit tricky, but here's the thing. They are very doable as long as you trust your gut on them, then you can do extremely well on them. She talks about real things in the world that is pertinent to us, and it honestly is very refreshing to hear. She does give the occasional extra credit to help.

BEST PROFESSOR AT PENN STATE! She gives amazing stories about her life and how it relates to HDFS. If you are interested in psych, this is the class for you. All you have to do is listen to her lectures and take notes; the powerpoints are usually not posted on canvas unless we are behind schedule. Exams are easy and fair.
Countermine is a great professor. She is a pleasure to learn from and makes it fun to go to class.
Molly is amazing! She tells great stories to help you learn the material and she is so funny. Her tests aren't bad if you take good notes in class and study them a bit. Would love to take her again.

She is a very popular in HDFS and everyone loves her. She only has 3 exams, which is frustrating because there is nothing much that will bring your grade up except the in class random papers. She is so funny and her lectures are always entertaining that makes it easier to learn.

I actually laugh out loud at everything she says. Also thank god I took this class or I would have prob been a terrible parent. This is a great class just for life in general-- I find myself applying so many things I have learned to my every day life. The material is so interesting, and she relates it all to personal stories which is so fun
BEST PROFESSOR! SHE LOVES HER JOB! Definitely take this class! My favorite professor yet!

Molly is an amazing professor. She is hilarious and she makes the class enjoyable. Her lectures are super interesting, but her tests can be tricky so study up for them. Don't skip class because she takes attendance everyday and there are thought papers given at random days. If you need to take any hdfs class take it with Molly, you won't regret it

Everything I could've asked for in a professor! Amazing person and makes the material super interesting and more of a learning aspect, than memorizing for points. 3 easy tests if you just go over the notes, and points for in class writings (6th one is extra points). The 4th test is the final and its not cumulative.

I LOVED going to this class. It was in the morning, but I had no trouble motivating myself to get up because Molly is such a great lecturer. She does a great job making course material matter to our personal lives. Overall, the best class I've taken at Penn State.

I can't say enough good things about Molly. Best professor hands down at psu. She is so driven and inspirational, but her exams can be tricky if you just memorize the information. After the first exam you get used to her questions and it gets easier. Take this class will Molly, you will come out a better person and learn a lot about yourself.

Molly is literally awesome. I cant wait to take more of her classes. Shes honest & funny & her lectures are so interesting, I actually looked forward to going to this class. She ties her life into her teaching and the way she gets people involved despite the class having so many people is really great.

Molly has an awesome personality and has a fair class. That being said, Molly is very opinionated. She brings politics into her class and is also certain everyone needs some sort of therapy. Molly's class is cool though and her exams are fair as long as you go to class.

Molly give excellent lectures that are engaging and interesting. Everything that you need to pass the class she gives you. If there is something on the test that wasn't discussed in class, she'll tell you. Her tests are hard, but they are fair. You just have to prepare for them. You have to go to class because she does not post the slides online.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Molly is amazing at what she does. I recommend taking the class because It will make you a better person and you will look at life very differently. She one of the best professors at PSU, and does a great job with her lectures. She is beyond funny and makes me laugh every class. exams can be difficult and barely any extra credit is offered.

Molly is an amazing professor and she makes the material interesting, even if you are not an HDFS major or minor. You should go to class and take notes and definitely go to the review sessions before the exams because they are extremely helpful!
Go to class. She has a no tech policy, but honestly it makes you pay attention and do better in class. Her lectures are interesting, often relocatable, and she's also incredibly open and nice.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Molly is hands down one of the best professors at PSU. She really cares about her students and their well beings. Her class is super interesting even though it can be long at times. Anyone in any major should take her class. Her class teaches you to be a better person. It is because of her that I chose to minor in HDFS.
Molly is by far the best teacher on campus. She knows her stuff and makes that clear through her clear, hilarious lectures. She is amazing and gives chances for extra credit. best professor ever
absolutely LOVE Molly, amazing lectures, makes a class or 600-700 people feel small and personable, funny life stories

Amazing woman.  Loved every one of her classes.  She's so spirited and engaging and hilarious, it's hard not to like her.  Exams aren't always the easiest, so go to class and study your notes.  Also, attendance is taken every day, but you can miss 3 classes free of penalty.  Definitely a worthwhile and eye-opening class.

Molly is the best teacher I've ever had. Her lectures are so interesting and she is hilarious which made me want to attend class every time. You have to go to class because sometimes she includes things from lectures on exams but she is awesome and super entertaining so it is worth it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great professor. Loves teaching. Very personal. Gives out random attendance papers but are easy. Doesn't allow laptops to take notes on. Se believes that all notes must be handwritten to help you remember the material better. Powerpoints are useful with great information. Just study powerpoints and will get an A. Exams can be difficult.

If you are even thinking about taking this class with Molly DO IT!!!! Molly is the best professor at PSU; she is hilarious and her class is genuinely enjoyable to sit through. Her notes are very straightforward and so are the exams. Her personal stories help a lot too. Easy A if you go to class and put in the work!!!

I took Molly for HDFS 129 and she was awesome! She explains everything so well and I love how she adds personal experiences to the lessons to make them more relatable. She offers "thought papers" that give you an extra 5 points if you do them. If you tend to skip class do not take this class because she only gives her notes in class, but worth it!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Molly is quite literally the greatest person/professor I've been blessed with meeting. She genuinely cares about her students and the material, and she AMAZING. Some test questions are specific, but if you read the textbook and study the notes you'll be fine. Lectures are mandatory, but you won't want to miss any because she makes them so enjoyable

Molly Countermine is a really passionate teacher, but her exams are just too difficult. There is so much information packed into one lecture. She does her best to make lectures interesting and engaging, and she is passionate when teaching.

Molly is known on campus to be the best teacher, and its easy to understand why. She really cares about the subject she's teaching. She doesn't care about the grades portion she just wants to make sure you learn something and enjoy the class. Amazing woman, amazing course, I recommend everyone take it even if it isn't for your major.

Molly is awesome!! The class may seem easy but make sure you actually go to class because she does random attendance papers that can really boost your grade. The class is really interesting and she makes it really fun.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Molly is such a great teacher! She cares so much about her students actually learning the material. As long as you pay attention in class and read over your notes before the exam, you should get an easy B! Her tests can be tricky at times, but she is a very fair grader and curves the exams. Would take this course again!
Molly is really a great professor and HDFS129 is very useful. But if you want to get an A, you need to go to class and take notes.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Molly is a great professor! Her real life examples help you understand the material and she usually curves tests by a few points depending on the class average. Go to class because there are attendance papers and they help your grade. Although her tests can be tricky as they are all application based, listen to her examples and you will be fine!

This class is great. It is so interesting and Molly loves what she's teaching. It's a big lecture, but don't let that make you think you can skip class all the time. It can be such an easy A if you simply show up and pay attention-- which isn't even hard because the class is great! Totally recommend this class.

Molly is amazing. This class has taught me so much about myself and life in general. She has great real life examples for almost everything, which are very helpful in understanding the content. She does not let you take notes on laptop and does NOT post the notes online. Attendance is crucial because the exams are fairly difficult.

AMAZING LOVE HER SOOOOOO MUCH!  She is a great professor, great person! Her personal stories are always relevant to the class. The material is extremely interesting! She is very personable. Exams are straight forward, if you attend class and engage in class you can easily get an A! If anything happens just talk to her she will understand!

Okay first of all, don't buy the textbook you don't need it at all. Her exams are based entirely on the notes she gives in lectures - which she won't post online so that's why going to class helps. Her exams are a lot of giving you an example and you have to figure out what theory or whatever that it applies to so it isn't always straightforward.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Hands down the best professor ever. Love her so much. Her lectures are the best, never gets boring, she makes it very interesting with all her stories
Fun class that really teaches you a lot. One of the best professors I have had in college. Highly recommend taking with Molly.
Molly does not deserve a single bad review. Amazing teacher, HDFS 129 is cake, adds up to a stress free easy class. Content is pretty interesting as well.

I love Molly! I took her 129 and 428 and learned so much. Her lectures are informative and entertaining. I'm definitely saving my notes forever from this class. She does attendance papers randomly so make sure you don't miss class, but you wont want to! Tests are hard but you'll get through them.

I think everyone should take this class. Molly is amazing and I always look forward going to lecture. Take notes!! It helps a lot with the exams. Exams are all applying the info so listen to her examples. There are also random attendance papers that are easy points if you show up. You really learn a lot about yourself in this class.

Molly was an amazing professor. Class was really easy -going, all of her stories made it easier to understand concepts. Test weren't bad, just make sure you pay attention in class b/c things she says in class but doesn't give notes for are still fair game on the test. Molly gives ALOT of extra credit and also, don't buy the textbook, it's useless.

The class is very interesting and Molly is an amazing person. She is so chill except she doesn't allow you to take notes on the computer. Make sure you go to class to take the notes. I memorized all the notes for the exam but the exams are difficult. If you are looking for an easy A definitely don't take this class.
As someone who is an HDFS major, Molly is the hardest of them all. She is a great person and lecturer. But her exam are very different and include a lot of abstract thinking.

Molly is an AMAZING professor!! Her lectures are fun and interesting and after week two you won't want to miss one. Her exams are a little tricky but if you study well enough and go to the lectures you'll pass  with a decent grade. She gives random participation papers so try to go to most of the lectures. There are also a few extra credit chances.
Interesting lectures but her tests are so tricky its annoying and they count as your entire grade. Took it as a supporting course/elective and that was a mistake. Never taking her class again

Molly's class is very entertaining but her tests are tough. She gives random attendance paper and doesn't post notes so you can't miss class. Even though her tests were hard I don't regret taking this class because it was very interesting.
Molly is such an entertaining professor. Her lectures are always interesting because she exudes passion for her subject. BUT her exams are difficult. Beware: the exams are all application based.

Molly is hilarious and makes lectures fun and interesting, she truly loves her work. Make sure you go to class because her tests are straight from her lecture notes. She gives some attendance papers and reading quizzes that will help boost your grades. Tests are kind of difficult, but manageable if you study. Great class, I would take it again!

love, love, love this class!! Molly is one of my favorite professors. Her class is so interesting. Love how she incorporates her own children into lectures to help you further understand the material. Information is useful whether you are an HDFS major/minor or not. Tests are a little tricky, but would highly recommend.

Molly is an amazing teacher, and an even more amazing professor.  I look forward to class. I purposefully took another class of hers next semester, I enjoyed it so much.  She makes class interesting, hilarious, and it is natural to learn in her teaching environment.  She wants students to succeed. Attending class is EXTREMELY helpful.

You have a quiz after just about every lecture, but if you take good notes youll get a 100 every time. Exams are heavily based on examples so be sure you know the material. You can tell she loves her job, she makes everything super easy to understand but it is just a lot of info sometimes

Class feels like high school. It is a tech free class, which is understandable. But she did not allow us to leave the room during lecture, not even to use the restroom. If we needed to leave briefly for whatever reason we weren't allowed to return. There are 3 question quizzes after most lectures and exams are entirely application based & confusing

I honestly think she is a great professor, but she started doing exams for PSYCH 212. Her questions don't match the lecture and just don't make sense. Our exams are worth 60% of our grade, and the final is cumulative. She doesn't drop any quizzes, which is hard. Exams do not make sense at all; it's clear this is her first time doing exams.
Doesnt give exams its just a quiz after each class. so much extra credit

This is a hard online class not because of the material but because of the amount of work you have to do for a good grade on discussions. This is the only class where I have to write basically an essay for every discussion post and the reply. The other posts threw me off because there's no extra credit and she's very picky with grading.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She's nice, but her online class is a lot of work. Assignments are due every sunday and there's a lot of reading and the only way to get it is by spending 80+ dollars on a book. There's no exams, but she's pretty picky about discussion posts. If you don't go more in depth on your own post + peer reply you will get docked lower.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Hunt is pretty good at teaching. The class is relatively easy and she doesn't take attendance but she gives a quiz after every class based off lecture notes. Gives extra credit throughout the semester. Her voice is a bit annoying and she kind of has an infatuation with little boys

tbh i cant stand her, but the class is so easy. her personality and voice is very grating, but a tradeoff for basically no work outside of lecture. write down every word she says bc the quizzes are super specific to lecture and hard if you didn't go, but she offers so much extra credit its not funny.

Easily one of the nicest and most understanding professors. Literally just come to class and you'll do well. People complaining about her prob didn't go to class since attendance isn't necessarily mandatory, but lecture knowledge is needed for quizzes and in class assignments. Many ppl however didn't go to class

I really dislike her as a person but it was an easy A. I honestly don't know if there were readings, if there were I never did them. She offers a ton of extra credit. There are no exams, after every class there is a quiz and in class activities you can't make up. She is so annoying (her voice and personality) but it really was an easy A.

You can tell she cares about what she is teaching. The lectures are interesting but make sure you are taking extensive notes. There is no exams but weekly quizzes based on the lecture. She offers a bunch of extra credit. As long as you show up and pay attention you will do great in this class!

Dr. Hunt is a very kind professor, but I personally did not enjoy her class. The lectures were very disorganized and she didn't follow the syllabus. Some of the information I found to be irrelevant. There are no exams, but weekly quizzes on the lectures. She provides lots of extra credit opportunities.

She's sweet, but in a chaotic way that makes you question whether she's teaching the material or just venting about her life. Half the time class gets canceled. You'll spend more time checking your email for cancellations than actually learning the material. She seems to care about her students mostly because it makes her feel better about herself.
Her lectures are entertaining and she connects her material to real world examples and she is very helpful during office hours. It's mainly quizzes and in class assignments.

I took this class thinking it'd be easy since grades are based on lecture quizzes, but they're confusing even if you attend. You must go to class for credit since notes aren't posted. She dislikes tech use, is hard to reach, posts quizzes late, and requires a $100 book for assignments. I would take a different professor/online instead.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Hunt was pretty good. The lectures are tough to sit through but you can tell she enjoys what she does. You definitely CAN skip this class, but she's big on the random in class assignments and it can dampen your final grade if you miss one of those. She doesn't do makeups either, so I never took the chance. No exams in this course which was cool

Class was simple enough with open-book quizzes and no exams. Dr. Hunt is a nice professor overall, but was cancelling class almost every week for some reason. Additionally, quizzes for each lecture were posted days after, sometimes a couple of hours before class. Overall, an easy class, but could be better organized.

No exams. Attendance not mandatory but GO if you want to get an A. 
Quizzes after every class -- they are easy if you attend class&take notes. AI sources regularly miss answers to the questions
Extra credit given, but you must be in class to be made aware of the opportunities. 
This sec. is the only PSYCH100 with NO FINAL and NO EXAMS.

While the class was easy it felt like a waste of time. Dr. Hunt rarely lectures and when she does she calls out students not paying attention in big lecture halls. Most of the time though she allowed her undergrad TA to give the lectures on random topics having nothing to do with PSYCH 100 topics. She only does quizzes on the unorganized lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Good class. Each lecture either has a short quiz or an in class participation assignment. There are no exams but there are longer quizzes based off the readings every once in a while. You need to do the readings to do well on them. Her lectures are interesting and she makes lots of jokes. There is no final and she offers a ton of extra credit.

Do not take this class if you ever plan on getting sick or experiencing a family emergency. The professor shows zero compassion and expects same-day emails even for serious situations like a death. Miss a class for any reason and you're out of luck. Rigid, unsupportive, and completely unaccommodating. Absolutely terrible experience overall.

TAKE THIS CLASS. There are no exams because she doesn't want anyone to be stressed. After each lecture there is a 3 point quiz based on what she talked about in class, somewhat difficult sometimes but can be easy such as "what color did i say in class will be on quiz". This and SONA are only grades so SO easy to get an A. Lectures very interesting

Only missed one class, told her before hand and she did not inform me I would miss beneficial extra credit. Went to every single class besides that one and still there were many quizzes I did not get 100% on. She is not organized and can be careless in emails. Not compassionate or flexible.Picks on you if on phone even for a second.

If you actually want to learn anything related to Psych 100, take another professor. Lectures are a joke, and she allows the undergraduate TAs to give the lectures, often on things that they are interested in in psych rather than the curriculum. Lectures on meaningless topics while singling out students not paying attention in 200+ lecture halls.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: she gives quizzes after each lecture, but they are easy for the most part (if you are taking notes). so many extra credit ops that bring your grade up so much, NO TESTS AT ALL. attendance not mandatory. i have a 100% in this class and its april so i recommend

you absolutely cannot skip 212. she gives quizzes after every single lecture on the material presented in class. she did not post the notes. even if you have someone giving you the notes, you have to make sure to write down everything she says, because she will quiz you on it. Tests were cake cuz they were online. easy to do well but u have to go
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Make sure to be in-depth with your discussion posts and reply to peers she will deduct points if you are not. The CDA's are easy to complete and quizzes are open note. Overall she is a fair grader and great professor.

Dr. Hunt really cares about her students! Instead of doing exams every so often, she assigns open note quizzes each class day. Because of this, attendance matters a lot, but as long as you go to class you are totally okay! She is super welcoming and easy to talk to, so if you don't understand something, definitely ask and she will help you out!

Great professor she really cares about her students and makes the lectures enjoyable. She only grades by 3 question quizzes and SONA but she does allow for a considerable amount of extra credit to help your grade! You do have to come to lectures tho because she doesn't post anything in canvas but as long as you show up you should be good.

This is the easiest class I have ever taken here at PSU. I would take this class a million times if I could and Ms, Hunt is super helpful along with great lectures. If you just show up to class you will get an A+.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Loved professor hunt she was very caring very understanding, her lectures were not very boring either. She gives out no big tests, instead does 2-3 weekly quizzes with only 3 questions based on the lecture. They really aren't that hard she is also understanding if you miss a quiz. Try to make most classes and you'll be fine getting an A.

took her online bc of the reviews, wouldnt recommend taking her online. theres exams online and exams includes way more information than what she presents on lectures vids. lecture vids only covers about 10% of whats on the exam so its very important to take notes on the book. there is only 3 exams but she will add old questions from previous exams
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Hunt is such a sweet woman and good professor. The class is very easy with no exams, just weekly quizzes based on what you learn during the lectures (so I recommend going to class). She is very understanding grade wise and offers extra credit throughout the semester.

Such a sweet woman. She doesn't take attendance, but the quizzes are based on lecture material and she doesn't post the notes, so go to class and you will be fine. Her lectures are interesting, though! Personally we had no tests or exams, we just had 4 question quizzes based on each lecture. She had us buy a textbook but I haven't opened it. 10/10.

Dr. Hunt's class is a fun and easy ride. While attendance is mandatory, the lack of exams and reliance on quizzes makes it manageable. Definitely use Unstuckstudy alongside the textbook to ace those tricky quiz questions.

Her lectures are very fun and easy to pay attention in. The only graded stuff is quizzes so pay attention in class. No homework other than the quizzes and module quizzes. Super easy class. Loved her class.

She is a very nice professor, make sure you go to class because that's what the quizzes are based off. She doesn't have tests and has quizzes and assignments that make up all the grading scale. She is very nice and her lectures are very engaging and she also offers a lot of extra credit. She is definitely one of my favorite professors I have taken.

Such a funny professor. Always says out-of-pocket stuff that will make you laugh. Loved the class and thought grasping the material was easy. The only graded thing are the quizzes assigned for homework after every class meaning you have to attend class to do well since she doesn't post notes. The only other thing is these quizzes are pretty tricky.
good professor, no exams. but she posts quizzes after every lecture and doesnt post the notes, so in order to do well u have to go to class

Shes funny but her voice will take time to adjust to. You need the textbook (her own) but its pretty cheap. about 3 quizzes every week that make up your grade but the questions can be worded tricky. Very helpful and pretty funny but wouldnt want to take again

She has been my favorite professor at penn state. she doesn't give exams, the only grades you have are online quizzes. go to class play attention and you will pass no problem. her lectures are funny and she gives a lot of extra credit.
Love her best professor at psu

Loved Dr. Hunt so much! Her lectures are interesting and she is the funniest professor I know. Her jokes can be a little out of pocket sometimes but she's amazing. Reading the textbook is required to do well of the module quizzes. There are no exams and no final which is really nice.

She is super engaging and so nice. Her lectures are super fun to listen to and she makes it very enjoyable to be in class.  No exams either. Grades are solely on weekly quizzes based on lecture so if you miss lecture and don't do well it can poorly affect your grade. Also, some of the quiz questions are worded weird and they're only 3 questions so.

I've taken two classes with Dr. Hunt and she's truly an amazing being. Her lectures are taught in an engaging way and she is very accesible outside of class.

212: No exams, only quizzes and occasional HW assignments. 
269: Exams + Final were based on class material, quizzes, attendance is mandatory

Easiest A. I didn't buy the textbook and got over 100%. The lectures are small and are word for word on the mini quizzes. NO EXAMS/FINAL. The worst thing I can say about this class is that it's large. But despite that, Cathleen is absolutely incredible! Shes very understanding and does not like to see students struggle.

The class is very easy because there are no exams but quizzes on the lectures. Attendance is not taken in any way however she does not post her notes which the quizzes are based on. There is an online textbook needed for the class and there are a few additional quizzes based on the readings. She offers a lot of extra credit, well over 20 points.

TAKE HER. EASY A!!!!! I didn't even buy the text book, got 4/6's on a lot of the quizzes, and ended WITH AN 100. She gives so much extra credit. Just go to class and take notes and you'll get an A. She makes lectures entertaining! I can't stress it enough TAKE HER. Only negative is she doesn't answer emails, so email the Grad TA.

Psych 212 with Dr. Hunt is a very easy class. There are no exams, only quizzes after each lecture. The only downside is she does not post the notes on canvas, so you have to go to class if you want the notes for the quiz.

Class is graded by 6 pt quizzes after every lecture (attendance is mandatory). Quizzes are easy if u take notes. I got plenty of 2/6 and 4/6's, and still ended with a 97. She gives a lot of extra credit. She cares about us learning + wants us to do well! There are many opportunities to get ur grade up if u do bad on some quizzes! Easy A

NO EXAMS, but there are short (3-5 questions) quizzes given over almost every lecture, so make sure you either go or get the notes from someone else. Dr. Hunt is single-handedly the best professor here at UP. No test or final exam. The course is compiled of weekly quizzes which are easy if you go to lecture. She makes her lectures fun and engaging so going isn't a problem. I refer Dr. Hunt to all of my friends because she is the best.

No exams and no finals. She is great. She really cares about her job and what she teaches. Lots of mini quizzes on lectures that help grades. Get ready to read the textbook to take other quizzes on them (but they are not bad). Loved her class.

Truly caring and compassionate about the topic and the students. She and TAs put in the extra effort to help you catch up. Hunt is a really cool teacher and person. It is evident how much she cares about kids and what she teaches. This class was extremely easy I was shocked. Definitely attend class and take notes for the quizzes, there are no exams which is lit.

Course followed a new format where there were no tests, only daily quizzes on lectures and TopHat questions during lectures. Very easy to get an A if you take notes during lecture. Plenty of extra credit. Randomly stopped recording lectures the last month of the semester which was annoying

Prof Hunt took away all exams for this semester. Our grade was solely based off 6 pt lecture quizzes on canvas and occasional tophat questions. The only reason she's not a 5/5 is because the last month of class she revoked the option to do Zoom which was a big help for many students.

Professor Hunt is an amazing professor. Her lectures were clear and easy to understand. She is extremally funny and worked her humor into the lectures. Terrible. Professor completely dismisses online students. Doesn't put any effort into teaching at all. Sure it's easy and I know a lot of students don't really care if they learn anything. I loved Dr. Hunt and she is one of the reasons I want to become a psych prof. Your grade is mainly based off quick after-lecture quizzes that are very fair if you listened in class. She truly made me laugh in class and I looked forward to lectures everyday. If you bomb a quiz there is surely some extra credit opportunities. learning, not testing

Professor Hunt's class was so easy and she is one of the most caring professors I have ever had. Dr. Hunt is genuinely one of the sweetest/ most passionate professors i've ever had. She's so knowledgable, relatable, and funny. Her lecture material was interesting and engaging. One of my favorite professors by far!! She actually goes through her reviews and suggestions by students and adjusts from that. Dr. Hunt is amazing, her lectures aren't long and she gives plenty of examples to fulfill your understanding. She is passionate about what she's teaching, which makes it easy to learn the material from her.

Professor Hunt is an extremely caring and funny professor! Dr. Hunt is super funny and is clearly passionate about what she teaches. She really cares about the students and wants them to do better. Lots of extra credit. Cant say enough amazing things about Dr. Hunt. She is truly in love with what she teaches and makes it easy to learn. Dr. Hunt us a great professor! Not only is she super kind and helpful, but the class is really easy to get an A in as well. Exams are super easy if u pay attention or even just look over notes beforehand. She sometimes goes off topic in lecture but I don't mind :)

Dr. Hunt is funny.. just because she's so weird. I didn't usually go to class (people posted notes in groupme) and still did really good in the class. She's really unorganized though and talks forever about random things during lecture.. overall not bad but not my favorite.

Professor Hunt is so interesting and caring. Her lectures are super fun and interesting. Tests arent bad as long as you study and take good notes in class.

Dr. Hunt is a very knowledgable and interesting professor. She gives real life examples to help explain the material. I looked forward to going to class and I am a business major. She's funny and the materials presented in her class are interesting. ask questions if you don't understand, she will help you. Loved this class. Dr. Hunt is so sweet and she really cares about her students. The tests are pretty straight forward but you DEFINITELY need to study and her study guides help you to find things in the textbook that she doesn't go over in class.
Dr. Hunt is a great professor. She is very clear with the assignments and is willingly to work with you if needed! If you need developmental psychology, take this course with Dr. Hunt!!

LOVED DR HUNT. So sweet and funny, great teacher, very knowledgable, knows her stuff. If you ask a question she can answer really in-depthly. lectures and slides are not organized. tough exams and grader. very intense class.

Dr. Hunt is great she's pretty funny and very passionate. She offers many opportunities to seek help (i didn't use them but there were a lot) Tests aren't awful mostly real world example. You can expect a 3 question quiz once a week which is only on material from one class they aren't bad if you go to that lecture. Overall very good class.
Dr. Hunt is hysterical and incredibly knowledgeable. I found her lectures to be informative and interesting. Great psych professor.

She makes it seem like her tests will be easy because the material she discusses is very clear and easy. Then the tests come and they're like paragraph questions and there's questions inside questions.

Loved Dr. Hunt! She's engaging, funny, and keeps lecture fun despite them being a bit long sometimes. CAN NOT skip class, notes aka ALL quiz AND test questions come from class. I underestimated the challenge level of her exams after the easssy online quizzes and got stuck playing catch-up w my grade all semester bc its just quizzes & 3 tests.

She's very clear about what is expected on the tests, and if you go to class everyday and take notes, and then study that you'll get an easy A. The tests aren't hard if you know the material. She's clear about what you need to know exactly. MAKE SURE YOU GO TO CLASS ON THE DAY SHE ASSIGNS ONLINE QUIZZES.  questions come directly from the lecture.
this class is really boring and the exams are unnecessarily tough. go to every class if you want a good grade.
Dr. Hunt makes class fun. She is very funny and the exams are fairly easy.

The course is okay but simply knowing the material is not enough to earn the grade. I missed the in-class activity that was arbitrarily assigned the most points, making me receive a disproportionately lower grade compared to the effort I put into the class. I got 100% on two exams and very high B's on the others but I still received a low B.
Loved her! Such a good class, she kept it interesting and great sense of humor. Class is very fair and she is super helpful and always there to answer questions.
Her sense of humor is great, her power points Are clear and straightforward. Def recommend her, she is a great professor, very knowledgeable. Her voice is kinda annoying though, just a forewarning

Dr. Hunt is a really great professor! PSYCH 221 is one of my favorite classes. Her lectures are clear and straightforward, and Dr. Hunt is extremely helpful during office hours. Her sense of humor makes class really fun! I would definitely recommended taking a class with Dr. Hunt.

Wow. This class is the easiest class I've ever taken. Minimal studying is needed for exams, she practically spoon feeds information to you. Lecture is mandatory unfortunately, but otherwise a VERY easy A.
Probably one f the best professors I've had thus far. Her lectures are very interesting, study everything on her study guides and you will be fine.

Dr Hunt was fantastic! Definitely take her if you have to take this class. The material was very interesting and her tests were very fair. GO TO CLASS because if you do you will have a 100% on all your quizzes, they're so easy. Not all of her exam material comes from the lecture so you need to buy the book.

She's so adorable and funny, I love her. You do have to attend class and study if you want to do well on the exams, but she makes it well worth your time. She keeps things interesting and fun and I never wanted to miss it.
Dr. Hunt's class was great. She went through all the important material in class and her exams were very fair.

Class is somewhat interesting and she gives pretty clear lectures. Exams aren't too bad. Just study everything off her study guides and you will get an A. Textbook is mandatory b/c she doesn't teach some material for the exam, maybe like 10% of material she doesn't teach.

I am an engineering major, did not need this course. Came with a friend one time to listen to her and registered right away. SHE IS AMAZING! her lectures are so interesting! and I genuinely studied and got a good grade. It is not an easy A, but the material is so freaking interesting and she makes it fun you will love studying for it!

Dr. Hunt's class isn't a pushover, but her lectures are really interesting, and she can be so funny in class. She's very willing to help all she can, and very approachable. Her exams are a little hard, but not impossible as long as you go to the lectures. Study guides are helpful too. Overall, she's a great professor. I definitely learned a lot.

I don't quite understand the negative developmental psych comments. I thought the course was very interesting. Dr. Hunt's exams are easy if you attend lecture and read the book. She also gives you opportunities for extra credit. I found Dr. Hunt's class so interesting, I never wanted to miss a lecture. Overall, I thought it was a great class.

LOVE her! She's awesome! It's not a bird-course, but she is very approachable and really knows her stuff! You should be interested in psych if you're going to take one of her PSYCH courses (sorry, but people saying don't take her courses unless you like psych are being a bit idiotic - don't take psych unless you like psych!). Great class.

Do not take unless you have an intrinsic interest in psychology. Developmental psychology is a very intensive course...on material that did not interest me in the least. I'm trying to save other people the hassle.

She is an excellent teacher! It is clear that she really knows what she is talking about. She uses many different examples to appeal to the wide variety of students in the class. Prof Hunt is hilarious. Yes, you have to study but as long as you do a good job and follow her outlines and GO TO CLASS you will be fine!

I have this woman for class this semester through World Campus. It is one of the worst classes I have ever taken.  She nitpicks everything, exams consist of absurd info from book & stuff that hasn't  taught.  She might be fine in person, but for online....AVOID. You will never be right & expect exam scores to avg 60%
Really enjoyed her class!
if there is any professor not to take at this fine establishment its her, she dosnt want her students to pass its as simple as that.

Boring lectures. absurd amount of information on tests, extremely annoying when it comes to asking the class to be quiet, and refuses to bump up any grades (or at least be nice about it). had awful TAs

This teacher is average to sub-par. Her lectures are very dry and contain LOTS of information, some of which isnt even on the tests. She completely ruined my interest in the subject. Powerpoints come straight from textbook. She tells you to read the textbook since she doesn't want to teach everything. You can never be sure what will appear on exams

This class was great! Dr. Hunt is very clear and thorough, and funny!.  She gives you outlines and study guides for all the material.  She nags about cellphones and computers but thats the only thing unpleasant about her!  Overall, the tests are very fair and the class is an easy A if you study! Definitely take this class!

I had Dr. Hunt for Developmental Psychology (PSYCH 212). I got an A in the class and found Dr. Hunt hysterical. Her lectures get dry at times but she tends to lighten them up with stories and jokes. Exams are exactly the information on the outlines she uploads to ANGEL and anything you don't have in your lecture notes can be found in the textbook.

I had Dr. Hunt for Developmental Psychology (PSYCH 212). I got an A in the class and found Dr. Hunt hysterical. Her lectures get dry at times but she tends to lighten them up with stories and jokes.
