Professor Lawson is a great professor who cares a lot about her students. The class was very easy and the assignments took not too long to complete. They were very straightforward. If you skip class, you won't pass

Professor Lawson's lecture provide information that will be super useful outside of class. Due to her experiences in clinical nutrition and being a manager, she has had real-life experiences and knows what we'll need in the workforce and for dietetic internship interviews. She's always available and willing to help even outside of class.
Easy A and makes her expectations clear.

Professor Lawson genuinely cares about her students. She is transparent in what she expects from you and provides ample reminders through canvas for assignments/exams in addition to giving thoughtful feedback on assignments to help with future assignments. Case study days are mandatory attendance. Very helpful in terms of career preparation!

Amazing professor overall. Very caring, informative, and gives clear instructions for everything. Really enjoyed the group business plan project. Both NUTR 386 & NUTR 370 taught by Professor Lawson are very important to know and understand for future in the Dietetic field.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I was never prepared for the level of difficulty of the exams. The PPTs are set up in a nicely but I think a lot of the exam material came from the book, which I did not buy. She is really nice, though. The class material was really interesting and useful to life after the course. She gives 1 extra credit pt if you go to class.

I really enjoyed this class. It is definitely an easy A if you put the work in. The tests are all from the quizzes and all the quizzes are super easy. There is a business plan group project, but it is not difficult to complete. Attendance is mandatory due to pop up activities and case study days.

I loved this class, the information is really interesting if you love to cook. If you don't know how to cook this class is perfect for you. Tests aren't hard, usually don't take longer than 15 minutes. Read through the slides and notes sections, they are very helpful. There is always left over food to bring home after class too which is awesome.
Easy A class just make sure you take the quizzes and go through the study questions with each lesson. Exams are in the testing center and they are very easy they never take longer than 10 minutes.
Hybrid course
not a nice person and exams are so hard. genuinely the worst professor i have ever had

I loved this professor!! She is very good at explaining things, and even though the course is a lecture-heavy class, she takes the time to explain it rather than just read off the slides. The tests follow much/all of the material off the slides, and if you study even a little bit, you'll get at least a B or A. Overall a good class!

Would not take a class with her again. She does not seem to care about her students, and she is honestly just not a good teacher. She makes her LAs do all of the work, and they teach us better than she does... which is very concerning. ALSO never has ever answered an email. Like ever. :(

Professor Dehart is a kind and understanding person. Attendance is not mandatory, she posts the lecture recordings online. However, I strongly recommend attending this class. The exams are based on worksheets/lectures from class. I also recommend attending her office hours or the LA's; they will go over anything you need. Have her again for 163!
Amazing professor! Taking her class again for BIO163!
Professor Dehart is very nice, and her class structure is easy to follow. If you use learning objectives on Canvas to study for exams or rewatch recorded lectures, the exams aren't too bad.
Professor Dehart is super nice and teaches at a good pace. Follow learning objectives for exams and you'll do fine. Not a lot of work, do topHats
Professor DeHart is super chill. Her exams emulate the content on the powerpoints. Pay attention, review in advance, and you will do just fine. Chill class.

Professor Dehart was a great professor. Tests are extremely straight forward and if you study you will do well. She gives learning objectives at the beginning of each slideshow, if you know those and continue to write them out and understand them/the worksheets/ the drawings from class, you will easily get an A!

she's an amazing professor and funny and lectures are uploaded in case you miss but the drawings are not uploaded and that's what a lot of test material is. to study redraw the drawings over and over and make sure you understand them

DeHart is a good teacher as long as you follow the criteria. Though class is not mandatory, you will need to watch the lectures when they uploaded 2-ish days later, as her tests focus on classwork. Most points come from exams, so try your best. Very nice teacher, let me retake the final when my alarm didn't go off.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Honestly, I failed three exams and still ended up passing the class with a C+. The course was based on four exams and a final, and it was really difficult at first. As a first-semester freshman. The material became much easier, and I know I could have earned an A if I had learned those strategies earlier.

Lectures are mainly just her reading off slides, but I found that helpful. Exams are very straightforward, and pretty easy as long as you go over the material on the slides and the worksheets that you do in class. Super caring, and the TA's host great review sessions.

Super caring professor! Lectures are engaging and occasionally give worksheets in class. Exams can be challenging, but you can do well if you study. Exams aren't a surprise, though; everything on them she has always covered in class. She is also very accommodating and easy to reach outside of class. Would definitely take again!
ok experience
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I absolutely loved this class! Professor DeHart is super organized, explains everything clearly, and truly cares about her students. The worksheets were incredibly helpful and covered most of the exam material. She also posts lectures on Canvas. One of my favorite classes and I'm excited to take Bio 163 with her in the spring.

I had a wonderful experiencing taking DeHarts BIOL161. She is a super fun and engaging professor, and her lectures are easy to follow. She provides review materials that are super helpful and exams are not tricky. She draws out the different processes and gives worksheets that we complete in class that are super helpful! I'm taking her for 163!

I really liked Professor Dehart's class. This class was pretty difficult but that's to be expected when taking anatomy. I saw some other posts about her accent but she's a clear speaker in my opinion and I understood her very well. She posts lectures so everything she taught was very accessible and she gives every resource you need for success.

A&P is hard, and no matter who teaches it, it's going to be hard. Regardless, Dr. Dehart was very welcoming and her lectures were enjoyable. She had a sense of humor and I enjoyed listening to her accent. She is an ideal biology professor.
She honestly isn't the worst teacher, I learned a lot in her class but a 9am is difficult to get to because it's so early.

I personally love Professor Dehart and her teaching style. Yes, the material is complicated, and she is fast-paced, but after a while, I got used to her. I would recommend her if you're a good exam taker, since it is exam-heavy. She gives you all the materials you need to succeed in her class, and I chose to take her again for BIOL 163.

Professor Dehart is very passionate about what she teaches! Yes, A&P is difficult to begin with. But if you put in the work, you should be more than fine. Do the pre-week assignments and actually watch the videos, take notes on her lectures in advance, and make a study plan. Just put effort in. She always provides great resources, too.
She doesn't teach. When she lectures she talks at you, not to you. Does not explain things well and overall has an attitude.
Just learn the slides and you will do great, she also hides a few exam questions in her review notes

Dehart was a great professor. I had her for BIOL 161 and chose to take her again for 163. She goes over worksheets which are extremely helpful for the test. The content can seem overwhelming at times but her tests are very straightforward and she never tries to trick you. TopHat attendance but you can do them anytime/anyplace.

I love Barbara! Personally I thought Bio 163 lecture was easier than 161. I believe she definitely put in more work to interact with her students this semester. Uploads worksheets and lectures are recorded and also posts practice exams which help a ton. You will have to put the work outside class to get a good grade for this class A&P is NOT easy.

She is very nice and her lectures aren't boring, she loves to throw in some jokes and she's very upbeat. It's not that hard, just make sure you study well for exams and you should do good. She records lectures which is very helpful. She isn't very easy to reach outside of class, it takes her a long time to respond. Highly recommend DeHart!

I have had Professor Dehart for two semesters now. BIO161 was definitely easier than BIO163. There is A LOT of material, but if you stay on top of your work and start studying earlier, it will be fine.

Great professor. As long as you do the pre-week assignments beforehand and pay attention to lectures, the exams should be fine. Her exams are based off the slides and there are no unexpected questions or topics on them. Overall I really loved her class and I recommend taking her!

Dr. Dehart is sweet but lowkey reads off the slides. There are tophats for participation and worksheet wrap ups/preweek assignments outside of class. I spent ~twenty mins a week doing hw, but the majority of time I spent outside of class was studying. Tests can be tricky, so know the slides verbatim because exams are literally learning objectives.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Her voice is very annoying so would not recommended taking it 9 am. There are a lot of worksheets in class. The TA don't really help your better off reading the slides and reviewing that. Toooo many top hate question. Just a lot of HW in general.

If you pay attention, study a lot, and go to class you will be fine. Its a lot of work, but its definitely do able. You definitely have to put the work in for this class. Professor makes things very easy to understand, so pay attention. Attendance isn't required, but I would say go so you don't fall behind.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The tests were very hard. There was no point in studying because the test were so confusing. She was very nice but didn't explain the content; she just read off the slides.
This is not an easy class.  She is a very good teacher though.  Explains complicated concepts well, and does a very good job teaching.  Go to class and take notes and you will be good.

She's eh. The tests are insanely difficult for some, no matter how hard you study the material. You'd think what you were learning in class was straightforward... No. She gives no study guide for the exam; she just expects you to use the slides and additional videos she provides. So get ready to work and basically OVER teach yourself.

She is obviously very passionate about biology. The exams are all fair, but you HAVE to pay attention in class and do the weekly worksheets and assignments. Luckily, if you are absent, she posts recorded lectures. Only one or two extra credit opportunities.

Prof. DeHeart is nice, but this is definitely a hard class. Exams are tricky & you have a lot of information to study for in one exam. She reads off slides the whole time & posts them on Canvas. Attendance not mandatory, but you do multiple TopHat questions in class that are graded on correctness. Short, quiz-like assignments at end of every week.

Her class is very bearable and interesting. She uses various ways to teach the material, such as Tophat questions, worksheets, and lectures. If you miss class you will still be able to edit your TopHat and she posts a video of the lecture from that day. Her powerpoints are useful and she makes sure her students understand the material. I recommend!
She is so passionate in what she does and helps when asked. 100% recommend!

Prof DeHart is very passionate about what she does and explains the material very well. There are assignments assigned before each week which really help understand what is going to be on the exams. Once you figure out her style it is easier to gauge what the exam questions are going to be like. She's a great prof overall and exams arent that bad

She mostly read off the slides and repeated info. We had pre-lecture quizzes and videos, so it was a flipped classroom. The exams were made up all the points, but they were always multiple choice. Honestly, I never went to lecture, and I studied a day before each of the exams (4 not including final). The final was not cumulative and stupid easy.

You can tell she is very passionate about what she does. she tells jokes and tries to make the class not too boring. there are worksheet assignments and pre-week and wrap-up assignments every week to help your grade. with that being said I know so many people who dropped her class. out of all the bio professors I heard her exams are the hardest.

Anatomy is a very information-heavy class - lots of memorizing body mechanisms. However, Barbara did a great job explaining the material and she spent extra time on concepts that students often struggled with. Her class is very heavily based on exams and the pre/post week quizzes. she posts lecture vids that you can use to study

professor dehart is such a nice woman who is so passionate about biology. she is so respected and smart, but can crack jokes and acknowledge how hard the class and information can be. she provides worksheets that are essentially study guides for exams. she provides study tips throughout classes. she made bio so easy and not intimidating.

I emailed her multiple times asking for help and she completely ignored all my emails and mentioned in class that if you weren't understanding everything you just had to study more and work harder. LAs were not helpful and often times were put into the position of teaching us more information than her. Felt like she didn't care about her students.
Barbara is perfect. She was such a good teacher and her tests were very too the point. Her exams were very straight forward and there was never any discrepencies.

She was a pretty good teacher and her class wasn't that difficult as long as you put in the work and go to lecture. There are weekly pre assignments and worksheet wrap-ups that can be found online. The course consists of about 5 exams. Her tests are pretty straight forward and coincide with her notes. I never went to any office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dehart is a nice lady and her exams are fair as long as you are up to date with the lectures and spend a good amount of time studying terms and concepts in advance of the test. She records lectures and uploads the powerpoint so attendance isn't mandatory, but I'd recommend going as material makes more sense when you hear her explaining things.

Nice lady but her exams are not clear and I failed every single one. They are very conceptual heavy and she makes the questions very confusing. Many people I know failed the exams every time. there are 4 exams and a final. Would not take again
If you attend every lecture and focus on it. It is easy to get A, the exams are mostly based on presentation and her exam material on can
Very disorganized and always run into problems on exam days

Save yourself the headache. A nice woman, but can't teach. There's typos not only on the slides, but EXAMS too. Exams are impossible, even if you put in the work. Will not curve the exams if her life depends on it. Went to her office hours and she made me feel dumb. Doesn't care if we do bad. I did good in 161 and still struggled w/ her. run.

I excelled in Bio 161, still had trouble. The tests were pointless to study for because they were so hard. She also has a test the day after THON, spring break. Tophats are accessible for a week after class, so class isn't  mandatory. She's nice but cannot teach. Just reads through slides. Doesn't give extra credit, even when the means are a 50.

Awful professor. Avoid her if you can. She packs so much material into each exam and doesn't explain it at all. She mixes lymphatic system, urinary system, AND respiratory system into one unit. Not sure how they go together in any way at all. Class is a waste of time. Would not recommend her to anyone!!!!

I really liked her class. I definitely did better in Bio 163, but I still did well in here. The exams are difficult if you do not pay attention in lecture. She is really funny and gives plenty of opportunities to earn you participation points. I would recommend this class! The lab also pairs nicely with the lectures.

dehart is funny and tries her best to give extra credit participation points. tophat questions are accessible for a week so u can change ur answer to get full credit. sometimes rushes through material but if u make quizlets out of her lectures, pay attention to what she says in class, and do her worksheets, u will do great in the course

You're basically on your own for this class. She speeds through the presentations and does not really go into depth with explanations. When she does, they don't really make sense. Content is easy enough, but again, you just have to teach yourself - beware of the tests having specific details from the slides.

The class is hard and a lot of material no matter who you take it with but she makes it as easy as possible. She explains the content fully and makes it clear what's going to be on exams. Her lectures are recorded and the topcoat isn't due until the end of the week so if you miss a class it's not the end of the world.

Very nice, good sense of humor. You need to attend class or watch the lectures, it's a lot of material, but with that and reviewing lecture slides before the exams, you will easily get A's. If you think you're going to struggle with A&P, take a medical terminology class first, because then you won't have to be learning the vocab at the same time.

Dr. Dehart made A&P pretty painless.  She keeps things lighthearted and her explanations are really clear.  Exams are worksheet-heavy and there's always a couple tricky details from the slides.  BUT if you study and are motivated you can get an A on every exam no problem.  Even in person, all the lectures were recorded and posted online. hallelujah

This course is tough but Dehart was a great professor and taught the lectures well. The topics were interesting and she made them easier to understand. Attendance is not mandatory, however, there are participation assignments to complete each week to receive a full participation grade. This class takes lots of studying overall to do well.

She overall is not too bad. She gives you all the learning material to succeed on exams. People just mess up sometimes because you actually have to learn and not just memorize. She sometimes messes up with her polling questions but notices quickly. Nothing amazing but also nothing bad about her.

Y'all don't believe the negative reviews! She is a great professor, she explains things in a way you would understand. The class is a lot of content to be prepared but as long as you go over the information many times you will do well. If you can understand everything in the notes she has and worksheets you will get a good grade on the exams!

Professor DeHart was a good professor and clearly explained all the content throughout the semester. However, she does not respond to emails in a timely manner. In fact, she ignored about 7 or 8 of my emails in a row after I had to take a deferred grade and needed to make up the remainder of my assignments and take the final exam. Unaccommodating.

She posts all the lecture recordings but that just might be bc of covid. All notes are online and easy to follow. The lowest grades are dropped on a few assignments which is nice if you forget to do one. Exams aren't that bad if you go through the powerpoints and worksheets she gives out, she doesn't try to trick you on the material. Solid choice
DeHart is fine, she's your typical college prof. Nothing really special but nothing wrong with it. Just watch the lectures and do a quick 2 hour study before tests. Its pretty basic.
I took her since everyone gave her good ratings. I struggled, her tests are so hard, she does not explain questions in depth, speeds through powerpoints

Prof. DeHart is a solid choice for A&P. Gives very clear explanations and will actually take the time to go over material rather than speed through it. No surprises on the exams, although they really made you think. Held worksheet Fridays before the exams and was very helpful after class/during office hours. Would definitely take again!

Dr. Dehart is an intelligent and caring professor. Maybe my view is tainted because the prof I had for the first anatomy course was awful, but having Dr. Dehart for A&P 2 was honestly so nice. She was easy to access outside of class, and more than willing to help you grasp the material. Study a few days in advance for the exams and you'll be fine.

Professor Dehart has been the best biology professor I have ever had! She cares about all her students and she's always willing to help you understand the material. I have to say that the material of this class was challenging, but if you are ready to learn and do the work you'll be more than fine. Good luck!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This review is for BIO163! She is such a sweet lady who is a great teacher! As long as you pay attention in class and take good notes, you should be ok. The tests are pretty hard but do your best and you'll be ok. There are also many assignments to help pull your grade up that are easy and worth a lot of points. I recommend this professor I like hr
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Dehart was a great biology professor! Even thought he material was a lot, she always recorded lectures so you could rewatch them if need be. She was so sweet and helpful at office hours and didnt simply just give you the answer, she made you think and helped you work through it. Id take her again!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor is super sweet and understanding. Yeah, lecture gets a little boring sometimes, but that's because of the material, not the teacher! Exams are pretty difficult but grades can be raised thru other assignments

Professor Dehart is knowledgeable, however, you are mostly on your own. It helps to have friends in the class because she never responds. She always had technical difficulties on Zoom so you often have to do poll and participation points outside of class and she usually doesn't answer questions in the chat. Exams are ok if you study a lot
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Dehart is an extremely knowledgeable and caring professor. Her lectures are heavy, but they are extremely detailed. She offers office hours and worksheet Fridays to go over material. Her clicker questions are in chat on zoom, but then you must complete them on Canvas on Sunday. Get ready to study for her exams as they are detailed.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Material is very detailed and exams are difficult. Most questions are applying what you know about the material, not straightforward classes. Clicker points are graded on accuracy. Pre-week videos/quiz & worksheet wrap up quizzes on canvas are a nice way to bump up your grade. Speeds through the material, but if you work hard you can get a B+ or A.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Anatomy is not an easy course; Dr. Dehart would be doing a disservice is she made the course simple, as you would not learn anything. I genuinely enjoyed this class. There is a lot of material,but Dr. DeHart and the LAs were always there to help. She also found ways to relate the material to everyday, very interesting!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Dehart's lectures were usually pretty interesting, she's even pretty funny. There is usually homework every week, but they're not that long or hard, good trade boost. Exams are straight from the powerpoints. I enjoyed the class. Easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Textbook is used for lab, gives very unclear lectures, exams have mistakes and you cannot ask questions during an exam, often messes up material during lecture, withholds information on the homework so she doesn't "give it away" and then never teaches that material, tries to trick you on exams with very difficult questions, hard final. Rambles alot

Barbara is an amazing lecturer. Her slides had a lot of fascinating clinical studies that even now I can still recall. You do have to work for the class, that I have to admit but it is so worth it. I highly recommend her because she really sets a strong foundation up for nursing school.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: With the lab this is the hardest class Ive ever taken. Massive amount of material that demands memorization. Material can get confusing so ask questions to clarify. Dr. Dehart has a great sense of humor & provides feedback for work. She has office hours and makes time to meet out of class. Work hard & youll do well. Grade based on more than exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: she was very unhelpful and rude when my hw grade was messed up bc of technical issues, she refused to fix it for me. she also went into way more detail than my friend in squyres class did. test questions were often not even on the slidestake squyres instead to save yourself a headache & be tested from information actually on the slides.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She often was all over the place and did not explain things well into depth. She makes the exams extremely hard and specific, so definitely note all detail including things she mentions that aren't put into the notes. Also not allowed to ask questions during exams?? She is the least helpful and toughest grader I have had. Lab boosts your grade up.

Even though I usually enjoy anatomy and seem to understand it, her teaching style made it a bit more difficult than it had to be. Lab is much easier, but she does rush and seems to have trouble explaining some things. Definitely try to get some help from the LAs before exams to make sure you understand what is going on.

She often seemed confused by what she was teaching, but overall the class was not too bad. It's bio, so obviously difficult, but she didn't make it worse, at least. Don't buy the textbook, it would probably confuse you more. She isn't the best at explaining things in class but she's kinda funny so class isn't totally boring

funny but she is not accessible outside of class at all. go to every LA session to get your hw checked before submitting and make sure u get every clicker  helps ur grade A LOT. lab is definitely easier than lecture. her exams are not hard but its a lot of material, so you have to study a couple of days for it.

Was not a fan of her teaching style at all, pretty much just reading off the powerpoint so it was hard to stay focused. She's EXTREMELY difficult to get in touch with, and with such a tough class that makes for a difficult semester. NEVER answered my e-mail and even when I went to office hours, I still didn't feel helped out at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This class is definitely challenging. It is very fast paced and the material is in depth and complex. Dr. Dehart never answers emails so if you have questions, it is best to stop by office hours. Dr. Dehart is a very kind person who tells some funny stories and jokes to make it less painful but the class itself is just very challenging.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: If you don't go to class you won't know what's going on. Most of what she says is more important than the powerpoints. She never replies emails so good luck getting in touch with her. Her study guides are useless just know everything she talked about in class and that was in the lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: ya the class is tough. shes cool kinda and i didnt hate her lectures too much. but her tests were hard to say the least. study the slides. everything is in the slides. there is some hw once a week, nothing too bad. There arn't many other teachers for the course so she might be your best bet.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Barb is a good-hearted woman. She's kind and tells some funny jokes and stories-necessary to alleviate some of the pain this course induces. She can be a bit scatterbrained and moves quickly so I suggest taking notes on the ppts before lecture, then noting what she says. Exams are very hard, but other opportunities to redeem your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Dehart is a sweet lady and takes her time going through course material. Although the course itself is fast paced, Dehart breaks her slides down and helps students understand the material with diagrams and drawings. To study for exams, I recommend looking at ALL of her slides, clicker questions, and homeworks assignements.
Barb is alright. She never really makes any sense during lectures. Basically just memorize the powerpoints. Is helpful during office hours though, which she only holds for an hour once a week.

She has an accent, but its not bad. She also jokes around a lot which made her long lectures enjoyable. She is very clear and specific when it comes to the criteria. You have to go to the lectures or else you won't pass, plus she gives out some clicker questions which help your grade in the end.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: DeHart wasn't bad, her test were tough, but aslong as you study everything should be fine. She's really funny and makes class enjoyable, all of her test questions come from her slides, so buying the book is unnecessary. Gives homework and does clicker points as apart of grades Class isn't mandatory if you don't mind missing clicker points.

She was an amazing anatomy teacher! Her lectures were useful and she always made them interesting. Her exams really aren't that tough as long as you take the time to memorize the material. I would definitely take the time to make notecards and memorize them, and you should be absolutely fine.

Dehart made me love anatomy. Her lectures were straightforward and were exemplified by many of her own stories or acronyms. Tests were 40 questions and based upon the lecture material. As long as you memorized the material they weren't hard. She gave out homework throughout the semester that correlated to the material and helped me understand it.

You really have to keep up with the work. It's organized pretty well, but tests are very detail oriented. She never once answered my emails though, class is only mandatory if you want the attendance points, which you probably do, they are a nice boost!

I love biology and so learning the material wasn't so horrible because I was interested. But DeHart made the course very hard, her exams were extremely detailed orientated. The other teacher for BIO129 is worse, so if you can take her!

AVOID THIS PROFESSOR. Terrible. Gave us incorrect info. She is a sweet lady, but wow. She gave us clicker questions for attendance, but if you didn't get the clicker question right, you didn't get points for coming & the clicker questions were REALLY badly worded. Lovedreally good at lab, hated lecture. Lecture info not the same as exams

Dr. DeHart is a great professor. Anatomy in itself is a lot of material and you definitely need to study for exams. The exams are tough but definitely doable and fair. I would take a class with her again.  I couldn't make her office hours and she would always arrange to meet me at another time. Definitely meet up with her. It pays off.

Clicker questions were hard and graded for correctness. STUDY those questions. You will understand how she makes her test questions. She is a wonderful person. She means well, but she is very scatterbrained. Exams required a lot of studying.
Her clicker questions are ridiculous and they count for correctness. Boring lectures, reads off of slides. Her exams were pretty tough. Really loved the lab in the course though

She never answers emails and she doesn't even use her own tests anymore, so half the stuff on them she doesn't even teach. not worth taking anatomy with her she reads directly off of the slides and doesn't explain anything further.

I love Dr. DeHart as a person, but as far as a teacher not so much. She makes lectures interesting with examples, but they are confusing, along with her test questions (which you can't ask questions on while taking the exam)  definitely make sure you know everything on the slide cause she will ask a random nit picky question
She is really funny and makes it interesting. I would recommend her anytime.  The class is not hard but takes up some time.  Also she has an accent which makes lecture much easier to listen to
It was a 9AM seminar, my only 9AM of the week so I was never excited to go. But she always made class entertaining. I hope I have her for a real class down the line.

Anatomy with her was easy and understandable. She was pretty funny which made lectures a lot more enjoyable. Class was not mandatory but it was actually fun going. Examples helped and she's got a good sense of humor.
class was so boring. i don't know why i always went, she always reads directly on the slides.  just memorize the powerpoints and the tests are super easy

I thought she was fairly funny, however she did just read off of the slides and didn't use many examples to help visualize. Her tests were really easy and then when Dr. Malcos switched in we were screwed because the tests were hard.

can not speak english well and reads directly off the slides. no point in going to class because you get the same info from what she puts online. would be an easy class if she taught the whole year but her and dr. waters switch and then you are screwed when it comes to the tests because your used to her easy tests
Professor Dumas is the sweetest woman. The tests are very easy. Professor Dumas is very caring and very passionate about her work. She has great stories that are very interesting.

Jo is a very nice and compassionate older lady. She talks a lot but attendance isn't mandatory and you can complete everything you need on Canvas. Exams are at the Pollock Testing Center but are designed in a very easy way where you don't need to study much at all, as it's just filling in the blanks and using common sense. Take her class for an A!
she is so sweet but yaps a lot. hard to pay attention i always zone off but the exams are easy and shes really kind
She is so sweet and so caring. She cares a lot about what she teaches but is incredibly boring and yaps a lot

I appreciated the learning materials provided, though some felt excessive given other class demands. The professor fostered an inclusive environment that supported the course themes. Discussions on nonviolence, justice, and free speech were impactful. Suggestion: limit the time spent on announcements—email or online posts could be more efficient.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very chill and laid back proff with a clear passion for what she teaches about. Exams were designed in a way where it was very difficult to receive a bad grade even if you didn't show up to lectures. Great experience overall.

GENUINELY TERRIBLE. She is such a sweet old lady but I had to drop because leading up to the first exam all she did was get sidetracked and yap and I didnt actually comprehend a single thing. It was actually terrible.

Jo Dumas was by far the best professor I've ever had at Penn State. She is the sweetest human being ever. Attendance is mandatory but lectures are so enjoyable because of her. As long as you study the PowerPoints, the exams will be a breeze. Only two exams in the Pollock Testing Center and no final. PLEASE TAKE THIS CLASS YOULL LOVE HER

Jo Dumas is a great person, but Comm205's lectures were too long and not very informative. Attendance wasn't graded, and few regularly went to class. It should be an easy class as long as you complete the weekly assignments (which aren't much work at all), and do well on the exams, which you should if you pay slight attention or do readings.

This was one of the most boring classes I've ever taken, but it's fine because as long as you do the assignments, you don't have to go to class at all. Professor Dumas is very sweet though which makes the class a little more tolerable.

Jo's lectures are extremely boring, but that doesn't matter because attendance does not count and all assignments are online. The entire class is weekly discussion posts, monthly MLE's and 2 very easy exams. Just read the notes and submit your work and you will get an A. Don't worry about showing up to class. NO FINAL.
Jo Dumas is such a sweet woman. Incredibly passionate about the class and her students. However, the class is incredibly boring.

Professor Dumas is one of the kindest and sweetest professors I've had at Penn State. I have taken two of her courses and been pleased each time. Study the powerpoint and you'll do great on the exams. Discussion posts are easy.

Super easy class. Just look at the PPT when you take the exam. Other assignments will earn you full marks as long as you submit them. Having said that, I learned a lot in this class. And she is a very kind professor, always replying to emails promptly.

Exams are super easy, basically matching fill-in-the-blank questions. Just read the notes PowerPoint a few times before exams and you'll be fine. Discussion board posts are super easy and not graded harshly, and she gave me full credit even for the ones I submitted late

Literally easiest class my entire semester. Didn't show up once and got an A. There are 2 exams and the second has questions from the first one. She uses one set of notes for the entire sem and doesn't require a book. Do your MLE's and DF's and you'll pass flying colors. She is very sweet but lectures are ungodly boring.

J is a super nice old lady. There are two exams and one discussion post every week. The class is super chill, but J rambles on a lot, and it's really boring. You'll end up with an A, but I didn't learn much.
She is a sweet lady, class is super boring, she reads the notes and shows lots of videos. Exams come from the notes, Don't think there's a textbook, never opened one for this class.

Exams are pretty easy if you do the readings, a lot of people skip but as long as you sign in for attendance, you will get credit. Do the discussion forums and MLEs (she will not accept late work) and you should get an A.

A lot of the class is just watching movies. all the notes for the entire year are on one singular doc (as opposed to slideshows etc) which is kinda confusing. A lot of people skip her class but attendance is graded. it's a really easy class though, literally just show up and do the MLEs and you'll get an A

Sweet woman but not a good professor. The course materials and lectures are all over the place. Attendance is mandatory. The class is relatively easy but the disorganization makes it difficult to learn and stay on top of everything.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Can concur with another review that the class is a hot mess. Shes unprofessional, poorly organized, seemingly unprepared, and ignores the conservative perspective entirely - this is NOT an open minded woman like others have said. Avoid at all costs if you want to learn something substantial.

Prof Dumas is such a cute old woman. Shes really helpful during office hours and bumps your grade up two letter grades if you attend most classes. Exams come straight from notes and as long as you know how to complete sentences, you are fine.

Jo is very sweet and she means well. I would highly recommend taking her class if you want an easy A. She gives two exams, which as long as you look at the notes she gives you, it's an easy exam. She doesn't require a textbook because all her notes are online. There are discussion forums and multicultural assignments but those are easy as well.

She's the sweetest lady you'll ever meet. She's a bit scattered, but it doesn't effect the course difficulty. There are only 2 tests and if you read the review they are extremely easy. Make sure to do the discussion forums and the learning experiences, as they are easy 100s. Most of class is just light lectures, discussion, and lots of movies!
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Tests? Not many--Would take again

reviews.comment: At first, I found her lectures are a little bit boring but then I change my mind. She's the most caring and open-minded professor I've ever met. She respect every student and really listen to you. She's not that strict with the due dates and that helped me survive from the writings. Exams are not easy and you need hours to prepare for them.

Jo Dumas really knows what she is saying and of her topics, but she goes on and on for a long time. Jo is probably the most free-spirited person you will ever meet. In class, students are on their computers and do as they please to pass the time. Jo posts notes and powerpoints on Canvas and allows students to ask questions about what to expect.

Jo is my favorite professor at PSU. I believe another reviewer said it best when they said she is "cute and crazy". She will often show up to class wearing a rainbow scarf and gets so passionate during lecture about what she's teaching. She obviously knows a lot about this subject and has decades of experience.

Jo is such a sweetheart. It's a typical 200 level course. Make sure you show up to class. There is a video everyday, and that is the majority of the material. Also, she takes attendance, so make sure you're there!
Study the guide she puts out 1 week before the test and you should be fine. Make sure you do all of the discussion forums she puts up.

An easy class if you pay attention to when things are due and just study the study guide she puts out 1 week before the test. I never used the book because she makes up whatever she wants to put on the test. No structure to the class. Come to class and do work for other classes and then study for the test before.

She is clearly very passionate about the subject matter and the movies watched in class are very interesting and thought provoking. Having said that the class has no structure and it's really confusing when things are due. But she really just wants participation so not a hard class overall. Just annoying.

attendance is very key to this course. she is very nice but this class is SOOOO boring. the movies are oaky, and the exams suck because if you don't do great on them thats like the only grade you have. she offered extra credit once, and we had a final paper and discussion boards thats it.

This class was a hot mess. There's no textbook, she just puts 45 pages of notes online for the whole semester. I studied those and I did alright on the exams. All you do is watch films and she'll occasionally ramble about the readings she puts online that no one reads. That's why exams were so hard to study for. And the semester project sucks.

For a class like this, she's one of the best to have. The team project might seem like a heavy one, but not really once you get things going. Readings are on ANGEL for the most part, uses powerpoints for lectures and you'll watch some films. Plenty of chances to raise your grade in the class. Definately a should take.

Sweetest lady but most boring class ever.  Watch a lot of good movies to help relate the material to real life but notes and powerpoints were really boring.  Easy tests if you go to class.  She takes attendance every day too with a sign-in sheet.

Great class to "goof off" in and yet you can't help but learning alot more than expected!!!  Check out her husband in the flick, Red Water!  I met my future husband in this class and will never forget it!
Excellent teacher....EASY TEACHER!!!!
Excellent class and teacher. Go with an open mind and just show up! Attending class is the easiest thing to do in school. The movies you'll see rock as well.
Takes attendance everyday so you have to go to class or you'll fail the class.  Lectures are boring but she is a sweet lady and the tests are on the easy side.
An intelligent, funny and cultured woman. It was really great being taught by someone who is so open minded. You will love her.
She's sweet!
So sweet and nice.  Some material was interesting, some boring.  Don't bother buying the book, everything you need to know is on Angel.
Dumas is a nice enough lady, but attendance is mandatory and the class is a snooze-fest. Tests and homeworks are pretty easy, but the semester project is lame.

So she's a super cute little old lady, and she's soooo nice...but I'm sorry to say, this class is incredibly boring. And the semester project sucks. The class is super easy, and she gives out tons of extra credit, but she also takes attendance. She's occasionally funny, but she mostly just reads off the powerpoint slides...it's an easy A.

I wish she could be my grandma! This was one of my favorite classes. Although the exams were very specific, the class was fun and didn't put me to sleep at 8am. Also, she gives a lot extra credit, and is accomadating. I was in an accident this semester and missed a lot of classes. She brought me videos to watch to help me catch up.

Jo Dumas is cute & crazy!   She is really excited about what she is talking about & means well... but it's hard to get interested because she is all over the place and the topics can be boring-REALLY BORING. Oh and on tests, she basically asks you what kind of underwear the author was wearing when he/she wrote something--it's that specific.
Dumas is funny. She loves this stuff. Easy class cuz you can sign in and then just leave. Full notes are on angel. Tests are easy. Def take this class.

While yes the tests are not as difficult as they could be I did not like this class.  I love learning this type of material but the way in which she teaches it just puts me to sleep.  Also the group project is a pain.

This was a pretty easy class, and the others are right, you don't really need the textbook. She's really nice and a bit quirky. She's really enthusiastic about the material. The three exams aren't too bad because she reviews everything and it's all on Angel. Also, do the extra credits it's easy

Class was easy. You don't even need to buy the book. Three exams, one easy semester project/paper. And she is a bit wacky in a good way.. she is nice and will help you if you have problems. Gave many opportunities for extra credit.
Very easy class, three tests and a semister paper.  She is a nice lady too.  EASY CLASS!!
She was amazing.  At first it seems like a lot of information, but she gives a great study guide.  She is so nice and helpful.  I'm so glad that I took her class.

Very nice woman... she tries very hard. The weighting of the grades is kind of harsh, there are only 2 exams each worth 30% and a semester project, but the material isn't hard and she tries to have fun with the material.
I love this sweet sweet woman

I'm not sure why his ratings are so good on rate my professor. He is very smug and tight with partial credit. The average across three exams was 62% taking up 80% of the grade. He is pretty stubborn about curving the class, so about half of the class is going to fail, and he seems perfectly ok with that.
great professor

Honestly best professor in the CHE department at PSU. He explained everything very clearly, gave opportunities to branch into real world examples for the final project, and was very helpful and understand if you were struggling. Content is pretty hard and needs background knowledge. Highly recommend him though!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The class itself was challenging but Dr. Zydney really cares about his students and is passionate about what he teaches (especially artificial livers!). He's a true gem that really tried his best to accommodate our every need. The lectures could feel long and boring, but that's just the nature of the class and because it was done over zoom.
After taking other CHE professors' classes, you will find Dr. Zydney is the best one.

Zydney is one, if not the best CHE prof at Penn State. He responds quickly to emails and offers great feedback on hw if you're confused. He truly cares about our learning and he uses examples that are relevant to CHE majors. The class is difficult, but he offers a VERY generous curve at the end of the semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Although material is hard in this course, regardless if you seek help from him about clarity on specific topics you won't receive it. It's been various times where I have reached out to him in a respectful manner, because I was struggling in the course, and I was always met with condescending and belittling responses.

He made lectures very interactive, and as he learned more about his students, he geared lectures towards things we knew and liked with examples which helped us learn better. His exams are in class, but so straight forward from the information on his slides.

Professor Smith truly cares about the content he is teaching, bringing relevant examples to class and is enthusiastic while lecturing. This professor also takes the time to make sure every student understands the content in the course.

Evan Smith is one of the best professors I've ever had here. For having his class at 8am he makes the lectures very engaging and entertaining. No homework, gives extra credit, 5 exams total, and 2 presentations with one being a final project. Attendance is graded so long as you go to the lectures and copy good notes you'll be fine.

Professor Smith has been one of my favorite professors that I have had in my 2.5 years at PSU. His lectures are always engaging and entertaining. His exams are more like quizzes because they are given so frequently, and they are quite easy as long as you pay attention to the lectures and take notes. Hope I can take another one of his classes soon.

450WHonestly one of my favorite MKTG classes ever. I went into the class expecting it to be 202D part 2, but that was not the case. Professor Smith's class was so enjoyable and fun to go to. Study for exams and you will do perfectly fine. He is such a lenient guy and willing to work with you. Lecture heavy but entertaining, fun, and funny 10000/10

I loved Mr. Smith's class. His lectures were never boring, and he always found interesting ways to convey information. He's a little corny, but I liked that.

Ask him to tell the story about how he broke his foot by stepping on his old roommate's foot while losing a basketball game! It was the hardest I laughed all semester!

He himself was a very good person who cares about his students when they are in class and the class I took with him was overall enjoyable. While he gave no homework, he gave 6 exams, an 8 page paper and presentation with it, which is arguable worse than getting homework occasionally. Unless you're ready to study and do a load of work, not worth it.

He was alright. Lecture's were boring and the class was silent the whole time it wasn''t a welcoming atmosphere. Easy grader though just do the assignments even though some of them are SO annoying and take days to complete. Be ready for group projects.

Best professor I have had. I took this class over the summer and it is the best class ever. Simple work, do your best. He grades very kindly and will always help if you have questions. Take his class!

Great class for Smeal pre-majors. All work is asynchronous. Few assignments, not very time-consuming. Modules posted every week. Two group projects with one of them being the final. Tons of EC opportunities. Complete your work ahead of time, it will pile up. Prof Smith and Prof Maguire were both very kind online. I recommend taking this class.
He was my only in person during COVID. He was a great professor, and was very understanding.
East class and a great passionate teacher. Genuinely cares about his students and makes the 9am enjoyable.
Evan is an awesome teacher and really cares about students doing well. He is also an advisor so that helps too! He makes even an 8 am enjoyable. Definitely pick him for psu6.

Probably the easiest and most worthwhile class at PSU. Attendance/participation is worth 15 of the 100 point class, so if you go to class and do the assignments, you'll get an A. Plenty of opportunities for extra credit. Evan is actually an advisor but he is also a great teacher. Cares about his students. Great man.

I would stay away from this teacher at all costs. I spent 90% of my studying on Spanish and only about 10% on my actual major courses that mattered more. i followed every guideline and rule and STILL she found a way to pick at stuff in my hw. I used 2 words that were not taught yet but were super basic and she accused me of cheating.
Will do everything in her power to give you an academic violation for something abysmally minor. (Using videos about Spanish from outside the course)

Not a good professor in my opinion. She is hyper focused on academic integrity instead of actually teaching us Spanish. Accusing every one of misconduct for what? Just to win an award that nobody cares about. Do not take this Professor if you actually have an interest in Spanish or if you have to take it for your major or BA requirements.

The worst professor known to mankind. She tried to ruin my college career. She filed an academic integrity claim against me, accusing me of cheating and using AI (which I never did), all to win a ridiculous “Academic Integrity Teaching Award” from PSU College of Liberal Arts. Looks like she didn't the same thing to other students as well…TERRIBLE.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: This is worst class I've ever taken in my whole academic career. This really put a bad taste in my mouth about what Penn State stands for. Someone like this should never have a place in teaching (she doesn't teach you anything to begin with).
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you are signed up for any Spanish class with this "instructor," you might as well drop it. You will be accused of cheating and you will have your college career ruined. She looks nothing like her picture, has a high pitched karen voice, and tries to belittle you. How this person is still employed is beyond my understanding.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Used an online tool for most weekly assignments, there were a lot but they were doable. Records a test prep session so if you aren't able to attend in real time, you can go back to see.
This is a university language course, so you're going to have more work than a HS course. If you follow directions you'll be fine - especially with test guidelines

DO NOT TAKE HER!!! She WILL accuse you of cheating and WILL report you for academic integrity when you've done nothing wrong. She also assigns 20+ assignments IN A WEEK, not including the actives inside each assignment. She also never checks her emails on the weekends, so good luck on assignment submit days. Exams are hard. She was horrible!

I figured that Spanish online would be easier than in person Spanish. I WAS WRONG. she only cares about academic integrity accusations and seriously could not care less about how you are doing in Spanish. Everyone I know got academic integrity violations AND WE DID NOT CHEAT. seriously, take ANY other professor this woman she ruined my life.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She honestly does nothing as a professor. She assigns a few assignments via the online textbook each week. Then she assigns a discussion post weekly. She has no grace with the timeline of discussion posts and no partial credit is given. She takes a while to respond to emails. But ultimately it became a generic Spanish class.

My experience in this online Spanish course was marred by unreasonably harsh grading, baseless accusations, inadequate instruction, and a subpar choice of course materials. I genuinely hope that the necessary steps will be taken to rectify these issues so that future students can benefit from a more conducive and supportive learning environment.

The choice of textbook for the course was deeply flawed. The material seemed poorly customized for the specific needs of the course and the suitability of the professor in question. I believe in the importance of providing constructive criticism to improve the learning experience for future students. LOUSY TEXTBOOK, LOUSY INSTRUCTOR

I must express my severe disappointment with the quality of instruction provided in this course. Professor Wiggins failed to effectively teach the language, relying heavily on automated tools and inadequate explanations. The course lacked the personalized instruction and support necessary to truly grasp the nuances of the Spanish language.

My experience in this course was profoundly disappointing. I encountered numerous issues that significantly hindered my ability to learn and perform my best. I found the grading system to be excessively harsh. The feedback provided was often accusatory and overly critical. DO NOT CHOOSE HER AS AN INSTRUCTOR! It was hell dealing with her.

Wouldn't recommend this instructor at all. hands down the worst spanish "professor" at penn state. shameful and accuses every student of cheating . You give a student 31/52 on an exam because their camera didn't show a 360 scan? what sense does that even make? if you have to take a spanish class for your major, avoid her at ALL cost.

It's easy and reflects college-level coursework. The curriculum created by the dept and imo isn't the most efficient where you have to follow online and the textbook to be successful. She was a fair grader making minimal deductions and recognizing effort, provided good feedback, graded promptly, and responded quickly to any questions or issues.

I really enjoyed this professor! I am shocked with all of her negative reviews. I do think the class is a lot of work for Spanish 1, but I do not think she makes the criteria. The exams being in Pollock were the worst part. If you follow alongside the textbook and look up words you don't know, you should be fine!!!!

Way harder than it needs to be. Slow your roll Emily, its Spanish 1 not 3. This girl single-handedly ruined my whole semester and accused me of cheating along with like half the class. If you see this chick as your spanish 1 web teacher, DROP IMMIDIATELY. I cannot stress this enough and I do not know how this girl is not fired yet! Ruined my Xmas.

Wow, I actually think I found the worst professor at this school. Legit in disbelief how terrible a professor could possibly be for a WEB class. I don't even get how it is possibly to be my least favorite professor in 3 years here when you're teaching a web class. DO NOT take this girl for a web class or anything else.
Absolutely not! If you see her on your schedule drop her & find someone else. She will accuse you for cheating & make learning Spanish a living hell for you. Would not recommend.
This teacher is a joke. Way harder than it needs to be. The average for tests is real low. Waste of time do not take. This class online is you teaching yourself with a bad textbook.

Wiggins teaching style is very bad online. She provides little to no help and grades hard. The tests are difficult and the partial credit does not work in the student's favor. Took this class to fulfill credits but became one of my hardest classes. Do yourself a favor and don't pick her.

A 4-cred foreign language class is naturally challenging. Wiggins is a very fair professor. She offered study tips and was clear about no curves or extra credit. 1 full day of study earns an A- on exams. The book is useful but not in exact order with the homework. I could have gotten an A with effort. She could have been a lot tougher but is nice.

Emily was a good teacher overall and wants you to do well, there are no curves or rounding 
You will WORK for every grade you receive in this class 
I had to pay for a tutor cause things weren't sticking
Study, study, and study. 
There are group projects as well the Spanish book that cost $94 is horrible when I used the book I was more confused
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor Wiggins is the worst professor I've ever had. I was failing her class due to a terrible custom made textbook for her course. I asked her for help several times, and her only advice was "just do better." When I took her class, 95% of students got a -C or below on the second exam. The average for the exam was 66%. Do not take her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Wiggins is very understandable and you can tell she cares about her students. I did find this class pretty hard, but it was not because of Prof Wiggins. The exams are very hard and takes up the majority of your grade percentage. There is no final.

not my favorite class but not the worst. She's helpful if you reach out. However she will nit pick the little things in your assignments. Group projects. Due dates friday and sunday. Uses that stupid myspanishlab site with no feedback when you're wrong. exams are proctured and closed book. Pretty good paced class, you just need to keep up.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: 60% of your grade is based on exams, which she grades hard. Professor Wiggins does not tell you what material you need to read in a given week and simply assigns lessons in my spanish lab. She does not provide any extra material or advice to struggling students and takes a LONG time to grade discussions and exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Profesora Wiggins is really nice and cares about her students. She puts heavy emphasis into participation so be prepared to raise your hand at least 3 times a class. There is a good bit of homework due every Sunday online, but honestly, they help a lot with comprehension. If you put some effort and care into this class you will get a decent grade.

This is by far one of the best professors of my college career and I graduate in two semesters. She's very kind and gives very detailed feedback. She really cares that you learn the material and goes above and beyond to help you learn it. Lots of learning resources provided. She's very funny and thoughtful as well. Take this professor if you can!
Ms. Emily Wiggins is the best teacher ive had at psu. my spanish isnt great since i havent taken a class since hs but this was an amazing class and she taught in a way that refreshed my memory
She follows the criteria set by the spanish department but shes a pretty easy going grader and really cares about the students.
Really nice. Foreign languages are tough, Prof. Wiggins is a good teacher.

Professor Wiggins is a very caring professor who usually makes sure information is well-understood before moving on. Her teaching style, however, is very repetitive and sometimes it's easy to tune her out. Grades fairly hard on participation and she has group discussions solely in Spanish each class, which is difficult if you only had SPAN 1.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Really easy as long as you show up. You do the online book work for the following week's materials so you are always reviewing in class. The exams are not hard, exactly like the online work. You have to write a couple of essays but they are all drafts that you get to redo. In class you just do listening activities and conversations with partners.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Best lady I know!! Hardest but teaches the most. Bout to become fluent. Participation was hard to get a good grade until I went to her office hours: after that I knew in order to get 100 all I had to do was raise my hand all the time and make an effort to talk only in Spanish for those 50 minutes. Made me enjoy Spanish again
Nicest teacher I've ever had she's super funny and the class is an easy A if you are decent at Spanish.

VERY VERY VERY HARD CLASS!! Hardest class I have taken so far in my four years of college. She is a very sweet women and will do whatever she can to help. No grade curve.  The class moves very fast and it is a lot of material. I would suggest that if you are not good at Spanish to take someone easier.

The class itself wasn't too bad. Study the vocab and grammar lessons for the exams and it's easy to get an A. The hardest thing was participation. I continuously raised my hand throughout class and would ask questions, yet she would give me an 85 almost every week. A lot of other people complained about it as well. Brought my whole grade down.

She is enthusiastic during lectures, however she makes it nearly impossible to get an A in participation. I haven't missed a class and participate every day and I've only ever received 1 A for a weekly participation grade. Most of my grades fall around an 85. This is ridiculous. This is the hardest class I have.

Emily was extremely sweet and helpful and genuinely wants to help her students. However, SPAN 100 is a LOT of work, to the point where it affected my interest in the subject. The work is good because it helps boost your grade, and assignment weights are spread out, but it's a pain. Emily is an absolute doll who is a wonderful professor, though.
One of the nicest, funniest, and sweestest professors I've ever had. Here's a chili pepper Emily! :)
Emily is really sweet and helpful, but the class is extremely difficult. Tons of work. Don't take it unless you have to or really like Spanish.

Emily is the best! The class itself requires a lot of work, but she is so willing to help. She met me sometimes at 9AM before class if I couldn't make it to her own office hours. She is such a sweetheart, and really cares about how you do. If you put the work in, you'll do well.

The class itself was unbearable. Emily was a very nice, pleasant, and flexible professor. The class needs to be restructured or eliminated. Students average between 60-70% on the final exam, no matter which prof you have. So really, any prof would be fine, because the class sucks either way.
Was unable to sufficiently teach Spanish in a way that allowed for it to be remembered beyond the 50 minutes of class.

THIS CLASS IS HARD!!! On two of the exams nobody in any of her 4 sections got an A, yet there was no curve...The exams suck.  You fly through material and skim everything, but never actually learn anything.  When studying, make sure to look at the things that you spent half a second covering in class b/c it is guaranteed to be on the exam

Emily is a very nice prof, but the class itself is super hard.  The homework is rediculous, having about 30 quizzes a weak on myspanishlab.com.  The tests are also pretty tough, and they are very tricky.  Overall Emily is very nice and she is very helpful, but SPAN 100 overall is a very hard course.  I enjoyed spn coming inot this class, now i dont
emily was really nice and really funny, but she talks super quick, even if its in english sometimes, which is tough because the exams and quizzes are super hard.

Emily is extremely nice but this class is very hard. Homework and quizzes really help your grade. Her office hours are extremely helpful and she is always willing to meet with you. Test are pretty hard.
Emily is an amazing teacher!! She is really nice and is always willing to help you on any assignments.  She is willing to talk in English to clarify things, and always encourages you to do your best.
emily was the nicest teacher i've ever had and she made a hard class easy! I would definitely recommend taking any spanish classes with her.
Emily is so so so NICE! She's really helpful and puts a lot of effort forth.
awesome teacher! shes always willing to help and shes really nice

Emily is a Fantastic Spanish teacher!  She speaks slowly and clearly and, unlike many PSU profs, is Always willing to speak English in the classroom to make sure the points are getting across.  The coursework is Extremely heavy but she'll do everything she can to help her students succeed.
best spanish teacher at penn state... by far!

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. There are so many better classes to take for a movement credit, ESPECIALLY if you are taking this class as a Theater Major at Penn State. It is the most egregious waste of time I have ever encountered. The entire class content could be summarized in one well-worded email. Avoid at all costs.
reviews.rating_tags: So many papers--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: DON'T TAKE THIS CLASS. Such unnecessary piece of work that you have to do for a single class. I don't know how this professor is able to justify giving out this much work for an online GEN-ED. I mean how do you explain wanting your students to write 20 SENTENCES on "what did you learn from the FREEZE-FRAME TECHNIQUE???" Absolutely no awareness.

I honestly never thought I would write a review on this website, but this class is terrible. It might seem easy in the first week, but it is an unbelievable amount of work. The 250-300 sentence journal logs are the most time-consuming assignments I've done throughout all of college. Avoid this class at all costs.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Get ready to write hundreds of sentences explaining the same thing every week. How does this professor even have a job here? What a joke for a 200 level gen ed. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS unless you want to spend hours every week repeating yourself for 20 sentences at a time. You won't realize how bad it is until after the first week drop deadline.

Took this class for an easy gen grade, while it is easy, the amount of work you have to do is ridiculous.  I'm spending so much time answering the same question over and over again for 15+ sentences.  There is no reason for the class to be set up like this and honestly takes away from my ability to do my major related classes, avoid at all costs.
This class is a ton of unnecessary busy work, but it is an easy A. A whole lot of explaining the same thing over and over again but it's really only 4 or so hours of work every 2 weeks.

Genuinely do not take this class. There are not a lot of assignments, but when they are they are ridiculous. She will ask the same question in 3 different parts, and expect you to write 15 sentences for each part. No the questions arent difficult, but how are we supposed to write 12 sentences for "how I handle stress."
reviews.rating_tags: So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class was so easy but the teacher was never actually there. I never reached out to her once and ended up doing fine. The only annoying part of this class was the deep dive assignment which took forever and was such a waste of time. The final was also dumb and study guide didn't help at all.

Such an easy gen ed. We had a few quizzes due every two weeks, along with Packback where we had to answer 2 prompts and respond to 1 classmate. We also had 1 writing assignment. If you need electives/gen eds, take this.

Probably the easiest class I took in college. There is a decent amount of quizzes but 90% of it is on Quizlet. She is a very chill and understanding instructor. If you don't get an A in this class, I don't know what you are doing.

Like the other person said, elisha has a major attitude problem and nearly every single one of her emails/announcements seems to be in a demanding and condescending tone. She just seems to have an attitude all the time and appears to be very self centered.

I personally have had no problems with Elisha, but the tenure and tone of her emails and online announcements are extremely rude, arrogant, and unprofessional to say the least. From the experience I have had with her, she seems very ego centric and demanding, which is is not something I expect to see out of a PSU prof. She needs ethics training bad

Get ready to use quizlet an awful lot. All answers to all the quizzes are on quizlet. I forgot to do the final and still got an A. She will either take five minutes or three days to respond to emails. No in between. She loves packback and weekly responses to prompts which are super easy. Extremely easy GenEd course whether you love dance or not.

TAKE THIS GEN ED!!!! easiest course if you use the materials and readings given. only took about 2 hours every 2 weeks (you have 2 weeks to complete a list of assignments). you do have a deep dive assignment on packpack that takes some time but you have almost the whole semester to do it. you get a study guide for the final exam to help you. easy A
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Easiest gened I took at Penn State. The most work I did in this class was the final which was a meditatioin. We had to make our own meditation practice which had to be thirty minutes long and included mostly papers. Other than this, it was just tophat every week. Nothing crazy.

TAKE THIS AS A GENED. Sooo easy and honestly interesting material. Everything is online canvas modules, and I spent maybe 20 minutes a week on it. I couldn't ever find answers on quizlet, but the quizzes are pretty much straight from the slides and readings. Just control F and ur good. Packback every week, and one 500 word Deep Dive. So easy

TAKE THIS GENED! This is such an easy, interesting class to take for a gened and GPA booster. It's fully online with canvas modules. The assignments take me less than an hour every two weeks. There's so many available points, almost impossible to get below an A. Pretty easy quizzes with the slides pulled up, and 3 packback posts every 2 weeks
One of the easiest classes at PSU. Maybe spent at most 1 hour a week with this class.
The final is wild. Wayyyyy too much work for a final, especially when you compare it to the assignments during the regular semester. Very easy class overall though.
There's a ton of assignments but as long as you do them this is an easy class.

I got an A in the class. I did not watch any lectures, I just looked at the info on the slides while doing quizzes. I got a 100 on the exam and tbh I don't even remember studying one time in this class.

This class is meant to be taken by seniors for graduation credit. There is absolutely no reason to have a final assignment that takes 10+ hours on a topic that no one cares about. The extent of professor Halpin's contribution to this course is compiling YouTube meditations for you to complete, and then giving you unreasonable amount of hw.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Online class. Biweekly quizzes and discussions based on lectures and readings. One exam open notes. A breeze.

The easiest gen ed ever. No live lectures and I spent maybe 3 hours a week for this class. There are weekly lecture and reading quizzes, but if you do the quizzes while you watch/read then it's easy. You have to do Packback every week but no one reads them so your score is solely based off curiosity points. The final is barely an exam

I'm sure this class would be much better in person, but I appreciated how easy it was. This is basically a meditation and reflection class, and the professor gives a lot of meditation practices. The only assignments were a couple weekly reflections that were pretty straightforward. A good class to get GHW credit without lifting a finger.

This class is the best interdomain ever. There are no exams and you don;t even have to take notes. You do need to go to class to know what to do for the weekly assignments and some assignments. There are Packbacks that are due at the end of the semester and you have to attend 4 performances. easiest class ever and super interesting.

One of the easiest gen ed's to take, literally just a yoga and meditation class. Only homework is to complete weekly journals online that are super easy and an art project due as a final. Would 100% take again. If you are sick or cannot make it she is okay with it, but just make sure you don't miss too much or you'll fall behind.

This is the easiest gen ed you can take. You dont have to go to class to pass. No tests only 3 pop quizzes which are very easy. Tons of extra credit plus the final is online, open note, with a friend, and you can use the slides and study guide. No class fridays and cancelled class for 2 weeks. Packback is the only work you have to do and its easy.

TAKE THIS GEN ED!!! That's all, thank me later. I didn't go to class for a month and got an A. The final was on canvas & we were told to use our study guides. All you have to do is discussion posts. There are 4 pop quizzes, but super easy & if you do them, you get credit.

50% of grade is based on asking and answering packback questions (extremely easy) there are NO exams and the final was on canvas and she gives you a study guide with the questions! Easy A, posts all lectures on canvas, videos are pretty interesting to watch, she said 4-6 quizzes but there were only 2 & if you were there you got the points
