reviews.comment: Dave is very passionate about economics and even through zoom makes his lectures super engaging. His guided notes that are matched exactly with his slides are a huge help. Homeworks are easy points and the tests are usually straightforward if you study the notes before hand. FYI no real reason to by any of the books other than the notes packet.

Guided notes are a huge help, and he explains things extremely well. Graded assignments can be scarce, so be sure to study for the exams (he gives ample study material). Dr. Dave is funny, friendly, and relatable. Would recommend 100x over.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dave is honestly so passionate about economics and makes his lectures really interesting and simplified. I have never studied economics before, but his lectures are very well structured. He gives a lot of HW but you get your out of class practice through it. I'll definitely take this class again with him.

Dr. Dave is a interesting person and he utilizes many examples and videos to help us understand the content. I love his class so much because of his passion of economic. And I also feel connected with him. He shares his personal stories with the class which made it becomne more interesting. The note and supplement also help me to be successful in t
Dave Brown is the GOAT! If you're taking Econ 102, he is who you want! Explains things really well, if you study hard and go to class, an A is definitely possible!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He was by far one of the best professors I have had. He makes boring material fun and brings his lectures to life. The material isn't the easiest and you do have to study to get good grades. But he gives extra credit opportunities throughout the semester.

I am writing this review 5 years after graduating and 8 years since taking his course, and still remember how great his clsss was. I majored in economics with a dual degree in MIS and think of him as the best teacher I had. He explained the material perfectly clear, made it fun and was very fair, it also helps that his class was fairly easy.

Dr. Brown is undoubtedly the best ECON102 teacher at Penn State. He is very passionate, makes lectures engaging and interactive, and provides opportunities for success through dropping some grades and extra credit. You don't have to go to class, but don't expect a B+ or above if you don't. I aced this class, but had to really work hard for it.

I was excited about getting an A- in this class because I had worked hard all semester. The practice exam and reviews for the final were far different from the exam itself. The final brought my grade from an A- to a B. Given that we are in a GLOBAL PANDEMIC, most people in the class, including myself, thought he would curve. But nope! No empathy.

Dave Brown makes every class interesting and funny. He shows videos, only when necessary, and some of them are hilarious. He cares about everything you do and is available outside of class. Class is not mandatory, but you should go to keep up with the notes.

Dave Brown is an okay professor, but the exams are really difficult. Most of the time you cannot find the information he asks for on the exams and quizzes in the notes. I had 96.7% the whole semester, and the final brought me down to a B+. He does not respond to emails and is not that accessible outside of class. Do not take ECON 102 with him!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: One of my favs!!! He's awesome and he makes his lectures seem like Netflix series, I swear. Dr. Dave makes the material super interesting and easy to understand, so homework, quizzes, and exams are manageable (as long as you pay attention to class of course). Plus, he's HILLARIOUS.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: AMAZING. One of the best profs I'll ever have. He gives you a course packet and that's the notes for the year and you fill in the blanks. 8 homeworks (2 dropped), 6 quizzes (2 dropped), 3 exams, no clicker questions. He made a somewhat difficult class easy and entertaining. I loved going to his lectures and I actually felt like I learned something.

Great professor. Teaches content well. Textbook is not required, but I got it anyways and read most chapters. Tests are difficult, but he gives practice exams and questions. You do have to study well to pass. Gives random quizzes sometimes in class, drops lowest(6 total) quiz and homework(8 total) score. Super easy quizzes, hw can be tricky.

GOAT. When Penn State went to remote learning, he stepped up and made the transition seamless. Didn't miss any class or skip a beat. He didn't whine about it to students like my other profs. During the online Zoom lectures he is inexplicably skilled and fast with Microsoft Paint, of all programs. He truly cares about his students and learning.

Greatest professor I've had at Penn State. Passionate about the subject, good at teaching, the notes are a great way to study and follow along in class. Exams can be a little hard, the class does require a good amount of effort, but if you show up you should at least get a B-. Very good teacher, funny guy, class doesn't usually get boring.
Dr. Dave is the GOAT of all professors. Very charismatic and a hilarious guy. He clearly knows a lot about economics and is enthusiastic about it as well. GOAT GOAT GOAT

Dr. Dave is a wonderful professor. He really knows what he is talking about and uses clear examples to help illustrate certain concepts. Dave gives an adequate amount of study material for test which is very beneficial. This is not the easiest class, but it is very logical. Show up to class and complete the homeworks and the tests should be easier.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I took ECON 102 because it was required, but this man made it my favorite class. The notes are super clear, the tests are pretty easy (if you study with the materials he gives you), and there's relatively little homework. If you have to take this class, take it with Dave Brown.

Dave Brown is the best economics professor you can have for 102. His lectures are very good and worth attending. He is super passionate and enthusiastic about teaching economics and makes learning all of the concepts easy. All of his assessments are fair and doable, but be prepared for the tests to seem a bit harder than you'd expect. StudyA

Dave Brown was one of my favorite professors last semester. Hes fun, his lectures are hilarious, and he tries his best to explain the material in a way students can relate. He was so good that Im considering becoming a grader for his class just so I can go back and listen to his lectures again! 10/10 would recommend
Dave is by far the best econ teacher at Penn State. He cared about what he was doing, he was enthusiastic, and was very wise and knowledgeable.
He is the worst professor I've taken before. Sample questions are not even similar to exams and his class doesn't really helpful to understand the lectures. Do not waste your time taking his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dave Brown is the absolute best professor I've ever had, not only is he an extremely good teacher but he makes the topics actually interesting, relating them to real life examples that everyone can relate too. Attendance is not mandatory, but he does give out some attendance quizzes and it is worth it to show up. Overall, Dave Brown is the GOAT.
GOAT

Much enthusiasm and passionate about what he teaches. Lectures are never boring. But exams can sometimes be very tough, so be sure to study. Getting a B is easily doable, but it would require a good amount of effort, studying and understanding to get an A. Drops the lowest two homework scores.
Absolutely love Dave. He's funny, relaxed and by far the best ECON102 professor. Makes class easy to pay attention and gives you everything you need to do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Amazing prof and great guy. Makes concepts easily understandable.
He's a really amazing prof and super into what he teaches which inspires you to do well in the class.

Dr Dave is the man. Great lecturer and does a great job relating the material to the real world and making it interesting. A majority of the grade is exams which are pretty difficult but there are a good number of pretty easy quizzes and homeworks to give you a small boost. Show up to class and do the review materials he posts and you'll be fine.

Dr. Brown is the reason I switched majors to Econ. Everyday he came in with a smile and made economics very interesting. Although the tests and quizzes are pretty challenging, they are doable if you put the time in.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: A great class, and he is great as speaking and keeping the class attention for the whole time. As long as you have good attendance and study a bit for the exams, you are fine. Course packet is very useful, textbook is not. He provides a lot of practice and review materials which helped a lot.
Tricky questions on his exams. Don't take him! Take someone else and enjoy your class
What a joke. His questions are super tricky and he doesnt explain things well take someone else and you'll enjoy econ. I hated his class.

Dave Brown is a good guy, Econ102 just sucks. He tries to make class fun, but nobody likes learning about economics. His homework and online quizzes are hard but are only worth 5% of your grade. Overall, Dave Brown is your best option for Econ102.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: His lectures are interesting, and his tests are fair. You have some homework and quizzes throughout the semester, they can be a bit difficult, but he drops the lowest two of each. He gives random attendance quizzes, so attendance is somewhat mandatory.

Dave Brown made Microeconomics bearable. I never liked Econ, but Dave kept it interesting. He can go fast at times, but he will always ask if the content didn't make sense. He uses great analogies and examples to get the concepts to stick and he's just straight up funny sometimes. He simply loves what he teaches and it shows.

Dave Brown's nerdy but such a great prof. I HATE ECON, but he made it tolerable. He's hilarious and makes class fun. Study well for the first exam, if you tank that the rest of the class will just suck. Very few things graded, but tons of pop bonus quizzes to help boost your grade. I didn't go to office hours and regret it :/ so I suggest going.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Great teacher, and he is good at keeping class interesting with the lectures. He's definitely the best professor I've got this semester. Tests can be tough, but fair, Be sure to put in the work and studying, and all will go well. He provides a lot of practice material and wants students to do well.

Dr. Dave is a great prof, but his class is incredibly difficult. I took him from friend recommendations and even though his lectures are intriguing and useful, his tests are nearly impossible. Gives random attendance quizzes. Graded on very little assignments so tests are the things that matter. Glad this is my last economics course I need.

MAN DAVE IS THE BEST! Econ 102 with Dr. Dave is honestly great. His lectures are awesome and he makes the class fun. This makes it a joy to go to class and makes it go by quick. The tests are not easy As but if you study and work hard you will. Dave is the best and everyone that doesn't have him is jealous that you do.

Dave is a great professor, he's funny and explains the material in detail. The tests are very difficult but the homework and attendance quizzes add to your grade. The class is hard, so make sure to go and study the material often and you should be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dave Brown is the best Econ professor. Definitely take him. His tests are kind hard so study hard for those. But he is a very reasonable teacher

Dave was the best professor I had my first semester. Most of the time he would make the lectures funny and different so you were always engaged in it. There are 2 exams + final, random attendance quizzes(but most of the time he would give hints of when was the next one) and 8 homeworks (which he would do part of it in class).

David Brown inspired me to seek an economics minor, he made the class very interesting and I loved how he used real-world examples. The most important aspect I believe is that from his class I think like an economist in real life. The exams are somewhat difficult but very manageable if you prepare. Definitely review after every class.

Dave's lectures are almost always very engaging and while he presents a good amount of material in every lecture, they are interesting enough that much of the content can be retained by simply showing up. About 75% of grade comes from the three exams, which are not very difficult if you do the practice exams and use the math book he recommends.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dave is an amazing guy. You must buy the course packet, that's what his class is based on and get Mapleton. Don't buy the optional textbook, you'll never use it.. However, his tests are extremely hard. You need to study at least a week in advance for each test. I studied a ton and did terrible on every test. The final is easier than the 2 tests.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dave Brown was one of the best professors I had at Penn State. Course packet aligned perfectly with the PowerPoint, and exams were extremely fair. Great guy and very funny (yet interesting) lectures. This class inspired me to pursue a major in economics.

If your major requires you to take ECON 102, BE SURE TO TAKE IT WITH DAVE! He is arguably one of the best ECON 102 professors at the university. His lectures are extremely engaging and interesting. His exams can be difficult but as long as you pay attention in class, and use the course pack you should be successful!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dave is probably my favorite prof so far. He is very passionate about economics and it reflects in his lectures. His course packet makes taking notes super easy and he shows a lot of videos to show examples of economic topics. He gives 8 homeworks with the lowest 2 grades dropped. Exams can be tricky if you do not prepare.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Dave was my favorite professor in my first semester at PSU. He has a great sense of humor, loves teaching economics, and makes his class fun in a variety of ways. The course is easy if you study for exams and pay attention in class. If you have to take econ 102, take Dr. Dave for sure.

Tied for the best professor I've had at Penn State, he's outstanding. His lectures are excellent and are planned to the minute. The class is relatively hard and requires a lot of work outside of class. He's very knowledgeable and makes lectures very fun and interesting. The exams are very difficult, but if you study the notes packet you'll be fine.

Great professor. Compared to my friends who had other Econ professors he seems to be the best and most straight-forward. Exams aren't awful if you start studying a few days ahead instead of cramming the night before. The 8 HW's are tedious but not difficult and he drops the 2 lowest. Don't buy the textbook, I didn't open it once.

Get the Mapleton math book! It has problems identical to homework 7 and 8, and even parts of the final exam. Very helpful for practice and studying. Get the course packet as well - this was extremely useful. I didn't think the textbook was really useful though. And go to class - the lectures are never boring! Occasional videos are shown.
Difficult exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dave Brown is a great guy and an outstanding professor. His lectures are entertaining and involved. His notes packet is exactly what you need to study from and you can do very well. His tests are definitely challenging and he makes you really work for a good grade.

Dr. Brown is a great professor not only because of his deep understanding of the material, but his passion for it. Dr. Dave shows up to class everyday with enthusiasm and a smile; it's clear right away that he is happy to be where he is. As an engineering major, I thought I was going to hate econ, and I was pleasantly surprised thanks to Dr. Dave

Dave Brown is simply the best professor I have ever had. He makes every class interesting and makes the material easy to understand by relating it to everyday life. If you show up to class and put in the effort, you should do completely fine. Highly recommend!
He's a really nice, funny guy but his exams are so hard. I went to class every single day, and still had trouble. Study many days in advance for midterms or you're outta luck.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dave is a great guy who actually loves to teach! He makes the lectures interesting and current to college kids. You need to attend and study for tests but you will have all the material you need from him to do well! Wish he taught more sections of Econ I would definitely consider a minor if so
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: really cool guy but need to study for exams but not guranteed to do good on it

Dr. Dave is a real gem. He's a great teacher that really puts passion into his topic. He has random attendance quizzes that range from simply putting your name on a paper for attendance or answering simple questions. I never missed one of his classes, but I never felt the need to skip out of boredom. Exams can be tricky though, so study up!
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dave is really funny and a really good prof. The homework can help your grade a lot and he gives attendance quizzes rarely--but those help too. He usually warns you when he is going to give one. There are a lot of chances to help your grade throughout the semester. The tests are not unbearable. I'm not an Econ person and i got a B+.

Dave is a great guy. Makes class interesting and keeps me paying attention. However, the exams are difficult. He is very wordy with multiple choice and it trips a lot of people up. He also has random attendance quizzes, so be sure to go to class. He does provide lots of resources to study with, but the class material can get a little confusing
Dave Brown is very good at teaching, if you attend class you will definitely understand the material. BUT his exams are tough and need to be well prepared for.
Dave Brown is an amazing professor! He has a genuine love for Economics and it shows in his lecture. make sure you pay attention in class and prepare a lil before tests and you'll be golden.

He is a great guy and teaches the class well. His lectures are enjoyable and he sometimes brings fun into them. The only thing is that his exams are pretty tough and he grades them fairly hard. Be prepared to study in this class.

Dave is a great professor and tries his hardest to make class interesting. I did not find the material to be very challenging but the tests are VERY HARD. The average for each test was a 70%. There are a few home works and they do take some thinking, but try and find others in the class to do the homework with. There are random attendance quiz's.

Dave Brown is an amazing Econ 102 professor. I had to drop Econ two semesters ago with another professor, but I ended up taking Brown because I need this class and I don't regret it. Lectures are engaging, his notes packet is amazing, and his homework is great practice for exams. He is very clear with what is on exams. Take him if you can!!!

Great professor, funny guy. One of the only professors at PSU that makes learning fun and easy to understand. Went through all of AP Micro having no idea what was going on, in his class I got it right away. Easy to get a good grade as long as you pay attention in class and study a little bit. He's so nice I wish all my professors were like Dave <3

Dr. Brown is the best professor at Penn State. My favorite lesson was when he dumped his BLT on the projector screen and we discussed what economic processes had to occur to give the product its current price. Interesting, engaging and fair professor. Take him for 102 if you can.

Pro: Passionate instructor about economics, and always welling to help. Con: Don't take his macroeconomics (104), it is not his area of expertise and he made the Exam way too hard in the second one but way too easy (just like the 102) in the first one. Recommended!

Great professor! Dave is a really funny guy, he keeps lecture engaging and entertaining, plus he explains everything simply and clearly. Very approachable and caring. There are random attendance quizzes (not hard at all, some are jokes) and two midterms (read the MC carefully). 8 HWs total, and final is not cumulative. You dont need the textbook.

he gives random attendance quizzes. his course packet makes the class a lot easier on you. he gives good examples in class so its helpful to go listen to them. when he assigns homework he always starts it with you in class and gives away answers. my issue on exams were timing. good guy, be sure to study for exams.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Amazing lectures--Would take again

reviews.comment: Great teacher! He showed a lot of videos that were perfect examples for the topics we were talking about.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Dave Brown is the best ECON professor in the game, very carefree, doesn't over complicate his exams or his classes, he has maybe a total of 5 attendance quizes it's usually not a problem to miss one but he usually gives some sort of warning or hint about the days that you should come. Great experience

reviews.comment: Great lectures and makes a point to engage the student. Great professor, strongly recommend.

Overall, Dave is a pretty good professor. He makes his lectures interesting by putting a lot of videos to help you understand the topic. He gives about 8 hws during the semester and drops the two lowest scores. He gives two exams and a final. exams can be tricky. He doesn't use the textbook but it is very helpful so buy it & use it!
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Dave Brown is hands down the best professor I have had at Penn State so far. His lectures are interesting and funny because he always has some sort of song to show before class and videos to show during lectures. He is really good at keeping everyones attention. Just make sure to study for the exams because they make up most of the grade!

Probably the best Econ 102 professor you can get. He's great at explaining things and is passionate about what he teaches. Attendance isn't mandatory, but he does a few pop attendance quizzes throughout the semester (maybe 4-5). Tests are average difficulty, just study the material. No textbook necessary.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Would take again

reviews.comment: Dave does a very good job teaching. The lectures get kind of boring because they are long and you have to take a good amount of notes, and you definitely should go to every class for credit on in class attendance quizzes. If you take Econ at Penn State, I believe Dave is the best professor available.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dave Brown is an interesting guy and a very good professor. Make sure you buy the notes packet because it is VERY useful. Pay attention in class and study a lot outside outside of class, because his tests are deceivingly difficult.

Dave Brown is actually the GOAT. He wants you to learn and if you somewhat pay attention or just cram a bit before the test you will be fine. The best was the final because there are 5 cumalative questions and they were given to you before test.(6 easy attendance quizes, only need 3 for 100) (lion tutors packet have same open ended as test)

Dave Brown is an awesome professor. His lectures are really helpful and he gives great hints and examples so students understand the material more. Don't buy the textbook or mapleton book. If you study hard for the tests and do well on homework this class is an easy A.

Dave is the BEST. AMAZING. He makes all material very clear and helps you understand as well as being hilarious during lectures. Many friends I have complain about how confusing and difficult their profs/material is. bonus points are given for attendance, exams are pretty simple and the book isn't used. if you take econ you HAVE to take it w Dave.

Great class and professor. Actually wants the students to learn, but also do well in the class. The Mapleton book was VERY helpful for homework and exam practice. Some problems were almost identical. Also, the course packet is a must-have.

Don't buy the mapleton book; I got an A and didn't even have it. Just study the notes and youll be perfectly fine. Sit in the front of the room, it really does help you pay attention. A lot of the information is intuitive and makes logical sense, so if you can think logically you be fine!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Would take again

reviews.comment: Lectures aren't too boring, has random attendance quizzes every once in a while, he would usually give a warning on when an attendance quiz will take place. Not too much homework, gives out hints on how to solve the homework and sometimes gives out answers, study well for exam the multiple choice is easy but long answers could be tricky.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: By pop quizzes, I mean attendance quizzes, so class is important to go to. Challenging class, but if you study and go to lectures you will definitely pass with a good grade. Lectures are interesting, many videos to keep you awake. Homework weekly, but he goes over it in class before due date. Would definitely take a class with Dave again.

Lecture heavy, but not boring at all. Great speaker, gives you what you need for homework & tests. Shows a video once or twice a week for change, but videos are actually relevant and useful! Homework not bad, but tests can be tough. Lots of review materials given. BUY THE MAPLETON BOOK! Some test and homework problems taken from there.

If you have to take Econ 102, I strongly recommend you take it with Dr. Brown. To get an A in the class all you have to do is do the homework properly and study from the class notes. Lectures are informative, but boring. Compared to what I have heard from my other friends who take econ 102 but have different professors, dr. brown is the easiest
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dave Brown is an awesome professor. My major requires me to take this class as my only business class and I was dreading it. However, Dave made it really easy to enjoy the material. He's really nice, accessible outside of class, and makes lecture interesting with videos and very through explanations. Easy pop quizzes. VERY lecture heavy.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Amazing lectures--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Great teacher, hard class. He's really passionate about the material and likes to include videos and cat photos in the lectures. The down side is that he goes through an insane amount of notes each class and its almost impossible to copy the notes down and pay attention at the same time. Easy pop quizzes meant to encourage attendance.

Dave is a really cool guy that actually cares about the subject he is teaching. Lectures can get dry at times, but he is an awesome professor across the board. It will not be an easy A, but Dave gives you the materials you need to succeed.

Dave is really passionate about the subject he teaches, which makes the class more interesting than you would think. He keeps you engaged and makes sure to connect everything he's teaching to examples you would understand. There are only 3 tests, including the final, and homework about every week or two. If you go to most classes you should be fine
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: A real gem!!! He's easy to understand, accessible outside of class but you really have to study for the exams. He takes notes in a note packet and doesn't post them online, so if you skip class it's hard to catch up. Attendance pop quizzes and some homework
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Brown is a great professor. His lectures are note heavy, but he does add in videos and activities to lighten the mood. You need to buy the notes packet and attend class since he does not post notes online. The are several homework assignments that help your grade if you actually do them. Overall, he is one of my favorite professors.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dave is such a nice man. You can tell he really cares about what he is talking about. Not a bad class to take at all. You get extra points besides the exams and have homework that will bring you up. You have to go to class because he'll do random attendance. All around not a bad class and a nice professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dave Brown is the only reason I will pass an economics class. He is a great educator and he really knows what he's talking about. Even though he is lecture heavy, it's worth it to take notes in the big packets that you can buy for his class. He really helps you understand what's going on! He's also SUPER funny!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: A great professor who knows what he's doing. He shows videos that help a lot with explaining topics. I never complained about going to this class, he makes it pretty fun. You have to buy the fill-in-the-blank notes that get inserted into a binder, makes your life so easy. Wish I studied harder for the tests because I could've gotten a better grade
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Dave is a great prof. I'd encourage any student planning to take ECON-102 to choose him. He is available outside of class and his Homeworks are not that difficult, and most of them are found online. Also, he sometimes does pop quizzes in class so make sure to attend. One more thing he gives a lot of extra credit; again try to be in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Hilarious

reviews.comment: The biggest thing I liked about his class is that when he comes in and plays music. Today, he had the soundtrack from Mario Kart playing! He's a great guy, definitely do not regret having him. I would without a doubt take him again!

Dave Brown is a great professor. He makes the lectures interesting and easy to understand. He gives very little homework and the homework is pretty easy. I would recommend getting the student packet because it is just a fill-in-the-blank copy of his lecture notes. The textbook is not needed at all so I wouldn't get it. Should be an easy A or B+

Awesome professor who really loves what he teaches. Everything you need to know is in the notes packet so make sure to go to every class and take great notes. Also, the practice exams and material he gives for tests is usually very similar to what you will see on the exams. Some questions can be tricky but if you study you'll be fine.

A really relate-able guy who makes economics a really simple topic. He offers a lot of practice exams that are similar to his real exams and wants everybody in his class to do well. Made lectures very entertaining without being corny like other professors.

Dave Brown is a real gem. Plays music before class that actually makes you excited for lecture. The best way to succeed in the course is to GO TO CLASS. He gives you tons of tips and tricks to remember the material and always dedicated the day before the test to reviewing.  Keep in mind that if you want to be a future grader, you have to get an A-
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Very rarely did I dread going to his lectures. The homework that he assigns is very helpful in preparing for exams and there aren't many assigned, so make sure you do them thoroughly. I had an A the entire semester until the final exam, so make sure that you're well prepared on the subjects included on the final exam because it is very difficult.
Great professor! He makes learning microeconomics fun and easy . Very helpful and fast to respond to emails. Homework and quizzes were easy, exams were a little more difficult.

Professor Brown made it a point to go over all of the important stuff and nothing that wasn't. His lectures were very straight forward, which made it very easy to follow along. His notes packet was used a lot more than the text, but that was fine. Some of the lectures had videos which showed up on tests, so be careful and make sure to review.
Dave is a great professor who is always putting in the extra effort to make his lectures fun and still informative. I would 100% take another class with him.

Econ 102 can be a boring class but I really enjoyed it with Dr. Brown. Though the course material can get old quick, he kept class engaging with real life examples that were really helpful and easy to understand. He also often used humor in his lectures, and showed funny videos that related to the content. I enjoyed this class because of him.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dave is a great guy. He loves teaching ECON. Get the notes packet, go to class, TAKE NOTES, and study for the exams. That is the recipe for an A. I never opened the book. Tests have tricky questions. He cares about his students. Don't expect an easy A without work, put in the work and youll do great!

Dave is a great prof. His lectures are interesting and I was motivated to go to each one. He has a notes packet that -- if you go to every class and fill in the notes and graphs -- make it easy to review for the three exams. Some of the exam questions can be tough, but he posts a ton of stuff online to help students review.

Not very helpful.  I took this class because of the reviews. Lecture heavy and never got our test back so we never know what we got wrong and right. Take Econ with someone else if you can. Study for exams all myself. Self study
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He makes learning about the economy interesting. His lectures aren't boring, and as long as you went to the lectures, you would do fine on the exams.
Great Professor
