reviews.comment: Dude just loves what he does so it helps to learn from someone who is passionate.

Dave Brown is a beast! If you are actually interested in learning econ, he is your guy. Some of his exam questions can be tough, but I learned a lot from him and would 100% take him again. Keeps a generally boring subject entertaining and has a great sense of humor.
Amazing all around great professor. Be involved, go to office hours and attend class. Witty, and very passionate as well.

I took David as my Econ 102 professor. It is by far the greatest professor I have had at PennState. The key in order to get an A is going to class and taking good notes. He explains the concepts with great examples for you to understand the material and get everything clear. I loved that he uses a packet and you just complete with your notes. best

Dave is a very nice guy, great professor, explains clearly, helps with homework. Tests can be hard, for 104, the average of the 2nd midterm was 60%; however, for the first exam it was 90%. Very interesting lectures and he is really fun, would take him again. Be ready to work, not an easy A. I also took him for 102 and also got an A.

First exam was extremely easy. Second exam and final were ridiculous. Even after studying all the notes and practice exams, I felt confident on about 50% of questions on the final two exams. The class is way too hard for an introductory economics class. Also his notes aren't very helpful. Over 250 pages, too much to learn from.

Great guy, but this was Brown's 1st semester teaching 104 and definitely ended up being an experimental class for him.. Exam 1 was EXTREMELY easy Exam 2 was EXTREMELY hard ridiculously challenging especially compared to the first. My guess is that he mistakenly made the first exam too easy and then the second too hard Final was fairly easy

I really loved Dave the beginning of the semester but with each exam I began to wish I picked a different professor. He clearly doesn't like letting students achieve good grades even with excellent understanding of course concepts. During tests I felt like he was trying to trick us. Save your GPA and 104 with someone else. Not worth the effort.

Dr. Brown is one of the best professors here at Penn State. His class is super interesting and he always shows videos that are related to the material that is taught in class. Attend every lecture, pay attention in class, study well for exams, and you will get an A. Will definitely take with him again!

Dr. Brown is one of the best professors I've ever had! He really knows the information he is presenting and he presents it in a very clear way. His notes packet is the key to class (definitely don't need the textbook). His homework assignments are really helpful. If you go to his office hours, he is really awesome and willing to help with anything.

Dave Brown is a brilliant guy and very down to earth. He is a great professor and classes are always interesting except a few days here and there. Do not get a textbook, it is never used.  Tests are very fair and if you study you can easily get an A. Very straightforward class and you should go to class due to attendance and notes. Take econ w/ him
Very into his lectures, knows his stuff.  Probably the best econ professor out there.
Very passionate about the subject and very engaging with the students. Put in the effort and you'll get an A and get a lot out of the class.

Dr. Dave is wonderful. He's a great speaker and incredibly makes this class interesting. I don't even want to pick up my phone in class. He's funny, helpful with homework assignments, and his notes are fantastic tools for studying. Don't bother wasting money on the textbook; I never used it.

Great guy and awesome prof! He actually kept my attention throughout each class and he presented the material in an interesting way. Review days before the exam will give you everything you need for the tests. He is very clear about what is going to be on them, though you do have to put in some work and you'll be fine.

Great, funny, clear, and straightforward professor. His homework is easy, but you will have to study for his exams. The lectures are clear and simple, and he shares videos to connect in-class topics to real world problems. I would definitely take econ with him again.  Only buy the notes packet, the textbook was not necessary.

He really is passionate about it! He shows videos relating to the topics. Gives some questions to do in class. And a multiple question homework only (ez pz). Don't buy the textbook, just the course packet is sufficient. Would really recommend him!

You can tell that Dave Brown knows about the topics, he is really passionate about it. Econ can be boring sometimes but he makes the class fun and brings extra articles and stuff to make the class better. Tests are not to bad, he makes his study guide really clear and he is a great professor overall.

Great lectures, he really knows the material and is knowledgeable about what he is talking about. He keeps the lectures upbeat and interesting. He is also pretty funny. The homework isn't bad and neither are the tests. It's a great class to take. I learned a lot.

Dave Brown is a funny guy who knows how to keep his students engaged. His lectures make the material quite interesting and he shows lots of videos towards the end that make the class more interesting. You definitely have to study for his tests as he throws some tricky questions on his exams.

Challenging but definitely doable. Best way to study for Dr. Dave's tests is to study your in-class/TB notes inside and out - you'll have to think outside of the box. Also, his lectures are very lively so it won't be boring. His voice might start to annoy you, but he's definitely worth it. Def take him if you are unsure of other professors.

Great Prof - Engaging, kind, and very attentive. Dr. Dave was a fantastic professor and I highly suggest taking his class. Test material covered very well in class and in the  notes. NEEDED: Course Notes Packet,  but don't waste money on the textbook though, you won't even open it

Homeworks are hard, tests are harder. Class is fun and interesting and he keeps you involved. Make sure you do well on the first couple homeworks because they just get harder as the class progresses. Nice enough guy, didn't really have a lot of time to help students though, or that's how it seemed. Pay attention in class and it'll be okay

Dave is amazing, he explains very clearly, his lectures are interesting and funny. Dave is a really nice guy, take him for econ102! the only thing is that his exams and homeworks arent as easy as other professors, there are tricky questions, however, he always helps with homework in class. His lectures, motivation, energy makes it worth it.
Dave is really a charming person in teaching economics. He made boring materials become alive and give out very clear lectures with graph and diagrams. Recommend him as the econ teacher!!!

Dave was a great professor!! Made me consider majoring in economics. He is very energetic and some classes are interesting and some are somewhat boring only because the material is so dense. Overall, amazing professor! Would take again

Honest and legit review of the professor. I took Econ in high school and was pretty confident about it in college. No doubt, the instructor is really good and he uses real life examples, movies and music to make lectures appealing. However, he is a real tough grader. The home works and tests are tricky. It's not easy to score in this class.
Go to every lecture. His lectures are fun and awesome, yet very informative. I don't like Econ yet  understand it because of him. He is a down to earth type of guy.

Great professor.  Lectures are pretty interesting and the tests are all straight forward.  If you understand what's going on in class, then there will be no surprises on the tests.  Occasional attendance quizzes for easy points.

Dave Brown is HILARIOUS! He makes Econ 102 easy to understand and entertaining to go to class. He's a good professor and as long as you study the exams you will do well, they are fair and based off of the class lectures and notes. Definitely take it with Brown.

He's not the best teacher , but to be honest he's always clear and teaches well. You guys can take him again , but midterms are  not that easy. To sum up you can take him. Oh also just to remind he's not like the boring econ professors.
He is definitely enthusiastic about economics. Good lecturer but I still went to Lion Tutors.

Well-spoken, loves his area of study, conveys ideas easily to class. He keeps class entertaining during his lectures. Sometimes  there's homework, but not often. Go to office hours if help is needed, he is excited to explain concepts further. Attend class if you want extra credit, once in a blue moon he gives out a couple points. He's a cool guy.

Dr. Brown is the best Econ 102 professor. Everything he tests on comes from his notes packet - don't buy the book or study guide supplement. Attend lectures because he does not put notes online. Overall, this was not a bad class.

Dave did a great job in making a lecture class successful. He has so much passion for econ, and that keeps it interesting. He also has a good speaking style. The tests are kind of difficult, but still entirely manageable. Best prof I had this semester. Also, don't buy the textbook.
he is good

Best professor at Penn State. Hilarious lectures, but gets the point across simply and in a way you can understand. You have to pay attention and take notes if you want to get an A, but the exams have straightforward reviews and practice tests. If you put in the effort, you will pass no problem. Would definitely take Dr. Dave again.
Dr Dave is the best professor i have ever had

Dr. Brown is one of the most relatable professors I've ever had. His lectures are funny and easy to understand when put in real life terms. He offers a lot of points for participation and homework to boost your grade. Exams can be abstract and tough, study a lot if you want to do well. GET THE COURSE PACKET. You won't use the textbook.

Dave Brown is the man!! He actually wants you to do well and will go over anything in class. He has random attendance quizzes but gives other opportunities to earn attendance points if you don't go. HIS COURSE PACKET IS NEEDED the textbook is not.
Best professor you can get for ECON 102.

Dr. Brown is an all around great teacher. He truly cares about his students and makes the material easy to understand with funny comparisons. Attendance wise, just make sure your there for the attendance quizzes, Dr. Brown offers more than enough opportunities. Also, Dr. Brown offers extra credit twice per semester through random attendance quizzes
Great class! Relatively easy and interesting lectures!

Take him. He's one of the best professors I've had. There's a lot of material, and he makes it fun. He's extremely clear during lectures and really cares about helping you out to make sure you understand everything. I would say that the assignments and exams can be tricky, but if you put the time in, you'll do well.

Good professor.  Kept class pretty interesting with entertaining videos and jokes.  I suggest reading through your notes after each class because you get a lot of information every day.  Also go to class, the notes are extremely important.  No need to buy the book.
Really good professor. He would definitely take another class of his again.

Dave Brown makes class really interesting and uses funny examplesvideos to demonstrate concepts in an intriguing way. Attendance isn't mandatory but you're not going to want to miss his notes and it's not a class you dread going to anyway. LOVE HIM! PS don't buy the book but you need to buy the note packet

Only buy the note packet.  Dave is easily one the best Econ 102 professors. Go to class, although if you miss a day it's pretty easy to catch up on notes. Read over your notes and do the sample exams he posts prior to the tests. There is no excuse not to get an A in this class. Also, don't waste money on Lion Tutors. There is free tutoring.

Dr. Dave is definitely the best Econ 102 professor at PSU.  Going into his class I had the mindset of "memorize some graphs and then pass the class."  But Dr. Dave got me interested in the material.  His lectures are easy to relate to and his humor is great.
Definitely take his class.  He truly cares about how the students are doing in the class and is very helpful and clear.

Professor Brown is very engaging and enthusiastic. He is able to simplify material and is able to relate them to simple real life situations. The videos are also very helpful and entertaining. Although you don't have to attend it is recommended because he covers a lot and on occasion has attendance quizzes. He seems genuinely interested and helpful

LOVES what he does, and lectures aren't mind blowingly boring.  Coming from someone who has taken micro econ before and really struggled, Dave is an amazing teacher, and gives help and looks out for students when needed.  Would def. recommend him

Concise, well educated and knows how to make all fifty minutes of class productive. Despite ALL THREE of his Econ 102 classes being enormous, he handles it all and handles it well to make it understandable for everyone.  (Don't bother with the book, his notes are your bible for the whole class.)

oKAY. If you want to understand the materials after you walk of his class, read the textbook for the chapter that you're going to study first. Because he put a bunch of stuffs on his ppt and talks a lot at the same time that makes it impossible to understand anything during class because you cannot write and listen at the same time He's okay

GREAT Econ teacher, one of the best around.  His enthusiasm about Econ alone made it worth going to class.  Exams were always a little difficult for me, but he does a wonderful job of explaining concepts and uses real-life examples that appeal to college-aged students to explain concepts.  Take this class!

Dave is one of the best Econ teachers you can hope to get. The class is a little hard, but he really tries to explain things with good "real world" examples. There are some attendance points, but you can skip without penalty. Buy his notes packet and go to LionTutors!!

Out of all Econ 102 teachers you want him. Helps alot, funny guy. Tests arent too bad and a B+/A- is doable. Dont have to go to class, which is helpful if you are pledging like I was. Overall great guy, highly suggested.
Great professor makes the class very interesting. Wants you to do well and genuinely cares about being fair and helpful. Definitely the best prof for 102.

Professor Brown is awesome! No interest in Econ but he made it interesting. Don't buy the book, you never use it. Course pack is a must. Practice exams and homework really reflect exam content. Great professor!

Dave Brown is the BEST econ teacher there is. He genuinely cares about the class and is enthused about the subject matter. Go to class, copy the notes into the packet for the class and it's an easy A. Also DO NOT buy the textbook, its a complete waste, you never use it.
GREAT PROFESSOR.  if you can take his class, do it.  He is knowledge in the subject and teaches in an easy and fun way.  If you pass him up as a professor you are messing up.
Great teacher! Take his class!

He's really a great professor. It's obvious he cares about the students, and the material isn't too difficult to grasp, especially if you have taken an econ class before. I would highly recommend this professor over the other Econ 102 professors.
good teacher, you can get A by taking the class and review before exam
So clear in presentation. His enthusiasm makes me actually enjoy going to class. Everything you need is in the notes.
Best teacher i have had so far. He is very helpful and his classes are very interesting. He keeps the class engaged
Excellent class, excellent teacher!!!!!!

He's a great instructor and really cares about his students doing well. If you go to the lectures and listen, you should do really well in the class. Econ isn't my thing, but I actually enjoyed this class.

He was amazing, easily the best teacher I have had a PSU so far.  Blows all of the other teachers out of the water for Econ 102.  Attendance is mandatory for about 4 classes all year, including tests.  Lets class out early on most fridays.  LEGGOO! He is...Penn State!
Great prof!!! He was clear and very entertaining! He made a boring class fun! Best prof I've had so far!!
Good teacher

One of the best professors I've had so far. Class is so interesting and he's amazing at what he does. Not what you'd consider an easy A but if you put in the effort and study for exams you'll do just fine. He's also extremely helpful and an awesome chill guy, you just have to be willing to want it.

Dave Brown is AWESOME. Take him for ECON 102. Go to every class and pay attention (which isnt hard because he's engaging). I took Econ is HS with an awful teacher and hated the subject. Dave Brown made me love Econ! It's also nice that we didnt have to get an expensive book. His note packet is AWESOME.
Dave Brown is the man. This class was so easy. It is impossible to fail. Take this class over any other professor and 102 over 104. I got an A and didnt work hard.

Dave provides a ton of materials (or "Supplements") to help you study.  If you get anything less than a "B" it's because you didn't do the assignments or didn't bother to look at all the materials he posts for you.  He sends emails every time he posts this type of material.  Great instructor!

Whoever says Dave doesn't reply to emails is wrong.  If he didn't reply to your email, it's probably because you sent him one email all semester -- you asked him to give you extra credit at the end of the course.  If you email him about anything during the semester, he is quick to reply and is also helpful during office hours.

He's enthusiastic about econ. He talks from the second class starts until it ends. It's a lot of info and can be interesting, but his tests are pretty overwhelming because they lack clarity. His online homework lacks clarity as well. Attendance is HIGHLY recommended. I studied my butt off and pulled off a C. If you can, take a different teacher.

This class was really challenging especially his exams. I mean some people say the class is easy and some say the class is hard. I believe it just depends on the person. It is either you understand the materials or not. The homework were somewhat hard too, well to me.Class is mandatory because he gives out pop quizzes here and there.
Really good professor. Don't have to be a genius o take his class. He explains really well. I think that you should take his class before you take ECON 104, but that's just me
Nice guy.  Kinda tricks you on exams and hws but there not too bad.  Go to lion tutors and pay attention in class.  Study up for exams and you will get a b or above.
He makes econ seem fun. The tests are pretty difficult but I would take his class every time because he is so fun.
Best teacher i ever had. random attendance points so i recommend going. not too many hws and with going to his review class and lion tutors i got an A
His class was easy and helpful as he will illustrate everything in the course packet in detail. Pay attention to details could avoid you from getting bad scores in exams.

For the most part a very fair exam. Go to class and pay attention and you will be fine. First exam is very easy, but the second is much more difficult. Do all the supplementary work and have a good grasp of the material. Take this class it is very fun and has very little work out of class. Don't buy the textbook!!

My favorite professor at PSU so far. A funny guy who makes the material pretty easy to follow. Go to class because his tests are based entirely off of lecture notes. He didn't even reference the textbook so don't bother buying it. A really great class and professor :)
Very enthusiastic professor who makes Econ relevant and interesting. Tests can be difficult, but all test material is somewhere in notes. Great professor, relatively easy class.

His tests are so much more difficult than they need to be.  I never missed a class, and I studied my butt off, yet I still felt the exams were so challenging.  He's a very good lecturer, but if you're looking for an easy A, this isn't the course.

I was pretty interested in economics until I took this class. It was very challenging in all aspects. The homework is very hard and the tests were difficult. He does give a good amount of extra credit, which helped a bit. Attendance is extremely important because he likes to give pop quizzes. Good Luck!

Easy A and lots of extra credits. The attendance isnt mandatory but I highly recommend you go as often as possible, cos the tests are highly basic on the lecture and book isnt as helpful as the notes. Plus the attendance quizzes take up 6% of the grade. sometimes it's 3 multiple choice questions but most of the time you just need to sign ur name

Great professor and fairly easy. You kind of have to go to class because he gives attendance quizzes. Also you definitely don't need the book for this class so DON'T buy it unless you want it as a supplement.
Good Guy, just not the easy A I was looking for. Hard to get a C, Hard to get an A. IF you're looking for Econ and don't mind getting a B, I recommend
Easy class, attendance is unnecessary unless he announces a quiz every now and then

Dave Brown is an awesome professor! He was so clear with all his explanations and examples and really prepared you for exactly what would be on the exams. As long as you do the practice problems he gives before tests, you can get a good grade in the class. His classes, both ECON 102 and 302, made me want to pursue an ECON minor. Great guy!
Class was really hard I thought, but he is a good teacher and kind of goofy.  Tests aren't too bad but the final is a killer.

Had an A going into the final. After the final, I had a B...the final was unnecessarily difficult. His tests/quizzes in general utilize every single minute of allotted time, so there isn't much time to think during exams. Despite a frustrating final, I liked his class better than Dirk Mateer's Variety Show and learned more from him.

No idea how he has such a high easiness rating. He must have changed something, because this class was not easy. Exams are 70 percent of your grade, and the questions are very poorly stated, making it difficult. Fairly easy B, very difficult A.
EXCELLENT TEACHER EVER I LOVED AT PENN STATE

Dave Brown is the best professor I've had thus far! He's engaging and is really down-to-earth. It's pretty easy to rack up the points in this class which makes it easier to get the grade you want. Exams are basically the same questions asked in different ways so if you know the material you have an 'A', but if you don't you're screwed. Love him!

Great teacher. Fun and interesting class. All lectures were pretty entertaining. Gives random "attendance" quizzes which are basic and simple just to make sure you're there. Attendance is not mandatory but the random quizzes are a necessary part of the class.
This is the most boring class ever. I could barely stay awake in my class which was at 2:30 pm! This class is definitely not an easy A. But it is a pretty easy B.

Dave makes class really interesting because he is so outgoing and excited about econ. His exams are fairly difficult but aren't ridiculous; if you go to class and study you will be fine. LionTutors was AMAZING to help you prepare. I'd suggest taking him... I learned a lot. But don't buy the book!
Great professor; very energetic, obviously loves what he does.
Pretty easy class. Just study the material, do the homework, and go to class and an A is very obtainable.

By far the most boring class I've taken so far. All his comparisons are to beer and pizza, which are funny at first, but not after four months of beer and pizza analogies. The examples all start to run together. Getting  out of econ was the highlight of my day. However, he is very energetic and interested in what he is teaching.

Take Brown. Dr. Dave's the man. He's genuinely entertaining (even when talking about Econ, which is quite the feat in my opinion). His tests are not that difficult if you study; I had no Econ background or interest at all, and I did just fine. He gives some homework answers in class, he's very enthusiastic, and he understands how to host a lecture.

Though I hear that all of the Econ teachers at PSU are awesome, I think Dave's as good as it gets.  He makes the class so interesting (even if you don't care much about economics), so paying attention is easy.  And that's about all you have to do for a good grade.  Do not buy the text book, Dave strictly uses his notes.
Dave is a fun and enthusiastic dude and class is not a pain to go to. Notes are easy to take and follow along with, but exams get pretty tough. I'd say take him though

Dave Brown is an awesome guy. A lot of funny examples and videos during class. Homeworks are generally pretty easy and notes are fill in the blank. Liontutors helps study for exams. First exam is easy but the second one and final are difficult. Put a lot of time into studying for 2nd and 3rd exams.

Easiest class so far. Just go to class, take the notes, and read through them before tests. Literally have not looked at the textbook once. Don't buy it. Dave's the man; he teaches you what you need to know. Videos he uses during class will appear on exams, but just go to class and you'll be fine.

take mateer.. he is way easier and way better. brown is not clear, and very unhelpful in his office hours. his tests have questions with two right answers. i took him bc of his rating on here, bad choice.

I had him for 102 and 302. Best professor I've ever had. Shook his hand when I turned in my 302 final. Inspired me to take up an econ minor (I am a computer engineering major). Take his class, he makes econ easy and enjoyable.

Dave Brown is the man. His notes are fill in the blank, so you barely have to write anything down except for graphics. He puts on music and funny videos. He gives extra credit for stupid questions if you go to class. Makes econ really easy and interesting. I'm an engineering major and am now double majoring because of him. TAKE HIM!
Dave is a good guy. Class isn't mandatory but it's worth going because he teaches you everything you need to know for the tests.

Dr Dave is awesome! While a lot of his jokes are pretty nerdy, he is a lot of fun and is great to have as a professor. I opened the textbook once or twice on the homeworks but probably could have survived without it.  He tells funny stories that kept me entertained.
very easy-going man...I like taking his classes and it's one of the easiest classes i've ever had...

Dr. Brown is very helpful and his powerpoints are really clear. All you need are the note packets, I didn't even open the textbook this semester. Study from there and make sure that you know the terms, and the class should be a breeze. Dr. Brown is very funny and he makes the class interesting.
Great Professor! I would recommend him to anyone. He makes econ easy to understand! I recommend lion tutors also! Bonus: You do not need to buy a textbook!!

I heard there was another teacher for the same class that was supposed to be better than Dave Brown, but I was in no way disappointed with him. He keeps the class entertained and into the lecture, and he knows how to get us to understand the material. I'd definitely take him again.
Dave Brown has been one of the best professors that I have ever had. he makes econ fun and I even learned. quite a lot actually. the best part is on fridays he plays video game music before class
Dave Brown... nuff said

Dave was the best. He was so enthusiastic that you actually don't want to fall asleep in class. His tests were kind of difficult, but easy A's if you study hard. Take his class... you'll learn a lot and enjoy it.

Dave Brown is awesome! Definitely my favorite professor. He always plays music from video games (Zelda!) while the students are arriving to class. Also, he tells funny stories. Make sure you purchase the note packet and go to class. You don't need to look at the textbook at all.

I had no interest in economics and only took the class because I was required for my major. I was expecting a horrible class- but it wasn't! I truly enjoyed his class and really thought that he made the subject interesting. The notes packet is really helpful- so much so that I didn't use the book once. If you have to take econ take it with Dave! :)

Dave was the man. I loved his class and he was my favorite professor alst semester. He makes the calss enjoyable and cracks jokes whenever he can. I already took the class in High School so I knew most of the material. If you go to class and review the notes before exams you'll get an A
He's funny and definitely really interested in what he teaches. However, he moves through the notes VERY quickly. Also, he doesn't put the notes up on ANGEL which is a pain if you have to miss class.

Dr. Dave is the man! Extremely intelligent, pretty easy to understand, and just an awesome guy to talk to! Gives quizzes in which to answer you have to make animal noises including that of a dying giraffe, plays music in class, and makes the dullest subject in the world enjoyable. I got him by accident this semester and I didn't care! TAKE HIM!!!

Fall of 2010 was his first semester and he was probably one of my favorite professors!  VERY interested and enthusiastic and makes real-life examples (mostly about pizza and beer) for clarification.  Entertaining guy too.  I highly recommend him if you just want to pass ECON or if you're genuinely interested.

The class was pretty easy, could've done better if I actually tried. Took an 8am so I hated going but she did cancel class occasionally because she knew it was early for students. Everything was two attempts which was great, but good amount of "homework" that's basically a mini quiz on the lesson in class. Tophat questions count towards attendance

Took this class to fulfill a math gen ed credit requirement. Open note and 2 attempts on all HW, both midterms, and final. Everything is online. Go to class and take good notes, write all the problem steps, and you'll do great. Ask questions in class, and Prof. Bonafini is good at answering and helping you understand. Also, lots of office hours.
Bonafini my goat. I suck at math, ended with an A. Go to office hours. Easy.

This class really wasn't that bad. I never struggled until the final, which I only really struggled on due to the fact that I didn't study. As long as you have functioning brain cells this class is easy. Bonafini's accent is not hard at all to understand and she's a really great and understanding lecturer. I would take her again if I had the chance
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Great professor. I'm pretty bad at math and took this to fulfill my last math credits. glad i did, super easy class. exams not timed, online, and 2 attempts--same for the homework. Lots of office hours M-F if you're confused about anything. Just focus on writing the steps to problems and formulas in lecture. Makes the homework easy.
Easiest A if you take this class online. Assignments every week but they don't take long at all.

Overall the class isn't that hard but its very important you actually go to class and learn the lessons when she teaches them. She's very sweet but the tests can be difficult but she gives you 2 chances to take them and they are online. I would take her again though don't let the other opinions influence you too much to not take the class.

I suck at math but I did great in this class. Exams are literally online & not timed. Very good resources. Concepts kinda hard for me to grasp but if u lock in on homework's n jus use the formulas she gives u will be fine. I'd recommend this class if u want the easiest psu math credit.
I suck at math and I had a great exp

nice person, not a great professor. so hard to raise your grade as the hw is only 8 questions every time. she let us have unlimited time and two tries on each assignment, which was nice. the issue was that most of the questions on the hw were much harder than those in class, making some assignments take me and my friends literal hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I never spoke to the professor, but this is an extremely easy online math class. Just look at the formulas and apply them. You'll do fine if you graduated from high school.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This class was extremely challenging for someone who is not good at math, although with good notes and paying attention, you should be able to manage. Class was extremely homework heavy and it took up a lot of time. Midterms and final are online and open note although the questions are nothing like the homework and are extremely challenging.

Nice professor, but difficult class. Graded on few things, also all the hw questions are worth the same amount of points regardless of how complex they are. Would definitely suggest getting outside help/ tutoring if you haven't taken a math class in a while bc the hw doesn't always match up with the lecture material. No extra credit btw so study!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. the final took me like 9 hours to finish and didn't end up with an A. she is by far the worst professor. every homework takes hours and hours and the exams are nothing like the homeworks. took this during my last semester and it dropped my GPA. this class and this professor is horrible. AVOID AVOID. she ruined my life
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of the worst professors I have ever had. Don't even bother going to the review sessions as it is nothing like the final and midterms. Midterm's took me 3 hours and final took me almost 6. Says "if your bad at math, this is the class for you" on the first day. DO NOT LISTEN TO THAT. This class was terrible and so hard and I suck at math.

Worst math class I've ever taken. The teacher seems nice but she's a god awful grader. I went to every class, wrote notes, and spent HOURS on homework/exams yet still got poor grades on them. I truly believe she makes up her own answers because no matter how much I follow her steps on the power points, I still get the wrong answer. NOT AN EASY A

The topics taught in the class are so easy, but there are so few assignments; just getting a couple of questions wrong on some will ensure you don't get an A in the class. If you were thinking of taking this class to get an easy A, don't. The professor isn't too bad, but I would never choose to take another class with her again.

DON'T TAKE THIS CLASS! I attend every class, spend hrs on HW and still struggle. It's ridiculous to spend 5 hrs on 8 questions and get a 75. Her teaching style, if you can even call it that, is horrible. Class examples don't match assignments. Online exams are impossible, even with 2 chances. My last math class with in-person exams was much easier

0/10 took math of money first semester freshman year in person, legit horrible the tests were online but impossible to cheat on. chat gpt sells every single time without fail. passed this class by genuinely 1 point, idk how i even passed. her accent makes it impossible to even know what shes teaching. if u can take online def do it heard its easier

This math class can be challenging, but with good notes, attending all classes, and using resources like unstuckstudy, you can succeed. The professor is approachable, but the workload is heavy. Overall, it's a doable course if you stay organized.
All work was done online in canvas. All tests including final was done online on your own time. She'd cancel class on Friday's for random reasons, but I didnt mind.

She's fine, you're literally going to be fine. These ratings scared me so bad last semester but honestly they feel dramatic now. I am not a math person and barely put any effort in and got a B. If you pay even a bit of attention in class and participate, you'll be fine. Homework, midterms, and final are all take home online w multiple attempts.

Professor Bonafini is an amazing professor and this class was good. I don't know why her ratings are so bad but she is a good professor and will give you all the help you need in order to pass her class.

The worst class ever. Worst class EVER. Oh online math class? Seems like an easy A. WRONG. The examples given are nothing like the homework or exams, I swear the teacher made up the answers, I tried 100 different ways to do the questions and never got her “correct” answer. Unless you're a finance genius, do not take

Class was an easy A, homework is fairly frequent (2x per week + mini-quizzes) and exams are tough and worth a lot. But mini-quizzes are free points! She wasn't great at explaining and tests didn't fully align with questions in homework (beyond the normal), so expect to use Chegg or GSGs as your friend. Overall, it's an easy A but study for tests!!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She was a nice professor but examples in class were nothing like the homework or exams. I went to every single class and spent over 3 hours on both midterms and the final. The final is weighted so heavily that my grade dropped 10 points from getting a 70. I thought I would be fine when I saw 2 attempts but do not let that fool you.
I thought this class would be more of a personal finance class but oh boy was I wrong. it is pointless busy work
Don't take as a gen ed. Take anything else.

The bad reviews are from lazy students expecting to pass without putting in the work. Dr. Bonafini is fantastic; the class isn't hard if you do the work. 1-2 1-hour homeworks/week, all graded assignments are take-home and you get two chances with your best score kept. TA hours are accessible. Would recommend to people who struggle with math.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She's pretty nice and understanding when it comes to missed classes. There are 2 midterms, 1 Final, 16 HW assignments which are all take home, typed answers and 2 tries on each. Takes Top Hat attendance you can miss up to 10 questions during the semester (about 3 per class); Very easy A, first few weeks is just learning how to take percentages.

Professor Bonafini is not bad at all. Her lectures are straightforward, and all of the slides are posted on Canvas with extra problems. The GSG works hard to have review sessions and extra practice to get you ready for the exam. The midterms are harder than the homework, but she tells you that in class and provides resources to prepare you.

I don't understand all the bad review about this class. Yes, some of the questions that appeared on the homework and exams weren't exactly like the ones in class, but if you understand the concepts covered in class, they questions are easy anyway. I spent about an hour a WEEK studying/doing homework outside of class. Exams took around 90 minutes.

She's really nice but the way the class is formatted is not ideal. Chegg is your bestie but use it appropriately. As long as you're organized, take good notes, and attend EVERY class you should be fine. Hw and exams take hours to complete but you do get two attempts. I still think this math class is better than most tbh.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Let me preface this by saying I am a 4.0 student. I love learning, and I can appreciate a challenge. This course was challenging in the wrong ways. It took me 6 hours to finish the midterm. One typo could mean you have to retake an entire assignment. Without exaggeration, I spent an average of 3-4 hours a day on this course. It's just too much.

Terrible. Horrible. Worst professor ive ever had. Dont worry if you dont understand the homework because the test questions are nothing like it!! Tons of work and literally never any time to do it. She could care less about anything else going on in your life besides this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is so awful, this class makes every student hate their lives and regret taking it. The only reason she has students enrolled is because admissions lists the class professor as TBD at the time of enrollment. Hours of homework a week, no leniency for grading, and no explanations that actually make sense.
Just took the final. Started out with a 93 ended with a 75. TA review session 3 hours long did it cover at least 3 questions on the exam? No it did not. Professor is god awful and has to go!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: My favorite part of her class is where she makes attendance mandatory, but attending class doesnt actually matter because she puts questions on homework and exams that doesnt appear in class!!!!!

Professor Bonafini is kind enough to give exam questions that dont appear in homework, lectures, or TA study sessions (which btw, are useless because they go over the most basic questions in all of class) Thank you professor Bonafini for making what should be an easy math gen ed into my most time consuming, worst grade of all my classes this sem!!!

Do not take this course. I have never spent more time on exams and homework's for any class. I should not be spending 3+ hours on an exam. At the beginning of the year, the professor said that"if you are not good at math, this is the class for you" .The biggest lie I was ever told. Questions on homework's and review are nothing like the exams.

Went into the final with a 95, get a few questions wrong that were no where on her slides or that we had gone over and dropped my grade 7 points. And of course we can round up and down on the test or hw but not when students futures are on the line.

i'm not sure why everyone complains about this professor so much, she was so nice and so willing to help however she could. if you can't handle basic algebra, don't take this class but if you can understand basic math you'll be fine. the material was helpful & practical & the professor/TA's are very accessible.
Horrible just horrible. I will be lodging a formal complaint. This teacher is awful. Homework is so difficult and none of the solutions are in the notes. Don't bother even trying to get an A.

If you want to take a class that will help you in the long run then avoid this one. Terrible professor, so much work for what's suppose to be a basic class. Little to no room for failure, horrible grading scale.
Don't bother taking this class. You'll waste your time. TA review is 3 hours long. Mid term take 2.5 hours. Final will take you over 3. Awful class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Awful just don't take

Grading structure is awful, teacher is awful, exams are awful, and even worse the TA is confused. Don't bother taking if you don't wanna spend 2+ hours on 8 questions of homework. She is the worst, my advisor has told me they have received multiple complaints about her.  She should not be teaching
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof. can be difficult to understand at times (accent), but overall does a good job teaching the material. The other reviews are failing to recognize that we are the ones in a 30 level math class for one reason or another, so you can't take the "too hard" claims to seriously.

This class and teacher is awful. She should not be teaching, has a wide variety of complaints against her. Class averages for tests are low and make up such a large portion of your grade. Half the material on the slides isn't even on the tests or homework. Don't take this class or teacher.

Prof. Bonafini is an amazing professor who wants you to learn what she teaches. You are graded on 17 homework assignments, 2 midterms, and one final throughout the semester, however, you can two attempts on everything, and it's all take-home work. As long as you pay attention to the notes, which are posted online, you will pass the class.

I would not recommend this class. I'm not good at math to begin with, and this just further confused me, and hurt my GPA. She's a super nice professor, but the tests/quizzes are much harder than what you go over in class. There's little to no extra credit work. All of the slides and practice problems are on her canvas. Still do not recommend.

Although I failed it was definitely not bc of her im just really bad at math. She was really understanding I even had a death in the family during the final exam period and she extended my due date. she was super sweet. definitely not the best teacher and i learned more from the TAs videos but I still thought she was cute
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!!!!! If you are great at math it does not matter, terrible course Penn State should really review this class. Most bizarre, unhelpful, confusing class. They say you can apply it to real world problems but that is so untrue since all equations are dumbed down which makes them virtually made up and un useful in real life.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE UNLESS NEEDED. was told me this was easy it is NOT. isn't necessarily a bad prof, but the class itself is hard. It is my lowest grade and i took it as a gen ed. Each homework took about an hour and was not like the lecture at all. You get 2 attempts, but the questions switch each time so you have to spend time redoing what u did right.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: As a BBH major I thought math of money could be useful. I was wrong. There are 17 homework's, but she does drop 2 scores. 2 midterms worth 20% each, and a final worth 35%. 75% for tests seems harsh. Two attempts on homework and exams helped, but homework took at least 3 hrs to answer 8 questions. Take an easier math if you can, this is not easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you take this class online there will be many ads on the lecture videos posted on YouTube. The professor herself is very kind and helpful in office hours but gets easily frustrated if you are not understanding. If math isn't your thing, I highly recommend this course. This might be the easiest math class at Penn State content wise.

I'm a communications student who struggles with math and this class was advertised to me as one I would succeed in. That was wrong. This class is way more difficult than it has to be. Not a fan of her or her TAs.

I thought it was going to be easy but it was not even though I did well. If it was not for my dads help I probably would have got a C. Teacher is not to helpful but is extremely flexible with dates and stuff. 60% of your grade is 2 midterms and a final. She is not a great teacher but you really just have to learn the material to do well.

I did not enjoy this class at all. I took it thinking it would be an easy way to finish my math credits, and I also thought I would learn some useful skills. Instead, I struggled with every homework/quiz/exam. I only passed because it was online and I had help from a friend. Not sure how it is in person. Would not recommend this class.

Professor Bonafini clearly understands what it takes to make a practical gen-ed an enriching experience. Absorbing the concepts discussed in class took precedence over memorization, coming away with learning the course materials was far more important than getting a great grade. Professor sets up class to pass, despite some challenges towards end.
I had a really hard time with this class. The lectures and slides were very overwhelming and sometimes hard to read. If you miss any classes, your grade will tank majorly.

Heard this was the easiest math course. Ended up having a really difficult time, and surprised I even got a B. There's barely any points and tests are graded heavily, so if you even miss a point, your grade can drop by a few percentage points. Lectures were all on YouTube, and although they were long, I still feel like they didn't help me learn.

This class was rough. This class requires genuine learning although it is online. Theres a homework assignment worth every single week that are worth a decent amount of your grade. the final exam is also 40% of your grade so if you don't do well on that your grade is screwed. Don't take this class unless you actually need it because it is difficult

As someone who is not interested in Math, this was the class to take. Bonafini is extremely leniant, giving two attempts on all homework, midterms, and final. Tophat participation every class, but she gave credit regardless if the answer was right. No extra credit offered but you don't really need it if you actually try.

I took this as a GQ gen ed. Honestly it wasnt bad. Three asynch lectures per week. Two attempts on every homework and exams. (1-2 HW per week and an "exit ticket" per video just to make sure u watched it ) DONT fall behind on lectures. Try to solve every example in the lectures on your own. Beware that 95 and above is an A. I still would recommend.

avoid this class by ALL COSTS. 2-3 homeworks per week when each one takes HOURS to complete. lectures are extremely difficult to follow. will get entire problems completely wrong for the smallest mistakes. 

took this class as a math gen ed & it's probably one of the worst classes ive ever taken in college. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS

Homework heavy (seventeen assignments), material unclear (gaps in explanations, parentheses in equation examples were not shown at all or in the incorrect places), questions on midterms / final were worded to deliberately confuse students. Online video lectures were more than a year old. Not engaged with class except to remind us of office hours.

lectures posted on youtube = wanting to smash your head through a wall. They monotone and go at a snails pace when you reach out she will simply copy and paste pieces from the syllabus and send it back She will have no empathy for any external circumstances. Final exam is super hard  on both attempts. TAKE THIS CLASS WITH a DIFFERET PROFESSOR!!!!

She's a good enough professor, my problems stem from the homework mainly always being in some way or shape different than what we were lectured about, the margin of errors being obnoxious, and the grading in general. She does her best and she manages to make you care, which is about all you can really ask for.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Chill professor who knows the subject well. You get two attempts on each HW and exam, which is helpful. Paying attention and taking notes will help you do well on exams and HW.

Dr. Bonafini is a really good instructor and really cares about her students. Makes class very interesting and a good place to be. I should say that the two changes to take homework assignments and exams really makes the difference.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Two attempts on all HW and tests is really helpful along with them being online and take home. She does tons of problems in class and have tutors that help as well. If you do the homework assignments, you will do well on the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I took this class because I heard it was an easy filler for a math credit. This was NOT an easy filler by any means. The course, while at it core is easy math, is incredibly difficult. It involves a lot of technicalities and procedure that is not explained well in lectures. Also, I hope you can understand thick accents if you take her. I couldn't.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: If you are looking for an easy, math fill in class- DO NOT take this! Although the content is not necessarily hard (if you watch the lectures), the homework and exams are extremely time consuming. In addition, it is very discouraging after spending hours on the homework to get very low scores. Unless you want to put in A LOT OF work- dont take
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This class is not nearly as bad as the ratings make it. Every single question is a word problem and equations that are given and learned need to be applied. 2 attempts on all HW and tests is really helpful along with them being online. Lots problems are gone over in class, however test and homeworks are sometimes trickier than lecture questions.

I really loved Professor Bonafini. You won't do well if you don't apply yourself to the course, but if you try and seek help when needed, you will do fine. She is really good at checking whether or not students understand. There is lots of homework, too, with multiple attempts, so you know if you understand. I'm really bad at math and got 100s.

Professor Bonafini isn't the best at always explaining problems in class, but a lot of the time the problems in the homework are easy to figure out based on the lecture material and you're given two chances so you can fix your mistakes. The midterms are also online and you have two chances, super easy!! I recommend :)
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The class was pretty easy as long as you followed along in class. There were two midterms and final, which were all open note, untimed, and two attempts are given. The homework assignments are only 8 questions and also give you two attempts with the lowest two grades dropped. I would highly recommend this class.

DO NOT take a class with her. This professor does not teach the material well. She doesn't accept technical issues as a valid excuse despite this being an online course. She has a very strong accent which makes her hard to understand. She is new to teaching undergrad so she may get better over time. She also reads off the slides and the slides are paragraphs long. The exams are online and not too bad. Make sure to do the Projects and Extra Credit.

This class was a joy to take online. The criteria of what was needed was stated clearly and allowed for me to work stress free. There is a couple papers that are a few pages long, along with 4 exams. The exams were online and you had 40 minutes to answer 30 something questions. She was very accommodating and Id recommend taking this course online.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Lectures are very boring, not on her account but all BA342 classes are. There's 3 projects that are longer but easy to get an A. Exams are online but you only have 40 linked to answer 35 of them.

Literally one of the best professors ever. He loves pharmacology and lights up when talking about the content. Material is not hard to understand if you have a semi-decent background in biology and signaling mechanisms. He's AWESOMEEEEE

I had him for neurological basis of behaviors and was pretty intimidated by the course initially, but he is really supportive if you reach out with questions and makes himself super available to student's schedules for office hours which helps a lot! I ended up doing way better than I thought I would and really enjoyed the experience.

I think that pharmacology is already hard and he doesn't do a good job of explaining complicated concepts. He brushes over a lot of material with the assumption that students have been taught it previously.

You can tell he loves pharmacology with every fiber of his being. He is excited and enthusiastic for every single lecture. He's also extremely open about his own experiences and non-judgmental when others ask questions. I'm shocked by how much I'm telling people about what I learned in this class. This is THE PROFESSOR to take this course with!

Professor Fry is amazing. He has a very dry sense of humor, which I appreciate. Definitely need to attend class for ICQ points. I missed a lit assignment hence the B. However, his lectures are very entertaining and he answers questions very well. Overall I really enjoyed his class, and the material was also interesting.Neuroscience is his field fs!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class seemed really hard at the beginning of the semester, but I kept showing up and attended office hours which helped alot. The way he lectures is really entertaining, he can always connect difficult concepts to things in everyday life which makes it easier to understand. Overall, I feel like he really cares about his students understanding.

This was probably my favorite class I've taken. Professor Fry's lectures about drugs were incredible. He's extremely nonjudgemental about the subject and will let you ask literally anything you can think of. Exams were difficult but this is pharma so I expected that. Study the slides carefully and fill out the study guides and you'll do fine.

Needed this class but was hesitant because I'd heard how hard it was. Thankfully, Dr. Fry gives lots of opportunities for points outside of exams and offers some extra credit. He is an excellent speaker which made it fun for me, and he was also very accomodating with scheduling office hours appointments whenever I needed help. Highly recommend.

Dr. Fry is a great teacher if he likes you. He definitely has favorites, and that is usually the people who speak during class. The exams a pretty hard, however, if you really study the material from the slides, you'll do well. Overall, he's a good teacher, and I would take a class with him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Fry is full of himself and reads off his slides during class. The questions on the 4 exams can be worded strangely. Overall, the online homework is very easy but the lectures are boring.

I love Dr. G so much. He has engaging lectures with slides that arent too wordy, lots of easy homework assignments that help you prepare for exams, and lets you drop an exam. He removes any unfair or confusing problems from the test if he sees them. Very funny guy and loved his lectures and British accent. Take his MICRB203 lab too if you can!

I took this class over the summer through the LEAP program. The professors are great. The class is entertaining and extremely easy. The "textbooks" are just two books that you'll read throughout the semester, but they're very manageable. Quizzes once a week are very easy and cover mostly lecture material. Definitely recommend taking this course.

This course is one of my favorite classes I've taken here. It's partnered with his wife, and the class pairs very interesting science concepts with literature pieces. Both of the Dr. Gs made the class very entertaining and interactive, and were two of the best professors I've ever had. I would highly recommend this class and both professors.

Dr. G is an amazing professor! His class has a very clear layout and exams aren't weighted too heavily - the lowest one gets dropped which is a plus. He is very willing to answer questions and correct himself when he makes mistakes. You can tell he genuinely cares about his students and what he is teaching, highly recommend!

He seems like a very genuine person. He is extremely understanding and fair when it comes to grading tests and assignments. He looks at things from all perspectives which is really refreshing. He is a great professor!

There were lots of exams for this class and they were difficult, but he makes sure you can get your grade up in other ways like tophats, lecture quizzes with multiple attempts, and open note exams after the closed note one. He makes the content easy to understand in class and is an interesting lecurer!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Super sweet guy. Hard exams, but the curve is INSANE. Generous with giving points back, dropping grades, deadlines, etc. Interesting lectures, super engaging. The most frustrating part was confusing/difficult exams, but even getting a 65-70 will be curved to a decent score.

Dr. G is the sweetest, most caring man you'll ever meet. He wants nothing more than for us to succeed and constantly communicates with us and takes feedback to heart so that we can. The class structure is awesome - 6 quizzes and you get to drop 1 - and he's a FANTASTIC lecturer; he's so engaging and provides tons of real world examples. 10000000/10

Dr. Georgiou is an awesome professor and genuinely a good person. He is extremely approachable and never makes you feel dumb for asking questions. His exams are challenging, but office hours help a lot. He also offers plenty of points and credit, so one bad exam will not ruin your grade. Highly recommend!

The tests are very difficult and application based but there are a lot of other assignments that allow you to keep a good grade if you do not do well on the exams. He engages well with his students and the lectures are interesting! Definitely go to class

I learned a lot from Dr. G's class. He's a brilliant professor and clearly cares about his students. Although the exams were hard, he made it clear that if you were scoring average on them (~75) you should expect to get a B+ to A-

I love Dr. G! He only started last sem, so still learning, but he's an amazing lecturer + you can tell he cares about his students. If you pay attention + take notes you will do great in this class. He recognizes if he makes a mistake on an exam or whatever and corrects it generously and always curves exams. Very accessible and wants to help, 10/10

Constantly made mistakes when teaching that had to later be corrected. When it came to giving exams, there would be typos and multiple correct answers with only one being accepted. Homework assignments were on topics that weren't on exams. No exam prep was offered. Exam averages were often times below 70, or even 60, but were curved to 80%

Dr. Georgiou was thrown into teaching this class less than a month before the start of the semester and was still able to make it one of the best Micro classes I took at PSU. He was always available to help and made sure we fully understood the material. The tests were hard but not fair, and he gave some hefty curves when the class average was low.

I loved Dr. G's class! He is such a great lecturer & you can tell he cares a lot about his students & the subject matter he teaches! If you pay attention, take notes, & keep up with learning the material you will do great in this class. He did a great job breaking down concepts that students could have trouble with. 10/10 would take this again!

I really enjoyed this class and Dr. G's teaching style. Although his exams were very difficult I know he kept making an effort to make them easier to comprehend. He set up the class so everyone could do well in the course. He had A LOT of extra credit which was very helpful.

Dr. G was a super cool guy. The exams were tough, but he gives a lot of extra credit, and the other assignments help to balance your grade out. I think there is too much material on some of the exams, which make them difficult. For his first class, I feel like he was a great professor. He uses top hat for attendance.

He was a very nice guy but this class could have been better. He did give a ton of extra credit and he was always willing to help if someone didn't understand the topics. It was definitely interesting having a new professor teach this class but it wasn't terrible. He made the class a bit easier as the year went on. The exams were a bit difficult.

He was alright. His lectures were very long and boring and he uses tophat to grade attendance. He just reads off the slides and I feel I didn't gain much. He gave plenty of extra credit and his final was open note, but it was difficult to find all the information with so little time. He was very nice and caring which I did appreciate.
Easy class, just make sure you stay on top of things. The only thing I didn't like was the promotion of the use of AI.

Lauren is sweet and wants to help you career wise. Take this class if you are looking for ways to enhance your career enrichment at Penn State. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS FOR AN EASY A. I took this class simply because I needed 1 more credit to graduate but this course gives as much work as a 3 credit class. Way too much work for a 1 credit class.

Lauren is the best!! I would definitely recommend meeting with her outside of the class. I am currently taking her LA 103 class via zoom, and it has been amazing. Take her, and get an easy, caring professor.

LA 103 is a Career development course and Lauren is honestly one of the best instructors I've EVER had at PSU. She is willing to personalize some assignments with you if you talk to her, and she genuinely wants to help you succeed in life. Assignments include making a linkedin, resume/cover letter, going to career fairs, small events & reflections!

The textbook was pricey, but you need it because of the smartbook homework. Always felt I did better than I actually did after exams. What he goes over is barely in the exams, and lectures can be very boring. This class made me rethink my major since it was a boring class. But he is a nice guy.

Nice guy but lectures are extremely boring. 3 exams for this class and a quiz on the last day of classes. Honestly you can put an hour into this class a week and you'll still get an A. One thing of homework a week and usually takes between 30-45 minutes. Easy class just very boring lectures.

He was a great professor and many of his lectures were engaging. Films are watched in class to relate to lessons and homework is often fun. The tests are straight forward and based on the readings. There is no official final but all tests and quizzes are in the testing center.

Fulton is a cool guy overall. I wish he showed more personality within his lectures because they would be 100x more interesting. I do not recommend taking this class super early, as it can be boring at times. A lot of the stuff seen in the textbook and the questions in there are on exams.  Homework is a pain sometimes, can be seen as "busy work".
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Lectures are boring but overall an easy class. Personally I thought he was very nice and respectful. Willing to work with your schedule if u can't turn in assignment or make a exam on time

Dr Fulton has been teaching me for two semester (SOC 1 and SOC 207), and I have been his TA for one semester. He's genuinely a nice guy, the grading rubrics on homework are pretty clear and easy to get a fair grade as long as you follow his pages long instructions (many find it long and tedious, in my case I'm fine with that). Strongly recommend.

The class is easy, and as long as you study (go over the lectures slides!) you're guaranteed above a 90. The homework is graded on completion and theres 2% worth of completion-graded extra credit. It's hard to fail his class bc the written homework is graded very leniently. Go to class in case of an in-class assignment, do the work, you'll be fine.

Lecture-heavy and goes over the same slides each class. No devices allowed so all notes are handwritten. Tests are not bad if you study the notes. Some projects assigned and weekly assignments which are pretty easy and help prepare you for the test and test questions. Lectures are boring.

Do not take Fulton if you have other obligations besides sociology.Dreadfully boring lectures repeat the same topic repeatedly,occasionally showing images on his slides that are inappropriate (borderline nudity) or irrelevant to the lecture overall. Exam material is 50% not from lectures, so each class is BS, with homework/busywork that takes hours

Professor John is a such a great person. His lectures tend to bit boring, but outside of class he is super funny, and actually cares about his students. There is a bit of busy work doing the Connect homework, and like once a week there are in class assignments that you need to be there for. The tests are not the bad, and there are lots of resources

Dr. Fulton is a great guy and is super funny. People who say he is boring are going in with a negative outlook. It's a super easy grading-wise, and he encourages people to go to his office hours. He has an interesting story and is a really good, supportive person. His class made me interested in sociology solely because of his lectures.

Professor Fulton is a really funny, sweet person, but a terrible teacher. We focus on the same 3 topics every lecture, circling back and forth very mundanely. Then assigns 50-60 terms on McGraw Hill, which is tedious and takes a ridiculous amount of time. His homework assignments are easy but tedious as well, being the same question over and over.

I've never encountered a professor who shows such blatant animosity toward students. His disrespectful behavior, dismissing questions and belittling students, creates a hostile learning environment. His unprofessionalism made it impossible to feel supported or respected in class. A terrible experience overall.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: This professor created a toxic classroom environment, belittling students and dismissing questions. His teaching style was disengaged and unprofessional, making it hard to learn. I expected more respect and support from someone in academia, but unfortunately, this professor was a huge disappointment. He does not reflect the standards of Penn State.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: This professor creates a toxic classroom environment, belittling students and dismissing questions. His teaching style was disengaged and unprofessional, making it hard to learn. I expected more respect and support from someone in academia, but unfortunately, this professor was a huge disappointment. He does not reflect the standards of Penn State.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I don't know where Penn State found this professor. I've had to take sociology courses with him (not by choice), and he makes fascinating topics genuinely dreadful. He gets lost in his own descriptions, and every homework assignment is three+ pages long, leaving the class unsure of what he even wants. Avoid him altogether if you can. Horrible guy.

Dr. Fulton is a tech-free classroom, which in my case is fine but caused some complications later on in the semester. He gives a lot of readings and homework, but as long as you do things on time and go to class you should be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Do not take this class unless you want to spend countless hours studying for exams. Don't expect to get higher than a C. Also i suggest going to every class he randomly gives in class assignments and although they seem like such small points they actually mean alot considering his exams are impossible to do good on.

NO ELECTRONICS. You have to do a lot of reading for this class and then an assignment based on the chapter read. There are 9 homework assignments. Go to lecture and take notes on the slides (about 50% of the exams are lecture material). I recommend making a quizlet off of the study guides that he provides. He offers 3% extra credit boost as well.

Not a bad class. The material is straightforward and exams are easy. 3% extra credit given and no actual final. The only annoying thing was random in-class assignments for grades. Also he doesn't allow phones/laptops but doesn't enforce it. Lectures can sometimes be fun, but mostly boring.

Dr. Fulton's class was among the easiest I took this semester, but he's quite boring. His lectures aren't super fun but it's important to go bc there's in class assignments sometimes and he doesn't tell you win. I missed quite a few classes and got As on the exams, so just do the reading/hw and you'll be fine. Take another prof if possible, though.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Took this class as it was required for my major and I can say it is one of the dullest classes I have ever taken. The material in the book is interesting to learn about but attending class had no purpose as the material on the exams is not taught in class at all. He gives random in-class assignments and extra credit.

He's dull but nice. The class is basically only textbook. Don't need to go to lectures but he does do random in class assignments. The exam questions are written to be easy. All are 50 question multiple choice and actually only include the information on the study guides. 2 homework assignments a week graded on completion.

Hardly understand the lectures and makes me a little bit uncomfortable at times. Seems like a nice enough guy but notes have to be taken on paper and just all the reading every week do not compare to the lectures he teaches in class, which makes the tests hard to study for.
He is an interesting guy. Never learned anything in his lectures cause he talks about nonsense, I had to do all my learning through the online textbooks because that covered the material on the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor's lectures can be dry, but the class is manageable if you stay on top of readings and assignments. Unstuck ai was a big help for exam prep.

this semsester i thought let me give soc a try and then i landed myself with professor Fulton all i am going to say is that he is not a great professor the guy explains things very weridly and also doesnt make sense half of the time and also the test are just boring in general so be careful with him
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If I went to class, I would probably have a better grade, but I had a 4-hour chem lab and 2-hour bio lab each week. He would do attendance once a week at random and not tell you what day. The class was honestly boring at times, and he was very monotone. Nice guy though just so boring. Would not have taken if it was not required for my major.

Avoid him at all costs. His lectures are actually so boring and does a random in-class assignment once/twice a week, so you take a gamble every time you miss class. He takes random points off of homework assignments (which is through a required $80 textbook) and then gives no feedback. He also gives 2 of these every week. Exams are unpredictable.

I really enjoyed Professor Fulton, I do have to say you need to attend his class, listen to his lectures a lot of the test is based on things he says in class. Some people may think its slow paced or boring but if your actually interested in learning you'll find what he says helpful and interesting.

Overall, a good introduction to sociology. Go to lecture and try not to skip (even though it is boring sometimes), he uses a lot of in-class lecture material on the tests. Requires a textbook that is $80, which is needed to do the homework. The smartbook assignments and the recharges are tedious but help a lot when studying for exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: class is super easy if you attend. be warned that if you don't, you will miss stuff that appears on exams but not on review material, but not a lot. lectures are mostly rehashing the textbook. smartbook assignments are long but can be brute forced (for completion only, infinite attempts) and a good 2/3 of the class is common sense.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Smartbook is required and costs a whopping $80 (maybe more I don't remember). I almost dropped this class but I'm glad I didn't bc it's an easy A/B. homework felt like busy work, but it's better than what other SOC classes are doing. Be ready to slave away at your computer doing the smartbook assignments, it takes it out of you for real.

Subjects covered in class can be interesting, obviously there is dull points as with any class. The issue with Dr. Fulton is the passive aggressive comments in class relating to his political views. No one with a PhD should be teaching biased views to students. It is wildly unprofessional and immature. Very disappointed with his professionalism.

John is overall a nice dude. His lectures aren't too boring if you find the topics interesting enough. Connect hw assignments are graded by completion which is nice and exams aren't too hard as long as you pay attention. It's important to do well in the beginning bc I found it difficult to get my grade up in the end even though I was doing well.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Definitely one of the easiest courses/professors I have taken at PSU. ~Twice a month he will give an in-class assignment (ends up being 5% of grade). Not particularly challenging but very boring. No phones/computers are allowed in class but he doesn't really seem to enforce it strongly. Just read the textbook before exams (3) and you will be fine.

Easy class, just read and review study points before tests. He did have a weird obsession with Eastern-Asian culture, almost always related everything to Asians. Very creepy. Also dictates the way you take notes, doesn't let you use phone or laptop for note-taking.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The class is relatively easy, as long as you read the textbook and keep up with his weekly homework assignments. He is, however, extremely unhelpful when you seek him for help. Very passive aggressive and you basically walk out with no questions answered. Just a bad experience.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This class is really easy but he makes the lectures extremely boring. There are online assignments for each chapter and then weekly homework. There are 10-12 in class assignments so you at least have to be there for that, didn't learn much in lectures. The exams are really easy if you read the textbook and study.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: He was extremely rude to students, provided little to no help when students reached out, and didn't answer majority of questions asked in class. His exams are very hard and not similar to the material in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The scariest professor ever, he takes all of the class time to explain the concepts of the exams but that explains nothing..
