One of the most sincere and caring professors I have ever had. The topics are made interesting. He utilizes effective teaching techniques to ensure students truly understand the topic. Gives helpful quiz reviews, and there is only one exam (the final).

This year with online lectures, the quality was only ok. He does spend too much of class answering repetitive questions, when he could cover more content. Otherwise, assignments are broadly spread out nicely. Read over your notes (sometimes the textbook too) and do practice exams.

Most genuine guy you'll ever talk to, but that's the issue. He is too nice and spends the entire lecture answering 1000 questions that people put in zoom chat and not actually teaching. Lecture is 75 minutes long and you go over 6 slides max. It could be cut to 30 minutes and the same information would be gained.

One of the best, a legend. He clearly presents concepts in a simple and in the most meaningful manner. Open to changes and seeks student's comfort. Understanding every step of the way is crucial for succeeding in the course. Questions are instantly answered during class. Has many surveys and quiz reflections to assure students understand everything

As a professor he is very stubborn when it comes to quizzes. Quizzes are the majority of your grade and there are only 7 the entire semester. The average of my quizzes is around 55%. Even in difficult circumstances, he will not allow you to reschedule a quiz. I had a circumstance that should have allowed for a reschedule, but he did not let me.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Really nice guy and definitely cares about his students!! His class was pretty easy for me but I definitely could've done better if I did more reading and studying outside of class. Also, lectures got a little boring because he went way too slow sometimes but I would definitely recommend him!!!!
He often gave back credit on tests when people did bad and he's a chill and nice guy, not hard if you take notes.

Bill Goffe is a nice teacher but he makes you do so many useless things like "muddy points, and cornell notes". It is very annoying. His quizzes are very difficult so make sure you go to GSG. Every quiz, there will most likely be at least one question he will regrade because people will say it was confusing/hard to understand.

This guy drives me crazy. Only take this class if you have a lot of patience. He talks a lot but isn't really saying much. The class is quiz-heavy, and all of the quiz questions are subjective and tricky. The class itself is way too complicated because he makes up stupid work called "JiTTs, Muddy Points," etc IN ADDITION to other real homework.

Absolutely hated Econ before this class. Goffe's lectures are easy to listen to, he's incredibly kind and considerate towards his students, and the work is fair. Quizzes can be difficult if you don't study (obviously). But this class was amazing all thanks to Prof Goffe!

One of the best professors i've had so far! He's super caring and the class is very manageable as long as you pay attention and take good notes. There's 7 quizzes and no tests which made it a lot less stressful. Definitely my favorite class this semester. Also, go to the GSG as much as you can, it's helps a lot!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: He sure is an absolute gem! He is very kind and is concerned for his students well-being. Lectures are very informative and do take good notes. The guided study group sessions are very helpful as-well. He even arranged quizzes at different time for the convenience of his international students. He is extremely helpful in both class and office hours

Test are not hard you can have 90/100 very easily but the last 10 points are only because of missunderstanding the use of e glish language (i am a french student ) For americans this is probably the best prof for econ ! So cool
Professor Goffe is great. He always explains everything clearly and if you listen to his class carefully, it's not difficult to get good gredes. He is definitly the best teacher I have ever met.
He's a great guy and seems like he actually cares about all of his students and wants them to do well. The material is easy but it's not a gimmie class.

Great person but econ is like a foreign language to me, and he kind of added to the confusion. While he is very patient and smart, I felt his lectures were confusing. He'd write all over a slide with scribbled handwriting and symbols that I'd have no idea what they meant. Manageable class-no tests. Quizzes and hw every week. Very nice man.

Class was completely online due to COVID despite this his lectures felt engaging and interesting like I was actually in person. Quizzes instead of exams which really helped me learn the material. JiTTs actually made me enjoy reading the textbook which is almost never the case for me. Also loved seeing Prof. Goffe's cats every lecture.

Literally one of the best profs I had this semester. He's a very compassionate man and he's very understanding as well. He tries his hardest to make sure that his students understand the material. He has practice quizzes where the reasoning for every wrong answer is explained. If you have the chance, take him. You won't regret it.

He's a good guy who loves his cats. He explains very clearly and has patience to answer questions in class. There are homeworks, quizzes and a final exam. He cares about his students and always try very hard to make our learning experience better through reflections and feedbacks. Take good notes, ask questions, come to class  good grades!

Dr. Goffe is fantastic. Even though the classes have 300 people in them he still cares about every one of his students. Graded on quizzes every other week, homework, and the final. Quizzes can be tricky at times and each question is worth a lot but Dr. Goffe provides lots of study tools. Just make sure to take good notes during lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Professor Goffe genuinely cares about his students and wants everyone to do well/understand the material. This class was online but in-class participation polls counted for our grade, these honestly helped me learn the material. There are many smaller quizzes final. I liked the quizzes because it was less to cram and I understood everything.

Literally the nicest man on the planet. His lectures are never boring and he's always super clear on what to expect on tests. As long as you go to class, take notes, participate, and read the assigned articles you'll do well in the class.
Really good guy and professor! Explains things really well, if you pay attention and study you'll do well. Goffe is 100% the way to go for Econ 104!

He has about 7 quizzes in the whole semester with a final exam. Couple of JiTTs and Cornell notes/muddiest points/polling participation required for extra tokens. He explains very well and you have to pay attention in the class so as to do the best on quizzes.

I love this professor, he is one of my favorites! I won't say his class is an easy A, but not too difficult either. He cares about his students and wants you to succeed. Will tell you stories and has no problem answering any questions. He also drops one of everything too because he knows that things can happen and we all have bad days. Take him!!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Perfect explanations, fair grading, and overall, just great.

Dr. Goffe is such a good soul. He truly cares about how much his students are learning, and does all he can to help students succeed. He provides a lot of resources to prepare for quizzes. If you put in the effort, it shouldn't be too difficult to get an A. I don't like Econ, but he made up for it.

Goffe is one of the best professors I have ever had. He truly cares about his students. He offers a lot of extra credit. As long as you go to class, take notes, and study the learning objectives he gives you for each quiz, you will get an A. The material is totally relevant to real life, and he alters his grading throughout the semester to be fair.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Bill is a good guy and the class isnt the most difficult. You should make a point to take good notes and pay attention, but even if you dont all the time, so long as youre good about getting your work done and can glean some key information from his boring lectures youll be okay. he does drone on sometimes, he just wants you to get it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Caring

reviews.comment: Goffe is the best professor I have had at Penn State, his lectures are easy to understand, if you pay attention you shouldn't have any trouble. Copy all the sample questions (clicker q's) he does in class, those come in very handy when studying for the quizzes. There is no midterms, just biweekly quizzes, 5 HW's and extra credit. 100% recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Goffe is the professor who would hold the final review secession by himself. There are 7 quizzes and you can drop one. Some questions are tricky and he would give all students full credits if you can convince him. His lectures are filled with iclicker questions but You only need click in 80% for full credits, no matter right or wrong.

Dr. Goffe is an amazing professor. Personally, I think 104 is harder than 102 content wise, but Goffe still does an amazing job at explaining it. Hes very accessible during office hours and after class, and is always very nice and helpful. He even adds a bit of humor to his lectures, which makes his class even better. Would definitely recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Mr. Goffe is the nicest professor here at Penn State. His lectures get a little boring at times but overall a very good Econ teacher. No exams only 7 quizzes throughout the semester which is quite nice.
Very nice guy. He lists all the material you need for revision

Mr. Goffe (as he prefers to be called) makes the class easy and informative. There are no midterms, only 7 short quizzes and a final. The final is very similar to the quizzes, so you'll do well. Goffe knows his stuff yet he's still humble. Attendence is worth points (clickers and Flip'd) but you can miss 20% of classes without losing points.

I think everyone is a little harsh about Professor Hedglin. He's super caring and understanding, and you can tell he knows what he's talking about. The class itself is very hard, but I don't think this is his fault. I think a lot of people compare him to Garner, who everybody loves, but Hedglin is also very good.

I really do like Dr. Hedglin! Chem 112B is difficult, but I think his resources are helpful like office hours and practice exams. He is a really nice guy and I think he has a low rating because of the course itself.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Hedglin has good lectures and is good at explaining topics. Sometimes as the year goes on it seems like he is going to fast, but I think this is not his fault. The class is very fast paced and will be hard with any professor. I recommend taking him.

I am pretty good at chem overall. I got an A in 110, but I found this course near impossible. It could be the course itself, but homeworks took multiple hours, weekly quizzes were much harder than in 110, averages for exams were in the 50s but at the end was only curved by 2 overall points. Lectures moved so fast even with an Ipad i couldnt keep up
He is a great professor if you learn with examples. the second exam was the hardest, and sometimes he goes too fast. the homework was helpful though and there were several extra credit opportunities.

Yes, I know I failed this class, but Dr. Hedglin isn't to blame. This class is very hard and after getting a B on the first exam, it just went downhill. The final was incredibly hard and the homework was difficult too. His lectures were helpful at times, but I did find myself lost on multiple assignments even after attending class all week.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Mark may initially come off as boring, but you will find he is a truly caring professor who enjoys teaching and wants you to do well. The first half of the course is easy, but the second half is literally impossible. He will fly bye on the lecture problems, so prepare to put in extra time to reteach stuff. Do practice exams and go to help sessions.

Overall not too bad of a Chem112 prof. Lectures are a little dry and sometimes he skips explanations. Very understanding guy. Chem112 is set up on a huge curve and there are so many resources. Pay attention in class and go to the extra credit LA sessions and you'll be good, although exams take a lot of studying!

Hedglin is great not sure what all the haters are on about. Clear lectures that are easy to follow, though a little dry at times. Chem department has so many resources that it is easy to succeed with some work. Homework is managable, just gotta spread it over a few days.
Straight A student but couldnt find a way to pass his class.  Terrible teacher

Mark seems to get a bad rep, but that is most likely from lazy students who don't know where to access the many resources he provides. It really does not take that much searching to find answers to any questions you might have. There are many different resources for extra studying. If you are struggling, it is easy to get help. Just don't be lazy:)
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: A lot of the other reviews were a bit harsh. Lectures are more example-based to review concepts covered in the book and clarify any book examples. There are lots of TopHat questions during lecture that count for participation, so pay attention to the questions in lecture slides. Overall, seems he really wants all students to succeed/understand.

The lecture is a waste of time because he just repeats things that are explicitly written in the textbook. The lecture is also constantly interrupted because nobody understands what he is saying and the more he explains the less it tends to make sense. He is obviously here just to use Penn States' research money and is not interested in teaching.
Good lectures and explanations for problems, lecture attendance and reading is important.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I had Professor Hedglin this past spring and he was an outstanding professor. The lectures were very clear and I loved that each lecture had plenty of practice problems that were similar in style to the exams. The TPEs that were given prior to exams were very helpful and similar to the exam style and were worth extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: This is a warning to all students taking chem 112. DO NOT take this class with this professor! His exams are IMPOSSIBLE to pass and the course work is insane. I had 43 LP, 42 PLA, 14 HW, and very few extra credit assignments just for 12% of your grade. As said previously, his exams are impossibly hard and yet worth 60% of your grade. Save yourself!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He is terrible and you will regret taking him. The tests he gives are ridiculously hard. I beg new students reconsider taking his class. Thank me later. Worst teacher Ive ever had
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Chem 112 is a hard course, but he gives you ample time to prepare. You get 4 practice tests before each exam to practice, and the questions on the exam are similar to what is covered in class. Professor Hedglin goes over everything in a clear, concise manner and makes chem 112 very doable!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Chem 112 is obviously a rigorous course and requires a lot of dedication and attention, but the assignments are often equivalent to what is tested. Dr. Hedglin does a great job reviewing difficult concepts in a clear way, and he goes in-depth on detailed problems. He moves fast sometimes but is simply trying to provide all info needed to learn.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He is the WORST professor at PSU. Just drop out his class it will make your life a lot less stressful. His lectures are very long and boring and he just reads the slides. Absolutely the worst teacher ever. No one likes him for a reason. Save yourself before it is too late.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This class is so hard and we're expected to know how to do things that are mentioned for 2 seconds in lectures. There is 0 regard for the mental health of students as we have an exam the day after Easter with review sessions on Easter day. There's so much homework and they purposefully make the exams so difficult.
DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR I HAVE NEVER BEEN MORE STRESSED IN MY LIFE
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Great professor who gives great lectures. Chem 112 is very math-based, especially with equilibrium problems being constant throughout the semester, so most of the lectures are sample problems. The homework assignments are absurdly long especially compared to Chem 110 here at PSU. Be ready for a lot of HW but if you work hard an A is achievable.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Hedglin does an excellent job in walking you through the process of solving the chemistry problems in lecture, but the class is generally rather difficult. He also responds to questions during class, so don't be afraid to speak up and ask if you don't understand something.

Lectures did nothing to help, I nearly had to learn all the material by myself and I still couldn't pass. I talked with him and he said that I didn't get the concepts, yet the pre-lecture quizzes he had us do state otherwise. He read off of the slides and did not elaborate on anything else any further.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The content itself was not all that complicated, but the delivery and presentation of it was very poor. During class he would read directly off of the slides, not really elaborating on anything and there was a lot of long homeworks that really didnt help at all. There was almost no similarity between practice exams, HW, and the actual exam
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The homework is difficult and pretty long, and its not super helpful. Theres a lot of quizzes, which are open for 24 hours and theyre always on Friday. Hes not very approachable, and if you do reach out, hes usually condescending in his responses. He just doesnt seem like he cares about his students that much. Just take a different professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Lectures are mandatory, yet helpful - definitely go to them. The man simply doesn't care about his students, though. Very condescending in emails sent to students, and gives mediocre, rude responses when asked Qs. Homework every week is 23 Qs with about 5-7 parts each (it takes about 5 to 6 hours), and doesn't count for much. STAY AWAY!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He doesn't even care. Dry, unenthusiastic, he's condescending. Assignments due every lecture, homework (50+ problems) due every week, quizzes given often (all this worth a measly 18% of your grade). Tests are select all that apply or "which is false" (meaning 5 True/False questions) and are too hard for 100 level course. He's out to get you. Avoid.
It doesn't seem like he cares. Exams are way too hard, and not at all like the practice problems. Overall would never take his class again.

Yes, this is a lecture class with exams and long homework, so is every chem course. Dr. Hedglin is a great teacher, he is helpful in office hours and willing to go through problems you are having trouble with. He plays music before class, and always starts lecture with a "This day in Chemistry." If you work hard and ask for help, you will be fine!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Just submitted my HW, 11 pages of work and explanations, no questions. The best part? 5 points for completion and 5 points from one problem he randomly grades. I could miss 1 of the 55 total questions asked (22 "official" questions but they have multiple parts) and get a 5/10. Hours of work for only 6% of my grade. The Ebook HW is much more helpful

Just frustrating. Class: power point lectures with clicker points, boring but fine. HW: creates his own instead of using the ebooks. LONG over 20 questions with multiple parts. Canvas quizzes: open for 24 hours on random days of the week. PLA due before every lecture. One week assignments are easy the next week impossible. Lack of flow to the class

Homework is ridiculously long, and test is much harder than homework and problems in lecture. Has a very confusing grading breakdown that makes it difficult to know your standing in class. Reads off slides verbatim and goes very quickly in lecture. Too many topics are crammed into one exam, which has only 25 questions so it's very easy to fail.
Does not explain content very well
Do not even think about taking the class with this professor.

The class is not taught in a way that connects lecture with the recitations and labs. Prof Pfau's lectures scratch the surface at the things we're expected to know on online HW and exam material. Make sure to watch Prof Coutu's video lectures to stay caught up.

Let me tell you something. A hamster spinning in a wheel could teach better. Not only is she the worst professor in PSU but she is easily the worst professor I ever had. The course is graded by only 3 exam it cover 63% of the total grade and no amount of study will prepare you for the test. Stay far far away.

Let me tell yall something. A hamster spinning in a wheel could teach better. Not only is she a worst professor ever in PSU but she is EASILY the worst professor i ever had. The class is graded by only 3 exam. And no amount of study will prepare you for the test. Stay far far away.

Please don't take this class if you have Pfau. A lot of the learning is done through the lectures, but she is the worst teacher I've ever seen. Has no clue how to teach, talks quietly, reads off board, doesn't expand or thoroughly explain topics and overall, it's impossible to learn anything. This class felt more self-taught. Don't take this class

Heike Pfau is a professor that teaches as if you know the material already. Lectures in this class are genuinely worthless. Attendance is done via tophat and the material you learn from lecture is miniscule compared to what you need to know. Most learning is done in the recitation and lab. Also she has a monotone and boring teaching style. COUTU>>>
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr Pfau is a new prof and it was her first semester teaching, regardles lectures consisted of her reading the slides off verbatum and then shining a laser on a math equation. Watch the prelecture videos by Coutu and read the textbook if you need. The practice exams are helpful if you can understand the concepts. This course is poorly structured.

Kind person, but not a great lecturer. Maybe consider other professors if you struggle with math; she moves through practice problems very fast. Perhaps this is a criticism of the course structure more than her, but I felt the lectures did little to prepare me for the exam.

Very boring, not a good professor. She just reads off the slides and does a few demos. Take Coutu  if you can. She doesn't control the grades, an administrator does. Lots of homework, but chegg / homeworkify is helpful for that. Test heavy, so do the practice tests and go to the review sessions. Exams are multiple choice, and are usually curved.
Horrible instructor and horrible class. Read from slides, barely covered content, hard to understand. Lion Tutors was the only way to be successful.

Pretty rough lectures, but should hopefully improve with time as this was her first semester teaching. Lectures didn't help with learning/tests at all, and practice exams were 100 times harder than the actual midterms/final. Didn't go to class at all after the first few weeks because I had AP Physics 1 in high school so I aced everything. AWFUL TAs

Not awful. If you can take Coutu instead, do it, but if you're stuck with Pfau, no big deal. Her lectures are REALLY boring, but the class is just something you gotta get through. Do the homework, go to the exam review sessions, and you'll do just fine. Strangely, Pfau's review sessions saved my LIFE for every single exam despite her poor lectures.

Very difficult to learn physics with this professor, hard to understand and the presentations during lectures usually have a bunch of information scattered all over the place, making it hard to see the steps and reasoning behind doing something.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Information given in class does not provide close to enough what is necessary to pass the class. Therefore, homework is very difficult. Professor reads off slides and does not do thorough explaining. Exam averages were never passing. Have never failed an exam until this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: If you have no prior experience you will fail with this teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Isaac was goated when I took him last semester. Exams are tough, you have to study more than you'd initially think. I only got a B because I didn't study enough for second exam. Lectures are easy to follow, and his practice problems in class are helpful.
Best math prof. out there. Super kind, caring, and an incredible teacher. You will have a great time in his class, just make sure to go to lectures as that is where you learn everything.

When I was a freshman at Penn State, I had gotten a 25% on my first quiz for math 140. Isaac was a great professor and was able to guide me to resources and made me feel confident in being able to reach out and stick with civil engineering as my major. He gives great lectures and makes the content easier to understand.

Professor Sunseri is the goat. Best math teacher I've ever had. Math 141 is a tough course but you won't even realize it. He perfectly explains the material in simple ways and does guided practice problems during lectures. He also uploads lecture notes to Canvas EVERY DAY as well as making concise exam review notes for every exam. Simply goated.
This guy is a great teacher
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Isaac is so goated it's unbelievable. He really only cares about your success, he just wants the best for everyone. Lectures are easy to understand and the practice problems are really helpful. Exams can be a little tough, but the class itself is really chill.

Professor Sunseri is the best math professor at this school. He is so caring and genuinely wants all of his students to get As. His quizzes are extremely fair compared to the other 141 professors and if you talk to him, you can get so many points back on the exams. His lectures and practice problems are so helpful.

I wish he taught more classes I want to take them so bad he is such a good professor please I beg do not take anyone but him for math 141. Isaac is the most kind professor I've met and he is extremely organized and caring. LOVE this guy.

Prof. Isaac Sunseri, I can't say enough good things about this professor. I will take him again in ANY class he teaches. He was phenomenal. He is kind and understanding he also color codes the notes so it is very easy to follow if you miss class or need review. Quizzes are literally similar in class questions and test are bit more difficult. Study!

There's a reason I call this man Goatseri. Explains all the theory with exceptional clarity and provides the neatest notes I've ever seen. Very kind person, he won't bat an eye if you ask a stupid question.

I received a 95+ on all midterms and I genuinely believe it is because of the way he organizes his lectures. You do practice problems in class, and he makes sure to walk around and help everyone. The class isn't rushed, and we usually had 2-3 days of review before each midterm. If you are picking a professor, pick him!!

The best professor for 141, pay attention to his lectures and ask questions if you understand. Go to class for the practice questions and you'll be straight...
LET SUNSERI SHOW YOU THE WAY!

I am not great at math, but he was very clear and concise when lecturing. A genuinely nice person who really does care about his students' successes. If you see him as an option when searching for classes, choose his section you will thank yourself.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: TAKE HIM, literally the best prof ever, notes were very helpful literally just take him trust me

By far favorite teacher I've had. Super organized in lectures and well paced. He posts all his notes which are super clean and nice to study from. Always understanding of situations for extensions and happy to answer questions.

I was nervous taking calc 2 for the first time, but Isaac is the best professor I have had yet. He teaches lectures very well and clearly, and is organized and sooooo easy to understand. He also has very neat handwriting! I have absolutely nothing bad to say about him, take him if you can.
Teaches the material extremely well. He is always there to help!
he's a great professor! he breaks down concepts very well and explains them pretty thoroughly. and, he really does want to help you. i haven't struggled to understand anything this entire semester.

Sunseri was great. Really cared about his students and lectures.  Material is hard, but he explains it well. Only reason I got a C+ was lack of effort. Very attainable B if you just study for each exam and quiz.

Extremely well-organized lectures. He puts in a lot of effort to make the lectures flow really well. He also posts his notes which are super detailed and neat. Does a lot of practice problems during lectures as well which helps a lot for quizzes and exams. He's also super helpful if you have any questions and is really good at explaining concepts.
Course was difficult, but Isaac Sunseri showed me the way.

Isaac's lectures are very well-structured, he has the best teaching style in the math department.  He provides lots of examples and will thoroughly explain to anyone who needs extra help, as long as you ask. I would highly recommend Isaac to anyone looking to take Math 140 or 141. He is the type of teacher who wants his students to succeed.

Isaac is a great professor. His lectures are very well-structured, he provides lots of examples, and is very caring. The homework is basically the same as MATH140, as are the exams. I would highly recommend Isaac to anyone looking to take MATH141.

This guy is the best professor I've ever had. He has amazing lectures and only moves on when everyone clearly understands the material. He literally does everything you could ever ask for in a professor. If you don't take him you are making a mistake.

isaac is great, has very clear and concise notes and explains them very well. he will not continue until everyone understands the material. there is a decent bit of homwork, but it is the same across every MATH141 professor. he helped me significantly improve my grade from MATH140, and i would very much recommend him.

Issac is the best professor I could imagine in Math 140 & 141. He is super nice, wants everyone to do good, and genuinely tries his best for the students. He does a pretty good job teaching material, and I would recommend him for anybody.

I had Isaac Sunseri for Math140 and I am taking him for MATH 141 currently, his lectures are amazing, and he is great at explaining concepts. He will always be a great resource to reach out to, and he will always be there if you have any questions regarding anything. If you need a more thorough explanation of something, he will know what to do!
Incredible professor all around! Super informative lectures with not to hard quizzes every week. Clearly defined material for exams and super easy to reach for help and feedback.

Isaac gave great notes and was a good teacher for his first semester. He's understanding of extensions on homework (sickness & occasional late) & making up quizzes. However, he didn't 100% know what would be on exams since he's new and the quizzes are really hard which I sometimes didn't feel fully prepared for. But, that should improve with time.

His first semester at Penn State. Not a very hard class, I was fortunate to take AP Calculus and understood most of the concepts, most...Has a quiz every Monday based on the previous week's homework. Accessible outside of class through office hours or simply emailing him. Homeworks can either be long and difficult or short and fairly simple.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: He does not teach at all, no point of going to class Honestly it is not hard to get a good grade in the class. Just read the textbook chapters and quizlet the terms and you will get an A/B+. if you want a good professor don't take him, if you want a class you can study for the night before and get an A in the class then yes.

One of my favorite professors at Penn state. His classes are not too hard and has a good balance of work. He puts class examples on the exams a lot so showing up and listening is important. His classes are a bit dry but if you go to OH and get to know him he's actually a fun dude to be around. Reading and lectures are not that heavy.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I love Prof Shrira. Super chill dude, very upfront about what is due/on exams. He always warns when he assigns big papers and tells you when you should be starting, so if you listen to him you'll be fine. Big papers, but he will help you work through them if you go to OH. He's a tough grader, but him and the TAs will tell you what he's looking for.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I've had Prof Shrira for a few of my classes now. His teaching style is easy to follow n his exams don't require too much studying if you show up to class. He's very monotone though and class is very boring. He doesn't have much of a sense of humor. He also sometimes seems annoyed with his own slideshows like he doesn't want to be there. Weird guy
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I don't think he cares about student success. He tried to make a 20 page paper due the same week as finals but was told that against Penn State's rules. He "teaches" about 5% of the material in class and you're expecting to basically memorize the textbook. He often uses strange examples for the subject he's trying to teach, goes on tangents a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: He is knowledgeable, but his slides don't translate well to the exams, which are drawn mostly from the textbook rather than the lectures. His explanations are often unclear, and his feedback tends to be blunt rather than encouraging. I wouldn't take him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He means well and will help you in office hours with your papers. I HIGHLY recommend going to class even though it's not mandatory. Extra credit is your best friend. Textbook info is the bulk of his exams. If you read the textbook and follow the directions of the papers, you'll be fine.

I've taken him for both 221 and 423, he's been great both times. If you show up to class and read the textbook (not even that much reading tbh) you're gonna get an A it's seriously not hard. He's very nice and gives some extra credit from attendance.

Super easy if you read the textbook and go to class. attendance not mandatory but extra credit is offered a lot when you go. class recorded via zoom and on canvas. tests are 100% of grade but he drops the lowest non-final. people say his lectures are boring but i really enjoy them. he has dry humor and funny stories. love this class and prof shrira

Definitely need to read the textbook because there will be stuff on the exam not mentioned in class. Also, go to class and take good notes - the slides are posted on canvas, but he only puts a few words on most slides, so it won't make sense unless you hear the lecture. Overall, not hard if you put in effort and he is a nice guy

I've seen mixed reviews, so here's how to study: 1) Read textbook chapters twice. 2) Go to class and take good, detailed notes. 3) Take notes on the textbook (doesn't need to be a lot) 4) Quizlet of textbook vocab. 5) Use AI to make practice multiple choice and application examples for vocab. 6) Make practice questions on class and textbook notes.

Ilan is very passionate about what he does but his lectures are really boring. Sometimes, they're really interesting. The exams are from in class but some of the textbook will be incorporated (even case studies you brush off). The course itself is interesting but the exams are the ones that WILL tank your grade if you don't "get it"

Should not be teaching an online class.  Limited slides and no lectures.  Expects you teach yourself the textbook and then understand it the same exact way that he does.  Not room to be wrong. Rude when giving feedback.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Rude and very condescending. Unclear expectations and then belittling if you ask for clarity. No lectures just some slides with notes.  Very heavy on the book but you must interpret everything EXACTLY the same as him.  I would avoid any class taught by this professor in the future.

Anyone saying this class is hard never went to class. I aced every exam because the exam is 90% based on class lectures and 10% textbook. No one goes to class due to no attendance, so of course people complain about the test. His lectures are not fast-paced; he goes over terms 100 times in different ways so you can understand. Fav professor @PSU.

I am a person that studies for exams. this class is stupidly set up. you have to read the text book (WHICH I DO) and the exams are just difficult for no reason. He expects you to do 75% of the learning on your own, goes over the concepts AS LITTLE as he can and the rest is up to the textbook. i'm not happy with this class and the way he teaches.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I personally did not like this professor. He went very fast through the power points and it was hard to follow along. You must read the textbook to do well on exams, so if you don't like to sit down and read this class is not for you. I am passing with a C by the skin of my teeth.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: One of favorite psych professors here. All you have to do is read the textbook and go over notes in class and you're good, always get an A on exam while only studying night before. His lectures are interesting but I can understand how some might not take to him at first. He is awesome at explaining the concepts and gives a lot of extra credit! TAKE
Awesome Professor. I can't thank him enough, he is the reason I graduated. Pushes you to your best ability, yet does what he can to make sure you succeed.

His class was boring and hard to follow. The tests are textbook-heavy, if you don't understand the concepts you won't do well on the exams because there all application-based. He gives about 20 points in extra credit which was amazing. All papers and labs are graded by the TAs, which can make or break you.

Lot of extra credit which is awesome and he seems very knowledgeable on the topics. This being said I still felt a disconnect between what he was teaching and what we were being tested on. The TA was not very helpful and they played a huge role in all the paper grading so this felt frustrating. Can not avoid class though so make the best of it.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Never take a class with this professor. Lectures are boring and he has no enthusiasm when talking. He makes conversations about sensitive topics more uncomfortable than they should be. Exams and writing assignments are the only two things that factor into the final grade. Some questions on the exams have nothing to do with course material.

Professor Shrira is THE MAN. Very interesting content and he made the lectures fun. Class isn't mandatory, but I would recommend going because he gives out extra credit a lot. Exams are short and easy if you have taken notes in class and done the readings. You have to actually put in the work to get a good grade but I got over 100% in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: We had online quizzes about the textbook chapters and exams. The readings are long but interesting. Extra credit was sometimes given in class. Ilan provides great examples and demonstrations in lecture and is very personable and helpful in office hours. He has been one of the kindest professors I've had. I would definitely recommend his course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Took Professor Shrira's PSYCH221 on World Campus for the summer and it absorbed all of my time. Each week I spent my evenings reading the assigned textbook and completing endless assignments. His writing prompts were never straightforward, and he would provide passive-aggressive feedback. He comes across as egotistical.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Leaves unnecessarily rude comments in your grades. He's not satisfied with anything. He give 4 extra assignments on top of a two part exam every couple of weeks. I pride myself in working hard but this is too much even for me. I've heard it's very rare to get over a B in his class.
Exams were somewhat difficult but good feedback was given. Very nice guy. 10/10
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I really liked his class. He gives so so much extra credit (so far 20+ points of EC this semester). To do well on exams you do have to attend lectures or watch the recordings and read the textbook, but if you do that then the exams are easy. Papers and labs are graded by TAs, so how those go are based on your TA.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This was my second course with Ilan Shrira taken in an accelerated summer format. Lots of writing each week in this format. I like his teaching style. I felt that he really read my writing and provided thorough feedback. He is not the type of professor to give an A for a half-heartedly completed assignment. I like and respect this.

Gaining a good understanding of a professor's personality online is often difficult. After two courses with him, I still don't feel confident in remarking about that. However, my communication with him through Canvas was very positive. He was highly responsive and caring. He is also direct and clear with his expectations.

His lectures are super boring, but he offers extra credit almost every class. Exams are super hard and not just definitions. He doesn't do anything other than lecture and is really rude and standoffish. The TA's make or break the class and are basically the professors since Ilan is unreliable and condescending.

If your read the book, attend lectures and pay attention to the examples given in class you will do good on the tests. The tests are application-based so you have to understand the info presented. Tests are hard and really make you think. Go to class and do in-class assignments and you get extra credit, these really help your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He gives overload of work. Exams are designed to make you fail. He truly makes you hate the class

Biggest advice: Shrira's lecture's are often vague and very boring. Exams are difficult if you rely only on lecture slides, so read the textbook. Come to class since he gives out extra credit once a week. Your TA will really make or break this class. Don't bother reaching out to him for regrading or towards finals week- often harsh and blunt.

I'm in the midst of taking PSYCH 221 via World Campus, but wanted to make a note that I did not find about Professor Shrira. I understand that classes are not meant to be "easy" but he definitely overloads you with work, especially on the weeks where you have exams. Professors typically give you the week to get the exam done, but not this one.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: if you just fully read the textbook, figure out when the tests and quizzes are and have the recorded lecture's transcripts pulled up... you're fine. The lectures can be interesting but also not really necessary to doing well. He's a super great guy but this class (especially remote) can just be self taught and aced.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He tells a lot of stories and examples to help you understand the materials. I really enjoyed the class.

It was nice to come to a real class, and this one was very cool. He lays things out to make things engaging and it really got to me, even though Im not a major. Tests and quizzes were not easy, but follow the lectures and really study the textbook and its manageable.

lectures are boring but if you take notes and read the chapters you will do fine on the exams. lectures are not mandatory but he gives many in-class assignments that are due the next day for 2 points extra credit. The TA for the lab of this class makes or breaks your grade. 5 papers throughout the course - TA grades those though. lab is mandatory!

Ilan is an amazing professor! His lectures are actually interesting and I very much enjoyed class. His test are all multiple choice and super easy if you study. He does focus A LOT on the textbook, so prepare to use it, but if you do, the tests are a breeze. He offers in-class extra credit assignments frequently. Take him if you can!

Ilan honestly ended up being one of my favorite professors. In the beginning, he seemed kind of dry and boring, but the lectures are interesting and he surprised me with his sense of humor and care for the students. The info in the class is useful but there are quite a few outside readings that are mandatory for exams. exams were pretty easy too :)

Really bad class. Honestly don't understand why everyone else seems to think he's great. Doesn't know his stuff and is genuinely not good at proof writing. Came into this class hating algebra and left this class hating math. Definitely take him if you want to spend time hearing funny stories instead of learning.

This course is tough, but its important that you practice intently and ask questions often. Dr. Handzy is very funny and makes lecture enjoyable. He emphasizes the points you need to remember, so pay attention. The course calendar is not set in stone and homework deadlines often changes, as well as exam dates, but overall it was a great course.

Prof. Handzy is a great teacher. He often goes on long rants on topics unrelated to the class, which I normally don't like, but he manages to do so in a way that does not set back the class overall. He is also the designer of the course, so he gives the structure of many of the exams to you. Make sure you go to lecture; he doesn't post notes.

I had him for MATH-311W. Great professor and amazing lectures. Really breaks content down in an easy way. Dr. Handzy hates grading so it may take a long time for assignments to be graded and can go on a lot of tangents in class (which are super funny) however overall he's an amazing professor and I can see why he's so loved.

one of the best math professors ive had, his teaching style is easy to understand, definitely go to the lectures as he doesn't post notes if you miss class, he's absolutely hilarious and does go on fun tangents, if you're going to take this course, you have to take it with Dr. Handzy!

This guy is quite the character. He's the course coordinator so he knows his stuff. If you're taking this difficult class, take it with him. Don't skip class, he doesn't post notes, and takes awhile to post anything. He often goes on random tangents in the middle of class. Do the practice tests and lots of problems, it's the best way to prepare.

Prof Handzy was a good teacher, he just got on tangents a lot and went off topic a few times; some of the things he said I found problematic. A big problem I had with him was he often posted the homework late, sometimes even after the homework was supposed to be due. He was also absent a lot and we had to watch videos that were also often late.

Absolute nutjob loose cannon of a teacher in the best way possible. All his lectures were super entertaining. He'd go on long tangents about random stuff, or complain he wasn't getting paid enough. Was an amazing teacher as well, broke down difficult concepts in a really easy way. Probably in my top three favorite professors I've had at Penn State.

Vegas Matt on social media meets schizo but boy is this professor the goat. HW was online and just had to submit the work, easy quizzes once a week, and gave plenty of information about exams before we had them. He also posted old exams, which were very similar to the real ones. Does easily get off track, but you can skip if you can get the notes.

Dr. Handzy somehow made differential equations somewhat enjoyable. The quizzes once a week were pretty much impossible, given 5 minutes for two questions. The homework took up about 3 nights of work, which really cut into my other classes. The exams were hard, but nothing I wouldn't expect. He made his class tolerable, and I definitely recommend.

he was not a bad professor by all means. i did not receive the credit for the class; that was mostly my fault. my issues were that he gave 5 min for quizzes & that he was constantly distracted during lectures, but he's a good person. go to lectures, he doesn't post notes; does everything w/ chalk. know people in this class if you're going to skip

The only reason I can't give him a 5 is because administratively, this guy is a mess! It took him until 1 week before the final to fix my grade on homework 3 (there were 11 homeworks). Grading always takes a really long time, but I can forgive him because he is such an incredible instructor. He makes lectures so approachable and easy to understand.

He is the course coordinator, so he makes the exams (meaning he drops hints and bases the exams off of the homework that he gives out). He also just makes the lecture super entertaining. If you can do the homework, then you can do the exams.

He is the course coordinator and very smart, he knows what he's talking about. But also very disorganized. He never responds to emails, makes grading errors that you have to hunt him down for and overall communication about a makeup can take a month (I am not joking). But when you do manage to get him in one spot, he knows what he's doing.

Professor Handzy is a unique character - entertaining lectures, clear explanations, and a true passion for the subject. The material is challenging, but using Unstuck ai alongside the free textbook makes it manageable. Definitely worth taking this class.

He can be a difficult professor because he explains the derivations of everything in detail and most of it you don't need to know. Just know all the formulas and be able to use them. Homework is quick and easy. He is a little bit unorganized and always late to class but ultimately it's a light-hearted and calm environment to learn high level math.

Dr Hanzdy is the course coordinator so he decides what is on exams and other profs typically match his pace. he loves to talk, don't worry though he's super enteretaining. He doesn't show up to office hours sometimes, but is understanding about questions and genuinely wants students to learn. He's great take with him if you can.
Professors can actually be comedians

Really great guy that's super talented at teaching students difficult concepts. A little odd and definitely sometimes yapped too long, but kept the classes interesting and funny. Made it super easy to take detailed notes during class, and provided good examples. JUST DON'T skip lecture! Really understood the class content compared to other courses.
He is a person who is good at talking and activating the atmosphere. but the office hours are also very short. All in all, you can learn something from him.
took over my class last month of the semester and did more to help me learn than the previous professor the entire semester. good lecturer and a funny guy.

He was a good professor and explained things clearly, is funny and told good stories. He is also the course coordinator meaning he writes the exams. The only flaws were that his office hours were online and he sometimes let students choose the numbers for examples which could lead to complicated results.

The best professor at Penn State by far. Super funny, easy to understand, and overall just a great person simplifying a difficult subject. Lectures weren't mandatory, but missing one would cost you, so DO NOT MISS THEM. This man is the reason I was excited for my 9 AM 4 times a week, so lectures don't feel like a chore. TAKE MATH 251 WITH HIM.

Professor Handzy was a great professor to have for this course. Class is graded on homework, quizzes (lowest two were dropped), and two exams/final. Exam questions are sometimes a little confusing in the wording, but he prepared us very well with just the lectures and homework he assigned. Would recommend highly to anyone.
he puts a lot of effort into lectures and has a great sense of humor. class is tough but he does a good job at teaching it

Brings life to an online course. You can usually attend his lectures live or he posts them the day after. Many times these online professors will recycle content and be more of a moderator, and will even do a poor job at that. Not Professor Handzy, he's very hands-on and cares about the quality of the content. Highly recommend you take his course!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Handzy is overall a good professor who makes a difficult topic easy to understand. However, he is horrible at responding to emails and is not easily accessible outside of class. The exams are reasonable and are not graded too toughly. He is a funny guy but he's very unorganized. He also makes many mistakes during lectures which can get confusing.

This man NEVER answers emails or requests. It took him 4 weeks to look at a homework, i was misgraded on. I never get an email reply within 3 days. The exams are HARD and UNREASONABLE. I've never finished an exam even while using all my resources. Do not recommend this professor for an "easy" online class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: If you have to take MATH 251 at this university, this professor will teach you how to do it in an enjoyable, yet extremely informative fashion. Highly recommend this professor. I took his course online with recorded lectures. Definitely do ALL of the homework if you want to perform. Exams and quizzes are fair and reasonable.

I would die for this man. one of the coolest, funniest, and most caring STEM profs i've ever had in my entire life. he makes the class super enjoyable and actually teaches really well. the exams, quizzes and hws are super reasonable, and you really just need to understand the hw really well to get good grades in exams. i cannot recommend enough
I had to watch all of Handzy's lectures to study for the 251 final because my teacher was awful. I watched all of his videos, they were hilarious and informative, and I aced the final because of him.

Handzy is one of the funniest and best profs I had at psu. He makes all the difficult math fun to learn and is actually hilarious. Liontutors for this class will get you high grade in exams. Quizzes or somewhat hard but are not worth much of the grade.

The best professor I've ever had. Makes the class super enjoyable and genuinely cares about his students. One of the few stem profs who are both good teachers and likeable people. Quizzes and exams are super fair. HW exercises are the best way to study for anything. Make sure you do those and you'll be fine.
Literally the best math professor at Penn State. Go to his lectures, they really help. The tests were fair and questions are pulled from HW and quizzes. Awesome guy who really cares about students.
Professor Handzy is literally one of the best professors at Penn State. Hilarious, very smart, and truly cares about his students. Please take his class; you won't regret it!

Quite possibly the worst professor I've ever had. He's a funny person, but an awful educator. Has no time management skills, and had on multiple occasions announced quizzes a single day before they were due. He also picks random days in the middle of weeks for assignments, nothing is consistent. He also hadn't responded to any emails or messages.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Hilarious--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: had him for math 252, he was a really good professor, a hard-ish class but he was a great teacher. would definitely recommend Dr. Handzy, he helped me understand the material and I got a 100 on the final. class isnt bad as long as you go and pay attention because he doesn't post lectures online.

prof was great at teaching and always made sure everyone understands the material. homeworks were easy and graded on completion, and most quizzes were easy MC. the exams always had sample exams that were very similar, so i did well on the exams. he's great and clearly enjoys teaching. honorlock proctoring was pretty annoying though not his decision

Dr. Handzy is definitely the best math professor I have ever had. He made his zoom recordings easy to follow and the HWs are just at the right amount. 251 is not an easy course. The only thing I have to complain is that these exams are on Honorlock.
His attitude is really positive and motivating.

Handzy is one of the most chill profs out there. He provides just enough homework problems to help you succeed without overwhelming you. Exams were a breeze with the provided sample exams. The man has a great sense of human and cares about students. Only downside is that he uses Examity.

Honestly avoid taking this class. He will not respond to you no matter what way you try. Takes weeks, almost months to grade. Very heavy on deriving the lessons rather than showing actual example problems we will do on the test.
He never reply to any emails. No feed back and no curve at all. I don't understand why he has a high rate like this.
Excellent lectures, made material easy to understand

Dr Handzy is a really funny professor, even though all his class is online but he still gives out amazing lectures, so I highly recommend attending the live lectures. Quizzes are not as forgiving as the exam but 2 lowest grade will be dropped. HWs are questions from lectures so is pretty easy to do. Overall one of the best professor in math depart.

Dr. Handzys lectures never failed to be engaging and interesting. I learned so much in his class and his explanations were always clear and easy to follow. He has a good sense of humor too and clearly cares about his students. He was also helpful and willing to answer any questions students had, and made the class something I looked forward to.

He explains concepts really well. Like honestly best professor I have had so far.... He always makes me laugh during class and enlightens the mood of the class even though it was a remote class. BEST PROFESSOR AT PSU

Nestor is definitely one of the better math professors I've had. He definitely cares about what he's doing and makes lectures interesting and funny. However, he took a particularly long time to grade the exams (up to several weeks to a month for each of them), and was a particularly tough grader when doing so.

Dr. Handzy's one of the best professors I have had in my college career so far. He is absolutely hilarious and has engaging lectures. The examples he uses are very thorough and are very useful when referencing them while doing homework. The exams weren't bad especially since the sample exams have the exact types of problems that'll be on the exams.
Definitely my favorite professor here. Amazing lectures, funny guy, fair exams/quizzes/homework. He listens to his students and is always there to help. I will definitely miss his lectures.

Literally the best prof at PSU. Online, in person, whatever. Take any class Dr. Handzy offers. Actually teaches you tough material and makes it easy to understand. Works so hard to make sure all of his students are understanding the material.
Dr. Handzy is one of the best professors I've had at PSU. Take Math 250/251 with him, and I guarantee you that won't regret it.

Nestor is the best professor I've had in PSU. He explains the material very well, he cares so much about every single one of his students, and he is hilarious. He always finds time for a little joke or a fun conversation, and manages to efficiently finish the content. I definitely recommend him for any math course he teaches (he teaches a variety).

If you get the chance, take Nestor for Math 250/251. He makes the material easy to understand, will answer any and all questions you have, and makes the class enjoyable to attend (even if it is online only). I hope soon he will teach classes in person so I can visit him!

Hanzy is a funny guy. He's one of those lucky teachers that is naturally good at teaching but really doesn't put much effort into the course. He's very difficult to reach outside of class honestly but when you do get a hold of him, he is pretty helpful. I'll take his class again bc he's naturally a good teacher, but he definitely isn't Mr. Prepared

Dr. Handzy runs the most efficient and greatest lectures at PSU. He explains the material so succinctly and clearly that he spends the rest of class time either answering student questions or ranting about a variety of topics- the weather, downtown state college, restaurants, the lottery, why God won't let him win the lottery and his son. 10/10.

Nestor is the GOAT. Coming from a student who had to drop Math250 the semester prior with a different prof, he is the best. One of the funniest and most genuine people I have ever met. Brilliant man with immense knowledge about math as well as the world in general. Never thought I'd miss being in a class, until this one ended. #Nestor2020

Dr. Handzy might just be the best professor at Penn State. Like many other professors, he is brilliantly smart, but he sets himself apart by caring for his students and explaining material in the clearest way possible.

If you see this, he is a go-to professor. However, I miss his dad jokes on Monday 8 am. What do you expect calculus math course other than hardworking on ur own and just pretend you understand everything in class?? Seriously , grow up!! He explains well and totally a very nice guy!!

Hes a great guy. Explains things very well. 250 was absolutely awful though. I found it incredibly hard to grasp the concepts. Definitely not at the fault of Dr. Handzy tho. If you have to take 250 tho, Id def recommend him!!

Dr. Handzy is one of the best professors I've ever had. He understands that students are seeing difficult material for the first time, and makes those concepts easy to understand. He really cares about his students' success and is super helpful in class and during office hours.

Great professor!!! Dr. Handzy is hilarious and probably the best professor I'v had at Penn State. I dread going to most of my math classes but not this one. I'm always excited to get to his class. 10/10 would recommend.

He is probably my favorite professor thus far at Penn State. He somehow makes differential equations fun and simple. I dont understand it. I have struggles in many other easier math courses but I have to attribute my success to Dr. Handzys teaching. He is so genius in making a hard subject so simple.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Diff Eq's was really hard for me to pick up, but I don't think I would have even passed had Dr. Handzy not been teaching the class. You can ask him literally anything and he'll have the answer for you, maybe with a joke! Exams are tough, but if you put the effort in to understand what you're doing, you'll come out on the other side of this class.

Dr Handzy exceed all of my expectations this semester. His explanations of concepts and problems were very clear and his lectures were awesome. The homeworks, quizzes, and sample exams are all you need to do well in the class. Highly recommend!

The reviews don't lie, Handzy is the man. I went to class knowing he would make me laugh once or twice, made lectures very fun. Super smart guy. Office hours are usually packed. HW and quizzes aren't bad, two midterms that are fair but stressful (9 questions for 20% of grade). No online component, so quizzes and HW are only announced in class.

Handzy is by far one of the funniest professors I have ever had. He does a great job during class teaching the material and making the kids laugh. I would take his class 10 times if I could. At the end of the day exams are not too difficult. He goes over everything that is needed to get an A. It is just up to student to apply knowledge and try

Dr. Handzy is the best math professor I have had at Penn State. His lectures are extremely helpful and he answers questions very well. Although class isn't mandatory, I would highly recommend going because his lectures are so clear you don't have to read the textbook. Sample exams are nearly identical to the actual exams, so make sure to do them.

Handzy is a funny guy who can explain tough content with ease. Takes top ten grades for homework and quizzes (usually 12 or 13 quizzes). If I could have him teach all of my math classes, I would. Sometimes his tangents go on a bit long, but he is so funny that I didn't mind. Would fully recommend to anyone taking 250.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great at teaching; you don't have to be a genius to follow his lectures. He makes differential equations easy to understand. Very funny and relatable. Outside of class, he is also very approachable. Clear grading criteria, fair grading, easy grading structure (lots of dropped quizzes)
Best math professor at PSU, he's amazing at simplifying difficult topics and making sure everyone learns the material. Lectures are always entertaining and very helpful.

Dr. Handzy is one of the, if not the best professor that PSU has to offer. He has that special ability to make a class entertaining while also teaching the material in an accessible way. He cares about his students and knows just the right place to put jokes and fun stories. He made me genuinely excited to go to a 9 AM class. You won't regret him.

Prof Handzy is one of my favorite professors. He explains things so well that I have been confused rarely this semester which is rare for a math class. He is also good at relating what you are learning to other classes to make the concept easier for you. His quizzes were hard in the beginning but got easier as the semester went along.

He does get off topic a lot during class but he is an amazing teacher. The quizzes are not always the easiest but they do reflect the difficulty of the exams. The textbook was really only used for homework and class isnt mandatory unless it is a quiz day then you might want to show up.
REALLY good

Honestly the best teacher I've had at PSU. Explains applications of what we learn, and explains everything super well. Always provides examples and never falls behind on material. Quizzes are helpful and so is homework. Funny dude and super interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Probably one of the best math teachers at PSU, makes up for every other professor who is not up to his standard

This man is the absolute best choice for Math21. Dr. Handzy made everything incredibly clear and he was always willing to go more in depth it that meant that the students understood it more. He has an amazing sense of humor, and he always made the class seem way shorter than it was. Grade A man.

Overall very good at his job in terms of teaching the material. If you attend class and do HW, the grades should come. However I can't give him a 5 based off the reason he doesn't put grades in until the end of the semester. He does hand back quizzes and HW grades in class, however nothing is uploaded into canvas.

Professor Handzy is easily my favorite teacher at Penn State. He is a great guy and always keeps class entertaining. If you pay attention, you will do well, and he clearly wants everyone to do well because he gives so many opportunities. He only grades your highest 10 HW and Quizes.
cool

Nestor Handzy is the best professor I've ever had. He explains complicated topics so well that they almost seem obvious. He also cares if people are paying attention and will use his funny jokes to keep everyone focused. I genuinely was excited to go to his classes every week, and without him, I probably wouldn't have done well in the class.
Best professor I've had yet. His lectures are extremely useful, do the homework and understand it, and the quizzes will be easy. Tests are difficult but he helps a lot with review.
Handzy is an amazing professor. He gives great lectures and examples in class. The exams will be a step up from the quizzes and homework, but if you come to class and pay attention you will do great!
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Amazing lectures--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Nestor is so good at teaching that he'll recognize that everyone is bored, tell a joke to regain everyone's attention, and then continue teaching. This man knows his math and cares if you do well or at least try. If you get to know him better outside the classroom, you'll see why he is my absolute favorite professor in college and always will be.

Handzy is one of the best math professors out there. Hes got a very dry sense of humor but after a while it starts to grow on you. His explanations are incredible and definitely help you learn and understand the material better. Only downside to this man is that he doesnt enter grades throughout the semester. Only at the very end

Dr. Handzy was very clear during all lectures, making the class easy to follow if you went to class. His positive and hilarious personality makes the class more enjoyable than any math class I have ever taken. As long as you go to class, a good grade should be achievable.

This is the only Math class I've ever really enjoyed in my life, not because i'm getting perfect grades, but because Dr. Handzy is seriously one of, if not the best professors you'll ever get in college. His lectures are very clear and well explained and he's also one of the most funny guys you'll ever meet.

A lot of professors can learn from Handzy's teaching style. Honestly one of the best professors or teachers I have ever had. He made class fun and something I looked forward to. Take a class with him and you will not regret it.

This man is the best professor I've ever had. His teaching style is really natural; he explains concepts well, has a really good pace, and knows when to take breaks. Grading is super straight forward, and he knows when to be lenient. He's great at answering questions, and on top of that, he has a lovably cheesy sense of humor.
Greatest teacher at Penn State. Loves his students and wants them to succeed in life. Jokes are kinda lame at first but you learn to love them. He's just all around a great person. 10/10.

Handzy is the funniest professor I have ever had. Three quizzes, drops the lowest one. Online homework, so much time to do it. He is super flexible with his student, he let me take my final early because I had a family emergency. Handzy is seriously awesome and you're missing out fi you don't take him!!!!

Dr. Handzy has a knack for communicating well, and is really able to explain difficult subjects. He loves puns...a little too much... and laughs at his own jokes, however, I always found myself looking forward to his class. Dr. Handzy is a genuine guy that will help you succeed, as long as you take the initiative to approach him.

Dr. Handzy is a phenomenal professor - he's hilarious so his lectures are easy to pay attention to.  He teaches everything thoroughly and without fluff, and he's the best resource you have taking the class-his explanations are far better than anything in the textbook or online.  Come to the lectures, and you'll soak in enough information to do well
Handzy is the man. He makes bad jokes but they are always funny lol. Just take his class because you will not find a better teacher at Penn State!
One of the greatest professor in penn state! Awesome and clear lecture.

Prof Handzy (Chief) is such a hilarious guy and really has fun with his lectures. He is so helpful in office hours and doesn't really care what section you attend. Homeworks & quizzes are once a week and not hard if you pay attention. He preps you VERY well for exams. I'd take another class with him in a heartbeat.
Handzy is hands down the best professor I've had at Penn State and probably the best I ever will have.

Nestor is a legend. The first math professor where I went to class and actually felt like it prepared me. He is a brilliant man, and he knows how to share his knowledge with his students. Has a funny personality and wants his students to succeed. I worked with him on and honors option and it was amazing. The greatest professor I have had in PSUmath

As a non-math major, I strongly recommend taking Professor Handzy. He listens to his students and is very flexible. He drops the lowest quiz grade and homework, and puts up practice quizzes/exams that are almost identical to the real thing. Online homeworks can be long but he gives you so much time to do it. Take this class!
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Chief is awesome.  He keeps your attention in class and he makes you understand what is being taught to you.  He gives clear explanations and notes.  If you can't make it to a class, he lets you sit in on others and take your quiz at a different time, either office hours or another class.  This guy is hilarious.  Just put in the effort for an A
Dr. Handzy's lectures are extremely clear and effective. Attending the lectures and doing the homework (and hint, hint practice exams) are more than enough to excel in his class.

Dr. Handzy is definitely one of the best math professors at Penn State.  With his energy and metaphors to describe every topic, he really tries to make it as easy as possible to learn the material in the class.  Occasionally you'll get a lame joke, but its all part of the fun.  If you have the chance, definitely take this professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Handzy is the best!!! I wouldn't recommend skipping class because some of the material is hard to teach yourself. He says he sometimes gives surprise quizzes, but we only had ONE. If you do the homework and pay attention in class, you will do fine. He's super quirky but a really nice guy and prepares you well for the exams. DEFINITELY recommend.
ive never given a review before but handzy deserves it! one of the best if not the best math prof out there. he talks about the most random things sometimes and treats his students as his friends.
Professor Handzy was a phenomenal math teacher. He explains things very clearly, and he wants you to ask questions. He has a great sense of humor that keeps class from getting boring.

Take math 250 with him instead of anyone else. He doesn't make it easier, but he is just a really good teacher. Overall if you like math you will like his classes. He will work with you so you get the grade you want/deserve.

Best teacher I've had so far. He cracks the best jokes and he knows how to teach the material. If you go to every class you will get an A or B. The hw and quizzes are easy and he tells you what's exactly on the quiz. Best Class.

Handzy is the man! without any doubt one of the best professors I ever had. The material can get tricky sometimes but he explains everything to detail and he always has office hours to help with any questions. His jokes suck completely and he even knows that but he makes the class interesting. Definitely recommend!
Teaches to the test. Easy A. Absolutely recommended.
Dr. Hadzy is the best teacher I've ever had. Taking math 250? He is your only option for survival. Other student's who didn't have him as their teacher were constantly attending his lectors.

If you're taking math 250; you want Handzy. Gives a great lecture and you'll learn everything you need to pass the exams with ease. Makes absolutely awful jokes  and then just laughs to himself because of how bad they are. He is always in a rush and looking to sell something or make a bet which sums to a great guy that can teach math. Classic Nesty

Best Math professor at UP. His explanations are ridiculously clear. I didnt have to look up a single video on youtube. Just go to class everyday and pay attention, do the HW yourself, a B+  is guaranteed. Honestly, there is no reason you should take 250 with any other professor since he teaches four sections each semester.

Hilarious person, and extremely nice. Probably the most helpful professor I've had. His explanations are absolutely top-notch, and in office hours he is great at explaining any lingering questions you might have.
