There was over 5% of extra credit available, so make sure you attend every lecture.
very hard course, cant understand. there're some extra credits but no curve even half of the class fails.

The sweetest professor and provides very detailed and understandable notes. Homeworks are average difficulty but good practice for the exams. Midterms were easy, final was a bit more challenging so study the last few chapters well. 100% would take again!
good teacher

Dr. Kim is an incredible instructor and clearly cares about her students and wants them to do well. The material is difficult, but if you do the homework and go to class you should get a good grade. She is also very generous with partial credit on the exams. Definitely the best STAT 414 instructor.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She use packet notes, but it's either you write her notes down, or you only focus on what she's talking about, at least I can't do both at the same time. But you still have to spend a lot of time study!. TA grades the HW, but TA is a tough grader. She Grades the exams and DOESN'T TAKE OFF MUCH POINTS for exams! A LOT OF EXTRA CREDITS!

Her lectures are fill-in the blank note packets which are great. She's generous with partial credit on exams and gives a lot of extra credit as well. Since the average was low on the 2nd midterm, she added 3 bonus points and let us make corrections to get our lost points back. This was by far one of the hardest courses I took yet one of the best
Take her!!! you will not regret!!

One of the hardest class yet one of the best professor I've ever had so far! It's a bit intimidating at the beginning given the pace she taught in class, but she tries her best to make sure everyone understand the content. Take her!

This class is really difficult for the content and pace, but it's a course which challenges you and you gain a lot from those challenges. Dr Kim is such a kind and elegant lady, and she does her best to answer all your questions. God bless her!

Take her if you can!! She made the material really hard but that is for you to learn as much as possible. She gave tons of extra credit to boost your grade, and she also cares a lot about students and hope them to succeed. Best professor I've ever had at Penn State!

Definitely the hardest course I have taken so far. I advise anyone to avoid taking this class with her at all costs. The content given is too much to handle, it's hard to understand the points of some concepts, and the TA is a super tough grader for the homework. Attending this course with another professor is strongly recommended.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Prof Kim explains the materials very clearly. The class itself is not easy so be prepared to work, the workload is worth it to do and she has reasons to put such deadlines (to make sure we prepare for the class). Take her if possible in any courses she teaches because she is such a gem!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She is the best math professor I've ever had!! Extremely caring to students, patient when answering our questions. TAKE HER!

This course is an intro to R. It's supposed to be a 2 credit course but most of us felt that we were actually taking a 4 credit course. You'll have homework like chapter exercises and weekly activities. Both of them will normally take you 1-2 hours to read and finish. Also, you'll have a quiz each week. Midterm(30+ short answers in 50 minutes, )
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Super strict with phones no matter the case. Not a lenient professor.

Uses lots of personal anecdotes in her lectures. She also brought in several speakers, which made going to class fun and interesting. This was the only 9 am I've ever been motivated to wake up and go to simply because I loved the class and the content. Go to class and take notes and you will get 100s on every paper and quiz. super easy grader.

Loved this course! Dr. Ishler is organized, enthusiastic, and truly wants you to succeed—not just in class but in all aspects of college.  She gives great real life examples of how theory can be applied in counseling settings.  And she gets to know students and supports them in their sports, clubs and activities.

HDFS 216 is a great new class all about relationships! Dr. C made it super engaging with fun activities, honest discussions, and interesting content. She took the time to get to know each of us, which made the class feel personal and welcoming. I learned a lot and loved going to class!  I can't wait to take more of her classes in HDFS.

Dr. Ishler is one of the best profs at PSU—this was my 4th class with her! Her lectures are practical, funny, and full of real-life examples. Go to class and quizzes are easy. She lets you submit your final paper early for feedback and a resubmit. This semester had disruptions, but she handled it with care. Highly recommend her!

She may know her stuff and the subject matter was interesting but I am still thinking about how awful she was to a disabled student in the class. She was very rude to them and sent them to the back of the class in front of everyone which was really upsetting to watch. I wish I had complained to the ADA office or said something. It was terrible.
She is very rude and talked way to fast on all of the lectures
Does not seem to care about what the students write in there papers but just wants to give it back without any proper feedback
This class was easy but she was super rude and her TAs were never helpful and the email responses sounded like a rude tone.
Does not care about students

Very rude and unprofessional to students. I had her for 4 semesters straight and had to fight to the end every single time to pass her class she never liked me and always put me in a bad position to fail every semester.

The class was easy and interesting but I couldn't get over how she was nice to the able-bodied students but completely rude to the disabled student in our class. Not exactly the person I would want teaching a THERAPY class. The exams were moderately hard so definitely spend at least an hour studying and go to class and she posts slides with blanks

Honestly, she was nice overall during lectures. When it comes to having patience... she has 0. She will not go back on slides if you ask. Any question you send over email, she will respond in a rude tone. It's when you don't understand something; she is automatically frustrated and difficult to reason with.

Just the worst. Doesn't try to hide when she doesn't like a student and is absolutely unhelpful when someone ask for help. Her attitude made coming to class really uncomfortable. Absolutely do not take this professor.

Dr. Crissman-Ishler is one of the best professors I have had. She is caring and easy to reach outside of class. Most of the grade is based on unit quizzes, there is also a few attendance grades, and one large paper that you can submit up to two times.

she sent a student who had many disabilities and accomodations to the back of the room and told them they were a disruption to the class. She also made a comment on the first day of class about how she knows she talks fast and if we need her to slow down we should tell her. but when students did need her to slow down she said no.

I loved this adoption class! Two easy exams, three papers, and a few in-class activities. So much fun and Prof Ishler is so passionate about the subject that it makes the class so enjoyable! Would 100% recommend this class and its super interesting!
She will not read what you write and does not seem to care. Will not take time to grade but likes to rush everything.
Rude and yells at students

She is such an amazing professor. She gives you so many opportunities to get a good grade. Sometimes she will have "pop" participation quizzes, its only two questions and shell usually post them on canvas before class so you know to go. I would recommend going to class, they are actually enjoyable and if you listen you don't have to study for exams

This has been my favorite class at PSU. Prof Ishler is tied to this material and loves sharing her story through her lectures. She is open, has clear expectations for assignments, and just wants the class to be fun. If you have the opportunity, definitely take this class and learn about Adoption!

HDFS Special Topics - Adoption. 
Dr. C is by far my favorite instructor from Penn so far. Her lectures are easy to understand, and the speaker series presentations gives real-life perspectives on the triad members. There are two main papers and weekly discussion posts. I loved this class!

This is my second class with Dr. C Ishler because I love her that much. She is one of my favorite professors I've had at Penn State. Her class on adoption is so interesting and really easy to follow and learn from. She is SO caring and understanding. The workload is easily manageable and the tests are also pretty easy in my opinion.

Trash professor. This class was the worst HDFS class I have EVER taken and this made me realize I had to switch my minor. I loved HDFS but she absolutely killed that love with this class. Were in the middle of a pandemic and she has no care or regard for how her students ACTUALLY are. She acts like she cares but she doesn't and she's snobby. AVOID!

There are mandatory labs each week, and you get 5 points off each time you are absent so GO TO LAB. Since we are in the middle of a pandemic, her lectures were recorded and sent out each week. You need to watch these because the exam material is on the lectures and lab. Weekly homework which are easy and like 3 exams. This is def an easy A
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Ishler is THE BEST professor I've had. Both at Penn and the college I transferred from. She truly cares about her students and wants to help them succeed. She is always available to answer questions but her standards are clear so you likely won't need to ask many. She gives helpful feedback on all assignments. You wont regret taking her!

Dr. Ishler was one of the best professors at Penn State. I enjoyed this class so much I took her again the following semester. She has so much knowledge and comes to class each day ready to teach. I learned so much in this course and it has prepared me for grad school In so many ways. GO TO CLASS AND LAB!!!! Do the work and put your phone away

This is one of the best classes I have taken at Penn State. It is a special topics class that deals with the topic of adoption. She is one of the best professors I have ever had. Work is manageable and interesting. She is very easy to reach and very understanding. I certainly recommend this class.

Have lecture and lab. Lecture was okay but very strict with no technology and would have TA's walk around the class during lecture. Quizzes and exams were pretty easy just study notes. Labs were run by grad TA's and would practice counseling interaction with other classmates. Sometimes it wasn't very structured at all. Lab homework is super easy.

Her class isn't bad but her exams could be on little details that aren't really important. The video analyses were annoying and graded tough on them at times which could hurt your grade. Must show up for class for random attendance papers and when the video analyses are being showed in class. One theory paper and about 5 quizzes. no exams.

Avoid this professor at all costs if you value your mental health. She has an insane rule where if you're more than 5 minutes late to an exam or to hand in a paper you get a zero because coming in late is a "disruption." Also very unreliable to communicate with through email. You have to send follow up emails to get a response if you get one at all

She is very organized and knows what she is talking about. She is very strict but that makes the class well structured. Her exams are based off the slides, so as long as you go to class and pay attention, you will be good to go!

loved this class on adoption. super interesting and really easy class. 2 exams and 3 papers. no final. gives out random participation papers with 2 questions. great professor and she has her own personal experience with adoption which makes the class more interesting. highly recommend

1 paper and 1 powerpoint assignments. posts pwpts online but have missing blanks in them so requires u to go to class to get the full notes. gives out random class participation papers with 2 questions (super easy). sometimes on the readings online or an easy question like what day is it (makes up the questions on the spot). few guest speakers come
Very easy FYS. The class only lasted 7 weeks long and she made every assignment very easy to complete. As long as you follow the syllabus, you should get an A.

The most amazing lady ever!!!! She is such a great teacher. She is clear when giving lectures and is clear as to what is on the exam. Such a great teacher and really cares about her students! Would recommend taking any class with her!

A few weeks in to HDFS 311 and I love this class.  The classroom environment is personable, challenging, and the lessons actually apply theories and concepts.  I can't wait to see where we go in class next.  First experience with this professor and so far, highly recommended.

311 was my favorite HDFS class so far. Dr C really knows what she is talking about and her lectures are interesting in fun. You get in class participation. Test and quizzes are easy if you show up to class and do the few outside of class readings. I would 100% recommend her.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This was by far my favorite class this semester and she is my all-time favorite professor. She is clear with what is expected and almost tells you what will be on the exam in class and if you go to OFFICE HOURS. Easy grader, easy A, makes class fun and involved. Super nice lady, can't wait to take more classes with her.

Great experience in 311.  She was a fantastic professor who I would recommend to anyone in HDFS.  Interested in what she is teaching and has clear examples of concepts.  Don't miss class and study for the exams.
Helpful, and clear with expectations from day 1.
This class lowered my GPA. That's a negative in my book. She's annoying to listen to and her expectations are way to high. She needs to relax a bit more by taking a chill pill.
This was an ok class... she can talk fast at times and there is a lot of information to keep up with, but I think she knows the material well

Although she explained things well, she is not very helpful when in tough situations and comes off almost snobby. Almost as if she is on a pedalstool. Take another professor for this course if at all possible!!!

Took her freshman seminar.  Great class where we talked about diversity, education requirements, and effective teaching.  She is approachable and helpful with any questions.  Good assignments require reflection and thoughts.  Good sense of humor, can laugh with us.  Couldn't imagine a better experience to start with at PSU.  We Are!...

I liked the real life examples of the topics.  Discussed bullying and self esteem and nutrition so it applied to real problems and people.  Overall, a good class that I would recommend.  This semester was tough due to her being out for part of it, but I'll be eager to take her classes again - thoughtful and caring, and at times entertaining.

Dr. Ishler was a very nice animated professor. It is hard to get an A in her class. She does not round up. I was also unfortunate in having a very bad TA, who grades our assignments. It was an interesting class, but it is not worth it if you are looking for a fun elective, or an easy class

Great class, very personalized and informative topics.  Time moves quickly and you can learn a great deal from the prof and the peers.  Class size is large, but feels much smaller than it is b/c Prof is open to discussion and always has thought-provoking questions.  Highly recommend her class - knows what she wants to teach and how to teach it.

Adoption is a great class.  I am learning a lot about children in foster care and adoption triads.  Enjoying the videos and class discussion.  Class is highly recommended as prof is very open to questions and discussions.

Great teacher. I've had her for a few classes before, and she always makes the expectations crystal clear. Do what she says and you'll get an A. I also learned a lot of counseling theories in this class. I like that she tests in small chunks so that you actually remember info.

Fantastic class with many practical examples of applying theories into practice.  Can't wait to take her next class.  I hear that she teaches classes on social services and adoption.  I'm excited to look for those this spring and summer.  Strong recommendation to take her class.  Read the notes, come to class, and show up for tests.

Overall, a good and interesting class.  Enjoy the discussions and lectures.  Class is fair and exams are not that difficult if you attend class, read, and study.  Pay attention, show up, do the work, and you'll be fine.

Great class.  I learned a lot about prevention, even got the chance to research and write about a prevention program that I hope to build someday.  Helpful professor - made what could be a dry topic very engaging and informative.  Take this if you want to learn about creating meaningful prevention programs.  Required for most people in the class.

At first I thought this class was going to be rough, but it turned out easy and fun! Attendance is not mandatory, but she does offer class participation points by showing up. Tests and quizzes are very easy. Power points are long, but straight forward. Class was always very interesting. She knows her info and is very enthusiastic!

Great prof! The quizzes are easy, the papers are graded very fairly, and there's easy opportunity for in class participation points. She's very enthusiastic about the subject. If you have interest in prevention/intervention or even if not, she'll make  you enjoy it.
Very enthusiastic, loves teaching.  Lectures are very straightforward.
Very easy class. Just go to class and get the notes. No textbook, and a few easy quizzes. The hardest part is writing the papers, but they grade fairly easy. Professor is interesting and nice.
good lectures- talks too fast for notes- but gives great info; cares about students and wants you to learn

Attend class, pay attention to lecture, meet with your TA and you'll do fine.  Keep up with ANGEL assignments.  She gives real practical examples of when / how to use counseling theories.  Good class, highly recommended for people with an interest in counseling / helping fields.

DR MARTIN IS THE GOAT, he gives so many resources to study with. He's one of the few professors i've had that truly cares about the students in all aspects. He makes it easy to succeed if you put in the work. I highly recommend Bio 230 with him and wish I could take him for more bio classes!
greatest prof of all time

Dr. Martin is probably the most caring professor I've had at PSU. Professors (especially in large lectures) don't usually care too much about the well being of their students but Dr. Martin does. He is extremely responsive and seems to dedicate a lot of his time to making time to meet with students and create “success plans”. He's the best!

Best teacher I have had hands down. You will not fall asleep. He cares for students and always wants you to be a better version of yourself. 4 midterms, 1 dropped if you attend most classes. Top hat attendance. canvas homework assignments. Lab is another story, can go good/bad depending on the TA.

He cares about his students success and will go beyond his scope to help them. In 230 he went beyond and allows a dropped exam if you have a certain attendance grade. This effort shows he isn't just here for the paycheck but actually cares. For any Freshman coming in I recommend you take his 110 class even if you have to move other classes around.
James Martin is an awesome professor. If you comment "gallon of milk" on top hats, you get a reward. He also dropped the lowest midterm exam grade.

I'm sure Dr. Martin knows what he is talking about, but he just isn't great at teaching college students. You can tell his roots are in K-12 education because of how much time he spends showing us Youtube shorts and explaining elaborate analogies that don't make sense. Lectures were a waste of time; just take BIOL 230W with another professor.
If you put in time, and want to do well in his class, he will reciprocate that and make sure you do well. TRUST.

Dr Martin is an amazing teacher and wants to see his students thrive. He provided top secret summaries that provided you with the material that would be seen on the test, lots of the questions in the summaries also showed up on the exam exactly. He is great and his lectures are entertaining. I am taking him again next semester.

I really liked him, his lectures are kind of odd but it keeps you engaged. (he puts a bunch of memes in his slides) Tests are all multiple choice, but def study for the last two especially. Overall just a great guy!

Amazing guy. Dr. Martin is very inspirational and wants to see you do well. He has these "top secret" summaries that have all the important information needed for each exam (they helped so much). He tries to add some humor to the class. Overall the class wasn't too hard. If you took AP Bio, the class should be a breeze no worries.

I enjoyed his class, he tried to makethe content relatable, sent out slides used in class, and sent out a "cheat sheet" for every unit. He cares a lot about teaching, is very smart, and cares about students success. He would make his own results graphs after exams to show us our average. He uses tophat, but I found it helpful to practice in class.

Dr. Martin is such an incredible person with a very inspirational story. He is very intelligent and he's funny. He shows tiktoks in class and read us dbz manga when we learned about DNA replication. You can tell he has a passion for teaching and wants to help the students as much as he is physically able to. Make a good impression, it's worth it.

I really enjoyed having him. For every exam, he gave us "top secret summaries," which was the information you should know for the exams. Students from other sections would come in and take pictures of them. He is very nice and really is passionate about the class. The class itself is difficult, but he tries to relate things to our generation.

Highly recommend taking Dr. Martin. He is very nice and really wants to see his students do well. He is funny and tries to add some humor to his lectures. He also gives you these top-secret summaries for all the important things you need to know for each exam.

Has a unique style of teaching and always keeps his classes interesting. The class is difficult, but I would recommend taking him because of his top secret summary guides which tell you most of the material needed for the tests condenced into one slide.

He is a newer teacher so he is still trying to find what works best for the majority of students. He has a really good foundation though and is a super funny and nice person. I would not take it again because bio is not my strong suit, but he made his class as fun and engaging as possible.

i'm absolutely shocked by the rating here. Dr. Martin is fr the best prof i have ever had. he gives a slide of all of the material needed to know per exam and he genuinely cares about student success. he's an absolute gem of a professor, & has a great sense of humor as well as down to earth. TAKE HIS CLASS! those rating lowly here are liars ong.

You should take another professor- Dr. Martin reads off of the slides and does not teach. His office hours were terrible, and I dont think he knows what he is doing most of the time. Take Dr. Woodward- I ended up going to her section despite being enrolled in Dr. Martins. My exam average went up a lot just because of this.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: One of the few professors that I felt wanted to see me succeed. Is super down to earth and is amazing at helping students with different learning and memorization methods. Lectures were engaging but did reference aspects of chemistry, physics, and other sciences that made concepts difficult to grasp. HIGHLY RECOMMEND OFFICE HOURS WITH HIM!

Please take another professor if you can. He's not the worst on the planet but he only has 5 years of experience teaching K-12 science. His lectures are just reading off the slides and he relies on his students knowledge of AP Bio to carry them through the course. His feedback is pretty nonspecific and he gives poor exam review. You should swap.

Dr Martin didn't teach anything. He kinda just stated what was on the slide and called it a day. SO much tophat and it had us answering questions we didn't even know. You are better off switching out of his section- so many people stopped going to our lecture. Highly recommend going to other professors.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Martin is a great professor!! He gave us study guide for each exam that helped A LOT!! Bio is a hard course but if you out the work in you will do fine. i would 100% recommend him!!
Dr. Martin is a great guy and he genuinely cares about all his students. He gives study guides that basically tell you what's on the test for every unit. He also is easily accessible in office hours

I recommend looking for another section to be in Dr Martins's section was terrible. I ended up just going to another lecture and even though it was at 9 am, my exam average went up a lot. You will be reading a lot, and Dr. Martin did not prepare us for the exams, the study guides are very helpful. Great person, but not a good professor at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I felt like his section was very disorganized- there were many discrepancies. He relied a lot on his students taking AP Bio (many did not). He does give good study guides, but I did end up just learning all material for myself. His teaching style is not the best either. Class averages for exams were also not the best especially for an intro course.

kind guy no hate, but literally can not stand his class. omg this guy is so boring, he only reads off the slides and manages to explain every chem connection poorly. only good thing is he gives FANTASTIC study guides. literally for biol 230w my entire friend group is having one of us take him so we can still use them
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He's a pretty good professor but I could also see why some people may not like his learning style. He is straightforward with what he teaches and gives super helpful summaries and study guides for each concept that has everything you need to pass the midterms. I have gotten As on all of them. Genuinely a caring guy too. Would take again

I stopped going to the lectures bc he did not help at all. I went to office hours and he did not help either. Exam averages were terrible, and there was such a low tail end to the scores. Most of our section relied on the lab for the grade bump. I recommend taking another professor, he does not know what he's doing most of the time.

So I dont know why the other ratings are good. He's honestly a terrible professor. I spent most of my time teaching myself the information. So many people stopped going to the lecture bc he just read off the slides. You're better off taking Dr Woodward or literally anyone else. I do not recommend it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I was honored to take bio 110 with Dr.Martin during his first semester teaching at Penn State. You can tell he cares and will clarify concepts that are unclear. Give very specific study guides with exactly everything you need to be successful in the class.

TAKE THIS CLASS WITH DR.MARTIN!!! Probably the best bio teacher hands down at Penn state. Makes the lectures interesting and is a very nice professor, you can tell he cares about his students and wants them to succeed.

Dr. Martin was AMAZING! I would take his class over and over again! He is very dedicated to his students and there to provide all the support he can offer. He provides "top-secret summaries" which make it super easy to study for the exams. He makes the lectures interesting and funny! Take this course if you can! Highly recommend!

Dr. Neisser is a great guy, but just can't teach. He did not seem to know what was on his own slides, or didn't like how things were worded. Lectures were disorganized. The worksheets did not make much difference. The exams were physiology based, with few questions regarding anatomy. Take this with Waters or Dehart, and save yourself the trouble.

Best class ever!!! If you are looking for an upper level BIO elective, CHOOSE THIS ONE!  The material you learn is so interesting and cool to learn about. I feel like this class has prepared me well for medical school. Only difficult graded work is exams. However, if you study and pay attention, you'll pass with flying colors. TAKE THIS COURSE!!

I enjoyed having Dr. Neisser as a professor. His exams were decently challenging as they were not many questions and worth 100 points so you do need to study all of the content. His lectures are recorded but not 100% reliable, kept lecture interesting most days with jokes etc. Kind of an awkward guy but funny and provided a lot of study resources!
AMAZING professor, his exams were easy and no needed to play around. If you are ever confused he's there to help and easily accesible for office hours. Don't be afraid to reach out.
Dr. Neisser is genuinely such a funny person that it made learning anatomy and physiology so much better. Would definitely take another course with him.
Super funny guy! He will make a lot of jokes and the exams are not hard.

lectures are brutal, does not explain things well and rambles on. reads off slides a lot without explaining and goes super fast through them. when he does writes topics out on a separate paper it feels like he rushes through them. super nice guy tho just not a great professor
exams are super hard. Very hard to keep a good grade in this class when it is so exam heavy. Nice guy and understanding, but very hard exams.
Good guy, not a great teacher (you have to teach yourself). Gives you everything outside of class and you can learn it last minute but if you want to learn it as you go, he's not the teacher for you

Don't take Professor Neisser. He goes on multiple tangents during lectures and doesn't seem to know what's on his own PowerPoints. Exams are very difficult even if you study the material. There are 5 exams in the class and he crams lots of information into them. On the bright side the lectures are offered on Zoom and recorded.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you're a Bio major TAKE THIS CLASS! I absolutely loved it, my favorite at Penn State so far. Neisser is such a nice guy, gave really good lectures, and I genuinely enjoyed coming into class. Homework once a week, group projects (you're able to rate your members though) and TopHat.

His class was alright. He kinda just reads off of the slides and sometimes does not explain it. His exam questions do not make any sense and they are worded weirdly but if you read them very carefully then you should be able to do fine on the exams. I think there should be more assignments offered since they do not really help with your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: LOVED prof Neisser. He makes lectures so funny and interesting and he is a very knowledgeable guy. He also provides a zoom link for class. BIO163 is somewhat difficult, and you have to do well on exams to keep your grade up. There is some homework, but not enough to outweigh exams, and there are top hats each class.
Kind of a weird guy, but he's a pretty good professor. There are other assignments but most of your grade depends on exam scores, so make sure to keep those up.

Dr.Neisser, is such a sweet and genuine professor. This has been my favorite class at penn state so far because he makes the content enjoyable. He can go by slides pretty quick but if you go to class and participate in the tophats the exams are pretty easy and fair. I would definitely take him for a future class.

You can just tell that he knows whats he's talking about. Watch the pre-week videos and everything he talks about in lecture will make sense. He may continuously talk about a certain topic only because he wants to make sure that you get it. Anyone that says this course was hard just didn't try. He's also just funny and relatable I can't explain it.
Dr. Neisser is super knowledgable and really funny. I personally really enjoyed his lectures however sometimes he does go a little fast

Bio163 is a hard course but he makes it a lot better. People complaining def didn't put in enough effort. Rewatch the lectures & go through the slides to study. I did that and received over 97s on every exam. Class isn't easy as its mainly just your exam scores, but if you put in the effort you'll succeed. He's caring & wants his students to succed

Material- not bad if you study. Lectures- Slides gone through fast, he goes on tangents, go for tophat points. Only had a few classes before 1st exam because he canceled-avg was bad. Small curve. He talked all semester about maybe curving the class. Didn't happen. Probably not the worst bio professor. Never available and doesnt care about students.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: My grade is not a fair reflection of Dr. Neisser because anatomy just isn't my best subject, but I do not think he is a great professor. He doesn't seem to know what is on his own slideshow, and they seem like they were made decades ago. I think he's a great guy and can be super funny, but he doesn't prepare you for the (5 total) exams at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Writing as a fourth year student who took this class just because. Not the greatest or worst professor I've had. Good lecturer. One big negative about his class is his inability and/or unwillingness to control his students. Granted, this is hard to do in a 300 person lecture, but it was extremely distracting when a quarter of the room was talking.

Overall, I loved Dr. Neisser. He's the best out of the rest of them so keep that in mind. He's hilarious and loves to joke around which helps because the content is a lot. The class is difficult, but if you put time into the material, you'll be fine. Dr. Neisser is kind of a mess, but that's what makes him so relatable and funny. Totally recommend!

I love professor Neisser!! He is genuinely so nice and actually cares about his students. My class struggled this semester so he changed some things in the syllabus around to help us. Biology 163 is very hard and even attending class did not do much for me. Neisser is so nice but the class sucks, but if you have to take it I would recommend him.

Professor Neisser is not a good professor. If you like to go to TA office hours good luck because his schedule is very limited having one TA per day during the week . Also, his handwriting on worksheets is illegible and he does not do a good job of explaining the lectures .Tophat questions are the only reason I go to class.

Dr. Neisser is a nice guy but he goes through lectures extremely fast, often skips over things, and is a very fast talker. It's hard to follow what he is teaching and often things show up on the exam that were not discussed in class. You are better off teaching yourself and watching youtube videos.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Neisser doesn't do a good job of explaining anything. It's a difficult subject and he blows through the slides. He tries to cram multiple lectures into our classes so it can be on our next exam, which ends up with him spending 10 seconds on each slide. I stopped going to class because I've taught this entire subject to myself.

A really nice charismatic guy which is why i think people are rating him so high but when none of his material is his own and he doesnt seem to review it before class, this leads to glossing over info and poor coverage on important stuff. i dont think he makes his tests either so how he teaches doesnt really match the tests as well as they should

Funny, knowledgeable, helpful . He post material and recordings which makes everything easier. His top hats are also very helpful when reviewing and not just busy work. His tests are a bit challenging, but there is plenty of resources to help you study and if you put the effort in you'll be fine. There are a lot of assignments but they're helpful.

He's hilarious and definitely worth it. I will say, his lectures go by very fast and he can cover a whole unit in one hour. He goes over the important stuff pretty quickly, probably bc it's common knowledge for him, so get ready to teach yourself stuff through youtube. Other than that, he's a nice guy. Cares abt us passing & sometimes curves exams.

He is hilarious and very awkward in the beginning but you get to know his ways of teaching pretty quickly. He does like to ask questions out loud to the general audience and will be happy to answer any questions that come up during lectures. He is very nice and one of the best professors that teaches A&P.

Dr. Neisser is by far one of my favorite professors at PSU. His human pathophysiology course is one of the only classes I've taken at PSU that is truly relevant to medical school. He makes class interesting, the exams are fair and the homework is honestly pretty fun. If you want to go to med school, take this course!

For a mostly online A&P lab, he and the A&P team did an amazing job! The "study tips" were very helpful for exams, so actually do them! Lots of small assignments each week, but were much more manageable with him than the Biol 162 professor in my opinion. TA's were also very good and well trained on the material! Good experience overall!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: If you are interested in the medical field, this course was FANTASTIC! Dr. Neisser not only knows the material well, but he knows how to clearly explain it to students and is so passionate about it! His exams are not easy (mostly case studies), but manageable if you studied hard. There is a textbook, but only use if you're really stuck on something

This class was taken online and it took a few hours per week. The material itself is not hard, but the application of it is. Make sure to stay on top of your work and pay attention to the modules! Overall, pretty simple class if you are willing to put in the work.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: This was a half semester course. Dr. Neisser was always kind, helpful, and made jokes throughout class. Sometimes we were split into breakout rooms which could be awkward because that's just how breakout rooms are. He made the material very interesting, and the assignments were very clearly graded.
Dr. Neisser was so kind and funny, he made class very interesting, and the assignments were also very thought-provoking. awesome experience, i learned a lot!!

Dr. Neisser is such a great professor and made learning enjoyable on zoom. 10/10 would recommend. Tests are based on the powerpoints and there are no surprises on the exam. Definitely recommend going to office hours or reviews if you have questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Probably one of my favorite professors I have had. He has some pretty dank memes in his slides and he tries helping his students out.

Professor Neisser was an all-around, awesome guy. Tests can definitely be tricky, but ask questions in class and attend office hours and you should be fine. He's a really funny guy and loves to incorporate memes into lectures to keep his students' attention. The material is hefty, so be sure to actually pay attention in class.
He's super funny and makes class interesting! The material was kinda hard but if you enjoy anatomy and pay attention in lecture you should get a B easy.

Dr. Neisser is genuinely one of the best professors I've had. he made learning on Zoom fun and interesting and although the class is note and lecture heavy, he made the class super funny and interesting and is honestly such a caring and genuine professor. for the vast number of students in the 300+ person lecture, he managed to care about everyone.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Such a good professor! Although this semester was difficult, he made me really love this class and helped with virtual learning. Dr. Neisser is an amazing professor and I learned so much from his lectures. There are a lot of points in the course that give you the opportunity to make mistakes and learn without failing.
Hes such a nice teacher and overall a funny guy. Although the lectures are a little boring he tries to keep it entertaining. Make sure to study for the tests!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Neisser is a great person, but if you've never received a solid science knowledge foundation, be ready to work very hard for an A in this class. His lectures are entertaining, though there is rarely any time for questions despite his speedy delivery of topics.

Dr. Neisser is a great guy, loves what he teaches. Course was interesting, textbook is easy to read and helps you when you don't understand from the slides. Always nice to talk to outside of class. Exams do test your knowledge though, so do not try to wing them. Would take another class with him again.

Very funny and very nice guy, a little disorganized but I learned a ton. More enjoyable & a bit easier than many other 400-level Bios. Homework is rather easy, as are group projects. Exams can be difficult and open-ended, just study slides. Text is v good, not used very much. It was real fun to go to. Definitely take if going into healthcare!

Dr. John is easily one of my favorite professors ever. He is incredibly knowledgeable about the material and his lectures make the information interesting and engaging. I think his class though sometimes can be boring he is clearly interested in the lectures and knowledgeable. I think his grading is fair and he gives good feedback. I think if you have him as a professor you shouldn't worry. As long as you do the work and show up to class majority of the time you should do good.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great Professor, very boring, however the essays we had to do were fun, I've learned a lot. Attendance is mandatory, however, we do not have exams, but we do have home quizzes. Funny guy

Bad reviews are over exaggerated. He is a nice guy who is clear and fair with grading. Not too much and deadlines are reasonably spaced.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: Do not believe the bad reviews. He is such a good professor and although he has a dry sense of humor he is a fun and nice guy. I always hate english classes, but he made it fun.

This is a review for my Spring '24 Semester
I did WAY better in this class than I thought I would do. Expected a low 80 on the really big major essay (counterargument) and got a hundred. The only times I got below As on assignments were on the textbook reading quizzes (textbook is/was free when I took it)

A bit sarcastic-mean but overall, 8.5/10
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--So many papers

reviews.comment: Very easygoing and low stress class.

The grading criteria is very clear, the class is easy if you try. Don't half-ass, try and “whole-ass” this class so that you do good. It's not much work if you actually try and it's a lot of work if you don't. Don't be dissuaded by the ratings he is a good professor. This is not high-school this is college so try and you will succeed.

Professor is very inconsistent with grading. I attended office hours to have my essay read over and he gave minimal corrections and said overall it was very good. In the end when graded I received a B even though when asked if the paper was good he said yes leading me to believe if i fixed minor details i would receive an A.

This professor is my least favorite professor I have ever had at Penn State. His criticism of our assignment pitches is highly unhelpful and borderline aggressive. reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

The organization of the class is awful as students aren't even able to communicate outside of online discussion boards. Grading is completely unpredictable, making an entry-level class way harder than it should be. Avoid this professor.

After completing this course, I realized that his grading scale varies so much. For example, I would respond multiple times on a discussion board. Sometimes I would get an 8/10, other times a 10/10, and even a 7/10. In addition, he would grade papers as if you were an English major. There was no leniency at all on any assignments.

I would not recommend schaub for english 15 if you are required to take the class. at first he was sweet and you start thinking you're going to enjoy the class, then he switches it up really quickly. he was rude and condescending and his grading was unclear. the comments he made under assignments were vague and unhelpful. would not recommend him
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: He made a required, entry-level class unrealistically difficult. He did not have a rubric and instead graded harshly on his own subjective ideals. Find a different professor who makes this an easy class because it should be.

He is a good professor and a nice guy, just a pretty tough grader for stuff he shouldn't be harsh on. He takes off points on assignments that are supposed to be your own thoughts and perspective. Eased up on grading toughness near the end of the semester. Not that hard if you go to class and do the assignments, but you will have to really earn an A

Math 140 as a course isn't the worst course, however, I feel that the way she teaches certain topics just didn't make sense to me, and some of her responses to some of my questions came off as rather rude. I do think she cares for her students, but if you just show up to lecture and that's it you probably wouldn't be able to tell.

Jivkova is highly underrated in the Math 140 department. Best way to describe her style is "tough love." She comes off as a little cold, but if you show up engaged in lectures, you'll have good results when it comes time for exams. I recommend taking her if you've had a calc before. If you haven't, it's not the end of the world, just ask questions.

This course may contain the heaviest workload of all your courses in your first couple of semesters, but I think it is manageable if you consistently show up to lectures and ask questions. The homework is a mix of both online and handwritten work. If you find any struggle in this course, plenty of outside help is offered.

She is the sweetest kindof hard to hear slight accent speaks super softly. she prepares you really well for the midterms the questions are very similar to the ones she has on quizzes/lecture. Quizzes are every week but if u do the homework its practically the same. easier quizzes than others i would say. GO TO LA SESSIONS helped my grade sm
Just not good at teaching. Hard to understand and doesn't explain things well

Super funny in class- often without meaning to be. The content is difficult but she does a very good job at preparing the class to pass the test and get the grade. If you struggle with calc she's a good professor to have. Professor Jivkova is probably the best teacher I've had at college.

Good at responding to emails and providing help outside of class. She can be very blunt with her responses, and can come off rude, but she is pretty nice. If you haven't taken Calc before, you might struggle because she moves fast and does not always fully explain concepts enough for first timers to understand. Penn State learning is helpful.

She is a very tough grader. The only thing making me pass right now is the online homework. She is very condescending and will make you feel dumb for asking questions. I learned more from the internet than from her lectures. If you haven't taken calculus before, DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS! I suggest taking it with a different professor. Most people fail

Svetla is a tough but fair professor. Her lectures are well-explained, and she's willing to answer questions. The class can be challenging, but staying engaged and using resources like unstuck ai can really help. Overall, a rewarding experience if you put in the work.
If you have experience in calc you will likely be fine, but if you do not you can fail. She does not explain topics properly and gives hard quizzes.

Taking calc in high school made this class not bad, but I couldn't imagine taking it without any prior experience. This professor is somewhat hard and the quiz grades can be rough, but there's some group quizzes to make up for it (not that the quizzes are graded too heavily). She has a small accent but is still completely understandable.

Excellent professor, teaches very well and is a very nice person in general. I'd recommend sitting towards the front of the class and engaging with her as she definitely is more helpful to people who show up and pay attention every day.

If you are going to take Math 140, I definitely recommend taking it with Prof Jivkova. At the beginning of the semester, she might seem like a strict professor, but I guarantee you this is not the case. Lectures are actually useful IMO and as long as you go to the LA sessions, there's no reason why you cant get an A- or A. Easier than AP Calc fs.
She cant teach
Very good prof

Dedicated to student success, using effective teaching methods. Daily 1-minute quizzes ensure understanding and make attendance essential. Attend regularly, and you'll do well!

reviews.comment: Professor Jivkova was a very good professor for this course. I dropped Math 140 the first time and she really helped me this time around because she was such an amazing professor. We had daily worksheets where we worked in a group to solve various problems, which was a huge help.

At Penn State, MATH 140 is just a tough class. So, don't look at the ratings too much. But, personally I would take professor Jivkova. She makes sure to explain everything and will answer questions to the best of her abilities. Also, really pay attention to her lectures, they are really well explained. I would recommend you take her for 140.

This professors style of teaching includes videos that you watch outside of class, to teach yourself. reviews.comment: She is a great professor. She cares about your study and will be ready to explain everything you need to know. The lecture is all you need for the exams. You get the grade that you paid for.

I never took precalc, nor a calculus course so I knew this would be tough. I took Svetla because I saw good reviews, but I was wrong. There is a front row of students that has taken this class before with her, and it is obvious. She favors them and speaks to them by their first names, but no other students receive this treatment. Do not recommend

I don't usually rate professors, but Professor Svetla was amazing. She gives very clear lectures and takes things like THON into account when planning. Any negative comments on here probably come from the fact that she teaches a hard class, and there are some rigid deadlines made by the math department as a whole. Also be sure to read her emails.
She is tough
attendance mandatory using tophat. i don't appreciate the style of this course. professor has strict deadlines, so most reviews are misleading. take with caution and avoid if possible.

Math 140 is a hard class in general but I think this professor does a good job in explaining the concepts and answering questions. She is flexible on quiz drops but there is a lot of homework that you can't fall behind on. The midterms make up a lot of your grade so have to be really prepared for them.

Svetla is hands down the best professor for Math 140. Weekly quizzes are hard and if you get a bad grade on them don't worry. I got 6/10 on a couple of them but then aced the exams thanks to them. Make sure to watch solutions to the weekly quizzes, I think I'd get a perfect score in this class if I did!

I retook math 140 with Svetla Jivkova and she has a minor accent and really well laid out lectures, Her class has a mini-built-in curve with teamwork assignments and if you reach out to her separately it would make her day. She's a good teacher and makes the material as easy as it can to go through it.

Honestly, MATH 140 itself is a pretty hard course, but she did a decent job explaining all the concepts. The weekly quizzes are not too hard if you try to study for them, but the exams are definitely important to your grade. You do have to learn a bit more on your own, but again, that's just how MATH 140 is.

reviews.comment: This was the most difficult class I have taken at Penn State. Her lectures were fast-paced and not she did not go into great detail when explaining. Professor Jivkova is easily the best professor you can take for Math 140. Weekly quizzes are hard and you will probably score low. However, those quizzes prepare you for the midterms really well. She was tough

Math 140 is a pretty tough class, especially with no prior Calc but she was a good professor for it. Explains things well and most people who went to office hours did well. reviews.comment: Took her both 140 and 141. Worksheets are very useful, and they really help when you are preparing for the exams. Quizzes are not very hard, but they are a little bit harder than the actual exam. But if you can understand the quizzes, the exams are super EASY. Have teamworks, will learn lots if you participate. The review sessions are very useful.

Big Svetla fan! I took her class over the summer, so a lot of material was covered during every lecture. She definitely peer-pressures you into putting in the extra work for quizzes, but it pays off come exam time. She's actually a sweetheart, and I'm actually going to miss class.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: If you are reading this considering taking her class for next semester, DO NOT. Her lectures are downright awful. Not only is she dismissive of student's questions, but she moves way too fast for anyone besides Goodwill Hunting to comprehend what she is talking about. She enjoys the fact that the quiz average in her class is in the 30s.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Svetla did a really good job teaching this class. Her class consisted of "team works", which are basically group pop quizzes, an individual quiz once a week, and two midterms and a final. The team works were very helpful in learning the concepts and they were graded easily. The quizzes were graded harder, but they helped in the long run. Take her!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Her weekly quizzes are hard, but the in class part of the grade is inflated by difficult take home quizzes before exams, but you can get a 100% on them as long as you do them. She is an alright professor, not bad, but not amazing. Her print out notes are nice too, if you are willing to use your printer sheets.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Svetla really knows her stuff and she is very clear in explaining the material. The best math professor I had at psu. The material can be challenging but she makes it way much more approachable. She also had helpful take-home quizzes before exams.
Doesn't really care. She does the bare minimum. don't bother asking for help, or advice.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Definitely knows what she is talking about but will not go into too much detail unless asked to. MUST PRINT OUT OWN WORKSHEETS!! She gives outlines of each chapter with practice problems that we do in class. big on teamwork assignments for bonus points so go to class!
By far the best math teacher I have ever gotten in my life. If I could have her for all of my math classes I would do it.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Amazing lectures--Would take again

reviews.comment: Grade based on quizzes and midterms only, no chances to fix your grade if you slip. No excuses for missed class. Doesn't really care about your grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: I had Svetla for both math 140 and math 141. Easily one of my favorite professors. Weekly quizzes can be challenging but when it comes to exams, I felt very prepared. Going to class is very beneficial because she outlines worksheets for each chapter that you fill in during class. I loved the way she set up her class - very organized!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Svetla is one of the best professors I've had in college. I had to late drop 141 when I had a different professor. Her in-class notes and quizzes help organize the topics of the course really well. Do all of the assigned homework in the textbook and go to Orals and you'll be better prepared for quizzes and exams. I highly recommend taking her class
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I took her Math 140 and 141 class and really enjoyed it.  She assigns homework after every class that is ungraded, so you do as much as you need to understand the material.  People say the quizzes every week are difficult, but they are on par with what is on the exams.  She will do anything if you say you don't understand something. Great professor
She is just not the kind of person who should be a teacher. She is not caring at all and she is like super not friendly. DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS IF YOU HAVE ANOTHER CHOICE.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Everything I learned in Math 140 I learned in AP Calculus in high school. She made it so confusing though and she's not that great at explaining something if you don't understand it. Her weekly quizzes are so hard. I got an A in AP calc and I don't think I got above an 11/15 on a quiz. Sometimes she can be hard to understand.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Jivkova gives out a lot of homework, but none of it is graded. Don't make the mistake of skipping all of the homework, you'll regret it! To pass this class, sit in the front, study for the quizzes, and do the homework. Dr. Jivkova is really approachable, so if you have a question, go see her!

Svetla is one of the best math professors at Penn State. She has her own typed lecture notes for you to print which make understanding new material a breeze. There are weekly quizzes that are much harder than the material on the exam so you are well prepared for it. She is always there to help you and I can't wait to take her for Math 141!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Shes a great professor, she assigns a lot of work but if you keep up with it and go to office hours with ligament questions she'll love you. Her exams were very straightforward if you did the homework, but she grades tough, if you try and explain where you went wrong in office hours shes very forgiving. You'll grow to love her Bulgarian charm.

Svetla is one of the kindest teachers in the math department. She gives one quiz every week and has teamworks for a decent amount of classes, but they prepare you very well for the exams. She does not require that you do your homework, but if you don't do it you won't be very prepared. She is always wiling to help if you go to office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Svetla is the most savage teacher you will have. For that reason alone, you need to take her class. It can be hard if you don't pay attention, but overall it's just calculus 1 stuff. Beware for Halloween tricks.

I liked her a lot. She would explain everything as many times as needed. She has teamworks in class which aren't on any specific day so don't skip class. There arent any graded homeworks so that's good. If you can't attend a quiz or something just email her and she'll take care of you. Overall, she's really nice and helpful.

Svelta is tough, don't get me wrong. But if you show up to class, pay attention, and do the assigned (albeit optional) homework, you can do very well in this class. I struggled in 140, but managed to do much better in 141 thanks to her. Be warned: her quizzes are very difficult. But it does make the exams much easier by comparisons.

her print-out note packets provide theory, examples, and pitfalls- these alone make her the best. she also thoroughly explains all topics in class. homework is not turned in. weekly quizzes and teamworks are your in-class grade, but some are dropped and all based on packet. she is sweet, gives out candy and prepares you for the test, i miss her
She's really helpful and homeworks are not mandatory. She gives weekly quizes and has some group work every week.

she's terribly unhelpful, she told me not to drop the course and then refused to help with anything or give extra credit. I failed the course by 2 points. Will not take again. homework is not graded but if you don't do it you won't pass.

She is so sweet! She is hard to understand because she talks very quietly. The class is difficult but the class was made to be hard  She makes note packets for you to print out and bring to class. She gives quizzes every week and has team works through the class. She gives homework but does not collect it.

Svetla is one of the best Calculus professors at Penn State. Her explanations are very straightforward and clear, and she's also very nice. If you go to class and take notes, you'll never have to read the textbook. Her quizzes are more difficult than the department exams, so you're completely prepared for the exams when you take them.

she explains like a high school teacher. Homework is not graded, but if you don't do it you wouldn't pass. Quiz weekly on stuff learned previous week and random days for group assignments that  are based on homework problems. Also non graded practice quizzes and exams on angel. Always there to help and want everyone to pass the class.
She is one of the most helpful professors I've had. Her grading is very easy for the in class part as well.
Dr. Jivkova is a sweet lady. She is always on her students' side and truly cares for the subject.

She's really hard to understand. She speaks quietly and with a thick accent and it matters a lot the way you show your work on quizzes and tests. You may have the correct work and the correct answer but if it isn't exactly how she personally likes it shown, you will lose points. You just have to play her game. Once I did, I did really well.
very good
Dr. Jivkova. Probably she is the nicest math professor in Penn State.
Extremely Boring Lecture

One of the best engineering TEACHERS, hands down. Committed to her students.  Always available before and after class to explain concepts.  Material is tough but she teaches it well -- giving theory and derivations where necessary and focusing solely on problem solving whenever possible.
She was great teaching Calculus  2 as she was teaching Calculus 1. If you are looking for a professor who knows how teach a difficult subject, take her!

Absolutely fantastic professor! If you would like to gain real knowledge about calculus and do well in the course you should take her. If you do the work and follow her instructions you'll get an A like I did. I'm taking her for Calculus 2.

She is one of the best professor for E&M course. Her lectures are clear and attendance wasn't mandatory so did the homework but she gave quizzes every week so I would recommend doing the homework. Exams are really easy if you do her homework and the exam prep packet. She is really helpful and takes the risk of going the extra mile to help.
Dr. Jivkova is a great prof. Calc is not easy for everyone and she made it easy to understand for us. Her exam prep quizzes will basically get you an A on the exam if you can do them.
really good teacher helped us out a lot.
She is the best!! Teaches everything with simplicity, accent is there, but not an issue for here quality of teaching!
she is not a good math 140 teacher. You can barely hear her in class and she doesn't explain things well. she also gets very lazy and makes students do problems on the board for her.
Best EE212 Instructor! Too bad she's not teaching anymore.
Very good professor. Explains material clearly and does her best to answer your questions.

Good professor that really wanted to make sure you knew the material. The notes were very helpful when it came to studying and homework. Wasn't very interactive during class but willing to answer any questions students had. Exams were fair and reflected material covered during lectures.

The class itself is very hard, but she has a very good teaching style. She has a small accent, but she's easy to understand and quite clear.  The class attendance is not required, but extremely hard to catch up if you miss classes as the book is virtually useless. Definitely a great professor! A++

Svetla really wants her students to learn, and she is willing to go to great lengths to help them out with any issues they are having.  She does not teach a hard class, but has a hard on for theory, so make sure you understand the important concepts.  Overall she's a fair teacher so keep working and you'll do fine.
She's nice, but hard. Hard to understand sometimes, and isn't all that clear.
Excellent professor.  Speaks very clearly and with a moderate pace.  Clarifies concepts quite well.  Also, she tries her best to prepare students for the exams.

He's a nice guy, but gets mad easily. The EDSGN curriculum is annoying, so it's not really his fault but he's a bit picky and tough with the grading. I don't really have a huge opinion as it's only the curriculum. He's understanding if you were absent due to sickness but expect you to do the work.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: The EDSGN100 curriculum isn't great, but he makes it as bearable as possible. He has a 1.4 right now because some guy obviously spammed him with one-star reviews for 460W, but he's a pretty good 100 prof. I'd take him again - the EDSGN100 curriculum is gonna suck either way, but he understands that and tries to help you out.

I can't speak on the other courses he teaches but for EDSGN 100 he is great. Do the work and check the rubric to make sure you have everything on it and you'll get an A. He responded to my emails fairly quickly. If you need an extension and have a valid excuse just ask he most likely won't say no. Most projects you will finish in class.
Completely ignored me when I asked for some clarification about one of my grades. Guy's a total tool. Avoid at all costs.
Probably allergic to peanuts.
I can just tell this guy snores.

I was originally in Dr. Mongeau's section (great prof) before the start of the semester. Over the summer, they switched a bunch of people to this guys section. This ended up being more disappointing than working on my teams terrible project prompt.
Unprofessional. Prepare to have your emails ignored. This guy can take pride in not knowing the name of any of his students.
Sean makes me think I could become a professor. Not because of any inspiring actions or words, but because if he can do it, anyone can.
Unprofessional. The only thing more rare than valuable feedback from sean is a philly sports championship win.

Unprofessional. Your team and project assignment will be the biggest factor for this class. If you are unlucky enough to have a bad team and bad project like I was, pray that you don't also have sean as your "professor".

Unprofessional. He will not give your team advice or spend any amount of effort helping your team unless he is interested in your project. His grading criteria is vague and his feedback is nonexistent.

Unprofessional. Will never know your name even in a class of 30. If he guesses your name, he'll call you someone completely different. Always had his ringer on full blast even while "teaching". Will come to every class looking like he got dressed inside of a tornado.

He is a really good guy. The class itself is 2 hours long on mon wed fri but its a good introduction to the field of engineering. He is cool and helpful and it seems like most negative reviews is on the course itself and not the professor

Knecht is awesome. Lots of group work in the classroom under COVID hybrid, in person mon&fri, remote wed. Very lenient, took late assignments without penalty. Class really pushes your engineering thinking and Knecht is just a super chill guy and easy to talk to. I would definitely take him again.

Very nice guy and if you have questions he tries to answer them. However he is horrible at checking email, all questions must be asked in class to get a response, and he throws you in groups and if your group sucks, then your stuck with them all semester. This class should be an easy A but Knecht makes it much harder than it should be.
Honestly, a chill guy who cares about his students. Makes the classes interesting

Doesn't grade anything until the last minute. Makes EDSGN100 way harder than it needs to be. Says that its only a three credit class even though its two hours three times a week because all the work is done in class which is complete BS. Gives a bunch of time to work on the first project and then gives you a few weeks at the end for 4 more. Trash.
Dry lectures but good guy

Sean was a great overall teacher and really accommodated to everyone and have plenty of grade opportunities. However, he was a super hard grader and gave almost no one an A on big time projects that decided your grade.

To start, Sean is a good guy. He tries his best to answer questions when asked but never truly makes anything clearer. Makes the class do useless work that wastes valuable time. Work is tough sometimes and the two big projects suck if youre working with morons. Pick your partners and group members carefully. Dont recommend taking EDSGN with Sean.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: most of the work is in class, with some SolidWorks homework throughout the semester. as long as you pay attention, you'll get an easy A
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests? Not many--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Makes you do a ton of homework, half of the coursework/homework you do is not graded (which you have no idea until a month) the other half is graded after a month. Although he lets you know where you stand in class, it is not clear. Don't be surprised if you receive a "You should think of dropping this class" on the last day of the drop deadline.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Knecht is great, he really cares about the students and is more than willing to accommodate you. Anyone who is complaining about EDSGN 100 with him should take a look at why their in college if they can't get an A in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Knecht is a good professor who has a lot of experience in the industry and will do his best to try and give you real life experiences. Many people complain about how much work the class has, but if you're complaining about work you shouldn't be an Engineering major. He also gives extra credit opportunities and is an easy A if you ask me.
you're better off pouring hydrochloric acid into your butthole than taking this class with sean.  take my word for it; he inspired me to have a new respect for falling asleep in class

I would not recommend taking his class. We have a lot more homework than the other sections and he's a pretty tough grader. Lectures are pretty dry and the only useful thing we learn is how to use solidworks. He also kind of taught me to hate engineering.

He is fine at teaching and at least TRIES to help when asked questions, but he is really disorganized. Mainly everyone hated the class because assignment criteria or when/where to turn in the assignments were unclear which made many do poorly because he was missing their work. But, if you show effort  and turn in work, you can get a decent grade.
If you want FAIL take this CLASS. It will make you HATE ENGINEERING. Will never appreciate your work.
If you want an A, this is not what you want to do. He is Mr. Perfect and he expects everyone to be so. He grades everything hard though stuffs you are doing will be really easy.
If you want to learn about engineering, don't take him... If you expect an A, don't take him..

Kristina is super caring and a great professor! She learns everyone's names despite being a large class. Content is easy to understand and learn. Yes, there is a lot of assigned reading, but you can make through without doing it. She gives lots of extra credit  - up to like 20 points.

KTP is a great person and prof! She genuinely cares about her students. Exams are based on readings but if you do the reading it is super easy. Attendance does matter though as it's a part of the grade. Very educational and insightful gen-ed!

Harder than you would think. No computers allowed, have to handwrite all notes which makes it hard to keep up. You will never be fully prepared for exams unless you read hours of textbook before each class. They are unexpectedly very hard. Sweet person but NOT an easy gen ed. Weekly quizzes. She does give extra credit which is nice.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Very nice professor and caring, but there is far too much information that she requires you to know for exams. The modules and material on each exam are poorly laid out and way too much to expect students to know. The exams felt like a trap and you will never be prepared enough. Do not take this class unless you have to.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I took this for my major and did not expect it to be this difficult. Hours of reading before each class. Each of her lecture slides has like 100000000 words on it so idk how she wanted me to memorize that. The tests were really hard for no reason I would go in thinking that I knew everything but clearly not. Lots of extra credit helped me.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor KTP is great! She gives extra credit opportunities and drops two attendance grades, which are completed through an in-class prompt that she gives you a lot of time to turn in. The textbook is required but I did not buy it and passed with a 93. I wish I would have read the online readings earlier because the exams are heavy with them.

I love KTP! She is such a sweet person and always willing to help with whatever you need. I took this class as an interdomain, and it wasn't an easy A. There were a lot of readings every week. However, I learned so much and enjoyed her lectures. Be ready to work, but if you put in the time it isn't bad.

Prof KTP is a great teacher and person, but the exams were a lot harder than I thought they would be. A lot of the questions were worded weirdly and there was a lot more content from the readings than I thought there would be (and also a lot of readings). It's not too bad if you put effort in, but it is not a low-effort easy A gen-ed
as long as you pay attention and do the homework assignments you should be fine
She is actually the best. Her class is always very interesting as well as easy and she is an awesome person. One of the best professors I've ever had and the semesters not even over.

I would take this class a million times over again. Trust her when she advises you to take notes on paper and pen. It helped me retain so much more. If you go to class, the exams will be easy. Quizzes were based on the textbook + lecture but super simple.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This class was more difficult than I expected for a gen-ed but KTP is super nice and gives good lectures. Just study and read and you'll be good. There's extra credit too. Weekly quizzes and some other homework assignments so it helps your grade. Attendance isn't mandatory but she does random in-class assignments.

Prof. KTP is very caring. This class isn't easy but as long as you put in the effort, you will be fine. Textbook can be found online. Readings are important for quizzes/exams (I just skimmed through them and noted important definitions). There are weekly quizzes and in-class assignments that aren't hard at all. I recommend this class!

I've had Professor Porter for a couple of CMAS classes. She is FANTASTIC. I would recommend everyone to take her. Her lessons are interesting, and she is always willing to help. I would take her for all your CMAS classes.

Her lectures are so easy to follow and she has a lot of energy to keep your attention through lectures. She gives a lot of readings but you'll do fine if you decide not to do them. She does go a bit fast through lectures if you like taking a lot of notes from lecture slides, but they're available on canvas and you can always go back to them.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor KTP is amazing! She is very knowledgeable about the course material and is very supportive of students. There are 3 exams, no final, and readings to do. Class attendance is mandatory but lectures are very engaging. I would take another class of hers in a heartbeat!
She is one of the nicest professors ive had. She is very knowledgable on the subject and wants to make sure her students understnad

Prof KTP is honestly one of my favorite and sweetest professors so far. She is clearly passionate about what she teaches and conveys it well to the class.
