reviews.comment: A sweet professor who teaches from real life experiences which is really interesting.
Dr. Vinca was entertaining, smart, and never spent too much time lecturing. Classes were more focused on group discussion and practicing counseling skills which I liked.

If you are really looking to enjoy your semester with a great proffessor, I suggest choosing her, she is really helpful and tells what exactly you need to do for everything, just pay attention in Class, if you want to recieve an A.

Maria was so funny and helpful and I found myself actually excited to go to class (which is rare for me). She's warm and caring, too. Something happened during the semester that was hard for me and she helped me through it. I love her!

BA-411 was alright. I did struggle at first, but I developed like Josh Allen. As long as your group is good and you can ask your TA or other TA office hours for help. It's alright. I struggled on the individual rounds, when it came to group rounds, I was able to contribute and help out in it. Ask your group mates and TA for help.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Take someone else
required to take. u barely interact w prof, just mainly w ur group and TA. all depends on ur group members fr and TA. capsim takes a lil but it gets easier. dont worry ab ur grades over the sem.
The class is not hard just a whole lot of busy work. The lectures are not very useful and you don't learn much. It is an easy A though.

An easy A if you get a pretty decent group. All should go well if you have a good teammates. There were a lot of group projects. Attendance is not mandatory, but it'll help you to stay ahead of the course's schedule.

All prior reviews are spot on. Class is a waste of time, but you have to do it so not much to get around. Whether you take the asynch. or live lecture course, going to lecture is useless. Pretty much just have to hope you get a decent TA who grades lightly, and a group that wants to help do the projects. Capsim is easy, just a waste of time though.

It's a shame this class is mandatory. After the first 2 weeks it actually gets easier after you figure out how to use the Capsim platform. Also very much depends on your TA and group members unfortunately. Capsim is just the worst ever and every group presentation is complete bs that you make up.

The class is just such a waste of time. It's a shame that it's mandatory. After the first 2 weeks it actually got better and was pretty easy after you figure out how to use the online platform. The "CapSim" platform is so unrealistic and has an algorithm that just makes no sense. Also depends a lot on your TA and group members unfortunately.

This isn't a bad class, but it is definitely a 'dull' class for me. The simulation is a big part of your grade, but it's not too tough if you read the guide (and listen to your TA too, Mike was great). There's a couple of group projects, but the grading criteria is clear. Just take the online section, you won't miss too much. Long but manageable.

I think the poor reviews on here are misguided. 411 is graded lightly, and the simulator is very learnable provided you can think abstractly and recognize patterns. The professor was very kind during lectures, and so was my TA. My only advice is to be prepared to do extra work in group projects, since some Smeal students don't care about grades.

BA 411 claims to "simulate running a business" but it's just a Capsim website where you randomly guess numbers and hope you get your silly 5 stars. Shame this class is required. Not valuable at all...

This class can be a mixed bag - it really depends on your TA and group. The content itself isn't too difficult, but the online format and group projects make it a bit of a gamble. Using resources like ChatGPT and unstuck AI for study prep can be a big help.

Struggled at first but talked to TA went to office hour trying to understand the structure. Later on, it became clear and easier to understand. This class is not necessarily my favorite class but as long as you understand how all the function works in capsim, it becomes easier. Take the online version, wayyyyyy better.

Material is useful, but professor needs to be fired. You have to take this class, so my best advice is to learn the simulation in the first two weeks using the manual, Reddit, Youtube, and friends that have taken the class before. I had a terrible TA (Ike), but managed to still get a good grade, so you can too. It is a LOT of confusing busy work.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: I can not believe I paid money to take this utter disgrace of class. Smeal should be ashamed to force their students to enroll in such a useless class. It is safe to say you will not learn one thing...completely unorganized and not realistic.

don't know what to say. I can understand why Smeal force us to take this course but don't understand why there are only one professor nancy. If ur laptop can't open the webcam or speaker, then the TA will tell u drop it.
worst in the worst. Even the TAs are..........

People overestimate this class. It's easy. Take Async, skip lectures, watch the 40 min youtube video and that's all you need for the entire class. Yes there are group projects so it is luck based but its not hard. Most smeal grads have worked so its not bad. Get a good TA as they will be doing all the grading.
!!!!! TAKE THE ASYNCHRONOUS SESSION !!!!! It is 10000x times better and you can record your presentations instead of doing it live

This is by far the worst class I've ever taken at Penn State. It is horribly organized, extremely confusing, and an utter waste of time. If you get an incompetent TA/group, the class will be even worse.
This class is just pointless

Class fully based on your TA with group projects. Take the asynchronous lecture and don't watch it. It's not worth it. The class is based on some online simulation and if you don't understand it, you won't get a good grade. Too bad this class is mandatory for Smeal majors. They offered 2% extra credit but still tough.

This course is just like HELL... Every single word the TA says was unclear and the professor was not reachable after class at all. Can't believe this is a mandatory capstone course for graduation from Smeal.
Very confusing, never clear about what needed to be done, the online set up is confusing as well and information is scattered.

This professor is not involved in the class whatsoever. You are 95% interacting with the TA. You will want a great group and Jerry as your TA otherwise you will probably be stressed out of your mind. Capsim may seem impossible but I promise you'll be okay. Don't want YouTube videos on it, they go by different criteria.

The work in this class is not difficult and most TA's grade easily. That being said, everything in this class feels like a waste of time. The projects are all assigned as group assignments, yet they are all structured as individual projects. This leads to one person doing 90% of the work for the entire group. Frustrating and pointless class.
Did not really see a point in this class. It is not realistic like they say, and was a waste of time. The class was pretty easy at least.

Boring and useless class. Total waste of money and time, don't know why Smeal force students to take this class that does not help us in any shape or form. Should have let us pick an additional class instead of taking this useless class.

This is by far the most unorganized class that I have taken in college. This is the sole reason why I won't ever continue my academic career past my undergraduate. Everything in this class is sugarcoated as being "realistic to the business world", however I have doubts to seeing any of this in the next five years of my life, or ever.

Boring class, the whole class is based around Capsim and mostly teamwork. Pray you have competent teammates who actually put in work or else you will be doing everything yourself for the entire semester. Do not know why Smeal forces us to take this useless class. Waste of money and time

Professor McClure was the only option for BA411 but the class isn't too hard. It's based on a simulation that you will buy at the beginning of the semester and work for a few weeks individually and then in groups. It also group project heavy and no exams. Your TA grades everything so as long as you improve and work well in your group be fine.
This class was honestly a joke. It is crazy that smeal makes you take it. It was the biggest waste of time.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: To succeed in this class, you must understand how Capsim works and create a winning strategy. If you are an accounting major and taken managerial accounting, most of the material in this class will be a good review of what you have already learned. Make sure to check what criteria your TA grades assignments and work diligently to finish group works

Students complaining about capsim and how difficult it is are the same students who rode the coattails of their peers all the way to a degree. Basic knowledge of inventory management and product positioning and you will be fine. Lectures are pointless as the information provided is just formulas hat will need to memorized anyway.

Lectures are a waste. Have to go to lab. Group project after group project and it is terrible. Class is so poorly set up and you do group projects on one person's work so they get stuck doing it. Page limits are insanely short and you can never fit everything you need. Not a fun class and learned nothing. Possible to do well if you put in effort

Prof McClure is really nice to students. It is not possible to learn and achieve without spending time and effort. All negative reviews are from those horrible students who do not know how to learn and succeed in college. She is knowledgeable, kind, and responsible, you'll learn a lot as long as you are willing to

This class prepares us for future workplace. Those who say she is awful do not know how to learn and obtain the most value from this class. Learning how to manage disagreement and conflict in a group and persuade the team to take a different strategy are valuable skills to all of us. Capsim can improve your ability to think comprehensively too.

She is the worst professor I have had so far. Her lecture is long and boring, grading criteria and instruction are unclear and frustrating. She emphasizes this class is for real-life business preparation, but the class content is not relating to any real-life business cases. They are just making it hard on purpose with unreasonable expectations.

She is the worst professor I have had so far. Her lecture is long and boring, grading criteria and instruction are unclear and frustrating. She emphasizes this class is for real-life business preparation, but the class content is not relating to any real-life business cases. They are just making it hard on purpose with unreasonable expectations.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This is the single worst class at Penn State. It is horribly unorganized. Your TA determines the majority of your grade. Most of the grade is based on a team simulation that caters to accounting and finance majors. If you're not one, good luck. If you are one, get ready to do all the work. This class should not exist.
The worst professor at Penn State. Attending lectures is useless because you won't understand her illogical explanations and constant use of abbreviations.

This is the only time I have given a professor a 1.0 rating. Professor McClure has a disposition that makes you feel bad for asking a question, even in her office hours. Outline for class: 2 exams(1 dropped), in-class quizzes, TA assignments. Your TA determines 75% of your grade based on CAPSIM/assignments. Exam has 5-6 questions we never learned.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Group projects

reviews.comment: The worst class I have never had for three and half years college life. More than half of the grade comes from group projects that graded by TAs. So MAKE SURE you find a easy grader. Some of my friends presentation just screenshoot template and gets 10more points than my group. Try your best to do well for exam 1 cuz exam 2 will be damn hard.

I can't believe how disorganized and unprofessional this class turned out to be, basically run like a kindergarten class. The material is not that difficult it's just that she is inconsistent in assignment turn in dates (8pm or 8am?), teaches math concepts a day before the exam, and puts so much emphasis on accounting/finance that I will never use.
one of the worst classes in PSU confirmed
I do not understand what the real world application is to this class
Very unclear class. Extremely frustrating!
Confusing class. Not applicable to the real world
Avoid this course
The course is extremely disorganized

If theres one thing I remember from this class its yo-yos, pickles, and starbursts. I never knew someone could tie business topics into those three things. One time my phone rang and I was so embarrassed cuz mommy knows better.

Got B-, but only went to 1 class so low participation grade. Class I went, she read thru slides, very boring. Grade weighted 50/50, class/lab. Pray you get a lenient TA. 2 exams based off of lab assignments. Quizzes at end of every class so go. Lab  Capsim, search online for guides, put effort in, you'll get the hang of it & beat other teams.

Go into BA 411 with an open-mind despite these reviews. This class is not difficult if you study for the exams and follow guidelines on group projects. CapSim also is not that difficult to understand especially after going through countless practice rounds. As long as one person in your group understands the simulation you will be more than fine.

Never had a more disorganized, pointless, and just plain ridiculous class at PSU. Considered a "capstone" course for the business majors but unless you're finance/acct, you'd better be prepared to suffer through hard tests and the stupid simulation worth a hefty 50% of your grade. She's also quite disrespectful to kids if they don't understand.

Does not do a great job when it comes to preparing us for exams! Tells us what to study but questions appear totally different on exams! Drops lower exam of the 2 exams. Basically threw Capsim at our faces and expected us to figure simulation out w/o any in-class training. Class average was a 45-50% on simulation. Luckily the class was shown mercy
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Exams can be difficult. Expects you to memorize a lot of financial ratios for exams. Group assignments are okay but the TA's grade hard.

I just have to say I have never taken a class that is more a waste of my time. It isn't that the class is hard or anything it is just absolutely pathetic that this is a required class for all Smeal students. Little to no real world relevance and painfully unproductive lectures. We pay a ridiculous amount to go to this school- do better "Smeal"
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: The worst & most useless class within my 3 years here. Everything taught is acct & finance based only. The CAPSIM module is the biggest waste of money and time, and literally no one knows what they're doing. She teaches a bunch of formulas once a week, and you're expected to know them all for the pollock test. The TA group work is half your grade
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: This class is as bad if not worse than the reviews here.

This is by far the most pointless class I have taken here at Smeal. It is incredibly time consuming. The "game" is super complicated and her lectures give you zero guidance. The lectures are you just wasting your time once a week for a stupid 5 question quiz. Honestly I dont understand how this is a required course.

a real tough class if youre not accounting or finance or actuarial sciences. tests are basically all finance and accounting ratios and problems. she does drop one test though which is nice. CAPSIM is based on effort. TA determines your class experience. some are tough, others are easy. Pretty much all group work. lecture has end of class quizzes

Lets just say I will be sending a request to Mr. Dean Whiteman for my money back for these tuition credits. Nancy McClure is everything that is wrong with Smeal. She is here to collect tenure. She should be teaching at State College Middle School.

She is a very nice person and is very intelligent, so it is hard to rate this class so harshly. I am NOT an accounting major, but this is definitely an accounting/finance oriented class. So for me, it's super hard and does not seem relevant to me at all. All business majors must take it so there's no way around this pointless class. TA's grade!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: This class is as boring as anything but Nancy is NOT A BAD TEACHER! If you ask her a question after class she essentially solves your problem in minutes. The class isnt about having your business kill its competitors, its about you understanding what is actually going on during the simulation. If you dont understand, she can summarize the solution.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Lectures are boring and arguably pointless beyond the scope of the class. It's pitched as being very real world applicable, but she teaches the class as if real businesses run based on the CAPSIM manual.   Graded by MBAs and many MBAs have no business background and know significantly less than undergrads and give pointless feedback and deductions
This class is about as useful as a white crayon. Unfair to accounting/finance majors who have to carry their groups.

This class is horrible, but there's no way to avoid it. Lecture is really boring, but you have to go for the quizzes. Most assignments are group based and graded harshly. The TA's are not helpful; wanted more detail in the assignments but took points off for being over the page limit. There is 1 exam, must study. Easier for ACCTG/FIN people

You have to go to her lecture's for credit one day and the other day is just the TA so you don't have to go. Your grade depends on the TA you get (beware of Chand). She won't give an extension on an assignment even if you have a medical excuse. Her test is kind of easy if you are an accounting major, but it is hard if you aren't. Office hours suck.

I highly recommend everyone to take this class during summer session. There's no individual Capsim simulation, no individual papers, no lecture class. Every assignment is done within groups except for quizzes. Quizzes are individual and are not open book. But it's doable. You basically come to class and do Capsim. I really enjoyed the class!

The lecture was pointless. She did give clear instructions about assignments but a lot of it was dealt with during the lab sessions anyway. Basically, if you don't have questions to ask her, it's really boring. My friends and I only went to class for the quizzes, which are group work and are a pretty easy way to bump up your grade.

The biggest thing I didn't like about this class is that she asks tons of questions that you have to answer for papers, but doesn't give you enough pages to answer them. Then when some details are missing, you lose points for not having enough detail. The TA's are instructed to lower your grade to fit the curve if the class average is too high.
Worst class of my college career. Useless

Honestly the class is a good idea but with awful execution. To earn an A mark you need an 94? Half of your grade is dependent on group work and Nancy just stops teaching half way through the semester. Luckily you can buy extra credit!

Save yourselves some money and don't buy the book. Which is composed completely of articles. All the articles can be found on PennState databases primarily Business Source Premier. Major inconsistencies between the Instructor & TA's when it comes to assignments.
So bad! Nancy is extremely condescending and was on a power trip the whole semester. She put no effort into the class. I am shocked that Smeal makes this mandatory. Completely pointless.

The idea of this class is good, but Nancy executes it terribly. Her lectures are absolutely pointless, and her quiz questions are ridiculously specific. The simulation itself is kind of cool, but the papers you have to write give you little to no proper guidance. This class would likely be much better if Nancy weren't the teacher here.

This is supposed to be a capstone course for senior business majors to incorporate all we've learned in the past 3 years. As the end of the semester is arriving, I can't really say I learned anything from the simulation or the assignments. The class is very unorganized and my TA did more for this class in one week than Nancy did the whole semester.

She does not teach. There is one lecture a week and one TA session (Tas vary greatly).  Lecture is useless except for easy scantron weekly quizzes.  HEAVY group work.  Do not take with other classes when you have a lot of other group work.  Hard to get above a B on papers.  Easier for finance/accounting majors.  Not taught how to write efficiently.

This is the worst class I have taken at Penn State. My TA was extremely hard. Nancy does absolutely nothing in this class other then her once a week lectures, which she talks about nothing relevant. Avoid at all costs

I highly recommend taking the accelerated section if you want to be an entrepreneur. You work with a group of students from different majors to start up a new company in State College. The assignments are completely different from the syllabus. Also, the grading scale is skewed for a better grade.
Easy class

Plain and simple, this class sucks.  How a 400 level class can be run based on a game baffles me.  There is so much inconsistency in the grading between the TA's.  Your grade in this class depends on your group and your TA.  There's a lot of buffer points built in though so you should walk away with a good grade.

Really easy prof... gives you all the quizzes ahead of time and lets you work on them together in class. Lab for this class sucks, but if you attend lecture and fill out the peer evaluation forms, that's an easy 30% of your grade.

This class is ridiculous. very hard. exams are close to impossible unless you have alot of accounting knowledge before hand. I received my first C+ at penn state with this class. I had a 3.99 before this class. I worked hard and did ALL the work and even attended office hours... this really didnt help. teacher not helpful & doesnt teach to the exam

I would say this is one of the easier of the 400 level classes. She had 4 exams (including the final) worth 16% each. The rest was hw/quizes/practice exams outside of class you should get a 100% on. The actual exams wern't bad (read the book and study the practice exam). Going to class didn't seem to help much except the day she went over p.exams

Very helpful if you actually participate in class and try to learn. Tries hard to answer related questions and does a great job initiating discussions. She is well versed and can help in understanding many area's of business. Read the book and you'll do fine.

If you can, avoid her! The TAs have no consistency in their rubrics and the prof does not account for this with a curve so I knew groups that put in zero effort getting the same grades as groups that put in 100%. The material is very finance and acctg oriented so make sure you have these majors in your group. Overall, a horribly structured class.
Not the best class. to take with her.The exam r a collection of random facts.
Avoid taking her for BA411. You will have to teach yourself everything. Also, she focuses the classes on Acctg, even though it is a general business class. TA's do all of the work.

Nancy is the worst!  Her exams are not about what you have learned but strictly based on memorizing stupid facts and dates.  She does zero work for this class considering she has like 30 TA's and they do absolutely all the grading.  She acts like this is an Accounting class even though it is not and focuses too much on ratios and crap.DO NOT TAKE!

She's soooooooo nice. She is really willing to help you in just about any class you have accounting-wise. She does focus on Capsim wayyy to much, its her life. Overall though, the class is real easy if you understand the simulation.

Avoid for this class at all costs.  Papers were graded extremely unfair and had points taken off because the charts at the ends were different colors and the grading rubric is not followed and points get taken off for things that we were never told to put in the papers to begin with.  Learned nothing and geared toward accounting majors

DONT TAKE BA411 WITH HER! she is a horrible teacher and exams (only in her section) are out of the e text she makes u buy for 80 bucks. she cant lecture and her grading scale is way off. First exam avg was below a 60 percent and no curve. Avoid at all costs.

Worst professor ever!  Has no concern for due dates, 1st group paper due day after THON with only 6 total days to complete, second due wed after spring break, teaches nothing in class, 1st time for exams in 411, takes points off papers for going over page maximum but not being in-depth enough. Avoid at all costs! THE WORST! prob Y acct @ PSU sux

Wouldn't call her a teacher, all we do is simulation and we have no idea what we are doing. I have no idea what is on the exams and the class is a joke. She requires us to read so much, so far we are 2 months in and she has taught 3 lectures

She is a very nice lady, but her lectures are mostly right from the book and don't really explain anything further. Preparing for the exams, which are challenging, is pretty much up to you. The majority of the class is the business simulation in groups, which is fun. The simulation assignments are easy. Study hard and you will do fine.

A lot of group work.  Nice prof - she talks about whats happening in the real world which I like.  Would go to her for career advice in the future.  Easy class - midterms are hard but curved at the end of the semester & the papers are easy (all group).  Capsim simulation is fun.

McClure is a great professor. This class is easier than her 471 class, but she still challenges you none the less. The business simulation was a lot of fun. She was always willing to meet for extra help - even for accounting classes that she wasn't teaching.

I felt she was very helpful.  Her tests were super easy.  Some how I needed one accounting credit to graduate and she was the only professor who would let me present in class.  I thought she was a fantastic person!

You want a accurate rating of this professor? LOOK HERE.  Nancy Mcclure is HELPFUL, but that only takes you so far when what she gives doesn't prepare you for the exams at all.(notes straight from text, no practice exams, etc) BOTTOM LINE Fall 07 AVG through 2 exams:61 other profs:78-87 BIG DIFFERENCE How can that distribution be justified as fair?

You're going to have to work hard in this class. I know that automatically makes her a bad teacher. She will answer any and all questions. She's always available for help. She has a sarcastic sense of humor and I really enjoyed her class, but you're going to need to hit the books hard. I feel better prepared than students who took other professors.
Horrrrible. Just don't take her. It will make your life so much easier, it's that simple, just don't take her even if you need to.

I really like Professor McClure. The class is difficult and she refuses to pass people who think they can coast through the class, which is a good thing. She is always interested in helping students in office hours and restructuring her teaching methods based on class requests and recommendations. She's not lazy. Whoever calls her lazy prob failed.

This professor was terrible, did not teach what was to be tested on exams, went over problems that were not even close to the ones she tested on. She also gave no help when other professors were bending there backs to make sure that their students would pass. Sought pleasure out of failing more than half of students because she frankly could.

She's a nice lady and has a sense of humor.GO TO HER CLASS ONLY ON QUIZ DAYS!! She usually reads right from the Powerpoints so if you can understand the textbook just read it and save yourself some time. The quizzes are extra credit so TAKE then SHE RARELY will curve. If i would of taken more quizzes i would of had an A!

This lady is the worst teacher I have ever head. She is like a wannabe partner in a Accounting Firm. She thinks we are professional accountants and teaches us like that too. I would never take her, I would not that class if I had to take her. Dont make the mistake I did, she screws people on exams and especially the Final. DONT TAKE HER. SYS.
No Comments

what can i say? it's acct 211 so of course it's boring and it sucks! notes are directly from the power point so you might as well just print them out. staying after the lecture to work through the problems and the practice exams are very helpful for the  exams. she will try to help you if you stick around.

Half of class was spent working on a simulation game (same one as in BA411). Lectures were extremely fast paced and hard to follow. Everything I learned was from the text book. You have 3 papers and 2 exams (which were difficult - 50% of grade)

She was the worst teacher I have ever taken in life! that is not an exaggeration. i am a dean's list student, and she made it impossible to learn. class average was a 61.3% at the end of the semester. Everyone I know hated her as much as I did, and dreaded her incomprehensible BS exams! WORST TEACHER ALIVE! wait teacher is me being too nice!
She doesn't know how to teach .. I gave up and stoped going to her class.. on top of that .. EXAMS ARE REDICULASLY HAARD !!... AVOID AT ALL COSTS !
very lazy ... HARD EXAMS ... TEACHING STYLE S*CKS !!!   AVOID HER !

your grade depneds on how much YOU put into it, read the book, nancy if VERY willing to help if you approach her, wont learn much through class, much read the text and teach yourself, simulation is fun and teaches you alot, overall a very fair and interesting class
No Comments

You basically have to teach yourself everything. What she goes over from the slides is nothing really like whats on the exams. Shes does try to help as much as possible when you do your problems during the class period. She does curve a decent amount, I got an A and finished with b/t an 82-84 avg. So I really can't complain too much. Nice lady.
I feel that the professor gave up after two weeks.  The 'challenge problems' were so challenging that the professor could not even help you.  I pity the next person who sits in her class.

she is lazy, and if the slides/problems arnt provided by the publisher, you dont see it.  the slides do not cover what you need to know.  the exams and concepts are fairly easy, but you need to teach urself, class is worthless to go to.  its a 15 minutes lecture and an hour of nothing.

She doesn't really make the students do that much work except for the projects which are very easy.  The class is curved tremendously at the end and most people end up with high grades.  She's very nice and is always willing to help the students.
She was a good teacher. Had her at 8am so that was not good, and rarely saw her, but she was there to help when you were in attendance.
she is overall a good teacher and a good class is you follow the format as given.  tests are right from the review sheets...got a good grade and didnt do a thing.

Steals all notes and projects out of textbook that is not used in the class.  Often explains things blatently wrong.  Material really wouldn't be that hard if she could explain it.  Took over a month to grade a project, then gave us our grade at the final

She isnt very helpful in answering questions. if you ask her for help she just gives u the answer without telling you how she got the answer. She assigns a lot of work and doesn't do anything herself. Why assign work if you cant grade them

She really knows her accounting because she has worked in the real world, but she doesn't produce any of her own material.  She uses the book's powerpoint slides and homework answers.  She is very willing to help, but VERY BORING.

Brings a new meaning to the word lazy.  Her notes and tests are from the book, and don't even think about asking her a question cuz she'll just read the notes again.  The projects are long and boring.  It's SO bad I made everyone drop it for next semester

Dang she's lazy.  Doesn't lift a finger for this class yet she expects a buttload of work from her students.  The classes were a very painful 2 hours long. I received an average grade in the class so that has nothing to do with her being utterly horrible
Avoid! I think he enjoys marking students down for fun. He definitely does not respect students and his reputation has really gone downhill. Don't expect to get an A.

This is for AFAM 502. Class is really disappointing. West micromanages the reading and there is way too much of it, nor is it interesting. I have to say I have lost so much respect for him while taking this class. Also for all the bad decisions he's been behind in the AFAM department.

He's slipping! Does not seem on the ball these days. Class is scattered and disorganized. We only meet once a week but he can't sustain the discussions or the topic. Seems preoccupied and not fully present. Dr. West, are you OK?
Class only meets once a week which is a good thing because it is very boring. He likes to hear himself talk.

I took the honors section of this class and let me tell you, for honors it was not very structured. He strayed from the syllabus multiple times and he was disorganized to the max. He was a nice guy but a not so great professor. His grading was always unclear as well. If you do not read the weekly readings, you will not pass this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He was recommended so I thought the class would be better than it was. He's not the worst, but I agree with the other post that said he takes extremely interesting people and events in history and makes them so unutterably boring.

I expected better. So very dull and I leave class with all inspiration sucked out of me. His grading is confusing and rigid. He's rigid. Also, I swear he lied to us a couple times and then played it off when caught. Weird guy. Avoid him.

Dude has probably been teaching the exact same curriculum, same assignments, same lectures for the past 40 years. I don't think he knows how to use the technology in the room. I wish he were more interesting. I can barely understand what he says because he mumbles and has an accent.

How can anyone make Malcolm X boring? Somehow he manages to make one of the most intriguing political figures in history uninspiring. Too much reading and he drones on and on. I've had it with this class and I have yet to take a good class in the dept. No wonder it has such a bad reputation. Please get better teachers. This one is terrible.
Don't bother. Not a great professor. He made so many factual errors throughout the semester and covered it up by lying which was pathetic. I was embarrassed for him.
Good professor who knows what he is talking about. A lot of reading and participation is necessary but not too bad. Very funny guy
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor West is insanely intelligent. if you do not do all the readings, you WILL fail his class. All readings are provided on Canvas, and he is specific about grading but very detailed regarding what he's asking of you. Tests are based on lectures and readings, but he does not use slides at all, so you MUST take notes during lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Respected

reviews.comment: His lectures can be very boring and hard to pay attention to. He is a fairy difficult grader in my opinion, and you MUST do the readings to pass. The readings are long and absolutely necessary to get a good grade in this class. He was hard for me to understand sometimes as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Dr. West doesnt sugar coat things but he does make it plain. Hes an amazing scholar and you better listen up, do the reading, and apply yourself. You will learn SO MUCH. He also teaches in the history dept. I want to take another class from him.

Brilliant guy! I loved his lectures. You definitely have to do the reading if you expect to do well in his class. I recommend going to his office hours. He may come off as cold and inscrutable in class, but he has heart and will really try and help you if you make an effort. Super smart professor with a revolutionary, Black power worldview.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. West is the best. He is brilliant and precise, and has remarkable knowledge of his field. You will learn A LOT and feel smarter once the class ends. Lots of reading and he expects students to apply themselves. If you are ready to learn, then take his class. He is a real old-school, disciplined scholar, respected in his field.

Professor Norvell is super engaging. It was one of my favorite classes I've taken and he's really great at making them interesting. There were five tests and they can be slightly challenging if you don't study hard but it's just memorization. The only grades really are test and he doesn't post his notes so make sure to show up to every class

Prof Norvell is probably my fav professor ive taken at this university. Although the class itself is difficult, only based on 4 tests, one assignment, and participation; if you keep up with the notes and attend class you will be fine. He is also very funny and understanding of external circumstances and always has a smile on his face.

Be ready to take notes in class, he doesn't posts his slides, so the whole class is making sure you get a photo of the slide before he changes it within the next second while he's still lecturing away.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: he's a lawyer and he's brilliant because he knows real world things. Ive taken a class w him every single semester ive been here

The best professors I've ever had at Penn State. Very engaging and interesting in class. You can truly tell he has had a lot of experience and love what he does. Def read the textbook and make flashcards if you take this class!
Very funny and pretty straight forward lectures. Make sure to at least review the textbook before tests, and pay attention during reviews!!

Professor Norvell was my favorite professor. He is funny, and has a lot of real world experience that he gives in examples in class. He goes pretty fast through slides, but before tests he went through what to expect and the textbook covered everything. Tests are not MC but doable if you study and pay attention. He responds to emails very quickly.

His lectures are interesting, but he's all over the place and goes very fast, making it kinda hard to get all the info down. Doesn't post slides, so show up. Grade is mostly exams, and the exams are mostly free response, so be ready to memorize a lot for them. If you show up and turn in the participation assignments you'll get 100 for attendance.

Exams can be tricky as they are not multiple choice. But if you read the textbook and review your notes frequently you can easily improve. Very nice and approachable! Genuinely down to earth and cares about you succeeding in class. Also had an interesting career which he gives great insight on.

Professor Norvell was awesome!! Easily my favorite class I took this semester. Attendance is mandatory, but if you pay attention during class, it is easy to do well !! He does not post the slides or the lectures, which can be a pain, so it's important that you show up to class. Just pay attention, take good notes, and you will do well.

Dr. Norvell is a nice guy and professor, his lectures are interesting to listen to, he truly likes what he teaches. That being said Crim 113 is a very difficult course but a good one to take if you are headed into any form of government or law. There is only 3 Exams the Final and an in class case brief so one bad test will tank your grade.

Such a nice guy! Tests can be a little difficult if you don't study for them. Most are fill in the blank and short description with a few multiple choice/true or false questions. Lecture heavy so you will need to attend, otherwise just read the textbook. I would definitely take another one of his classes, great professor overall.
This is a must take class. He makes it so much more of an enjoyable class and makes the lectures so much more entertaining.

AMAZING professor. The most caring and respectful professor out there. His class is pretty hard and he moves through the slides quick. He also does not post them. However if you show up to every class and before the exam you should do pretty well.

If you have the chance to take a class with him, do it!! Absolutely my favorite class so far. He doesn't post the slides so you have to go to class, but he's very entertaining and it's worth your time. I genuinely feel like I learned so much in this class. If you attend class, take notes, pay attention, and study you'll have no problem getting an A
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is extremely entertaining and has great stories related to a lot of topics. Notes sometimes were hard to take, but his test reviews the day before basically summed up the whole test. Class is pretty easy if you're a good listener and go often.

Very nice guy, definitely cares about students and the topic. He does go through the slides super quick and doesn't post them so it's crucial to go to class and take notes. Go to class the day before the test, he'll tell you what's on it. There's only 4 tests so try not to bomb any. Pretty difficult for a gen ed but not impossible. I like him.
Might be the most difficult GenEd class I have ever taken. Try your best to take pictures of all the slides because you don't have any time to copy it down to the notes. Very funny professor.

Very funny. Definitely cares about his students and the lectures are usually engaging besides when you are scrambling for notes. Exams are very difficult and each test consists of 120+ textbook pages that you need to read to do well on the exam. For a Gened class I did not expect this to be my hardest class.

Very note and textbook heavy. Issue is taking notes in this class is virtually impossible with how quick he moves through the slides. He posts nothing on canvas so if you did not get any notes down you are beyond cooked. The exams are ruthless and half the stuff is on nothing that was talked about in class. Good luck is all I have to say.

Super funny guy, he makes you want to go to class. Go to class the day before the exam, it's a cheat code to do well on the test. Don't plan on taking any notes during class you're going to have no time too. He's worth it if you're a good listener. Super funny guy tho if u want to laugh during class take him. He also has good stories.
Great professor, super engaging. Make sure to show up to class, do the readings, and put in effort.

Professor Norvell is a very nice guy and he makes class exciting and engaging. My only gripe is he tends to be very tangential and hard to follow at times, and the reading for his class is simply absurd if you want to get an A. What he says in class is the test. Show up to class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This was one of the best professors I've ever had in my life. While there is a TopHat, he's the type of teacher that makes you excited for the next class. He teaches everything in a fun way, using real world scenarios when going through his notes. SUPER funny guy and genuinely taught me so so much.
Bad lecturer, hard quizzes
hes the GOAT

(Math 140) Professor Ramos is a nice guy. However Math 140 was difficult with him. His in class quizzes were very difficult. On several of them, the entire class couldn't finish within the time limit and there were back to back quizzes where almost everyone got a 0/10 - 2/10. He doesn't teach the material well, I had to learn most of it on my own

This guy gets hate for no reason in my opinion. THE CLASS is tough not him. He was trying his hardest and it was his first year ever teaching. The office hours and LA sessions helped so much and whenever you asked him a question he made sure to answer it. If you attend class and do your homework yourself you will receive a good grade.

Where do I even start with this man. Don't get me wrong, he is a very nice guy, always happy. But for the love of God, he can NOT teach pre-calculus. The quizzes were always very difficult. He does not know how to teach you concepts. You are better off self-teaching off of the Achieve E-Book. Please find another professor for this course.

This was the worst "professor". There is no point of going to class because you are going to have to teach yourself anyway. Very nice guy but he cannot teach pre-calculus! There was about 40 students on the first day of class and there was about 8 at the last class. The graders are extremely harsh and unfair. His weekly quizzes are impossible too.

Pretty chill professor. This class was the hardest I took last semester, but not in an unfair way. The times I spoke with him he was very friendly. Lectures can get dry and powerpoint-heavy at times, and there is a fair bit of memorization, but nothing impossible. Moderate amt of HW. I walked away with so much more knowledge on networking/telecom

Super deceptive teacher, he is very knowledgeable and jokes around in class which makes you think its going to be a fine course, but his workload is very heavy and he grades VERY harshly. Would not recommend at all.

This man replaced Professor Meky midway through the semester and ruined EVERYTHING!!!! Before, attendance was not graded or mandatory, labs were regular and normal, exams were online, and this man CHANGED THE SYLLABUS. We don't even know him and he's changing the entire dynamic of our class. NO ONE LIKES HIM!!!!!! DO NOT TAKE EVER!!!!!!
Professor requires way too much for simple assignments and if you don't meet his required "highlighting standards" he will grade you poorly.
Very strict grader and takes forever to get your grades back. I would never take him again.

Honestly, one of the better IST professors, he has good lectures, is very easy to get together with outside of class, and has competent TA's that help a lot. The class is very homework-heavy, but if you put a solid amount of effort into this class, it isn't hard at all. It is NOT an easy A. You do have to work for it, but an A is very doable.

DO NOT TAKE HIM

you're welcome

Suchan unnecessarily hard class and he teaches it so poorly Exams are in person on paper with no cheat sheet, he runs it like the military Claims that it's better than the Pollock Test Center but I'd rather go there for the rest of my life than take an exam in his class againLabsare ridiculousgetsmadandmarksyoudownifyoudon'thighlightthewayhewants.

The reports here do not do Giacobe justice. He is not easy, but he does care deeply about the success of his students. It's like tough love -- he won't sugarcoat anything, but if you put in the time, effort, and energy, the class is definitely manageable. His instructions on labs and homework assignments are very detailed, follow them closely.
Great professor, 440 is a difficult class but he makes it engaging.

To put it simply, the person in this class needs to have a psychological diagnosis. To be fair, Dr. G tried to make the lesson chill and easy, but the poor courseware and unreasonable grading still made the course deeply inhuman. I wouldn't recommend this course to any student in any major.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Not as hard as some reviews would have you think. Worth it to take 220 with Dr. G - he makes you actually learn. The class isn't easy, but if you put in the work it pays off. He's really good about holding office hours and the LA reviews are useful for the tests.

IST220 will be one of the hardest classes you will take and I recommend you take someone else for this class besides Giacobe. His grading is super strict, you will lose 15% of your grade if you forget to underline a screenshot. His classes are death by powerpoint and the exams are the polar opposite of what is covered in class. Do not take him.

Dr.G is a good profesor, but you must be willing to learn, meet with him, and study. If you are just taking the class for credit and do not want to learn then you will struggle. The tests cover a lot and he doesn't narrow down areas to study so make sure you have decent understanding of most areas of the material.

Avoid at all costs. I have never had a more disorganized prof. Lectures are him yapping about unrelated topics. No help or info on labs that require LENGTHY reports. Exam reviews are 10 seconds of him listing topics he THINKS will be on the exam. Ask him clarifying questions and you will not get answers. Even the Canvas modules are confusing.

DO NOT TAKE HIM! Unless you are ready for 100+ pages to read, boring lectures, and simple labs that are made to be more complicated than they should be. Choose another professor! Don't get me started on the exams, please heed my warning and choose peace/ protect your mental health or go for peer tutoring every week!!!!!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Good teacher overall, class is difficult but fair, provided extra credit opportunities which helped. Find good group members, the final project is a large part of the grade.

as a person, he is cool, but as a professor, just don't. this class is super difficult, the lab took hours to complete it and the grading is wayyyy too strict for a 200-level class. the LA helped a lot, but still, they are harsh graders.
i would not take a class with him EVER again

He is a nice guy. He obviously knows his stuff. But the ego with having the hardest IST class clearly took over. The grading in this class is ridiculous. He is terrible at explaining labs and gives no help. You will take 5 hours sometimes on them, get mostly everything righ,t but get given a 29/40 because of improper annotations.

In retrospect, this class was not that bad. Make sure you make at least one friend/study partner. Having someone to study with and work on stuff was a game changer in this class. The assignments are more time consuming than they are difficult, but you can work through them. The exams were pretty tough. Last few grades clutched up tho and I got a B.

He was a good guy but the class was hard. The more help you get the easier it gets. You would have to go to ist help for labs if you are not a computer nerd. Essays on every exam with cumulative final, no cheat sheet, no review sheet, and no curve is not the most ideal situation.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: If you want to feel actual pain, take this class with Giacobe. That's all.

This class was easily the hardest IST class I have taken. The TA's were difficult to get a hold of to schedule office hours. Multiple times I had to advocate that a grade I received was lower than I deserved and asked for points back. there are 2 midterms and a cumulative final that are extremely content heavy and include an essay portion.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. G is the dude! Very knowledgeable on any Cyber subject and his lectures are very informational. Quizzes are open note, powerpoints are published online, and he assists you throughout the labs in class. Group projects is also fairly easy. We barely used the textbook, so find a PDF online rather than blow $150. Other than that, would take again.

If you take Cyber 440 online beware. He does NOT communicate, grades things extremely late. We are currently sitting on the last week of class and half of the semester's assignments still are not graded. Expects deep dive analysis when he only "teaches" surface level analysis. The course is heavily disorganized and is not student friendly. Awful.

The labs are the killer in this class if you are able to complete the labs right then you should get a good grade. The exams and weekly quizzes are pretty easy. However, it is a lot of work should be a 4 credit class bc/ the labs take like 4 hours.

I like him, others don't. I happen to be a networking geek and so is he. I found the class to be easy. He held office hours until midnight 3 times a week. His exams are short and content-heavy, the labs+reports aren't fun but the weekly reading quizzes are fine. If you like to think and learn, take his class. If you don't, don't take his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Hard class even for computer nerds, but it's worth it in my opinion. His lecturing isn't the best, but he is fair and knows what he's talking about. This will probably be your first roadblock in the IST curriculum if you're putting in half-effort for the rest of your classes (me, I failed the first exam), but go to office hours and you'll be good.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: IST 220 is difficult, but I felt like Dr. G helped navigate me through the course well.  3 difficult midterm exams, labs, and homework took up a large chunk of the final grade.  Took a long time to get grades back, and sometimes did not know my true grade for weeks on end.  Group project at the end was not bad.  Great guy, very difficult class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This is a hard class in general, but I think that Dr. Giacobe does a good job. The TAs grade most of the work. Dr. Giacobe takes awhile to grade exams sometimes. The exams and homeworks are pretty difficult. Definitely a class that you have to put work in to do well, do not expect to just show up to class and do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Giacobe is a great instructor and you will learn a lot... if you try. DO NOT EXPECT JUST TO SHOW UP AND PASS. 3 Huge Exams where I know people were not studying and getting 25% on. Great guy, great info in class, hard to get a good grade.

Dr. G will make you really work for a grade. Don't expect to slack off and get by. He is very nice and understanding, so don't hesitate to go to office hours or shoot him an email if you're in need. Will also give great professional advice as well.

Tough class given curriculum you take throughout your career. He is willing to work with students, has good career advice, cares about his students. He favors those with technical skill. Never grades anything on time -- beware of this.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: As a 200 level class I can confidently say he gives more work than a 300-400 class which is absolutely absurd. Kids won't learn If you're constantly throwing new topics non stop. On top of the weekly quizes and the two biweekly labs and homework. He expects you to do 4 exams that are extremely difficult. Half the class received a near failing grade
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment:
Real easy class, a few tips.

2. Read through the textbook, do the quizes, labs, and homework.
3. GO TO THE REVIEW SESSIONS BEFORE EXAMS, THEY HELP YOU SO MUCH. 

Last tip, 1337.

yeah that's about it giacobe chill
He's cool just study you'll be fine

I feel like I barely learn anything by attending class. He has many contributions to the school doesn't means he is a good teacher. Advice: you will not learn any in class. reviews.comment: Would absolutely never take this professor again. He never grades anything so you don't know your grade in the course.
