reviews.comment: He does not know how to relay information. All class-based off memorization of hundreds of slides and hundred of textbook pages. He is frequently assigned in groups of 60+ pages. His lectures were very dull because he was just reading directly from the slides. He takes forever to grade anything.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very difficult professor to learn from. He FLIES through the lectures, and never asks if he needs to repeat something or explain something again. Grading is very strict, and your grade rides on the labs, which are very tidious to complete. Keep in mind that it takes him weeks/months to enter grades into Canvas, so you won't know your grade.

This class is TOUGH. You have to study/memorize the small stuff. Ex. Knowing HTTP response codes, port numbers, and private IP addresses. If you're struggling, you have to ask either the teacher, the LA's, or other classmates for help, otherwise you will drown.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Quite possibly the laziest professor I have had to date and simply not being in his class has lightened my workload ten-fold. He puts absolutely 0 effort into his teaching by reading directly from powerpoints; the driest class I've ever had. Paying attention is an absolute must, but there is absolutely 0 notation between what's important and not.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This is for IST220 and my second time taking Giacobe. I feel he is a good fit for a class and clearly knowledgeable on the subject. The majority of the class was as expected with a reasonable number of homework and labs. He was flexible with the timing of these which was nice. The 4 tests were the hard part and perhaps excessive(one gets dropped).

Dr. Giacobe has become one of my favorites at Penn State and he truly cares about his students and their understanding of the topics at hand. His class can be dry at times and it is pretty lecture heavy, but the effort you put in is what you'll see in your grade. Super chill professor and will go any lengths to help you out.

During class he just reads off the slides . Also you are required to read chapters weekly and each chapter in the book is about 80 pages long along with quizzes too. His homework's and labs are long and are required to do a lot of useless things. He is also a tough grader in which you fail one exam you are basically done for. Be ready for alot
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: In this class he just reads off of the slides that the textbook has made, I was looking forward to learning something but really ended up being bored. Doesn't really care about the students and the grading is a little harsh with little explanation as to what you did wrong. Be prepared to study for the tests as you cover a ton of information.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: not sure what i did/learned in this class to be honest. seemed like a mixture of sra111 and sra221. kind of felt like a waste of time. giacobe seems nice and friendly. responds to canvas messages quickly and is very flexible with time. he will hold office hours till midnight for big assignments/tests. weekly quizzes for each chapter.

Dr. Giacobe is absolutely one of my favorite professors in IST. I took him for CYBER 100 and CYBER 262. He really cares about the class and does a great job providing engaging lectures and meaningful assignments. His exams aren't too tricky and, as with all IST classes, there is a major group project.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: The entire course is very dependent on your own learning - his lectures are long, dry, and usually pointless. Assignments are very hard and vague, and grades don't go in for a while and it's pretty much the end of the semester. He is very belittling and makes you feel stupid if you ask him a question, or are confused about class material.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: One of the worst professors I've had. The class is hard to begin with and he offered zero help whatsoever. Class is extremely unorganized and barely any of the grades are in even though the semester is over. Labs are very difficult and what he teaches in class doesn't relate to them at all. No idea what will even be on the final

Horrible. Doesn't follow syllabus, office hours still say TBD 4 weeks into the semester. Lectures are boring and cover way more than you are tested on. Midterm was alright but need to study a lot. Labs are extremely difficult and when you ask for help, he seems like he barely has a clue whats going on. More than 1/2 of grades aren't in yet...

Professor Giacobe is extremely knowledgeable in his field, but is really ineffective in his teaching. He goes over a brief summary of the information in a PP slide, and at the end is a link that you have to go to in order to learn it to the level required to do well on the exams. Fortunately the material is not all that difficult.
Not supportive at all. Avoid him if possible.

Professor Giacobe creates tests on every chapter of the book that he has you read. As long as you read the chapter you will pass the test. For exams, they are more based on concept than individual ideas. Lectures are shot from the hip and are designed to answer any questions that people may have. Overall he is a good a professor, would recommend.
He is hilarious and a great teacher. Make sure you read and prepare for all of his quizzes. Check Quizlet for a lot of the quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He is a great professor. I would take one of his classes just to have him again. His lectures are interesting and he is funny. He is always willing to help you. Great guy.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Absolutely fantastic. Very clear grading criteria, funny, and is very to the point. If you don't pay attention, you won't pass. Giacobe makes you actually learn the material, rather than memorizing. Would definitely take again.

He teaches the class as if everyone in it is already super knowledgeable about the subject. Some of us were coming in with no prior knowledge. Doesn't expound on what he teaches. Great person, willing to give advice, but not a great teacher. Tests are hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: This class was really easy, I've heard that his upper level classes can be more challenging though. He likes to make jokes in class and his lectures can be pretty entertaining. His classes tend to have too much reading assigned than is reasonable. In the case of this class however, the content was so easy that most people would know it already.
Amazing professor: he is experienced, relatively funny, and is willing to help students with things outside class and will give advice if you ask for it. If you can take a course with him, do it.
He's pretty average. His tests are hard and lectures are boring.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: As long as you get all your stuff in and follow the rubrics youll do fine in his class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Dr. Giacobe was super heavy on book reading. He could have done a much better job of selecting only the important information instead of assigning the whole chapters. The actual grading wasn't that tough, but expect to skim the book instead of read it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Knows a lot about networking and is very credible. Tests and labs are somewhat hard, but he teaches a lot of good material in a clever way.
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GROUP PROJECTS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Terrible professor and grades everything at the end of the semester. There are no rubrics for projects which makes his grades seem very opinionated. Avoid him if possible
The worst professor I have had at Penn State. Belittles students and is extremely disrespectful.

I am not a fan of him. He gives you back grades for assignments he didn't even explain. If you try to ask why he won't give you a direct answer. Most vague teacher I've ever had. Don't bother trying to email, he never responds. He doesn't care about you or how you do. If you can take the class with another teacher, do it!
This guy could not care less about you or if you are learning.  You sent him an email?  Wait two weeks for a response.  Projects weren't graded until the semester was over.  Does not teach.

Dr. Giacobe is engaging as can be. Great sense of humor. He really has a knack for making the coursework interesting. That being said, his class is quiz-heavy. READ THE BOOK. If you ask him for help, he gives it readily. If you put in effort, you'll get a good grade. Also, he's quick to respond to emails.

Do not take SRA with him unless you have no other option!!! Yes, he is a charismatic person but not a clear teacher and makes the class harder than it needs to be. SRA 111 is a basic class and he treats the students as if we were all graduate students. Also, there is an attendance grade so you have to go to class or you will lose points!
Dr. Giacobe has a hilarious sense of humor.  His lectures are worth attending and his class is really easy.
He's the boy, very good teacher. Read the textbook and youre going to get at least an -A. Also very funny and makes class interesting
You read the whole textbook and took a quiz for each chapter, but he made the classes fun and the material easy to understand.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Professor Giacobe is a great teacher.  He is very clear about what he expects and the class is straight forward. Overall, he does a great job in teaching the material while providing in class activities instead of always lecturing.   If you do the work well and study you will be fine. Giacobe is always willing to help and has a good sense of humor.

Nick is a very helpful, hands-on professor. He will give you all of his attention when asking for help.  Hell, he'll even ask about YOU which you don't see in a college atmosphere all that often.  His class structure is very straightforward and he always lays out his expectations.  Aside from the occasional lack of organization, Nick is awesome.

Dr. Giacobe was phenomenal. He clearly lays out the course structure and expects readings to be done before class. The next class period, there's a quiz. Then he teaches about it. But it really works.
Gicobe is a tough grader but always willing to help. Very very funny lol

This class is easy, especially if you already know information security topics coming in.  Giacobe is not a good teacher, you're much better off just learning from the book.  Doesn't respond to emails and is not helpful at office hours.  Dropped my grade from A to A- for no reason. Avoid him, he will lower your grade for bs reasons.

My biggest problem was that if you didn't understand something the book said (which should happen since this is an intro course) you can study a lot and still not get the best grade.  If you already have a decent understanding of computers before the course though, I would definitely recommend him.  He's very easy going and laid back.

Giacobe is a very sharp guy, but it's obvious his research comes first. Not a very good professor at all. Very responsive but HORRIBLY vague in his assignment expectations. Answers that would be right anywhere else are not right with him. Makes class difficult simply for the sake of being difficult. Would not recommend.
Giacobe is not the easiest professor, but his expectations are not unreasonable. I learned a lot from this class. Expect weekly quizzes and a lab or homework assignment each week.
Class covers too much info and gives no exam guidance.  Hw/labs graded harder than they need to be. Final write up ridiculously long.  Avoid this guy for networking if possible.

Do not take him if you have the choice not to.  Everything is graded much harder than needed and exam covers well over 400 slides of information with very little guidance as to what is on the exam.  He really knows his stuff but basically assumes that everyone else gets it. Write ups for the final project are too long for no good reason. AVOID HIM!

This class is the worst class I have taken at Penn state. He covers like 90 pages in a class of 50 minutes with no one understanding a word. Class is MUCH MUCH MUCH MORE difficult than it should be, this guy is simply UNREASONABLE  ( Take it at your own risk, best of luck in advance)
Giacobe knows his stuff. The exams can be tricky, and the group project can destroy your grade. I wish he was a bit more clearer on what he wants you to know for exams.

Overall a very good instructor. He's a no-nonsense kind of guy but he's always happy to share his insight with you and is happy to help. No exams or quizzes in this class, so be prepared to actually do work on projects and homework assignments and you'll be just fine.

Giacobe has no textbook, no quizzes, no test, no final. All you do is is like 3 writing assignments, 6 take home assignments and 2 group projects. its super easy. The TA's do most of the work so befriend them.

Easily one of the best professors I've had at PSU. Seemed strict at first and I was worried about failing and currently have over 100% in her class. Super nice and is accessible if you need help. She gives A LOT of extra credit, and exams are open ended and graded very fairly. I wasn't even interested in neuroscience until I took this class.

Top 3 best prof at PSU, hands down. Seemed strict at first, & exams are open-ended, but she is SO understanding & helpful to clarify concepts in office hours, even future plans. Just studying, no HW. She structures grading & extra credit so you can easily do well. Incredibly intelligent & great lecturer. Go to class & you will be prepared for exams

Definitely goes through lectures quickly, but she makes sure to highlight the important info on the slides instead of just telling us to just "know everything". Exams look intimidating but are not bad if you study. Lowest exam dropped, majority of the class did not take the final. Lots of extra credit opportunities

This class was heavy on independent learning. I thought she went through the slides a little carelessly, most were very wordy so it was hard to understand what aspects were important. It is a difficult course, but the format of exams being only six open-ended questions made learning hundreds of slides of content a little counter intuitive.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dennis is amazing as a professor. Her lectures can be informative. Her exams are literal hell; she expects you to know the material front and back. I remember coming up with my own examples to better understand concepts, and she took away 8 pts because I did not use the textbook example. She expects you to know the studies by heart. AVOID IF U CAN.

Definitely one of my favorite professors. Extremely nice, caring, approachable, and seems to genuinely enjoy the material so lectures are not boring.
80% of the grade is based off the 4 exams, which are mostly short answer and fill in the blank, so you do have to know the material pretty well. 
Super interesting and enjoyable class + professor.

Lectures are very busy and can be a bit confusing to look at. Attendance isn't mandatory, but definitely go because sometimes she will mention things that will be on the exams. Exams can be tough, make sure that if you have any questions about your grade to go up and ask her to go over it, you may very well get points back. she will answer emails!

Dr. Dennis is great. There is no homework besides discussion board where you either ask questions or just give examples of what you learn in class. Exams are T/F, fill in blanks and short answers. It's not too hard as long as you pay attention and study. She gives a lot of extra credits for the exams which helped my grade a LOT.

I think she was nice but as previous ratings have stated, she got very defensive when we told her that we were all having trouble keeping up with her lecture slides and when we questioned her grading on one of the exams. It seemed impossible to get full credit on the short answer section on the exam. There were 4 exams and 2 papers and that was all
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dennis is very kind & smart; however, you also need to be an expert on the given material. Her exams are wordy, very info based. Rewatching recorded lectures was a blessing & a curse. Her short answers are worded heavily. She works very fast. Very few graded material. Be sure you have a lot of time to study the text... Good luck. Avoid if possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Ive taken so many psych professors and she's easily the worst one yet. She was defensive when the class called her out on wrong grading or teaching and wasn't nice about it. I'm even in engineering and she's one of my least favorite professors I've ever had. could be because I had her online but I always dreaded logging in to her class
What a wonderful way to mess up with your GPA. Essay questions are heavy in exams but she does not provide any study guides for them.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Shes nice and all but she goes through powerpoints way too fast and I feel like the test format makes things harder than it needs to be- especially the fill in the blank.

She is a great professor. Her exams can be tough though and you need to study because they are mostly fill in the blank and essay. Her lectures are very interesting and you can tell she is passionate about her work. 2 papers and random in-class attendance but overall would only recommend this class if you really like the topic.

Took her class in Spring 2014. She is by far my favorite teacher in Penn State! Her classes were very interesting and she does know a lot! PPTs are so well made and so clear I rarely used my textbook. There were four exams with 15% each so you have more chances, which is pretty nice. Two paper reviews 10% each, attendance 10%.

Tests are not multiple choice.  They are T/F, fill in the blank, and short answer.  If you attend class, make sure you understand the material, and study her power points, you should be fine.  She is extremely intelligent and knows what she's talking about.

Very lecture-heavy. There is a quiz every time the class meets, so attendance is mandatory. I felt unprepared and discouraged because she looked for specific quiz answers, which made it difficult to do well. The tests are 11 essay-style questions, which are also harshly graded. If you can take a different prof. I do not recommend taking this class.

If you're a CSD major, and there's another 300 section offered, take that one. All three of the exam averages were low C's because we all did not feel prepared, especially with the tests being essay and short answer format. Half of the answers students wrote on the tests would be crossed out or circled with no explanation why.

Many students struggled heavily in this class. No one felt prepared going into exams. The exams are all essays you have to choose 8 short answers that have to be 4-5 sentences each and the essays have to be at least a page each.  The final exam is cumulative almost studying 300 paragraphs worth of memorization word for word.
This course was as challenging as a college course should be. You need to study outside class to do well on the exams, but the content is really interesting and the professor gives good feedback.

The professor wasn't very approachable or understanding when students needed help. Exams are all essay questions, and it feels like there's only one “right” way to answer even if you have a solid explanation. The final exam is now mandatory and cumulative, and many of us felt unprepared going into it, and many students had a tough time passing.

This professor can come across as quite harsh and unsympathetic, and doesn't seem very supportive when students face difficulties. Her classes rely heavily on lectures and can be quite dull and monotonous.
Annie's classes are lecture heavy and require you to engage with the material, but she sets you up for success.

Don't listen to the bad reviews. It's not bad at all. Don't zone out in class, the slides are uploaded to canvas, but she doesn't include every bit of information,The class has three tests (the last optional).They're five essay questions but you can choose from multiple prompts. Just actually understand the material and be thorough in your answers.

The poor reviews don't really make sense to me. If your a CSD major, I don't see why you wouldn't enjoy this class. Prof Olmstead really wants you to learn. The formatting of the exams are difficult as it's 5 short answer but honestly if you just study & pay attention in class you'll do fine, it's not as hard as the reviews made it sound.

3 exams that are all essay only and she is a very tough grader. classes are all lectures and extremely boring. attendance isn't mandatory but you have a participation grade. she is nice but just not a good prof. final exam is optional and replaces your lowest grade even if your final grade is worse than your lowest grade so its a gamble.

Worst professor I have ever had at Penn State. Every exam is in essay format and are impossible to pass. You have to put exactly what she wants to get it right even if it is not even correct. Would never recommend her to anyone unless it's my worst enemy lol. Literally everyone in my class thought they were going to fail / did fail. DONT TAKE!!!!!!

Professor Olmstead is a great professor and she is accessible outside of class. The neuro class is very hard, but I think that she is very caring and does want us to succeed. You definitely have to put in the work in this class but I think it is worth it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I was initially worried about this course after reading the reviews on this website, but I was pleasantly surprised by how much I enjoyed the class and the professor. Lectures are very long, and she does a lot of talking, but I truly like listening. She's passionate about the subject and encourages students to be too.

I recommend taking CSD 300 with the other prof that offers this instead. While the class is not impossible, she will say one thing and then change it. There is a likelihood she will not work with you should you have to miss an exam. The final as an optional final that can replace an exam score. The final was take home and really helped my grade.

Easy to zone out-made like 5 slide lectures last 75 mins & rarely ended early. Exams are 5 questions ALL ESSAYS & closed note, but she gave partial credit. Towards the end, she became a much harder grader, almost as if she wanted us to get lower final grades. She calls on you randomly in discussions even if you don't have your hand raised.

Enjoyed her lectures and there was a lot of thought behind lectures. However it was easy to zone out because there is 6-8 slides for a 75 minute class. She is extremely nice, however an extremely tough grader especially at the end of the semester. I thought I could boost my grade doing the optional take home exam, but not really worth the time.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Friends of mine had this class years prior and warned me of how difficult it was going to be.  They said Professor Olmstead was a difficult grader spent the lectures writing on chalk board.  She changed her teaching format this year bc she had powerpoints that had all the info needed to succeed.  Written exams it was easy to bs, I always got an A.

This class was hard, but not impossible. You need to make sure you type out everything she says during lecture. She will often say something in class and then when asking her a question she will say something different, so make sure to check your notes with her. I recommend going to office hours with her before exams to read through your notes

Her class was difficult, but not impossible. Most of the content was comprehensible, and all of the notes taken in class truly reflect the test questions. If you actually take the time to study and pay attention in class, you will get an A.

Honestly do not have any good thing to say about her. She only talks during class in lecture form, which is fine, but does not provide any clear notes and the class is not organized well at all. She is very condescending and does not take any responsibility for us not doing well on exams, always says we need to “study harder”. Avoid this class

Possibly one of the hardest classes Ive ever taken. She claims she wants to help you and do everything she can but when you go to her office hours(just speaking with her after class because she doesnt have any)she is very rude and tends to talk down to u onhow you need to study more. Ive studied so hard for every exam and I could never do good
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She is an expert when it comes to communication sciences/disorders, but one on one I sometimes felt like she was looking down on me as a person and being very condescending. She can come off as passive aggressive or just plain rude at times but usually maintains her politeness. Just something to be aware of.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This was honestly the hardest class I've ever taken. She only graded us on about 6 assignments total, 3 of which were exams, one being a cumulative final. She was not flexible with student needs and had a no laptop policy, and also did not use any powerpoints or visual guides. Oh and her exams were always essay and FITB. Good luck.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Material is nothing like the tests. Studied for 12 hours and test was nothing like study guide/exam review. How does one try to derive and compute something we have never specifically seen before 20 times in 50 minutes. Avoid this class.

I don't recommend her for SCM200. She's a nice person but a bad professor. I had to late drop because exams are over 80% of your final grade in the class! If you bomb one you're done for. Zooms are pointless unless you have specific questions and HW takes ages because of the format. I got a 60 on one for forgetting equal signs in a few places!

Professor Blanco is a very good professor. I actually found that the flipped classroom style of the lecture videos and then zoom session was better. You get what you put into this course. The exams are difficult and in pollock, but if you study and review practice problems, you will do fine.
It's unreasonably hard. Not a good teacher either makes the easiest topics super hard to understand. Zoom is pointless just get ready to spend 2 hours analysing a 35-40 min video
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dont take this class. Do not take this prof.  You have to watch pre-recorded videos almost an hour long before every class. The zooms are pointless because you pretty much are teaching yourself statistics. The homework's have to be perfectly formatted and handwritten follow the template or you get a 0. Avoid this class at all costs.
WORST TEACHER EVER. She tries and say she is helping on the zoom but she literally doesn't. She is lowkey rude on email and doesn't let you see what you got wrong on the past exams.
The average on mulitple choice exams are in the 50s. She will not allow you to see your exams after to check what you got wrong

The zoom classes aren't helpful unless you want practice problems. It's like an asynchronous class because you watch the lecture before the class. The exams are really hard if you don't study, they have some very specific questions and all of the homework has to be written in a specific format

For SCM200 the "flipped" class means you watch a 45 minute lecture video and join a 50 minute zoom every day. Even though the zoom is mostly pointless. The content is tough, not impossible, but it goes extreamly fast and while Blanco provides lots of extra practice. If you ask a quesiton she is rarely helpful and sometimes refuses to answer.
Hard to learn from, takes away points for nothing, class is not mandatory but watching videos that last 30-80 mis is, if possible, takes huffs class

I took this class 2 semesters ago and I am still mad about it. Marilyn is the worst teacher in the history of Penn state. I'm not sure why this class is comparable to Stat200, because it is not even in the same stratosphere. It should be a requirement to become a wizard of mathematics. Seriously impossible class. Avoid at all costs.
Might be the worst taught class of all time.

This instructor has made this course unnecessarily difficult by abruptly changing the curriculum and grading with extreme harshness. Homework is graded like publishable research, not a learning tool. The course covers an unreasonable number of topics, yet the cumulative final is unpredictable and unfair. The worst professor of all time. DO NOT TAKE

reviews.comment: TERRIBLE TEACHER SHE SUCKS EVERYONE I KNOW IS FAILING THIS CLASS SHOULD BE FIRED AND BANNED FROM PENN STATE DO NOT TAKE HER TERRIBLE TEACHER SUCKS
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She was the worst teacher I've ever had. Listening to her talk is like listening to a fork getting scrapped on a plate. So many people I know have failed this class and aren't able to get into Smeal because of her. She won't curve when the average was a 55. She is a miserable old woman who has nothing better to do than screw over her students.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This might be the hardest class at Penn State. Mrs. Blanco might have the intentions of the entire class failing. I actually think the only reason she teaches is to get joy from the suffering the students go through for a prerequisite into the already wack business program. Definitely steer clear of Mrs. Blanco and her rain of terror. Thank you.

take stat 200. this class is ridiculously hard. extremely lecture heavy and she is a ridiculous grader. professor blanco does not give any helpful information to help you succeed in the course. the final exam is cumulative but somehow has only 20 questions. professor blanco might just enjoy seeing her students try and fail over and over.
She did not teach well and the way she provided us with the information was not good. It is like you are learning off of a youtube video. Take stat 200.
Take STAT200 horrible process, class is online and she doesn't help but tests are in Pollock and very difficult with very little ways to practice - only 6 supplemental practice problems per test

Marilyn is nice but MAN DON'T TAKE SCM 200.The class is all online, lectures that are optional zooms, with once a week optional help with an in person lab. The exams are in PTC and incredibly hard. You will learn nothing, and Marilyn isn't tech savvy so it will be very hard to be successful, even though she tries her best. PLEASE DON'T TAKE.
TAKE STAT 200. Class should not be hybrid. It should be completely taught in person. So hard for no reason.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This teacher was experienced but she made me feel as though I would think it is her first year teaching and that she hates teaching.

Please do NOT take this as the videos are recycled from previous years, and EVERYTHING must be taught by yourself. The Zoom sessions are only to answer questions. You will lose heavy points if you do not follow the guidelines strictly. does not care to fail her students. The course switched from online to pollock this year, and it doesnt work atall

Horrible would not recommend taking this class. Recently switched from online to in person tests and no adjustments have been made. Everybody I know is struggling, not nearly enough time for the tests.

please please please DO NOT take this. this course is online and the lectures are painfully boring. the homework is extremely time consuming and the tests are super difficult. the professor does not care if she gives you a bad grade and she isnt willing to help you. theres so many better professors out there so ur better off taking stat 200.

DO NOT take this course unless you want to teach yourself EVERYTHING and complete time consuming assignments. its fully online so you have to deal with LOTS of slow lectures and difficult exams at the pollock testing center. the professor is really strict and old fashioned so if you accidentally miss or forget something your grade drops like crazy.

DO NOT TAKE THIS COURSE, it's online and you have to do all the lectures on your own, you are better off taking STAT 200 offline, the professor does not make this course any easier. I highly discourage anyone to take this course. She is not a bad person, but this course ain't it.

Much much better than most smeal professors. Watch the lectures and take notes, you don't have to go to zoom but they help. She actually cares for her students and wants them to all do the best unlike most smeal professors. Lectures are pre recorded but as long as you actually learn the class it is easy and decently interesting.
boy oh boy DONT take this class the lectures are all pre-recorded and the tests are in pollack and are super hard
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: do.not.take.this.class the exams are in pollock now and they're so tricky, the homework she gives is so time consuming and the lectures are so boring 45-50 min each. save yourself and take it with another professor

Very sweet and willing to help, she wants the best for her students. Exams were easy, it's an online class so that helps immensely. The HW was sort of difficult at times but graded on completion, also reasonably spaced out to give you time to do it. HW had to be turned in on Canvas with a picture of your handwritten answers.

Ridiculously boring online lectures. Homeworks are extremely time consuming but are worth only 2.5 points each. If you want to learn statistics you'd be better off with the STAT professors despite them having lower ratings. If you just want to STAT out of the way it'll get the job done.

Don't make the mistake I did and get the flu before an exam, just try to power through and finish it online. If you reach out to her she is nice, but overall lectures are unhelpful. Literally the course objective is to "Follow Directions", so the homeworks are super picky. Honestly the most boring class I have taken at Penn State.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor is absolutely terrible. She does not care about her students at all. She doesn't teach. She gives you a video to watch and expects you to join a pointless zoom video. She is extremely rude and strict. If there is another professor you can take for SCM200, I would strongly recommend it.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: VERY old! Not very tech savvy, even though her entire class is online. Her entire canvas course is a maze. She tries to trick you on exam questions, and is incredibly picky with homework answers. The lectures are so long, and she talks so slow that it's painful. Honestly just teach yourself the material, it will be easier.
worst teacher ever!!

awful lectures. I would rather get waterboarded than watch her lectures. put them on 2x speed if you want to get anywhere. u don't rlly need to go to class. I knew most of the stuff from high school and YouTubed the rest of the info. the actual course is easy but lectures are incredibly awful. don't take this if u actually wanna learn something

not sure why anyone would give prof blanco a 5/5 rating I would rather watch paint dry than listen to her lectures. putting them on 1.5x speed is the only way I got through them. zoom classes are not mandatory. she has probably been teaching this course the same way for the past 25 years.not too hard though.

This class is so incredibly easy but the teacher is awful. She is not helpful in the slightest and booked me for an academic integrity violation that I'm not even guilty of. She has probably been teaching this class for 50 years and still teaches like it's the 50s. I haven't learned any useful information but still take this class it's easy.

God I never want to experience this course again when I am done. The lecture videos are equivalent to Chinese water torture. The way she talks so slowly and repeats every other sentence 3 times just makes you want to rip your hair out. Terrible class layout on canvas on canvas as well, difficult to find what you need to access. Easy class though.

The class itself is not to bad compared to normal Stats class as long as you keep up with lecture videos. Zooms are optional but Mrs. Blanco makes the class as boring as it gets. The worst is she repeats everything 3 times over if they're are important and it will drive you crazy. This can even include spelling the word FAIL over and over.

I learned almost nothing from this class. The 3 exams are extremely difficult, and they, along with the final exam, are almost your entire grade. If you do poorly on the exams, you have no chance of catching up with the assignments. The only upside is that if you take this online, it's easy to cheat using AI, including the final exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: In all 19 years of my life, I have never experienced a class with a structure this horrendous. It is truly remarkable how you can take such an easy topic like stats and make it this difficult and time consuming. The online zoom classes are a complete waste of time, she doesn't teach you anything and you are basically left to teach it to yourself.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: she appears to be the lesser of a few evils when it comes to this vs stat 200. probably should take her as its online but she does next to nothing to actually teach. she's tenured and doesn't care lol. lock in like 2-3 days before each exam and make yourself a solid review sheet to use for the exams (open note) and it'll be manageable

The course is watching recorded lecture videos and filling out a packet. The Zooms do not help much and exams are your entire grade. There is barely enough time during the exams to do the work for the problems, and the lectures are pretty redundant. If you have self-discipline, take it. If not you will fall behind fast due to how boring it becomes.

I do not have anything specifically against professor Blanco, but this course should not exclusively be offered online. Even though she offered office hours and there is a lab once every week, watching posted lectures and listen to her on zoom did not help prepare me for the tests. The homeworks are easy, as long as you fill out the textbook/packet

She's the average professor, doesn't give much personality but not bad at all. The people acting like she's the worst are dramatic. Class has 3 exams and a final. The excel portions of the hw can be a pain, however i didn't do much and still ended with an 85. All tests are online as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She does not do any teaching. You will watch lectures and basically figure it out yourself. Your grade is based solely on exams. The homework takes hours to complete but is only out of 2.5 points and will not help your grade at all. She does not teach anything and is no help during optional Zoom meetings.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She puts in the bare minimum effort and her responses to student questions are often rude and swift. Your REALLY have to like Statistics to do well in her class, she designs it so there's no other way. I hear she's the lesser of two evils with the stat 200 profs. Will just say she's clearly tenured and has no interest in the success of her students

I stg I got an A and I am telling you DONT take this professor take STAT 200 instead. She assigns videos recorded YEARS ago and literally does not teach you I stg. Take STAT 200 instead you will learn more, trust me. Statistics is important for later classes, especially for Exam 1 of FIN 301 which all business majors take.

SCM200 with Blanco is a challenging but manageable course. The pre-recorded lectures can be dull, but the zoom sessions help clarify concepts. Staying on top of the work and using tools like unstuckstudy AI for study prep are key to success.

Seems to not care; Constantly brings up, in a boastful way, writing up nearly 100 kids per semester for academic integrity. Kids should not have to cheat to get by, offer more resources instead, and have a more understanding attitude toward your students. Also displays a attitude that if you fall off the boat we don't really care. Not personable.
Didn't give proper guidance to students and was unwilling to answer some questions
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Her teaching style was having us watch lectures on our own, and then class was just working on homework and asking questions. Although it is a lot of work, if you do it and don't get behind you will be fine. Grades are based on the 5 quizzes, so as long as you study and put the effort in you can succeeded.

Marilyn's class is a backwards classroom, so be prepared to watch about 45 minutes to an hour and a half of lectures before every class, followed by a comment submission so she knows you watched it. Although attendance is not mandatory, it helped me out as we reviewed the lectures and did homework in class. Interesting style of teaching, so beware.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class was very difficult, but if you put in the work you'll do good, plus Marilyn has office hours and is willing to help. The quizzes are hard, and the true/false questions can be tricky, but you'll be fine if you study and don't fall behind on the lectures. She also changed the grading cutoffs at the end.

Take STAT-200 instead. Ms. Blanco does not know how to teach but rather just give pre-recorded lecture videos from years ago. I am, frankly speaking, annoyed by the fact she has to repeat herself every three seconds. She said she always wants to dive into the whys behind every question to make us understand, and yet she rarely did.
TBH I didnt watch a single lecture. All tests are online, 6 homeworks and you have to submit a question or something you learned after every lecture. Easy class especially if you watch the lectures.

Marilyn Blanco is a great teacher who does care, you just have to seek out her help. She makes herself available during the zoom calls at the end for questions and will go over and explain anything you are confused about. This class is very content heavy so stay on top of the lectures and attend the Zoom sessions. Exams are hard but not impossible.

For this class, it's required to watch lecture videos outside of class and complete a CQI after completing the video. On top of the that, she host three times a week online. NONE of the videos/ zoom meetings are helpful. Exam are impossible to study for and worth almost all of your grade. Completely unhelpful and super strict grader.

reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: There is literally no reason to go to class other than for the notes and even then the notes are very unhelpful with limited examples. Trust me, take an hour a week and learn this on your own. The material is not hard to master, but there are much better ways to learn statistics than from this lady. At least @ the end of the year ur grade is curved
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: My favorite comment from Marilyn Blanco for SCM was when she told my class that her job wasn't to ensure that we could get a job after college, but that we could keep a job after college. She does an excellent job of making a challenging subject easy to understand. If you attend class regularly, and study hard then you can easily earn an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Definitely one of the harder classes here for a business major. There are three exams and a final, and if you mess up on any, it could be detrimental to your grade. My scores were 98, 68, 90, and 85 on the final and I ended up with an -A. I got lucky that I did very well on the first exam and the final compared to the rest of the class. Take Stats.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Best professor I have had so far. It is very clear as to what you need to do to pass. If you don't do well in this course then you clearly didn't take the steps necessary to pass. There are 6 home work assignments, graded on completion so they should be easy A's for anyone willing to put a little effort forward. 3 exams and a final.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I love her classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Not a fan of Professor Blanco. Class was difficult because I didn't learn much from her in class and had to teach myself before the exams. She is very dry and strict on how her class is run. Attendance is not mandatory for a grade, but you HAVE to go to get the notes if you want to succeed. I did not like her personality, but she is willing to help
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Very clear about her expectations and always around to help (tons of office hours plus 2 weekly optional labs). Exams are multiple choice. NOT a class you can procrastinate for the day before an exam.

Blanco is one of the best profs I've ever had. A word of advice, she will tell you EXACTLY what to do study for her exams to do well, and if you do EXACTLY what she says, you'll get an A in the class. You have to put in the effort, but the way she teaches makes you understand the material. Pay attention in class and keep up with it and you're good.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: Very dry professor. No-nonsense. Everything is very clear cut. She also happens to be very boring- don't take her class if there's an alternative. Stat is easy enough to study online.

Professor Blanco was clearly able to help me understand key concepts, and went at a reasonable pace.  In addition, the chronological order of topics made sense.  However, I did take AP stat in high school, so that definitely helped a bit.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Marilyn is a very good lecturer and is clear from day one about how her students can get an A. If you follow her advice, turn in all the homework on time and work hard for the midterms, you should be good. Her course packet is the Bible and you need to know it in and out to ace her class.

Exam 1-3 were not too bad and I got in the 90s on them and then comes the final which was incredibly hard and not like the other tests and I barely passed it. It was not really fair to have such a hard final. Marilyn is very nice though and willing to help you. Attendance isn't mandatory and there's homework but it is graded on being done.

Exam 1 was easy. Exam 2 was hard. Exam 3 was fair. Final was hard. Definitely a dry class, but Marilyn does seem to truly care about the performance of her students. My advice is try to stay on top of the material weekly so you don't need to cram last minute. You're going to need to study many days in advance to truly comprehend the material.

This has been my favorite class so far at Penn State and I never even took stat in high school. Attendance isn't mandatory but it is easy to fall behind. Tests were fair. 6 Homeworks but it's graded on completion. Marilyn is the best teacher at Penn State and I highly recommend this. She is so thoughtful and wants to help you. 3 tests and a final.
Excellent professor. She is more than willing to help students. Very straightforward. You can find all her exam questions in her note packet, just with different numbers. Easy class.

Scm 200 itself is difficult but Blanco is amazing! She helps you throughout  the semester. You really have to study but once you, you will survive. Attend to labs and classes. Pay attention to her because she likes things a certain way. I thought I was going to fail. I also attended lion tutor which helped soooo much! Take her, you won't regret it

Marilyn is very clear in her lectures about her expectations. If you listen to her suggestions and underline the important parts of the test questions, make a list of relative and absolute measures, and cut up the questions and mix them for the exams, then you'll do well. She is very willing to help, but she makes you put the work in first.

Marilyn is an amazing professor and is very helpful! This is a really tough class and you need to pay attention and practice problems. Class isn't mandatory but 100% worth it to go. The tests are hard but not impossible. Just pay attention to details!!! - She will drill that in your head. Homework is graded on trying not correctness (so just try)!

I actually really enjoyed professor Blanco's class. It was hard, but I walked out of there actually knowing what she taught me. However, her final exam was awful. It brought me down from a B+ to a B-. I had done really well on all of her exams until then and she doesn't offer a curve. According to angel, average grade in the class was a B-.

Very good instructor. Although she may go through the material somewhat quickly, she will gladly answer any and all questions regarding to the curriculum. If you are uncertain about something, she makes it very easy to clear it up for you. Homeworks are graded very strictly but it isnt too difficult.

Marilyn was one of the best teachers I've had thus far. She is kind, straightforward, and very knowledgeable on SCM. Her notes are easy to follow, and her exams are fair. She curved my A- to an A at the end of the semester. I highly recommend this professor. Also, she rocks her transition lenses.

One of those teachers that is completely oblivious to the needs of her students.  Fails to recognize that watching paint dry is more interesting than her lectures.  Can't ask clarifying questions on quizzes.  Won't know you're grade throughout the semester.  She purposely makes the toughest trick questions and acknowledges it.  One tip, switch out.

There are 3 midterms and 1 cumulative final. The first and third midterm are relatively easy, the second midterm is the hardest, and cumulative final is usually curved up. Getting a good grade is not difficult at all. All you need to do is show up to class. All of her lectures are very clear-cut and she is always there to provide extra help.

By far my favorite professor thus far.  She's incredibly helpful and ALWAYS willing to help those who seek out assistance.  The material isn't easy, but if you put in the work it all becomes clear.  I went as often as possible to lab and office hours to avoid getting behind. Stay ahead and don't wait until you're lost.  Take this over Stat!

Marilyn was a stellar professor.  Her lab sessions and office hours were extremely helpful.  The material is tough and you really have to STUDY and practice questions in order to do well on exams.  First exam is easy, second is very challenging, third and final aren't too bad; they are just a continuation of the second exam's material.

Good teacher. Go to class. Listen and get the notes. Office hours are helpful. Study a lot for tests and you will do well. She words the questions in a tricky way. 2nd and final test are very hard. Go to lion tutors. Finished with an B+ but she bumped me to an A-. Overall not terrible. Not sure if I recommend it though.

If you can take STAT instead, take it. Everyone I know had 100 in the class while I was pulling an 89 in SCM. Her tests aren't too bad, my average was a 90 but did horrible on the final, and she basically just goes over the course packet. She has a hard on for Academic integrity so don't copy your friends homework. Great teacher, not too difficult.

Marilyn seems pretty tough in class. Some people don't like her style, but I do. She's very organized, and she does everything she can to help students succeed. Material was taught well. HW assignments are easy, but tedious. Exams aren't too bad. If you go to class, take good notes, and review a few days before tests, you'll be fine.
take stat 200 instead. there are only 5 grades all semester, 4 exams and then homework.

There is a guided note packet that you have this class. if you attend class and fill out  the notes and study for the exams you will get an A. Everyone that is saying that this class is hard is a total idiot. They are just angry that you might actually have to study for a class. Marilyn is a boss.

Marilyn was an excellent professor this semester.  She doesn't have a textbook, just an outlined notes pacet thats less than $30 at SBS.  She follows it directly and keeps all of the covered material extremely organized.  She designs her homework in a way where if you do it after the class it coordinates with, you understand the material. Good prof
GO TO CLASS, GO TO THE LAB OR OFFICE HOURS, AND YOU'LL DO FINE IN THE CLASS. THE ONLY PEOPLE THAT DON'T LIKE HER ARE THE ONES WHO DONT PUT IN THE EFFORT.

The class isn't too bad. Marilyn has a hard on for academic integrity and is out to fail her students. If you want to deal with this kinda professor for a semester be my guest, but my recommendation would be to take an easy STAT 200.

I thought she was a tough person at first but I was wrong. She's really helpful and kind. Go to class to write down notes on her packet. You just need to finish the homework to get full point, she doesn't matter right or wrong. Tests are in the packet, read through and understand it clearly. She will give you the formula paper during tests.

Marilyn Blanco is amazing. Everything discussed in her class helps prepare you adequately for exams. She doesn't make you get a textbook, and messing up a test won't sink your grade with her course structure. Much respect for her and her class procedure.

Everything you need to know for the exam is in her lectures and homeworks. She is more than willing to help in office hours. If she sees you working hard, she is more willing to help you. Do not show up in the last week and expect tons of help. But she truly cares for students who respect her class. Also, follow her exam advice, it actually helps!

Very organized, going to labs and office hours help. Very simple, demands respect of her classes, and presented the material quite nicely. I was glad that she taught SCM 200. I took AP Stat in high school and much of this was review.

Professor Blanco is one of the most organized teachers I've ever had. Go to lectures and you are most likely to pass the course. She repeats important information three times so it's easy to pick up. Use your course notes and there is always lab to ask questions. Makes you pick up your homework in lab (optional) and tests are tricky but fair.

She's kind of serious but you can tell she really cares about her students. Class is pretty fast-paced so you will need to review the notes after each class if you don't want to be lost in subsequent classes. Do the homework, watch the videos, and you will do well. Major plus: No textbook!

She was a very good teacher. The class itself was very fast paced as i took it in the summer. She was always available and helpful during office hours and announced every class when the office hours would be. Tests are difficult and require a great deal of knowledge on the material. I recommend you read the notes each day after class.

Marilyn Blanco is one of the best professors I have had yet at Penn State. She is more than willing to provide you with extra help and great explanations. This course in particular was not too difficult and the material was very applicable to other areas of business. I really recommend not only this course but her as a professor!

Very difficult class if you are looking for the easy GPA booster then I would suggest you take STAT 200 (guaranteed A).  However if you are looking to actually learn about statistics Marilyn will prepare you more than any professor in STAT.  The most difficult exam is the second!  The first one will be a breeze just don't get too confident.
The class is somewhat difficult, but Marilyn is always enthusiastic to help students.

Blanco is a great professor overall. She cares for her students and is actually fun outside of the classroom. Attending class is a must if you want a decent grade. If you re-read the notes every night like she recommends, the material is much easier to understand. Easy A if you put the work in.

Her class wasn't easy, but it wasn't impossible.  Once you get the hang of the material it's not too bad.  The sample exam questions she gives are just like the test questions. Make sure you circle key words in the questions and know definitions!  She's fair, but the final was very hard and some questions were confusing.

She has very strict principles but that will actually benefit you in some ways.  Great at teaching, prepares students well for exams.  Go to class and study 2 days in advance and you'll have no problem getting an A or B.

Go to class, take notes and study. She's really fair (no surprises on tests), just need to put in some work to get an A. She really wants you to learn. If you have questions, go to lab or office hours. TA's help too.
Study hard and read quiz questions thoroughly and you'll get an A.
She is super helpful and has easy homework. Her exams require a lot of studying, but an A is definitely possible. I recommend taking her!
She repeats everything important three times. She repeats everything important three times. She repeats everything three times.

If you go to class, look over your notes after class, and ask questions if you have any you should be good. I never got behind and got A's or A-'s on every test. Went to office hours once and she was very helpful.

GO TO HER CLASS!She is really helpful and easy going instructor, her TA team were also very wonderful! If you attend EVERY class, ASK question with no doubt(she is REALLY patient to answer all kinds of question about the class),go to lab or her office hour to ask question and study hard! It's really interesting class. And you will get A!

Attendance is mandatory and no technology is allowed in class. The textbook helps a lot with using Excel and the Monday/Wednesday evening labs are very helpful. Blanco is a fair professor, respectable and is a good person. The class is difficult, exams are difficult, but if you work hard you will get a decent grade.

I actually really enjoyed her class. I took stat in high school with a horrible teacher and did so badly. Marilyn is very clear in her approach to teaching. She knows what she's doing and if you really pay attention in class, homework and exams aren't bad. She may come across as intimidating at first but she's nice.

Hard class but an A is possible, Go to class and do the homework. The first exam is easy, second is hard, third is so-so, and the final is very hard. But if you study you'll be alright for this class. I could of got an A if I didn't mess up on the second exam

She might be the straight up best pure teacher I've ever had.  This stuff is not easy to teach, and she makes it seem a little more simple.  If you know her notes, you will be fine on tests.  Some questions are tricky, but most questions are basic.  She wants to help you out.  Do the hw and you will be fine gradewise.

She is extremely helpful when you have questions. She acts like she's very strict but her teaching is very good and you acay learn a lot from the class. Go to classes and don't get behind then the A is easy to get.

very nice class. I enjoyed it alot. she seems to b alittle harsh at the beginning but actually she's quite sweet. she got a very adorable ways of humor. you MUST go to class and write down everything on ppt and the graph she drew. listen carefully to what she says. go to lab if you get confused abt the material

Marilyn is one of my favourite teachers! She's adorable and somehow manages to make a class of 300 seem small. She makes stats fun, which is not an easy thing to do. The class is structured in a way to make you get a good grade. Do all the homeworks, don't skip class, attend labs and you can get an A. I only ever studied before the exams and I did.

This isn't an easy class but Blanco teaches well. Attendance isn't taken but you MUST go. Test questions come straight from the packet so study it well. Basically go to class and take advantage of lab hours and the class is definitely doable.

Revise all the material before test, pay really much attention to her course packet, all of the questions come from that packet. She sometimes says something 3 times over and over it means it is going to be on the test, do homework the way she wants you to do, they are easy points, go to class solve course packet at least get an B+

If you can, take Stat 200. It's the same material, only taught in a more simplified way. This class isn't difficult material, but they way she teaches it makes it seem hard and she tries to trick you during tests. You MUST go to class and you do need the book for homework questions, but if you do the sample problems, you should be fine.

Definitely not super easy, but not super hard either.  Just go to class, she emphasizes what will be on exams and gives tips to those who go to class.  Make use of lab time, she is very willing to help you.  Need the book for some hw questions, which is graded on completion so just do it.  Not a bad class if you just pay attention.
She's a professor making no mistakes on teaching. If you receive a bad score, go to class and get your homework done.

Definitely a very hard class, but Marilyn is willing to help anyone, the same goes for her TA's. Lab and office hours are beneficial, so take advantage of that and go when you don't understand something. Personally think exams can be really tricky and require a ton of studying if you even wanna pull off a B.
She's hard, and you have to pay attention and study. But if you work hard, it'll pay off. ATTEND CLASS. And visit her office hours and lab hours. They are what will really help you.

Very fair teacher. However, this does not mean it is a an easy class or one that you can slack off in. She explains the material well, but unless you are interested in it, this class will not be fun. Go in for help if you need it. Make sure you get your homework and tests when she tells you too.

Very fair. Go to class and she helps you very much. All of her test are based off the note packets she gives you and goes through everyday in class. Gives all of the formulas on the test. Study and go to class and she is an awesome teacher.

When I took SCM 200, Blanco was my only option. She made it pretty difficult, but at least I came out learning a heck of a lot. If there are easier alternatives, look into them, but if you see her for office hours, she clears up anything you didn't understand. She's pretty tough though.

One of the best professors I've had. Her lectures are clear and organized. If you put in the effort and study what she tells you to, you will do well. Do not fall behind on any of the material, and go in for help! Her and the assistants can clarify anything.

During class she always gives examples and makes sure that everyone has a clear understanding of the topic. Go to the evening labs if you have any doubts to be cleared. Do the homework as you go. Buy practice papers from Notehall. Notehall papers and Blanco's papers bear some similarity. Go over notes thoroughly.

This is a very tough class. Blanco is a great teacher who is very clear and is willing to help out any student who puts forth effort. I would take another class of hers in a second despite having trouble in SCM 200. Her first exam was easy, 2nd was very difficult, third was easy, and final was challenging but fair. A challenging class but take it.

Professor Blanco is always willing to help you when you need it. I got a lot of my questions answered by going to the evening labs. SCM 200 is a challenge, but if you put the effort into studying in advance, you will be set up to succeed. I ended up getting an A in this class. Study hard, and do the homework as you go.

she comes of mean and humorless at first, but if you go to her office hours and just talk to her, she really isn't that bad. you gotta study pretty hard, but once you learn how much you need to study you'll do great. was supposed to get a B but got an A- after my final. Curves the final like crazy

She may seem like she's strict and pretty tough at first, but as long as you go to class and work your butt off when the time comes for the tests, you'll find that it's much easier than it seems. She's very good at helping students out when they have any questions. Got A's on all the exams.

Her class isn't that bad as long as you put in the effort. She tells you everything you need to know for the exams. She stressed the importance to pay attention to detail because she will try to trick you, but she almost always tells where students go around. Pay attention and study and you can get a good grade.

Marilyn may not be the most interesting prof you'll have, but she's incredibly helpful if you're having trouble. She gives you example problems in the packet that are very similar to test questions so you know what to expect. Also, share a book with a friend - you barely use it the entire semester and just study from your notes.

Her class is incredibly boring.  The material and the math is real easy, but she purposely tries to trick you on the exam so it is less about knowing the stuff and more about looking out for her tricks. She was ok but I would not take another class with her.
Very well organized, go to class and study and you'll be fine.

Blanco is a great teacher and fair. She is helpful when you need it. Homeworks are easy you get random points taken off but as long as you do the problems even if you get them wrong you can get full credit. Exams can be tedious but if you study hard and get past exams you should be fine. Hope she curves the final at the end of the semester.

Marilyn was a fair teacher, very clear in her notes and what you were expected to know. However, I felt as though the exams were very challenging and you should expect to study a lot for them in order to do well.
The math isnt very hard but the exams are extremely tricky.. you can leave an exam thinking you aced it and find out the next day that u got a C

She's extremely knowledgeable and tries very hard to make sure you understand everything.  The material can be tough at times, but she's about as helpful as teachers come (answering questions, office hours, lab, etc).  I got A's on every exam, but you do have to study and go to every class.  Good professor

Pretty much as plain and vanilla as they come. She is very methodical with the notes and emphasizes exactly what to know for the tests. Class is very fair. Don't buy the books as it is only needed for the homeworks.

Prof Blanco was extremely fair and helpful the entire smester. It starts off easy, but gets a little more difficult. Not really an intense class...basically just statistics. I'd take her for another class.

Alright teacher, alright class. Lecture is boring, but necessary. The 6 homeworks are pointless, and the only reason you need to buy the book (which you can't return). Material not very rushed at the end of the semester (you get an entire week of review). Final seemed easy, but I did bad on it. Would take another of her classes.

Cancels 6 classes for "time spent in evening exams" which seems cool at first, until she rushes through material and you realize that those 6 classes probably would have helped. Very dry class, not too much homework. Must go to class to get notes (and I hope you can speedwrite) book is useless for studying but you need it for homework.Final is hard

Marilyn is a very fair teacher. That being said, the material is very difficult. I went into the class thinking it would be an easy A, but I was very wrong. I wound up with a B for the semester, but I learned that it is important to keep up. If you slack off, like I did in the beginning, it will be very hard to catch up at the end of the semester.

Good teacher. Everything on the exam is from her course packet, but can be worded differently, and sometimes difficultly. However, if you prepare, and really study the material, an A is not too difficult. Very fair, and tries to help her students do well. Can be intimidating looking, but still approachable. Class known to be harder than Stat200

she's pretty good at explaining the concepts although beware because this class is extremely boring. the tests are beastly too. on a personal level she is kind of a **** and treats the class like it's first grade. overall  a decent prof. she'll help you at office hours but tends to take the approach of "why don't you understand this, this is easy"
Go to class and you'll never have to read the textbook.  She teaches right to the exam, but the exam is a bit more difficult  in its wording than examples.

Professor Blanco is the best professor I?ve had at Penn State!  She presents the material very well and she really knows her stuff.  Her teaching style is great, but if you want an ?A? in her class, you?re gonna have to put the time into it.  Best part about Blanco is that she treats everyone equal, no special treatment?no exceptions.
Class is hard. Marilyn is ok, but class is very boring. Go to class, take notes and you'll do alright, but would be better off in STAT.

One of the best professors I have ever had.  She is VERY helpful! The class is difficult, but she is helpful.Go to labs and office hours and you will be all set for the exams.However, you must work to earn an A.Not because Blanco is tough, because the material is tough.

I'll admit it, this class is really boring, and unless you develop a knack for this stuff or you end liking it, it will be tough to stay awake. But it's very important that you go to the labs and go to office hours any chance you get! She's very very very helpful and will take the time out of her day to make sure you do great. Take it in stride.
you really have to earn the A in this class, the tests can be pretty hard and theres no extra credit or big curves or anything.

This class is one choice for business majors...take stat 200! Blanco, though a very nice lady and very available after class, is a terrible in class teacher. I had extreme trouble staying awake during her lectures. She may have smiled once throughtout the entire semester and talks in a monotone voice. I did become a great doodler during this class!

Blanco is a good teacher and knows how to relay the information to her students.  You can purchase her slides partially completed which is a good idea.  The only reason you use the book is to learn how to do the stat on Excel.  You mainly learn from lectures and the notes.  Overall, good class and good teacher.

Blanco is a great instructor.  She teaches a somewhat boring subject and does her best to keep the class interetested.  She truly cares about her students and is always there to help.  If you need to take this course, definitely take it with Blanco.

i cant say enough bad things about this class. blanco makes it so much harder than it has to be, but holds labs to act like she is trying to make it easy. stat is much easier than how she presents it. i studied for her exams a lot and still did bad. plus her voice is so monotone and terrible, i just hated this class so much. sorry business students
really good teacher, if you go and try to get help she will go out of her way to help. Exams-80,83,83,93 and ended up with an A-. Hard Class but worth taking!

This class was horrible. It was so hard. I studied so much and still did bad on exams. SHe is so boring and her voice is so blahhh. The homework is a huge waste of time and counts for almost no points at all. The material is not explained well. She tends to say something is true and it is false so you don't know which is the answer. She was helpful
Nice teacher, material can be very tricky if you can't understand it.  Take stat 200 if you want to get a better grade.
impossible teacher, impossible class, take regular stat
Great teacher that will help you and listen and teach.  Shes def. one of the best out there, but just face it, this material is pretty difficult.  I def. recommend her!
clear and helpful

GREAT Teacher. You'll love the class because of her. The material is a little tricky, but if you study hard you should be able to get an A. Just make sure you go to lab hours every week and ask the teacher any questions you have about the material. The final exam was harder than the other exams, but i still managed to get an A for the semester.

in lecture she seems no fun and strict.. if you go to office hours or lab hours she is extremely helpful and willing to answer any questions.. she explains material better in lab hours.. still, had to study a lot.. 3 exams and then a final.. culmulative final was A LOT harder than the other exams.. not a bad teacher but you do have to work HARDgotB

Great Teacher! She is very good at making dull material become understandable. Her class is very fair, no tricks. She cares about her students so you always feel like your questions matter. Penn State needs more professors like her, especially for classes required for our majors.

more than willing to help you whenever, go to the lab to do your hw, email her if you have a question. if you have trouble dealing with her you have a problem. basically gives you answers. class is boring, harder at the end, but its a requirement

I love this teacher!!! She is sooo nice and funny when you go to those study thingys that she holds every monday and wednesday. She has an impecible style that is very hard to compete with and NO CHILD IS EVER LEFT BEHIND!!!

SO happy i got her for stat... does so many examples in class & reiforces all the info so it sticks in your head & becomes seconds nature.  if you actaly follow along during lecture, theres no way it can be 'boring' & you'll be guaranteed to know what you're doing.  makes information easy to understand, cares alot about students, excellent teacher.
Boring lectures, HW isn't hard, tests are not easy but can be done with a bit of studying.

Marilyn Blanco is a great teacher. She helped me pass that class with all her helpful hints and suggestions. Her personality is very contagious and outgoing. She cares about every student as if they were her own children. She makes me look forward to geting up everyday and going to class. MARILYN BLANCO- YOU ARE MY ROLE MODEL! Good TEACHER! A++++++
Lecture is really boring...HW isn't too bad, you have to study for those exams.
Marilyn is a great teacher and she really wants you to do well. If you go to labs, she will answer any questions you have. The tests are hard but class isn't too bad to sit through.
Lecture does get boring, but the class really isn't difficult as long as you go. Also, she's very willing to help after class hours.

The class can be hard, especially if you've never had stat before, but that's because of the material not the prof. She is very helpful if you go to the labs, office hours, and ask questions. She genuinely wants you to succeed. And if you stay up on the lectures and go to class you'll do well in the class.
She is a great teacher.  She made me almost consider pursuing a career in statistics.  Don't listen to other people's ratings that****on her.  She is great.  Get her!!!!

Blanco is the most boring teacher I've come across at PSU. She has such a monotone voice that I had to leave class early today because I couldn't take it anymore. The class sucks too. Every single topic seems like the last but with little changes that screw you over on tests. Dont take this class, and please please dont sign up in Blancos class

She lets you the very beginning of the class how difficult the class can be but she's there to help and believes everyone can make it. To date, she's one of the best teachers I have come across. Very passionate about all that she teaches and her jokes are pretty hilarious. She's the best.
Blanco has the personality of a brick wall but she can teach well and explains the**** pretty well.  Her tests are really fair and a good judge of effort put into class.

Connor Olson is a great MATH 140 professor. He gives clear and concise lectures and is always willing to answer any questions that students may have. His office hours and review sessions are extremely beneficial as well.

He explains the material clearly, and questions are encouraged throughout lecture. If you want a professor who teaches step-by-step, take him. One of the most understanding professors I have ever had
Amazing professor.

He is a really sweet Prof! Please take Calc with him! he is super helpful and understanding. He genuinely wants people to succeed. He has a stutter and is a tad nervous, but he taught the content well. He is funny and very personable.

He is a really nice professor and definitely knows what he is talking about. Very kind person. He cares a lot about his students, and he wants them to succeed. If you go to class and go to office hours, you will be fine. He also hosts review sessions for each exam, which are extremely beneficial.
We love Connor Olson
Great professor.
