Dr. Honavar  makes complex ideas simple and easy to understand and connects AI  to philosophy, psychology, and computing. Do not miss this course.

This course was taught as a special topics course. The course covered descriptive, predictive, and causal data science methods. I really hope it becomes a regular course soon. I took the course because of Prof. Honavar's reputation as a researcher. I was not disappointed. His lectures are amazing.

Absolutely amazing course. Well-designed course materials. Great lectures that covered not only technical concepts but also their interdisciplinary roots. I loved working on the course project of my choosing and ended up with a publishable manuscript. Dr. Honavar is extremely unassuming and approachable despite his many accomplishments.

Dr. Honavar of the best professors I have ever had. He teaches you the ideas behind the methods, and provides intuition about how they work, and when and when not to use them. Scientific rigor and reproducibility of analyses are front and center in the course. He changed the way I approach data, study design, and research.

I took this "special topics" course "Data Science for Researchers and Scholars" the very first time it was taught. The course was simply amazing. Dr. Honavar made the material accessible to students with diverse backgrounds. This was one of the best classes I have taken in grad school at Penn State.
Great professor. The lecture was full of important stuff. Very experienced. The only issue I found was that he did not explain the reasons for deducting points.
Dr. Honavar is amazing. I had to work really hard for my A, but I learned a lot. I am hoping to do machine research with Dr. Honavar and may be apply for grad school.

I really struggled in the first half of the semester because of my math phobia. But once I got over my math phobia (with lots of help and encouragement from Dr. Vasant), things became easier and enjoyable. If you're a freshman and reading this, pay attention in calc 1 & 2, probability, etc. If you want to learn ML, take this course from Dr. Vasant.

If you want to really learn machine learning (not just running tools, but core ideas), take this course from Dr. Honavar. I aced an internship interview because I was to explain how  "kernel trick" can be used to "upgrade" any "linear" classifier. I was able to do this because I learned the math behind the kernel trick in this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Unlike others, I did not find the prof to be difficult. As long as you are comfortable with basic math (calculus, probability, matrices), the course is not difficult. The prof. explains key ideas very well. Problem sets and labs really help you learn. The prof. goes out of his way to help students, e.g., when we miss classes because of illness.

The class is a little heavy on math. But that seems unavoidable if you want to really learn machine learning. Dr. Honavar is great at explaining the what, why, and how of machine learning. He is super approachable and is always happy to help - you just have to ask. This is the best course I have had as a Data Science major.

Dr. Honavar does a great job of balancing the conceptual/theoretical with the practical aspects of machine learning. The lectures are amazing. The labs really help with the practical aspects. Dr. Honavar clearly loves teaching this course. It is the best course I have taken in the Data Science program at Penn State.

I have never had to study so hard  in my entire time at Penn State. But then I interviewed for a data scientist position at a top company. I had to derive a gradient based update rule, explain how to cope with unbalanced data etc.. I aced the interview. I got the job. I have Dr. Honavar to thank for everything I knew about machine learning.

Great prof. One of the best, if not the best I have had at Penn State. He teaches you how to come up with machine learning algorithms for different problems from first principles.He really knows machine learning, and really loves to share his knowledge. He explains the main ideas in several ways - mathematical, visual, etc. until you get it.

Brush up your  multivariable differential calculus, probability, basic linear algebra, and python programming before you take this class. Prof. Honavar will review what you need to know before diving deep into machine learning, but you will do so much better if you are prepared. This was the best class I ever had at Penn State. Really great prof.

I took this class from Dr. Honavar back in 2018. It was one of the hardest course I had ever taken at Penn State. I struggled through it and managed to get a hard earned B+. The course helped me land my first job. Now as I look back 4 years later, I really appreciate the course. I have gone back to my notes  to brush up on my machine learning.

I loved the class. Prof. Honavar does not take attendance and lectures are not mandatory...but if you skip class or snooze, you lose big time. While readings and slides are posted, the explanations he gives in class really helped me understand the material, especially the math behind machine learning. I learned a lot.

The class was tough. Prof. Honavar expects students to be really comfortable with multivariate differential calculus, probability theory, and mathematical notation. But if you ask questions, he will take the time to explain even the most basic stuff. He is very knowledgeable. I learned a lot, but had to work hard for my grade.

Prof. Honavar's lectures emphasize the why, what, and how of machine learning and not so much implementation in some programming language like Python. He expects you to be able to program, and use the python libraries, etc. which you should be able to if you have taken the prerequisite programming classes. Oh.. brush up on math before you enroll.

Dr. Vasant is encyclopedic knowledge of machine learning. You can learn a lot from him. He will teach you not only the concepts and algorithms but also the history of the main ideas . He is very helpful but you have to make an effort, pay attention in the class, keep up with the readings, work through the math, do the homework and labs

This was one of the best - if not the best - classes I have had at Penn State. Vasant really knows his stuff and is passionate about teaching Machine learning. Make sure to brush up on your calculus cause you will need it. I found Vasant to be really approachable and willing to help outside class. He also helped me get into a top grad program.
Tough class. Dedicated instructor. Really cares about students. Makes you work hard. Helps you learn. I had to work really hard. But I learned a lot. The class helped me land a great job that I love.

This is a required course for the applied data sciences option. The material can be difficult, especially if you have not really learned your basic probability, statistics, and multivariable differential calculus. But Dr. Honavar is extremely knowledgeable. His problem sets challenge you. But he is always available to help. A great prof.

This course, at least the way Prof. Honavar teaches it, is very demanding. We got a math quiz at the very beginning of the semester. How we did on it told us how much we had to review. It helped that Dr. Honavar reviewed the relevant math before it was used in the class. It is the hardest class I ever had, but I did learn!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Really interesting material. That is, if you pay attention in his lectures, and ask questions when you are lost. As Dr. Honavar says, there are no stupid questions, only stupid answers. He was incredibly patient with me when I had a family issue that was weighing me down. Great prof. and a truly caring human being.

Tough class. I only managed to get a B-. That too after working really really hard. But this class taught me why math is so important for machine learning and data science. I wish someone had told me this. I would have paid attention in freshman calc. Dr. Honavar was incredibly patient with me and explained things. Great prof.

One of the hardest courses I have taken at Penn State. Dr. Honavar is really passionate about ML. He teaches you not just how to use ML, but also the math behind ML. What I learned in class helped land an internship at a top AI company. But if you have a math phobia or are lazy, you are better off taking the class from somebody else.

It is not often that you get to have a top notch researcher teaching an introductory undergrad course. As an honors student, this is by far the best undergrad course I have had at Penn State. You need to attend the lectures and pay attention to learn the material. I missed one lecture and had to talk to him for an hour to catch up.

Hard class. You learn a lot. If you don't attend lectures and don't ask questions, you miss out. I never worked so hard in any class. But I learned. I worked for my A. I feel lucky to have had a chance to learn from him. He is the best.

This is a tough course. Students who are used to taking courses that are light on math or don't know programming struggle. He does not require attendance. But if you attend, you learn. The slides and readings are posted, but the lectures is where you learn the main ideas behind the algorithms. He is always there to help.

Only about 7 assignments in the whole course so if you mess even one your grades go down the drain. The worst part was even with such few assignments they were never graded on time. Dr. Honavar is a genius so it can be hard for him to dumb this stuff down but he is available after class if you want to actually learn go to him and he will help you
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: The lecture slides were hundreds of slides in length, which made studying and following along challenging. Esp with no slide numbers to help you follow along. By the last quarter of class, only about 30% of the overall points had been graded, making it difficult to tell what your final grade would be. Lost of math & proofs. Graded by 9 assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I find it incredible that anyone rates him so high. He is very nice and is always willing to help you but it is incredibly difficult learn anything in his lectures. A lot a math that doesn't make any sense at first and it doesn't get much better after he explains it. Most people ended up not going to class as the lectures become kind of useless.
His materials are just absurdly difficult. If you are new to Machine Learning and doesn't think vector and partial differential equation is a familiar thing for you, take another professor's course.

If you are serious about learning machine learning (ML), and are prepared to work much harder than you are used to in most courses at Penn State, take this class. I learned not just how to use ML, but also the math behind ML algorithms. What I learned in the course helped me get a great job with a leading AI company. Great Prof. One of the best.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: One of the toughest classes that I have taken. Ever. If you take this course, you better not be afraid of math. Learned a lot from Dr. Honavar. He is very knowledgeable and passionate about the topic. He expects you to work hard. He is always available to help. Great teacher to have, if you want to learn.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Super hard material but a super great professor. Lots of readings and the problem sets are ridiculously hard. However, he is always accessible outside class and he is very happy to sit down and go over a problem with you that you don't know. Gain a lot of knowledge in this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: He is one of the top scholars; he teaches this course like a graduate course. The materials are hard, and he likes to say "it's nothing more but freshmen calculus...". However, you can really learn a lot if you work with him. Great teacher, would like to take his course again!
He is a really smart guy and is really interested in the subject, but the problem is that the material for the class is ridiculously hard.

the workload in this class is actually insane and there are zero due dates listed on the syllabus so it just springs upon you with limited notice and everything requires genuine time and effort. take this class with a prof that givers you clear deadlines because its just not doable

I don't understand the hate he gets. I loved him. The whole concept of 460W was to be a “real” newsroom, hence its fast-paced nature, honest feedback and strict deadlines. If you show up, participate and interact with him regularly, he is wonderful. Very understanding if you come to him with issues. Honestly, my favorite professor I've had at PSU.

Let's see.. Walter's feedback is super offensive and discouraging. Did not learn a single thing this semester, feel less confident at a journalist now!! He also has an interesting personality. I would advise future students to carefully consider if this class is the right fit for them. Example of his feedback: "Huh??"

Genuinely dont get the hate with Walter. He really cares about his students understanding the concepts and that is what he grades on. He is heavy on the AP Textbook but thats all for textbooks. He really cares about his students succeeding not just in the classroom but in thier future. Be open about if your understanding or not and ask questions
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Do not take this professor. I had contemplated dropping his class since week 2 because it was so bad. He is a tough grader, and his criticism is rude and unhelpful. Also, as of the last day of classes, he still has over 15 assignments ungraded, so you won't know your grade until it's finalized. Save yourself the stress and choose another professor.

Worst professor ever. I dreaded going to his class. He had no syllabus for us until over half way through the semester but told us to "refer to the syllabus" when he didn't feel like answering questions. Gave rude feedback and was very passive agressive and rude to students in class. I purposely chose not to take classes that he teaches.
worst professor.  does not care about students.  hope you like being belittled.
He is nice but expects SO much out of you and will not give anyone a good grade. He wants everyone to be able to learn to write AP style perfectly which is SO unrealistic.

His feedback is unhelpful and unprofessional. Middlebrook chooses to say nasty one-liners about your work while offering zero recommendations as to fixing errors he does find. As an example, he highlighted an error and left a comment of "Huh?????" with nothing else.
Don't get the hate for Middlebrook. He is a funny guy and easy professor. Just show up and participate and his classes are very easy.

He's unorganized and expects you to prioritize his class over everything else in your life. Didn't even have a syllabus. Once we had an assignment due on a set date, and he emailed one day saying that it was now due that night giving us 12-hour notice to finish an assignment that was originally due a week later. I didn't learn a thing all semester.

I dropped this class after the first day. He showed up to class late, with no syllabus, no plan, no grading criteria, just bad vibes. He assigned us an event to report on with 3 days notice, and when people made it known that they wouldn't be able to make it due to classes or work, he seemed surprised that it couldn't be their top priority.

Nice man, can be funny. If this class is not mandatory for you- run. Large amount of papers with unclear guidelines. I never felt like there was a clear structure that would allow me to improve. We were just expected to memorize every little thing in the AP stylebook, and if you mess up get ready to receive a mean comment. GOOD LUCK!

Loved Professor Middlebrook. I'm not sure why his rating is so low. He may be a tough grader on papers and requires AP Style, but the class is literally called "News Writing," and to become a better writer, which he will make you. He gives good feedback, is funny, caring, and overall a nice, helpful guy. My favorite class I've had, ever.

Nice man, but do not take this class with him. Literally ridiculous amounts of work and he expects you to just know everything after he says it once. He expects you to be a real journalist for a basic class most COMM students take.


Nice guy and funny but not a good professor.

A class with Middlebrook is not just a waste of your time; it wastes a huge chunk of your time, and it will drown your schedule. Be prepared to have articles due three hours after class and receive incendiary, insulting commentary on your rushed writing. I dropped the class out of self-respect, and I implore others to avoid it for the same reason.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: If you are thinking about taking a class with Walter just don't do it. The class is overloaded with so much busy work and an insane amount of assignments per week. He is an extremely harsh grader and has no idea what he is doing. Avoid him if at all possible.
Great lectures
best professor ive ever had in my entire life. he is amazing. the way he speaks just makes u remember every single thing he says
The professor goes off on lots of tangents. Difficult to understand what the material really is. Read the textbook! Tests are hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Pay at least a little attention in lecture or read the slides, and you will be fine. Great at teaching for what he assigns. Lots of opportunity for extra credit. Very awesome and wholesome dude. BIG YAPPER. Will talk about his kids half of the time.

Loved him, but he made us attend lectures and then read the book cause apparently lectures only had 80% of the content. This makes lectures useless, as you will have to read the whole book either way.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He was a good teacher, make sure you use his study guide and make your own application based questions when studying for the exams. The tests are cumulative.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I love this guy. He is so passionate with his lectures even though he tends to ramble on and get distracted sometimes. Attendance isn't mandatory and he posts all of his lectures on canvas. Barely any homework and he posts study guides! Exams are very simple! Would take again!

Great professor! His lectures are engaging and interesting. Lecture heavy class with 4 exams plus 1 final. We have access to all ppt's and he gives study guides before the test with everything on. They are very helpful. Tests are multiple choice and are taken in the classroom. Daily TopHat questions and I would recommend going to class.
Very good teacher, a great introduction to psychology. Do not underestimate the Assessments. Research credit is very fun but tedious.

AMAZING professor! My sister was taking AP PSYCH and her teacher sucked so I sent her the recording lectures and she got a 5 on the exam. He is amazing!!! take him. Exams were fairly easy never got less than a 90 and he teaches you new study methods.
“Meh” professor overall.
A bit passive aggressive, I would go with someone else.
Joshua's Psych100 is engaging and manageable with extra credit. Attendance matters, but you can still do well by using the textbook and unstuck AI for study prep. Overall, a great intro class.

I loved Josh. At first the class was hard but he gave us cheat sheets for some exams. We had 5 exams and then a cumulative final. There was so much extra credit and he curved exams. No homework except weekly quizzes. He was also super nice and good at engaging the class. He even had a lecture on how to study and that really helped with performance.

Dr. Wede's Psych100 is just lectures based off of PowerPoints that are posted on Canvas, and attendance is mandatory only to a certain extent - if you go X amount of times for the points, you'll be fine. I skipped a lot of the classes near the end of the semester and I still did well. He often goes off topic, but he keeps it funny and entertaining.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The class was sooo hard for a intro to psych class. That being said the professor was kind and helpful. There is an online option which is nice. A lot of quizzes and and exams. Very hard but cares A lot
The high rating must be due to intimidation. Save yourself the undeserved grade.
Pick someone else.. if you can.

He is a good person, but lectures get boring after awhile. Weekly quizzes, 4 exams including the final. You need to participate in 6 credits worth of research studies on SONA, most of them are online, makes up 30% of your grade. In general, it's a psych class. I think he might be the best professor to take for psych 100.

Book is online and helpful but not necessary. Attendance isn't necessary all the time either but i recommend going because all you really need to pass the exams are good notes. He's really passionate and entertaining and gives really interesting examples in class. Great teacher, loved this class.

Josh is a great professor. His lectures are straightforward and quizzes are easy. If you hate exams this class may not be for you considering there are 4 big ones that essentially make up your grade. However his exams are pretty straightforward and not too grueling. He makes the class fun and is easy to talk to. I highly recommend him.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very good professor, he explained things thoroughly and everything is posted on canvas so if you miss a class, it won't hurt you. I would 100% take another psych class just so I could have him again

Lectures are not worth it, the slides have little to no information on them and all class is just little experiments that do not help you understand the material at all. Plus the quizes and exams are harder then any bio and chem exam I have taken. Not straight forward, and little no information is actually gained by going to class.

Dr. Wede is one of the best professors I've ever had, he is so passionate about psychology which makes the lectures fun and engaging. His exams and quizzes are very straight forward, if you focus in class and read the book you will ace them. I would definitely take a class with him again!
Just a great class overall, probably the best gened I've taken at penn state.

Dr. Wede is honestly one of the the nicest guys ever. You can tell he is passionate about what he is teaching his lectures are engaging. Also, take advantage of the textbook and the extra credit. If you are taking Psych 100, don't waste another minute looking for another professor and just take Josh.
This class is amazing!

PSYCH 100 with Professor Wede was by far one of the most interesting lectures Ive ever had. He made all the lectures interesting and easy to keep up with. Exams were about every 2 weeks with quizzes and pack backs in between. Pack backs were a bit of a hassle, but overall the amount of work he asked for wasnt a lot. Take him if you can!

Professor Wede is one of the best professors that I've ever had. He is super nice and genuinely cares about his students. He offers plenty of extra credit opportunities and he is very clear about what you need to do to get a good grade. The only thing about this class I didn't like was the weekly Packback posts, but they were just tedious not hard

Loved having Wede as a professor. His was my favorite class. As long as you keep up with readings and attend the lectures or go over the slides, you should be fine. Exams are open boo, so you have to know how to apply the concepts you go over. Lectures are super easy to sit through. He makes it really fun and shows his dogs. Low grades get dropped

Hes a great guy! Makes class really interesting and fun. He gives examples of everything, but I have thought that I did so well on the exams and turned out getting 78-80s on most of them which was really annoying. I also never opened the textbook though so that could be why. I recommend studying, because there is a lot of material on the test.
His use of examples makes the otherwise boring concepts really memorable and enjoyable.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Wede is one of the best psychology professors I have had at Penn State. I literally went out of my way to post this, which I never do. He is so chill and makes the class so interesting. Take this man if you get the chance!!

Lectures and exams go hand in hand, though occasional textbook references in exams show up. Can get by without reading textbook, but must have understanding of cognitive principles and experiments. A subject with much application. His examples, experiments, and lectures help to retain the information. He is very jolly and knowledgeable. A-feasible!

PSU Psyc dept needs to streamline classes. It was an INTRO class and is set up for PhD work. He seemed nice and all but the class has too much needless memorization- we learned about how memory works, but class did not follow own advice and expects word vomit of useless information- Pass on him, beware YARWOOD too,

He has been one of the best professors I've had at Penn State. The assignment, quizzes, and tests are exactly what is taught in lecture. I recommend going to class to better understand the lecture material; however the material is posted on canvas if you miss. He gives lots of extra credit opportunity and is very understanding to situations.

Dr. Wede was extremely understanding during our transition to online remote learning. He didnt give exams anymore and we just had weekly mini assessments. In order to succeed in this class make sure to review after lectures and study a little bit every day. This class wasnt as easy as most people on this website say so take it with a grain of salt.

Dr Wede is very understanding, he is always available and tries his best to deliver some lecture topics through real life examples and i think that is very good. He gives students the chance to receive extra credits too. Skipping class would be a bad idea, because most of what comes on the exam is from the textbook or lecture class.

For some reason Josh gets a lot of hate on this website, but I really loved him. Literally did not use the textbook once and got an A in the class. But I highly recommend attending all classes! Take lots of notes and pay attention to the examples and you should be good :) Also the exams are mostly application questions instead of memorization
THE MAN THE MYTH THE LEGEND! I seen the other reviews of his other classes but PSYCH 100 IS GG EZ LADS! THis the real deal one of the best prof at psu for sure

If you have to take psych 100 (most majors do), Joshua Wede is the way to go. He is so passionate about what he teaches, shows helpful videos and examples, and is so animated with his lectures. Really cares about his students and such a genuine guy. If you actually do the work and literally just listen in class, totally possible to get an A.

MY FAVORITE PROFESSOR AT PSU! Professor Wede was a wonderful professor. He gives take home quizzes that can be difficult, but you can use your notes. Exams are tricky, but with the quizzes and study credit it's easy to not excel on them and still pass. He's very funny and interesting which makes it easy to learn in his class. TAKE THIS CLASS!!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Treated 200 level class like it was a 400 level test. Exam questions were difficult because he wants students to understand how the material works and works together rather than definitions. Wouldnt take again due to the fact his exams are out of 200 points and you are not graded on many other assignments except participation and like 4 hws.

Great professor, really cares about the subject and his class. He's funny, witty, and creative with his lectures, and what you learn really sticks in your mind. As long as you stay on top of research credits, you're golden. I'd definitely take another class with him.

AFTER EXAM 1 REVIEW: All I can say is WOW. The exam was EXACTLY the level of difficulty as his practice questions. Basically memorisation but given context/scenarios. Absolute beast of a professor, so energetic and now that I know his exams are great too I absolutely love him. Amazing, best prof I've had so far.

I really liked him!!! its so easy if you just go to class and take notes. the textbook is online and free and I never read it once. do all the exam study guides and you'll do just fine on his exams. He offers so much extra credit, DO IT!!

FIRST IMPRESSION REVIEW (COME BACK FOR UPDATED REVIEW): Seems very friendly. He smiles during the entire lecture and changes his tone of voice to show emphasis. How he acts suggests that he is really enthusiastic about this course, which is definitely a plus. I am not saying the lectures will be exciting, but it will be better than boring.

Easily one of my favorite professor. He puts a lot of effort into his lectures and students which makes the class enjoyable. He provides study guides, lecture outlines, and all of his powerpoints. LOTS of extra credit! Get your research hours done early. I would definitely take one of his classes again.

Professor Wede was one of the best professors I've had. He is so engaging during class and really cares about the material. Even though attendance is not mandatory, I felt that I did well in the course because of attending class. Studying was much easier when I was able to relate to what he said in class. Definitely take him for PSYCH100!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: I had Prof. Were for my first semester of college and I am almost certain I will never have a prof as amazing as him. Go to class it will seriously help you out and study hard for the tests because you will get what you deserve. He is ALWAYS giving out extra credit (I think I got 50 points total) and gives great help outside of the class
Great professor! Always makes class interesting just exams are really hard. I took AP Psych in high school and always thought it wasn't that hard, but now Psych is my lowest grade right now...

Josh's lectures were incredible and was very hands on, even with very large classes. The thing I did not like was that the exams were extremely hard. They aren't impossible but still very hard and requires a lot to get a good grade. If you are looking for an easy A, he's not for you. If you are willing to put in work for a good grade, I'd recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--Tough grader

reviews.comment: i had a difficult time with the quizzes because I thought they were pretty hard. the exams are not easy but not impossible. just make sure to memorize everything esp the txtbook, go to the review sessions, and know the examples that he uses in class
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: only complaint is exams are very hard. tons of extra credit to basically raise you from a B to B+. Great professor, great guy. Very caring and funny. ADVICE: READ TEXTBOOK. only need to go to 20/42 classes for full participation grade. exams are in class. if you can deal with very hard exams, pick this guy for PSYCH 100

Exams are extremely difficult and not particularly reflective of the reading. You really have to delve into the concepts of each chapter. The study guide provided was not helpful. Even if you make your own, it wont help. He has feedback, and even if you think you did well, you didnt, and points are missing. He is, however, respectful. Good luck.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: The final and midterm are difficult. The questions asked on the quizzes are easy and are not reflective of the exams' difficulty levels. He gives great feedback so you can prevent making future mistakes. However, he will just find something else wrong with your next assignment. 100's are a rarity except for quizzes.

Great professor. Easily one of the hardest classes I have taken. I recommend the textbook in order to do well on the exams. Definitely must study a lot and it doesn't hurt to visit him in office hours and review exams. Attendance counts only up until a point and then it counts for extra credit (not much but still helps)
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The course material is not difficult at all, but the exams are worth 88% of your grade, so you basically need to score 90s or above on all exams to get an A in this class which is a little ridiculous. Fill out the study guides and do all practice questions before each exam and an A is attainable. Up to 3% extra credit is available which helps.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He's a really good teacher and obviously knows what he's talking about. The lectures are so interesting and he easily engages the entire class. There are clickers for class participation and attendance, so you need to show up. It's mostly graded by exams, but if you go to class and take good notes then you should do well on the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Wede is an amazing professor. He keeps lecture interesting and interactive which is so helpful in understanding the material. He genuinely wants you to do well, and he's very helpful when you need assistance on a topic. There is 20 points of extra credit thats pretty easy to get as well.

He is a great professor, cares about his students and gets back to you as fast as possible, but his midterm and final is very hard and has many trick questions. This class is very demanding. It was definitely one of the hardest classes I took so far. There is no extra credit. The median of the final was 39 from 60 points possible. Bad.

Prof. Wede is a great person. However, very wordy, repetitive and often times confusing with his online notes. Exams held the most weight and there weren't many other substantial graded assignments to make up for lower exam scores. No extra credit available.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: great professor! really nice and cares about students. Offers a lot of opportunities for extra credit and tests are fair. Gives you a study guide for each exam that tells you what to study. You only need to go to half the classes for full attendance, and if you keep going you get extra credit.

Dr. Wede is a fantastic professor. PSYCH 100 is a fairly easy class, and the lectures were always interesting. He gives plenty of opportunities for extra credit, and hosts exam reviews before each exam (run by him, not TAs). He made psych really cool and interesting for me, 10/10.

He is an easy psych 100 professor. He gives you so many opportunities for extra credit to boost your grade. He holds review sessions before every exam ran by him, not Ta's. He also posts review guides and practice tests. The lectures can be on the long side but he has outline notes which is super helpful. Overall a good class and would take again.

Psych 100 is basically about showing up to class and actively listening. Dr. Wede has a fun and free spirited personality, so it is not that bad. However, this class covers so much material. There is a lot of extra credit, and tests are fair. The book is "mandatory," but I did not use it much. You can do well without it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Great guy. If you have a question ... Ask! He does a great job of answering questions throughout the class.

This is your standard college class, but Josh makes the boring subject of psychology interesting and uses fascinating examples . The textbook is honestly not necessary, the exams are pretty easy so long as you have common sense, and there are so many areas for extra credit. However, not a lot of assignments, so you have to take the exams seriously.

He only requires you to go to about 60% of the lectures to receive full attendance. He gives lots of opportunities to earn extra credit. He gives study guides for every test so focus on those because it will cover material in the book so you won't need to purchase the book. He is passionate about psychology making for good lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Psych 100 with Wede was one of my favorite classes. He is knowledgeable of and enthusiastic about the material, which made me look forward to every lecture. I even had it as an 8 am, but never dreaded going. I would definitely take another class with him. Highly recommend.
Wede is an amazing lecturer. He gives a lot of examples and makes the class enjoyable.

His lectures made it possible for me to only miss one of his 8 am classes the entire semester. There's a lot of info, but he explains it well and he's interested in it and makes it fun. Show up, use the lecture guides, start studying early, do the extra credit, and you're good as gold. Josh "wheaties" is great!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Had him at 8 am and actually loved his lectures I would actually pay attention. He gives so many opportunities for extra credit and even gives out study guides and prelecture notes. If you don't pass it's def on you and not him. He is also just genuinely nice and willing to make sure you know the information. I would 100% recommend him over anyone

He is such a nice professor. He really cares about your understanding of the material. He gives you many different resources to learn from and he is really good about email. His class is like any psych class, you have to put the work in but for his exams he gives really helpful study guides. I would definitely take classes with him again.

Amazing lectures , very engaging and you can tell he is really passionate about psychology. Tests can get specific but If you go to the lectures he will give you examples that are similar to what you see on tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Wede was an awesome professor to have. I do not recommend taking PSYCH 100 at 8 A.M. if you cannot focus. Dr. Wede explains everything thoroughly and with clear intention for the student succeed. There is also a TON of extra credit opportunities, so take part in those. Overall, just a great professor, but pay attention the tests can be hard.

A great professor who seems to show genuine care about the class. Coming to class isn't mandatory as you can usually skip one or two classes per test and still do fine as long as you get the notes from somebody else and read the textbook for the lectures that you missed.

Prof. Wede first off, has amazing lectures. The tests pretty much rely on lectures and although attendance isn't completely mandatory (he does use clickers!), I would definitely try to make every class. That being said, this class was my 8 am and getting up was incredibly hard,however he's such a dynamic and engaging guy that I never dozed off once
He is the most interesting lecturer I've had. He's really engaging and fun. He takes clicker questions for attendance but it doesn't count tooo much.
Engaging lectures, passionate about the topic, classes are excellent and well worth attending
Good Instructor, Bad exam Qs

I thought his lectures were really interesting because you could tell he really loved the subject. He uses really good examples and as long as you go to class and do the study guides its a pretty easy A. He gives a lot of extra credit opportunities and is really open to helping out students when they need help.

He's an extremely tough grader and expects way too much for a 200 level class. Assignments are super long for 15 points , if I'm going to spend hours on a paper, give me more then 15 points, maybe? He gives good feedback but to me it wasn't helpful becuase the course content was just lectures and reading. He does love what he teaches though!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: The textbook made this course dull. But, the labs are extremely and I love how they are applied to real life situations; which made it easy to complete. The blogs are also an easy part, because you can relate it to a personal experience. However, he is one of those professors who take off some points if he feels as though you could have added more.
I LOVE Joshua. He's a great professor and he's hot as heck. 301W was a lot of work but looking at his beautiful face made it all worth it.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: He was my favorite professor that I've had at Penn State. I had him for Psychology 100 and you could just tell he cared so much about the material he was teaching as well as his students. His lectures were always really interesting and his exams were pretty hard in Psych 253, but he offers a lot of participation points that add up to extra credit.

Really awesome professor.  Josh is extremely helpful when it comes to questions and offering extra credit.  I would definitely invest in the textbook; there were some topics on each exam that were ONLY covered in the book and online quiz questions could only be answered with the book.  Overall, I would highly recommend any of his classes.

I liked Josh. He taught the material in a very clear way to understand. I enjoyed class because he made it interesting with funny examples and videos. If you show up and do the required work, it's not hard to get an A or A-. The only things that weren't in his lectures that were on the exams were clear to look up on the study guide. Plenty of EC.

DO THE EXTRA CREDIT. He gives soo many opportunities for extra points that you might realize you needed later on. GO TO CLASS. His lectures are mostly very interesting and he puts a lot of info right out of his lectures on exams. Do these and bump your grade a lot. Exams are tough but he explains how to learn everything. Very interesting class.

Dr. Wede was easily the best professor I have had at Penn State so far! His lectures are fun and engaging, and if you do the study guides you will do fine on the tests! Attendance is important for his class, but as I said his lectures are so fantastic that it's absolutely worth going. Dr. Wede's class inspired me to take up a minor psych!

Dr. Wede is a very good person but I wouldn't say he is the greatest professor. His exams do not reflect the material that he presents in class which leads to terrible exam scores. Even the assignments and online quizzes were ridiculous. I would recommend trying to find a different professor for psych 253 because he makes it too hard for what it is
I loved Dr. Wede! Favorite class my freshman year. Class was a lot of fun. Exams were tough but he teaches you how to study. Would take again - highly recommend
Amazing professor, class is actually fun but tests are near impossible study a lot. Gives a lot of extra credit
I loved having him as a professor for his sensation and perception course but I do not recommend taking him for 301W. This class was ridiculous. the assignments were easy but the exams were hard.
really nice guy.  makes the class interesting.  would recommend!

Took Dr. Wede for 301W which is probably the hardest Psych that's required for the Bachelors degree.  Numerous papers leading up to a final term paper. Also 3 midterm exams and a final. Grades on the papers all depend on your TA.  Dr. Wede sometimes goes a little fast, but with that being said if you go to him for help he is more than glad to help.
Dr. Wede was one of my favorite professors. He loves what he does so much, and it shows through his lectures. The class wasn't an easy A, but it wasn't all that time consuming either.

Josh Wede's class was easy if you did what you need to do. Take good notes, pay attention in class, and study for the exams. If you take the time to do the study guides for the tests thoroughly , you should be totally fine. His passion for this subject makes learning a lot more interesting, and he is always available to answer questions.

Josh Wede makes a 300 person lecture hall seem like there's only 20 kids. He will teach you how to study and if you do the work properly you will be fine. This guy is passionate and cares about his students, and he's freaking hilarious

Dr. Wede is a great professor, always willing to help and talk despite big class sizes.  Do the readings when possible--some test questions are not from the lecture outlines.  And go to the lectures--he always includes interesting clips and real life situations during the lectures, which definitely makes it easier to understand.

Josh was an awesome professor! Do the readings and go to lecture and you'll be fine. His lectures were awesome and I think he's really funny. I would totally take him again!! Only downside was that since it was an intro class the department had so much control over the course which can kinda suck -__-

Wede is an amazing professor. His lectures are mandatory to pass, but he makes them a joy. He is very clear and elaborate. His exams are beyond tough for a 200 level course and the time constraint is somewhat ridiculous. Either you know the question, or you don't have time to think about it. Gives extra credit, but not enough to impact your grade.

Dr Wede is an amazing professor! His passion for psychology made the class so interesting and fun to learn. His tests are tough though. To ace this class you need to really put an effort on studying a little extra.  I would definitely take this class again.

Even with him having thousands of students, he still made me feel valued and important. Always answered my emails the same day and he genuinely cares about his students. I definitely recommend getting the textbook to read before exams, it helped me a lot.
Wede made psychology a serious interest in me.  He uses a lot of examples to clarify his point and gives plenty of extra credit opportunities.  He is my favorite teacher at Penn State so far.

Dr. Wede was awesome. He's always willing to help and is a very solid lecturer. Tests aren't that bad but there are usually a few questions on them that are pretty tricky. The book isn't mandatory but it definitely helps to have.
Dr. Wede is an awesome professor who makes complicated ideas enjoyable to learn.

Dr. Wede is one of the best professors that I've ever had! His lectures are really interesting and they will make you want to come to class. The tests are application based, but aren't too hard if you make and effort to understand the material. Take advantage of the extra credit and other assignments to boost your grade!

If you can take this course with him, do it! His lectures aren't bad and he provides tons of examples to better understand concepts. He gives a ton of extra credit, up to 30 points of it. Tests aren't terrible, you have to study, but they're doable. Provides note outlines and study guides online to help. Honestly, if you show up, you're good to go.

Really cool guy, very clear about information being talked about. Generally an easy class, you should have no problem getting an A if you pay attention. Lectures are easy-going and interesting! One of my favorite classes I've taken.

He was my favorite professor from my first semester! Such a nice guy and will help you with any questions. You must go to most classes (Clicker questions for points) but I didn't mind it because I actually enjoyed his lectures a lot. He made Psych really fun. As long as you pay attention to lectures and do the readings you'll pass the class easily.

He's very knowledgeable and helpful! He gives you skeleton notes, but you need to take notes on everything else that he says too. Questions on offhand comments often appear on exams. You have to read the book if you want to pass the quizzes. He does not discuss everything that will be on them in class. Exams are hard, but definitely passable

Wede is AMAZING. He really does care about the students that try in his class. He gives you tons and tons of extra credit opportunities. All you have to do is take advantage of them. The tests are not easy, but they aren't impossible. His lectures are intellectually stimulating and sometimes even fun. He is by far my favorite professor here.

I love Josh Wede. He is very entertaining and I loved going to class. You only have to go to 10 classes the semester and each additional one you go to is .5 extra credit. The quizzes are online. The exams are definitely not easy but if you study and learn the information you should be fine. I would love to take another class taught by him.

This class has extremely difficult content.  It is unlike any other psych class.  That being said, josh was an amazing professor! Go to class, he makes everything super clear.  He also is more than available for help. I have never had a more approachable and fair prof.  He drops an exam and has extra credit too.

By far one of my favorite professors I've had in three years here. Go to class enough to get the clicker points and put a decent amount of effort into studying for quizzestests and this class isn't bad at all. Josh is so funny and sweet, makes his lectures really cool, and will always help you out.

Wede is my favorite professor at PSU. He wants to help you as much as he can, but he also wants you to learn to apply the information. Only need to go to class 10 times, but I never missed because his lectures were genuinely interesting. If you go to class you don't need to read the textbook to get an A. If you miss class he provides notes.

By far my fav professor at PSU. Actually helps students learn how to understand what he's teaching. Never met a prof who really cares about his students and is willing to do everything he can to help you learn. Tests are HARD, but not impossible.

Extremely helpful. He genuinely WANTS you to get an A in the class. there is so much extra credit, and the exams are not that difficult if you put the time in to study a little bit. He has review sessions before every exam that help you get all of the tricky questions right. Never read the textbook and I still got an A.

Extremely nice guy that makes class interesting and occasionally funny. You only need to attend class half of the time for perfect attendance, but more attendance helps with tests and you receive bonus. There are tons of bonus opportunities, but his tests are not easy.

Probably the best professor I have ever had. Lectures are interesting and easy to follow. He provides you with everything you need in order to succeed in his class, all you have to do is give a little effort. TONS of opportunities for bonus. Nice guy, super helpful if you need him. I would recommend taking his section for any class he teaches.
This course was great and Dr. Wede was awesome at making the course fun. Use the study guides for exams and they aren't too hard. Lots of extra credit.

Very passionate and fantastic at what he does! He is ALWAYS smiling and happy to help you if you need it. His positive demeanor makes attending class worth it. All of his explanations were always so clear and his examples helped material sink in. Exams and quizzes were fair also. Will DEFINITELY take another class by him if I ever get the chance.

He is so enthusiastic about teaching and really makes it easy to understand. The tests are not hard at all and if you do the study guide and go to class and answer all the clicker questions. He takes participation points so just go to class. Also do ALL the extra credit possible! It helps a lot and it's kind of fun to do. Great professor!

best class ever!!! hes so adorable and class is actually fun so youre missing out if you skip! quizzes were more difficult than tests. he slips in random questions from info in the textbook so make sure to skim it before tests AND quizzes. all in all my favorite class freshman year fall semester
He is more than willing to meet up with students and try to help them. The tests are not the easiest but a B+ in the class is definitely attainable.

Wede is awesome. Lectures were fun since he included relevant videos in nearly every class period. He provides note outlines for every lecture and study guides for every exam which is really helpful. The tests are somewhat difficult, but they're not impossible if you know all the info from the study guides really well. I definitely recommend him.

Dr. Wede is great! I was absolutely dreading this class but he made it as interesting as possible and I currently have my highest grade of the semester in this class. Pearson is good too but I would recommend taking 301 with Wede. Pearson's A starts at a 95 instead of a 93. And for Wede's final paper you dont have to do the experiment so its easy!
Not too shabby, exams really got to me, but he was helpful and offers a wide variety of exam help tools that I tried to utilize, just poorly.
Horrible at teaching, unhelpful if you need help, I've taken two of his classes and they were both terrible. Avoid if at all possible.
I really liked this class.  The quizzes were annoying but class was usually fun.  Exams were so so.  Read the book and go to class it helps.

This class is very hard.  Although he was one of the most helpful professors I've had, it was the hardest class I took in Psychology. He gives a lot of extra credit which helps a lot. Material in the textbook&lecture are worded conceptually on exams which make the exam almost impossible. Exams are very hard but the work isn't bad. GO TO CLASS.
I loved his class.  Class was always interesting and he gave out a ton of extra credit.  Exams were tough but use the study guide - it helped a ton.

He's a really great guy. The lectures are interesting and easy to understand. He holds trivia sessions and gives study guides to help with exams. There's more than enough extra credit. Overall good professor
Great guy, he makes lectures interesting with his sense of humor.  The tests are challenging but the study guides help some.  He does offer around 16 points of extra credit which really helps.
I could listen to this guy lecture forever. He's a great speaker and the class is pretty interesting for an introductory class. Lots of chances for bonus.
he's really really nice! the lectures are easy and he provides lots of examples to help you understand. and he gives out lots of extra credit. i want to take more of his classes!

The class is just learning psych words which is simple. His lectures are intresting and he gives you notes but they are fill in the blank. HE really helps out. I missed a quiz and he opened it back up for me cause angel crashed! <3 But you use the book a lot so you need it. Id definetly take another class with this guy. thank god i dont have too.
great teacher.. lots of extra credit. interesting class
boss.
Fun class.  Tough exams.  But lots of extra credit.  Go to class - it helps on the exams.

Josh is a super interesting lecturer and makes going to class informative and pretty interesting. Going to class often leads to bonus points, and there is other EC on the side. The tests are pretty hard but going to class and studying goes a long way. I hope he stays at penn state forever.

He's an all-around great teacher. Pretty hilarious, when appropriate, and gets you interested in the lesson. You can tell he knows what he's talking about, and LOVES Psych. The tests are a little hard, but the study guide REALLY helps. I wasted my $ and time buying a textbook, so don't even bother. Overall, he's pretty awesome.
Very fun and laid back class. Don't miss lecture, the discussions are interesting and engaging.
Definitely recommend taking this class. Professor Wede is a great professor and gives a lot of extra credit that will help your grade. You do have to study for tests though.

Awesome professor and a cool guy too.  His lectures were very interesting and I actually enjoyed going to them.  If you know everything on the study guides he provides you'll do well on the exams.  You do have to study though.

He's a good teacher and a nice guy. Class wasn't mandatory but he was pretty engaging. He would always send out very detailed study guides and host a review so it was pretty clear what material would be on the test. He also offers a lot of bonus which boosted me up a letter grade at the end. I'd recommend Josh to anyone for the class. Good guy
Great professor. There is a lot of extra credit, but the class isn't that hard. I wouldn't say that it is an easy A though, you definitely have to study.
Fantastic professor.  Kept me interested the whole year.  Lectures are very well organized and you can get away with not using the textbook.
Great class and great teacher.  Exams weren't easy, but at least class was fun.  I actually didn't mind going.  Definitely take it with this teacher.

Great Gen Ed! Dr. Wede is a great lecturer and he did a good job of integrating videos and other things into his Power Point to keep things interesting. His tests are HARD. Attendance isn't mandatory but unless you want to fail the tests you better show up to class.

Josh was a great professor. Lectures aren't mandatory, but he randomly chooses days where you complete a simple activity that's bonus. He puts up a study guide on ANGEL a week before the exam. You'll ace it if you can answer everything. Three midterms and a final. Easy quizzes once a week or so. Do NOT buy the book. Not necessary to know material.
Interesting lectures full of videos and class activities. Gives out in-class extra credit left and right (especially after exams). Gives easy exams compared to other lecturers.

Good guy and a good lecturer. Tests could be challenging but they followed his in-class notes word for word. I hardly went to class because of this and still pulled out a good grade. DON'T buy the book. He hardly uses the text, at least for PSYCH 100.

Great teacher who knows how to teach well. Answers questions, facilitates discussion, shows videos, and gives extra credit. The tests aren't gimmes but they aren't very hard either. Pretty much tells you you won't ever need the book. Highly recommended, would take a class with him again.
He makes class fun, but the tests are pretty hard.  The study guide definitely helps.
He is so nice and always willing to help students.

The tests are hard, but they are exactly from the notes, with few curveballs.  You don't HAVE to buy the book, since the test is strait out of the notes, but reading the book helped me.  He's young and happy to help and answer questions.
His tests are exactly like the study guides. He's really nice and helpful and gives tons of bonus.

Wede is a pretty cool guy. He's enthusiastic about his lectures and gives a lot of extra credit. The lectures are posted online before class, but quizzes are announced in class. So, if you skip class, you won't know if there is a quiz.

He was a really cool guy.  His lectures were filled with interesting stuff-I actually really liked going to class.  The tests wern't exactly easy, but they were very strait forward.  He gives you a study guide before the test that contains everything you will need to know for the exam, so the class is very stress free.  Study the guides = an easy A

Great Teacher, Help me a lot.  I got 65's on my first to test.  An 80 on my third and a 69 on my final.  The final is cumulative, but if you study you should be alright.  His quizzes are online and timed but they are easy most of the questions can be found on Google.  One of the greatest teachers in Penn State.
Exams are impossible, too many trick questions. Lectures are extremely boring. Terrible teacher. I would NOT recommend him.

Wede is a good professor who is very interested in what he teaches which makes the class fun. He sounds like he has a nasal problem but you get used to it. The tests are very material heavy but if you put the time in you can do well. The PSYCH studies required seemed like a pain in the ass at first but turned out to be fun.

He is a great teacher. I found the course extremely easy. but then again someone on my floor got c's in all the exams. where as i got A's. I did study hard. It's really interesting, reading the book helps and his lecture outlines should be read before exams.
He makes things very easy, exam questions come straight from notes and he gives a study guide for each exam!  If you go to class and pay attention to the lecture, you will be fine!

Funny guy, good sense of humor so it makes the class more interesting.  Also watch a lot of Youtube clips which is cool. I never read the book but still got a good grade in the class (A-). Not much work outside of class required.
great guy

Hated this class- terrible... His tests are very difficult- you really have to know each detail of each lecture slide + to get an A you pretty much have to read each chapter at least 3x over. Good Luck- my recommendation: find a different teacher.
Great guy and great professor. Dirk Mateer of the Psychology Department. Hopefully will be at Penn State for years to come.

Wow... hardest class my freshman year.  I had to do sooo much work and studying in order to pull off an A.  The class is interesting, but overall just take a different teacher.  This guy is crazy hard.

All outlines for class are posted on angel, and if there are no blanks you can easily skip class. If you do, just check angel to see if he announced a quiz, which you have a day to do. Exams are all multiple choice but are easy as long as you study a fair amount. Josh is always upbeat and makes the subject interesting by showing a lot of videos.
He was the instructor for my online class. He was very accessible and the class followed the textbook.
Very helpful in office hours. Really does care about students who are not getting the material. Didn't really need the textbooks because the stuff you need is in the lecture or on ANGEL.
Very helpful.  Genuinly cares about people have difficulty.  Makes things as easy as possible while maintaining a professional level of work.  Would love to have him for another class.

Josh is a good professor.  The course is identical to AP psych classes in high school.  All the notes are online and he is very easy to understand.  He provides a lot of examples that make the information easier to remember, but you will still need to study for exams. He also announces online quizzes in class so if you miss class, check angel.

Josh is absolutely a nice guy, but he lacks teaching skills. While he has a LOT of knowledge on the topic, he does not know how to put it into a context for his students to understand.  Requires a LOT of study time, tests are hard!! Class attendance is not mandatory, but he surprises you with exercises at times for class credit.
Overall great professor!  You have to work in his class though.  But you will learn a lot that applies to your everyday life.
No Comments
No Comments

Prof. Wede is an overall really nice guy. He loves what he teaches and knows how to relate the class to his students. The class is pretty hard, but if you study and go to his lecture then it's really not that bad. He is extremely helpful and open to criticism and wants to know how to improve. Shows a lot of videos too. I liked the class/prof

Lectures are really boring, which can make coming to class difficult, but attendance is mandatory. I don't think he's a tough grader, but there are a lot of assignments, mainly due the same day of the lecture. DON'T GET THE BOOK. You won't use it. He's pretty chill and easy to approach. Very understanding. Easy class.

Honestly, I don't understand how he grades essays. Class is mandatory but the lectures are pointless. The feedback on essays usually doesn't make much sense. The assignments for class are very easy and graded on completion but he offers no feedback on those. All in all not a time consuming class but not a very good professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Do not take. He whispers and is impossible to hear. Really tough grader. I never once got below an A in HS for any essay, and it was a private school, and my first two essays in his class I got like 1.67/4. He gives a lot of feedback that basically means nothing, and the girl next to me barely showed up to class and got 4/4 on all 3 essays...so...

Genuinely the absolute worst professor I've had. I'm now a junior and created this account specifically to warn against this guy, took his class as a freshman as I didn't know any better and regret it to this day. Mandatory attendance, tried on every essay and struggled. Am yet to receive a grade below an A in any class except his.

I actually thought Professor Wherley was underrated. Super nice guy and generally pretty reasonable. ENGL 15 was essentially just AP Lang all over again, so it's generally pretty easy as long as you took that. 75% of the grade comes from 3 essays, so you do have to lock in on those.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
NO! 
Homework is assigned and due THE SAME DAY...
He is such a hard grader on essays...
whispers...
talks about sweet nothings for an hour of class and its mandatory ...
you can tell he cares about his job, but he is just not it ...
English should be an easy class Gen ED and it's not....

Professor Wherley is way overhated on here. He is actually a great teacher and has an interesting personality. He is patient and wants you to succeed. He is very lenient with accepting late work and overall an understanding and great guy.
All of the assignments are due the day of class and the grading is TOUGH.

If you really want to challenge yourself, Prof. Wherley will put your writing skills to the test. He is extremely knowledgeable and has a deep understanding of the English language. He grades harshly and homework is often due the day it is assigned. If you actually want to improve as a writer, he is the professor for you. Don't take for an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Worst professor I've ever had. Impossible to understand what he's saying because he talks like he's shakespeare reincarnated. Also mumbles throughout his sentence so it gets harder and harder to hear him. Toughest grader ever and feedback he gives never makes sense. Class was a complete waste of time.

Talks quietly and makes himself impossible to hear or understand. Gives almost no feedback and after he gives you a bad grade for no reason. Uses participation to just lower the students grades for no reason. wastes a ton of class time. made us buy a book we used the first week and then never again. Makes no attempt helping failing student.
Not a great communicator and an unreasonable grader.

He taught well in the class, but would sometimes lower his sentence to a mumble and you couldn't hear what he was saying (I sat towards the front of a 20 person classroom). 
Feedback he gave that you put into your essay was told it was unclear, even though he suggested it. Kind of a hard grader.
Had him for ENGL 15. Gave feedback on the assignment, but the grade was the opposite of the feedback given. Great guy, but a tough grader.
Had him for ENGL 15. Would give feedback, but it was the complete opposite when it came to the grading. Great guy, but a tough grader.
Very hard grader. Would take so many points off for just spelling errors. When asking for help he simply just spoke for 20 minutes about the most random things. Nice guy, tough grader.

yeah i had to drop this course instantly he does not know how to grade whatsoever and i dont know why penn state allows untrained grad students to teach courses that are for credit. never take this course with this guy . he's a student himself and is not the best at english as he admits himself.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: who let this guy teach this course . he is not good at his job whatsoever

lots of reading before each class and have to actively participate else grade will be affected

grading:he is extremely harsh. no one is on track for an A(maybe only 2-3 english majors) 

gives low grades but provides no feedback for the entire class making it feel even more discouraging.

an A is impossible

I would not recommend taking this class
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: so much reading , so many assignments , for absolutely no reason . i heard other engl 15 professors give way less homework because i mean ITS ENGL 15. it's not supposed to be rocket science. he loves making it impossible for the whole class to get a bad grade.and hes a grad student so he has little to no experience teaching.dont select this course,
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Thisprofessor grades really badly and he dismisses anything you ask him afterclass or in office hours I asked him if I could write about something other than my previous assignments and he said yes he even saw my work process each class and in each assignment and he never said anything. He failed me the project for not remixing previous assignments

good at explaining in class but awful grading ( possibly the worst grader ) .  always got good grades including english in college as well but he's just the worst grader . decent guy although he may come across a little awkward .

This class was much more enjoyable with Dr.Woodward. The class was genuinely not that hard, just a lot of work. A lot of the content comes from the textbook, which is required for you to read before the lecture. She really just reinforced concepts rather than fully teaching things. She was very nice and funny, so I would definitely recommend her.

Woodward is an exceptional professor. Her lectures are engaging and entertaining, and she consistently fosters a positive, educational atmosphere in the classroom. She is very caring! Her teaching style feels conversational yet remains highly informative. Paying attention in her class will be very beneficial to your success.

I never interacted with her, but she's nice. You have 5 exams, the lowest grade gets dropped, but they can be challenging if you aren't working with it outside of class. She praises the learning guides, but their helpfulness varies. You do have a 3 hr lab each week, but my lab leader Lily, was pretty chill and the lab can help your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Ok, take this course if science is not your go-to subject. I like Denise; she's funny and casual, knows how to make the class laugh, and she's an amazing teacher. Definitely easier than most high school biology courses. To pass the exams, just show up and read the tutorials; they really help give you a background on the topic. It's that easy! 5/5

Dr. Woodward is such an amazing professor. SO sweet and really knowledgable about what she is teaching. Always made lecture interesting and fun. I found this class to be very straightforward and easy. The content did not really surpass highschool level biology. Dr. Woodward helped prepare for questions you would see on the exams.

My main issue with this class is that the exam reviews by the lead TA's don't help you at all. I just spent the last 3 days reviewing learning guides and practice tests (like the prof told us to do) and like not even a quarter of what we reviewed was on my exam. the review sessions are pointless and don't cover important material.

her exams are in pollock. shes a very fun prof and shes a very nice person. class was kinda hard but that was more of a me problem than a her problem. i would 10000% take a class with her again. ATTEND HER EXAM REVIEWS!!!!

Dr. Woodward is by far THE best professor at PSU. This class was so much fun, you had a few small readings and a discussion due once a week, but other than that all we did in class was do projects regarding the garden. Would take this course again in a heartbeat, take any class you can with Dr. Woodward she is amazing!!!!!

Great professor! You can tell she loves what she does. Lectures are fun and engaging and the greenhouse project was fun. I ended with a canvas grade of 88 and an A on lionpath. Idk how that happened, but I'll take it!

She's the course coordinator, so she knows what she's talking about. Exams are tougher than you think at first, studying really matters. Final is structured great! She's so passionate and funny, really cares about biology. I hope she teaches forever.

Dr Woodward is great. The class is cookie cutter, but that's what you get for gen bio. She tries to give thoughtful explanations and make sure things are clear. She also really cares about teaching how to learn effectively. She was always happy to answer questions and wanted to see her students succeed.

Very good lectures and notes. I won't lie I stopped going after the first month and still ended with an A-. Attendance is not mandatory. Had her in lab once and she's just an all-around great professor to talk with.

Professor Woodward really cares about biology and makes her lectures very engaging. Attendance is not mandatory but make sure to keep up with the learning guides. Exams weren't difficult and lectures prepared me well.

Professor Woodward is passionate about biology and makes lectures engaging. The class uses a free online textbook, and while attendance is mandatory, you can still do well by studying the learning guides and using resources like unstuck study for exam prep.

I have always loved Dr. Woodward's classes. She is genuinely interested in what she teaches and knows the information like the back of her hand. Bio 110 can be tough in general but if you apply yourself, do the learning guides, and study ahead of time you will do good in the class. She prepares you for everything that is on the exams.

she is so cute and obviously loves bio and teaching. lectures are definitely not mandatory especially if you've taken bio in hs. you can learn everything from the readings and learning guides and lectures are recorded too. overall super easy class with a lot of grades from small canvas quizzes u can look up.

Professor Woodward does a great job teaching! She definitely cares about students (always willing to answer questions mid-lecture) and is passionate and knowledgable about biology. Honestly, not a ton of homework (1-2 assignments/week). Exams are pretty easy if you do practice questions and take notes during/before class. TAs are helpful as well.

I took 133 for credit, thinking it would be easier being an intro class. However, I was mistaken and this class was more stressful than my major classes. Prof Woodward is a great lady and the lectures aren't bad, the choice between in person and zoom was amazing. But there is a ton of material and exams cover 1/4 of it, so studying can be tricky.

dr woodward is so sweet and funny. the 4 exams can be a little hard but the questions are based off of homeworks, tophat questions n textbook. def recommend reading textbook when studying for exams. writing assignments didnt take much time and are interesting. quizzes are easy but timed. exams are in pollock. review sessions helped sooo much
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Respected

reviews.comment: Tests were not too bad if you read the textbook and don't cheat on the HW. Shes a fun teacher and was a fun class

Professor Woodward is a great teacher who is clearly passionate about the subject she teaches and always willing to stop mid class to answer questions. There is not a lot of homework in this class at all (perhaps 2 assignments/week). Exams are relatively easy if you study/do practice problems. LAs are helpful as well as the professor's office hours
Is  a very good teacher, explains key concepts well. Office hours are very helpful, makes lectures for the most part interesting and engaging
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Test heavy

reviews.comment: I love Professor Woodward. You can really tell she is passionate about what she does and it makes lectures more enjoyable. The class is tophat-heavy, but the tophat questions aren't graded. If you've taken AP bio it is a pretty easy A. The class uses a free online textbook which is nice.

One of my favorite professors. She makes her lectures fun and light. Wants everyone to succeed and cares for her students. There are two midterms and a take-home final. One group project which is actually fun to do and a lot of case studies that you do in groups. There are quizzes on assigned readings so actually read the material.

I struggle to formulate how incredible this professor is. Words can not express how exceptional and smart of a person this professor is. I am an A student and this professor saved me to say the least. She saw my potential and did not let me suffer in a pool of failure. Rather she saw my potential and threw out a life vest of success. LOVE her!!
Although Woodward is a very nice person, exams tend to be pretty hard. The lab grade and homework assignments eventually make up for it and one exam gets dropped which is nice.

Dr. Woodward is probably one of the best profs I have ever had. She was extremely personable snd you genuinely wanted to hear what she had to say. The exams are straightforward and you will do well if you listen to lectures and do the assigned assignments. She wants her students to suceed and she truly does care- which is hard to find in most profs

Great energy, explains sometimes complicated topics in a super simple/digestable way, offers zoom option if you prefer to stay home. She uses her own textbook, but it's cheap and is written specifically for the exams, so I didn't mind reading it. I was dreading this class but I'm super interested in it now because of her teaching!

BIO 110 is a very easy class. Exams are straightforward and the lowest score is dropped. Lectures are recorded and are best enjoyed on 2.5x speed (or not watched at all). Very few concepts are discussed each week. The hardest part of this course is lab, which is only annoying if your partner is bad. Lab is 1-2 busy work assignments each week.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Bio 110 is easy for students who came in with previous upper-level biology experience like AP Bio, my friends who didn't have any exposure to previous biology concepts Woodward's lecture style was boring and hard to understand. The exams are hard to study for since the questions come from deep within lectures or homework.
