Most boring class I have ever sit through. Her lectures were slow and all over the place. Class was easy mostly because of the one exam drop and lab points. If you study the LA exam review and your homework's before the test, you can get away with not doing the learning guides.
She is honestly a great prof and makes the exams based off the learning guides. Worst thing about her is that she talks a little slow but overall is so nice and caring.

Professor Woodward has to be one of my favorite professors. She is great and she hardly assigns any work except for some online assignments. The class is fairly simple, just make sure you do your work and learning guides and you should be fine . She is very nice and cares a lot about her students. The lab for this class isn't bad at all either.

Dr. Woodward knows what she is talking about and explains things so they make sense. This class was interesting and exams were easy if you study and review the homeworks, class quizzes, and tophat questions.
I loved Dr. Woodward's class. Her explanations were easy to understand and the tests are similar to the learning guides and homework. I would recommend taking Bio110 with her.

Professor Woodward is one of the best Bio professors Ive had at psu and I cannot say enough good things about her. For Bio 133, her exams are super straight forward if you pay attention in class, do well on the chapter quizzes, and pay attention to the TopHats. She is accessible outside of class and makes learning interesting

You must take Biol 133 with her! The class itself is not a lot of work, and is easy to understand if you go to class or Zoom and pay attention. Exams require studying, but are easy. Plenty of examples and practice in class. She is lowkey so funny and just such a cute woman. She cares about her students so much it's truly heartwarming

I loved having her as a prof. She was nice and funny and the concepts were pretty easy to understand. The exams were difficult at times but honestly if you study and go to class you'll do great! I can't recommend end this class enough.

One of the best professors I've ever had. Course material is organized clearly by exam block. Lectures are fun and engaging. Gives amazing practice and examples to help students understand. Gives a lot of time to meet with students to discuss class materials and past exams. Helped me quickly understand concepts I've always struggled with.

Enjoyable class. Very clear and thorough. Uses tophat for practice. Has option of going in person or on zoom and posts lecture recordings on Canvas. Posts lectures and extra practice online. Quizzes and exams are kinda hard but they hold review sessions.

Woodward is a nice caring professor. Shes passionate about what she teaches. The content is not difficult but it is A LOT. For every exam there are a million different concepts you need to know and throughly understand. The lab will help your grade tremendously in this class. One exam is dropped. Put in the effort and youll be fine.
Class was not too hard and the lectures were actually enjoyable.

Decent teacher, but an insane amount of homework. She clearly is interested in what she is teaching but the subject matter can be a little boring and tedious at times. Overall I would take her course again.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Dr. Woodward is awesome!!! you can tell she really just loves teaching people about biology. If you go to class, all of the exam questions come from her lecture slides or the homework. Lowest exam score is dropped, so you have the chance to do well in the class if you put in a decent amount of effort.
She is an amazing professor and her lectures are never boring. She does make things interesting and teaches very well. You won't regret taking her class!

Woodward's class was super fun as a freshmen. Her homework is helpful and the questions from the homework are also used in her test/exams. Super easy A/B if you put in the work. Her class is fair game, take notes, do the homework, show up to class, and ask questions. Super fun teacher and incredibly passionate about what she teaches. Nicely done ��
Very organized with information

Exams are really tough, but that is a symptom of the class not the professor. She is clearly the best BIOL110 professor. She is caring and interesting to listen to. Homework and projects are generally useless.
kinda boring but relatively easy and denise knows how to do online teaching well, as she taught web campus before. the lab can be annoying though

The nicest professor ever. Always very considerate, caring, and VERY laid back. Every assignment we took we took in groups, and the assignments were not hard at all. I am 99% sure everybody got an A in the class, and the information is very interesting. She always offered extra time after the due date, and you can tell she is very passionate

Woodward was super nice and really did work with you and was super flexible. Lectures could get a little boring and monotone here and there but she threw jokes in to try and keep attention. LAs were super accessible as well. Would take it again but definetly study. Dropped the lowest test score which was super nice.

If you're here looking for a professor for BIOL110, look no further. Dr. Woodward by far has been my all-time favorite prof during my time at PSU. I recommend not underestimating this course due to its lack of homework because the exams are heavily weighted and pretty challenging. I also recommend going to LA office hours - they are really helpful!

I love Dr. Woodward. I'm taking her class on zoom and the only homework we have is Mastering Biology and we barely have assignments for it and it takes max o30 minutes. The exams are pretty easy and straightforward, and she does practice problems during lectures that are on the exam. She's super sweet and the workload is light, surprisingly.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: A nice lady and her class isn't the hardest. If you put in work you'll do well. Her class is a pretty standard biology 110 class and just what I expected.

Class is easy for biology-based majors but can be challenging for non-science majors. Exam questions come pretty much from the clickers and quizzes. If you come to class and do all the homework, no reason why anyone can't get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: The workload is incredible for an online class. I've taken many online classes, none have ever required the amount of time and dedication that this class does. The testing is ridiculous. Truly some of the most conceptual and difficult testing I've ever experienced. I wouldn't recommend to my worst enemy.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Woodward is fine enough. There is a lot of learning on your own and the tests are quite difficult. It's definitely a weed-out class, so don't get discouraged if you're struggling. She isn't terrible, but she isn't going to be the best professor you've ever had. I didn't enjoy this class and almost changed my major because of it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: There's soooo much connect homework but you basically learn a lot of the material from it while getting free points and class is like a review of the textbook. If you've taken a 200-level bio, this class is all review of things you already know, which was my case, so I had a hard time making myself go to class. If not it may be more challenging.

Poorly explains topics, class is primarily self taught and lectures are minimally helpful for expanding knowledge of the covered topics. Tests tend to ask obscure questions on topics covered. Should have run the first day when she said "I don't lecture, I guide discussions." Be ready to use your iClickers, a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Literally the hardest class i have ever taken, and she doesnt help. You have to read and basically learn everything for yourself. Lecture is basically just clicker points and some examples. The tests are SO hard. The questions are designed to trick you. The average exam score was a D for every exam. If you take this class, well good luck Charlie.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: I have taken two classes with Dr. Woodward (bio 110 as a freshman and bio 415 as a sophomore) and have also been one of her bio 110 LAs. Dr. Woodward is an excellent professor, quite possibly the best I've had (now a senior). She gives you the resources you need to do well, but will not hold your hand. Take her classes if you can.
Very knowledgeable and will help if asked, but expect alot of material and knowledge making. Study alot!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr Woodward is the most amazing professor I have ever had. Makes a genetics course fun and worth going to class. You only need 5 clicker questions correct per exam block. The TA is awesome and helps guide students through the clicker questions. If you have to take BIO133 it would be a mistake to take it with anyone other than Denise!

Woodward is truly a peach. This course is tough, it's not an easy A, but an A or high B is attainable if you put in the work. Homework doesn't take that long and you have unlimited attempts. 4 exams, 4 quizzes, 2 essays (1 page each), and 30 homeworks. Solid choice for genetics.

Shes fine! Nothing really special, a very nice woman who loves her job! Her exams are kinda hard - they ask trick questions and she gives awful study material. I used everything she gave us - could do it in my sleep yet got 70's or below on exams. Concepts aren't hard her questions are. The HW is really long and time consuming too.

I really loved this professor and her class! It was by far my favorite at Penn State. She teaches such interesting material and in a way you can understand and feel smart doing it! She has fun with lecture and makes sure it is interactive - I feel I can only learn that way. Several projects and group work but nothing you can't handle!

Denise is such a great professor. She goes in depth with what you really need to focus on for the exams and gives many many examples of how to complete tricky problems. She's very personable and cares about student successes. Online practice exams are the best indicator of what test questions will be expected to look like.

Dr. Woodward is a great teacher. She explains things in a way you can understand. Going to lectures wasn't so bad because she makes thing interesting and funny. I didn't go to office hours because she was pretty accessible via email and provides a very helpful online textbook.

Denise is the best! She made lectures fun and informative. For really big classes like BIOL110, I'd recommend sitting towards the front of the room to help with staying focused. I also never read the learning guides and instead took my own notes on the tutorials and that worked super well for me. Denise is awesome definitely take her if you can!!

TAKE DR. WOODWARD FOR THIS CLASS! Her lectures are very thorough and are extremely beneficial in clearing up concepts that were hard to understand. Enjoyed going to this class. Read the tutorials, do the homework, and keep your grade up in lab. The tests were challenging, but managable if you study the right way (mind maps highly recommended).

Bio 110 is difficult and definitely a weed out class, but if you're taking it TAKE DENISE. She is by far the best 110 professor, and she is the head of the department so she really knows how to present new things. It does take some getting use to, but if you do the tutorials and take noted on your own as well as notes in lecture you'll be good.

This class is all over the place. Definitely the most disorganized class Ive ever taken. The material is not bad to learn, but the way it is presented is not ideal. Dr. Woodward is a great professor. Her exams are kind of difficult but if you learn how to study for it you will be fine. Work is online, class is basically only for clicker points.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Woodward is amazing. She is smart and actually pretty funny. The class is not that hard at all and she goes over in detail what will be on the test in class. As long as you go to class and take her practice exams you will get an A. The only annoying part is the homework and the lab work but the averages on both are very high.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Easy going professor but tests are extremely difficult. Need to study weeks in advance for them and questions on the exams seemed to be aimed to confuse you. If you are on top of the work in advance you should be fine, but don't fall behind. Lots of good points incorporated from Lab.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Dr. Woodward is really chill and funny and I enjoyed her lectures, but the course overall seemed to be kind of all over the place. The course is a little more in-depth than a typical AP Biology course but you won't have any trouble because Dr. Woodward & all the LAs are ready to help you. Many opportunities to get help w/ the course if you need it.

I actually really enjoyed this class and found the lectures to be well taught and informative. Tests are difficult but if you pay attention, take good notes, and study in advance you will be fine. This is a weed out class so it isn't necessarily an easy A, but I thought with detailed lectures and guided notes an A was not unattainable.

Professor Woodward was pretty cool, and class was decent. The tutorials ARE TERRIBLE but overall if you take good notes and study for exams, youll be fine in this class. Shes funny and is really good at explaining material

Absolutely the worst teacher I have ever had. She gave me a zero on a group assignment that I missed due to a funeral, and even after acknowledging the circumstances refused to change the grade. Recently, she submitted the wrong exam to the testing center and offered a re-take, in which after reading my availability still scheduled me horribely.

A lot of this is learning on your own. Lecture on really counts for clicker points. Exams are definitely tough. The average for each exam is never really high. Not very clear and sometimes some of the LAs don't even know what she is talking about.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Doesn't deserve a paycheck. The information you will learn from this course is going to be 100% from the online textbook which she assigns as reading, and then insults you during lecture by pretty much reading it back at you. Anybody can tell you what to read and test you on it. Being a good teacher requires a lot more
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: i would take a class with professor woodward whenever possible. she is extremely sweet and very approachable and personable. her lectures are entertaining, and she does not lecture heavy. homework is due every day before class, but it is online and easy. definitely a loved and respected professor.

Denise is awesome. She's a very hard grader and her exams are difficult, but that does not mean she isn't a great professor. Show up, take good notes, and study hard- her exams are very fair. She is overall a lovely person and one of my favorite professors at Penn State.
Great professor except she is very hard. Answers your questions however sometimes her explanations are not clear. Homework is all online and difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: This should be an online class. The only reason I went to class was for clickers. Otherwise, the class was pointless and Denise made them fairly boring and annoying . You can literally just read the tutorials before the tests and get A's on them, lectures don't matter. She tries to trick everyone on clickers to show superiority, which is annoying.

This class covers a lot and it's pretty boring, but she makes it somewhat bearable. Lectures definitely cleared up the big concepts & the clicker points were helpful, but you will probably need to do A LOT of studying because the exams cover so much. We could drop our lowest exam and if you do well on hw and labs they give you a decent boost.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: She's a very nice lady and makes the lectures interesting. Only thing is tests are kind of tough, you need to read the tutorials thoroughly and make sure you take good notes. Studying the night before will not help. Clicker points and homework boost your grade but not enough to help if you're failing.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Exams are tough, but if you put the effort in the class really isn't bad. As long as you read the tutorials and are good at memorization, you will be fine. Denise made lectures interesting and made some of the more difficult concepts easy to understand. Don't skip!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Homework takes forever and material is confusing! The sequence of course material is odd and she tries to make it engaging but it is terrible
reviews.rating_tags: LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Tests are tough--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This class was the most difficult class I have ever taken and I'm a junior. I struggled to pass the class. She went out of her way to make the final exam as difficult. Exams are tricky, confusing, and you need to study hours on end.
Denise didn't get with the program.
The class average for my section was 68%. Good luck!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This class is very challenging.  It requires work and studying.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: I thought this woman was better at teaching basic biology concepts that were covered in AP Bio than my actual AP Bio teacher. Also, she made boring concepts into funny things to remember during lectures. She made Biol 110 seem like a breeze compared to Chem 110. If you read tutorials, come to class, and do reading guides and review you'll do fine!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Denise is pretty funny and she's great at explaining everything. I found exams to be hard because there are a lot of application type questions. So if you're good at applying concepts this class shouldn't be too difficult as long as you study. Personally, I had to work really hard, but I managed an A-.
She manages to make boring concepts interesting and engaging through discussion and her diagrams. Hilarious!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Absolutely loved Denise Woodward. She makes the Bio110 exams and they are pretty difficult, but read through the tutorials and do the MasteringBiology homework and you'll be completely fine! I felt her lectures to be pretty helpful as well - she explains some tricky things you may not initially understand in the tutorial.. don't skip!

Attendance is not mandatory because everything is online but you should go to class for the clicker points. The exams are okay but Dr. Woodward makes everything easier to understand. If you have to take Biol 110, I would really recommend taking it with her.

Overall, Denise was a very delightful professor to be around. It was easy to tell that she had a passion for the course material and she wanted her students to have the same passion as well. However, her tests are very difficult and a lot more specific than her lectures. If you absolutely hate biology, you will probably find this course very hard.
Excellent professor. She made lectures bearable and interesting. She offers practice questions online before exams which are exactly like the test questions.

I have taken such harder bio courses and have received flying colors, yet in this class I can barley keep a C. She skips around so much during her lectures and does not answer all the questions that she posts on the slide. She also does not give you enough time to answer clicker questions, which is awful because they are used for points. Good luck.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: She is a great professor. She was able to make even boring subjects entertaining by making jokes. Get your clicker point! The tutorials are only necessary for studying the tests. The mastering biology assignments are easy, you don't have to read the tutorials.

Woodward is such a good professor. She really explains the material and makes it interesting. However it is up to you to put the work into it. The class is very challenging and requires ALOT of reading and work, but I'm glad I have Woodward to help me.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: I took BIOL 110 as a summer session course my freshman year. Half was taught by her and the next is taught by Dr. Toppper. She is an incredible teacher! Lectures are engaging and entertaining. The course itself can be tough but if you do the tutorial and ask questions when you don't understand you will be fine.

Denise is great! She keeps the class interesting and is super helpful with questions or one-on-one.  The tests can be tough, but if you keep up with readings and go to lecture it's not bad.  Plus, one exam gets dropped.  Also, the LA office hours and help with clicker questions are a great resource.

Dr. Woodward was an amazing professor. She always made lecture interesting, and is extremely kind and helpful. Bio 110 is not that bad of a class if you attend all of the lectures and do the learning guides outside of class. Woodward was always clear about what material was important to learn for the test, and I would highly recommend her as a prof

Denise was such a great teacher! She made even the most boring topics interesting, she's a very coveted teacher for this reason. She explains things in full detail and really lets you know what's important for the exams.

BIO 110 was one of the hardest classes I've taken in my life. Denise is a great teacher, but the tests (which account for 60% of your grade) were very challenging as they focused more on your critical thinking skills than how well you knew the content. Also, this class covers A LOT of content so get ready to study really hard!

Dr. Wooward is awesome! I love the way she taught bio! She is very clear with her powerpoints and referring to the tutorials. Speaking of which,  the tutorials can get very tedious, but they are important! Dr. Woodward is also hilarious and can make the whole lecture hall laugh! I wasn't a fan of the order of the class material, but I loved Denise

I LOVE Denise Woodward.  Her lectures are super clear, and she manages to make a lecture hall with 350+ students laugh.  Exams are tricky, so make sure you set aside time to study.  Only thing keeping me from giving this class a 10/10 is the lab.  Lab can be a huge pain if the TA is a jerk - which trust me, it can happen.  Take this class anyway!

Woodward is the best. She really explains and knows the material. She uses powerpoints but also takes handwritten notes with the class, and always asks if you have questions. She really cares about her students. The exams are tough but the lowest gets dropped. I would go to her lecture, she focuses on the material on the exam, and helps you learn
She's a very interesting lady whose teaching style is effective. However, expect to do all of your review solo as there is very little time set aside for that in class.

Bio 110 is rough. However, Denise takes something awful and makes it as good as she possibly can. She explains things well and is always willing to answer questions. She does her best to keep Thomas 100 engaged, and sometimes she's funny. She's a sweet person. Go to class for clicker points, do the Mastering Biology hw, study for the exams.

Denise is a nice lady. With that being said BIO 110 is not a nice class. I found it to be harder than CHEM 110 with a prof that barely spoke English. DO NOT EXPECT AN EASY A. This class gave me nightmares. I spend countless times in the lib trying to study for an exam that is so general and vague tricky. If you have to take this class, good luck.

Very good at keeping a large lecture hall full of kids entertained. Although attendance is considered to be mandatory, you have plenty of opportunity for clicker points and can definitely miss a few classes. Very clear lectures. No review before exams, which are a little tough compared to what's covered in class

110 is an Intro level class so the material isn't too difficult, so the mandatory attendance is a nuisance. She does her best to keep a room filled  with 600 kids entertained. She's very nice and will help at her office hours

This course is marked as "for non-majors", but I'd argue it's in between a bio major and bi-sci course. Sure, it's not as in depth as other courses, but a lot of it overlaps w/ BIOL 110 and goes into further depth than is unnecessary for say a liberal arts major. It's more for people in the applied-sciences and NOT to be seen as an "easy gen ed."

Overall, the class was pretty easy and I didn't have a whole lot of trouble. Going to class was helpful for note and clicker points, try not to skip too much. Make sure to do all the online assignments since those are easy points you don't want to miss. Also, when studying for tests, use your online assignments because some questions are verbatim.

Dr. Woodward's lectures are clear and she makes use of iClickers to help practice exam questions in class. The tutorials are a nice break from the textbook since they are a little more interactive. The lab was pretty easy and helped apply the lecture material. One of five exam grades is dropped. Take this class with Dr. Woodward!

This class is easy if you take the time to read the tutorials and take good notes.  The lab portion can be a bit confusing at times but most teaching assistants are willing to help. There is a mix of memorization and application on the exams questions so make sure you really understand the material.

I liked Denise. She's really nice and helpful, but when it comes to Bio 110, it really doesn't matter what professor you have. It's an extremely time-consuming and difficult course, and you basically teach yourself all the material. If you want an A or B in the course you need to study and take notes constantly and not wait until before the exam!

This was a difficult course. I studied quite hard, yet the exams were impossible (even with Nittany notes and attending every class). Homework assignments, online quizzes, and lab definitely saved my grade. Do not expect to walk out with an easy A
Clear and direct with the information you need for the test. Class is slightly interesting for Biology.
class was really hard and alot of work, not a bad teacher though but it was alot

Very good teacher.  She's very cute and fun. Easy class, they even drop 1 exam score... How could you not get at least a B+ in this class. I love Woodward though she's amazing if I was her age I would ask her on a date

Dr. Woodward is really nice if you ever get to interact with her. However, the class is SO MUCH WORK. There's 3 online quizzes every week along with 1 homework a week and an extra quiz on exam weeks. PLUS a lab quiz on some weeks. THE LAB IS HORRIBLE. I swear it's designed to stress you out. The lecture is basically mandatory for clicker ?s.

Enjoyed going to lectures.  Sometime we had movie days, which were always pretty dull.  Good at answering emails.  Exams are on material covered in class.  Questions are mostly strait foreword, with a few difficult questions on each exam.
Very clearly enthusiastic about the subject material and seems to enjoy teaching the class.

The assignments, online quizzes, and clicker points are easy; the tests are hard if you don't actively process/learn the material thoroughly. Labs can take down your grade depending on the TA, but there's a chance they'll be curved. Dr. Woodward is really nice and always really enthusiastic. Find some bio buddies sit with @ lecture and study with.
Had a blast in my freshman seminar with her!
Class requires studying but is not impossible. Adds in assignments and case studies to bring grades up. Very nice and knowledgeable.
She's not the greatest professor in the world.  Some poor planning on her part and harsh grading kind of turned me off to this class. She also is really really slow to post grades.

Class was fairly easy, and Woodward is very nice. Reading the online tutorials was very helpful for me, as were the online powerpoints.  Clickers were broken, so we did online quizzes through ANGEL, which were easy points. She was easy to understand, and her presentations were very clear.  Did not buy book but would recommend going to class.

Good teacher. She really takes her time and makes sure people understand the concepts before she moves on. It's a tough class but as long as you put the time in shes is always there to help. Overall a good quality teacher.
Was not at all helpful outside of class, poor communication.

Dr. Woodward is a great professor. Material is not that hard and if you just go over her powerpoints before exams you'll do fine. Has a great sense of humor. Projects are easy and so are the quizzes if you just read the book. Interesting material and she presented very clearly. Highly Recommend if you can take it.

Ecotoxicology is my favorite 400 level Biology class I have taken.  There are tons of points to earn.  Group projects, quizzes, and case studies boost your grade.  Not based on just exams.  Topics are interesting, notes are clear, exams are fair.  Dr. Woodward is very helpful.  Got an A without too much work.  Highly recommend!!!

Professor Woodward presents you with all the information you need to do well in the course but it is up to you to teach yourself everything. This class requires a lot of studying regardless of the teacher. She gives clicker questions for attendance points and the rest is exams. Study hard and teach yourself all the information she presents

She was a very good professor.  Kept class interesting with side expansions on the material.  Taught what was important and got rid of all the unnecessary information.  Clicker questions require class attendance, but by going and paying attention you can limit your study time by a great deal.

She was really fun to have at 9AM, which is saying something. She didnt mind talking and was easy going and i felt prepared for exams. Read powerpoints and go to class to get the "clicker question" points and you will do well.
great class, gives many diff opp to raise grade, not only about exams, many group projects
Dr. Woodward is awesome!  Go to the lectures because her notes are the exams.  The class was definitely work, but its worth it.

Dr. Woodward is a great teacher. I've noticed a lot of people saying that she's horrible and that her tests are tough. REMEMBER that she doesn't write the curriculum for the course, the department does! She teaches what is required of her to teach to you! Go to class, ask questions, and study hard you'll be fine. 110 is one of the toughest courses!

Amazing!Dr. Woodward is an excellent teacher, she has a way of explaining things that makes them so simple and clear to understand. There's a lot of work involved, but she makes you want to do it, and to learn. I would recommend Dr. Woodward to anybody.

She's a solid prof.  Smart, communicable, funny, understanding, kind, etc - she's really a great person.  Lectures were boring though, and I was only there because of the clicker questions.  Book isn't needed, lab is easy.  The first half of the class is high school bio.  It's a standard level 100 class in terms of difficulty, i.e. it's really easy

I loved the class.  The material was interesting and Denise's presentations are very clear.  The class is big, but she's always there to answer questions.  The book is more or less optional because any material not covered in lectures will not be on the test.  Just make sure to show up for case studies.  Otherwise missing a lecture is no big deal.

Dr. Woodward is RIDICULOUS. Perfect professor in every way. She's such a great professor it isn't even fair. If it wasn't for her great instruction, I would have failed. She is awesome at explaining things and has a good sense of humor. Excellent class!
Cool teacher, helps a lot. Highly recommend her, best bio teacher ever!

Good teacher but her lectures are not compatible with the tests. Have to really study outside of class to get a good grade. The TAs in lab make it difficult to get an A in the class. Get the best grades you can on the tests and attend lectures because she tells you what to study for the exams.
Great professor.  Has vast knowledge of subject.  Explains material very clearly.  Gives many hints as to what will be on the exams.

Woodward is the best Bio 110 teacher out there. She really wants her students to get a grasp of the work. Going to the review sessions REALLY helped. She doesn't get mad no matter how dumb your questions are. . I got a high A and never cracked open the textbook. If you need to take Bio110 make sure you try to get Woodward. Take notes on tutorials.

Great class and great professor.  Dr. Woodward is a very nice lady who cares about her students.  She is very helpful and explains concepts well.  Study a lot.. that is what I did and I managed to get an A in the class.

Basically, there's a lot of information to know so do the tutorials and attend lectures for clarification. I wouldn't say she's amazing or anything but she gets the job done. If you do your work and study hard, you should be fine. DONT FALL BEHIND. its a killer catching up.

reviews.comment: Teaches at a fairly slow pace, which makes it easy to understand. Grade is based mainly on homework then quizzes, attendance, midterms, and a final project/assignment. He is not a good professor simply put. He claims to be a tough grader but grading is always lenient. The first half of the semester is basically useless and then he speeds through the important material in the second half. He also ran out of time at the end of class and assigned a midterm over finals weekend. Easy grader but bad teacher.

Do not under any circumstances take him if you have accommodations. When I told him that I'd risk dying if I came to take an exam with a broken insulin pump, he said "If it isn't forced by Penn State, I won't accommodate it". PSU cannot force a teacher to reschedule an exam for accommodations, only encourage them to be flexible.

Professor Yang is overall great. He makes sure that he only includes material that comes in exams and hws. Most of the exams and quizzes were taken online as well. He may be dry sometimes and expects you to already know everything but you'll get used to him. There are many opportunities to do well in this class. Would recommend.

The best professor I've had thus far. He is super kind and willing to work with students. Quizzes can be difficult but exams are always similar, if not easier than the quizzes in class. Understand your errors from quizzes and you will do fine come the exams. Gives extra credit too for attendance and other easy tasks. Homework is reasonable too.

Best Prof Ever. Dr Yang really cares about his students and doesn't teach you anything you don't need to know. Told you exactly how to prepare for exams and what is going to be on them. If you have a chance to take a class with Dr. Yang, Dont miss it.

This is a professor that doesn't teach you things you do not need to know. He's worked in the real world and only teaches what needs to be known. Quizzes and exams are VERY easy. The only reason you should get a bad grade in this class is if you get a bad TA which I had. Lectures are funny and he loves making group decisions as a class.

The professor often seemed unprepared and nervous during lectures. Examples were not very helpful, and he frequently made mistakes even when using his notes, which made the material confusing. Explanations lacked clarity, with a lot of backtracking. Overall, I learned more from the textbook than from lectures. Do not take this professor if possible

Nice guy, but scattered, talks fast, and hard to follow. I would get something out of a lecture about every other week. Assigned problem sets were often behind what he was teaching so it was hard to practice what you learned that day. Not a hard set up for the class, (3 quizzes, 2 exams) so if you read the textbook you should be fine

Professor Wang is a nice person but cannot teach. He just writes a bunch of formulas and proofs straight out of the textbook on the board and he rarely works out example problems. Most of the time he's facing the chalkboard without taking time to read the body language of the class, making it extremely difficult to keep up or ask questions.

This class wasn't hard. The professor gave quizzes after every exam for a chance to increase your score. You had a max of 20 point to be added to your test score (and it was added to the 40/60 grade rather than the calculated grade so it ends up being more). I particularly didn't learn that much in lecture, but easy class. Professor cares about you

easy class, group project was really tiny, attendance isnt mandatory, cant comment on the professor because I attended twice but I was sick for a presentation and he offered to let me present in another section, so I'd say hes pretty understanding, just do the assignments and you'll be fine
super chill guy, easy class, little to no homework
Will record class on zoom every class in case someone is absent. All assignments are super easy and the same difficulty level as the exams.
One of the best prof I've had till now! He is very chill and considerate if you have any problems, would absolutely take him again if i ever get to!

Prof. Xiang has set up a good course for learning RDBMs, and lectures are definitely not mandatory. The slides he posts are great, and you are graded on your midterms, HWs, and group projects. He does things by the book and you should make sure to actually read the syllabus. That being said, it was an easy course that teaches you the material well

Amazing professor, one of my favorites this semester. Lectures are very clear, explains concepts well, and is always open to questions. He also gives us a ton of practice in class to get used to the material. Homeworks and exams are similar to in-class material, so be sure to do the practices on the slides and you're good.
Great professor! One of the nicest professors I've ever had at Penn State. Lectures are not mandatory, and recordings are available for each class.

Great professor! Take him for DS 220. Lectures are optional and he reads off of his slides. The material is not too difficult to learn if you put 1-2 hours into it each week. The tests are straightforward and he lets you bring a double-sided cheat sheet to each exam. The assignments took me maybe 1 hour a week max. I still learned a lot too!
Attendnce is not mandatory and he provide recording for each class and you can join the class through zoom. He's really good and its not hard to do well in this class.
DS220 is a pretty useful course. The professor makes the material very simple and assigns beneficial homework. The exams are straightforward.
He is great. Take his class and you will never regret it. If he teaches higher level courses, I would love to take them. Best professor I had.

Very nice professor. Take DS 220 with him and you wont regret it. Even though there is a required textbook, it is absolutely unnecessary if you pay attention in class. HWs are fair, dont take long, and are not very frequent. Exams are fair and pretty predictable. Professor is always willing to help if you need it.

The course is well-organized and he goes through each topic very thoroughly. He simplifies all the confusing parts and explains them to his student very clearly. The exams are just like homework. If you listen to the lecture and take good notes, it should be an easy A.
If you go to class and pay attention you will be fine . It's not hard to do well.
Database Organization. Great teacher. Extremely smart man, well respected.

30% biweekly/weekly hw, 30% midterm, 30% final. Great lecturer, though lecture heavy, Dr. Li provides a great learning experience by providing many examples during lectures. Very concise. Class does get harder as the semester progresses. Attendance and participation is very important, as it is easy to fall behind in his class. Great professor.

I enjoyed this class and never felt stressed over it. Weekly homework, midterm and final are what makes up the grading... but exams were similar to practice ones he gives out. Why does the homework seem to correlate less and less with the lesson as the semester progresses. Frustrating because it seemed to be fine in the beginning of the semester but now I can't find similar examples from the textbook either

Xiantao was a pretty chill professor, we had hw every week which was not hard if you paid attention in class and worth 30% of our grade, besides that only one midterm (30%) and one final exam (40%) which were very similar to the practice exams. Very nice professor

Don't let the name fool you, his english is flawless. Great prof too, he's a bit boring with the monotone but I learned a lot out of his class and his quizzes were consistent with the homework. No tricks, he just does his best to teach you the material.

He shows the new material in a way that is easy to learn, moving from easy problems to more hard problems.  Won't try and stump you with them, but will help the class move along.

He makes his own test for the honors section and they are very reasonable. From talking to my friends in the normal section, I felt like the honors was easier. His quizzes are cake if you did the hw. He needs more examples in class but makes up for it with his reviews before exams. Pretty clear voice but write lightly on chalkboard.

He's a great math professor who makes tough concepts clear, and is completely there for his students. He learned my name quickly and was relatively engaging. If you take his class, GO TO THE IN-CLASS REVIEW SESSIONS. They pulled together everything we needed to know, and were crystal clear. Big recommendation!
I switched into this class from another because the other teacher was bad.  This class was inconvenient for my schedule, but definitely worth it for the better teacher.
Very kind and funny professor. She goes deeper than just the language; she loves to discuss culture and politics. As long as you communicate with her, she will be understanding.

Get ready for homework regardless of any Russian class you're taking! It's learning a language-- there's going to be lots of time put into it. She is such a kind and funny sarcastic woman who is fun to learn from. She teaches not only the language but the culture surrounding it which helps with immersion. She can be strict but because she cares!
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She truly cares for her students, both in class and on a personal level. She is kind, and a great professor. While I was in her class, I was going through a tough time, she went out of her way to research any outlet she could to help me. I was failing her class, but she ended up passing me.

My Rus100 class was online and asynchronous. It was a lot of reading. She focuses a lot on Russian art. The chapters were at a good pace until we reached the Soviet Union. I think she focused to much on art and should focus more on historical events. If I knew she would focus this much on art I would not have taken the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She is so funny and extremely knowledgeable. One of the best professors Ive ever had. There is a lot of homework, but you will be better for it and her comments on them are helpful

The course consists of a lot of reading. She is also a thought grader. Would not recommend it unless you are very interested in Russia. She created this course and had some questions in a quiz incorrect. I pointed this out and she was fairly defensive. My father was in the hospital during this course and she refused any accommodations.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I took Yelena for Russian 1, 2, and 3. They were the hardest classes I've ever taken, but if you do all the homework and make test corrections, getting a decent grade is pretty easy. You can get 10% extra credit on each exam and 10% back on test corrections. You will fail if you don't read the textbook and do the work though.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Love her! She really cares about her student she and wants them to actually learn Russian. Her jokes are awesome and usually self-deprecating, and if you are making any kind of effort to do well, she will bend over backward to help you reach your goals. Highly recommend.

A lot of people seem to be bashing Yelena but she is great! Her Russian class requires a bit of a learning curve, but it gets much easier as long as you try your best and ask for help. Yelena wants you to do well. She also has a hilarious, old school sense of humor. People need to learn to not be so sensitive, her roasts are always in good taste.

In Russian 100 there are lecture quizzes each week and they ask extremely difficult and specific questions considering how much material is covered in each lecture. Zotova is accessible for the most part and responds quickly and there are opportunities for extra credit. She won't tell you the correct answers unless you ask about a specific one.

This history class might as well be taught in another language. The language used is so dry and boring that I honestly didn't learn anything in 4 months. As others have said she is rude to her students and if anyone gives her criticism she blames the class. This "professor" doesn't teach, period.

Incredibly rude "professor". This is an online class, and she would send unprofessional emails constantly, berating the whole class. Online she is nasty and gets that internet courage. Due dates are unclear, and 4/5 of the class missed a discussion deadline. She was forced to reopen the assignment, but those who did it on time got graded poorly.

DO NOT TAKE. Very UNPROFESSIONAL. Very rude to her students. Don't be surprised if she rolls her eyes and sighs at you if you can't answer a question. She laughs at her students in a way that makes the students feel inferior to her. She also writes rude comments on submitted work. Overall very bad quality teacher. Makes fun of students who struggle
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Don't take this class as an easy language course just because you know some Russian from your parents. Put in the work, and you will be rewarded. Zotova is a great teacher - funny and intelligent, and she cares about each student growing and learning something new.

Dr. Zheng is nice,but lectures are very frustrating.He spends a lot of time talking about irrelevant topics like AI instead of teaching the material.There are no notes or uploads, just copying from the board.What he teaches often doesn't match HW or exams.I had to learn from videos before class and still left confused.Take it with Darla if you can.
He is actually one of the best professors I had, especially in any math courses I had to take.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Yuxi is the sweetest professor ever!! although the material wasn't the easiest, he always tried his best to make sure we understood it. Class was not mandatory, and lectures were sometimes boring. There are 2 homework assignments and 1 quiz due each week. Nothing crazy. The exams are pretty hard so just study a week before. BEST PROFESSOR!!!

he's a good professor, but often times he gets off topic when he is teaching. this doesnt really help this class, since its quite difficult. he is very knowledgeable and wants the best for his students, but it can get distracting when he talks about politics and current events all the time

Yuxi Zheng is what I can only describe as a very old school professor. No slides, no lecture notes, just the plain ol' blackboard and some chalk which isn't necessarily a bad thing but it is one of the areas he lacks because his descriptions can be vague. Attendance isn't taken but it sure is mandatory if you wanna stay caught up in his class.

Im normally good at math and I can pick it up pretty easily but not in this class. He rants about almost everything except math. He talks about religion and politics. Its an easy class if you are on top of your work. You definitely have to teach yourself and office hours dont help.

This class was awful. From someone who is pretty good at math and works hard, it was a terrible experience. I failed the class and have to retake it with a different teacher. His lectures are confusing, do not cover everything you need to know, and he rambles about unrelated topics constantly. I have never been so confused in a math class.

The beginning of this class was rough, because it is a whole new way of thinking and the prof has to get through so much material quickly. Just now we got to resonance and eigenvalues, and suddenly the class is a lot more fun. Dr Zheng really cares about your understanding, but you may have to seek him outside of class because lectures are dense.

Lectures only covered bare bones for HW and tests, Lion Tutors is a must for this class. Literally had no idea what to even study or how to answer the HW questions 90% of the time. We only learned about 20% of applicable material during lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Zheng is a very responsible professor. He teaches well and answers questions clearly. He would also extend your knowledge beyond what's required for the exams. 5 non-cumulative exams accouts for 80% of the grade. Easy if you did the sample ones. Very short weekly quizzes accouts for 12% and homework for 8%. Not hard but need to spend time.
Easy grader and really helps you understand the material
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Good teacher but explains some things differently than I learned in the past. If you attend lectures and take time on the homework, you will do well.
Great teacher and passionate about the material. Very accesible outside of class. Is tough grader on some parts of homework.

The instructor really cares about the students and tries to help them as much as he can. He is also passionate about the content and seems to understand it really well. Some say his explanations are confusing, I would say they are a little advanced. If you have a solid background in math you will understand his steps.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Writing this review so I don't fall asleep in his class. Do not take this class, makes the class as boring as physically possible. All he does is go through his hand written notes, 95 percent exams.

The content of this course is super interesting, and Dr. Yetter delivers it in a great manner. The lectures are easy to follow, and although the homework may take some time, they totally prepare you for the exams which make up 75% of the final grade. This isn't easy stuff, but he grades generously and makes learning fun. Great professor.

Waited until the second half of the semester to cram all the assignments in. The Canvas page is extremely disorganized, and most assignments had problems that were neither covered in class nor found in the textbook. Currently writing this during the last week of classes and half the assignments remain ungraded. The class overall is unengaging.

He is just the nicest old man. Very humble, does things differently. I had him for a rocket propulsion class and he teaches us about the concepts and how the machines are built THEN math comes later after their is a clear understanding of what is physically going on. In 4 years of college, he is hands down the best professor I've ever had.
Very helpful, I highly recommend. He cares for his students a lot and wants them to succeed in his class. His lectures are a bit dry but his notes online help out a lot. Very easy grader for exams.
Great professor, I would gladly take again.

Homework was hard.  Projects were hard.  No exams.  But everything was hard but very do-able if you went to class and took great notes.  His lectures are boring and he talks way to fast but damn does he know his stuff.  He grading is very fair.  I'd take him again for Combustion Engines.

Kind of Lazy.  Extremely boring in class.  Hw is hard.  Exams vary relatively to how the class is doing,  is class is doing well then the exam is hard as hell with unexpected tricks, if class is doing bad the exam is straight forward.  Pretty sure the class was curved at the end.  Do the supplemental problems before the exam, that helps a lot.
BEST PROFFFF!!!!!!!
Worst math class I've ever taken. Dosn't care at all, dosn't post any resources. Final was insane and designed to trick students.

She does not educate the class. Lectures were purely formulas with no context. Tests and homework unrelated to the material. When asking for help she says "You should already know this, it's so easy!" Says the textbook is optional but you need it to pass and gets her entire lecture from it. Avoid at ALL costs.

Final exam was 35% of our grade and contained topics not discussed in class. If you ask her for help she will just say “this is simple you should know this”, doesn't grade anything and writes on a chalkboard. No resources AT ALL.

The only resources we have for the two tests that we take are the practice exams, which are multiple choice, and she does not post work for them. I emailed her and asked her if she could post work for them and she replied "I do not have time for that." How can you not post work for our only resource in a STAT CLASS. The book is useless.

Gennerally terrible and bad at her job. Literally draws on a chalk board all of class about theory. No resources on canvas. Puts all grades in out of 0 so preventing you from being able to see averages. Going into the final exam half of the homeworks arn't graded and she won't post the attendance grade. Literally avoid at all costs. Waist of money
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The exam was all multiple choice, which reduced the pressure to a certain extent, but it was still a very difficult course after all.

The only professor in my 4 years of school that does not have any resources. Doesn't post notes, doesn't have any slides, doesn't record lectures. Just rambles on and on about theory all 90 minutes of class, and then when you go to complete the homework it's nothing like what you do in class. 10x harder than every other 415 class.

Not good. Provides no resources on canvas and just rushes through lectures. She exclusively draws on whiteboards. Basically if you don't write everything word for word from the chalkboard you won't have any way to look back at anything. Avoid this professor.
Awful teacher. Did not understand anything, gave very little examples. Doesn't use R to help calculations where other teachers do. No partial credit on exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is an awful teacher. She teaches like she is in a rush and does not care whether or not you understand the materials. If you ask questions, she makes you feel like you are stupid. She says everything is easy and the lecture is her turned-around writing on the chalkboard for the entire 75 minutes. If you want to learn, do not take her.

Definitely my favorite statistics course at Penn State so far. It is challenging for me, but manageable. You will need to spend plenty of time after class to comprehend the lecture notes in order to secure a satisfying score in exams.
She is very knowledgable and approachable if you really put efforts!

She is a wonderful professor in teaching. Some people don't like her, but she is very approachable and willing to help if you drop by. She is very knowledgable as you can see she has very good publications.

One of the worst professors Ive ever had (and Im a grad student). She is out of touch with reality. She describes assignments as easy ahead of time, but they are very difficult. She teaches straight from the book. She is accessible, but isnt helpful. Do yourself a favor and stay away if you can.

Obviously, she doesn't care whether you understand her lectures. She intentionally make impossible exams to identify top students. She doesn't care about students and their grade at all. Yuanyuan Ma loves mocking her students' IQ. Never take her classes!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: The critiques below are way too harsh. Professor Ma has her humor on the class, and though her exams are hard she provides nice curves so that you could survive. The class itself is really difficult, be aware to work a lot on it, not only before the exam but all the time.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: By far the worst professor/teacher I have ever had... Homework and exams are very tough and she is very unwilling to help with lack of office hour. Does not know how to teach. Her "recitation days" are utterly useless. DO NOT TAKE HER BY ALL MEANS. Unless you're a 4.0 student you will definitely have the worst time in this class.  Bad english
worst stat teacher in psu. lecture was so boring. test was so hard. No review sessions or review materials. don't take her

Dr. Xu was good at posting info and extraneous material outside of class on canvas - so of all classes to self teach yourself- this is the one. As a lecturer and in person class though, this class was bad. The lectures were uninformative and impossible to follow.
I late dropped this course since it was on days that I had 4 other classes.

He missed over half of the time before the first midterm. He repeatedly told us that chat GPT would be better at his job than he is, and he is right. We got 0 exam prep materials/guidance and were basically on our own to teach ourselves the entire course. Take any other professor for this class.
There was no material given to review for the exams. Lectures felt pointless as they didn't cover all of the material, had to learn stuff from other sources. He is very nice though.

When I took this class, the course coordinator posted lecture videos online which were very helpful since they explained the content of the course. Professor Xu's lectures complimented these lecture videos by providing examples that were similar to those on the exams. But without the coordinator videos, I feel that I may have struggled.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He is a really good professor, I literally struggled with Math 220 at first and had to drop the course, then later took his course and got an easy A+. There are quizzes which are based on class lectures and easy. Exams are from textbooks and previous year papers. Not much to do actually.

The course does not a good grading structure, he only gives quizzes for credit and not homework so it is hard to score. He is a fine teacher but the course structure makes it hard to do well as all questions in the exams are multiple choice.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Ping seems like a very kind and caring person, but it's very difficult to understand him through his accent. After the first couple of weeks it became easier, but those were the most important topics. The graders of the tests (not Ping) were terrible. They could not grade any quizzes consistently or accurately, so the quizzes became much harder.

He constantly stops to ask the class if they have any questions. He tries to make sure everybody understands and loves answering questions. Don't be afraid to ask if you are struggling on something, he will gladly explain

Ping is a very friendly guy, which makes for a comfortable learning environment. His lectures are not thrilling, but he has been teaching this class for a long time, so he will tell you what you need to know. Be warned, there is no homework, but weekly quizzes instead. They are based on last weeks' class examples. Straightforward, simple class.

As long as you stay on top of concepts in the beginning, this class isn't bad. Ping teaches exactly what you need to know. I guess you could say his lectures are confusing sometimes since he assumes you remember how to apply previous concepts to new material. All in all, easiest Penn State math course I've ever taken hands down.

You can tell Ping genuinely cares about his students; he really wants everyone to learn. Unfortunately, Ping isn't a great teacher. He doesn't place emphasis on concepts that should be emphasized; his explanations of difficult concepts are never quite up to snuff. It doesn't help that he gives weekly quizzes as opposed to homework. Avoid if you can
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: This class is highly dependent on how you are in math. I'm naturally good at it so it's an easy A for me. Ping explains things clearly and I have no trouble understanding him. Do plenty of exercises will help.

He's a good guy and he cares about his students, but he's not a great teacher. If you didn't take high school calc you will struggle, but if you did its a breeze. Sample tests are almost identically to actually tests so study those hard.

Not super easy but manageable. Due the HW and study for the exams and you'll be good. Never took Calc or Pre Calc and managed an A. Ping is a funny guy, but he is often clueless as to what is going on in the classroom and it makes class much more fun.

Class is helpful to learn the material. It is best to do the self assessments and home work for additional practice The guided study groups are also helpful. If you do the work an "A" is definitely possible.

Going to Dr. Ping's lectures made me significantly worse at calculus. I immediately started to do better when I stopped going to class and started just teaching myself out of the textbook. Take this with any other teacher, but honestly the textbook's all you need  along with the angel resources they give you

Ping is a decent teacher. He is tough to understand at first but you get used to his accent and teaching style. Sit in front if u want to do well and understand the material. Ping also moves very quickly and is hard to copy down notes because it is so fast paced TA is important as well, do not choose Brian Burns as your TA.

Ping is awesome but he's terrible at teaching. His accent isn't that bad, but this class is a struggle. Ping isn't great at explaining concepts, and If you do poorly on one exam you're basically screwed. Also, it's course policy not to give extra credit, and only tests/quizzes count. Don't take this class if you don't know calc. Take Jin Nu for TA.

Ping isn't awful and I personally didn't struggle to understand him even though he had a thick accent. However, if you have a question, ask your TA or go to Hager's office hours, because he can't understand his students and gets very frazzled.Practice quizzes are super helpful for exams, but make sure you fully understand all concepts.
He's a lot of fun and very entertaining!

He is by far the worst professor I have ever had! The class itself was not that hard but I ended up having to go to another teachers class to understand the material. Xu can not speak very clear english, and always seems to be confused. His lessons don't prepare you very well for the tests. If you can avoid taking a class with him DO.

He is the man. His accent will set in after a week. I did not take calc before this class, but i still managed to get a good grade in the class. I stopped going after a while because the recitation will take care of the lectures. Go to the guided study groups before the tests.
Ping's a nice guy, but has a very, VERY strong accent (and teaches straight out of a powerpoint), so lectures are useless.  If you took calc in high school, you'll do fine.  If you didn't, good luck.
Great and funny guy, but hard to understand. If you have taken calculus in high school, you will do great with almost no effort.
Ping is so cute and funny, but his clarity is not good at all.  Would be a great teacher if you could understand him, do practice problems!
Quizes are harder than the tests. If you go to class and take good notes you can get an A
He's a good teacher!

Extremely hard to understand at first but once you are in his class for a few times, you learn to understand his accent. Just copy everything down on the board and study at a later time. Pretty easy class.

Amazing teacher. Had him for calculus, and he explained everything clearly. I agree that he "dumbs down" the textbook for you, which I prefer cause its easier to get an A and understand all the theories. I dont think I could've scored as high with a different professor.
He is impossible to understand. Attend a different lecturer. The TA is confusing too. You're best bet is to find a tutor. Try Lion Tutors because their reviews are brief and extremely helpful.
Almost impossible to understand, but if you follow along with the book you'll understand Ping. His tests are not that difficult and the optional homework is very helpful.
pretty methodical teacher. He sticks to the textbook and pretty much covers one section a class. Its a big class so you dont have to go, i only go 2 out of 3 days a week got a B+.
Ping may know how to show a lady a good time but he fails at teaching the class anything.  2 + 3 = 10
Ping is the man!!

I had him for MATH 250 (diff EQ), and I loved him. The material is very hard to grasp, but given the nightmare stories I heard about the other teachers I'd say he's your best bet. He always made the class laugh and actually used good examples in class to help students understand the material. Funny guy, good attitude, nd so far my fave math class a

best calc teacher given the alternatives.  the class itself is hard but he does a fairly good job explaining the material and is very eager to help.  a little hard to understand sometimes but overall not a bad teacher

Ping Xu only has a bad rating because the class itself is difficult. He is an excellent professor. He keeps the class interesting through his humor and his blunders with the equipment in the lecture hall. The content of the class can be difficult so go to class and do the practice exams. Ping is an excellent professor, but you may have a lousy TA.

Ping is a gentle man, but seems to bamboozle himself during class which leads to hilarious blunders.  The examples are dry and generic.  Go to the math center if you want to pass.  Start the first day you have trouble if you want a chance and take the practice exams with you.  Personally - nice guy, but not very good at coming down to your level.
THE MAN...enough said

Ping is hilarious, went to every lecture just to watch his funny antics and all those problem examples. Alright teacher but overall great guy.  Check out the pictures of him and his family on his course page!

Ping really isn't that bad. I have never taken calculus in high school and I did well on the first exam. Just go to his class and take notes then go to the TA's office hours. It is REALLY important to go to recitation because ping won't exactly teach you the material in class. He's really funny tho!

If you havn't had calc, this is not your guy.  I had the class in high school so I didn't have to much time in, but friends struggled hard.  Hard to understand, doesn't understand why students cant grasp the concepts.  Go to recitations and study hard.

Okay, so Ping is a smart guy, I'll give him that.  And, if you're good at math, you shouldn't have a problem.  But, if you find some calc. concepts difficult to understand (like me) his heavy accent, pace of his lectures do not help the situation.  Learning from the TA in recitation, and teaching it to myself is what got me through this class.
No Comments
No Comments

What a waste of psu dollars to pay this guy. You wont be able to understand him, and even if you do he's just going to assume your a math wiz like him. Actually gets pretty mad when you dont understand something or ask him certain questions. Stay away and hope their is someone else teaching the class when you want to take it.

Awful, not another word to describe it. Don't even bother going to class. Stay home and try teaching yourself thats the only way you will be able to pass the class. Could care less if the students do well or not or understant the concepts. I found my TA to be much more helpful and a better teacher.

Ping likes to use the examples from the book and he teaches them so damn fast, so going to class is kinda pointless. He  sorta sees the problem in his head and doesnt explain steps. The material is hard but not impossible. Give yourself at least a week to prepare for the exams b/c they cover a lot. Ping is one hell of a crazy asain

Ping is the worst teacher Ive ever had! buy the book, and teach yourself, if you wait for him to teach you, you'll never be taught the material, he was the only 110 teacher when i took him, hopefully for you he wont be! LETS GO STATE

Honestly, yea his accent is strong, but you get used to it. His examples are really helpful and as long as you just look over the sections in the book you wont have a problem in this class. Also, funny in his own weird way

The only reason I passed was because the fire alarm was pulled TWICE during two seperate exams, so the class was curved by almost 3 letter grades.  I would have failed otherwise.  I went to his office hours, and he got flustered when I didn't grasp a very introductory calculus concept.  If you can take it with anybody else, do it.

This guy is absolutely attrocious at teaching, you can barely understand him and the resitations do not even prepare you for the tests that you take in his class.  If you can avoid him for Math 110 do it!

I had this guy and the only reason I got a decent grade was becuase of a 15 percent curve.  Enough said.  His accent is incomprehensible.  I found my grades went up once I started teaching myself out of the book and started skipping class. Didnt take this in High School but easily placed into this class.  Good luck understanding his english!
ping does not speak english and neither do his TA's, the best way to do well in his class is to have taken calc before, possibly in high school

very easy class - just follow the book. you'll have to teach yourself, since this is college and all, but not a hard subject. ping is a very straightforward teacher, tests and homework is fair, not hard to get an A. YES, he has an accent, its cute - i can still hear him saying "invertible" yrs later
Not bad, curves aLOT!!
PING SUCKS. He simply cannot speak English. I found myself not understanding 99% of the lectures. I had a friend teach me everything. Steer clear!

Although Ping has a strong Chinese accent, he knows his math.  I stayed after class many times to talk with him about the lecture and he always stayed with me until the next class would come in.  He WILL get mad at the class if they all talk during class, so stay quiet and ask questions when needed.

DO NOT TAKE PING!  he is the worst teacher i have ever had in the existence of teachers.  did not learn a single thing, the only reason i passed with a D is because i took calc AB last year in high school.  doesn't speak english well, and 95% of the tests will never be discussed in class.  good luck

Ping is a terrible speaker.  Although he seems like he tries, he can't speak our language.  However, study before the test and you'll probably pass (just plug and chug equations).  I have no idea if I learned anything this year but I got an A.  Best bet is to get another 314 teacher.
Terrible.....harsh accent, unwillingness to help, doesn't answer questions if he is annoyed.
Speak Eng

I was an "A" student in Math my entire life, but decided to take AP Stats instead of AP Calc.  Boy did I **** myself over, because Ping is a terrible prof.  He can't teach, can't speak English, and is very unclear.  The TA's don't speak english and can't answer Q's.  This class makes me want to die.
Ping is a good guy and he says guy alot, Hes not so clear though his english is overshadowed by his accent.

prof cant speak english making it very hard to learn calc, especially if u never had it b4. He does ask 'do u understand?' during class but everytime a student asks he says 'what do u mean, i just said that'. he also wore the same ink stained pants to every class 4 about 3 mo. Take burago's class!
Hard to do well when prof can't speak clear english!!! Went from a A student in Math to C/D. Horrible class. Penn State needs american prof!!! Ping is a nice guy, but not prof material!
Ping is the man, plain and simple.
Went to 3 hours of math help a week and still failed his tests. His notes don't make any sense and he can't speak English. If there is any way you can avoid him, stay as far away from you as you can.
No Comments

his pace is a bit too fast, but the students in this course are very very disrespectful towards the teacher. half the class never shows up anyway. everyone leaves 5 mins earlier than usual. This indicates a desire not to atempt learn and complaints of not learning is partly the fault of the student.
Same comments as everyone else. Hard to understand, On the side he doesn't help neither do the TA's. Do yourself a favor don't take this class with this professor.
SUCKS
Ahh.  He's a horrible teacher.  The language barrier does suck, and the TA's are no better.  Going to his office hours doesn't help, because he's never there most of the time.
He Sucks
I agree with the rest, there is a HUGE language barrier with him.  The only thing fun about the class, was watching him lean against the blackboard with his clothes.
he is terrible...and recitation is really hard when ur TA is a spaz

He is very naive and generally has no idea whats going on in class.  His notes are disorganized and the chalkboard is so dusty its almost impossible to see the board. If you havent had calc you probably wont understand anything. He doesnt speak English very well, and his microphone never works. =(
No Comments

do you want a good math grade? dont take this class.  when you can understand what he is saying, which is never, you will not be able to understand what he is doing.  he does not explain his examples, and his ta's suck... no help at all.  go to the bouke building for tutoring if you take his class
What an ass. He doesn't speak good enlish either. Avoid him if you want to see a good grade.
The only people who speak worse english than him are his T.A.'s
No Comments

I am very happy that I took this course under Prof. Yadav. He is very knowledgeable about AI, and he is one of the best lecturers that I have taken a class with at Penn State. Lots of homework and projects, along with quizzes, but it really makes you learn well.
He uses the lecture from UC Berkeley course. What a great professor!
Best Professor in CS Department

The lack of communication from Amulya and the TAs is laughable. We were told about a project we would have towards the end of the semester and have yet to hear any details about it (There is 1 more week of class). The project descriptions are ambiguous and don't line up with what we learn. Notes are boring and copied from other similar courses.
