reviews.comment: By far the worse professor I have ever had. Don't teach anything but expect us to do everything.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Definitely take his leap PLCS 1, he did such a good job of easing his class into college level work, and he always made sure to stop and check in with his students. It was not hard to get 90s on his exams, and his homeworks were a little annoying but doable. Amazing dude, loved his lectures.

Fine teacher, tries to get class engaged and participate, a little odd but nice. Explains things well but a lot is left up to you to learn and understand. A nag about attendance and stingy with excused absences.

Took this because I thought it would have some applications in the real world. It is a glorified history course, the practice tests and participation assignments are absolutely nothing like the quizzes or exams. Its all based on lectures, videos, and readings that you have to view outside of class time. Will tank your GPA. Beware.

Show up to class because I regret not going and it affected my grade. His tests are kind of hard because the questions dive a bit deeper than surface-level information. Lectures are a bit boring but he's a good guy and it's tolerable. I'd take Nye again if I could.

Dr. Nye was an amazing professor to have. The quiz and test questions are very specific but as long as you know the material you will get a good grade in the course. Dr. Nye knew every single one of our names in the class so he really does take time to know his students and it makes the class very enjoyable. Take him if you can!

Never read the textbook and was fine, some questions on the quizzes/exams were v specific to the videos or reading and I think that's unfair but for a 400 level class it was def on the easier side. j go to class, participate, and watch the review videos and u can get an A- or A

some questions on the quizzes/exams were so specific to the in class videos or reading, it was kind of ridiculous but overall they were not too bad. j make sure you go to class and watch the review videos. (also didnt really read any of the reading n was fine). There's no hw which is great but unlike others I find his "humor" insufferable.

Professor Nye has some pretty dry dad humor. The fact that no one gets the joke for about 5 seconds is what makes him hilarious. The actual class itself is simple and easy to understand. Go to class because he takes attendance and has participation assignments. The exams are somewhat difficult. Do the readings and go to the study sessions.

trust me, hes hilarious. raise your hand a few times and dont miss class because theres participation assignments. quiz/test always same format. MC and matching section (always tells you what the matching is on). material is easy-ish. he always has review sessions and practice quiz/test. def need to study a little bit to get an A in the class
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Nye is, in my experience, one of the best political science professors at PSU. His class is funny, engaging, and well-structured. He is upfront about his expectations and grading policies, and as long as you attend the lectures and review sessions, you will be set. If you ever get the chance to take one of his class, I highly recommend it!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: After 4 years Dr. Nye is my favorite professor at Penn State and is head and shoulders above any other Poli-sci professor here. What I appreciate most is his clear and informative lecture style. If you attend class, pay attention, and take decent notes you'll be set. If you're a no-nonsense student who wants to learn and do well, Nye is your guy

Wouldnt recommend all you get graded on is showing up and the exams and quizzes and the questions are purposefully trying to trick you i dropped this class instead of taking a C which would have ruined my gpa nice guy and super kind but i care about my grade and learning more than kindness didnt learn anything and wasted my money
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: His lectures are super clear which makes the tests and quizzes pretty easy. Just do the required readings and pay attention in class and you'll be totally fine.

Dr. Nye is an all-around funny, nice professor. Quizzes and exams are lecture heavy, but he tells you exactly which topics will be included. The reading comes from some court cases and the textbook, which may take a while, and they are mostly included in the tests. Attendance and participation are encouraged and a part of your final grade.

Prof. Nye was a great teacher. His classes are very lecture heavy. Class were a bit boring but tolerable. We only used the textbook for Unit 2.Exams and quizzes were based on notes and readings. Attendance is mandatory. Hosts review sessions for exams and quizzes that were helpful. If you can take Prof. Nye, he cares about his students.

Dr. Nye was my first professor here at PSU and he was amazing. He always tried to keep class interesting. His lectures aren't on the reading so reading is a MUST. There is a lot of it. He really cares about his students and if you just talk to him and ask for help he's always willing to give you a hand. Participation is important in this class also

Nye is one of the best professors out there. I highly recommend him. Before ever class he makes dad jokes. They're a hit or miss. Overall great guy not that many people raise their hands but if you know the answer raise it high and he will call on you. Quizzes and exams are easy, he does participation videos with a small assignment to get points.

Professor Nye is just your average funny guy. His lectures are funny and he makes dumb jokes that make everyone laugh through his lectures. He is very knowledgeable about his lectures. He does review sessions over Zoom for quizzes and tests so you can go over the material. He is very accessible outside of class and very willing to help you out.

Hes such a nice guy and his lectures were fun to listen to but he graded us on basically just quizzes and exams which i think didnt really promote learning just memorization which made it hard to keep up with honestly wish I never took this class its gonna ruin my GPA :/
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Nye is a funny professor and is good at keeping a class engaged. He held study sessions before the exam which helped a lot. Attend class and take notes and you will be fine. Participation is important so make sure you talk and answer questions.

I had two classes with Nye. 473 is much better than 471 with him. He talks about the same stuff all semester, so just get a general grasp and you'll be fine. Don't buy the textbooks. Do the course reserve readings. Attendance is important for the participation assignments he does. Not understanding if you miss a class.

I had Nye for two classes. 471 is a hard class, wish I hadn't taken it. Don't worry about the textbooks, it only accounts for 2-3 questions on every quiz/exam. His humor is dry. Participation matters. Do the course reserve readings. Participation assignments in class can hurt your grade, so don't miss them. Take something else if you can.

AMAZING professor, goes over all of the exams in great detail before and after so that we are best prepared. You have to do the readings to get a good grade, but the lectures are about more than just the readings which makes the class interesting. really really nice guy, especially if you communicate with him.

Structures the syllabus where a lot of the points come from discussion posts and quizzes. You read several lengthy articles to then answer 50 specific questions on the exam, that come from the quizzes but you don't get to see the correct answers after the quiz. I don't think you learn anything truly applicable. Don't take, a waste of time
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Dr. Nye is a great professor and very reliable. You knew exactly what to expect from quizzes and exams and as long as you study you will do well. He expects participation and attendance but really cares about his students.

This is my third class with Dr. Nye and I will be taking him again in the spring! Your grade depends on 3 quizzes, 2 midterms, 1 final, and your participation in class. He hosts reviews for the quizzes and exams as well as making everything very easy to understand. He is very understanding, has a dry (but good) sense of humor, and is my fav prof!

Funny guy, but good luck if you have him. We spent more time looking at pictures of animals he found on campus than actually learning the material. The quizzes and exams usually have nothing to do with the information on his review sheets. He also grades you on how much you talk in class, so if you are a quiet student, this professor is not for you

He's a fine guy. The test and quizzes are easy. But the essays are the problem. One wrong word and he'll give you a 1/5 on your essay. Also, same thing on the homework's. Doesn't matter if you know everything about the subject. If you have a sentence fragment. He'll drop your grade even more.
Terrible grader

Took this class for a humantiites credit and wasnt what I expected. Exams were open note since zoom but everytime there was a handful of questions I couldnt find anywhere in the lecture notes. This was because he gives you lots of reading for each section and pull specific questions from that and the videos from participation assigmentnts.

At first I really did not like Dr. Nye. I thought he was way too dry and boring but honestly as the semester progressed he's become by far my favorite professor. The man is absolutely hilarious and makes learning fun and enjoyable. Not to mention he's extremely knowledgeable on so many poli sci topics. If you're lucky you'll meet his bird grant!

Adam Nye is that guy. Go to class everyday, participation matters at the end of the semester. He makes class so fun and interesting, it never drags on. I have him at 9:05 a.m. I once emailed him saying I failed an exam and I was "straight up not having a good time," and he excused my absence.

Dr. Nye is an awesome dude! He really makes learning enjoyable and is absoloutely hilarious. His classes are interactive and never boring. I was always genuinely excited to see what he had in store for us each class! He's a fair grader and gives his students every oppurtunity to succeed. Not to mention he gives out gifts every once and a while...

Dr. Nye is probably one of the nicest people you will meet. His humor is on par, his grading criteria are easy to follow, and he is very helpful in office hours. He will set agendas for the day, which is also really helpful. I would recommend taking classes with him, you won't regret it. Also, this is a no computer class, so get a notebook.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Nye has a passion for teaching and makes class upbeat and interesting. His quizzes and exams are fair. Be ready to read though.

Probably the nicest and funniest professor I have ever had. The exams and quizzes are not super easy, and there are few assignments that make up your grade. The quizzes were harder than the exams because before every exam he had a review session. If you attend the review session it will be easy to get a B at the very least, if not an A.

Adam is a decent guy. He is, however, the most awkward professor ever. It makes class very weird for a 9am. On top of that, participation is essential to your grade and determines if he will round your grade or not. He also bases lots of test questions on the readings so you HAVE to do them.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Decent guy not a great professor. Very unclear grading, he'll say one thing and then completely go against that. Picks favorites. He also posts assignments super late and then changes due dates, or posts example assignments after the original was due. Super slow grader & will take off whole points for things like no capitalizing a word.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Nye is a great lecturer and makes the sometimes dry content very inspiring and funny. The quizzes and exams are somewhat challenging, but not unfairly so. He also hosts a review session before each quiz and exam. Didn't really use the textbook, his lectures were usually sufficient to do well on the quizzes and exams.

Nye is hilarious. He is a great lecturer, and always tries to engage the class in a conversation and that makes it easier to learn. His exams are fair, as well as his quizzes. If you study, the class won't be too hard. You do have to read a lot, but Nye explains the key points from each reading very well. I hope to take another class with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Don't believe the hype not an easy A!!! Could be an easy course but he makes test a lot harder then they should be. Very picky when it comes to short response questions! If you talk to him during office hours not helpful. Not a bad teacher just not an "easy"course.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Do not recommend. Class is so boring it's hard to pay attention. Really made me hate constitutional law.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: If I were to ever take a PLSC class again I would hope it would be with Dr. Nye. All of his lectures kind of blend together, but they're still very enjoyable. Reading & participation is mandatory. As long as you do what the syllabus asks you'll pass with nothing lower than a B
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Nye truly cares about being a teacher. At first, he may seem to have a dry personality, but by the third week of class, you realize he is really just a funny guy who loves to teach. He will often try to make the class laugh, and wants to help you succeed. Pay attention in class, don't expect to use your laptop to play around.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Nye is just the best, and I have recommended him to my friends. If you show up and pay attention, you'll do fine in his class. He always has test reviews which I found to be extremely helpful, and his sense of humor is hilarious. I thought waking up early for his class would be tough, but he makes class so awesome that it wasn't a problem

Dr. Nye is a great professor and I wish I would have had him for other PLSC courses. He always has reviews before exams/quizzes and if you go to them and class and take good notes you'll be fine. He has a dry sense of humor and is hilarious - the topics were incredibly interesting and he always kept things relevant. He's a great guy!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Tests are tough--Would take again

reviews.comment: I really just love him. I've taken just about every class he teaches even if I don't necessarily need to because he's so funny and the classes are really interesting. They are also challenging but if you put in work As aren't impossible to come by.

Dr. Nye is an amazing lecturer and teacher. He genuinely cares about his students and cares less about the grade than teaching the subject. Not only did he teach me about American Government, but he made me familiar with State College and did a very good job and easing my LEAP class into the Fall semester. I would absolutely take his class again.

Dr. Nye was a fantastic instructor over the summer. His class is very self-explanatory, and he's very upfront with the grading. The difference between passing and getting an A is listening to his lectures. While he may seem a bit dry at times, he loves what he does and wants you to do well! I would certainly take another one of his classes!

Dr. Nye is truly an inspiration.  I've taken just about all of his classes while at PSU, and I regret nothing.  He's super clear about what will be on the test.  All of his classes are run the same 3 quizzes, 3 tests, participation; a few exceptions, nothing major.  The lowest quiz is dropped.  He's also a pinball wizard so be sure to ask about it!
You learn a lot in his class and he is funny. One of my favorite classes. Would strongly recommend.

Funny and helpful professor. He did a review session outside of class before every quiz and exam. (Class is graded by participation, 3 quizzes, 3 exams). Everything is easy, but it's hard to bring your grade up from one bad grade. I messed up on the first exam because I missed the review session, but still managed to finish with a B.
I genuinely look forward to class. He's hilarious and makes everything very interesting, and he's super clear about what will be on the tests/quizzes and how he will grade them.

I've taken Dr. Nye's classes multiple times now, by far my favorite professor at PSU.  Very good sense of humor and clear explanations. As long as you pay attention in class and put in the effort necessary, you'll do totally fine. True inspiration to all PlSc students, especially to those with a concentration on law.

Participation matters! I've never had to rate a professor before but he is BY FAR the WORST professor I've EVER taken! STAY VERY VERY FAR AWAY! After I write this review, I'm dropping this course and I'm never taking another course with him again. To be specific, I'm taking PlSc471 with him. Harder than any law course I've ever taken.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: If you like an awesome professor, Dr. Nye is the best choice.  Actually retaking his classes after summer session due to his passion. Highly recommended.

Dr Nye was a fantastic professor. He is super funny in an awkward way. He sometimes will even bring the class breakfast! He grades kind of toughly but fairly. Loved having him as a professor. He says you must read but i did not and did fine. He likes to incorporate games into his lectures too to make it fun. Awesome professor!!!

Loved his classes Civil Liberties and Constitutional Law. He's really passionate about the material, and he sometimes shows you his poetry he writes about Constitutional Law. Even though its boring material he makes it pretty fun.

Dr. Nye is a great professor and a great guy. He's really humorous, you'll really learn to appreciate the class. But be warned ! His exams are savage bruh. Easily the hardest I had at Penn State. If you don't take notes in class, you'll get roasted becuase he doesn't post lecture slides online. It's not an easy class.

His class can get boring unless he plays one of his "Get to know State College" games those are kinda fun. He seems like a nice guy and is usually in a happy go lucky mood. But don't be fooled by the other posts, the class is NOT easy. He is a really tough grader.   Especially on your essays. Cool guy, but I wish i had dropped his class.

Conflicted. He's funny and I look forward to attending his class because his lectures are interesting. He is also straightforward about his expectations & what will be on the tests/quizzes. However, his essay grading is outrageously nitpicky, and he calls on the same few people all the time and penalizes other students for low participation.

Dr. Nye was a great Professor and I was happy I started out college with a professor like him.  His class wasn't easy but it was very doable if you put in the time and effort.  Don't be afraid to go talk to him he was very helpful with me when I set up and appointment.  I will be looking to take classes he teaches in the future.

While he may be extremely awkward, that is what makes his class so amazing. He incorporates his humor into lectures that are entertaining as well as quite easy to understand. If you go to class, pay attention and take good notes you really should get at least a B+. Loved this class and him.

Adam Nye is a very good teacher. He is incredibly interesting in his lectures and always offers extra help or clarification. While he is a tough grader on homework and essays, he is very fair about his criticism. Overall, an excellent professor that is truly excited about teaching.

Dr. Nye's lectures are anything but boring. Everyday, one can expect a lesson of full of dry humor and self-deprecating jokes. Overall, Nye. provides a friendly learning environment that ignites interest in any topic that he teaches. A great professor and a great contact to have.
Dr. Nye is the best professor I've ever had. Extremely funny and always has fun games and videos in his lecture that keep you entertained. Definitely recommend taking his class!

He made learning fun. The lectures were entertaining yet informative. He makes what will be on the test very clear. Reading the book definitely helps but not totally necessary. He's looking out for you and wants everyone to do well
Dr. Nye is hilarious. His lectures are engaging, and he is really knowledgable. Tests can be tricky, but with prep can work out well for the students.
Nye was a great professor. He kept the lectures interesting. At first you don't know if you should take what he says seriously, but you learn as the semester goes on. Very funny guy.

Wonderful professor with a great sense of humor. Keeps class interesting everyday and presents material clearly. No essays! Strict memorization for the quizzes and tests. Make sure to throughly answer the essay questions; it feels like he is doing key word grading. The readings are helpful but not essential. Would take a class with him again.

Best Professor I've had so far at Penn State.  He is very clear on the material and will help you with whatever you need. Hilarious in an awkward sort of way. Definitely knows his stuff. His classes aren't easy A's, but it's possible. I'm taking him again next semester.

Dr. Nye makes class interesting everyday! He jokes around a good amount and incorporates his humor into slides at times. As long as you participate in class and go to exam reviews you should have no trouble. I would undoubtedly take another one of his classes.
Nobody could teach a class with this type of material better. Take him even if you aren't a Political Science major. He is funny, helpful, and other synonyms for everything great a teacher can be.

He's 1 of my favorite professors I've had at PSU. He's hilarious and makes material very interesting. Almost everything on the quizzes and exams come from his in-class lectures. Out of class readings are helpful but only 1-3 questions from them are on the exams. His class is very easy as long as you show up and pay attention. Easy A or A-

Nye was a great teacher for this course this difficult. The material is dense and dry, but he made studying Supreme Court cases interesting. Attendance and participation are mandatory, but you couldn't skip class for this course and do well even if you wanted to.  He knows his stuff so take good notes and participate and you'll at least get a B+
Great guy, super helpful and understanding. Just do your work and take some time to talk to the guy; he will appreciate it and remember you.
He is a great professor.

Excellent professor with that sort of dry, witty sense of humor you can't help but love. If something isn't understood, he has no problem going back and going more in depth into a subject. Extremely helpful and very approachable. Subject isn't always interesting, but he finds ways to make it so. Absolutely loved his course. Fantastic professor.
Great guy with a funny sense of humor. Great way to start my time at PSU.

I love Nye; he's one of my favorite professors in the poli sci department.  He stimulated my interest in constitutional law and tried to make a sometimes boring subject interesting.  I'm taking him for 474 now.  I'd highly recommend him; he's very easy to understand. Attendance and the textbook are mandatory.

Professor Nye is great!  However, the material is dry and difficult, and this course is not easy.  You can get an A, but it requires a lot of work.  There are 3 exams, 3 quizes (lowest one dropped), attendance and participation.  You have to be a discussion leader for one day out of the semester too.  Good class and professor, but difficult stuff.

Dr. Nye was pretty much the bomb. He's freaking hilarious, his lectures are interesting and easy to understand, and he shows a lot of films which help class not be boring. I never dreaded going to class and instead looked forward to it. Did I mention he's hilarious?? Take his class, you won't regret it.

Great professor and great class!  You learn a lot about law, and most questions on the exams are covered in lecture; you still have to read the book though!  Attendance is mandatory, and there are homeworks and a project, but it's all great!  I definitely recommend this course and this professor!

The instructor's course is difficult, even when considering that it is a 400-level course. Unless you reserve a great interest in the course content, you are advised NOT to take any of Nye's courses. If you take his course, you will find yourself working like a slave to get a mere B by the end of the course.

Constitutional Law is a very dry class; no matter how great a teacher Nye is (and he is), that's not changing. It's challenging and tricky and the exams aren't easy, but he does a very good job clarifying difficult concepts, and keeping class pretty light. Even encouraged discussion when we had the time. Good class to take if you're pre-law.

He's one of the most hilarious professors I've had this semester. He's really dedicated, and you can tell he loves what he does. He is way too funny for words, but you have to work for you're grade. Also, a great grade booster is class participation. Speak up, and it'll help.
Great teacher!  Nye is really friendly and funny and has really clear and structured powerpoints.   Just go to class, jot down the powerpoints and some additonal notes, and you'll be fine.

Take him. Arguably the best teacher in the PL SC department. He actually cares about the material and enjoys teaching it. Go to class and you'll be fine; he doesn't put his notes online. I learned a lot in this class. Also, he's hilarious. His PowerPoints are great. My boyfriend and I joke that in 10 years we'll see him on a Comedy Central Special.
This class is an awesome 400 level.  Nye is a great teacher that really knows what he's talking about.  There are 3 quizzes with 1 dropped and 3 exams.  Good 400

Goes out of his way to make sure students understand everything. Getting good grades is a matter of paying attention and reading the book. He does not hand out good grades but is great in helping you prepare.

Great Teacher! Goes out of his way to make sure students understand everything. Getting good grades is a matter of paying attention and reading the book. He does not hand out good grades but is great in helping you prepare. GREAT TEACHER!!!

Great guy! Really cares about the material, uses the books a lot so make sure you do the readings and listen to lectures. Reviews things before exams well. Overall, a nice guy whose has a very very fun dry sense of humor and cares about his students.

Pretty easy. I recommend going to class because he reviews everything that's important/more likely to be on exams every day. If you do this, you don't really need to read too much. In class assignments usually just go along with videos.

He's a good teacher, most of his test questions come from class lecture so it's good to go. Some questions come from the book, but he'll usually discuss readings in class. His tests are fair and as long as you go to class and read you'll get an A.
Nice guy. Relatively helpful. He claims he tests a lot from the book, but there's usually no more than a few questions directly from the text.
No Comments
Teaches an English literature class but literally can't speak English. Very hard to listen to him yap incomprehensible words for 3 hours. Needs to be replaced immediately.

Unclear instructions and rambles during class way too much, can't get to the point of anything. Very repetitive information. Contradicts himself all the time. If you have a choice you need to pick literally anybody else
If you're looking to learn nothing, hear about soccer, his son, and his "incredible resume" and not understand many words in an ENGLISH LITERATURE CLASS, then this professor is for you!

The class was ok but the instructor does not have clear instructions about what they expect in class. It makes the assignments very confusing. We were assigned many readings but half of them were not discussed in class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Enthusiastic & always willing to help and answer questions, but gives VERY unclear instructions, feedback, & answers. Frequent extremely last-minute canvas announcements. Talks almost precisely three times as long as necessary & rambles. I think I contracted an evil curse and felt it further intensify in my bloodstream during every 3-hour lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: It's a joy to take a class with Dr. Yee. No one lectures with a smile quite like her. No one can get me excited about integers or keep me engaged through a proof like Dr. Yee. She makes examples really clear and grades very forgiving. Homework and Practice exams make the exams easy every time. My favorite professor at the school.

Professor Yee is so kind and an amazing professor! She truly cares about her students and wants them to succeed. Her accent takes a couple days to pick up on, but it's not bad at all. The class itself is pretty easy, and the exams are just like the reviews. I highly recommend Professor Yee to anyone.

(Had for 536 but it wasn't an option)
Amazing lecturer.

Dr. Yee made linear algebra pretty fun. She often seems unprepared for lectures but she makes sure that everyone understands and truly seems to care about her students. She is a very forgiving grader and if you don't know how to do a determinant from any starting position, you'll know, or at least the sign.

Dr. Yee made linear algebra a very easy class. While she would often get lost during lectures and confuse herself, by the end of the lecture you'd usually end up understanding what she was trying to say. When she wasn't totally lost, she explained things very well. Homework is short and exams look just like the homework.

She is really caring professor. She replies to the email really fast and tries her best to help us. Her exam and class are not easy but if you put a reasonable amount of effort, it's a really good class.

MATH 435 is a terrible class overall, but Professor Yee at least made it manageable. She is very sweet and kind and cares about the success of her students. She gives reasonable amounts of homework and provides additional practice including an exam review before the two midterms and final. I highly recommend Dr. Yee!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: She goes slow which is really helpful because it gives times to absorb the info. Personally, I need time to process stuff. She is super helpful in her office hrs. Her quizzes were similar to the HW assigned. I loved her and the class. Her accent might cause an issue for a week or so but later you get used to it. Her notes are also helpful.

She is really nice but sometimes get lost on what she is talking about. She doesn't go too fast so you are able to process the information and ask questions. Her practice exam is almost identical to the exam so make sure you really study the practice exam. Tests are written response. She's gives a quiz twice a month. Homework not graded.

She's really great. The class isn't easy but she always tries to make sure everyone understands everything. She's also really good at correcting students and explaining why their ideas might be wrong.

This class is complicated but we had homework and quizzes biweekly. Homework is hard but office hours help a lot. Exams aren't terrible if you can handle homework, class examples, etc. She is kind and sophisticated. You will learn!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: She is really nice and helpful. The class is hard, but she makes it easier!

Ae Ja Yee does the best she can teaching a very complicated topic. We had a few problems due every Friday based on lectures the week before. Homework is hard, but if you go to office hours she will help you immensely. Exams are not too bad. If you do the practice exam and understand that, then you should have no problems. She also curves heavily.
Lecture is really helpful, also the sample example she provided. Lecture is clear and the course is easy.

I thought this class was hard but she proved me wrong. Gives 5 questions on hw almost every week, which was just based on examples in class. Just go to office hour if totally clueless bout the hw. Easy exams and she curves a lot.
She usually give five problems in each homework, very patient and nice, and she usually have easy exams. Highly recommended.
Difficult to understand what she was going over but her notes were alot more helpful than the textbook. Tests are pretty tough but she curves the grade a good bit which is great
She's very helpful with homework and projects.  It's like she did it for you, also she's a well-resepected mathematician in combinatorics field.  Take her class if you can!

Very nice lady but not the best teacher.  Rushes through some important stuff.  Homeworks and the writing project were easy though and she is extremely helpful during office hours. Tests are hard and difficult to prepare for.  You could probably find a better teacher but don't be nervous if you end up with her.

Prof. Yee was not the greatest math prof I've had at PSU, but she wasn't the worst either. She was difficult to understand, but was a very nice person who was willing to help. Lectures were okay, but don't skip out on her test reviews. They were extremely helpful and gave a great outline of what the tests were on. I wouldn't discourage taking Yee.
Prof. Yee is the nicest professor ever. Her homeworks and exams are extremely hard but if you go to her office hours she basically does the homework for you. She also curves insanely!

Dr. Yee gives clear directions for homework, and outlines what will appear on the exam.  Her exams are predictable, so you know what and how to study.  She is interested in her students and will take time to help them understand when they have questions.  Fair and consistent with grades.  I strongly recommend her as a prof for MATH 465.

I'll give Ae Yee the benefit of the doubt.  She isn't too bad of a teacher.  Like everyone said, she is hard to understand, but that's how a lot of professors are in college.  As long as you do the homework you will be fine.  The concepts are not difficult, although the tests were fairly challenging for a  2 credit class.

She's hard to understand and doesn't communicate very well. The book for this class (Strayer) isn't much use either.  I recommend wikipedia or mathworld instead to try and teach yourself and then do poorly (in my case at least) I'm avoiding her classes in the future
very unclear. speaks very poor english. never fully answers questions...somehow avoids them. expect to fail but get a B bc of rediculous curve. go to office hrs. yes, she gives answers away.
Her lectures were worthless.  The book taught me everything.  Math does not lend itself to 20 question SCANTRON exams where each question is worth 5 points.  Know you're****.
Very nice but can't teach.  Homework is really hard but if you go to office hours she'll basically tell you how to do it. Exams are rediculous but she curves them.

This class was overall a blast and fairly straightforward! It's a semester long group project. It was a lot of work, especially with trying to schedule interviews and designing a prototype, but it was well worth it! Highly recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Great professor and would take again. Easy class as long as it is a group project for the entire semester, and will have to have meetings outside of class time. 3% deduction to the final grade for unexcused absence past 1st skip.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Prof Canale was great. She gives lots of opportunities for extra credit and was always super encouraging. She also gives you plenty of time in class to do work. Participation is important, so make sure you go to class or you'll get behind on assignments and group work.
Great professor. Easy class as long as you do the work. Group project entire semester, occasional meetings outside of class. 3% deduction to final grade for unexcused absence so show up!
Professor Canale was really awesome and a really caring person. She is super approachable and willing to help.

This class is a surprising amount of work. It's a sem-long group project and there's a lot of "out of class" commitments. There are a few papers, lots of reflections, weekly quizzes, and the work for the project. It's rlly overwhelming the 1st 2 weeks, then gets better. Abbie is really sweet and a good prof, but doesn't always know what's going on

Really loved this class and Professor Canale was such an amazing teacher. It was her first time teaching the class and she made everyone feel really welcome. Attendance matters so make sure you attend class. Definitely take EDSGN with Professor Canale if you have a chance.

This guy was great. The majority of the semester was spent working on the final project, which is just whatever you want to make really. Lectures are kind of boring, but you don't even need to listen because he really pushes students to use AI. He cares about his students and walks around and checks on everyone. Super chill dude.

Saeed is my favorite professor that I have had at PSU. His lectures were incredibly clear, and he would stop to walk around the class and check on students to see if we needed help. He posts the lecture slides with step by step pictures of how to code. Mid-terms were open note. Opportunities for bonus points on the final project. He is so kind!

Saeed is so sweet, caring, and genuine. I took 340 when he was newer. We struggled a bit but he put so much effort into working with us. Go to class, take notes, participate, and you'll be fine. He is great at walking you through concepts even if you aren't a strong programmer.
Gary is great. This is a seminar course so as long as you show up and interact with him, you are practically guaranteed an A. Very down to earth and likable.
Gary is not only a great teacher, but a wonderful guide into the communications world. Every class was super fun, and the assignments were not bad at all. Would highly recommend!

Gary is such an amazing prof. I was bummed that this freshman seminar was only 7 weeks bc he's so funny and great. He truly cares about each of his students (its a small class) and honestly if you show up and participate you'll basically ace the class. I missed only 1 point in total.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: Easiest class I've ever taken. Gary is so cool and chill. I loved being able to interact with him. He really cares about every students and understands that first year seminars shouldn't be difficult. You have a few assignments but they're so easy

The class itself was great, but she grades however she wants, which I felt was unprofessional. She did not give us any grade throughout the semester, so I felt like I was blindsided until I received the final grade.

We had a lot of readings for homework which would be par for the course for a history class but for the most part it wasn't too bad. The midterm and final were writing assignments. I would take the class again if I could.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: If you want to take this class, DON'T. She makes this class SO hard for a 100 level INTRO course. You honestly don't learn a ton from her lectures but you need to attend them on zoom to do the discussion posts & she was never clear on everything you have to do so kiss 15% of your grade goodbye. AVOID AT ALL COSTS.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Tough grader

reviews.comment: You're going to want to sit close to the wall so you can bash your head against it. I have never had a professor push a liberal agenda, bore the crap out of me, and give lectures based 100% on opinion all in a 50 minute class, 3 times per week, until professor Abel. If I could go back in time I would never have taken this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Group projects

reviews.comment: Literally the hardest class I have ever taken at Penn State. The professor is just straight up the rudest instructor there is. Requires participation EVERY class (when there's like 35 of us) and if you don't participate, well kiss 15% of your grade goodbye. Extremely subjective and opinionated. Pro tip don't do an assignment on Japan you will fail.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This class was A LOT of work for a freshman seminar (hence the 3 credits instead of 1). Prof. Abel is really passionate and caring, which keeps the lectures engaging. An insane amount of reading (you definitely have to skim read). Participation in reading discussions required for each class. Two papers and a short answer final exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Great teacher, loves in class discussion. I've taken 3 classes with her and loved all of them. She makes the subject interesting and so long as you study and prepare for exams you'll do fine. You'll do better when you participate. The class is demanding, and she expects you to have read, but the work load is reasonable for a 400 level.

Probably one of the worst gen eds you can take at psu. Nice professor, but for a 100 level class the material is so dense, there are large numbers of readings, and the power points are virtually pictures off the internet. Don't really recommend taking the class unless you really want to know what asia is.

Awesome professor! Very approachable and intelligent. She's very clear on what she expects from you. Readings are a bit difficult and lengthy to get through especially if you're not an Asian studies major. But easy A if you show up to class and listens to her lectures!

She's a very knowledgable professor. Her lectures are easy to understand, but the reading can be ridiculous.She likes to beat the same point into your head until it's caused a headache. the tests are rather difficult, but nothing you can't ace with preparation. I recommend her classes!
She is a very engaging teacher. Her lectures are clear and and right to the point. She can always draw out the good points of her students' responses, so don't feel afraid to speak up in her class.

The readings assigned are equivalent or greater in frequency and length as 400 level classes I've taken with her. Definitely not a 100 level class, a 400 level amount of reading with a 200 level difficulty factor.

Very nice/friendly professor but assigns too much reading expected for a 100 level class and definitely not an easy grader. I had to work a lot harder for this class than most of the 400 level history classes I have taken.
