The quizzes, lectures, exams, and textbooks all do not cover the same material making them difficult. And she has her grades disabled, so you don't know what you have.

The whole 50 minutes for 50 questions thing on exams was way too hard. The assigned readings were very long. The lectures weren't very engaging. The questions on the quizzes/exams were worded in a confusing way. If you don't have to take her, don't.

She is very nice and the class is extremely easy. The exams are online and there is one hw assignment a week. Also the topics aren't complicated. Definitely would recommend if you are looking for a zero effort course and want to get at least a B.

She's very sweet as a person, but as a prof very difficult to learn from. Lectures are slow & mostly just read off slides, material seems easy to grasp but when exams come around they are HARD. Be careful not to fall behind bc it will be almost impossible to catchup. She's nice but I'd try to take a diff prof if possible.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS WITH HER. I know this could be a really interesting class but Dr. Amie made it 10x more difficult. Her lectures are elementary level especially paired with the notes, they really fool you to think it's easy until you get to the exams. They are just ridiculous and I regret not dropping her.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Weekly readings that are so long for a 10 question weekly quiz.  The exams are all applied knowledge and super difficult.  She is super sweet and nice but doesn't structure this course well.

PLEASE DON'T TAKE!!!!!!!!

You have weekly quizzes based on textbook reading about 40+ pages a week plus 3 1 hour long lectures that have nothing to do with these quizzes. Exams are based almost purely off lectures and tells us to only study lecture notes. Constantly confuses information. Plus she doesn't post your grade until end of the semester.
Reading quizzes outside of what is learned in class that are not easy. I take notes on the reading and continue to do very poorly. Material in class is elementary level

She was really nice and caring, like a mom-figure, but made the info so boring. I had exams online, 50 Qs in 50 minutes, and they were so hard- would fail them in person. She asks questions very specific to how she teaches and what she said, not just basic facts. Homeworks helped bring up my grade but exams were too much

Professor Skattebo is an incredible professor! She teaches the material in an interesting and engaging way. There is weekly quizzes and self-discovery assignments, but they're not terrible and actually allow you to put what you learn to use in real life.

Dr. Skattebo is okay. Psychology can be interesting, but she makes it boring. She made her tests online this semester (50 Q in 50 min), so I could quickly look at my notes. Her tests would be soooo hard in person!! Very specific questions. Very lecture heavy, but shows a lot of videos. I wouldn't take her if I did not have to, but also isn't bad.

Exams are VERY difficult. Must not just memorize the material but also be able to apply it to real life situations. Take detailed, organized notes by hand as I didn't find her skeleton notes to be all that useful. Also don't rely on the study guide posted a week before the exam because it won't do you any good unless you already know the material.
Her quizzes and stuff are due on Saturday nights, so they're really easy to miss. Also quizzes you on stuff that is meaningless/she didn't bring up in class/hidden in the textbook.
2 assignments every week, which can be long. Nice but lectures are long because she goes off topic sometimes. Wording on tests are weird. If taking for a Gen Ed would not take her.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is every helpful if you out if you have any questions and wants her students to understand the material. Does give long assignments every week but as long as you do the readings you should be set. Definitely not the easiest class but as long as you study hard youll do good.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: You get two days to review all lesson material and post a lengthy discussion which she doesn't every give full points for. Material and articles are very confusing, quizzes are hard. Don't expect her to reply on email for two weeks, so if you have a question on this weeks material youre on your own and you will get bad grades. hard for 0 reason.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Long lectures, material on exam does not correlate with the lecture review quiz. Gives fifty minutes for fifty question exams, does not give enough time to thoroughly answer questions.

She goes into detail about the material, which is good for you. The tests can be confusing because of the wording, but if some effort is put into studying and memorizing the material, you'll do just fine. She's strict about the deadlines, but there is an easy 20 point extra credit opportunity that involves doing research. Can come across as snarky.

Dr. S is very passionate about her topic, and very kind too. However, her lectures are very long and she words things a little confusingly. She's also very clear about how things are to be done and when they're due by. Exams aren't that bad as they're all multiple choice, and she's more than happy to help you review. Very kind, just a lot of work.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Do not take this class if you dont have hours upon hours every week to listen to prof. Go on tangents during HOUR PLUSSS long lectures. Takes forever to get to the point and test are nothing like material on study guides. Do not waste your precious time

This teacher is exhausting. Her quizzes are extremely hard she times you at 20 mins for 20 questions. When other professors standard time is about 45 mins for 20 questions. Her lectures are just overwhelming and stressful, if you do not have to take her just DON'T

Tests are HARD. She says they are "closed note" (not proctored), but even open note, the tests would not be easy. TAKE THOROUGH NOTES. Crush the first exam, its the easiest. Get 5/5 on every lecture quiz. The tests are just too hard, even after studying and taking good notes. I would try and find another prof.

There is absolutely not reason for psych 100 tests to be so difficult. You take the test thinking you did relatively okay, only to find out you got a 60-70 because the questions are so terribly worded and each answer is too similar.

Took her exams and felt like I knew everything then would get my grades back and I would get mid 70s-low 80s. Didnt feel like her tests were a fair reflection of what we learned. Watched all of her lectures, took good notes, and did well on her quizzes. After taking the tests I would look back over my notes and thought my answers corresponded

Great lectures, engaging, plenty of examples to illustrate concepts. Grade is: 3 exams (very hard, but fair) and final, 3 quizzes per week (only best 34 count), a weekly written assignment, and SONA research participation (can get extra credit). Class attendance optional, but definitely go if you have questions. Good teacher, interesting class.
There's absolutely no reason to make the exams for a 100 level psych class so difficult.

The exams are entirely lecture-based, and she provides skeleton notes to fill in during lectures, so as long as you study these simple notes, you'll do fine on the straightforward exams. Extra credit opportunity for SONA studies, which is easy to get. Only thing is that there are weekly textbook-based quizzes, which are a little bit tougher.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Her assigned reading each week is massive. There are difficult weekly quizzes and weekly activities. The activities are cited research papers on HR practices, there is little to no guidance. You have to post on the discussion board three different days a week all citing the book and outside resources. The final project is not instructed and is 15%
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Amie is really nice and caring about her students. Go to class and take notes and you should be fine. There is a quiz every week and 3 exams. There is extra credit if you do extra SONA hours which is nice. She is nice and her class is not too hard. It's really mostly about going to class, but there's not a lot of work and the exams aren't too hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. S. is one of my favorite professors so far. She really cares about her students, and she is really sweet. If you need help with anything, dont hestitate to ask her. Her exams are lecture based, but the online quizzes are textbook based. The exams werent too difficult for me, just study and youll be okay.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Amie is very passionate about what she teaches, but be aware she can ramble every once in a while. I passed this class with an easy A+. Just print out the skeleton notes before class, show up to lectures, and read the textbook for online quizzes and you'll be fine. Reviewing/rewriting skeleton notes before tests helps a lot, too!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Skattebo is honestly a pretty good professor. Her class is lecture heavy which can sometimes drag on but she shows a lot of relevant material to make sure you understand the concepts. HOWEVER, she doesn't post her lecture slides, which is a real pain if you ever miss a class or during finals week.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: the class/assignments/grading was all more difficult than necessary. Very harsh grader (ex: Great work, unique points  4/6) assignments very tedious. Book is super bland and boring. Quizzes are extremely difficult and questions are hard to understand. Dr S was kind and responsive, good person hard class. summer class spent 10-20 hours/week
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Extremely harsh grader, and grades based on items not explicitly described in the rubric. This is one of my last classes in my program and I've never been graded so harshly on subjective items. Her feedback delivery is also pretty rough. Definitely do not recommend this professor if you aim to get a good grade, no matter how hard you work.

Took PSYCH 482 online through World Campus and was literally a self-teaching class. There were minimal notes posted from the professor and no indication of what might be on the exams/quizzes. Good luck to anyone taking this class, I highly do not reccomend this professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Very sweet lady but her lectures can really drag out. She shows videos which are fun. Sometimes she is really insensitive but I don't think she tries to be- for example she once called borderline people "difficult".
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Big class, 50 points participation but not a big deal if you skip. DOES NOT UPLOAD LECTURE SLIDES ONLY SKELETON NOTES. Exams are heavy but not too bad. Just the most standard college class you can get.

Her quizzes are ridiculous. You read 15 pages and maybe 1 sentence on the text will be a question. But DW because that's a small % of your grade. Go to lectures, take notes, for an easy time on the exams. Exams are plain, simple memorization. If you memorize your notes, cross-reference with her study guide, >90% guaranteed. Also, NO HOMEWORK!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: definitely a great professor. She gives a lot of examples on the materials in class and those examples are identical. to the ones on the exams. as long as you know the examples for the exams you'll be fine. she gives a lot of opportunity for extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: One of the hardest classes I have taken besides a bio/chem class. Quizzes are impossible to study for. Quizzes are based on textbook readings but are very hard even if you read the book. Exams have nothing on it that's related to the quizzes. Her review is he bullet pointing everything covered already which makes studying impossible. STAY AWAY!!!

If you follow her very specific directions for things (like online quizzes and how to take notes), the class is not that hard. She comes up with good ways to remember psych concepts. It's a little annoying that she doesn't make her lectures available on canvas, but during class you have enough time to write everything down that you need.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Made lecture material fun and easy to understand

Aimee seems nice, but she takes her time grading assignments and isn't always fair or consistent on how she grades. The amount of work applied to the class is ridiculous for a level 200 course and it's not Psychology at all, it's Business. Group projects are a nightmare, but I guess that's not her fault. The quizzes are very difficult also.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Amie tries to be nice but she gives you like 5 mins for the online quiz that is like 10 questions. Each question is too specific and she expects you to practically memorize the textbook- even tho you do not need the textbook to study for the exams. Ask for a miracle I studied her lecture notes so hard and got a 75 on exam

I really don't know why this professors can get 61% of a re-taking rate she's awful as a teacher that teaches first year classes. Her grades are very weird each semester you can earn up to 1000 points in total and 800 of them are EXAMS. She doesn't give out note presentations, only skeleton notes and study guides don't help. Just don't take this.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Readings were interesting. I cannot stress enough how incredibly fair she is and was always willing to work with me through my several challenges I experienced during the semester. Do the readings, and APA cite like a maniac! She was always available even though she was trekking through Europe. Good professor but a great educator!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Good lecturer, exams based on lectures so show up if you want to do well. Tests not particularly easy. Averages were 70-78-82.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Amie is very approachable and is happy to give feedback, and even to admit when a test question was graded incorrectly. Grading is very fair, and is clearly stated up front. Group projects are sort of a hassle, but are required for good reason (you'll have to work in a group when you graduate inevitably at some point).
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Skeleton notes are not helpful. Clicker questions for almost every class, and she usually doesn't know the answer to the question because there are at least 2 answers that could answer the question, which goes for the test questions, too. Interesting course subject, but I dreaded this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Dr. S was super nice and was a pleasure to have her as a professor. Her tests were fair but the only annoying things were the timed quizzes because I don't do well under pressure.

HER LECTURES ARE EXTREMELY PAINFUL AND HER EXAMS ARE EXTREMELY UNFAIR. NO MATTER HOW LONG OR HARD YOU STUDY YOU WILL MOST LIKELY DO HORRIBLE BECAUSE HER TESTS MAKE NO SENSE. NEVER TAKE THIS PROFESSOR.

(online) - Dr. Skattebo was very accessible and gave useful information at the beginning of each lesson. sometimes her weekly emails were a little late which made meeting her criteria of posting on different days a little difficult.  SHe could have provided better feedback on her grading but she is pretty timely and very repsonsive to her students.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Honestly regret taking psych 100 with her. I took AP psych last year and aced it (100%) & i struggled to get an A- in this course. Clicker points are daily, quizzes aren't relevant to exams. The quizzes are solely based on reading & you never look at them again. Such a waste of time, honestly. Also she can't help it but her accent triggers me so.

Bad professor. Frequently lectures the class about her copyrighted powerpoints and has some what of a big ego (goodness knows why).  She humiliates students if they get caught with their phones in class (beyond adequate scolding, more so to the extreme degree of being almost cruel).  She treats the class full of adult college students as children.

While Dr. Skattebo will provide depth of many concepts of psychology; be prepared to read like you've never read before. She will over inform on every tiny detail to the point of nausea. The material in the course commentary is great, it is the wiki, additional readings that will put you on overload. Expects near perfect grammar so watch details.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: she has an insanely annoying voice that at some points makes you want to tear your hair out. sometimes i dont even feel we're learning about psych but rather her opinions on random social issues and vaguely trying to connect it back to the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Definitely what you'd expect from a 200 level class. Takes attendance, weekly quizzes & discussion boards (with replies), exams aren't too bad. Discussions are easy and fun, just time consuming. You'll need the textbook for the quizzes. Dr. S has amazing lectures and really makes the material interesting! One of the nicest professors I've had.

Be prepared to go to class and write her slides down word for word!! Exam questions come straight from the slide and are not easy whatsoever! I did poorly on the first exam because she said she was testing "general concepts", memorized my notes word for word for the next exam and was much better off! She is a very sweet women & always has examples

Dr. S is an amazing woman who really has a passion for psychology! Her lectures are interesting and she explains things well. Reading the textbook and taking online quizzes definitely sucks but it only helps you better understand the material. My best advice is to go review your tests with her in office hours and you'll be sure to succeed!

Dr. S. wants her students to succeed. As long as you have the lecture notes and follow along you will do great on the exam because it is all pulled straight from the lecture. You only use the textbook for supplemental readings for the quizzes (which are pretty tricky). Dr. S really knows her stuff and her enthusiasm helps the topic come alive.
This professor is so nice and is more than ready to help you if you don't understand something or have literally any questions at all. Would definitely take her class again if I could.

Good lecture notes are what get you through this class. Her voice is pretty annoying and I want to fall asleep most classes but the class itself pretty easy. Skeleton notes are provides and study guides which is nice.

VERY intense class! Must have book and ready to read 30plus pages for each 20question quiz. Additional weekly assignments plus group projects. MUST cite everything in the correct format! Her instructions are extremely long. It takes hours to finish one project! I hate this class. However, it is a req. for LER major. Currently halfway through course

She is an amazing professor! she uses a lot of examples, associates lessons with funny and interesting videos, and is organized. Just go to class, pay attention, write down your notes instead of using the skeleton notes, review before exams, and you'll do great.

Dr. S was a great psych 100 professor. Definitely less focused on the biological aspects of psych than other intro psych classes I've taken but overall, she is really nice and helpful. Show up to class and do the work. pretty good gen ed.

Warning: This is not a psychology course--it's a Business course that focuses on business consulting and organizational behavior. If you are looking for a psychology course, this is not the class for you; it would be like taking a Supply Chain Management course when you're a Music major. But if you're interested in business, this class is amazing!

It is so incredibly refreshing to have a professor who visibly loves what she does. Dr. S is enthusiastic, full of energy and very intelligent. She is willing to sit with you for as long as it takes to figure out any problem you may be having and in a way is more than just a professor. If you have the chance to take a either PSYCH 100 or 281 do it!

This class is more related to business than psychology but definitely take it if you are considering I/O psych. Dr. Skattebo is passionate and knowledgable about what she teaches and is willing to help if you have questions. Weekly quizzes are based off the textbook. The online discussion boards can be time consuming but they are not difficult.

This class was not bad at all. She gives plenty of examples throughout the lecture including funny videos to associate certain topics with. Dr.S gives weekly quizzes and drops your 3 lowest grades. Offers EC through the studies students sign up for. Her test were mainly implied so know the work really well. Also, show up for the clicker points.

As a person, she is quite annoying with a terrible accent. However, the class was easy enough and her exam questions are very conceptual-based, which I prefer over fact-based and are based off of her "skeleton notes". Paying attention in class is a must. The textbook is only useful for the weekly online quizzes, which are essential to your grade.

Weekly quizzes so there isn't a final. (*The quizzes are based off your text and her lessons . They are somewhat tough.) There are group assignments and class discussions. Overall not impossible to get an A but it does take effort! She is helpful and very clear on her expectations.

She has a very loud, high-pitched voice, which can get a little annoying, especially at 8am, however she is a very sweet lady and willing to help you. I barely showed up to lecture and got an A. The material is common sense and extremely easy if you make the effort to at least pay attention or read the textbook.

Quizes are definitely tough. There is 1 quiz a week. She does give extra credit options. If you take good and specific notes in class and study hard for exam you should do fine on them. If you go to her for help it does clear up a lot of things for the exam. Her study guides help.

The worst professor I've ever had. Voice is a shrieking Alaskan accent, weekly quizzes are on content not covered during classes, and quizzes are 10 minutes long for 15 questions forcing you to rush the entire thing. She is so afraid of copyright infringement that her skeleton notes are basically useless. Sign up for a different professor.

Takes her time grading, meaning you don't get feedback to correct on future paper (while she continues to dock you).  Quizzes make no sense and confuse myself and many of my classmates.  She doesn't respond to questions and provides no help beyond pre-fab slides. She treats an Intro class like an advanced degree class. I got an A- by some miracle.

The lectures make you want to die, the quizzes are very specific, and the exams aren't even english (by that I mean, only someone with a psychology degree can understand them). Her voice is so high pitched and annoying.  She rarely emails you back if you have a question and she is also very rude. Don't take psych 100 with her, its hard with her.

Weekly quizzes are easy and tests aren't bad but lecture is dreadful. Her voice is high and annoying and she says 'um' and 'sort of' more than the actual material. She thinks we are interested in her very boring personal life which is not fun to listen to. Skeleton notes for lecture are helpful. Book readings not necessary but useful for quizzes

Definitely did not like her. Mostly talked about her own life experiences, and didn't explain the terms at all. Her "skeleton notes" are pure hell. Her voice is way too high and squeaky for an 8am. She didn't teach at all, and the only way I learned anything was from the textbook.  She reminds me too much of a high school teacher, not a professor.

she wasn't my favorite person but the class overall wasn't bad... her lecture notes are virtually useless, you either have to memorize the textbook or take notes of every word she says in class. go to class for extra credit points. i did not think i was doing well all semester but by the end had over 40 points of extra credit bringing me to an a

She is so concerned with copyright infringement that it makes the notes more confusing. Her study guides don't help with exams because her questions are so unbelievably obscure. She is nice, but her teaching style is sub par

She uses a lot of videos to help explain her points, some of them help, but some of them don't really do much. There are weekly quizzes based on the book, which are annoying, but easy points. She's really knowledgable though, she tries to answer all questions really throughly!

I LOVED HER!! She is a great teacher and really tries to make the material easy for everyone to understand to get the A. She is so nice and definitely one of the best teachers at Penn State. She has a very cute personality and tries to make the class relaxing and fun. If you're taking Psych 100, you should absolutely try and get her!
She was so nice and a great teacher! You could really tell she cared about her students and what she does. If you have to take this class I suggest her as a professor

She's very sweet and very helpful. Made 8 AM a lot less awful. Tests are easy if you go to class and print out her "skeleton notes". Reading the book is helpful, and it is also needed for the online quizzes. Definitely a great professor that is engaging and knowledgeable.
I love her! She is so kind and makes this 8am a pleasure. Which is hard, trust me.

She is an amazing teacher hands down! Always keeps you engaged through her many videos incorporated into the lesson. A true sweetheart. Be prepared for her exams in advanced, note cards on exactly what is on the slides really helps. Also take not of what she puts on weekly quizzes and you are guaranteed an A.

i really enjoyed her class! shes so cute and fun! granted i did take AP psych in high school, this class was very easy. you didnt need to read the book if u went to class she explains it very well. online quizzes were easy too

I dont know what everyone else is talking about. I thought she was a great teacher that made Psych extremely easy to learn. Go to the lectures, she puts "skeleton notes" up online but she leaves out a lot of the material on those. If you go to class everyday its easy!
textbook needed for quizzes, lecture notes and review of quizzes should be good preparation for the exam. study has.  TA was completely useless, wasnt flexible or knowledgeable about anything

her tests are very fair. i crammed for every test and did well on the tests. As long as you skim the chapters you will be fine for online quizzes. she uses amusing videos to try and make the information useful. she is more than willing to help you if you need it, and is very understanding.
She's so sweet and kind. As long you come to class and to well on the quizzes, you will be fine. She made love psych even more.
Was not very helpful nor understanding. Very difficult to comunicate with.
she does random attendance activities that go towards your grade so although attendance isn't required it is strongly suggested.

She was very helpful in office hours and gave lots of extra credit. Her slides don't provide much information so you have to really pay attention to what she says and write fast because she talks a lot.

Dr. S gives ocassional extra credit for being in class, but I had her at 8am and I wound up usually not going. Even though the tests were hard and 80% of the grade, her class was too boring to go to. I lucked out because I had the same textbook in high school, so I managed, but her test Qs ranged from her personal opinions to very specific facts.

In the beginning I wasn't Dr. S's biggest fan, but she turned out to be one of the most helpful and nicest professors I had this semester. She used a lot of good examples in class and also gives tons of extra credit at the end of the semester. You do have to study for the tests and its not good to miss lecture, but overall she was a good professor!

This was one of the better classes I've taken, and Dr. S made it really easy if you put forth an ounce of effort.  She is always willing to help out, and if you go to class you should have an A.  I don't get all the bad reviews, because Dr. S is probably the most helpful professor I've had.

Probably the worst experience I've had in college so far. She aplogizes for every single thing. Her voice just makes you not want to go to class. Her tests are way too hard. Her lectures are the most boring thing on the planet. If you have to take PSYCH 100, do NOT take it with her.

Quite possibly one of the worst experiences I've had.  She is very knowledgeable; however, she has an attitude that borders on condescending.  At times, she feels more like a bully than anything else.  I worked hard for my grade, but finding the appropriate style that would please her was very difficult.

I took this class to see if I would like psychology as a career. Well i was wrong, the material was interesting and Dr. S knew her material well, but the help wasn't there and the exams were increasingly hard. Don't take this if you don't need to. She is a very nice professor, but for such a large class, i think it can get lost.

I don't care what anyone says, this is definitely an awful class. I did go to her office hours and she was nice but gave little to no help relating to the class. I had to study a lot to pull off a much lower grade than what I'm used to. Going to class was basically dreadful, just don't do it. Only take this if you 100% have to
Lectures are fun, she is totally approachable, but exams are way off balance; some are easy, others are fiendishly difficult. Few opportunities for extra credit.

You people are just lazy to do the works. Dr. S is a great professor. She is well organized and she knows her materials well. If you don't want to do your works, there is no reason for you to have a good grade. So suck it up!

The class was insanely difficult, even if you study for hours. I tried to go to her office hours, and she made me feel guilty for working instead of studying for one of her exams. She is VERY rude and snobby. If you can avoid her, PLEASE spare yourself from having to sit through this excruciating experience.

This class is ridiculous. She rambles on only to confuse you more, and she calls you out in front of everyone if you leave early, even if you have good reason. Her tests are completely unfair and at office hours she is unhelpful. And to top it off her voice is really annoying. Avoid this class at all costs.

Horrible proff. avoid any and all her classes! ive neva met such a horrible proff who doesn teach the key stuff but rambles all the time. theres no need to review cuz she neva test u the stuff she posted as review session.
She's terrible.  Avoid her   I do not enjoy going to her class.  Lecture notes do not match up with book on more than one occasion.
Grades hard,rude, inconsiderate. Avoid if you can!

I don't know what they are talking about This is a great Proff. who loves her work and wants you to do great! This class is no more difficult than the next. Just study and if you get stuck she will work with you until you get it. If you are or desire to be in HR or a supervisor you will leave this class running circles around your peers! Take it!

WORST EVER!! Final paper sucks, class is terrible, and she has the most annoying voice. Dont take if you dont have to or take Dr.Loviscky. She expects you to love the class and get a P.H.D in the field. If you love annoying and boreing people then take this class. Also, the grading is totally bogus!! USELESS CLASS AND PROFESSOR.

Avoid her class if you can. She does not provide clear direction, her grading does not match her grading rubric (very uneven), and she is extremely inflexible. She believes that you live and breath her class and have nothing else to do. She is the worst teacher I've ever had...and to say she has a PhD.
Great prof.  You will learn alot, but if you pay attention to what she writes, you will be fine.  Only Exp with her is online.
Assignments are locked until Thursday, and then due on Monday?? Ridiculous timing, nonetheless, this class was easy and was taught relatively well.
Easy A not much to say lol

Absolutely take this class. Weekly quizzes but the work takes no more than 45 minutes a week. Everything is on quizlet and there is a final exam which is based on the weekly quizzes. Professor is very understanding and is very responsive. Would highly reccomend for easy A.
There are new questions in the exam. you know what I mean, be careful.
Very easy class to do well in. I gave about 0% effort towarrds this class and got an A-. Almost all of the material can be found online.
The class is fully remote so you can do all of the work on your own time. There are weekly quizzes and every other week there is an exercise. Great class overall. Definitely take.

I absolutely loved this class. If you need the gen ed, take this one. Dr. Anandakrishnan and Dr. Alley are very funny and engaging with course topics. Supplemental videos shot from the actual places you are learning about provide extra learning and make the lesson go by quickly. Quizzes are straightforward and homework every two weeks.

Took through WorldCampus. Super fun professors for this class. The material can be really interesting too. Not too much work or too overwhelming. One quiz a week and one exercise every two weeks. Save all of the quiz questions to help you on the final. Hard to rate the prof on an online class, but I recommend it to anyone needing GN credits!

Him and Dr. Alley are hilarious. Took as a gen ed, but if you pay attention during the videos it's an easy class. Plenty of opportunities for extra credit. Save your quizzes since the questions show up on the final.

Easiest online class you can take. If you decide to actually read, some of the stuff he posts is actually really cool and shows how much he cares about the course. Has some whack videos along the way too to brighten your spirits.

Quizlets are very helpful for this class. If you save the feedback given on the quizzes, a lot of those questions will show up again on the final (I'd say around 80% of the final was repeat questions).

Pretty easy class. Pay attention to some questions on the quizzes as they answers are mostly the same with a slight word change that changes the entire answer. If you're into the national parks, you'll like this class. Is a tad bit on the boring side, but an easy A.
Great guy, great teacher, math wiz, and pretty hot too.

I took this class for a GN requirement and this class was super easy! I really recommend this course for anyone looking to complete their GN as well and want a nice and easy online course to do so. All of the weekly quiz answers can be found online. Just an overall easy online gen ed.
EASY CLASS, GPA booster, free elo. TAKE IT to help your gpa!

I had him with Dr. Bice for Geosc 203. He focuses more on the math side of the course, which I found extremely helpful, and he has a great sense of humor. I preferred their in-class explanations of concepts to the readings, which are difficult to understand. Email early and often to contact him for help, as he can be a little tricky to reach.

EASIEST CLASS EVER. Every single question on every quiz + the final is on Course Hero or Quizlet. Every week I'd log on, Google the questions, and get 100s. Ended up with a 99.87% in the class. Easiest GN ever, I recommend!!!! 10/10

Easiest class EVER!! Weekly quizzes and one final exam. EVERY answer is on CourseHero. I didn't do a thing for the entire class, just logged on once a week, Googled the questions, and ended up with a 100% in the class. 10/10 would recommend as an easy GN.
Watch the lecture or read, you only need to do one to pass the quizzes, lots of points and extra credit. The teacher is funny, and the course allows for skipping  some assignments without a penalty.

LOL @ people who thought this class was hard...I finished with a 98% average...take notes on every lecture and you will get a 14/15 or 15/15 on every quiz and the questions on the final come VERBATIM from the quiz questions

Don't listen to these geosc 010 rooks. I had him and Bice for the physical process of geoscience and they were both great professors and always helped you when something was not clear, and geo 10 is a very easy class
Geosci010 is pretty much useless and just frustrating.  If you're looking for an easy science gen ed that doesn't require a lot of work, don't take it.

Took this class online and it was quite easy to get an A- without doing any work.  I didn't read the textbook and got 70s on all the quizes but the other assignments bring up your grade.  The 5 points of extra credit also helps a lot.

Online class and does not respond to emails (which are the only way of communication)!? Knows his stuff?but not impressed. Do not take if you are looking for an easy or basically worthwhile science credit.

Umm I took this class because I thought it was easy from some of the comments, but this guy has the worst TA's ever who think they are teachers and like to give out bad grades. This class is not easy I promise and the main guy is the worst of them all because he likes to make an easy class hard as hell
Ridiculously hard for a gen. ed web class. Don't take it unless you're desperate for a GN.

Very nice professor. He is very helpful and friendly. You can tell he prepares his classes in advance. The lab is very demanding but the course is worth to take if you are in any earth sciences field.

Comeon guys, one of the best teachers i've had here. His quizzes r on angel so u can look up what is on them, and his exercises r extremely easy. Only met one time a week, wish it could have been 2, awesome class
This professor is NOT HELPFUL AT ALL. You never knew what was going to be on the tests. Don't take this class if you're looking for an easy A gen ed.

The ABSOLUTE WORST teacher I have had so far. Thought the homework assignments would be easy but for one we had to walk to DAMONS (on the way to the mall) ps I got a 60 and answered ALL of the quesions correctly on that one with help from someone that worked at the place we had to visit

He is by far the worst teacher I have ever had. I HAD TO DROP THE CLASS! He is very unhelpful and thinks he is always right. He lies about his expectations and he thinks that he is always right. HE HAS NEVER TAUGHT A CLASS BEFORE! But, if you do a presentation on galciers he'll like you :)

HORRIBLE!!! Avoid like the plague. Boring, unclear about his expectations, basically, bad teaching. Put things on the second exam that he did not tell the class would be on it, then told the class he was not responsible for telling everyting on the exam. DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR! bisci(3)is better

So far the worst teacher I have ever had. His second exam covered questions nevered reviewed or covered. His reponse to this was "You can't expect me to cover everything". Flat out a horrible teacher expecially for "rocks for jocks" which is supposed to be an easy class.

This professor literally can't teach. He is insanely disorganized and also never tells you when the quizzes are unless you ask. You are able to retake the quizzes which is helpful, but it's not easy when he doesn't teach. Overall, easy class but don't take it.

Mr. Baxter is an amazing professor. The grading criteria can be confusing at first but if you study just a little you can easily pass every single quiz not to mention you can make up everything as many times as you want. If your concerned about what your grade is you can meet with him quickly, he's very good with office hours and so kind!

DO NOT TAKE MATH32 AVOID AT ALL COSTS. The grading system is extremely confusing, he never answers emails, he is disorganized and teaching style is very chaotic I could never understand what he was saying. He would get through a problem and realize he made a mistake and would have to redo the whole thing leaving everyone very confused.

Do not take this class if you genuinely want to learn. Half the time I could not even understand what he was saying. He did not assign any practice problems for the quizzes. Weirdest grading system ever and does not respond to emails. Avoid him if you can.

The material of this class is so unorganized, and even when I ask him questions, he never explains well. He also NEVER answers emails, so good luck getting in touch with him outside of class. His grading system is so strange, I have never seen anything like it. I definitely do not recommend anyone taking this class.

Easy class. Why are you becoming a teacher if you can't do basic math? If you can do basic addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division, this class is not hard at all. People are getting their base 10 digits wrong, and it scares me for them teaching in the future. Work hard and you'll do great, slack off and really, that's your own fault.

Great professor! Super accessible and genuinely wants students to succeed. The class is designed so you pass. Even getting 1/3 on every quiz will let you pass, but you'll need 3/3s to get an A. He's clear, supportive, and always willing to help. If you put in the effort, he'll match it. Highly recommend—great guy, great teacher.

Had him for 200 and 201. He knows the content but sucks at explaining it. He is all over the place and the new grading format/homework/quizzes is so confusing. Procrastinates on the grading until the end of the semester.

Had Professor Baxter for Math 200 (the previous semester) He changed the grading criteria, so its funky. Procrastinate on grading until the end of the semester. Also does not remind you when the homework is due, so you better do it. Exams are re-takable, which is a plus if you make stupid mistakes or don't understand things the first time.

Such an amazing class, if you can do 5th grade math you should be fine. People claim they struggle in this class, but that is because they don't show up or talk through his whole lecture. Does procrastinate grading, but he'll do it if you remind him. Tests are retake-able and final grade is really up to you and how much work you're willing to do.
Professor Baxter is a great professor but this class was hard for me since I am not good at math and the way we were learning was hard for me to understand.

He is a really nice guy although a bad teacher. He doesn't grade anything till the end of the semester and always procrastinates. You can tell he knows what he is talking about but is not good at explaining things clearly. He is extremely scatterbrained which makes communication hard. He isn't reliable and has made a lot of students dissapointed.

Very nice, but very scatterbrained. Doesn't explain material well. Also doesn't update canvas ever, so I have no clue what my grade is. Attendance isn't required but if you skip the lectures, you will have no clue what's going on. The textbook is only slightly helpful.

He is a good guy, but he's not a great professor. He is very unorganized so as a student it's hard to know what to expect from him. It was extremely stressful to get all of the quiz checks in, and we really started rushing towards the end of the semester. I feel bad because maybe he has something personal going on. I would not recommend this class.

Realistically, You will pass this class if you attend regularly. However, you do not get a grade in the course till after the semester is over. His grading scale is set up by "concepts". He is extremely disorganized and your grade will reflect this. He knows the material but is awful at explaining it. You teach yourself everything. do not take!!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: A nice guy, just disorganized and all over the place. Lectures are very confusing and he assigns a lot of assessments, then never grades them unless you go to his office hours and ask him to do it right then. He waited until the end of the semester to begin grading everyone's assessments- finals are next week and nobody knows their grade.

Mr. Baxter is a very nice guy, our final got cancelled! We got so many papers, and the grading was sometimes unclear and inconsistent. We did not have formal assessments; we had learning targets that we could retake but he took a really long time to grade them. GO IN FOR OFFICE HOURS or else your stuff will not get graded. Lectures were confusing.
the worst professor anyone in my class has ever taken. so insanely unprepared and unorganized, takes a month to grade any assignments and never answers emails
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: People are making Dr. Baxter to be way more out there than he is. If you can do basic algebra, then you'll be fine. This was the easiest math course I've ever taken! His homework isn't hard, and his lessons are fine as long as you take notes. I promise, it's not that hard to add numbers together and know place values.

Sweet guy but doesnt explain material well. He is the only prof for this class but he is unfortunately all over the place. The content itself is easy if you went up to pre-calc in high school, but his explanations are very confusing. Your grade is made up of quizzes that you can take as many times as you want but he doesnt give enough time to do so

Very nice guy, just a terrible teacher. You can tell he actually knows the content but he SUCKS at explaining. The man is all over the place and explains the material in the most complicated way possible. Class itself is very easy since you can take the quizzes multiple times for a pass.

He is a very sweet guy, however he doesnt grade anything. I have quizzes from the beginning of the semester still ungraded so then I dont know where my grade stands. He takes so long grading and even if you remind him multiple times, which i have, he doesnt.

Professor Baxter is an amazing math teacher. He is so helpful and really wants you to pass. He's a pretty light grader, and as long as you show work for something even if it's wrong, you will get credit. If you don't go to class, you will not pass. He sometimes records the lectures, but rarely.

Prof. Baxter is really nice, and he is a good teacher. If you go to class and listen, you will do fine in the class. He cares about making sure students understand all the concepts. However, he is not good about grading. He gets really behind on grading, so I still had N/A as my grade during finals week because he only had auto-graded grades in.

Andrew Baxter is a very friendly professor who clearly likes his subject. Lectures are recorded and notes are on canvas, but going in person helps. All quizzes, HW, and tests are online. Units are all pretty separate, so if you struggle at the start it's easy to fix your grade. No cumulative final. Nice, easy math gen-ed.
The lecture didn't help at all. There were very few examples duiring class, which had no help towards the homework.

He is very disorganized and the homeworks are unfair. The first one was due on a Monday at 2 pm, which required use of a formula he wrote on the board a minute before class ended the Friday before. He did extend the due date because he caught COVID but not because he did not teach us the material required.

you only get "homework" when he finishes going over a section of the unit and it's a fairly short quiz. he takes forever to grade so you might spend the entire semester scared that you have a low grade when you don't. he was a really nice guy and you can tell that he enjoys his job. would definitely recommend it!!
Your grade is essentially made up of quizzes and tests but everything is open note and online so it's super easy.

Dr. Baxter is the only math professor that matters at Penn State. Understanding, kind and happy to help his students. Material is easy if you pay attention, the quizzes and his system of grading are highly beneficial. Would take again if i wasnt graduating!!

If you ever want to get in contact with him, good luck. this man did not reply to a single email i sent him all semester. He was hard to understand and never went through content clearly. This was not only me, but many others in the class that were lost the entire time. do not take this class.

honestly, Baxter is a really cool guy. I had him for the last two semesters in 471 and 470 and his lectures are good. The only downside, even though he knows it, is that putting grades on canvas takes awhile. Which at times can be frustrating. Other than that baxter is a really caring professor. Hes a really good guy!

Professor Baxter makes this class really easy. He is really good at explaining the lessons and is always willing to help. The class is essentially just quizzes which are easy if you pay attention to the lectures.

Andrew is genuinely a nice person and does his best to explain the material practically. The course is unorganized and outdated but not extremely difficultone of the easier math courses for GQ. It could be a decent class if it is revamped. The textbook was not needed.

I had Dr. Baxter during remote so I never met in person, but nicest guy youll meet. Very kind person. He is the absolute worst professor Ive had and im a sophomore. He was corrected at least 8 times by students on the class material and he NEVER responds to students emails. Made the class more difficult than it needed to be and just terrible prof

So this is like the easiest math class ever. Andrew is super laid back and very quirky so class is enjoyable most days. The tests aren't bad at all but you have quizzes sporadically that seem harder than the actual tests sometimes. Easy easy A though

Professor Baxter is really cool. he understands that math isn't everyone's favorite thing, and tailors his lectures to that. He is very understanding and willing to go over something again if someone doesn't understand. Extremely patient, and clear with his expectations for quizzes and exams. Take him if you need a GQ!

He gives one example problem, makes us do two on our own, and moves on until the midterm/final. He says he'll work with you and not to worry but at the end does nothing to help you benefit. He laughs at your questions when you don't understand. I spent so much time in the learning center and they questioned why I hadn't learned things on the hw.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Baxter was one of my favorite professors! I had to work really hard in that class because I didn't take calculus in high school but overall he was incredibly helpful and was always available to answer questions and clarify whatever I was confused about.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Andrew is a great guy and super nice but he is the absolute worst professor I have ever had. The only way that I passed this class was from the textbook. He makes no sense when he teaches and is always all over the place with his topics. When students ask questions in class he never answers the question.I don't think this guy knows the material.

I had to drop this class. Everyone I know got below a 50 on exam 1. His lectures do not correlate with homework, which does not correlate with quizzes and therefore exams. Straight up migraines 4 days a week from this class. He is also a very slow grader. He isn't very understanding either. Do not recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Dr. Baxter explains concepts really well during lecture. He is super friendly and willing to help outside of class during office hours. Homework load is manageable too

Dr. Baxter is one of the best professors I've had. I was really struggling in the class & was far behind my classmates but, he was patient and took the time out to help me. The formatting of the class could use some improvement for the calculus beginners BUT if this is your 1st time taking calculus I'd still recommend him.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: I skip class, just do the My Math Labs, and it is very manageable. Take this professor!
The best teacher I've had at Penn State. If you can, absolutely take a course with him. He loves the material and genuinely cares about how well the students do.
Bax is a great professor. Explains everything well, and assigns a manageable amount of homework. Exams are always fair.

Dr. Baxter is such a good choice for a math professor. I had calculus in high school, so this class was a breeze for me, but Dr. Baxter always knew exactly what to say to get literally everyone on board with what he was teaching. He also assigns a very manageable amount of homework unlike other Math140B professors.

Andrew was by far the worst mathematics professor I've ever had. He barely teaches, he just stands in front of the class and solves the problems for them then magically expects everyone to be able to do the same. His quizzes are just as difficult than the exams. He "claims" to give partial credit. TAKE ANOTHER PROFESSOR unless you're a math wiz.

This prof is so kind. He's a very good teacher and really helps you understand the material and why it works the way it does. He really cares about his students too. I had received an A on all my assignments but I bombed the second midterm because I had to skip class the week before, and he made sure it didn't affect my grade too much. Great guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Baxter explains concepts very well and most of the learning in the class comes from the lectures. He uses proofs and intuitive examples to explain concepts which is not for everybody but I found this very helpful. The weekly problem sets are also really helpful but can be challenging.

Dr. Baxter is a great professor and really cares about his students. He takes the time to make sure students understand topics through clicker surveys. Some of his lectures are proof-heavy so they can be little boring. But if you meet with him outside of class, he can be very helpful. Not too much homework but homework that is assigned can be hard

Dr. Baxter is a very nice person but sometimes is not clear when he teaches. He does not give a lot of homework which is great! This class is an easy A if you've taken calc or AP calc in high school!!
Typical math teacher, very nerdy. No formal notes which is annoying but tons of example problems. So much less work than the other 140B classes!!!

Dr. Baxter wants his students to do well, but he doesn't do a very good job at helping them do that. If you've never taken a calc class before I would gear up for this. I took Calc AP in hs and still had to late drop this class. He gives a lot less homework compared to the other professors but it's hard. Office hours would confuse me more sometimes
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Dr. Baxter seems like he would care about the grades his students get, but about 20 of us showed up to his office hours and he didn't even show up. We tried to figure out the homework problems by ourselves out in the hallway. Still not understanding anything and the homework takes up a lot of time.  This is the science section of calc 140.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: I read his reviews on here before and was happy I had a good math professor since I struggled for math. This was his first time teaching 140B, so he wasn't used to open-ended exams I believe. He "gives" partial credit hardly. I relied on my calc notes from last year, and that still wasn't enough. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS WITH HIM. The hw is no help.
The best Math professor ever

he is so good. makes math easy. always there for you. he focuses on details so if you want to understand the material really well you must have him. he gives almost 7 quizzes and then takes best 5. every week there is a problem set homework but it's not that hard. definitely recommend him!

I really really like this teacher, his lecture is so amazing! He explains the concepts clearly and really eager to help. When taking this class, you only need to listen carefully and take the notes.  There are not much homework. You just need to do his recommended homework and do his problem set once every week. His problem set really helps too!
I think the best professor in the math department. Very clear class and very helpful homework. If you work hard, you can definitely get A.
one of my fave teachers, and i love math
Very Clear
Dr. Baxter is the best math teacher I have ever had. He's so sweet and cares about his students. He is easy to understand and goes out of his way to help you. I wish I could have him again.
Amazing prof. He is really helpful. I just wish that he reaches all of my MAT classes.

He is THE best math professor I had by far at Penn State. He is a very clear and straight forward in his teaching. He cares about students' performance, and most importantly he is a great person that loves to teach and help. Dr. Baxter if you happen to read this by any chance, Thank you for everything, I appreciate all you did to us.

I love Dr. Baxter. He's very clear, helpful, a sweetheart and caring. He is the ideal math professor. The way he taught is just like a mother spoon feeding her child. Consider taking his classes without any regrets. I never thought I was going to do well in this class but he helped me do very well.
Love Dr Baxter. Greatest Professor I have ever seen. Always ready to help and drops few of your bad quizzes.

Great professor, and just a good guy overall.  He will help you out so much in office hours.  Lectures are rarely boring, and are really useful towards doing well on tests.  The tests are hard, but attendance and doing the homework will help.  He will also give out study guides.  Take him if you can!

Baxter was a great professor. He isn't like most calculus professors who just hurl example after example at you. He first explains the ideas and concepts then integrates those into comprehensive examples. He's a great instructor and you should definitely take a class with him but remember that it's a tough class no matter who you have.
Great professor. very knowledgeable. teaches simple topics extremely well. keeps students engaged. would definitely take his class again

I took Math 035 with Dr. Baxter over the summer. The class was small and none of us were actually interested in math. He altered the material to keep us engaged and he was such a SWEETHEART! He would sometimes share bits of his personal life and always engaged with us personally. He's brilliant and he was very  good at explaining concepts!
He is the nicest teacher ever ! Math 36 is so easy and a ton of fun, hes also a genius.
Great teacher!  Tries to make class as fun as it can be, and does that well.  His lectures are very organized and easy to understand.  His grading is also very fair.
This guy is the best teacher I've had since I've been in PSU and Id bet he's the best teacher in the whole math department. Didn't understand proofs at all until this class.

He is a great professor for 140. I wish he was teaching 141 as well. he is 100% dedicated to helping students. He makes the exams a breeze if you do all the assigned homework and his problem sets. His quizzes are kind of tricky, but prepares you well for the exams.

A difficult class but if you go to office hours he will be GLAD to help out. He really enjoys teaching and loves it when you come to ask him questions. But you definitely have to work to get a good grade. And attend class!
the subject is hard so the lecturer can do the best in helping us understand. and by that, he's succeed. he's extremely helpful.
Best professor I've had so far. He takes the time to explain everything clearly and is very fair. He makes his students' learning his #1 priority.

Knows a lot about the subject. He goes through a lot of examples and explains everything thoroughly. He is very willing to answer questions during lecture and office hours. Quizzes and proble sets are easy but the tests are super hard.

Great teacher.  Mostly makes up own examples.  Going to class isn't required but you will be lost.  Very helpful and answers all questions on the spot.  If your struggling like me spend time in his office hours.  He will break everything down into easier terms. Quiz and HW are on alternate weeks.
Great teacher, lectures are well organized and easy to understand.

Great teacher. I would definitely reccomend him for any math class. Knows a ton, is always willing to help and is a pretty fair grader on quizes and such. Unlike most of the math140 teachers he only gives hw due every other week and a quiz on the weeks in between so its not a lot of work. take this class with him if you can.

smart guy. knows an insane amount about calculus and its history and even has calculus story time friday mornings. go to class or you WILL NOT do well in this course unless you can self teach. tests are hard as is, and you need to prepare well. i would recommend him, but know this class will be difficult no matter who you have as a prof

Fantastic Professor! Thurough and keeps it interesting. Always open to help when available and knows more than alot about math. I would deffinantly reccomend him. There are not a lot of points in Math 140 and he makes you earn them all but makes sure you know the material well. Very fair.
Smart man. I just suck at math is all.

Professor Benkiran is genuinely one of the best math teachers I've ever had.  He does an amazing job of explaining concepts and wants to make sure every student succeeds.  Going to his office hours is especially helpful if you're ever confused by something.  100% would recommend.
Best math prof you will have.

Professor Benkiran is an excellent teacher. Would 100% take another class from him. If you have any questions ask him and he will explain it until it makes sense. Attendance isn't mandatory, but if you want to make sure you don't miss quizzes or material, I would prioritize attending.

Amine is one of the best math professors I've had. His lectures are engaging, and he's genuinely committed to helping students succeed. Try using Unstuckstudy for extra practice - it saved me a lot of time alongside the free textbook.

Slows down class in order for everyone to catch up and stay on pace, without falling behind the class outline. Attending all the classes and doing the homework will help you succeed in the class. One of the best teachers I've had and definitely recommend.

He is a very nice caring man and cares a lot about the well being of his students. He does very well with accommodations and will always let you make up work or if you are sick he will always let you retake a quiz.

Dr Benkiran was a great professor who was very accommodating. Any time I needed extra help, or when I missed an exam due to illness, he was there to support me. The course content and technology was difficult sometimes, but he made me feel comfortable to ask for help.
The only reason I did not give him a 5 is because I have yet to find the perfect teacher. If there was an option, I would say like 4.8.

I'm sure he's great in person, but if you're taking his 251 WEB right now, you can agree
that the homework & exam problems are 500x harder than anything that is actually taught. The video lectures are rushed and there will be like one example of one type of problem, and then there ends up a being a completely different type of problem on hw...
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Just a nice guy and a good teacher hes a dog

I took him for Math 140 and 41. I can truthfully say be was the best math teacher I've ever had. He really understands the material and wants his students to understand. He is always willing to help and explain things as many times as it takes. His office hours are incredibly helpful and he gives a lot of in class examples. I would recommend him!

Amazing lectures and great professor. He really tries to connect with his students and more often than not he succeeds. My only warning is that he moves very quickly and if you don't have a solid understanding of precalculus then you will be left behind. He is very accessible so it is up to you to reach out for help if you need it.

Easily best math professor I've ever had. Class was hard but that was expected. He just wants you to do well. Going to Ta's a certain amount was extra credit. He would dedicate time in class to work on homework problems.
Amine is such a great professor! He clearly cares about all of his students and wants them to succeed. His class is very easy to follow and he is great at explaining things.
Really great at explaining concepts and office hours are very helpful. Credit is awarded for dedication. My favorite math professor.

Probably the best math teacher I have ever had. He explained material extremely well and made difficult subjects easy to understand. He cares about each one of his students and will help you with any problem you have. I would recommend him for anyone who has to take a math class.

Amine is a great professor with out a doubt, if I could I would take all my math courses with him because he is dedicated to his students learning and that's not something you see really often. If you need help he will work with you to ensure you understand. Best professor at Penn State without a doubt.

SC 220 is a really good class to get you ready to be a Math LA. Amine is a coordinator in the Math LA program and he is wonderful. He is very helpful and understanding. I learned a lot from the readings and the discussions in class. Take any class you could with him! He is amazing not only in this class but even in his math classes.

Very lazy prof, at least for this class. Not a single thing has been graded weeks after the class ended (not even the first assignment). All he did is assign readings for research papers and then have you write an essay for it every week. He didn't even prepare anything for class - he just asked you to talk about the readings. I Learned nothing.
It took a ridiculous amount of obsession for differential equations me to get an A in the course and avoid him at all costs.

he gives lots of homeworks each week but thats what make you learn. he is the best math teacher ever.. he clarifies every topic and so helpful and cares every of his student a lot..
