Very hard professor but also very understanding... If you attempt hws u get 100% for HW. DOesn't have to be correct, just have to try. He is very lenient when he grades as well. If you did bad on one exam but did very well on others, he will forget about that one exam. I'd recommend him

Really good teacher.  Makes material easier to understand and presents it in a way that makes more sense than most physics teachers.  Exams are fair, and he's always available during office hours to help with homeworks.

Very easy to understand, presents the information in a way you can understand. Homework was graded on if you tried it not accuracy and tests were very easy, were only on the basic concepts...nothing tricky. Definatly take him if you get the opportunity.
This class is very hard by nature, but he does a good job at presenting the material.  Grading is fair considering the material.  I would recommend taking him as a professor.

Dr. Axtell has incredibly difficult tests. Understand good teachers give challenging exams but his exams are not explainable because he doesn't teach well. He also lies about the material that will be on the test. He does not give the answer key until it's 2 days before the exam. That's all you need to know to NOT take his class. Save yourself.

Hard class for BMB majors with no prior biology experience. The class was interesting but the professor was very boring. There were in-class questions and HW but the exams were most of the grade. Lied about what would be on exams when asked during office hours. Claimed exams were application-based when a fair amount was definition memorization.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Axtell was OK for BIOL322. He's helpful if you go to office hours but the class is pretty bland overall. His exams were probably the most difficult ones I've taken at Penn State so far, but I will say they were fair. Have to know the material through and through to do well on them. Grading scale was brutal - no extra credit.

This professor is one of the worst professors I have ever had. His exams were extremely unfair and everyone I know felt very unprepared going into the exams. He lied about concepts and questions that would be on the exams as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's nice, but this class is very difficult. He gives practice exams, but they're not very similar to the actual exams. The exams are HARD and usually had low averages, but he never cared or gave any extra credit. Overall, this class was fine, but avoid it if possible.

Dr. Axtell did a good job of explaining lecture slides and top hat questions. The homework was manageable but a lot of probability math. His exams were challenging, but there's a practice exam and extra credit assignments. The class requires work, but Dr. Axtell is approachable for help. He might mess up some fractions, but he laughs at himself.

I really like Dr. Axtell! He's very smart and his lectures are pretty interesting. Tophat helps make long classes interactive. The exams are hard!! But if you study and prepare in advance, he gives you the means to succeed. Always open to questions and helping

He can't do fractions. It wasn't once. It's every week. (4/9)=(2/3)?????? bro my guy. 
His exams were so hard to take and he was just okay with a 60 average. He teaches okay. He explains stuff at the very start really nice so I had really high hopes, but towards the end, he just gets confused himself and it often isn't helpful.

Dr. Axtell is a great professor. He is really passionate about what he teaches and is very clear on what you do and do not need to know. The worksheets are sometimes challenging but very helpful for the exams especially since many exam questions come directly from them.

Dr. Axtell is a lot easier than Dr. Waters. He is very dry, but if you pay attention he lets you know all you need to for the tests. The worksheets were horrible, but so many test questions are about the worksheets.

Dr. Axtell is very passionate about his job and his studies. While there is a lot of information to study, do it and attend class, and an A is very possible. His exams aren't that bad... but sometimes focus on little details. Best to know everything. Good professor, and even though he can put you to sleep, he knows what he's talking about. Rec.'d.

Dr. Axtell's half of this course was much more clear than Dr. Waters' half. I am much more interested in humans than plants but I would rather have taken two courses with Dr. Axtell than one with Dr. Waters. Expect all exam questions to be directly from what he presents in class.  Know the diagrams and definitions and you will get a wonderful grade

Axtell is a good professor. He makes boring material interesting.. plants aren't interesting at all. His exams are directly from the notes. Literally memorize and spit it back onto the paper and you'll be fine. Very enthusiastic and energetic which makes for a bright and lively class. Highly recommend.

Axtell loves plants and will go on all day about them. That being said he gives you a false sense of whether you know the material. He doesn't care to help his students much but his tests are 100 percent off his notes.
His lectures were very organized and everything tested was from what was discussed in class.

Dr Axtell does his best to make a subject that doesn't interest many students interesting. He gives you so many opportunities to do well on his exams and if you put forth enough effort, it's not that hard. GO TO LECTURE. It is beyond helpful for his exams. There aren't any surprises on his exams, his ppts give you everything you need.

He was helpful and really tried to make the plant material interesting. The exams were very detailed with a couple of tricky questions each time, but I can guarantee that everything you need to know was mentioned in the lecture. While attendance isn't mandatory, it is definitely important if you want to do well on the exams!

He is okay. I find him to be a very strange person in office hours. He acts like a jerk when you ask questions. I don't think he means to, but I think he has a weird personality which makes it uncomfortable to ask stuff.

He's a nice guy, but it's really hard to make plants interesting. I only came to each class for the clicker points and his lecture notes can be a hard to follow at times. Definitely a wake up call if you're coming straight from bio110!

Lots of homework and quizzes.  De facto mandatory attendence due to the quizzes. Notes are all old school chalkboard. He goes pretty fast and it can be hard to keep up at times, it would be much easier/effective if he'd get with the times and use powerpoint.

His class is by no means easy but he is fair about what he expects you to know and is a fair grader. He is very approachable. My only grievance is that he goes a little overboard on quizzes and homework. If you put in the work you can most definitely get an A.
Really good teacher. Very helpful and accessible outside of class. materials sometimes boring but very relevant if youre a premed major. really liked this class
Not the best.

I really don't have an interest in plants at all, so his monotone voice didn't spark any more interest in the subject.  I only went to class because of clicker points honestly.  He seems like a nice guy just really boring and doesn't show much enthusiasm.  His tests are difficult even though the plant material wasn't that tough.
Really cool person to talk to. Takes a serious interest in helping you learn the material and makes it easy to relate to. Definitely would recommend taking a class with him

A great guy and an awesome teacher. One of the best profs I have had at PSU so far. He does a great job relating the info to the class and keeps in interesting with a few of his awkward jokes that he puts on his slides. Tests are straight forward with little tricks. Study the slides and you should be fine.

idk what the neg comments from the last two pages were about but i thought he was awesome! maybe its bc of the horrid experience from patterson from the first half of the semester. I went from getting F's from patterson to B's from axtell

To avoid confusion, he is the professor for the plant section of the course.  He seems knowledgeable and passionate towards his topic, but lacks social abilities.  When spoken to, he does emit considerable understanding, but also a huge sense of awkwardness.
That is how you write a test.

So maybe he's not the best professor i've ever had, but his section of the class saved me form failure. the plant section was so much easier to understand the the animal section (Dr. Nelson). i barely passed the animal exams and ended up getting a B in the class because of Dr. Axtell. he was a great help.

Dr Axtell absolutely loves plants. It is kind of weird how excited he gets about them at times. He is a good lecturer and explains concepts well, but this is not necessarily a good thing because gives you a false sense that you understand everything, but then he goes ahead and makes difficult test that you would think you knew but actually don't.

This guy is mean. I asked him a question after class and he blew up in my face. He is alot better than the teacher for the animal section of the class when it comes to lecture and love his plants. This class is so difficult you won't believe it. They threw more info at me then I could handle and provided almost no way to learn to except read

Dr. Axtell is a family man, thus should stick to only raising a family and not teaching at a university. His voice sounds like he narrates a children's show on the Disney Channel. Second, his tests are nearly impossible even if you read the book, attend tutoring, attend lectures, ask questions, etc. Extremely useless, unhelpful and inconsiderate

I had a question about the material and waited until after class to ask him about it. There were about 10 other students waiting to talk to him. While I was waiting, a girl asked him a legitimate question. His reply was, "Don't waste my time with questions like that." I decided not to ask my question. Not the worst exams, but effort is required.

Axtell loves plants but his class is very boring. He gets mad easily and it's kind of funny. Virtually puts zero effort in to helping kids succeed (no on line practice tests, hard accessibility). Not so much his fault, but it's a horrible class.
He talks like he's on a nursery-rhyme kids show. It's hard to take him seriously. And he starts every sentence with, "Well it turns out..."

Prof. Karera is knowledgable about her subject, but she struggles to connect to students and make classes engaging. I love the subject matter of phil204 (I am a phil major), but she was very difficult to connect with. Be prepared for her to be a bit abrasive and cold, though she is clearly extremely smart -- I think she prefers graduate students.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very knowledgable, but not a great lecturer -- kind of all over the place. Attendance was mandatory but she cancelled class A LOT. We did not get our first paper (due in late September) back until after Thanksgiving break. She cancelled two of the papers because she took so long to grade them. So, basically our entire grade depended on two papers.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If you actually want to learn something and/or have a professor that cares about teaching, do not take her course. She canceled class constantly but grades our attendance for every class. She canceled two of the papers and now our ENTIRE grade is based on two papers. We did not receive a single grade until after Thanksgiving and she still gave Bs.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: If you want an A you should probably speak up in class. I think she was easier on grading my papers because I spoke up and participated a lot.  Never miss a Friday. 6 two page papers due and 1 five page do at home final. I had to read a lot to do my papers. She tries her best to make things clear and helps in office hours.

Not exactly an "easy A" but not very hard at all. I enjoyed it! Professor Karera is very intelligent and knows what she's talking about. She's a very cultured person and she's also pretty funny and personable! For the response papers: they DON'T have to be long! Just explain your opinions, not things from the readings. Final exam is take home!

Not an easy class but the best class I have taken at Penn State. If you do the readings, go to class, and engage, you can easily succeed. The hardest (and at times) most frustrating class I've taken, but a class that makes you a truly more intelligent student and person. Makes you a thinker. 100% would recommend.

Took attendance but missed several classes due to "emergencies", wasn't clear on material to be on the exams, and just overall didn't seem to know what she was doing. Lectures are pointless (just a summary of material that was supposed to be read) although if you do go to class then the textbook is pointless. Wouldnt recommend.

Multiple choice on tests are vague and confusing. Everyone did poorly on the first test. "Best answer" deal instead of correct answer. Lots of reading assigned but no real incentive to do it. Passionate about subject and into students who show likewise. Response papers easy As if thought out. This is a politics class so racereligiongender etc fyi

Not a fan of her teaching style. Requires you to go to class for, in my opinion, pointless lectures. She doesn't give much direction on exams or what the response papers are supposed to be like. Most of the class failed the first exam, although she did give a small "curve". Shows up a couple min late to multiple classes and then has an attnd policy

Hilariously awful professor. I'm honestly not sure she is qualified to be be teaching students. The material isn't bad and the class wasn't that difficult, but Axelle is probably the worst professor I've had at Penn State.

Great professor. Attendance is worth 5% of grade. Quizzes in class every Friday. This was my second time taking 405, so I was nervous, but I had a much better experience with Dr. Aybat. His exams are very manageable, he's available outside of class, and his TAs are great. If you can, take this course with Dr. Aybat.
He is a great professor and great guy. Exams are difficult but pretty manageable. He lets you use a cheat sheet which is really helpful. His teaching methods are solid

I can't recommend strongly enough to avoid this professor. 

Out of dozens of courses I have taken over my 7 years of undergrad and graduate, this was the absolute worst experience I ever had. 

He does not post lecture notes. Assigned work is needlessly difficult and irrelevant to course objectives.
Not recommended for so many reasons.

A math class where you'll be stating theorems, doing math derivations & proving them daily, even for EXAM. No numerical problems, more like a theoretical math class. Need to know Linear algebra & real analysis and be comfortable with theoretical proofs and derivations. Browse the book in the syllabus to get an idea of what to expect.

Horrible. One of the worst profs and classes I have EVER taken. He is rude and condescending. If you don't have the background and asks what he thinks are "stupid questions", he passes demeaning comments. The material is so theoretical with little application based problems. Your grade is dependent only on 3 tests which makes it so easy to F up.

You do well in class if 1. Already taken this class 2. Good math proof skills and a subset of linear algebra (math 220 not sufficient) Prof said IE 405 not needed, incorrect. If you are #2, take a different class. You can learn all the material over a few weekends. Slow lectures. Confusing explanations.
Brutal class and brutal professor. There is no right way to prepare for exams.

Not recommended, unless you have to. The "lecture" is very similar, almost to a replication of the main book reference. No problems/computational applications are discussed and after a full semester of course the prof were not able to teach us any optimization at all, only general proofs available in the book. Exams much harder than expected.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He couldn't care less. Hw's were assigned, but never graded and solutions were incomplete. Board is a copypaste from book, so you can skip classes if you want. Often late for class. Gets angry when nobody answers his questions. Final was a surprise, probably forgot to write an exam and printed an old version he found in his pc 10 m before ex time
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Pretty solid professor grading wise, lectures are hard to understand though. Quizzes every week make up for a third of the final grade, they aren't hard, but easy to overlook. Advice would be to watch Youtube videos on the topics to see other methods on the same process.

Necdet is a nice guy, but his lectures were often a bit difficult to follow. He often uses a lot of technical jargon that can be hard to follow. The material covered is not super difficult, but exams were graded very tough, and it is difficult to receive an A. Best of luck with this one!
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--GROUP PROJECTS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Great professor, class is sort of tough. No mandatory homework. Quizzes are on Thursdays and worth 25%, he drops one. Show up to lectures and look at the hw solutions and quizzes shouldn't be a problem. Allows cheat sheets on exams so those aren't too bad. 1 group project at the end of semester. Final is hard. Overall a good professor
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He's a very nice guy and a great teacher, very knowledgable and also approachable. Go to his office hours, he is helpful and understanding.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: For those who don't have a good background in math analysis, his lectures are difficult. However, you can learn a lot from him if you care for what you study. He is generous in giving good grades.
Very helpful during class time & OH

Aydin is a great professor with so much expertise to offer. Class structure is straightforward: hour-long lecture each day followed by a group activity, six case reports and/or presentations, and a few reading assignments. The material is both interesting and applicable to the field of SCM. Attendance is mandatory, but I enjoyed going to class!
Really great professor who actually teaches. Groupwork heavy class but no exams. Would recommend taking him.

Best professor for SCM 450W. The content is extremely useful as it is real-world supply chain scenarios. If you want to do well, you must participate in class, but it will help you learn. No quizzes/tests... just 6 group cases and occasional readings. I would recommend Professor Aydin to every SCM student who needs to take this course.

I absolutely loved 450 with Aydin. He's very thoughtful & receptive to student feedback! This was one of my only SCM classes that actually felt applicable to the industries, too, probably because it's case-based. The main takeaway is choose a good group as you'll work with them ALL semester. Attendance is "mandatory" but flexible, just participate.

Math 230 is pretty difficult, but he makes it fine. He posts his notes weekly, so attendance isn't technically mandatory. Sometimes can be confusing with due dates, but is very understanding and takes feedback from class. We've only had one quiz and it was take home. Is accessible in office hours, and goes slow enough in class to keep good notes.

This man was awesome. The homework was long, but he was always willing to give the class an extension when necessary. His quizzes were just a way to force us to study, and easy points. The exams were fair, and he is an easy grader. He's also always willing to meet with students and answer questions whenever. He is a kind soul and great professor.
Class is very lecture heavy with lots and lots of homework. The homework deadlines often change with little notice. Exam grading is lenient, but seems arbitrary at times and no feedback is left.

He sounds like he would rather be anywhere else than giving his lecture. Like seriously miserable. It was so hard to listen to. Also doesn't offer makeup exams for any reason. Class was stupid easy though it was literally just high school chem

If you have to take Chem 112, be sure to opt for a different professor. Dr. Sen is a nice man, but his teaching style is extremely outdated and difficult to follow. The lecture slides aren't bad, but his teaching is scattered and unclear. The class did so bad overall that he did give a nice curve, though.

Worst professor. He is such a nice guy but class was SUCH a drag. I had to force myself to go to class because I knew I wouldn't learn if I didn't. But even when I did go to class, he never taught me anything. He doesn't even know what he's teaching sometimes. Do yourself a favor and don't take him. He doesn't care one bit about his students.

I was forced to take this class and having Dr. Sen made it worse. He is not a good teacher and I found myself confused a lot in this class. He is a nice guy, but I do not recommend him as a professor. He does not want to be there and it shows. He does not explain concepts well and does not care about his students.
no homework just weekly quizzes but be sure to keep up with information for exams
He is very monotonous and is not clear when explaining topics.

The tests were impossible. The class was curved so much because no one was doing well. Sen is not a good teacher, he is difficult to understand and he is extremely boring and does not explain things well.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I was not very crazy about Dr. Sen. He was very monotone during lecture and was hard to follow. He also does not make his own slides and seemed like he didnt care. Exams are tough and are worth 80% of the grade, but the class got curved at the end. TA office hours, LA sessions, and reading the e-book/ doing the homework (not mandatory) are a must.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: While he is a decent lecturer, he had a bunch of extra credit up on his page that was for another class. I had to show him his canvas page in office hours for him to even realize that it was there. I dropped the class, but I'm sure that some people stayed in because they thought the litany of extra credit that he had posted would save them....

not a good professor at all. made me dislike chem 100x more than I already did after taking chem110. closes the clicker literally after 2 seconds and if you bomb one exam there's no coming back from it. Practice exams kinda help but not really.
Every morning I woke up for this class disappointed I survived the night. The reason I am switching my major out of chem.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Horrible professor! I work really hard at chem because it is a naturally challenging subject for me. He gets problems wrong during lecture and is corrected by students. He never says when he's about to close a clicker which is ANNOYING. Only reason I passed was because of Lion Tutors & only went to lecture for clicker points towards the end of sem

Dr. Sen is a really nice guy, but Penn State didn't hire him to teach Gen Chem. He's a very smart guy but not really a teacher. His lectures are very boring and do not give any insight that you can't find in the Gen Chem e-book. CHEM 112 is not a difficult class, just do all the readings and you'll be fine.
This guy is so bad at lecturing its unbelievable. He made this class way harder than it needs to be, and barely knows how to teach it.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I liked Dr. Sen a lot. He has the ability to make dense material a bit more palatable. I probably didn't make it through this class since I find chemistry to be quite a difficult subject, but I know that it was really not his fault that I couldn't make it through. He takes you through examples step by step during the lecture, which is helpful, too.

I think I did ok in this class, it's not because of the professor. 1. if you are looking for a professor with passion, don't take his class. 2. if you want to get a clear explanation or clarification of some hw problems or practice problems, don't take his class(He didn't know what he was explaining. only can explain thing with his prepared notes

Chem 112 is just a challenging class, but if you have to take it, I think Sen is a good choice. All prof's for this class grade based off of the same rubric, but he makes class interesting, and makes it not so miserable. Study using the practice exams, they are very helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Our class seemed to get gradually taken over by the head TA in the last few weeks of the semester, so near the end we barely saw Professor Sen. However, he explains problems clearly and does his best to make some dense material interesting.

Sen really knows his stuff and is a really nice guy. The class is essentially run by an admin (not Sen) and they make the tests very tough. Do practice tests. Sen's quality of teaching seemed to decline as the semester went on and didn't show up for the last few weeks. His sweater vest game is on point.

I actually really enjoyed this class. Dr. Sen tries to make it as interesting as he can, incorporates clicker questions and example problems into his lectures, and tries to keep them as focused as possible. This isn't meant to be an easy class, but work hard and use the resources given to you and an A is definitely within your reach!

He is not very good at explaining. CHEM 112 is a difficult class already, and his lectures were not terribly lucid. He is a nice man, he knows his stuff, and he genuinely cares about his students, but he's just not that great of a teacher. He never actually finishes problems in class, which is frustrating. Not awful, but take w someone else
Barely passed Chem 110 and got an A in Chem 112 because of him. His lectures just make sense

Ayusman was the man. Funny guy, he has a good attitude when he's teaching. He makes lectures tolerable.  Unfortunately, however; clickers make attendance mandatory. Chem 112 overall is a hard class, but if you do enough practice exams you can get the hang of it.  Lion tutors helps, and the HW packet problems too. argyle sweater vest every day too
Sen is the man! Best option for 112 no matter what time.
Great teacher with a great attitude! Expplains things very well.

Worst professor ever. SOOOOO boring. Can literally put you to sleep. All he uses are pronouns. This, that, this, that, it. So confusing. I do not recommend him at all. Only positive thing about Dr. Sen is that he puts his notes online so you don't have to hear him put you to sleep. Reads right off the power points. Worst/Most boring teach at PSU.

If you are looking to blindly learn and mechanically solve problems, he is perfect, but if you want to learn about the subject in detail and understand what you are working on, he is not the right choice.

I didn't find him to be a great lecturer. However, the textbook for Chem 112 is really good and if you don't want to go to lecture just read it and do the packet problems. That's really all you need to do to do well in the class.
The best CHEM 112 instructor at Penn State. To the Point. Solves a lot of problems in class. He is in LOVE with liquid nitrogen. Tough luck, his experiments always are disastrous though. :(

Ayusman is the man, but I didn't think he was such a great lecturer. BUY the pink packet and do ALL of the problems. READ the textbook, believe me, it helps so much more than lecture. Past exams are a must. Go to the reviews for past exams and study with friends.

Sen is a very amusing, comical, and witty guy. Attendance isn't mandatory, but helps. He actually knows how to control and teach an entire lecture hall, and does a very good job at it. Always in a dress shirt with brown pants, and ready to teach!
Sen is irresistible as a professor. He's clever and witty and overall amusing. If you don't hate Chem, it's a really enjoyable lecture. Looking into the book is highly recommended.

Sen knows what he's talking about but is sometimes hard to understand. He mumbles and sometimes his accent can throw you off. Nice guy and can be funny. The class isn't too hard, but you will need to study much more than you did for 110.
First prof I have had at PSU that taught well in a large lecture hall. I looked forward to his lectures. Knows his way around a fresh button down/vest combo too! Hell of a man

He is a great professor. Gets through material in a timely manner so there is usually at least 2 classes before each exam to review material in class. He goes over questions that are on the exams and keeps class light with his humor. With that said, I still suggest reading the book to make sure you understand the material because it is difficult.

Awesome class with awesome professor, what can be better than this?:) He is funny, easy, & tell you what's on the exam! I got all hundreds for my exams. The semester before this I had Benesi, he was horrible, wasn't helpful at all. Dr. Sen failed in demo sometimes, but it's funny & he admitted it. Katlin Haas and Matt Langston best TA ever for 112!
I dont really like him as a teacher. If you go to him he isn't helpful at all.

Sen may be the coolest teacher I have ever had.  He is teh sweet.  Chem 12 was possibly the most useless class I ever took and my outlook for Chem 13 was not much better.  Sen made coming to class worth it.  This is basic chem people... its pathetic stuff.  Class was curved to hell but that is the chem depart. way of testing

When I took it the Fall of my freshmen year the Cutoff for a C was a 58, thats how bad the class was doing. On the final I accidentally skipped the last 4 questions on the back page and I emailed Sen right after the test when I realized this and he never responded. I ended up with a 57.02 avg and he would not help me. I had to retake the course.
Makes an awful class worthwhile.
He's funny, but the class is hard.
great teacher, although the tests are habitually erroneous and i dont think he ever makes them himself based on the covered material. its funny when he curses

Sen is the man! He makes this impossibly hard class as fun as possible. The material is very hard so do the homework and go to class. (I got a 95 in chem12 and an 80 in chem 13) The curve was HUGE for this class.
He Rocks!! His class was good enough to get me out of bed in teh morning. He has a weird sence of humor but you can't help but laugh.... take this class
Very smart and funny man.

Very good teacher. He made every lecture clear and was very funny- it made 10:00 am chem not so boring. i thought his tests were fair- most of the problems came from practice exams. watch out for the final, it tripped me up at the end.
Loves his job and it shows. Sen makes a notouriously difficult class a lot less stressful through humor and clear lectures
He is the best chemistry teacher I've ever had.  He keeps it interesting with lots of demos.  It's a hard class but everyone does bad so you get a curve.  If you can get him as a lecturer, do it.

Sen is great.  At first glance he looks like a really boring person, but he's surprisingly funny.  And to whoever said he was absent minded and not a good teacher...um...I don't know...maybe you're just an idiot?
Sen is the man. His lectures are clear, concise, and they always end early. He's funny; I can't remember a time I didn't laugh during class, and the grades all get curved up at end of the year.
I'll admit he's a funny guy. But he's only funny cuz he is absent minded. And that doesn't make for a good teacher. Trust me. But the other chem 13 prof is just as bad, sorry to say.
easy to understand, very organized, explains concepts well, answers all questions in review lectures

this is the second time i took this course.. hands down one of the best teachers i have had i learned more on the first day with him then the whole semester with the other teacher.. fun as hell too (lets make some explosions) man he loves fire
he actually makes chemistry fun, unlike all the other chem profs

Funny Guy. Class is always entertaining. The best was when he used a dirty test tube which inadvertenly started bubbling and smoking. He said, calm as ever, "I'm not going anywhere near that thing" RECOMMENDED
the guy is pretty funny, much better than the other chem 13 professor. he's a good teacher and is fair with grades
No Comments
He's a pretty entertaining guy (for chemistry).  He's very straightforward, and he knows his stuff.  He's one of the better chem profs, and his grading scale is more than fair.

Hes excellent at explaining problems that are similar to the exams questions, but he is a very tough grader and doesnt curve. Hes tough to deal with when discussing grades. Group HW will depend on coding and consumes a lot of time and effort with little to non help offered. Overall, he acts like hes on the students side, but hes far from it.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Best professor in PNG department, hands down! He is so nice, he appreciates hard work, he explains everything and if you take notes, you'll do well. The course is heavy, but he made it fun and he is so helpful. I just respect him so much.
Arrogant Prof, Talks too much useless things (Theoretical Proof which is useless)
The best professor in the Petroleum department. Really cares about his students and loves teaching
The course homework and projects are difficult and time-consuming but they are not very innovative and challenging.

Dr. Ayala is very good at explaining material and is always willing to help. Going to class will help you immensely. Exams are excruciatingly difficult. Does not curve or round grades, but he gives a lot of extra credit.  Overall a great professor, just very difficult exams & a strict grading policy.

Dr. Ayala is probably the greatest PNGE instructor on campus.  He expects his students to truly understand the material, not just how to do cookie cutter engineering problems, so don't expect exam to be replicas of the homework assignments. Do the basically unlimited extra credit and the group project and you will get an A.
Ayala is the best and most effective professor I have had in college.  He expects a lot, but if you devote time to this class, he will make sure you succeed. Phenomenal guy overall as well.

This guy rocks. He is one of those professors that demand a lot from his students, but gives them the tools to succeed. Clearly not easy classes, but you'll learn so much if you have him as a professor and devote the required level of interest. I highly recommend him.
Not approachable, serious temperament issues and don't like international student.
Best
Easy class..................No. A very good class. Must take.

Overall the course itself is extremely difficult and requires much time spent outside of the class in order to succeed. With that in mind, Dr. Yener is a great person and lecturer that enables the understanding of the fundamentals. The course is rigorous, however, Dr. Yener is always willing to help her students out every step along the way.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Excellent teacher, most fun I ever had taking an exam even though she doesn't make them easy... Great interactive lectures, good math background.

She is a good prof, and explanations are very accurate. BUT exams are terrible. She gives you only hour and 15 minutes, but to solve all of the questions you at least need 2 hours. Hope she will curve.

This faculty has no common sense as if she was never a student herself. She, in a way, competes with the student rather than trying to be helpful. She shows a lack of capacity for someone who teaches others on information theory capacity. She should try to practice what she preaches. Avoid!

I was misled by the 1 rating on this page as to how helpful Dr. Yener is. This professor is useless during office hours and will not help you, not even to go over material taught in class that day :( Her exams are extremely hard and not well laid out as her point-assignment is ridiculous. On Test 2 we had to show lots of work for 5 points.Stay away

When I took this, she handed out notes for you that contain everything you need to know.  This prof is clear and helpful, but also expects you to already know the prerequisite material for this class clearly, which makes sense for a grad level course.

She is  fair, caring, and understanding.  As long as you participate and show that you are working hard she will make sure to help you out if you need it.  She reply's to questions quickly. I would take her again for sure.  Great professor.
She definitely expects a lot from her students, but for me that's what makes a good class. Can be harsh grading, but helped me improve. Thinking of minoring in philosophy now.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Very sarcastic. She expects you to know everything. The course was okay, but bad professor.
Definitely helpful and passionate professor. Covers a lot of information so the pace can be difficult.

Overall, the class was pretty easy. She is a bit confusing and seems to sometimes confuse herself at times, which definitely makes things frustrating. She uses test examples straight from the textbook so practice those and you'll do fine. Make sure to stay on top of your homework and grades because she seems to misplace things often.
Sometimes she gets herself confused, but overall, she is nice and willing to help students as best as she can.

Worst prof in the EE major. All his notes are on power point all copied straight out of the book, speaks so slow u will fall asleep. If u ask a question, he will make fun of u big time. Go to his office hours and ask question and he wont answer a single one. I dont think he even know the answers to the questions he gives u for practice tests
Monotone, takes notes straight from the book, got a walrus mustache and is a terrible test grader...only good part about class is when he owns kids when they ask dumb questions
He is an awful teacher.  He obviously didn't want to teach the class or be there so he just rambled off of powerpoints that he took directly from the book. He graded tests really harshly, too.

Downright awful lecturer. Another great example of the EE department's neglect of the undergraduate. Not only does he not care about his lectures, he actually shows it. All his notes are out of the book and he doesn't hold office hours well. Typical graduate advisor snob.

This is the worst EE professor I've had at Penn State. Lectures are almost completely useless. He pretty much just points at the board and the equations and expects you to know what he's talking about. He goes through examples lightning fast and you never have enough time to copy them down Do not take his classes. Period.

This man must have tenure or something because he really put no effort in lectures.  He communicates very poorly, and he really isn't very pleasant when you go to his office hours.  On the final I don't think he really taught half the stuff he put on it.  Just read the book, cause its pretty good.
Avoid this guy.  He's lousy.  Not able to properly communicate.
No Comments
No Comments
Don't know any real world applications.
Good Teacher, has a tremendous knowledge in his area but cant distribute it well
good speaking skills, easy homework
One of the best 330 teachers

Azeta is a gem. She really inspired me to continue doing Journalism. She does stand and lecture for a majority of the class but is really good at making sure students understand. She is always available outside of class and genuinely cares about her students. Azeta is my fav teacher I've had at Emerson so far. I really hope I get have her again.

Prof Hatef is a wonderful instructor. She expects students to apply critical thinking to essays and discussions, and will reward hard work with good grades. If you are struggling, ask for help. Hatef is receptive and great to work with. One of the standout courses during my four years at PSU. Highly respected in the field for good reason.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Azeta is awesome! She really knows how to make a class very interesting. Attendance is mandatory and the notes are only given in class. Many opportunities to get a good grade. The midterm wasn't too bad as long as you carefully studied the notes. Response papers are straightforward. Final paper is difficult but not impossible. Would recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--SO MANY PAPERS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Azeta is one of the coolest  professors I've had at Penn State. Her lectures are really interesting and you have to go to class to get the notes, but it's not a problem because I always wanted to go. The exam she gives is fairly easy if you study your notes and the work load isn't too much! Final paper is difficult but manageable
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Ranjbar was an AMAZING prof for my Geog of Intern'l Development class. Her lectures were so engaging, insightful, and each class was unique. The class was pretty big yet she worked to get everyone involved and thinking critically. I learned more in this class than in many of my classes combined. She is so smart and understanding toward students

She is an amazing and passionate professor. she's also very very smart so well respected. the course could have been boring but she made it better. the class is basically readings and class discussions with a few lectures here and there. theres also only one final exam thats a paper, a group project, then response papers. very easy to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Inspirational--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Azita was amazing, this course could have been much more boring with a different prof. She's insanely brilliant and driven, but so caring and understanding at the same time. She read pushes each student to be their best. She cares about the students, want to help and is all ears if you need to talk or have questions. HAVE TO TAKE A CLASS WITH AZITA
She shows how what you do in class will matter in your career, which is important. She also answers questions thoroughly, but doesn't give any kind of practice exams.

Dr, Lintereur cares about her students and wants them to understand the why in all concepts. Her homeworks are not a waste of time, and the concepts carry over to exams. Exams arent easy, but doable if you understand the material. She is always available to help and the book isnt needed but is a good resource to have

Dr. Lintereur was by far one of the most passionate professors I've had. Her lectures are always interesting and the homework always comes back with great feedback. The class itself can be difficult, but professor Lintereur was a big help with review sessions and answering questions during class.

Without a doubt the worst teacher I've ever had and the hardest class I've ever taken. She finds a way to demean you while still smiling and playing it off as if she did nothing wrong. She also blamed us for having to give us exams. The exams are insanely hard and I would've failed if our entire class handed banded together to make study guides.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Tests are tough--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She assigns about 60 pages of reading for each class. It's all from 1985 or earlier. her tests are all about making you memorize names and random facts from her slides. 4 tests and a paper. the worst
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: explains things wayy to deeply when it could be explained in such simpler terms. missed 1 class and fell so behind. Slow teacher, doesnt catch attention. Expects you to know wayy too much
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Easily the hardest class I've ever taken, and no I didn't slack off. There's a ridiculous amount of reading/studying required. I'm a good student but this class was a struggle. Her expectations are crazy high and I felt like I was already in a graduate level course. Good luck.

This class is not impossible but it will make your whole semester extremely stressful. The tests cover a lot of material. Dr. Azar is understanding and helpful but the class is still very difficult. Do not take this class unless you are able to commit to hours and hours of reading and studying per week.

Respect her as an individual but not as a teacher. Exams are all short and long essays but she gives you a study guide a week ahead. She expects you to know  a lot of information in great detail. I was told I correctly answered the questions I just need more detail and still failed the class. Grading not practical for an undergrad class.

Dr. Azar knows them matierial inside and out. Its obvious she's had a lot of experience working with families and marriage counseling. Unfortunately she does not effectively pass this knowledge to her students. Very picky with descriptions on her essays- to the point where I felt the exams were not reflective to what I had learned.
If you show interest in doing well, complete the readings on ANGEL, it is a really easy A for Senior Seminar!

Not helpful AT ALL. Only speaks of her point of view ans don't try to tell her that she may be wrong, she will doc your grade for it. Very intelligent but needs counseling herself for her obviously unhappy marriage. Please seek help AZAR, bitterness is a nasty taste. That is what she will leave in your mouth after that class.

Her lectures are extremely boring and the exams have nothing to do with what we talk about in class. Very opinionated person and god help you if you aren't planning on going to grad school. Exams are easy if you just review the study guide and regurgitate it word for word. Awful class.
I learned the most from this class out of any class i have ever taken in my almost 15 years of schooling. Her essay tests are hard, yes, but you will actually learn very useful stuff from Dr. Azar.
Self centered and is absorbed in her personal views.  Very ethnocentric.  Wouldn't waste your time if you want a well rounded education/discussion in class.

This class is difficult, it takes some preparing for class and about two days of studying, tests are difficult but all questions for test are provided ahead of time. Although class is difficult, she is probably one of the only intelligent professor with actual experience at psu. If you give her a try she will be very helpful.

Has a lot of experience, professionally and personally in working with children, especially form poverty. Good content and lecture, but she ends up being so preachy about it that it's a chore to come to class. Tests are all essay, and are very difficult. If you can stand the constant (and unnecessary) guilt trip, it's a good content course.

shes awful her tests are awful she is the worst grader ever and you would think she would have some compassion from what shes been through in her but she doesnt shes horrible do not take this class with this awful woman!!!

One of the hardest I've ever had.  She needs to go back to Harvard cause that's where she belongs...not among people who like to have fun outside of class.  Way too demanding for Penn State test takers.
very interested in self, no interest in others.
horrible. absolutely awful.

I had always been an A student.  When I went to talk to her because I had received scores in the 60s on two of her exams she said she wasn't worried because other people were getting 20s.  I made it out ok because of the final paper and last two tests, but she was by far one of the least helpful professors I have ever had.
I thought she was a great professor and I loved the class. Her exams can be detailed but as long as you do the review before hand you'll be fine
I hate this class. She is a horrible teacher. If half the students in your class fail a test maybe you should take that as a hint that you SUCK at teaching.

this is the worse class ever! she is the worst prof i have ever had in my life. wtf was PSU thinking? she is a **** and doesnt care about her students at all! she goes out of town all the time, especially 2-3 days before her exams so we are forced to go the TA for help, and of course our TA knows nothing about our class! Her exams are impossible!!

She made me read her grant proposal that was 30 pages and double check every citation (at least 20 or 30 a page) and then she was pissed when it took me hours.She's not helpful at all, and she's VERY rude. Basically, she sucks. Don't take her.
No Comments
Very very very difficult exams!
No Comments

Mental Health in Schools.  Azar lectures VERY VERY fast through overheads and students are expected to copy it all down and pull tiny details for essay exams.  3 long essay and 4 short answer are hell to get done in 75 min.  STAY AWAY!!!!!!!!

Even though it was only a first year seminar, he was awesome to have. I know of other class that had to do huge time-consuming projects, while his classes only had to do a couple easy projects. He also canceled class a ton and we did not have to go to class the last 3 weeks of the scheduled length. Definitely take him for first year seminar!
take this seminar there are only 3 short assignments
This guy is terrible!  Avoid his seminar!

Had him for my frehsman seminar.  Three assignmnets all semester that make up 90% of your grade, but they are not really hard.  A lot of the time you just have a geust speaker, so it wasn't a bad class.  He's also a good person to talk to about your plans for the future, since he will take the time to talk.

He is very nice, however the class is boring.  You aren't really going to learn anything in this class.  There are only 3 assignments all semester and they are long assignments that take far too much time for a one credit class. He is willing to help in any problems you have though which is good.
I had him for a freshman****ar, so the class was easy and laid back. I can't really comment on him as a chem engr professor, but to me he seemed pretty cool.
No Comments

I took his CAS100A class over the summer, and honestly, it was not bad.  DJ is an interesting guy and a decent teacher. Just show up to class, do what you have to, and pay attention to his rubric.  Easy A if you just put in work.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: DJ is a very cynical person, and he loudly proclaims it often. His tests are highly specific, resulting in needing in-depth knowledge of theories and terms. He is lazy as well, taking very long to grade assignments due a month ago. His tests are intensive and depending on the section will have material not covered on them all in all do not have him
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The class is as hard as you make it. If you show up, put effort into the speeches, and pay attention, you'll do fine. He's clear in what he wants to hear in the speeches and exams aren't tricky. He's kind of awkward, but wants you to do well. Go to office hours if you need help, it'll do wonders.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: As long as you pay attention in class you'll do great. He tells you what's expected on the exam and doesn't pull any tricks. The speeches aren't too hard, but you're obviously going to have to put some work into this class, just not as much as a STEM class for sure. He assigns a fair amount of work but I never found myself overwhelmed. Great prof!

Professor DJ graded speeches pretty fair. GO TO OFFICE HOURS FOR HELP!! He does a great job at pointing his students in the right direction. The only complaint I had is he preached inclusivity in the classroom, but if you arent a liberal then it wont be a fun class for you.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: DJ is a good guy and grades relatively fairly if you put in the effort. Id recommend going to office hours before speeches. This class isnt easy and required work but you get what you put in. His tests are pretty tough though.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Mr. Barger or "DJ" as people call him is very picky about speeches. He is a tough grader and WILL pick out any flaws (he's a hypocrite). He does give good feedback before speeches though, so be sure to see him to review what your plan is. His reading quizes are pop-up, so be prepared. The good news though is that they are only 5 points each.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Prepare for a hard work.
He was perfect in my opinion, his accent you get used too. Just attend lecture, do written homework, do LA worksheet before exams and quizzes, you'll get A.

I'm one of his TAs, and I'm glad I'm not his student. I often find myself having to teach students about concepts entirely because his accent is so thick. He isn't a mean person and will help if you ask. Attendance is not taken and he doesn't get to know students. The workload is standardized across all 141 sections. Not first pick but is ok.

Overall good guy, very enthusiastic and ready to teach. His accent can be a little hard to understand but manageable. He gives out a fair amount of homework so be ready for that. Very helpful and available. If you show up and pay attention you should be able to do fine.

Bang was an awesome professor, would recommend. His teaching is very clear and concise, all the problems in class are exam type problems. 

We had a textbook for online homework, but it wasn't used to actually teach. If you show up to class you'll be fine.

Bang is a legend, while yes he has a slight accent, he navigates it very well and always makes sure its clear what he is saying. He always answers every question with a smile and is great at accepting if he made a small error on the board. Definitely go to the LA sessions as they help for extra practice and give you credit towards some quiz grades.

Mr. Bang is a caring, passionate teacher, that really wants you to understand the material. His accent was hard for me to understand at times, but you do get used to it after a while. My biggest recommendation is to annotate his slides rather than trying to write everything out on paper, since you won't be abletolistenandwritethatmuchatthesametime.

Professor Bang was awesome. His accent is not an issue at all and by the second week you will not even notice. He is so enthusiastic it makes you want to work hard and do well in his class. His lectures are very clear and he is always making sure we understand before moving on. I would highly recommend!
He's the goat

He has a great personality, but his thick accent and teaching style are not suitable for me. Even though I took Calc in high school, his quizzes are extremely difficult. No matter how much I study—written homework, LA sessions, LionTutors, and his slides—I still score low. I do NOT recommend.

Dr. Bang is an excellent professor, while his course is challenging, he is always accessible through office hours and via email. Dr. Bang always seems like he wants to help, but you need to step up and ask the questions. His lectures move fast, but they are always very clear. Just make sure you go to class and let him know when you cannot make it.
Great professor

I took the summer session 6-week Math 140 with Professor Bang. I took a college prep calc class in high school. He went very quick through the material and didn't explain very well. I had asked for help because I wasn't doing good and he told me to change the way I was studying. He would write 20+ formulas on the board and told us to memorize them.

Dropped the class not because it was hard or he was bad. Just already had the high school credit and my adviser for whatever reason told me to take it again. For the time I had him, his accent seemed like you were gonna get stuck with a bad professor but give it a second and you'll see he's great at his job. Go to the classes and pay attention.

Bang has a noticeable accent, but you get used to it very quickly, and he gets his message across even if you can't understand every word. Amazing lectures, he is an extremely effective teacher. 1 quiz a week, 3 exams + final. No quizzes on exam weeks. For every exam period, going to enough LA sessions will replace lowest quiz score with 100.

Don't be scared off by the accent, he's the goat. Seems like he's been teaching math for a long time because he really knows the content. He's also energetic and wants you to pick up whatever he's putting down in class, so ask him questions because he'll be happy to answer.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Bang is one of the kindest and most understanding professors. He genuinely cares about his students & goes out of his way to support them. It's disappointing to see negative ratings that seem more rooted in bias than in his actual teaching. He deserves to be recognized for the respect and kindness he shows to everyone. Take his class!!
He is a great teacher, take him.
Made me hate university
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Definitely takes some time to get used to the accent, but Professor Bang was very good at breaking down the concepts and making them easy to understand. He didn't overcomplicate things and was open to questions during/after class. Would definitely recommend taking him for Math 140. Keep in mind when choosing a prof workload will be the same.
I couldn't understand his thick heavy accent.

Dr. Bang clearly knows what he's doing. You can tell he's taught this class thousands of times. He's extremely energetic and enthusiastic about math, which makes me excited to go to class. Yes, he has an accent, but after 30 mins, it should be easy to understand. If not, maybe consider switching because this class moves FAST !

Professor Bang's lectures are clear, and he provides ample examples to help understand the concepts. While the class can be challenging, using resources like Unstuckstudy alongside the textbook can make it manageable. Definitely worth taking.

Loved this class. No notes.
You'll be lucky to get Professor Bang for your first math class at Penn State. He's not easy by any means but he's a great transition into college classes and teaches at a good pace.

Math 140 is difficult regardless but his heavy accent and his teaching style did not help me. He would not give clear answers when emailing and confused me more than helped. His lectures take place with digital notes rather than a chalkboard/ white board so if you do not learn well with pre-written notes: DON'T TAKE!

He has an accent, but it is understandable. He puts a lot of effort into explaining the material, and if you listen carefully, you will achieve a good grade. He is highly passionate about his subject.

This was by far the worst experience I have ever had with a teacher. He does not care about his students at all and does not teach the information in a way that is possible to actually learn it. I went to every class and took calc in high school and I understood nothing. Definitely do not take him.
I couldn't understand him had to late drop because I never took calc in high school.
Boring and hard to understand. Thick accent

Dr. Bang was a great professor for a bad class. The class is structed to be exam heavy but all Math 140 sections are like that. The material isn't super hard especially if you took Calc in high school. Nice guy who will always answer your questions.

Dr. Bang was an incredible prof. his lectures were easy to follow and hw wasn't too difficult to understand. he gave good feedback with quizzes and although the quizzes are pretty hard, with everything extra to do and dropping 3 quizzes, it isn't hard to succeed in this class

Dr. Bang is a great professor; he is a little hard to understand, but you get used to it. MATH 140, however, is the worst class at Penn State. I took AP Calc in HS and passed the Exam. I still struggled in this class, even with hours of studying. The number of trick questions and obscure formulas is almost laughable. I highly recommend Bang.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The absolute best g I have ever met at uniPark. Straight to the point lectures that are easy to understand. Made the class fly by easily. I miss having professors like Bang teaching me. Hope to get more people like him teaching at Penn State.
The best thing about prof Bang is his lecture slides. Easy to understand, recorded lecture to rewatch is also very great.

Although he has a strong accent, he does a very great job teaching this course. I always learn the material easily from his lectures. If you have a question he will give you a meaningful answer. He is also very nice and can be entertaining.
He has a very strong accent but he covers the topics thoroughly and will answer any questions you have.
His class is relatively simple, but his lectures are passionate and he is very knowledgable. He seems like a genuinely nice person and I would definitely recommend him for this course.

Professor Bang is by far the best math professor I have ever had so far. He explains things really well, record lectures, accessible outside class, and he cares about his students. I love his energy in the class. Sometimes he make laugh.

Absolutely loved this man. He knows how to teach unlike the rest of the Math department. Records classes and post them online with notes incase you miss a lecture or want to review. Man is OP when he hooks up his iPad to the projector. If you need help he is very happy to help you.

I took Dr. Bang for Math 140 as well and I still like his class structure. He records every lecture and gets back to you quickly. I do think he was better for Math 140, but I still enjoy his teaching.
lectures can be hard to understand, but he is incredibly knowledgeable in math and can be really funny
I was worried at first because of a slight language barrier, but he is such a passionate teacher who KNOWS HOW TO TEACH, thank god. I understand each lecture and I actually enjoy going to math

I had Dr. Bang as my math professor for math 140 and I can say I will gladly recommend him. I did take calculus in high school, so concepts came easier to me, but I felt his teaching is very straight forward. Everyday you know what to expect and he's very clear when there is a quiz and what it will be on. He is also just a super genuine sweet guy.
Loved Professor Bang. Great at explaining concepts and class was certainly doable as long as you watched the lectures. Also loved the format of the class, despite asynchronous nature
This professor is a mathematical stud. Very good all-around professor.

I love Dr. Bang! He gave easy lectures and provided many examples. Although attendance isn't required, I highly recommend going. He gave weekly homework which was very tedious but every other math teacher does too. There are quizzes every Friday and he drops two of them. If you understand how to do the quizzes, you should do fine on the exams.
This professor is great talent. Highly recommend attending his lectures.

Bang is the best professor I have had at Penn State. He gives good lectures with lots of example problems. However, he gives little partial credit on his weekly quizzes and exams. He has some funny one liners and can get the entire class laughing every so often. I definitely recommend him as a math professor.

This is a hard class but Prof. Bang is the best! His lectures are very organized and he explains concepts really well. Go to office hours if you have questions because he is very helpful and will make sure you understand the material. Try your best on hw and quizzes because they are easy points. He has a slight accent but you get used to it.

I had him for Calc 1 and 2 and honestly he is my favorite professor at Penn State so far. Go to his office hours or stay after class and the material will make so much more sense. He is really good at explaining and teaching. I definitely recommend

My FAVORITE Professor by far. Super passionate about teaching - incredible explanations and really wants every student to understand. If you pay attention in class you will do well. Definitely taking him again!
other than his English, everything is fine

Honestly one of the best professors at Penn State. Extremely passionate and organized, w/ useful slides. He also is so helpful when it comes to answering your questions. Have stayed behind after class many times to ask him questions and he always gave great explanations. Highly recommend him for 141. 141 itself its a hard class but he makes it cool

Incredible teacher! His accent can be a little difficult to understand at first but It's clear how passionate he is about teaching, just reach out if you have any questions or issues with the material. The course content is made more difficult than needed but that's not his fault. Literally always wears a blue polo and khaki shorts :)

Had professor Bang for math 140 and 141. Truly one of my favorite professors in all of psu. His lectures were extremely organized and well planned out, he was really good at explanations and especially good at showing examples. He also responds fast to emails, office hours are helpful.

Seunghoon Bang is a great guy, helpful, but the language barrier is something to mention- Do not worry, you will get used to his accent quickly. I would take this guy again. He is very intricate in the way he explains things, making sure everyone understands.

Very Great professor! His quizzes are easy if you pay attention in class. The homework is hard but not impossible and is only worth 2 points. However, Penn States Math department isn't the best. Therefore the exams are very different from out practice exams. He doesn't makes the exams so I do not blame him.

Awesome professor that walks through everything with a lot of examples that really help. Most of the exam comes straight from lectures of homework. Only downside is his accent but you figure it out after like 1 week and it's not a problem at all.
He has given me so much hard time for stupid reasons. Embarrassed me in front of the whole class. Would never take it again.

Very hard to understand. During lectures, there were many times when I had no idea what he was saying. Doesn't really explain examples, just goes through the steps without describing where the steps were coming from. Easy to reach out of class and caring. He definitely means well.

TAKE DR. BANG IF YOU GET THE CHANCE! Dr. Bang is one of my favorite professors! He is so precious, and genuinely wants you to succeed. He does have a heavy accent, however, you get used to it. Dr. Bang was easily accessible and understanding despite the class being completely online. Math220 consisted of only 3 exams based off of the MyLabMath HW.

MATH 140 is a hard class to begin with. I took this class on zoom and it was all lecture based. His lecture slides/notes were so vague as compared to homework and exams. Exams were difficult but short. He would explain homework if needed but other than that, not super helpful. If you're not good at math - would not recommend this prof

Math 140 is a very hard class overall. However, Dr. Bang was one of the nicest professors that I have ever had and he is really passionate about what he teaches. He really explained the concepts and made this class not miserable. The exams were hard, but that is expected for this class. I highly recommend taking this professor!
One of the best professors at Penn State

You will get used to his accent rather quickly. His lectures are well made and he explains what he teaches very well. Attendence isn't mandatory, but your success in this class depends on if you attend his lectures! Homework and quizzes aren't bad, but the exams are hard. Complete sample exams, attend office hours, practice, and you'll do fine
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Bang is an excellent professor. He does have an accent, but you'll get used to it quickly. GO TO HIS OFFICE HOURS IF YOU NEED HELP ON HOMEWORK QUESTIONS! His lectures are very detailed and class isn't mandatory. He records all his lectures so you can watch them on your own time.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: His English isn't great so it'll be hard to get passed his accent at first but the class isn't too bad. Either a quiz or test each week (always one or the other). There are weekly written homework and a couple online homework a week. Attendance wasn't mandatory in his ZOOM class so you can watch the recordings whenever. He's always available too.
He is the best
Don't take math 220 with him. Worst professor for this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: He might be hard to understand at times but you will get used to him, he is a very smart teacher who makes learning easier.

He has a heavy accent, but you get used to it after the first week or two. At first, he was bad at pacing his lectures (he had us watch videos to finish material he didn't get to in class), but by the end of the semester he was very on top of his stuff. Very little HW and straightforward quizzes.

I was initially confused a bit by his accent, but Dr. Bang was great for Math220. I got used to him very quickly. The class, in general, is extremely easily as long as you go to class. Take him, you won't regret it. One of the easiest PennState math classes, and Dr. Bang will make it even easier.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: I had him for both 140 and 220 and he is my favorite math teacher I have had thus far. He is very helpful, especially if you go to his office hours! His quizzes are very similar to his examples in notes and take home quizzes are like quizzes. He does have an accent, but you get used to it quickly. I definitely recommend taking his class, he's great
Great guy! Don't think twice just take him! Easy A. He is very helpful and his grading criteria is really nice. All his homeworks are offline and you don't have to spend an extra penny.

I would 10/10 recommend Bang, he's super clear and organized in his lectures and makes it pretty easy to understand. But don't get me wrong like you still have to show up and do his homework. But as long as you do that your pretty golden.

He has an accent but you will get used to it within two weeks. He cares about his students - GO TO OFFICE HOURS they help out so much! There is a take home quiz due each week and then an in class quiz each week as well, just study and stay up with his lectures and notes and you'll be fine
He was alright, the way he taught did not match my learning style but he's a nice guy. If youre good at math youll be fine.

Seunghoon is an amazing professor. Most math professors are a hit or miss, and although he is very tough he is great at explaining everything and always takes the time to answers questions. His lectures are extremely helpful, but it is possible to learn out of the textbook if you don't need to visually learn. Flawless board work, very tough exams
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Tough grader

reviews.comment: While Math 141 is not going to be an enjoyable course, Prof Bang is one of the best teachers I have ever had at Penn State. Yes, he has a slight accent/speech pattern because he is from South Korea - however, his lecture notes, tips he shares and desire to give his students the resources to pass the class outweigh the different speech pattern.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: overall a hard course, bang gives pretty good lessons and notes, pay attention and youll be fine
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He has a thick accent, but you get used to it after a week. He clearly explains everything step by step so as long as you go to lectures and pay attention, you'll be able to learn the material. The exams are difficult but the professor does complicated examples during class to prepare you. Gives take home quizzes which are difficult but manageable.

Does not teach as he tests. He will show examples of very basic problems for advanced concepts during his lectures, then he will test you on the fringes of that knowledge with difficulty level of problems that he's never worked in any lectures. Shows examples of basic problems, but tests on the fringes. Not a good distance learning professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Not a good distance learning professor, very difficult to understand, not active on boards, not good for feedback. Does not teach material, simply shows examples. Had to watch his lectures then go to Professor Leonard to actually learn the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Great teacher, but it seems that you may struggle if you haven't taken this material before. The practice quizzes are extremely helpful. Understand all of the practice exams and you'll be fine.
After you get past his accent, he is a great professor. Extremely accessible outside of class, but the tests are just rough. Study the practice exams
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Great teacher, hard class. His lectures are thorough, but he usually gives straightforward examples that are much easier than exam questions. Beware of the tests. I found them to be rather tricky and they usually required a lot of algebraic manipulations. He's very happy to help you after class. Despite my grade, I still feel like I learned a lot.
A really smart professor who provides countless examples to prepare you for the exams. The only thing he's better at than teaching is when he's balling out at the IM.

He is the best professor I've had so far. He did an amazing job on teaching the materials. It was clear and easy to understand. Homework is not graded and he gives you both in-class and take-home quizzes. They were pretty easy, not too difficult and he makes sure he goes over all types of problems before midterms or quizzes. HIGHLY recommend him!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational

reviews.comment: If you dont come to class you will not do well in the class. He gives a lot of examples and really explains things. It is very test heavy and so if you do not do too well on the exams it might be hard to get a good grade in the class. He is extremely helpful during office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: His accent is really strong, but you get used to it. He always explained everything and gave good examples in class. His in class and take home quizzes are not too easy, but if you do the assigned homework, you can do it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Math 140 is not an easy class, especially for me who sucks at math (second time taking it, I dropped it the first time--had it with Dr. Bharath --was not good). Dr. bang's lectures are really helpful for exams and quizzes. some quizzes (take home and in class)  are challenging but it helps you practice.

He is a really good professor, his lectures are also great. Taking notes of everything he puts in the border is crucial since the take home quizzes and in-class quizzes are really similar to examples he gives in class. He will tell tricks that you might face with problems. Study for in-class quizzes and you will be fine
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Out of the couple hundred points that professors can assign, he assigns all on quizzes and none on homework. The quizzes have 5 - 8 questions max and lots of points are taken off for little things (Theres no homework to balance out the grading either). Take this class if you are completely confident in not missing any detail on quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He teaches the class as if it is a review session. He doesn't go into detail with anything and expects everyone to understand everything before he teaches it. If you do not have a great math background, do not take him.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: He really cares about his students. Very good lectures. I've heard from friends that he's the best Math 140 professor and after taking his class, I do believe that! He does have an accent that can sometimes make it hard to understand at first, but his examples are also written on the board and he is more than willing to answer questions in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This man is a real gem! He has a funny accent but its understandable after a week. He gives so many great examples that you NEED to write down. They help with hw and the exams. He tells you all the tricks for each problem and what to study for the exams! His quizzes are a bit hard but you should be able to get an 8/10 on all of them.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: If you struggle in math I would not recommend him. He does have a higher than average passing rate but he made calc very difficult to understand. I never missed a single class, and went to the tutoring center at least 3 times a week for 3 hours every visit and end with just enough to pass the class. Nice man but incredibly difficult to understand.

Lectures are very good, so go to class because he give a ton of good examples. Quizzes are brutal though, take home quizzes are pretty easy, JUST CHECK UR WORK, i lost a lot of point on stupid mistakes because i didn't. An A in this class requires dedicating a lot of time to practicing, so don't take it in a crazy 18+ credits schedule!
Bang is a great professor. He will help you on anything, just asked.
