Attendance was not mandatory but the course was challenging. However, Prof Bang did as much as he could to help us. His methods of saving time in exams were extremely helpful, as well as the examples he gave. The in-class and take-home quizzes were simple, but the exams were a little bit more challenging, as they weren't written by him.

An excellent professor. Have 2 quizzes, one as home homework and one for class quiz. Just focus on the class quiz but most importantly focus for the exam. Exam is quite hard and have just a couple of question that bring big marks. MAKE SURE TO FOCUS ON THE EXAMS!

He does everything to help his students, but 141 is a very challenging class and I could not understand half of his lectures due to his accent. Had to drop the class halfway into the semester, otherwise would have failed.

Overall great professor. Take home quizzes are lengthy but they prepare you for the quizzes and exams. His lectures are very clear, not interactive at all but he is super nice and always willing to answer questions. Definitely would take him again!!!

He is a great professor. He makes it very easy to understand. The class is hard because exams are the same for all professors. His quizzes are hard (you need to study), and he gives one every other week. His homeworks are not too hard if you understand (and if you don't just go to his office hours and he'll help you). Don't fall behind in the class

Professor Bang is very clear at explains Calc 2, and is willing to help if you have questions. Even though attendance isn't mandatory, attending his classes is very helpful. Overall, I would definitely recommend taking him.

He is the best math teacher I ever had. His quizzes are take-home ;). No late submission penalty at all. He allows us to attend another class of his if we want to. He write down each single step and never say "YOU SHOULD'VE LEARNED THAT". Always Gives simpler non-book rules and his own fast methods to solve problem faster.
Math 141 is a hard topic, but he makes it the easier for you. Take home quizzes can get long but help keep your gpa up. Sample exams are given so the real exams aren't too bad.

Best math professor he made the course smooth and easy by giving you shortcut. The quizzes came straight forward from his notes so if u attend the class you will pass. If u need help go to his office hours he is really helpful

AMAZING TEACHER! HE REALLY WANTS TO HELP YOU LEARN. ALL WAYS TELLS YOU WHEN THERE ARE SHORTCUTS TO EACH RULE. ONE TAKE HOME AND IN CLASS QUIZ ALMOST EACH WEEK. GIVES YOU "SUGGESTED HOMEWORK" BUT NEVER GRDES IT! ATTENDANCE IS NOT MANDATORY, BUT I SUGGEST YOU GO!!! HIS LECTURES ARE VERY CLEAR AND MEKES IT MUCH EASIER TO UNDERSTAND.

A REALLY GREAT PROFESSOR! HE KNOWS WHAT HE'S DOING AND HE ALWAYS GIVES YOU SHORTCUT TO ANSWER THE QUESTIONS. JUST GO TO CLASS, LISTEN TO HIS LECTURES, ANSWER TO CLASS AND YOU HAVE EVERYTHING YOU NEED. WHAT'S MORE IMPORTANT IS THAT HE REMEMBERS HIS STUDENT!! OH AND HE'S CUTE TOO

Mr Bang is without a doubt an excellent teacher.  The mild language barrier poses no real issue if you are focused on his lecture presentations, which by the way are very effective at teaching the material.  I would definitely recommend him if you are looking to take this class.

The teacher is really nice and his explanation is clear. Very directly to the point, you can learn a lot without reading the textbook and just pay attention in class. Really recommend if you are going to take Math140. Very nice teacher!
REALLY NICE

He's a very good teacher. I've heard people complain about the language barrier but honestly his explanations are very clear to those who pay attention. Would definitely recommend to anyone looking to take 140, very defined grading and assignment schedule.

So because attendance is not required, if you really don't understand a word he says  like i did, just stay in your room, do the practice quizzes on Angels and if you don't understand something google it online and you're good. I think so far he's a fair grader but don't take math140 if you  know nothing about calculus.. BIG NO

GREAT PROFESSOR. The best math teacher i ever had. All you need to do is pay attention and take notes. Do the take home quizzes early, do your homework and study for the in class quizzes and tests and you should be fine.
JUST TAKE THIS CLASS.

He was an awesome teacher.  He didn't just assume that you would understand what he was talking about and so explained everything step-by-step.  He always finished the course material a few days ahead of schedule and used that extra time to review, which was helpful.  He definitely made sure we were prepared for the exams.
Nicest teacher ever! and hilarious at times.

Bang is perfect and if I take 140 I would definitely take his. The explanation is extremely clear and he really tries his best to explain the knowledge. The exams are the same for all the Math 140 students no matter which professor you have but the quiz is not very hard as long as you listen the class even not do HW. Definitely recommend his class!
The man. Do the homework.

He is the best professor I've had so far at Penn State. Math 140+141 are both really hard since the math department here really tries to screw the students over, but Bang actually cares about his students. He tries to prepare you as much as he can for the exams. Definitely try to get him as a professor! I wish he could teach me all of my classes.

The most awesome professor for Math I've ever had. Hilarious, clear (although he has an accent which you will get used), and really helpful. Gives suggested homework, and does review sessions regularly, which really helps a lot.

I am a math major and initially this class was pretty tough, but Professor Bang is just AMAZING! As long as you want to learn, he will go out of his way to help you and walk you through anything you don't understand. Probably the most amazing professor I've had!
This man is awesome. I will admit to being an extremely lazy student so I only got a C, but he made calculus so clear to me. Now that I take Math 141 I miss his clarity so much. I want him again!

Dr. Bang is an amazing Calc professor. He has an accent, but you quickly become used to it. I also think the accent was help at times because he would over stress the points that were important. Very helpful, very nice, and if you are looking for a good grade in Math 140 he can help you obtain it.
Challenging material but if you do all the homework and study his notes, you will do very well

Math 140 is a difficult class, so you NEED a good professor. Mr. Bang was a really good teacher! He is hard to understand at first but you get used to his accent in a few weeks. My favorite thing about him is that he is very repetitive with concepts to make sure the class really gets the material. Overall, a WONDERFUL teacher! :)

He is a really nice man and hilarious at times, but coming in with no prior calculus experience was a struggle. Even others in my class who had taken AP Calc struggled to pass the exams. Others are right, he prepares you for his take home quizzes but not for the 2 midterms and the final. I passed, but lion tutors was my savior.
best math teacher ever!!
Great professor, very helpful! Very straightforward with you and always willing to help if you are struggling.

He is a very nice professor. Down to earth. Always willing to help as others have mentioned. The exams, which he has no influence over, are extremely difficult. I barely made it out with C+ in the class and I am a straight A student. Sometimes felt that maybe he didn't prepare us for how hard the exams would actually be, though.

Prof Bang is the best professor I have met!!! He is so helpful, and he explains very clearly. His classes are interesting and help you understand quickly. I highly recommend you to take his classes!!!!!!!!! I hope that I can take his other classes in the future!
He is the man!!!!!!   Believe it or not !!!!!!   Best MATH tutor!!!!!!!     Always willing to help!!!!!!!!!
He is a very very GREAT professor! He explains the questions clearly and he is so kind and helpful! I definitely recommend him!!!!!
Great teacher. He always supplies many examples during class and is a great teacher to meet with during office hours. I definitely recommend him.

Bang is a cool guy, definitely knows what he is talking about. His quizzes each week are usually pretty easy, and attendance isn't mandatory. The exams are EXTREMELY difficult, but that isn't his fault because he has no say in how the exams are made, but Bang is definitely a good prof if you don't mind his accent, which isn't hard to understand.

Professor Bang is awesome! He is a little hard to understand at first but you get used to his accent. He is fair on grading and knows what he is doing, class can be boring but he tries really hard to make sure everyone understands it. He is a cute little asain man who is can get the whole class laughing. Awesome professor! Take math with him!
once you get past the accent he is a great teacher. very helpful, nice guy.

Professor Bang is a very good math professor. He understands that students need to actually be taught in that he doesn't just read out of the book. He is EXTREMELY available outside of class and is always there to help if you don't understand anything. He is very understanding as well. GREAT professor in a class that was quite difficult.
One of the best math teachers i have ever had.  Deff have to get past his accent.  If you do the home work and take notes in class tests are not too bad.  I would deff recommend prof bang
go to his office hours he will go out of his way to help you!
He is basically a good teacher despite his accent.

He is nice but his accent makes things a little difficult. I suggest that you attend class but you go for extra help with the topics you cannot understand from him. Lion Tutors has really good weekly reviews and that helped me a lot all semester. You should definitely invest in it if you want to do well in the class.

Bang is a real chill guy. Don't be intimidated by his accent: he is perfectly understandable, but he does have his funny quirks when speaking. They're more funny than distracting. He's perfectly willing to help and wants everyone to succeed. He held a review before the exam and brought doughnuts, so definitely go to that

This guy's a great teacher.  He makes things really clear, despite his accent, and he'll do his best to help you out and answer any questions. The class is hard, but his examples and practice problems are really helpful.

I love Bang he is the man. I had him for math 140A and math 141. THEY ARE VERY HARD CLASSES NO MATTER WHAT TEACHER YOU HAVE. However, Bang was the man go to class and ask questions he is very helpful. Very flexible office hours and will always help with hw if ask him.
Great teacher for 140, extremely helpful, just ask him anything. BANG is the man.

I had him for both Math 140 and 141, he was great teacher. He gives suggested hw which he will answer any questions you have about them in the beginning of class. Also held review sessions before exams going over old exams. You'll get use to his accent. He's great help during officer hour too. Great math teacher, wish he could teach Math 230 too.
AWESOME TEACHER!

Professor Bang is a really nice guy and if you go to office hours for help he does a really good job. It's hard to pay attention in class, but try and actually do the suggested homework which he doesn't collect. He has an accent but it's pretty easy to get used to and he tries to explain everything well by writing stuff out on the board.

At first its hard to understand him because english isn't his first language, but you get used to it. He is an awesome teacher. He derives everything from the beginning so its really easy to understand. If you go to his office hours, he will answer all of your questions extremely well. I highly recommend him as a teacher and hope to have him again
This is my worst experience. I didn't understand even a writing on the blackboard,never mind THE accent I believe it is too early for him to teach.
I am frustrated I didn't learn a thing

his accent is hard to deal w/ at the beginning but hes a good guy. he does a very poor job preparing you for test.  he tries to help as much as possible.  he breaks his chalk alot and he makes some jokes so the class isnt that boring.  hes not the worst and not the best but hes the man still haha

He is an average teacher. Certainly not the best you can get. His accent is somewhat difficult to understand and he speaks fast. His teaching methods are not so special, but you should pay attention to the examples he gives. You should also try to solve the suggested homework (which is not collected). Do that, and you'll get an A for sure.

He's got a very heavy accent that makes him hard to understand but he's very helpful if you go to office hours or ask questions face to face. The only time you really have to be in class is to take the quizzes. He doesnt make a big deal about people leaving and is very friendly if you need help.
He's not too bad, previous people have said his accent was terrible, but I find he's understandable and teaches pretty legit, better than previous math profs. that i've had.  Exams are easy.
Class is relatively easy. Examples come straight from the book. Quizzes were a little tough, but the exams were very easy.

Yes, he has a heavy accent. This is a petty complaint considering that he is extremely helpful during class and office hours. Many folks came and went during class without him ever making it an issue. The material is all from the book. Do all the reviews, ask questions, and you should get an A.

Bang is not that hard to understand. You just have to listen carefully and pay attention to what he's saying. Although he may not understand some of the questions you may ask, he will do everything in his power to try to get you to understand the material. He is also a really funny guy. Overall he's pretty good for a Math 022.

I wanted to drop this class the minute I heard him speak.He is VERY VERY hard to understand, and I don't think he really understands english because when you speak to him you will not get the answer you're looking for.But, he gives a lot of practice problems and good review problems for the exams.Get past the accent, and you'll do fine.

VERYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYYY hard to understand...i cannot say that enough. I have taken Alg. before, but i had to drop this class because he made it much more complicated. Also, the class was almost always completely empty b/c no one ever came. He taught right out of the book, same examples and all, it was exact

ok this prof isn;t that bad you just have to sit in the front and ask a lot of questions. and if you don't understand him which is quite pollible because  his english is good but he HAS A REALLYTHICK ACCENT.but i mean if you go to office hours he will help you.
HE NO SPEAKA ENGLISH!

Unless you want to learn math from the book only, I wouldn't advise taking this class.  His english is pretty terrible... so bad that you couldn't even ask him questions in class because he couldn't understand you!  It is possible to do well, but be prepared to do most of the work on your own.

Jenn was an incredible teacher for Pharmacology. She was always answering questions, and extremely accessible even by text when confused on content. She worked so hard to make sure all students were clear about the exam expectations, and thoroughly taught information. I loved her as a teacher and person.

Jenn is absolutely one of the most amazing professors I have ever had. Yes her content can be very difficult but that is just the nature of this class. She has impeccable communication and will do whatever she can to ensure that you get the best experience possible out of her class.

I took NURS305 aka Pharmacology with Jenn this semester. This was the first time she had taught it but I still thought she did a great job. She made an effort to teach meds in a way that was more understandable and emphasized meds/ideas to students that would be on exams. She clearly cared about her students and wanted to help them succeed.

You will be teaching yourself. She does not teach in class AT ALL but still gives hard exams. She expects you to learn off of each other with in class group work and group homework assignments. But there's zero lectures where she teaches. Getting through her class was the biggest struggle ever. Unfortunately the only OB teacher in Hershey.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Jen was a fabulous OB teacher! Tests weren't an easy A but just study and you'll do great. Her class made me realize I how much I loved this field of nursing - I am currently a mother/baby nurse. Jen is a genuine, sweet person who cares a lot about her students. Love her!

Good gen ed but i whole heartedly think he is mis-representing data to push his agenda. For example, he says females are dis-proportionaly vulnerable to heat waves. His source for this is purely based on the fact that females have smaller bodies and lose heat faster. This completely ignores that 72% of heat deaths are MALE due to occupation.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: If you are looking for a good easy gen ed take this class!!!

Took Meteo 1N with him. Very easy do it at your own pace course. He essentially gives you all the reading and you take the quizes at your own time. He is very helpful and will answer questions if needed. Overall easy A.

I took him for Meteo1N online and this class is very easy and straightforward. There are quizzes twice a week but they are all in the readings that do not take that long. He also allows for questions in discussion posts which help before taking the quiz. Overall great class for an GN or inter domain!

he literally doesn't reply to any emails, and if he, it would be weeks after you email. He will never let you makeup for any quiz. if you missed you are gone, he just doesn't care - although i achieved A but it was on bondary - he will never be supportive - he just doesnt care - 

he will make you confused if you ask questions to him-

I loved him! He was very helpful and always engaged with us. I took his course online and felt like I could understand it pretty well. There are weekly quizzes that go along with the material you learn on your own. He answers all of our questions even ones that are on the quizzes. I would definitely recommend this class!
He is a very organized professor, even when online. Note that he stresses the importace of reading. This is key to doing well on a quiz. I would take him for another meteorology class.

Professor Reppert is among the best professors I have ever had. He has made a topic which I knew nothing about (meteorology) very understandable. He schedules weekly meetings to discuss topics, quizzes, labs, and projects. He's focused on us learning and spends a great deal of time answering questions both in the live sessions & on discussion board

Really nice and funny Prof. Good & easy web gen-ed to take! The workload: there's approx 10pg reading, one quiz, and a mini "lab" every week. He creates videos to guide students on the material weekly. Readings are hmmm I wouldn't say hard nor easy. I'd say the course takes about two hours of your time every week. Take this easy web gen-ed course!

I took this class as a Gen Ed thinking that it will be a easy class as it was a 100 level class. Their is so much of reading for this class. I also found the quiz being really hard and the assignments were not described, or written properly. But the professor was quick on responding back. I clearly was not ready to put more time for a gen ed.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This is an informative and easy gen ed with Ben. He really is caring towards his students and makes learning about the boring parts of weather more entertaining. I had a wonderful time in this class. Also, 90% for an A and gives a 5% extra credit assignments.

Easiest professor I have ever had in my college career. Gives weekly labs which he dedicates every Monday half the class to help us with the lab and quizzes on every Friday which are fairly easy and if you miss a quiz he lets you make up however many quizzes you missed the following Monday. Highly recommend any class with this professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: He gets a bad rep, and I just don't get it. He is a caring teacher and is always there to help. The lectures are actually interesting if you enjoy econ. The class itself has a lot of content, too much for him to teach in lectures, so there are a lot of lecture videos. If you pay attention and understand what you learned in 106, you will do fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: awsome cool

Prepare to teach yourself, lectures aren't enough to prepare yourself for exams and homework. Fortunately there are a lot of resources for self teaching including hw demos and practice exams that closely resemble what you will see. The course content is difficult and the work load is demanding be prepared to allocate a lot of time for this class.

hot take but i don't think he's that bad. yeah his class structure is weird and the tests aren't super reflective of the lectures but he literally gives you practice exams that are almost identical to the real exam. if you do the practice exams and take the time to genuinely understand the content u'll be fine.
he would laugh at other students struggling with his exams
BOOOOO! HIS AVERAGE ON A TEST IS 30% THIRTYYYYYYYYYYYYYYY!!!!! BRO YOU WILL BE COOKED!

Lots of people struggle with this class with him mainly due to the material just being difficult and students not attending. His lectures are informative and he gives plenty of other points. He gives good study material for exams and is overall a pleasant person. If you are the type of student who is not ambitious and skips class maybe stay away.

He was an excellent professor who was very organized. He had a clear and generous grading policy and provided students with lots of resources and practice for exams. I went to class everyday and 3/4ths of the class wasn't there. The people who don't show up to class are the ones leaving the bad reviews.

He was an excellent professor that gave more than enough buffer to make this difficult class accessible. He dropped grades, his exams were not worth as much as they could have been, and there was endless practice. I went to class everyday and it was 3/4th empty most of the time. The people who don't show are the ones leaving the bad reviews.
Easy enough and if you go to OH, you would be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very structured course, which was both helpful and demanding. The material is dense and unfamiliar, so it can be challenging. If math isn't your strong suit, you'll need to take the time to make it one. With consistent effort and serious studying before exams, you can do well. Difficult, but rewarding overall.

reviews.comment:
If you have any other option, TAKE THEM. Professor Austin did not know how to teach economics and always spit bs in the classroom. 

His exams was far way different from what he taught in the class and the video lecture. 

He genuinely does not care about the students at all, too strict about small thing and it is ridiculous. 

dont choose him
Don't do it.

I never leave reviews but he is one of the worst professors at Penn St... lectures are incredibly useless and a complete waste of time. He doesn't teach what is on the exams and his class is all over the place. He assigns lecture videos that cover things we learned a month ago and then talks about random stuff during class. Horrible teacher.
MESSED UP. Somehow he taught this class and made it seem like it was 2 classes combined, either the material was too intense, or he made it seem like it. Avoid taking this specific class with him.

One of the worst professors I've had at Penn State. He rambles and rambles and it's not hard to tell everyone except three kids are completely lost in class. You will be doing busy work almost daily. Test averages are somehow the highest ever (65%) even though exams are almost 1:1. He is the only professor for this class so good luck avoiding him.

Lectures in morning, which already makes it tough to stay engaged. However, the main issue is the exams when the class average on midterms is around 50%, something clearly isn't working. The material is challenging enough on its own, and the lectures don't always make the concepts any easier to follow. I wouldn't recommend this class.  Take McLeod.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He was truly a nice person, but his class was bad. WAY to much homework, the exams were way harder than they should have been. I also feel like I walked away learning a very minimal amount of information.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Lectures have no clear direction so he just talks super fast and spits out multiple different ideas for the same thing. You have to watch the lectures outside of class. If you know how to do math you will have a better time teaching yourself with the videos.

All of his exams are hard, just buy the lion tutors. His final was not real, it was all multiple choice. Use chat gpt on every homework because he makes you come in class and do it with partners, then grades it for accuracy. Taking notes in class are pointless, I never used a single one.

The most failed classes are this and 304 but if you are an econ major, you have to take these classes. I thought Boyle was a great professor. There is a ton of work, and you have to show up to class on time because he does in-class assignments. For exams, they were exactly like the practices. Overall hard, but he prepares his students well.
Please do not take a class with him. drop it

Professor Boyle went off topic alot in class and it was hard to copy the graphs he made because his handwriting is hard to read. The slides he posts don't have the graphs so this made it hard to study on my own after.

Professor Boyle is nice, but not my favorite prof. Lectures were long and kind of all over the place, hard to follow, and I still felt I had to teach myself a majority of the material. The first two midterms are ok if you study, but the final was impossible. He isn't clear about what will be on it, and it tanked my grade. It's all multiple choice.

Personally I just did not like the guy. He can be nice, but is also just rude and condescending at times. He also is not a good professor he goes through topics quickly making it hard to keep up. He also gets very sidetracked. The tests are very hard and there is a lot of homework. The class is doable though however if you keep up with the work.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Honestly just don't take this class with this professor, if there is another option take it. He truly just made things difficult when they didn't have to be.

People are kinda overreacting IMO this was by far the easiest class I took this semester. Actually reading the textbook helps. He does talk alot without actually saying much and readings are like a week behind lectures which is weird but the exams were a breeze if you understand the material. Bonus points for the Homestar Runner reference.

He is funny and nice it's just his class structure is very frustrating. We have reading quizzes on one chapter, homework on a different chapter at the same time, and his lectures were always a chapter or two behind. The material isn't too hard just hard to learn in time for all the assignments and exams.

I don't know what other people are talking about with this class being hard. Yeah the Packback questions were really annoying but if you come to class and make an honest effort you should be fine. Professor Boyle is also a really nice guy and totally willing to help if you go to office hours or stay after class.

WORST EVER. I hate this man. There is SO much work. This is a basic econ course and he made it so much harder. 2 mid terms and 1 final. I got an F on 2/3 of the exams. He is TERRIBLE. Only reason I got a decent grade was because of how much work he gives. The lectures make no sense and he just rambles. Avoid this man at all costs.

Study 16+ hours or perish. Final felt like an academic horror film—then it actually started storming. Left the exam soaked and emotionally unstable. Professor patrols the room like a test-taking hawk. Homework saves your grade (barely). Bring snacks, a raincoat, and maybe a therapist. Proceed with caution.

TAKE SOMEONE ELSE! I used every resource available to study for the exams and it did not help at all. The final was horrific and made no sense. On top of that you don't get to know what you got right and wrong unless you go to office hours which just isn't feasible for everyone. Please take anyone else!!! I don't know how this man has a job.
His teaching style was confusing and it was really hard to stay focused in class. the exams were very hard and I only passed this class from watching the gsg videos

I haven't left a comment on this site before, but I have to offer an alternative view given all the negative feedback here. Dr. Boyle is my favorite professor I've had at Penn State. He delivered engaging lectures in which he would tie class concepts into real world matters, and he is helpful and non-condescending to those who come to him for aid.

Genuinely the worst professor I've had at psu. The lectures SO boring & half of the time he's just rambling about something that barely has anything to do with the class. Spent 200 on course materials that I never used (including guided notes that were literally just the slides with fill in the blanks). TAKE SOMEONE ELSE

I wish I did research before taking this class, because this is the worst professor I've had at PSU. I studied for 10+ hours for all of his exams and got 70's every time. The lectures are unhelpful, homework is also useless, and he doesn't teach by the textbook you're forced to buy. Take any other professor.

this man is the most frustrating professor i have ever met. he barely understands the class himself, then the exams come and they are the weirdest, application-based questions i have ever seen. he makes you pay $200 in class materials just for none of them to help you learn. take this class with any other professor you can. he is the worst.

Boyle is so bad at teaching lol. For 306 you have to take him since he is the only professor for this course. I didn't go to class bc he just rambles and I ended with an A-. Literally, just make sure to do all the assignments and for exams practice the practice exam and you"ll be fine. Wish there was a better 306 professor who actually teaches.

Lectures are very boring and you will not understand the graphs he draws because he goes too fast. Exams are very hard. 2 midterms and 1 final. Way too much homework. Do the practice tests and go to GSG sessions. Only giving him a 2 because he can be helpful sometimes in office hours and seems like he wants his students to succeed.

DON'T! Austin makes you spend over $200 on materials that you don't use. I have not once even laid my eyes on the text book. If you have to take this class study with the practice exams and explain the questions to yourself. He just talks to himself about random stuff in all his lectures and is the core reason of 95% of my crash outs this semester.

Took this class and was lost during the lectures because of the random side topics he would discuss. When he was explaining graphs, you couldn't actually see what he was doing, mostly, and it seemed like he was talking to himself a lot of the time. Spent over $200 on this class for programs and an online textbook that was never used. Don't do it!!!

Took this class as a subplan credit. Boyle makes you pay over $150 in three "add ons" to the class. Exams are insanely difficult with the average on them being about a 65%. Topics in class literally don't correlate to the exams. Went to exam review session with TA and he did not even know what was going on. studied 15 hours and failed last exam.

By far the worst professor I have had at PennState. Creates study guides and says he has useful material to study exams, but never elaborates on these materials and they end up confusing students more. Exams are insanely hard and he spends most of class talking about irrelevant points that will not be on the exam. Do not take Econ102 with him

He spends over half the lecture talking about things not related to economics or what will be on the exams. Study guide questions match up to exam questions, but still stuff on the exam not covered on the study guides. Attendance taken from packback questions, but you can do them outside of class so attendance doesn`t really matter on tuesdays.

You have to buy $150+ course material that doesn't help. He claims that buying the course pack is optional, but literally everything is in it, so you need it. If you ask him a question, he'll confuse you even more to try to get you to understand it yourself. The study guides are very similar to the exams, but it doesn't cover everything, so study.

Lectures are just endless talking with no clear structure, super hard to follow. Don't expect help either. Spent $200 on materials we barely used. He says the coursepack is optional, but good luck passing without it. Overall, this class felt like a waste of time and money. (but I had to take it) !!USE THE STUDY GUIDES FOR EXAMS!!
Always teach things unrelated to the course. No partial credits at all. Choose a different professor if you have any choices. I do not want to say something else just RUN!!!

This class was the bane of my existence. I would study so much and not get a good grade on the tests. The midterms are both multiple choice and open answer so be sure to know what you're doing. He does give partial credit on the exams. I probably could've went to a study sesh but whatever. He's not a bad professor, I'm just bad at economics lowkey.

had to drop this class. too caught up in the material to actually make sure his students understand. basically need to attend every class in order to score a decent grade on the midterms and he also uses packback polls in class. if you have the option, take this class through a community college online or just pick a different professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This was by far the most BORING and UNBEARABLE class that I have ever taken. Sitting through his lectures is on a whole different level of boring, you will start to lose your mind. The material itself is already boring but his lectures make it even harder to understand. On top of this you have to spend upwards of $150 on materials which is absurd.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: His Exams are pretty hard. But he gives many study materials and does teach well. His study guides were very similar to the test, but you have to study the concepts on them to understand the exams thoroughly. He gives a lot of homework but it's good so one exam won't destroy your grade. He's tough but he has your best interest at heart.

Genuinely the worst professor I have ever had. His lectures made absolutely no sense and the examples he gave were so poorly explained. Exams are similar to the assignments, but he changes them to the point that you need to know the concepts, which he doesn't teach well. Even the TA was confused when I went to a guided study group. DONT TAKE HIM!!!

Austin Boyle seemed great at first, but his class went downhill fast. He relies heavily on lectures, making attendance essential to grasp economics. His lectures are hard to follow, and the pricey course pack adds little value. His handwriting makes graphs tough to read, and grading errors were common. If you need to pass, don't take it with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Boyle is a great guy. He is younger than most ECON102 professors and makes you feel more level with him. Your grade is heavily based on homework assignments rather than exams, which was great for me as I am not a good test taker. He has a guided notes packet that you are able to buy and fill out during lectures. Highly recommend him!

Terrible professor, gets side tracked and goes down many rabbit holes for like 10 minutes every lecture. Oh, he also makes you pay for 3 different course materials about $225 in value. There are so many comparable platforms that are free or less expensive and just as nice as what he requires. He also says many ignorant things irrelevant to lecture.
There is not much to say but RUN

Boyle gives a lot of room to boost your grade through homework which is nice and a group portion on the exams. I will still say this is the hardest class I have taken and the avg on exams were all 60s. He is not a great teacher though, lectures do not teach you anything and you need to have a very strong statistics background.
Do not recommend

At first, this class was hard but once I got used to his way of teaching it was okay. Tbh if you know how to do the think pairs and the homework, then you'll be okay. Don't procrastinate on the videos because it will make it easy to be left behind. I bombed the second exam and still ended up passing the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Boyle knows how to make tough and tedious mathematical concepts comprehensible in a short amount of time. He gives lots of work between all the different assignments so be ready to have lots of time spent doing various sums and reviewing concepts, but if you're thorough about it you should be able to get most of them eventually.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Boyle knows how to
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: His class is difficult, but that isnt on him. Rather it is just that the content itself can be hard. Dr. Boyle is probably the nicest and most caring professor I have ever had. Sure there is a lot of work, however, when exam time comes around all that work is great for review, and if you watch the videos to understand the concepts you will do well.
awful professor, do not take him for credit, take someone else
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Boyle gives out an insane amount of work. He doesn't curve anything because he gives you a study guide which is nothing like the exam itself. Not only are you expected to learn in class but he gives you  a million videos to watch for homework, which you have to teach to yourself before class otherwise the class won't make sense (his words)

He would be a good person if he wasnt a teacher, but unfortunately, he is. He seems to be smart but just cannot teach. If you arent a teachers pet kind of person and dont want to sit in front every class + studying 5 hours extra dont take it. If you are not an econ major DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS! A WORD IS ENOUGH FOR THE WISE
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Dr. Boyle stands out as one of the most exceptional professors in the economics department. The structure of his course is straightforward, which allows students to grasp complex econometrics concepts more easily and with confidence. He also allows peer assignments for points, which is greatly appreciated. I wish nothing but the best for him!

He is nice, and I think he does care. But his way of teaching is so not productive. He's not good at explaining things adequately and goes down a rabbit hole with every point he makes, making the topic impossible. I retook the class in the summer with a professor that knew how to teach, and it literally seemed like a completely different course.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Don't do it
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Test heavy

reviews.comment: A tough grader, and his tests are tricky. There's a lots & lots of homework. He uses Pearson and Backpack for assignments. There are only two midterms, but they're difficult, with each question worth over 2 points. He provides sample exams, but you need to read a lot and practice. All exams are in person, so be prepared!
Excellent professor who cares very much about economics. Absolutely willing to help.

I'm not sure why so many people HATE this dude; his class was extremely difficult, but he clearly cared if you reached out to him. It was extremely lecture-heavy, and exams were difficult (especially the second), but he provided practice exams and study guides. Just do the reading and go to office hours, and you'll pass with a B.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: His tests and midterms were insanely difficult and cumulative heavy. The final was brutal to sit through and I left quite frustrated with the class itself. He spams you with homework all from differing units (some homework comes before he even covers it in class). Wouldn't recommend him.

Okay so this class is VERY hard. The Packbacks are useless and there is a ton of homework every week. I went to every lecture and pulled a C+. Exams are very hard and the mean scores are around a 65 and he does not curve. Boyle is a cool guy but he yaps and the lectures can get boring. He post practice exams that I thought helped but I guess not.

This class is the annoying class this semester. I took this as a Gen ed and do not make that mistake! You have  5 homework each week and need to pay for a lot. The classes are 1hr and 15. This class is so much do deal with, only take it if its compulsory or if you're an econ major. Just not aa a Gend ed
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dude is a BOT!!!!!

He's lowkey a cutie. He is so nice and will try to help you if you go to office hours. However, his exams are not easy. You can for sure get by barley studying if this is not your first econ class and you pick up on topics easily. However, you probably should put aside some time to study each week. There are many resources other than lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Reviews are so cap when the people complaining can't even draw a slope. Test questions are reworded from the practice and you can get by with common sense for 2/3 of semester. Significantly cuts down the curriculum (2 mts vs. 3 from other profs). Based professor he talked about how the gender wage gap wasn't real and monkeys having sex in lectures.
Not a good professor. Not considerate and would not pay any attention to me when I raised my hand. He should be relieved of his teaching duties.
This guy is so annoying. Don't take his class

Professor Boyle was a decent instructor for me two years ago. However, after taking the final, he accused me of cheating and using AI to write my answers because they were well written. He has very little professionalism and he is disrespectful.

Professor "Boyle" is a good human being. He will talk to you and try to help you, but don't expect extra credit or real grade changes (even when he makes a mistake). Study class handouts if you want to do well on exams, and put aside at least 5 hours for homework on the weekends (unless you love econ). If you don't go to class you'll be confused.

Boyle is a good professor, there is a lot of homework in his class but most of it is pretty simple and the tests aren't worth a ton of your grade and have group portions in them. The content can be challenging at times but he does a good job of trying to make sure you understand. He is very nice and personable and is a great lecturer.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If you take Austin's class seriously, his class is not as bad as some people say. All of his homework, exams, and group work, he will give you an example, usually a similar one  from last year. As long as you look at these examples and modify the numbers, you can get the answer.

Failed the 1st two exams but Dr. Boyle pads your grade severely with lots of homework and worksheets

Make sure to watch the video quizzes he assigns outside of class as lectures are based on practice problems. 

Dr. Boyle and his TAs are very accessible outside of class and theres free tutoring. 

Put in alot of effort and the work you will pass.

Boyle has made it impossible to fail. If you do, it's your fault. Extremely easy class, gives out plenty of practice. Lectures bolster online material (video lectures). Homework and practice mirror exactly what's in the exams. Just study Edgeworth boxes, everything else is very easy, only requires advanced algebra math understanding.

I was nervous coming in but he set us up for success. Lots of homework assignments to boost grade, can still bomb a midterm and do well. Expensive class upfront with about $250 worth of material needed, but he helpful in office hours. His lectures and material can be confusing and he answers questions with a question. Show up and put effort in.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I was worried coming into this class, but as long as you go to a majority of the classes you should be fine. He offers many different assignments that will boost your grade as long as you do them. The exams resembled the practice exams quite well and kept the same concepts. There was a group portion on exams that helped boost grades with good group
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Austin Boyles exams are crazy difficult, and very unlike what you learn in class. I've felt fully prepared for both midterms so far only to be met with much harder questions, sometimes trick questions, and very small amounts of time to complete the tests.

He is. a nice teacher, but the exams are NOTHING like the practice exams and he puts questions in that he has not reviewed. The homeworks are hard and unlike what we learn in class. Both the exams and homeworks are graded extremely hard with little partial credit. Assigns tons of videos to watch at home instead of teaching it in class.

The class is alright honestly, but the exams are horrible. Almost everyone is crunched on time, the questions are set up very differently from all the practice/HW/assignments, and class averages are very low.

I had this Professor before for another class. He is a nice guy but both of his classes were made up of homework and tests. That was basically it. His exams are nothing like what you practice in class or outside of it.

Wasn't exactly the greatest professor but I did enjoy his class. I bombed all the exams but still ended up passing. The practice exams were nothing like the actual exams so you're better off studying for the exams with his study guide. I wasn't able to go to his office hours but you'll definitely do better if you go to them and ask for help.

The only thing the Packbacks and the super hard online homeworks are good for is boosting your grade when you inevitably bomb the exams.  Attendance was mandatory, however, if it wasn't I don't think I would have ever gone to class.  I did not enjoy this class whatsoever and I alwys studied hard for exams and never did well, I wrked hard for a B.

Really liked his lectures but the exams are pretty hard. Definitely doable if you work hard. He seems like a cool guy but I only attended class like once a week. Even though class was at 11 I like to sleep in until noon. So attend lecture and you probably will be fine.

Boyle is not great. Not terrible, but not great. Exams are pretty hard, but they are only 50% of the grade so there is room to bomb one and still do ok. Some group work involved which I did not like at first but grew to enjoy as it spread out the knowledge amongst the class. He curved the whole class up a grade - I got an 88 but finished with an A-

His class is passable but be aware for the worst times of your life. Practice exams never matched the actual exam. Maybe makes up about 10 out of 50 questions. Packback was absolutley useless and meaningless. Overall would not recommend.

Professor Boyle is a good guy, and helped me out when I was having trouble with homework. He even gave us his phone number if he couldn't reach via email. ECON 106 is hard, but it is required if you're an ECON major. But take him for 306 instead of Medina. He'll definitely help you out when you need it.

Acceptable professor for Econ. Every week there are Pearson Homework and Packback homework due every Sunday night. The averages for the midterms were extremely low. Average of 60%-70%. Be sure to know how to study for the exams. I would recommend reading and taking notes on the Pearson online textbook. Also, read the notes and DO PRACTICE TESTS.

The class is not terrible with the in class work and the homeworks but the exams are terrible and the average for every exam was between 50 and 60. The final was also the worst thing ever and everyone I knew failed it. I would recommend taking another professor.
Boyle was absent and almost never interacted with the class. does not explain concepts in a comprehensive way. exams were difficult for 102. don't take Boyle for Econ.

54% on the final. If you can take anyone else do it. If you get stuck with Boyle not the end of the world but you have to read the textbooks and try on the homework's to do remotely well. Some of his exam questions make no sense and are unclear. Very passive aggressive and doesn't care about students. Get all the non-exam points possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: There is something wrong with your teaching style and tests if the average is a 55% on each exam and you don't curve it. Lots of homework but it helps boost your grade because most likely you will get less than a 70% on each exam. Lectures are alright but lion tutors is way more effective. He seems like an eh guy but is just mean a lot of times.

The only good thing about this class is the fact that it's over. We had SO MUCH homework every single week & it was not nearly as helpful as it should've been for the time spent. He made all of his students feel stupid on purpose in class. The tests all averaged failing grades, still no curve. I studied so much for the final & got a 69. NEVER AGAIN

This guy's exams are so unbelievably corny. He makes every basic topic so twisted with intricate scenarios that are worded terribly and can be interpreted several ways. Universally low grades for the class on all midterms, no makeups, 0 extra credit, lame lectures, impossible final and an annoying tone. Weird guy.

Idk why people are not happy with Prof Boyle, he is the best literally he just wants you to listen to him and pay attention. I felt that some students were rude by backing up early while he was talking. His exams have low percentage of the total grade he and the best thing his exams are similar to practice tests and just do the homework.
Doesn't curve test and the averages are low, never responded to emails and didn't seem to care much. Homework was just busy work and didn't help much. Nice guy though.
never curved tests, and test averages were between 50-65. avoid. nice enough guy, but avoid taking this class with him.

Decent Professor, but like feels like he reads strictly off of power points. Liontutors is your best friend for exams because he doesn't help at all for prep for those, and for some reason did not curve when class average was failing for both exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Not sure what's up with the other reviews...
Dr. Boyle is a good professor, he truly takes the effort to let students understand the content.
He is always happy to answer any questions. His practice exams are similar to actual exams.
However, he has a tendency to get annoyed at times.
If you do the readings and pay attention you will be fine!

Lectures were extremely boring, read right off the PowerPoint. Average grade on the first two exams was below a 70 but did not curve any of the exams. Made little effort to interact with students as everyone sat there on their phones and often times left class.

Professor Boyle knows his stuff and is a great professor. 306 is a hard class no matter who teaches it. If you pay attention in class and study you will pass. He is great in office hours for questions, but in class gets annoyed when no one knows the answer.

There is a lot of outside work that accounts for 50% of the grade (extra 6-8 hours a week). Many of the students failed the first exam and still managed to end with a B or C. He apologized for the first exam and did not curve it. Definitely take a different professor if possible.

This guy sucks. Do not take him. Spent about $150 bucks on McGraw Hill and Packback, just to have to drop the class halfway thru the semester. He sent out a hateful email after the first midterm to everyone who did poorly, even tho the average was a 60%. He makes the content so much harder than it needs to be, for the love of god, don't even bother
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Ausitn is not a good prof AT ALL. He quite actually apologized about the average in the first midterm and then did not curve it. Also has his own coursepack that you basically have to purchase along with other websites. Not economically friendly to college kids who are already paying way to much for his class to begin with. Avoid this class!!
Make sure to prepare yourself before each class and take notes during the class. Expect the actual exams to be more difficult than his practice exams.

Prof. Boyle is okay, just make sure you do the quizzes due every Sunday. He's basically a ghost when you email him, only to reply back two days later, when I have already figured out the question I asked. He does give you his phone number to get a jump start. Make sure to keep up on practicing your stats because econometrics is gonna be hard.
Austing is an awful teacher for poorly designed classes. He is practically a ghost since he does not engage with students to actually teach. He should be fired. My worst class in Penn State so far.

At least for my online section, he literally did not teach the class. Lectures were some 20 year old recordings and were just a waste of time. There is an easy weekly quiz, but then a biweekly homework that has more questions, one attempt and no feedback. I don't understand why the "homeworks" are basically exams but they're manageable.

I took the online version of this class (I believe it was the standard world campus version), so I can't speak much about the content in regards to Prof Boyle. However, he was always helpful and informative in guiding us through the online course, so I would take him again.

I would never take this professor again. He barely helps when you ask for it and does not do a good job at presenting the information for the class. His personality makes you feel like he thinks everyone is dumb and should already know everything he is teaching. If you see his name, please steer clear and pick another professor.

The class was not super easy but the MyEconLab is majority of the grading and that part is not that bad, just takes up a lot of time. Boyle is a nice guy and can be personable. Show up to class and you'll be alright.

Prof. Boyle's lectures are not the most particularly interesting thing in the world, but how can you exactly make a math-oriented class like Econ fun without focusing entirely on concepts? You will pass with high marks if you show up, do the attendance questions, and do the weekly homework (Quizlet is your best friend here-- word to the wise).

From what I know, if you have to do ECON 102, do it with Boyle over the other options. His lectures are not bad, and there are a lot of assignments to help your grade. Exams do not carry too much weight so there is not too much worry about there. You definitely learn Econ well and can certainly achieve a decent grade.

Boyle is great. I can only assume that the people who give him bad ratings are the ones who don't show up, don't so the work, and just don't care. He can have an attitude, but professors are humans too...get over it. 102 is easy as long as you pay attention and put in the work. Don't listen to the bad ratings.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very nice guy, just did not enjoy the class. The tests were online which was nice but trying to do graphs on a computer sucked. Keep up with the homeworks, packbacks, and tophat questions and you'll be fine.

I'm not sure why Dr. Boyle has such a low rating. I took him for Econ 102 and he was amazing. Energetic, passionate, and thoroughly explains the material. Do the readings and watch the videos on Pearson, and you'll more than understand the required material. Super easy A with a great professor, Econ 102 with Boyle is the best thing you can do
A young and relatable professor who you could really tell knew he was teaching an easy class. Frequent interesting asides and still covered all the material effectively. Easy W for Econ102

Lots of homework, bombed one of them and never recovered. Honestly a pretty easy class, just take it seriously because each assignment and exam actually holds a lot of weight. Exams and homework are all file upload meaning you'll need to do them by hand, scan, and upload them. I recommend the scanner app if your phone can get it.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The entire class is on MyLab. Exams are 10 questions and unless you have a great understanding of each concept beforehand, you may struggle with the time you're given. Had to take it twice, ended up with a B- the second time around. Does mess around in this class it's really not that hard if you study like you should.

Pretty difficult class honestly. Exams are 10 questions each, so one wrong is -10% instantly. It's all fair, but if you're hoping for an easy A you actually have to put the work in. Only got a B- because I slacked on the quizzes. Exams aren't too hard, but triple check answers to make sure since you can't show work for credit on MyLab.

The exams feel like they're trying to trick you and they are. There are insanely stupid true false questions, weird quirks to questions on exams, doesnt give out much work but youre unprepared for the exams because of it. Austin is the definition of mid. His lectures are really boring and not focused on any singular topic. He's just kinda there
Dr. Boyle was mediocre. Lectures were extremely boring. Only 3 tests including the final. Homework was hard and gave no explanation. Online exams, Quizlet is your friend.

Austin Boyle receives a lot of negative feedback on here and I'm not sure why. For Econ102 he was a very nice professor. He was boring at times, but just work through it and it's fine. The exams were pretty straightforward and don't even affect your grade that much. Keep up with the work and you will do fine in this class.
He was not a bad guy, but his lectures were not interesting, making them hard to follow. Felt like I learned more from my econ lab.

The class was mediocre at best. Unfortunately, I had to take this class and it was a pain. Everything is done online and automatically graded, and the only way to pass is to study the textbook a bunch. Lectures don't even help, you just need to memorize the textbook. There were 2 end of semester tests (both within a week) which is just ridiculous.

reviews.comment: Austin is a caring person but he is a bad professor. I feel like he is nice in the beginning of the semester but he progressively gets worse. He doesnt teach the material on the exams so you pretty much need to go to lion tutors for every exam.

reviews.comment: Boyle assigns textbook reading and quizzes before lectures and then lectures on the same things that were done for homework. If you take notes before class, the lectures seem kind of pointless (other than being graded for attendance/participation). Both midterms and our final were online and open-note, so the class isn't hard to pass.
Hate this dude with a passion
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Easy Homework

Dr. Boyle is the most mediocre man I have ever met. The class was a waste of my time honestly. I came out of this semester with barely any more Economic knowledge than I had before. Also there are 2 'finals' which is ridiculous. One online w/ notes, like the midterms, then one in the testing center. Makes no sense. Lots of HW and Packback 3x/wk.

Not the worst teacher, but he sucks at giving extra help. Very passive-aggressive and doesn't seem interested in helping unless you're a suck-up. There are MyEconLab assignments and HWs. Not mandatory but he does Packback attendance & participation during class. Read the textbook! Overall not hard; don't fall behind though
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: His class is not only boring but he rambles during lectures making everything so much more confusing than it has to be. Only huge lecture I have ever had where participation during class is graded (TopHat) and attendence is marked every day. I see what other econ students are learning and it is so much more clear than what he teaches.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Take Wooten if you have the chance. Class is extremely boring and tests were stupid hard. Uses top hat to take attendance and you have two 500 word writing assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I currently have an A in this class even after everyone failed the first exam but I still don't think Boyle is a good professor. He takes 20 minutes to answer a question and wastes time by asking us what we should do. If we asked the question, how would we know what to do? The average for the first exam was a 38%. Speaks for itself. Nice guy tho.

Professor Boyle is not a good professor. Good luck following the concepts that he so poorly tries to explain. He makes MANY mistakes when trying to teach you and most times does not catch them. The homework is set up in such a way that grades you on answering questions right before he actually teachings you what to do. Does not reply to emails.

Dr. Boyle is a very personable person, who wants you to succeed in his class. The microeconomics class he teaches is very interesting and makes you think differently about the decisions you make every day. Lectures are a bit longer than usual, but they are pretty interactive since he uses tophat for clickers. Overall a solid choice for a Gen-Ed.

Econ 302 might be the toughest Econ class at Penn State. Professor Boyle used Kaltura for lecture videos and then class time was used to reinforce what we learned. Make sure to pay attention right away as what you learn the first few weeks of the semester is used the entire course.

reviews.comment: Don't ever wanna go through this class or have to listen to him ever again.

reviews.comment: A lot of the reviews here are reflective of the course and not the teacher. Econometrics itself is a tough course. Austin though has been fair and the structure of the class is easy to figure out. Tip: You have 2 chances at the quizzes. get them right, write them down and you will see them again come exam time. Getting the A is easy this way.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Econ 102 was one of my gen eds that I took my first semester. Dr. Boyle is very nice and he makes the class a lot more fun. He is not the best at teaching, but he makes this class a lot more interesting. The exams were never too hard and there was never a lot of homework. If you take this class, I highly recommend taking Dr. Boyle!
Weird dude, but he's alright.

If you have no background in econ dont take this class. It was only easy because Ive taken this class before but the lectures did a poor job covering tested material. You must read the textbook to do well. He was one of my funnier professors though, the lectures were entertaining.

Truly Austin wasn't a bad teacher. He was able to explain the actual economic information better than any professor I've taken. His class structure is just ridiculous and he's kinda a d**k about it. Your grades rely on 3 exams and 3 homeworks, and since the exams were online, he made you upload pictures of your work during the timed quiz.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Boyle is a great person and makes class as interesting as he can, but the lectures do not help much with the tests, and there is a lot of reading necessary to understand the material.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Boyle is a solid choice, not sure why he has so many bad reviews. Hes a nice guy and communicates well. I found his grading is a bit on the tougher side compared with other professors in the department but if you do the work and understand Econ you will be fine. reviews.comment: This guy is really horrible. He is just a weird dude over-all and he is a TERRIBLE teacher. This dude was so bad that he couldn't even teach a class for the spring semester because no one wanted to take his class lol. Whatever you do, DO NOT TAKE THIS TEACHER. HORRIBLE!

He knows what he's talking about but he's not very good at explaining it. I also found him to be somewhat mean as a person. He yelled at students and his TA's. I ended with a B but it was mostly my own personal work that made me understand the material, not him.

I didn't like Boyle's class and recommend taking it with another teacher because the class was really boring and I studied so much for the tests and ended up doing bad. He was a nice guy but I don't recommend taking econ with him.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Austin was very fair overall. If you show up to class and do the homework's you should have no problem earning at least a B. Its not an easy A but if you put in the time its possible. Many people think he's too cocky but I didn't think it was too bad. He does a good job at keeping his lectures fairly interesting and interacting with students.

I didn't even touch the textbook, you just need his notes for tests.  Austin really cares about his students.  He certainly makes it possible to get an A. He offers a lot of participation points and extra credit.  He only has 2 midterms and a final, so make sure you do really well on the first test; the second is pretty difficult.

Dr. Boyle's class was fairly challenging. It is composed of 2 midterms and a final exam. The 2 midterms are pretty tough, you will need to study a large amount, liontutors won't help much for his econ class. The final exam is very difficult, ours got curved up, the average was probably around a 65 but I got an 87 because i studied VERY hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Austin is a young and cool teacher which allows him to put what you are learning into terms that you understand which is helpful. His tests are hard but no different than others I have heard of. Its not much work other than a short quiz online once every other week and I studied for his tests for about 2-3 days before. I recommend the 50 min class.

Good guy and tried to relate to his students but fell short. Was a very hard class and the exams are hard to do well on even with studying. The best advice would be to go to every lecture and review his notes after each session so you are not lost for the next class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Hardest class I have taken so far. Offers over 400 participation points but only gives his students 310 max. Exams are extremely difficult even if you study the material for a long time.  Going to GSGs and LionTutors are the only thing that helped me barely pass this class. Do not recommend taking Austin Boyle's class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Very smart guy but just didn't know how to teach the concepts well. He used real life examples that weren't relatable, so they didn't help. Tests were rather hard unless you were naturally gifted in Econ, so even if you study a lot, you may not get the grade you deserve. Don't take this class if you can avoid it.

Austin's lectures were very straightforward and he emphasized what would be on exams pretty clearly for most of the semester. He's animated and seems to really care about the students' understanding of the subject.  Had a B+/A- all semester, but don't get comfy for the final: threw me for a loop.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I really don't understand the hate for Austin. He really seemed to know his stuff and was open to questions both in class and through office hours if you don't understand. Sometimes went fast. Used a bunch of different examples to explain concepts. Course wasn't really challenging, pay attention and study and youll be fine.  Offers practice exams.
Went to class once a week maybe and did fine. Go to lion tutors and your fine for the exams. Tries to be really relatable and sometimes its just weird

Austin may not be the most liked professor on campus, however it is clear that he cares about his students and their success, while his lectures may seem a bit scattered he provides plenty of resources for the student outside of class. Not my favorite class, but tolerable, success can be achieved if effort is put in.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This class is RIDICULOUS! Do not take this class with him. He only has two exams and a final. The questions are so confusing. Basically, if you learned one thing, it's different on the exam. Ruins your GPA!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I had a hard time paying attention in class.  Econ is not the most exciting subject to begin with and he didn't do much to change that. Exams are crazy hard, if you don't put more than 10 hours into studying you are screwed.  Homework and quizzes are easy and much needed points.  And once again, the exams suck.

Austin doesn't seem too popular but he gave good real life examples for everything that helped you work through any problem on the test. There's a lot of cushion with easy home works and quizzes and you have to study for the tests but nothing crazy.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: He's a great professor with a lot of energy. He keeps lectures interesting. You don't have to worry about the coursework a lot because he offers a lot of opportunities to make up points if you miss some class. Study for the tests and he tries to make himself really accessible to the students.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Tests were impossible. did not teach well, read straight off powerpoint.

Don't get me wrong, Austin's not the best professor by any means, but if you make an effort to understand what he's saying and not just blindly write everything in the course pack you'll pass. He gives plenty of extra credit, and getting full participation credit is easy. With this in mind you can pass with a C only getting a 60 on each exam.
Not very inspiring for students whose strong suit is not Econ. Nice person though. His teaching style doesn't serve as an effective ferry for ideas.
his examples make no sense at all. rambles on and on and its painful to hear him talk. 2 tests and a final and they're nearly impossible. don't take this professor if you're looking for an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Whether you're good or bad at Econ, Austin's class is very tough. He really knows a lot about the subject and really wants his students to love it too, but his examples aren't clear. The tests are insanely hard, your entire grade is pretty much 2 exams and a final, lots of people dropped the class. He expects everyone to understand everything.

If you're taking Econ 102 DON'T take Austins class. His lectures are extremely dry and boring and there is material on the exams that was never covered in class. He has his own course pack but it is not helpful in studying at all. I only used my textbook. If it wasn't for clicker points I wouldn't ever go to class because you don't learn anything.
Not a good professor, tests are extremely hard. can study for hours and still not do well on tests. guided study groups really help. gets mad when the whole class doesn't do well.
He's hard, his examples aren't the best, but he tries to keep it interesting and gives extra credit if  you volunteer for in class things. Tests are really hard though

Uses analogies to try to connect Econ topics to real life situations. These metaphors rarely make sense and he goes so far off on a tangent that you don't remember what he was even comparing it to. He's a tough grader and talks the entire class. He also relates things to sex a lot (thinking its funny)  which is actually really weird and uncomfy.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Austin is really cocky and not a very good professor. HIs tests are extremely hard and he is not very approachable if you are struggling and need help. The entire class is a heavy lecture and most of his examples do not make sense. Many people have had to drop his class. If you have the choice do not take Econ 102 with him!

Boyle is a nice guy, but not amazing at teaching. His explanations make no sense and almost everyone has trouble on his exams. I wish I knew how hard this class would be, a good portion of people had to drop it due to failing his exams. If youre going to take Econ102 don't take it with him!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--TEST HEAVY--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Solid prof. all things said. Interesting enough lectures, and he is an easy going guy. You have to attend every lecture because he gives pop quizzes and does clicker questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He's not the best professor I had, but he's fine. Honestly all the material I learned by myself and it didn't go will on exams, but the amount of extra credit he gave helped a lot.

Not the greatest teacher. He knows the material but he's not amazing at explaining it. He tries to relate it to real life examples and they just don't correlate. His exams are kinda tough and you definitely have to put in a good amount of studying, especially if you've never taken econ.

The class was alright. The tests are a little tough. You must study for them and pay attention in class. Easy to not pay attention at lectures and can affect your grade. Engages students in lectures. Online quizzes and homeworks. Easy to reach full credit for participation. Gives lots of extra credit

Great professor all around. Knows concepts very well, explains them well, and goes to extraordinary lengths to make sure his students do well. Also, the class isn't hard at all if you're reasonable competent as a student.

Personally, I hated Econ with a passion, but I loved Austin. He was the most chill professor I ever had. He makes the lectures as interesting as they can be. There are plenty of opportunities to pull your grade up, since he gives extra hw assignments. You have to study for tests but its not terrible.

Come on, Austin is a great guy. If you need help and go to him he will help you. If you do not understand a concept, he has a very great talent for dumbing it down without making you feel stupid. He also has a really cool YouTube channel where you can get help on material on the course. He uses great analogies to explain the course material too.
bad at explaining

Honestly, Austin was one of the best professors I've had. Very interactive and includes a lot of fun games and examples in his lectures. He really wants his students to do well as tries to get everyone to feel comfortable and earn as many points as possible.

I absolutely adored taking a class with Austin, his class is one of the reasons I'm majoring in econ. He's helpful and drops so many of your lowest grades. Do the work, go to class and you'll get an easy A. The exams are exactly like he says they will be and very similar to the practice.

Austin is a very nice professor, but if you never took economics in high school, you might struggle. You may think you understand the material but get to the exam and do poorly. The biggest problem I had was knowing what will and will not be on the exam, there was really no way for you to know. Study WAY ahead of time for success. Don't skip class!

Was told I was going to hate him, but I loved having him this semester. Easy to get full participation, he wants you to succeed and uses relatable examples in class, gives out extra credit, tests are alright (I should have studied more), and there are plenty of study materials
A very great and helpful professor. Lots of participation points available, so it's easy to get full participation points. Do the sample exams, homework , practice quizzes and you'll be fine.

At first I was told I would hate this class, but apparently Boyle has changed his teaching techniques. This was my favorite class this semester. He gave you everything you needed to succeed, and he was always available if you needed him. He explains things thoroughly and will relate concepts to your life, with examples, if you ask.

Great professor to have in my first semester of freshman year. He uses awesome examples to complement and lectures were entertaining and interesting to attend. Professor Boyle is hands down, the best professor I had in my freshman year, and will continue to be one of my favorites.

Literally the best Prof I have ever had. He makes class so much fun to the point where I actually wanted to go and looked forward to going all week! He has great stories and gives really great examples to help everyone understand and even gives out candy for participating in class! He gives a ton of opportunists to get the max participation points!
