The people rating her are dramatic. This course is an easy A if you show up and do the work (though yes, there can be many assignments / week). You are expected to speak in almost every class to answer questions and you cannot be on a device unless she allows it, but it is one of the easiest classes I've taken, and classes are sometimes on Zoom.

Betsy Campbell has been the absolute worst professor I have ever taken a class with. She creates a terrible classroom environment and can never teach for more than 2 minutes without calling someone out for being on their phone in a large lecture. I wish i had more characters left to describe more in depth just how horrible she is. Do not take her.

I agree with the one review that said that gave her a 4, saying her class is easy. This is true. However, her teaching antics and behavior towards students is extremely unlikable and almost unbearable. This class is tedious but an easy A. But as a professor, Betsy Campbell is the most unlikable I've ever had in PSU.
The lone person rating her a 4 might be her in disguise. Do not listen to that rating. Her class is unbearable. The cube microphone she throws out is the only highlight watching people dodge it.
guy who said she's a wonderful prof. blink twice if she's holding you hostage.
This professor has made this class insufferable

Not sure why everyone is so upset with her. She is tough sometimes but if you just pay attention you will be totally fine. She's very helpful and understanding if you go to office hours. Don't listen to anyone here, they are all just upset because they don't put in enough effort

Main focus of the class is to be a technology dictator. She is obsessed with telling students to put away technology and it takes away from the class. Content is not bad, however she utilizes this microphone foam box that she hurls across the room. Short answers don't cut it and she makes that clear. Honestly just an off putting environment.
There isn't anything I could say that hasn't been said already. Stay very far away.

Miserable class. Cares more about students being "focused" than on actually teaching. 0 electronics policy despite being an IST class. Cold calls on people, and will yell at students for having their phones out in front of everyone. She facilitates a terrible learning environment, don't take her. Worst part of my day.

Ms. Campbell is extremely rude to students and brings a type of negative energy to class that takes away from the learning environment. She makes kids want to not participate by her passive aggressive and judgmental comments and attitude. Coming to her class is the worst part of my day.
Could not ask for a worse teacher. She treats people like they are toddlers. Everyone hates her. Her TAs don't even know what to do because she is terrible at explaining anything.

Only been in class for 3 weeks and she is by far the worst professor I've ever had. She treats her students like they are in kindergarten. Worst professor ever and this class is very interesting. Sad this professor is ruining the class for me. Unfortunately I had to take this class so I couldn't switch but if you can DONT take with Betsy
Class is easy, but take anyone else if you can help it.
Don't take her

Do not take betsy if you can help it. At least 5 assignments due each week and sometimes they are large like research papers. She cold calls on at least 10 students to answer every question she asks in a 200 person lecture hall and embarrasses students who do not know the answer or repeat answers. She never knew what she was talking about.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: You don't need to show up to lectures. Everything can be done outside of class, and is relatively easy, its all straight forward and the TAs are more helpful. Workload is mainly tedious tasks, that flood my page. I DO NOT recommend Betsy, she cold calls and insists on participation for such a large class - she will not move on until someone talks.

At least 5 assignemnts due for her each week that are so boring and complicated for no reason. I am taking this class for my minor but nothing in this class applies to my major or what I want out of a class. She is rude and passive agressive. She doesnt take attendance but gets mad when no one shows up to class. The TA's are more helpful than her.

Betsy has made an easy course unbearable. She has an insane passive aggressive attitude and will do random cold calls. If you don't know the answer or are confused she will publicly embarrass you and call you lazy then go on about how we need to participate during her terrible lectures. Betsy spends more time calling us stupid then teaching. 0/10

Dr. Gerace is so nice and the best professor I've had at Penn State. Attendance is mandatory, but I found myself always looking forward to class. She provides outlines for the notes which was really helpful. She also gives out a study guide that makes it really clear what will be on the exams. The final was online and open note!

I loved Dr. Gerace so much that I am considering taking a class because she is the professor. We usually got out early, and her lectures are entertaining. She is also really funny and you can tell she cares about her students. There was no additional homework or reading – it was mainly based off exam and SONA credits.
She is a great teacher, we have 3 tests in the class and a bunch of easy textbook work, which takes no time at all.

Attendance not technically mandatory but does use TopHat points. Final is online asynchronous and two in-person tests. Really good at her lectures (makes them interesting and pertaining to our lives). All work, except tests, are in the online textbook program.

Really great class! She connects her lectures to relatable life experiences, making it easier to understand. She is very positive and you can really take a lot of out this class. I would take this class again if I could! She also prepares you well for exams

Class isn't bad at all, attendance is mandatory but you can miss up to 6 classes without losing points. Graded on textbook questions and 3 exams but it's really not bad and professor makes lectures super interesting.

She's very realistic and doesn't expect too much from students. Gives good, detailed study guides for the tests and the tests are all multiple choice. There is homework but it's maybe once a month and easy to get done quickly.

Wow, what do I say about this professor? Dr. G was one of the best psych professors up at Penn State ever she would give extra credit for Sona research points if you did extra studies and she would give out one extra credit assignment. Her first two exams are in person and slightly hard but manageable if you study. Final is online/open note

Lots of ways to earn extra credit. All graded assignments are through MindTap. 2 in person exams and 1 final which is online. Has outlines on canvas to fill out to study for the exams. Sometimes is hard to reach outside of class. Class can get boring at times. Wants her students to succeed.Talks about her kids a lot. Overall nice lady

Dr. Gerace is a lovely human being and a great professor. She is obviously very knowledgable and passionate about psychology and it shows during lectures. Classwork is very minimal and not at all difficult. Exams are slightly challenging and studying is required but 100% manageable and makes for a very easy gen ed.

I've had Dr. G twice now and she is genuinely the best and most caring professor I've ever had. She is brilliant, kind, and inspired me to pick up a psych minor. She is so understanding and accommodating and tells it how it is. I looked forward to her class every single day and never skipped once. I cannot recommend her enough, she is amazing!
genuinely the best professor i had at penn state!!! take this class!! Beth is so awesome and genuinely cares about her students SO MUCH.

Dr. G is genuinely the sweetest and kindest woman ever. PSYCH100 can be a lecture heavy class but she makes them so interesting, I had to take this class in order to graduate but it ended up being one of my favorite classes of the semester. It is so clear she loves her job and she is so understanding. Office hours help a lot if you are struggling!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: My favorite professor at Penn State. She story tells in her lectures and it makes it so much more interesting to listen to. I genuinely enjoy learning from her.

Dr. G was one of the best professors i had at penn state. She made lectures very entertaining and is very chill if any issues come up. She provides a note packet for each chapter. She has 2 in person exams and the final is online.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Why theres so much f homework.... I mean she gives grace period for extension of the work BUT thats because theres just too much.  Lots of people missed taking exams because there was just too much work to do.  Every week there are 7-8 assignment on average and each requires reading the textbook and some assignments are purely writing an essay
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: One of the best profs @psu. Psych 100 was very easy if you attend the lectures because she does top hat. Only 3 exams and they are easy if you study and the last one is online. She also offers extra credit

Kindest professor ever. She only does 2 exams, chp 1-6, then 7-12 of her OWN book, so cool. Super short chapters. BUT if you study the info, you absolutely will do well. She always adds a slight curve too. Class is literally therapeutic and you learn things that you will carry with you forever. You will not regret taking this class.

if you need to take ANY psych class, take it with Dr. Gerace. She is so incredibly understanding and her class is so easy. I personally like psychology, but this class was genuinely so light and an A is easily achievable if you do the bare minimum. I took this class as a gen ed and i highly recommend!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I absolutely loved her for PSYCH 100. She is an amazing professor and I looked forward to going to her class. Very easy to end with a good grade, just show up (participation counts as extra credit) and complete the homework. She gives a lot of time to do the homework and her exams are fairly easy. I highly recommend this course and this professor!

This was my first time ever taking a psychology exam, and Dr. Gerace made is enjoyable and interesting. You have 2 exams and the final is take home, so the exams are pretty easy if you just pay attention really. The only annoying thing about the class is the SONA points but just do them early so you don't have to stress. Other than that loved it!!
Such an amazing psychology instructor. Made me find psychology super interesting. I know some people that changed their major to psychology because of her.

Beth is a super nice lady, she makes classes interactive and entertaining! The only bad thing about the class is there are 2 exams (weighted heavily) which split up the material. The exams have a lot of material on them, so you need to study a good amount to do decent. However, the hw and assignments are easy, but attendance is mandatory. Love Beth

It was genuinely a pleasure showing up to her class every other day. She's incredibly personable when you need help, and her lectures are always engaging. She cares about her students and it shows. If you want to take Psych or need an easy credit, take this class for a low risk opportunity.

She is the absolute best. She makes lectures very interesting and is hilarious. She offers soooo much extra credit through sona and gives very direct study guides for the exams. Final is online and open note as well
beth gerace is the best, so chill, specifically psych 243 is such an easy class, tophat attendance, she cares a lot, she gives curves, and gives a lot of time before tests to study. 10/10
She was awesome. Psychology isn't something I love but she made it so interesting. She is also rly funny and will make you laugh. Definitely take her class.

definitely the best psych professor at university park, she made every lecture actually interesting, and when you actually studied, the exams were pretty simple. often let us out of class early, was extremely understanding if a situation were to occur. as long as you attend the lectures, take notes and study, will definitely pass, trust.
Professor Gerace is so hilarious, relatable, and super understanding. Her lecture style makes it really easy to retain and remember information. I always wanted to come to class.

She is so funny and very easy to connect with. Super lecture heavy which got boring sometimes. The exams were difficult which were in person and on paper except for the final which was online. Lots of extra credit but hard to get your grade back up if you don't do great on exams.

She is amazing! She gives lecture notes and study guides to help you succeed. She is super funny and makes the content interesting! She is super easy to connect with; Her and the TA's will help you anytime you need them. She offers extra credit which is a nice grade booster. I absolutely recommend her if you have to take an intro psych class!

Great professor who was funny and shared personal stories that connected with class. The lectures were really interesting but could get long (often got out early tho). There was a good amount of reading outside of class plus having to participate in SONA research. Lots of extra credit though and exams were online and open-note. Would take again!

Great professor who was hilarious and very passionate + knowledgable about the subject. The lectures were really interesting and engaging at times (often got out early). There was a good amount of reading outside of class as well as having to participate in SONA research for credit. Lots of extra credit though and exams were online and open-note.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Best class by far, very easy course. All exams are online, but it's nice to show up to lectures for extra credit on some days. You have to do SONA, but you get extra credit for doing additional studies. One of my favorite professors by far. If you need to take PSYCH 100 for your major or a gen ed, don't take anyone else.

Best professor I have ever had. I loved every second of her lectures and looked forward to her class i am so serious. She is absolutely hilarious and talks to the class like we are best friends gossiping. she has amazing stories for everything and really loves what she teaches. the exams are straightforward and minimal homework. I already miss it.

Absolutely loved her, she genuinely cares about her students and their learning. She always makes lectures interesting and engaging, telling stories from her personal life, and her time as a crisis counselor as well as her time as a professor. 100% recommend taking PSYCH100 with her, exams are online on canvas.

This was my last class out of 4 back to backs on Tuesdays and Thursdays, and as exhausted as I was, I looked forward to going because she made the material fun and engaging. She also spoke to us like we were her friends, which made everything feel a lot more personal. Simple assignments, chapter quizzes, a group midterm and a final exam. TAKE HER!

I love this woman. Her class was so inspirational and she talks to us like we're her best friends. Everyday I left this class feeling good about the world. That could be because its basically a class on how to be happy, but I also think Prof Gerace is just an amazing woman

The professor herself is very nice and offers opportunities for you to improve your grade. But this class is not open book/notes on exams. You must use the universities proctoring system for exams and they are difficult, regardless whether you read the assigned reading material (which is heavy)/complete the homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: A great professor to take this class with. She is super nice and truly cares about students. The exams are online/open note and the homework doesn't take long and is pretty spaced out so it's never too much. You have to complete SONA credits but can receive them all by doing online surveys. She offers tons of extra credit. Great professor!

Dr. Gerace never failed to make me genuinely laugh, I loved attending her lectures because she engages everyone, provides amazing examples to help us understand the material better. mindtap quizzes/hw relatively easy, SONA can be annoying but tons of extra credit is offered, exams are fair cause she provides us w useful notes. one of my fav profs!!

Dr. G is a really fun and kind prof who gives interesting lectures and lets class out early almost every day. Her exams are open note and on canvas, and much easier than some other psych 100 classes. I took this as a gen ed and it was a good experience.
The sweetest woman ever. Exams and quizzes were online. A class I looked forward to attending. Dr. Gerace was very caring and kept lectures entertaining. LOVE LOVE LOVE

She's a phenomenal psych professor! Overall this class was pretty easy because all the exams were open note and she was a really understanding teacher.  There's also multiple opportunities to receive extra credit as well so make sure to be on a look out for that!!

Dr. Gerace was one of the best teachers I have ever had. She is so understanding and overall just a great person. She is very easy to approach and really cares about her students. The tests are not hard as long as you go to lectures and they are all online and open note. I HIGHLY suggest taking this class with Dr. Gerace

My favorite professor ever!! Attending class is important but she makes lecture very interesting and has note guides to follow along. Very little homework is assigned and minimal studying time is needed for exams if you go to class and pay attention. She truly cares about her students and also gives extra credit for attendance sometimes.

Literally the nicest lady ever and tells stories about herself that are related to class and educational. You can really tell she cares about her students. Make sure you start to SONA studies early and if you do above the required amount you get extra credit. Exams are pretty straight forward. Will randomly give extra credit for coming to class.
She is amazing at relating the content to real life examples. The exams are also fair and are somewhat easy if you pay attention in class.
Amazing. The best professor that I think I will ever have. You need to take a class with her. She made class to easy to enjoy and made me actually want to go. I love her!
She was the best! She let us out early, fascinating lectures, and relatively light coursework. I learned a lot and really enjoyed this course.

I really enjoyed Dr. Gerace's teaching for the time I went to class in person, but honestly that only lasted about 2 weeks. Lecture outlines can be filled out by reading the textbook, and this saved me so much time compared to going to class. The exams are online and open note, so I really didn't find a reason to go to class in person.

I absolutely adore this woman. She goes above and beyond to make class interesting through anecdotes and videos. Classwork is very manageable with long deadlines to allow for flexibility. She was always conscious of students even if that meant ending class early or opening exams early. Similarly, all exams were open note and on canvas.
She makes her class fun and enjoyable. Her slides make it easy to study for the exams because she makes guided notes that go along with them. I really liked her class and would 100% take her again.
Professor Gerace made this class legitimately interesting and extremely interactive. I hope to have her again!

Gerace tried to make her lectures as interesting as possible and did not give too much homework. The workload was very manageable. There were 4 exams that were all on canvas which I believe is how she plans to keep it in the future as well. Each exam got progressively easier and the content was interesting.

She was literally the funniest professor I've had, she talks to the class like were her best friends and her lectures are so fun. She makes you answer tophat questions but they're posted if you couldnt attend class. She gives you note outlines to fill in words. No exams except the final that was online open note.  Assignments not hard at all

I love Professor Gerace! She is so funny and makes the lectures enjoyable. She made content interesting and the tests weren't too hard. She also gave easy homework and Sona studies to help give a grade boost. I would recommend!
Lectures were super interesting and exams were open note. She makes psych easy to connect to with personal anecdotes and examples. Super easy gen ed

Fun professor who explains the material well. She really tries to help students and keep class light and fun. Attendance is not mandatory but it helps, and the lectures are interesting. Workload is pretty minimal and exams are online.

Gerace was one of the best professors I had despite the class being a 300+ person lecture. She really formed relationships with students that cared, she was very passionate, and overall just a really sweet woman. Would take her class again and recommend others take psych100 with her!

Professor Gerace is such an awesome professor. She makes the lectures entertaining and interesting. Not much homework. An online textbook is necessary because there are assignments in the textbook. Note-taking is important to succeed especially because the exams are open notes. Overall, great professor, I would definitely take her again.

Dr. Gerace relates her lectures to real life situations which often include funny stories from her own life. Attendance is not mandatory and she uploads lecture recordings to Canvas. Graded assignments are taken through the e-textbook and are easy with plenty of time to complete and there are 3 Exams that are all multiple choice. Take this class!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Graded by few things--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I loved being in Professor Gerace class. I would honestly take her class again. I highly suggest her!
Super easy psych class. All tests online and open note
A very nice and fun professor. Class is easy you just have to take notes during her lectures.

Beth is a great professor! She was very engaged with us during class and her exams were relatively easy. She had interesting stories and would share videos that went along with the content of the lectures

Dr. Gerace is the sweetest soul. She loves what she does and it is evident. She cares about the well-being of her students. I loved how she engaged with her students even when the class was with 300+ people. Take this class. We love her!!!!!!
Dr. Gerace was very nice and very personable. The exams were open note and online. She is fairly flexible and understanding. Dr. Gerace also offers extra credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: When I took this class in Fall 2021, the tests were on all on Canvas uhhh that's all I'm gonna say about that. Dr. Gerace is a fantastic teacher with real-world experience! She tends to really FLY through the chapters, so don't expect to get a deep understanding of the material.
Great choice for psych 100. Tests were a little difficult, but they are open notes so if you take notes you should be fine. Easy class overall.

I love Dr. Gerace. She is one of the kindest professors I know. Her lectures are never boring and she is very interactive with the class (plays music every class, asks us if we have questions, etc.). She is so knowledgable with this material. As long as you do the readings and MindTaps, you are sure to succeed in this class!
The class never heard from her, and she was also unresponsive. I was looking forward to taking a class from her because I had read the positive reviews, but she was completely absent from our class.

Beth is amazing! Her lectures are really interesting and its clear how knowledgeable she is and how much she loves teaching. She even managed to make zoom school tolerable! The study guides she posts before the exams are really helpful, as are the lectures outlines we have to complete.

I loved her class. She really enjoys teaching and made it easy to learn the material. She is super funny and made the best out of having class on Zoom. She is really understanding and wants her students to do good! there are extra credit opportunities as well. if you have the option to take her, DO IT!

I LOVE her. She's so funny and real. She often gets side tracked, but it honeslty helps you to remember the material better and break up a long class. There were lots of chances for extra credit and the exam weren't very hard. Defintely take her.

Dr. Gerace is a fun professor. I will definitely miss classes with her. She knows a lot about psychology and does an excellent job at explaining it. She does get side tracked a lot, which is okay especially for a class online since we all get distracted through zoom. Definitely recommend taking her thought. She will leave a lasting impact.

This is my second class with Beth. I absolutely love her!! She's very knowledgable about the subject and always has a fun story to tell. The exams are a little difficult - you just need to study! There was a group project at the end of the semester (instead of a final exam).. It was a little annoying especially with class being online.

Requested instructor based on previous reviews. All mentioned great lectures. Not one of the lectures was recorded by the instructor. The class was online (COVID). All other reviews I now noticed were in person. Not a PSU World Campus caliber instructor. Not a good investment. Disappointed.

Dr. Gerace was amazing. She was so funny and caring, as well as knowledgeable. Psych 270 with her was so fun, even though it was online. There's a little homework and for the test you just need to study a little bit. Definitely take a class with her, I would again because I miss her.
Amazing professor!! would take her class again
LOVE HER!!!!! Amazing professor and you can tell she truly cares about her students. She is one of the best professors I have had at Penn State and would 100% take another one of her classes!

I genuinely love Dr. Gerace. She is such a sweet person, and a caring professor. Her lectures were enjoyable and interesting. The class is very test heavy, and you have to study if you want to do well and get an A. I would take a class with Gerace any day.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Gerace is amazing! She cares about students and lectures are informative and fun. She manages to teach a lot of information without making it overwhelming. I took her class during the covid transition to online learning and she adapted well and was extremely understanding of students' personal situations.

Dr. Gerace tells you exactly what you have to do to get an A at the beginning of the semester. She uses her own experiences as examples in class. Her exams are easy if you come to lecture, take the quizzes, and study. You technically need the online textbook for the weekly quizzes, but you won't have to read it to pass.

Lectures and memorization-heavy will help in exams. Her examples and experiences dealing with psych disorders helps in understanding abnormal psych and retaining in the long term. Interest in the subject matter is important to do well, with a basic scientific/biological understanding. Bio-psych with social/environmental aspect-heavy subject

Beth was easily my favorite prof this semester, she went out of her way to make sure we had transitioned well to online learning due to covid Lectures are engaging and fun For a gen-ed I found myself looking forward to this class often. She gives multiple opportunities for extra credit and even extended a few deadlines. I'll miss Beth next semester
She is a very nice woman. The homework was very nice and attendance is not mandatory. The tests are not hard if you study and the content is very interesting.

Professor G is an awesome person and makes class interesting. Attendance is not mandatory and all your homework is on MindTap which is an easy A for homework. She also gives you a lot of extra credit opportunities. Tests are very fair too as long as you study some you will be fine.
Genuinely cares about her students. She was very lenient with deadlines and graded fairly! I loved being in her class. Attendance was graded.

I'm a psych major and I took her class for psych 100. She is the best professor I've had at Penn State so far. Her lectures are engaging and she uses real-life examples to help you remember the material. The exams aren't too bad as long as you study the notes and the cengage questions and she gives tons of extra credit in class for attendance.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Beth is an amazing professor!! Highly recommend this class as a gened. The notes are given in an outline, review a couple days before exams and you're good. So many other opportunities for easy points it is impossible to fail. Also she keeps her lectures very interesting and funny!

Prof. Gerace is SUCH a good teacher. Her lectures are super enjoyable and she actually teaches the test material. She's a "teaching" teacher or whatever, so her students have to do relatively well for her to keep her job, and she teaches accordingly. You definitely need to study for exams, though. I highly recommend, but it is not an easy gen-ed.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: My favorite professor I have had! I honestly miss her class, her lectures are very interesting and she has so much humor involved in it as well.

She randomly will take attendance, giving extra credit to those who showed up, so plenty of opportunities between that and SONA! She is super nice and drops some of your lowest scores. Beth is a great professor, I loved her lectures!

The class introduces a lot of theories and the majority of the grade is based off of the test. The study guide was way to long and it was a distraction. The professor does not respond to questions about the course. Even though I passed the class, I can't recommend the professor if you need clear direction.

Beth is such an amazing professor, I am definitely taking another one of her classes. 4 exams including a final. All tests are based off of class lectures which are fill in the blank notes that you print out. SONA was the only annoying thing about the class but every psych 100 class must do it. Tons of extra credit and easy to understand material.
Amazing teacher. Keeps the class fun and interesting. Psych is a lot because of all the memorization needed but Gerace keeps it intriguing so you are not too bored in class.

Dr. Gerace is by far my favorite professor at Penn State. I had her for PSYCH 100 and 270 now and I want to take more with her. She is hilarious and gives the best examples to help you understand the subject material. She gives you a note guide to fill in from her lecture. The homework is very easy and the tests are straightforward!

Dr. Gerace's class was my favorite class this semester. She makes the lectures so interesting and funny and occasionally gives extra credit for coming to class. Exams aren't hard if you study. Can't recommend her enough!

Dr. Gerace is one of the best teachers I have had at Penn State thus far. Her lectures are clear and her humor helps to make the class interesting and entertaining. She also uses great examples that help me to remember class material. Grading is based mostly on exams and occasional homework

Beth is an AMAZING professor. She is very funny and keeps the lectures very interseting throughout the entire class. She gives great examples to help you understand the concepts even more and often times gives extra credit for just showing up to class. Exams are very easy as long as you go to class.
Formally known as Beth Lebetron!
Dr. Walters is so sweet and truly caring. You may have a hard time staying ingaged in lecture if you do not appreciate the content, but if you do, she is definitely a good and informative professor.
Everything Amazing in this class! Dr. Walters is very interesting and kind and friendly and wonderful! She taught us to celebrate humanity and love, and... she actually does!!!!!!!

Dr. Walters is a wonderful professor and an even nicer person. Very knowledgeable and cares for her students. Attendance is mandatory but it will benefit you by being present for lectures as many of the artifacts discussed in class will be on the quizzes/exams. As long as you pay attention and review your notes, you will succeed in this course.

she's so so sweet but a bit lost. if you talk to her, she'll love you. she rambles and can't keep a train of thought but that's something i'm familiar with so i usually could follow. she's not great with technology but she does know her stuff and she's incredibly lenient with dates. if you need a hardset course don't take this, but its an easy ride

Super easy class i barely went and got an A+. Teacher is so super sweet and old and wants you to learn. she gives extra credit and as long as you do the work you will get an A. she doesn't make sense when she talks 90% of the time but still chill class.

All of these reviews that are giving "awful ratings" are comical. She has a super easy class and although not tech savvy; produces a well-rounded class. Minimal studying, minimal work, and papers get graded generously. I have taken two classes with her for various credits. Highly recommend.

She was so hard to understand!! She definitely speaks English but nothing she says ever makes sense. Also if you miss class more than 2 times she drops you a letter grade. Please take any other class than this.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment:
Seems like a nice person but she makes absolutely zero sense. If you're a STEM major or just not all that interested in Art History, I highly suggest you take a different class for Art. 

Lectures are unorganized streams of consciousness.

she's really a lovely person and i very much enjoyed the class, but she was hard to understand most of the time (live or over email) and we had quite a few tech struggles throughout the semester. that being said, her grading policy is very lenient and she extended deadlines often (just about daily.) i went from a C- to an A+ in the last week.

She's so sweet you guys, she really is. BUT you won't understand a single thing she says, EVER. 3 "quizzes", maybe 3 assignments, tons of extra credit and really doesn't care when you turn things in. She once shared her screen and had 400+ unread canvas messages. Her lectures go on forever. Learned nothing, but we had a good laugh in the GroupMe.

Prof. Walters is one of my most memorable professors so far. She has such a spunky personality and is so fun to talk with, and she seems truly passionate about her subject. She never failed to make class and laugh smile with her wit whether she realized or not. She provided many extra credit opportunities and easy assignments with flexible rules.

Dr. Walters was absolutely fantastic. I've seen reviews where people say she is unprepared but her ability to discuss monument after monument in class is unparalleled. If you show up to class, listen, and take notes, you will get an A. She offers up a lot of extra credit, even for in-class quizzes, so it's important to be there. Would take again!

This Lady is an absolute Saint. Always willing to help and tries to make the class as easy as possible. Very passionate about what she teaches and it shows with her presentations. 10/10 would recommend

Dr. Walters is at times extremely hard to follow and its hard to understand what's expected of you - just ask/talk to the TA instead. There's a ridiculous amount of extra credit (20%) thats extremely easy to get. 12 page paper (20%), 3 exams (20% ea), attendance (10%). Overall definitely not a hard class, but Dr. Walters is a bit silly.

Crazy woman, calls herself mommy. possibly the best elective to take though because 3 credits for an A. Go to class and write down what she says, the power points are impossible to follow and don't make sense so DO NOT rely on them. gives pop quizzes for extra credit. also gives extra credit on essay tests
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: She's a very nice person, very passionate about her lectures. Her powerpoints are a bit unclear, but she posts them online, which helps a lot. Attendance isn't mandatory, but a few extra credit opportunities are given during class. Extra credit in this class could raise your grade 15 points, I'd consider it an easy A because of that.

The class this year had up to 15% worth of extra credit points up for grabs, so by the time finals came I only needed a 40% to get an A. Class is unique and interesting, but she doesn't have very clear lectures/powerpoints which make it somewhat confusing. Don't need to go to class, but the extra credit points are given out during a few lectures
lowered my average a whole 10 points for attendance, bad class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Lectures are pretty boring. She is very knowledgeable and nice but is a very poor teacher. 2 tests with a monument info day and an essay day. Monument day is rough, two pics are shown on projector for less than five minutes, you must write down all info and move on when she switches it. 5 page paper on monument of your choosing, horrible.

Dr. Walters seems like a caring person who is knowledgeable in her field, but she is a terrible professor. Her lectures and notes are confusing as they're not given in structured sentences. It's also worth mentioning that she is zany and quirky. She has called herself "Mommy" in class twice now, it's a bit uncomfortable. I don't recommend her.

She's a very intelligent lady, but not a very adept professor. I had no idea what to expect going into the first exam... the format was weird and hard to work with for the first one. Her lectures are either very interesting or a complete snooze fest, depending on the day. However, she really wants to see her students learn, not just memorize.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Fab

Dr. Walters is a great person. She's caring and passionate about the subject material. However, she is not a good teacher. She's scatterbrained and doesn't know how to make effective powerpoints. It's not hard to get an A, but the material is boring and lengthy so be prepared to study. Just pray you get a good TA and show up.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Hilarious

reviews.comment: nice but crazy. she's very passionate about what she teaches. tests are memorization. you have to go to class  but she posts the powerpoints online. powepoints also make no sense. never knew my grade in the class

Dr. Walters is an extremely nice lady, and she definitely knows what she is talking about.  Unfortunately, she has no idea how to teach.  If it is just for gen-ed or you don't care to learn anything, you're fine.   But, if it is for your major, I would highly recommend not taking her class.

Very scatterbrained. It's an easy A class once you figure out what she wants. Here's a hint: on the essay exams, she doesn't want you to actually write an essay! Each essay should only be three paragraphs. In the first sentence, state each monument's relationship to the prompt. For the rest of the paragraph: ignore prompt; vomit info on monument.

She is a very quirky, yet vibrant person. Most of your notes will be more of what she says than what is on her slides because her slides are too vague. The quizzes are very straight forward and she gives extra credit on those as well as the exams. Course reserves should be used as a supplement, not to skip class. Exams are 2 written essays.

I have never met a more reasonable or helpful teacher! She loves what shes does and can get side tracked. Go to class and take notes ( it's in the syllabus). If you take notes and make connections it's easy to pass. She cares about what you've LEARNED. :-) If you don't show up then you miss out on extra credit and will need to study more at night.
Easy A. Very long lectures and scattered info. She's not out to harm your gpa and will help if you go to her.

I was so afraid after the first day of class because she was all over the place, but I stuck with it and she turned out to be great. She is always willing to help and lets you redo papers until you get an A. Tests were very doable. Lots of extra credit opportunities. Defiantly take any class offered with her! She is passionate about teaching too!

I guess she is too good at her field that makes her talking too much about the crazy details that students don't care. She directs a project that goes to Egypt to actually dig stuff which not that many ppl in the get to do. Talk to her if you have difficulty she will actually help you and give you better grade if you improve.
Crazy person.  Nice, but clearly crazy.
Easy, but classes are so boring. She is also loopy.

I'm honestly shocked that she received such bad reviews. Yes her lectures are all over the place, but she obviously loves her topic and is a very easy grader. Although the class is a little boring, it requires a very minimal amount of work to receive a good grade.
Very random in thoughts and lectures, hard to understand where she's going with everything. Takes tangents frequently. Grading isn't to hard, but you will mostly be teaching yourself.

Dr. Walters is extremely nice and passionate about her work. However, during her lecture, she is very scatter-brained and often rambles, which can make sitting through class hard. Exams are more like quizzes and her grading is easy.

I really enojoyed this class, I think attendance is worth alot.  She likes participation but won't force it.  Studying is pretty much all memorization, I always started studying two nights before and got an A.  I recommend this class for satisfying the international GA

Really liked this teacher. She knows her stuff, she's interesting. Her only downfall is she likes to talk A LOT and sometimes she will ramble and get carried away. But hey most pple do that when they get excited about something. Got a 98 on a paper about Stonehenge I wrote for her. know images and dates, you'll do fine
I highly highly recommend her, such an asset to the art history department!
Love this woman, best professor ever. Highly recommended.

Very caringhard to keep up with the workings of a genious mind, but who cares - she helps you along and makes sure your grades reflect your effort (REALLY bumps you up if you need it and deserve it). All it takes is consitent effort and honesty to impress her.

Not horrendous, she has a great heart if you get to know her. She's so passionate. She'll spend the entire 1:15 class on two pieces of work. Before the exams, she posts all of the slides, and just memorize them. That's it. Don't need to come to class, just prepare for a couple hours on wikipedia. Cared about having you succeed. Recommended.
The class is pretty easy, all you have to do in b.s. your essays on the test. She is pretty much crazy and has no idea what is going on, you really don't learn nething from her.
This professor is terribly boring and the class is horrible.
If you study for tests, you can do very well, but she is very unorganized and is impossible to get in touch with.  Also, your better if the TA's do the grading rather than her.

Walters is a nice and helpful professor, but way too  much work for a gen-ed. too much to study for, and all the tests are open ended so there are no definate answers. TAs grade all the exams and they are ****es when it comes to grading. A lot of extra credit is offer, but I would not recommend this class.

don't take this class unless it's required. she's the most scatterbrained and outright weird person i've ever spoken with. its impossible to compile organized notes to her random lectures. just trust me and do not take this class.

Worst teacher ever. Extremely unclear, throws absurd amounts of information at you, and frequently gives you the WRONG version of history, so you have to learn her warped little history. Her TAs do the grading, so throw any hope of a good grade out the window. Her attendance system is online, so say goodbye to that grade too. Stay away from her!

Art H 201...Horrible...for exam 2..15 sites were covered in 15 days.  Had to memorize the name, year built (exact), location and about 100 other nitty gritty details.  Each site has about 6 pictures and you basically have to know them all.  She also constantly goes off an tangents.  I put more time into this GA than i do for my core classes.

she's nice but completely scatterbrained... grading was completely up to the TAs, and some of them were really strict.. however, people started to complain, so she graded the last exam herself and basically just booted everyone's grades up.  i just read from the book and studied the monuments list and i was alright, but it was realllly stressful.
nicest woman in the world. easy grader.

I had art hist. 112 at Hazleton campus, and it was really good. Once I entered this class I ended up hating art history! She did not teach us anything during lecture because she's very unorganized and scatter-brained. You have to read all of the material on your own to learn it for the test, and the tests were hard too.

Unless you want to learn about her little slave children in Egypt don't take this class. She's is a complete idiot whose TA's petitioned to remove her from the class because she was so awful. Stay away!!!
very disorganized and unclear. she's crazy.. in a bad way, and incredibly annoying. tests are hard, and you have to teach yourself the material. stay away from this one!

She is one of the worst professors I have ever had.  I should be able to hand in work that is just as inconhrehensible and disorganized as her lectures were.  The best time I had in her class was when she left for a week and a half.

she couldn't figure out how to turn the lights off in sparks the other week, she also missed her office hours, doesn't answer e-mail and is one of the most absent minded people i've ever met.  I like the class, I just wish we had a different prof.

it all depends on the TA you get; i learned more from the week the TAs taught class than i did the entire semester from Walters. some TAs are rough, some easy... good luck. don't take the class unless you have to, or at least find a clearer prof.
She sucks

If you're non-major, don't take this class for gen ed. If this is your major, find a good prof. Not hard material, but she's totally unclear about writing assignments in the syllabus. Example: explicitly says use one source for a paper, but says after grading that meant AT LEAST one. You'll see how jumbled her brain is if you look at the syllabus.
No Comments
i really liked this class. its def one you dont want to schedule early cause you have to go to know the material. tests are not too bad, depending on how ta's grade
worst class ever.. she's completely confusing and obsessed with her own dig site instead of course material.. definitely neurotic.  avoid this professor!!!
This was the worst class I've ever taken.  She's completely unorganized, jumps around so much when giving notes that you have no clue what shes talking about.  Avoid this class at all costs.

This woman is wacked. Unorganized amd goes off on tangents in her lecture. Frequently talking for 15 minutes while u take extensive notes then saying u wont be held responsible for what she just said. Good note taking is essential. Dont waist ur time with this class she is nuts.

She is completely obsessed with architecture and i think forgets she is teaching a class and often just rambles about things. Lots of interesting facts and tests aren't too bad. Just hope the TA's don't make blurry slides or else she goes berserK.
Neurotic. Seems ready to blow

Three things to know: 1) She suffers a severe case of Attention Deficit Disorder. Her lectures lack any clarity, chronology, or reasonable organization. 2) She distains the Architecture department as a whole, and intentionaly scheduled a pop quiz during an Architecture field trip. 3) Cat Fish Drll.

This class isn't difficult as long as you are willing to put the study time into it.  There ia alot of memorization.  She tends to dwell on Egypt a lot and gets distracted, but she is willing to help and very nice.  A little Disorganized...but worthwile.
willing to help, but don't wouldnt recommend the class
No Comments
Slightly dotty yes, disorganized no. I found her enthusiasm so contagious that I picked up an Art History minor. Lots of memorization, deeply worth it.
Do not take this class unless you must. She is completely unorganized.

He is so sweet and you can tell he loves his job. However, his tests are extremely difficult and I feel like I can never do well on them regardless of how much I study. Also there is barely any grades in this class so if you do bad on one thing your grade is tanked. I think we had like 6 grades in the gradebook by the end of the course.

He is literally so sweet and kind plus really knows what he's talking about. There are 4 exams and one project. The first and final exam are in the classroom with the other two done in Pollock. Lowkey the exams are hard but he gives lots of resources. Make sure to go through the study guides they help a lot. But a lot of the questions are wack.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: this man is adorable and so educated. the class is enjoyable, but you have to go for points (which is literally so easy just go). and then you have one easy project and 3 exams. the exams are literally just the study guide and he gives you lots of the multiple choice answers in class during review (exact questions).
Best professor I've ever had.

Great prof and a great introductory course to advt! He has tons of industry experience under his belt and is very very up-to-date on current events- which makes the class fun since he's an older guy. 4 (easy) exams, 1 quiz, 1 "project" and attendance is your grade- not difficult. I'd take another one of his classes in a heartbeat- don't hesitate!

Professor Birschbach is amazing. There are 3 tests and a final which isn't cumulative. He gives a study guide for each one with exactly what you need to know on it, and he also gives the answers to test questions in class. There is one project and one quiz which are also really easy. There's  tophat attendance but you can get the code from someone.

Professor B has to be the most caring and funniest professor i have ever came across i really enjoyed his class all i would say is pay attention and use the TA she is super helpful but overall easy class i would say

Great professor! I learned a lot from his class. There are 4 exams (which includes the final) and 2 other assignments. I thought the course was very straightforward and the exam content matched exactly what we had learned in class. Definitely would recommend!

He is my favorite professor so far. He is so funny and sweet and you can tell he loves what he does. This class was easy but so interesting and I loved going to class because he made lectures fun. The tests are easy and he fully gives you the answers for the questions on the exam word for word in class. Highly recommend.

He is a pretty chill guy. He is really funny because he is older but still keeping up with the times, so he does things like say Cardi B's "okurrr" during lectures and shows funny commercials. Exams aren't difficult but sometimes the questions are worded weirdly. Honestly just pay attention and go to class and you're going to be fine.

Loved Professor Birshbach, however he is a tough grader and does not give feedback. ATTENDANCE IS MANDATORY so double and triple-check that top hat recorded your attendance, the service in forum is horrible and it may not have saved, I had proof that I was there but some of my days didn't save in top hat and he will not do anything even with proof.

Choose Birschbach! I really enjoyed this class - it was easy, interesting, and I learned a lot from it. Your grade is only made up of exams, one quiz, one assignment, + attendance, which I preferred to a homework-heavy class. He also uses topical & relevant examples in his lectures, which I thought made things fun.
He is such a good teacher. He cares about what he does and wants his students to succeed. His lectures are interesting, and his exams aren't too tough if you put in the work.

Birschbach is such a genuinely great professor. My only complaint is attendance, however, his lectures are interesting. He has such a big heart and you can tell he loves what he is doing. I would take this class again for sure. I honestly wish I could have another class with him because he is perfect.
Really good professor, cares about the work he does and the students he teaches.

He's a nice professor, but he doesn't give feedback on ANYTHING. He also doesn't respond to emails. 9 assignments, 2 quizzes. They were never long, but everything was out of 6 or 8 points, which was really frustrating because he's so subjective. The final portfolio was out of 24, though, so there was more room for mistakes.

Mark is great! Super personable and the class is relatively easy. Attendance is part of your grade but he's very flexible. Mostly made up of tests but you are given a study guide that basically has same questions on the test as shared in class.
He is funny and his lectures are enjoyable. This class is very easy for a 300 level course. He is kind and helpful. If it is not for I changed my major, I would def take more of his classes.

Mark is a very personable guy, very entertaining if you're interested in learning about how advertising works. Class is insanely easy, tests all have study guides and there are often questions that are phrased wrong in the exams. That means you often get free points from error on the professor's half. Solid class, easy elective.

Pretty easy A, make sure to attend classes as attendance is required and look over the slides before exams. Lectures are enjoyable as well and he uses examples pretty often in them. Class is made up of four exams (based on slides), a small project and a mini quiz before finals so as long as you go to class and pay attention, you should do fine!

Easy A. Content was actually interesting and relevant. The professor made the class entertaining and easy to understand. There's one assignment during the entire semester, and a few exams + one quiz throughout. I would 100% recommend this class.

Such a sweet professor. The only assignments for the class were 4 exams (in person), one quiz and one written assignment which was just a paragraph creating our own commercial. Attendance counts for a big chunk of the class, and the exams are pretty simple, but you'll still have to study. Caring guy, and an easy A. Take him if you can.

I LOVE THIS MAN! He made this class super interesting and he is super sweet and funny. Having good attendance is super important because the only assignments given are 4 exams, a quiz, and a project. He gives back points on every quiz/ exam, so it is not hard to do well. I definitely will try and take him again for my future Advertising classes.
he is a careful teacher with wonderful lecture! So many curve on the exams to help you get a good results!

When I say tough grader, he's not the worst. He just never gives feedback on anything. He posts slides sometimes. He brings in coffee, kitkats and other things that we are working on writing advertisements for. He's generally a very nice professor and he's pretty chill. Gives you class time to work. I suggest taking him if you take this class.
Pretty easy course, just watch for attendance since it is required. As long as you take the time to review the lecture slides and understand the review questions before every exam you will do well
Mark is super nice and sweet. Attendance is graded so go to class. Overall he is really nice and I would recommend. His lectures are kinda boring but not bad!

I took comm320 and 421W with Mark, I loved both classes and he is such a sweet & nice guy which honestly makes a huge difference when going to a professor for feedback/advice, I felt so comfortable talking to him and ended up really proud of my final portfolio in 421W. Definitely take these classes with him if you have the chance!

This class is all common sense and if you half pay attention in class you'll be fine. Just use his review powerpoints and you'll have no issues with the tests. The setup of the class sucks because it's exam heavy but the material is so easy that it doesn't really matter. Really sweet guy who cares about his students and gives helpful career advice.

I truly enjoy advertising, it runs in my family. But I had a horrible experience with this man. He doesn't answer emails nor does he show up to his prescheduled office hours (the ones that are stated on the syllabus) not even on exam days. He reads right off his slides, I could read them off my computer and learn just as much. Don't recommend folks

I love him. So caring of students and really wants us to do well. I had to go into office hours to take a quiz and he really made an effort to get to know me, even though it's a huge class. Exams are exactly like the study guides. Only hard part of this one random quiz that was difficult, but he let everyone retake it. 10/10.

Professor Birschbach is so cute and caring of his students. Attendance is mandatory and the lectures can be boring but he is such a nice caring guy. I would definitely take a class with him again. The exams are not hard and he reviews a-lot before them, Definitely take class with him!!

Marks lectures can be difficult to follow because he jumps around and moves quickly, but he straight up tells you word for word what questions will be on the exams. 3 exams, 1 quiz, and 1 group project. Exams and quiz are multiple choice and very straightforward. Attendance is 22% of total grade. Go to class, take notes and you will pass with ease.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He's nice and caring, but his feedback is vague and he grades based entirely on his personal opinion of what ads should be. You're only graded on a handful of assignments, and you lose half a percent off your grade for each class skipped. And since this a 2-hour class where most of the time is just a work period, it can get tempting to skip.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: Nice guy. Attendance isn't mandatory, but you'll have trouble if you skip. Most of the exam questions are like "Which of the following is True/False?" and has 4 options so it's almost like 1 test question is made up of 4 different questions. Even with the open-note exams, you need to somewhat know the material so you don't run out of time.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is good about giving us all the information, but clicks through lectures very quickly and offers very little time during exams. Attendance is not mandatory but if you do not attend class, you will not do well.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Just finsihed taking exam 3 for Birschbach and all I have to stay is avoid this class if it is not required for your major. Most of your grade consists of four exams and weekly participation questions. That being said, if you bomb an exam, your grade is going to drop. Material isn't hard, he just gives very limited time to answer exam questions.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Mr Birschbach is one of the best professors I have at Penn State. He genuinely cares about his students. He gives a lot of extra credit opportunities which can easily be done. Tests aren't hard and cover most of the stuff he goes through in class. He also presents real-life materials that would come in handy if you work AD.

Such an awful professor. He means well and attempts to give good feedback, but when you submit projects for grading, it is very subjective and unfair. His feedback is usually unclear and his lectures are so beyond boring. This was a 1:25-3:20 class where students has most of the time to work on their own projects instead of learning something.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Mark is a nice guy, but lectures are INCREDIBLY boring. His presentations are dull, and he speeds through slides to the point it's difficult to get the notes down. He tends to just read off the slides and not explain much in depth. No homework aside from one small project. Very repetitive, and spends a lot of time in class reviewing exam material.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: The most boring professor and he does not give any advice when it comes to studying or critiquing your assignments.

I'm not an ad major so I wasn't sure about this class. But Mr. Birschbach was excellent. He worked in the ad business so he gave tons of real world examples. Really passionate about advertising especially the creative part. He goes over PP slides really fast but posts everything online before tests.

this semester he changed up his exams from previous semesters. his power points cover some of the material on the test, but not all. his lectures are so boring. if you don't do good on the exams you'll get a bad grade. get nittany notes. and good luck in class because this guy is so boring
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Mark is a very nice professor! If you review all ppt he uploads on canvas, all tests will be easy! You can really learn many practical stuffs in his lecture. Don't make fun of this old guy, he is new to PSU, but cute. He does everything by his own, no TA, and he tries to make lectures and review sessions interesting.

Mr. B is pretty cool and super easy going. His intro class is heavy on lecture but is on interesting stuff as long as you're into advertising. He's really passionate about the subject and has a lot of experience. He's big on attendance, so go to class! Took his COMM classes in both the fall and spring, great guy, would take him again!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: Mark is new to Penn State this year and was clearly still finding his footing during this class, which caused many rude students to inappropriately take advantage of his kindness. Outside of class, he is a super helpful and caring guy who is really passionate about advertising. If you're serious about the field (especially creative), take him.

With all clicker points you get extra credit on your average, and exams are very easy. He goes though the powerpoint fast but will post the slides on canvas. Reviews for the exam in class and literally gives you everything that will be on it.
Get your clicker points because if you get a 100% , he will give you extra credit. I really enjoyed him. he goes through powerpoint insanely fast but posts it all.

I really enjoyed the class. Mark is very passionate about advertising & has worked in the field prior to teaching. Kinda dry. He goes through the powerpoints very fast but will post the necessary ones right before the test. You MUST study the pwrpnts thoroughly and read the readings for the exams. Grades come from exams, attendance, & group project

Dr. Bird is a very nice professor that gives very interesting lectures but they often go beyond the end of class and it is difficult to follow along with the examples he uses at times. However, this class was an easy Gen Ed and helped me understand anthropology concepts better. There are only a few assignments and optional attendance.
He is a very nice professor and always wants you to do well. It all comes down to whether you can understand the content. He also assigns a lot of podcasts.

I feel bad because he is sweet, passionate, and wants to do good. But, hes also insane, loud, slams desks. Never in a bad way, but having him as my last class of the day with all that was a lot. Class was pretty easy in my opinion, simple work, final project AND paper which was tough. Be ware, he is insane. Im not joking, hes actually crazy.

hes a very dedicated teacher, passionate about the subject, however. He is LOUD, like, headache inducing loud, yelling, rambling, slams desks. I had his class as my last class everyday and i always left drained with a headache because he just rambles, and the things he talks about are borderline gibberish. Class itself is ok, its just him.

Dr.Bird is a very funny, enthusiastic, nice guy. The class didn't interest me as much as I thought it would however, his energy and goofiness made it very easy to stay engaged. Get ready to do lots of reading, listening to podcasts/watching films. Even though attendance isn't mandatory, he does randomly do participation questions on TopHat!

Don't depend on lectures to do well on quizzes and exams. If you're not an anthropology major/need the class I do not recommend. Although this class sucks he does remain enthusiastic in teaching. Participation is random through tophat.

reviews.rating_tags: Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Terribly teacher, boring, not engaging what at all.

Prof Bird is really knowledgeable about anthropology and is crazy enthusiastic during lecture. Slides are just really text heavy and I wasn't personally interested in a lot of the material being taught but still a pretty good class.

Dr. Bird was one of the most inspiring professors I have ever had. He is beyond knowledgeable in his field and I learned something new after ever lecture. There was literally never any homework, just some readings. only a midterm and a final. Very manageable and easy to get an A on. I could not recommend him more.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: HE IS SO AMAZING! His class is only lectures, but his homework has a range of different types so you're not always reading out of the same boring textbook. He also loves the topic that he teaches which makes him that much better of a professor.

I thought I would like this class, but I thought the way the material was presented was unnecessarily dense. Prof. Bird is very knowledgeable and passionate, but I don't think he is the best at teaching this material, I never knew what to take notes on. His TAs also graded everything, so got no real feedback from him.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: I cannot stress this enough, he is an AMAZING teacher. You can tell how truly passionate he is about his subject and he sounds like a muppet, so easy to listen to. All the work for his class is on your own and not directly related to the subject matter so if you aren't interested in this subject, you won't make yourself do the work.

Grade is 5% clicker questions & you only get full credit if you get the question right, 25% podcast homework assignments, 30% midterm exam, and 40% final exam. Also, he assigns a ridiculous amount of readings and podcasts every week. Not to mention it's impossible to pay attention b/c the lectures are so boring. He also says uhh every 2 seconds.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Bird is very passionate about what he teaches but i found him to be pretty scatterbrained and the lecture slides to be confusing to follow. attendance is graded but only with clickers and only during some classes. only a midterm and a final both worth most of your grade plus a few random assignments. not the best not the worst
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Gives one midterm worth 200 points that completely dictates your performance in the class yet speaks nothing of it until the TA releases a half-ass study guide 2 days before the exam. If you screw that up, kiss your chance of a decent grade goodbye. He gives zero chance to improve upon a grade worth that many points, despite the EC assignment.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Doug is a super cool guy, he gives a lot of extra credit. For example, right now I am typing a project that will boost my grade 8 percent. But the fact that he feels the need to give an assignment worth 8% extra credit shows that he is too frickin hard. Everyone fails. Class should be a joke but it's the hardest class I've taken at this school. ):

reviews.comment: Passionate, Funny, SO Knowledgeable, Awesome experience. Made me fall in love with a subject I didn't really care for, curious about things I didn't ever think about, activist and caring.

He is a very engaging professor and the best out of the 3 in kines 100. Very exam heavy class so use quizlet or flashcards and you will do well. Do the readings, go to class and study and you will get an A. LOTS of content but its not hard.

This section of Kines 100 isn't that bad. Philosophy can be boring but is overall pretty easy. Put in the work and you'll be fine. Weekly quizzes are annoying but are not hard if you pay attention and take good notes. He's a very nice guy and you can tell he loves what he does.

Great professor, attendance mandatory but if you were sick he would excuse you from tophat questions. Quizzes and exams were decently hard but if you paid attention in class an educated guess can land you an A. Definitely the best of the 3 Kines 100 professors

AMAZING Professor!!! Took him for Kines 341, attendance not mandatory at all. Weekly online quizzes and 3 papers throughout semester (only had to do third if you didn't like your grade for first two). By end of sem only like 20/200 kids came to class, he does not care. Genuinely a great professor and caring individual.

Mr. Kidd is my favorite professor that I have had so far. He thoroughly enjoys teaching and you can tell every single day he shows up to class. His experience he brings to the table strengthens the class further and makes for great lectures (though very long and class goes up until the end). He is a genuine ,caring, and shows up smiling every day.

He is one of my favorite professors!! SO nice, funny, and gives the best insight. He has so much experience in the industry and told crazy stories and also helped me realize what i want to do. The class is super easy if you just pay some attention and attendance isn't mandatory but he tells you specific exam questions so id recommend going.

One of the easiest A's I've ever received (granted there are several papers and a few quizzes but so so easy) but I learned the most from Bill out of all my classes this semester. He's super knowledgeable and has great stories and loves his students so is super flexible if you turn things in late. Show up to class, especially on case study days!

This class is a super free gen ed. The content is fairly interesting and the slides have literally anything on it. Dr. Zhang is really good at simplifying things and she gives very clear instructions for assignments. 2 papers, and one of them is very informal. 3 exams and no final. Highly recommend
She is genuinely the funniest person I have ever met. Class is not hard at all, it was based mainly on projects. Recommend sitting close to the front she'll become your best friend.
Very good and very kind! Genuinely cares about her students!

Bingbing was an ok professor. I think this was her first time teaching 413W but in my opinion I think someone else should've taught this class. She tends to skim essays and doesn't know how to use canvas very well. We had a quiz every class that was based on journal articles she picked out. She's nice but pick another professor if you can.

Everything was pretty straight forward. You had at least two options for homework it was only a few questions. There is a paper but it is broken down throughout the semester. Though the weeks during the paper the assignment can pile up. The midterms and final exam are fairly tedious. Other then that it wasn't a bad class.
great professor that is very straight forward about what is expected. Makes the class very easy but you still learn a lot. Her study guides for the exams help so much and reflect the exam directly

I felt like her grading criteria never fully matched the description. She seemed to take random points off with little explanation like even if you religiously followed the criteria. That's really the only negative from her class overall it wasn't too bad

Beware and prepare - modules 12-24 parts long so plan accordingly. Dr. Bissel-Havaran is a tough grader at times, and not so great when life happens. The research and writing is extremely time consuming as are the lessons. Tough class with tough teacher. Use the examples provided - they help. Tests are tough with short answers too.

I took this class online and it is honestly very easy. The weekly short answer questions were simple and based on opinion or short readings. Just be sure to cite well and use facts if it says to as she is a bit of a tough grader. The exams are pretty easy as well as the paper project throughout the course, which is done throughout the class.

I don't know why people are saying this class was a lot of writing or difficult. The "short essays" can be a page double spaced and are mainly opinion-based and take little time! The content is interesting, but you can still get an A without putting in much work. She is a great professor who takes the time to give genuine feedback!

She is very kind and responds very quickly to emails. However, prepare to write your butt off. Short essays due almost every week. Prompts are easy and interesting, but it takes a while to complete. She does not like to give 100s on assignments or exams, but she will if you go the extra mile. Overall very happy and would take her again!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She was never happy with my writing. Her famous words were always a "good effort" or good start. Never gave any words of encouragement. Her tests were easy but the essays are what got me. Since the tests were timed I couldn't make my thoughts clear enough. So it didn't make sense to her. She's very picky and expects you to be a professional writer.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Clearly sets expectations from the very beginning. Shes a very fun teacher, but you have to make sure to read the material and complete the essays. She offers extra credit and she responds quickly to emails. She offers great feedback on your writing so there is room for improvement. Textbook is needed for some content, but not necessary.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Most of the homework assignments are essays. There is also a paper that is due as well, but she has you work on it throughout the course and it makes life so much easier. She provides good feedback so you can improve your work & as long as you can take the feedback and use it to improve, youll do really well. She offers extra credit as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She definitely wants to see you succeed but makes you work for your grade. She grades everything harder than I think they should be graded. With that being said, the exams aren't bad as long as you read everything and do your work. You'll hate this course if homework every week is a drag to you but other than that you should be fine!

Another person said she'll never give you 100% on anything for no good reason at all and I completely agree. I always worked hard and felt really good about the assignments I turned in, just for her to give me a lower grade than deserved with no explanation. I wouldn't take her again or recommend her to anyone, her class alone is killing my GPA.

She does NOT like giving you a full grade on ANYTHING just for the sake of it. I also forgot that this was an English class because she picks on things that, for one, are not even grammatical errors, extremely often. Oh wait, it's NOT an English class!!! I would not take her again or recommend anyone taking her in the future.

She's awesome. She sends out weekly reminders of what is due that specific week.  Return emails fast. Fair grader. The test she gives aren't easy but as long as you read the material and the course content you will be fine. The test are mostly multiple choice and only a couple of short answer. I will definitely be taking her again!!! :)

I thought she was fair...I am taking classes online so it would be unfair to say anything more but she was responsive to questions. Don't bother trying to buddy up with her though...she's there to teach...
so easy. attendance counts for a test grade! if you go to class, and skim the book there's no excuse for not getting an A.

Hard class, only uses powerpoint and doesn't put much information into it, talks so fast that you can't write down much, tests are short answer and some multiple choice, tests are very hard, don't take this class if you don't need to, grades unfairly, doesn't give you many points, papers are hard

Ottar is chill but DONT take his class if it is offered COVID-remote/mixed mode!!! Ottar is the worst professor I've had at PSU. Very nice professor! He also grades very leniently.. class average on the exams (part-MC, part open-ended) were in the 90s because he gave partial credit on MULTIPLE CHOICE!
Prof. Bjornstad is the most awesome prof of all time!
Great professor. Tests are hard though, all short answer.

You will never see her. I have no idea what she even looks like. Your grade in this class is basically random based on the TA you get (thankfully I got a pretty good one). Don't expect any of your issues or conflicts to be accommodated.

One of the most poorly designed courses I've ever taken. 90% of the effort for the class is writing completely obvious questions onto paper, or having to complete a 'pre-lab' which is essentially rewriting the lab manual.
