reviews.comment: Delivers really engaging lectures and is a very genuine guy. He is understanding but doesn't take any bs.
Really enjoyed his lectures. They were interesting and enjoyable to attend and not difficult to understand. Also,  understanding for any inconveniences and issues.

Dr. Block is the best and super knowledgable. Genuinely an easy A. Attendance isn't mandatory, so just keep up with the reading and go to lecture if you're confused/need help. Graded by discussion posts,  three exams and 2 papers, all of which are super easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easiest class ever. All exams and finals are online. The only work you have to do is two 5 page papers throughout the class, and one short response a week.

This class was a breeze. Hardly had to go to class. All the material was online so class wasn't that important. He tells you to get the book but I didn't use it at all. Very easy class. A couple papers but not too hard. No final and 3 exams throughout the year.
Great teacher! Was willing to write my letter of recommendation. He's super nice understanding and all round great teacher. I would definitely take his IST 301 class again.
Found the curriculum to be very welcoming and collaborative.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Thoroughly enjoyed this class. You get out of it what you put into it. The group project was interesting and I like to keep it for my portfolio.

Professor Dean really helped me learn about project management in the IT space. The class project was good. It was quite ambiguous, but that's the nature of IT projects in an organization. Our team worked together to be successful. A very caring and conscientious professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Dean is a very nice guy, however, he isn't very involved in the class. For the class itself, I highly advise you take it with a friend or multiple. It's a semester long project, and if you get put with a random group, you better pray they do their work. On top of the project deliverables, there's biweekly quizzes and discussions. Not bad.

Honestly, I regret not being more involved in the class with him. Dean is so sweet and genuinely cares for the class. Dude is probably one of the most genuine professors on the planet. Can't lie tho, class was kinda boring, but if you really try and stuff, I'm sure you can get a lot out of the class. Dean is fire. Take him if you can.
Dean really cared about his class. This was one of the only courses where the content was directly applicable in a real world setting. Could recommend dean any more!

Great overall person. Really cares about what he is teaching and it is obvious that he wants you to be successful as well. Great look into the real world and can set you up with some awesome connections in the industry.

Professor Dean organizes materials well and actively addresses group issues with helpful suggestions. While IST302's abstract concepts can make lectures somewhat dry, his semester-long project approach clarifies these ideas effectively.

Professor Blackstock was an all around great professor. He was always willing to help whenever you needed it and the group project is great as it gives you a good glimpse into what the real world will be like. Would definitely take another class with him!
My favorite professor! Really gets you ready for the real world with his project.

Best professor ever! One group project guided by an EY rep which is cool and you get a lot of real world experience in how a project runs and all the aspects of a successful project. Gives honest feedback!

I took IST 302 with Prof Blackstock in Fall 22. He has experience with what he teaches and it shows. He cares about the academic and professional success of his students and tries to make the class as accurate to a real professional experience as possible. His lecture style could use a little work (tends to ramble) but overall keeps it engaging.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took this course in Fall 2021. Professor Blackstock is very knowledgeable about IT and often brought in guest speakers for the class to help us expand our horizons. His real world experiences translated into his lectures. The project itself was very fair but also a great opportunity for students to get exposure to the world of ITPM. Great prof!

Awesome guy, has extensive knowledge and experience in the IT project management field. Semester long project is as close to being in an IRL IT project as it gets. Very knowledgeable and accessible professor. Overall very informative and interesting class.

Professor Blackstock provided a great learning experience that was challenging and thought provoking, however he was always willing to lend a helping hand and give advice no matter the time or place . You can tell he truly cares about his students and the material he is teaching us.

I liked Professor Deans class a lot! He outlines the entire class early on and is very helpful if you reach out and ask questions. You can tell he wants his students to be successful and will help any way he can. Take this class with friends if you can it is very group heavy.

I would like to let students know that professor Blackstock is a great teacher and a friendly person in general. Professor Blackstock helped me personally me in the internship process and I know he would be a great help for anyone else that had questions with the class and/or with any other IST related questions, such as internship positions.

Great professor that cares about the students. One large group project that goes throughout the semester with a final group presentation at the end. Lectures can be a bit dry but the application to the project is interesting. Good class for the real world.

This was Professor Dean's first time teaching this course, and I think he did a good job for it being his first time. My group's EY rep messed up a few things but when we told him, he gave us points back. The lectures are not very interesting but he understands that. Overall the course isn't that bad, if you put in work you should get an A.

Only class I have ever recommended to everyone. This was my favorite class and my favorite professor by far. He genuinely cares about everyone in his class. This should be a mandatory class for everyone, with Blake as an instructor. If you're a girl taking this class please make the 5 guys in the class feel welcomed.

This was probably one of the best classes I've had at PSU! Prof Colaianne is so nice and caring, and really makes the course enjoyable. I always looked forward to going to class. The assignments are very simple and clear, and while attendance is mandatory, he's very understanding, and it won't ruin your grade if you miss a class or two.

Very chill Gened and interesting class. Definitely recommend if you want to learn more about yourself. Every week there are reading and videos and you do a discussion post, and then a practice log. There are three big "projects/essays".

The course is really good! this is one of the easiest and enjoyable classes at Penn State! The easiest Gen Ed known to humanity! the professor is great too! sometimes he got on my nerves, but overall he's good! TAKE THIS CLASS IF YOU CAN!!! EASY A!!!!

This is the best class at Penn State and everyone should take it if they get the chance! The lectures are engaging, helpful, and interesting. There are meditation logs and discussion posts for homework each week. Blake is an amazing person who strives to help every student succeed and flourish in their life. I can't say enough good things!

Professor Colaianne is great. I took his 5 week 497 course and it was pretty easy. Homework is pretty light. One project is divided into 3 parts and some discussion posts throughout the 5 weeks. He gives feedback on all homework assignments which is helpful. I would take one of his classes again.
He's a nice guy, He is all over the place, hard to follow and not a good teacher, the class is not that hard, but you'd be better off learning with a friend.

Bharath is a good guy but he is not good at teaching. He just scribbles barely legible stuff on the chalkboard and rambles. His classes have barely any structure to them. Luckily the exams are standardized and its not too hard to teach the material to yourself, but I would avoid having him as a professor if you can.

Professor Narayanan was amazing to have my first semester. While the course heavily relied on practice problems and paying close attention to the board (he went quick), he had so many office hours to clear up any confusion. Further, he gave out random bonus for just showing up, he genuinely cares about your grade and success.

Very unorganized teacher. I also had trouble understanding him, he is very quick and is a chalkboard writer or at least he was for my class. His notes suck and are impossible with his bad hand writing. Very knowledgeable guy and easy to talk to but besides that I would not recommend taking this course with him

A good lecturer, all of his lectures made sense and he was good at explaining concepts and problems. Occasionally came off as passive aggressive, but I truly don't believe those times were intentional. Also a pretty funny guy, and he gave bonus points just for coming to class every day.

He's difficult to understand. He will go over problems similar to what is on the exam in class, but these problems are not in the textbook. There are a lot of quizzes and homework. He will randomly take attendance. He's not mean or anything,  just very hard to understand. He'll also take off points for small things like missing or wrong units.

Terrible at explaining, class feels like a race to copy his unorganized notes rather than actually learning. He seems very knowledgeable but tends to skip steps to solve problems and class engagement and rather does the problems himself. can't even give an accurate difficulty because I can't tell you what we are learning
Professor did not explain certain topics well and did not answer questions in a helpful manner.

Professor Narayanan is a good teacher. Math 141 is a tough class, but he offers plenty of opportunities to help you earn the grade you want. Always go to class—he gives out random bonus points for attendance. The material can be confusing at times, but he encourages students to use his office hours and email for extra help.

Man, I don't even know what to say. Professor Narayanan was a blessing I received during my freshman year. Easily the best math professor I have ever had. I had no calc experience in high school and came into college and got an A in 140 because of his teaching. You will not go wrong with this professor. Please take him.
Hard to understand and bad at explaining. Didn't go to lectures and still did fine.

I felt the professor covered essential topics way too quickly for me to keep up with. I also thought the professor was sarcastic at times when I asked for help and was passive aggressive towards students who answered questions wrong. There were also times where he'd claim you didn't study enough despite spending several hours studying every night.

Bharath is an amazing professor for anyone is good with a fast paced class. He really cares about all of his students and is really helpful in office hours. Although going to class is not mandatory he gives LOTS of bonus points for showing up. I would definitely take him if you have the chance. GOAT professor and very funny too.
GOAT-got a 90 in the class bumped to a A in lions path. Show up to lectures literally gave bunch of free points, grade rose 3% randomly overnight. If u make the commitment to go to class it's peak.

He's a smart, educated professor who definitely knows his stuff. He's very nice and caring and will take the time to help as well. I believe he knows the material so well that he sometimes has a difficult time teaching the material to people who aren't as experienced. Definitely make sure to show up to class everyday.

Same class as high school calc but somehow made it much harder to understand. Lectures aren't really helpful, but he randomly takes attendance (idk why. it wasn't graded). Definitely go to LA sessions and ask questions there because they're actually helpful and you get extra credit. Don't bother going to office hours. Decent amount of homework.

I took this class going into calculus with 0 prior knowledge, which I knew would be difficult, but this professor was the worst possible thing that could've happened in this situation. If you ask questions he will respond rhetorically and act like you are dumb. He is very hard to understand and scribbles his problems down instead of explaining how.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Narayanan can seem unapproachable at first, but he's genuinely a good guy who cares about students. The material is challenging, but with effort and tools like unstuckstudy, you can succeed. Attendance is key.
straight up terrible professor. makes fun of you if you ask questions, has no clue how to properly teach, does lessons off the top of his head and frequently makes errors. AVOID AT ALL COSTS.
His class isn't too bad but I found him snooping around my house so...

This professor is terrible. He does not explain anything he is doing. Just writes on the board way too fast then erases it. If you ask a question he will put you down or make fun of you. I spend countless hours with a tutor after every 2 hour lecture and take notes every day. I am still very lost.
Doesn't even explain what he's doing, will just do the problems and expect you to know what just happened. Also if you ask a question he'll make it his goal to make fun of you for asking a question.

Great professor. Helped me engage with the subject. Has had a clear impact on my interest in math. Though he is serious about the subject, he can also be funny during lectures. Overall, Great professor.
Would Take Again
AVOID AVOID AVOID!!!!!!! He is the worst professor for MATH 140 at the university, he will insult you infront of the class if you ask him a simple question. DO NOT TAKE HIM!!!!!

The worst professor I have ever had in Penn State. He does not know how to teach. He constantly made mistakes in lecture, explained poorly, and gave us incorrect lecture ntoes. Writes really messily, and doesn't even finish his sentences half the time. Avoid at all costs

AVOID! Tests are worth 75% (math department requirement) no calculators, and lots of formulas. Weekly quizzes are annoying, and there's lots of homework, both online and written, but they're not worth much. Lecture heavy and random attendance, so never skip class. He's very smart, but doesn't know how to teach that to students, but he's a nice guy.

Not very good at teaching. One of those professors who is so smart he can't explain it well. Assumes you have already taken calculus and can often jump over material without teaching it. Office hours are not helpful and aren't worth it. Often demeans you when you get it wrong and doesn't understand the questions being asked of him.

He never really taught class, he will explain two really easy questions and then the hw will be hard topics we never covered. Every friday was a quiz, with an occasional exam. Quizzes had 4 questions max, exams had 10. I mostly relied on tutors to understand. And he was strict in the beginning and started to be funny and more in-depth at the end.

Prof. Narayanan is definitely a very nice guy. His classes are boring, and he was very unclear at times. Many people struggled on his exams, but if you use the study guides they are extremely easy. Wouldn't recommend him as a teacher, but he is a super nice guy and is definitely tolerable as a teacher.

He uses lots of examples in class and encouraged participation. We also had days where we would just work on practice problems with other students that I thought was very helpful. He really encouraged learning unlike other math professors I have that just lecture on theory everyday with no real examples. He prepares his lectures ahead of time.

I was very anxious about Math 141 as I did not do well in Math 140, but having Dr. Narayanan saved my GPA.  He was a fantastic professor, and if you attend his lectures, you will do great in class.  I saw him a lot during office hours and this also greatly helped me.  He genuinely cares about his students' success in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I liked him a lot except sometimes he goes way too fast during lectures.  Go to class he sometimes gives extra quiz points for people who regularly attend classes (and he gave attendance bonus at the end of the semester).  He seems to grade things pretty leniently too with partial credit.

While Dr. Narayanan can come off as hard to approach towards the beginning of the semester, a student will eventually realize that he is overall a good person and cares about his students. His lectures are very fast and sometimes difficult to grasp, but if you come to class and pay attention, you should be well off.
Good guy
This is a tough class no matter who teaches it, and I thought he did a pretty good job making topics understandable given the material!

Dr. Narayanan was a great professor. Although his lectures started off as hard to understand, it eventually got much easier to get a grasp of what he was explaining. He might not seem approachable but is actually a great guy and will offer help as long as you show you care about the class. Rarely took attendance but it's best to always show up.

I really enjoyed having him as my professor for Math 140. His lectures were never boring and he gave a lot of good extra practice questions and tips during them so be sure to attend. As long as you show up and write down what he writes on the board, you'll succeed in his classes. He's also super chill, was a great prof.

Overall good professor, attendance is not mandatory but better attend all the classes otherwise you won't understand all the topics after that. Workload is heavy, will take about 5 hours per week to do all the assignments, plus reviewing weekly quiz. There are four exams which make up 75% of grade, so you need to spend even more time on review.

Professor Narayanan is tough in the beginning of the semester but will quickly ease up to his students. He will do his best to make sure you're understanding the material. There are lots of quizzes and homework in this class so beware. Extra credit is given randomly if you show up on certain days.

Very nice, but no phones or laptops in class. If you talk to him and he sees that you are trying he will try and help boost your grade. He gives extra credit on random days for coming to class, and in the lectures he will solve questions that are on the exams and quizzes. Attendance not mandatory if you know the material, go if you don't.
Really funny and happy to answer any questions. Gives very good review questions for exams
Great Professor, funny guy and nice. Is very easily reachable by email or even talk to him after class, he will kindly answer your questions.

As with all math professors at Penn State, the exams make or break grades. I didn't do too bad on the final and did very well on the second midterm but bombed the first one. He is somewhat stern but as the semester progresses, he gets more laid back and cracks plenty of jokes. He knows his material very well and is good if you put in the work.

Easy to understand and clean lectures. Only used the textbook once or twice while doing homework because of how organized his lectures were every time we attended class. He might seem a bit intimidating when trying to ask questions during lectures, but he's more than happy to answer and explain them.
You wont understand anything he says because he doesnt explain a thing. Go to the LA sessions for extra credit if you want extra points though. Otherwise, don't bother unless youre a genuis
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor Narayanan seems to be tough at first because he wants his students to be successful. He likes to yell at his students when they ask questions, and he also likes to make his students feel stupid after they ask questions. He is very smart, but he can't teach in a clear way. Narayanan seems very mean at first, but he is a nice guy overall.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: At first, he made everything hard. He told students that they would fail his class because of dumb algebra mistakes at the beginning of the semester. When you get used to him, he WILL lighten up and actually care about you and your success in the course. Make sure to visit his office hours to make the process easier faster. He is hilarious btw.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. B is a great professor; he encourages you to ask questions. The tests are 70% of your grade (math department requirement). Weekly written hw(can be hard) and online hw. Weekly quizzes that are based on what you learned in the week(gives partial credit but is challenging). Review rescources that are exactly like the test.

This is the worst professor I have had at Penn State. He lost my tests and put them in as 0%. He never clearly explained the notes and criticized you for asking questions. Your whole grade depends mostly on the midterms so if you get a low grade you will not be able to bring it back up. I had to drop the course so i didnt fail it.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: A great guy and knows his stuff, but somewhat unorganized in teaching. He doesn't explain "every" step while solving. Loves answering questions and meeting with students for clarifications. Provides good pre-test reviews. Attending lectures is not enough, you need to have some self-study outside class. A "no other choice" for the course.
This class is obviously very tough. He explains the concepts pretty well. Gives clear directions on how to do everything. Notes can be tough to read sometimes but overall not bad. Really great guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Narayanan is pretty good. Students made fun of him a lot and didn't seem to like him, but his math 21 was pretty straight forward and easy. If you do all the assignments and practice for the exam you should be fine. He sometimes gives pop quizzes and the Mylabmath was a pain though. You can definitely do worse than Narayanan for math though.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Hilarious--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: Math 140 is a tough class, especially without prior Calc knowledge. Dr. Narayanan was alright. His review sessions were extremely helpful, but in class, he would skip steps and was defensive when people asked questions. The quizzes are challenging, but if you pay attention, work hard, attend reviews, and do the practice exams, you should be fine.
Difficult class but the math department practice exams are exactly like the actual exams which account for 80% of your grade. Go to office hours very helpful.

Math 140 is certainly designed to be a tough class and he did not make it any easier. I only survived because I took calc in highschool. The only good thing is that his homework is minimal and will sometimes give you problems very similar to the exams. Your best bet is studying the practice exams. If you can, take someone else.

5 quizzes and 7 exams a semester is a lot. The weekly homework was short at the beginning of the year, but it has gotten much longer. If you didn't take Calc in high school, it may be hard to pick up but it's doable. While it is challenging, it is a high-level math class and I don't think Prof. Naryanan did anything wrong.

This is the worst Professor you can choose for Math. His explanations are hard to understand. His notes are messy. He skips steps thinking we are math freaks. Hardest quizzes ever. He is a tough grader. His excuse for everything is the online instruction. He is manipulative and intentionally tricky. He makes you look stupid when you ask questions.

I feel like he would be ok in person but it was so difficult over zoom. He gets mad when we ask questions and so many of the concepts are so unclear. The tests are not similar to what we learn in class and there are not a lot of resources to study.

You can tell he is smart, but he is incredibly condescending. Very rude, does not explain things, and gets mad when you ask questions. Direct quote- "I am not here to teach you, I am here to tell you when you get things wrong". I understand this course is a weed out but he is absurd. Should be teaching graduate level math, not an intro course.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Math 141 is a very hard class that requires plenty of work and practice. Bharath teaches very clearly and does a lot of problems during class. He posts class notes on canvas before the lectures and is always prepared. He will warn you throughout the semester of the difficulty of exams and how important it is to practice. Homework is assigned weekly
Hard to understand. He got problems wrong regularly. Not a nice profesor.
Give really good lectures. Teaches the math problems very clearly.
He's so nice. He explains really well and he's very understanding. He will always be there for you and bend the rules. I would love to have him again :)
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Caring

reviews.comment: This class was hard for sure. Attendance counts for points and is often graded at random. There's typically a quiz every week or so depending on how lectures go. quizzes are hard, tests are even harder. However, he's a funny professor and is very well educated on the subject!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious

reviews.comment: very good

Dr. B was honestly one of the best professors/teachers I have ever had. The class is really hard but he does a great job breaking it all down so we fully get it. Plus he is hilarious and really down to Earth. Just go to class and pay attention and you will be fine. Math 140 sucks but Dr. B is an amazing professor so I'd highly recommend taking him.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Hilarious

reviews.comment: He goes off on tangents about random math things and barely teaches the lesson. Makes lots of mistakes when doing examples and is very disorganized on the board. The only reason I go to class is because he is technologically deficient and wont upload the actually good notes to out course page.
Dr. B was pretty good. He has an accent which takes getting used too and can go on tangents during lectures. However he is very accommodating in office hours and really want to help you learn.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. B was alright. Homework is online, and the tests are touch (as expected). I didn't really like his teaching all that much and I didn't really enjoy this class overall. Ended up doing okay, but I wouldn't say that he's your best option as a professor. Overall though, not a bad choice of a professor compared to others.

Bharath helped me a lot by taking care of me and helping me with all kinds of problems I faced in the past year which I couldnt appreciate more. The BEST professor I've ever had. There was homework once a week and in-class quizzes every Friday. Attend class on time and do homework, you'll nail the quizzes and exams!!!

Lectures are pretty boring, but I think that's more reflective of the course than the professor. He often made mistakes when working out problems, but he was pretty clear when explaining concepts. Homework is assigned online and isn't always representative of what happens in class. Attendance starts to count if nobody shows up.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He cares about your success as long as you care enough to take the time to learn the information and you go to office hours enough.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Okay I honestly loved this guy. Not only was he always able to answer my questions, but he actually taught the class and made it kind of fun! You really have to show up and absorb the info though because it is a tough class in general and you get free attendance points sometimes! I needed a perfect on my final for an A in the class, take him!

I just wanted to thank Bharath incredibly for helping me during my exam. I have definitely been struggling this semester with finding my way throughout this universities ins and outs. I really appreciate his patience wnd caring attitude because he genuinely wants his student to do well and will go to any length to make sure they understand.
Dr. B is literally the MAN. Go to his office hours atleast once a week and when he sees that you're putting in the effort, he grades much easier. He basically tells you whats on the exam.

Not a fan of his teaching. He would get this smug look on his face when someone was wrong as though it made him feel better about how much he knew. Lectures were difficult to follow with him jumping around with little explanation. I'm a Dean's List student but had to drop after the first exam because of him.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Honestly, Dr.B is a good guy and he knows his stuff but he often gets flustered in class while trying to do examples. He makes mistakes somewhat often and wastes a good deal of class trying to correct them. His teaching style is kinda all over the place and very softspoken, so listen hard. If you took trig in highschool, i hope you kept your notes

Dr.B is a pretty average Math professor. Like most math classes there is no attendance, but he has quizzes once a week and the weeks there is no quiz he takes attendance so beware of that. He isn't very good at teaching so be prepared to teach yourself.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Dr. B does a wonderful job of teaching the difficult concepts. His lectures occasionally seem to go on a tangent but overall they are fairly well organized. If you pay attention to his examples & do the homework you will be in a good position to succeed. Always ask questions because he is happy to help. Study hard and you'll get good exam grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He is a wonderful, wonderful man! He cares about his students and is very down to earth. I loved his lectures, because he broke everything down step by step. Great guy, great prof... took this class 4 times and I passed only because he is a great professor. TAKE 141 WITH HIM IF YOU CAN!! Thanks Bharath!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. B is so great that I had him for 140 and 141. He assigns minimal homework and tells you everything you need to know in class for the exam. As some may find his quizzes hard, he does give extra credit from random attendance he takes throughout the semester. He is a little unorganized so be prepared to stay on top of your grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Hilarious--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Already did not like the subject and having him as a professor just made taking calculus unbearable. I was clearly struggling and when I went to his office hours for help he told me I should've know how to do that. Doesnt update grades in canvas s you dont know what you have till the last day
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: Dr. B is an excellent teacher of clac. the test are not written by him and are extremely hard. He gives ALOT less hw. then other 140 profs and all but the first assignment were graded by comp. Go to every class because he will randomly take attendance for points. His quizzes are extreemly difficult but u get a HUGE quiz curve (20pt) if u go to clas

Overall, he does care about his students. A little under half my class did drop after the first exam but as long as you do the homework and listen in class, you are good. He's very helpful in office hours too.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Caring

reviews.comment: This was my second time taking Math 140 and I'm glad I took it with Dr. B. My first professor was unclear and didn't care about the students and Dr. B was the complete opposite of that. Class could be a bit boring at times, but it's Calculus and that's expected. Quizzes every 1/2 weeks and they're based on lecture material and homework.

Dr. Bharath is a very, very caring professor. I saw a comment mentioning his accent but I had absolutely no problem understanding him. He has a very clear grading criteria and has only few aspects that determine your grade: quizzes, homework, midterms, and occasional attendance. Attendance checking is random so skipping one class wouldn't hurt.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Super caring, considerate and nice. Feel free to talk to him if you are feeling frustrated or confusing about anything. He really knows how to encourage his students. He would often pause to make sure his students fully understand the materials. Just come to the classes, do homework and sample exams and you'll get a good grade. Dr. B is very nice.

Super kind, helpful, knowledgeable, and easy to understand. There's a lot to cover, but he will answer any questions you have and do his best to explain. There were so many times I asked "Hey, I missed that, can you do it again?" and he had no problem doing so. Would HIGHLY recommend to anyone taking math140.

His accent does not effect his teaching at all. His english is pretty good. He knows a lot and cares for his students. If you have a question, right away he will answer. Shows all the steps to a problem. Throws in a few jokes to try and lighten the mood. As long as you study and practice, you should do well. If anything is unclear he will help.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. B is an excellent professor. Knows a lot about math, he sympathizes a lot with students. Very helpful in office hours. If this class wasn't Math 141, probably everyone who's in his class would get an easy A.

Dr. B is an awesome professor.  He throws the occasional joke in the lecture to keep you happy.  His accent is totally understandable, and in 140 he provides a lot of grade boosting homework assignments.  If you're not someone who memorizes formulas but needs to see how things are derived, Dr. B is for you!
He is a lazy professor. Consequently quizzes and homework are so easy but class is mostly useless.
Dr. B is a great teacher. He is always willing to help with questions you have. Going to his office hours with any question is a smart choice.

Awesome guy. Teaches lessons using as many examples as possible. Doesn't waste time in class. If you show up to class every day and try, he will help you out. Homework is every week or two, it would probably be better if he assigned homework lesson by lesson, but it works. I would be happy to take him again!

Wonderful person. Funny. Actually teaches each lesson. If you take any initiative to study...like at all. you'll be fine. He's always open to going over any homework questions or overall doubts. don't drop the course, you may be surprised by your homework grade at the end of the semester :)

at first I was so overwhelmed because I dropped this course last semester with a different teacher, and let me just say Bharath is soo much better. You have to understand the material is hard, he tries his absolute best to help and explain things and he tells you everything that will be on the exam. I used lion tutors too!

Confused and unorganized, makes many mistakes with almost every practice problem so it's difficult to actually learn the concept. Quizzes are easy (practice ones are online)! Exams are hard, but not his fault- but he Gave no review for any exams. When in his office hours he is awkward and was not eager to help.
The most understanding guy at Penn State. I told him I was having a bad day and he told me to go relax and take the quiz later. Great guy and hilarious.
Nice guy, but he has trouble getting things across. Also, his exams are the hardest thing you will take. Even people who had calc in high school struggle big time.
he's the best. he explains everything very clear, and he helps in terms of quiz and homework

He explains the material very well, and answers any questions asked. He knows his stuff! He gives a lot of homework, but it really helps in order to learn the material. He also uses the funniest/weirdest analogies. I recommend him over any other math professor here.

Very nice and intelligent guy. He explains the material well, but gives a lot of homework and the quizzes are slightly more difficult than I would expect. Overall, a decent professor, but that's really the most you can ask for from the math department.

He's friendly, and willing to explain any student's questions. He makes sure that students are aware of the difficulty of the course, and reminds them to ask questions. I personally find him the most intelligible mathematics teacher I've had at University Park yet.
Very good and smart professor, he helps a lot and do hes best in teaching the material

Gives a fair amount of homework and goes over all the other problems in class. Rough at the time, but I don't think I would have learned the material nearly as well with a different professor.  Interesting and funny lecturer.. Never feel like skipping his class. Had him for 140 also.

I enjoyed his class a lot. The more he gets comfortable with your class, the better of a teacher he became. Gave weekly homework and quizzes but aren't too bad. His review sessions were great and prepared you perfectly for the exam. Does a lot of problems during class which is the best way to learn calculus. Practice. Highly recommended.

I was out of high school for quite some time so I wasn't sharp on my trig. Either way, he gives you fair warning about it and lets you study up. Quizzes on Fridays and homework (he claims is optional but it isn't) He goes over many problems in class so it's only a matter of time before it clicks and you get it. Got better as the year went along
he did not know what was going on. Not very helpful. Basically he would just go through problems and not explain much.
the best teacher ever!just attend his lecture and you will easily get an A.
This guys knows his material. If you ask for help he will make sure you understand the stuff. Do the hw and you will get at least a B.   One of the best Math profs at PSU.

This guy knows his stuff. If you dont know something just ask him. He is more then willing to help you in math and even physics. If you go to class you get free points towards the hw/quizz grade which is 100 points out of 450. If you do your homework you will end up with at least a B in the class. HE DOES EXAM problems in class.... so ace it!

He's a not a very interesting lecturer, but he definitely teaches you what you need to know for exams. Attendance isn't mandatory, but he teaches by doing homework problems, so it's smart to attend. Assigns a lot of homework problems instead of giving a lot of quizzes which makes it easier to do well in class

Bharath was a very clear teacher who basically told you everything you needed to know for the tests. Class just consists of doing problems on the board. It's not the most interesting but you'll learn calculus. He has some occasional random tangents about math that are kind of interesting too. Overall I'd recommend him
HE IS SIMPLY GREAT!!

The content was fairly difficult but I really appreciated Bharath's enthusiasm towards questions.  I  didn't really ask many at first because I thought I was just supposed to understand, but when I started to he actually got excited to help and really made it much easier to learn.  I would definitely take his class again.

Good overall professor. Ask for extra credit and you receive it through attendance on random days. It really helps out. You will have to learn most of the information on your own through homework and lots of practice, however he also helps by going over partial credit problems which are very similar to exam problems.
Probably one of the worst teachers EVERR

This man is a legend.  The way he teaches and presents himself makes you motivated for his calculus lessons.  He'll ask you a question, but right before you put up your hand to answer it, he'll answer it.  You'll get used to it.  "Why does this make sense? (pause) well, this is why..."  Great man.  Great class.

Not the greatest "teacher" in the world, but definitely not the worst either. He had to miss class for over a month and our replacement was 1000 times worse. People might say Bharath is bad, but he knows his stuff much better than anybody else. Teaches using a lot of examples for you to figure out what's going on which is the ONLY way to learn math

he is very bad at communicating his thoughts to the class. he mutters to himself more than he teaches, and rarely actually explains the topics. i would suggest switching to a different professor early on.
His voice is too low and he barely speaks the language. He is so bad at explaining the material. P.S I don't know how he got his PhD!!!!
he is quite so you have to listen carefully. he is willing to answer questions. he does a good job of teaching the concepts, but i have found that no everyone understands what he means all the time.

I used the textbook to teach myself due to the professors inability to convey principles and concepts in any sort of a meaningful manner. If this professor is assigned to your technical calculus class, take another class.

Bharath is an ok teacher. He just has a different way of explaining topics.  As long as you go to every class, work out the problems he does in class, and do the homework, and A in the class is possible.  I got a B on the first exam, but then i started doing the hw, and then i got an A on exam 2 and the final.

He is an awful teacher.  You cannot understand a word he says and he just does tons of practice problems in class.  I went to class maybe once every two weeks and got a B in the class.  Take it from another teacher and it will be tons better.

Knows his stuff but can't teach it for the life of him. Also he speaks very quietly and even if you can hear him its hard to understand. My only suggestion is to do as many practice problems as humanly possible.

He is hard to understand and doesn't actually "teach." He knows his stuff, there's no question there, but he can't really get it across to his students. It is a tough class and because he just does problems in class, it is much more difficult.
very nice guy and great teacher. go to class and ask questions when needed and you wont have a problem.

He is extremely soft spoken and seems to talk quieter and quieter as he speaks.  It was nearly impossible for me to learn from this guy.  Yes, he knows his stuff, but that is different from being able to teach it.  I changed professors half way through the semester and I was much better off.

He is very soft-spoken and mumbles a lot. If you sit in front, that should help. He's not a good "teacher"- mostly he starts class with a formula and then does example problems, hoping you'll get what's going on. He knows what he's doing despite making frequent algebra mistakes. The class is hard no matter who you take it from.
No Comments

Course is tough so it's hard to give a high rating on easiness, but he is a good professor.  Shy and softspoken, so YOU must take the initiative and ask the question or sit in front to understand everything.
He is very soft spoken, so sit up front if you want to understand everything he says. He will help you out and knows the material very well and gives good notes. Tough class, good professor

He seems a little frazzled in class but he emphasizes what you need to know. When he says you need to do the homework and practice problems, he means it. Quizzes every friday but no homework is collected. This is def a difficult class but manageable. I would recommend him.

The class is really hard.  It's important to go to his class and copy down all his notes.  Lots of times in class he makes mistakes and students will correct him.  He is really nice, and intelligent.  He is always willing to help.Don't  fall behind,if you want to do well, keep up with all the work.

His style in class can get very dull.  As long as you follow his steps youre good, but if you get lost, youre screwed.  He is the most helpful prof though.  If you see him after class he is more than happy to help you and does a good job at it.  The test problems come right from the practice problems he gives you, so do them!
Best teacher @ Penn State...ever.
Good man.  Good professor.
I liked this guy, i thought he was a good teacher. Come to class and pay attention, do the practice probs he gives u and u'll get an A.

Bharath is a "teacher" who not only knows the material but also how to teach. Great guy. I loved his teaching method. Very, very clear. Exam problems come from his review sheets that he posts online so do them! I got an A in the class although i think im mathematically challenged.
Very good professor.
Great guy.  Helpful.  Very funny.  Decent class.  Got a A- without much work (took AP in high school).
He's a nice and willing to help. The course is challenging but he provides examples that help you along the way.
No Comments

He is an amazing teacher..usually does all the imporatnt questions from the exam point of view..the course is very hard but he makes it easiers for the students by his excellent talent of teaching..i would definitely recommendhim.

He is a great teacher and knows his stuff. the class is hard, but since its hard to avoid taking it, i would say take it with him. he speaks well even though his name makes you think otherwise. a smart and funny guy who is a good teacher

Chill guy to be around and very generous when giving points back with the regrades if you asked. Main problem is his lectures had zero to do with the material since he just rambled on about some derivation so I had to instead scramble though the textbook to find the equations for the HWs. Also had a fixation with using EES which I never heard of.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I found myself teaching myself the topics and found that lectures were often unhelpful when it came to the assignments. May lectures were theory-based and not helpful when it came to the homework. Attendance got lower as the semester went on; our first exam averaged below a 60%, and he had to curve 10 points to compensate for the low scores.

Dr. Ramos is a solid professor that is very accommodating. His grading philosophy is pretty lenient giving partial credit if the problem solving process is correct. The homework is challenging, but you get enough material from lectures and the textbook to figure it out.

Very good professor.. sometimes i think he was too easy and i didnt learn anything, but maybe that was just coming from insanely hard professors. He taught fluid mechanics well. his grading scale was as follows. quizzes :10% exams 30 % homework 30%.. OPTIONAL final 30%. very good professor indeed!
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Ramos could be one of the best Professors at PSU. He is extremely dedicated to his work and actually wants every single student to succeed. Because of this it is almost impossible to get anything lower than a B. This doesn't mean his class is easy, but the Professor will make you learn whether you like it or not! TAKE ALL OF HIS CLASSES!
Get ready to work!
If you can get her for English 15, take it! She's a great professor and works hard to make her classes successful.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She's very happy to be there and teach you something she really cares about. Easiest class in the world just make sure to write about something you like and participate in class.
Dr. Black came to every class upbeat and ready to teach. If you go to class and participate you will do well. I really liked her class and she is very approachable and interesting.

She is incredibly caring, respectful, and overall such a thoughtful person and made such a boring class more interesting. Her style of assigning work every week might seem like a bit much, until you get to the final paper deadline and realize all the work is already done by you weeks before. Take her for English 15!!
Great teacher. She's fair and pretty interesting. It's annoying that the class is required but since you have to take it anyway do ypurself a favor and take it with Jennifer Black.

I never expected to enjoy english class especially english 15 but Dr. Black made it really interesting and our class had a good time. We participated for the most part. I liked the prof she was easy to understand and gave good feedback. all my friends hated their english 15 classes but not me!
No exams!!

Her personality is very nice, and it is sad that no one in the class answers when she asks questions, but I am unfortunately also too anxious to respond to things I do not know 100% for sure. She is very laidback and accommodating, does not assign much if anything, and although she does have an attendance policy, is very nice & excuses a lot.
Dr. Black is a very nice teacher, I know alot of freshman may be worried about having to take ENGL 15 but this class is honestly a breeze if you commit and get things done on time.
Dr. Black is a very nice lady. We have one assignment due a week, which is always relevant to our bigger project due at the end of the unit. The lectures during class are kind of relevant.

Her style of teaching makes you feel like you're in elementary school. I would take a different professor for this class if you do not have any background in STATS. She is super confusing with nots and includes a lot of irrelevant info

The rating rn is a little harsh. I'm not going to say it's an easy class, but you have a week to do the homework and she will help. Additionally, if you show up to lectures and ask questions leading up to exams she'll give little hints and you get memory sheets. If not in person, at least join the Zoom. She knows her stuff and is helpful, just ask!

Math 319 is a hard and demanding course but professor bond is a great professor and really helpful. She is super nice and cares about her students. My advice do the homework, show up to class, participate, ask questions and you will be fine

She is not the best lecturer because she goes on tangents and seems disorganized, but you can tell she really knows what she's talking about. She made the class really come together after we covered all the material, so with the way she teaches it gets progressively easier to understand. She is SUPER nice and super approachable.

Take another professor if you can. Lectures were all over the place and good luck if you want to look back at the notes because she will handwrite problems over them that you can't read. Exams are worth most of your grade. If you do bad on one your grade will not recover as the homework's and quizzes are only worth a small percent.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Bond is a very fun and laid back professor, but the lectures can be too fast paced to understand sometimes. Taking notes is extremely important in this class and even when you do, it can be hard to keep up. Otherwise her class is a great environment.

She is a very nice lady, but I hated the set up of the slides and how she taught. It was hard to study for and lots of topics weren't really explained much. Class overall isn't super hard but I struggled to motivate to go to class every morning. Also can't see what questions you got wrong on exams you need to go to office hours. She is fine but meh

I don't get the negative reviews. Professor Bond is super funny and passionate about statistics. She wants her students to learn and explains topics well. Even if you get lost during a lecture, it's easy enough to go back to the slideshow or find online help. I hate math but I had a good time with her.

Genuinely don't understand the bad reviews. Dr. Bond is a good professor, clearly loves teaching statistics, and is always in a good mood. Was very helpful when I had issues regarding homework assignments. There are tons of resources to help get a good grade (Pearson, slideshows). This course was easier than AP stat in high school.

Professor Bond is a great professor if you pick up on Calculus quickly and can learn it as you go. Her lectures are definitely hit or miss and her exams are very difficult. If you study the lecture notes and the previous exams she provides you should be okay, and the homeworks are not too bad at all.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This professor isn't that bad if you go to class and take notes. She clearly is very kind and cares about the success of her students, and she makes the exams significantly easier than the homeworks. That being said, the lecture slides are extremely unorganized and hard to follow. The final exam was almost entirely questions from previous exams btw

Unprofessional.Creates HW assignments she cant solve. Forgets concepts. Canceled office hours for months due to dog-sitting issues...yup. She mocks how difficult the course is. Exams weren't graded before the final, and the final wasn't written until the day before. Calc 3 material was included, when this class is for students who haven't taken it.
I hate to say it but she can't even screenshot full questions in her assignments. "Refer to the full question in the book". Absolutely terrible.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class was all over the place. The homework, the labs, and the class felt like three different topics. Didn't know how to help me the first time I emailed her. I couldn't really understand anything taught in the class. Don't recommend this course.

Took her for 319. She is really nice and if you show that you care, will be lenient with late assignments and give extensions. Weekly homework (can find textbook pdf online). She uploads her slides and tells you what to study for exams.  I would recommend just attending class and asking questions but honestly not needed if you're like that.

All over the place, please try to take another professor. Honestly one of the worst classes I have taken at Penn State simply due to how the class is organized (or lack thereof) and taught by the professor.

She's all over the place. Going back and reviewing the notes is basically impossible because they're so disorganized and confusing. Luckily I took AP Stat in high school so I had some foundation to help me. Just take another professor if you can.

stat was easier for me my senior year of hs because unlike professor Bond, my teacher wasn't all over the place. she doesn't teach during lectures- she just rambles so you're better off not going and just attending the labs. even so, the wording on the labs is awful so good luck teaching yourself everything.

Mrs. Bond is an absolute joy in lecture. Unquestionably the best-dressed and most enthused math professor I have had so far. In terms of difficulty, I would rate her stat318 as middling. Not the hardest, not dead easy. Kind partial credit. HW basically graded for completion. Her slide organization is my only problem.

She may be nice to you, but she's evil inside. Her Class is the most insanely hard class I've taken. I am a senior CS major and this class has been the hardest class I've taken because her class feels like a Calc 3 class at this point. All the other sections have their exams online but she has it in person and its HARD. All-nighters are useless too
HARD
She has an mini exam 3 before the final's week and her lecture slides are not good
Had a midterm the week before finals...

Lectures are useless. Labs just consisted of the T.A running around and attempting to answer questions from 40-ish students as the lab made no sense. Don't be surprised when your grade tanks in the last 5 weeks due to bizarre concepts and lack of explanation of the instructor. Save your GPA and take a better GQ.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Bond is very nice and cares about her students. However, I have a hard time following her lectures and I have a hard time paying attention in class. It feels like she is all over the place a lot of the time.
Super easy class, you don't even need to pay attention to pass with an A.

Prof. Bond is one of the nicest professors I have met. She is kind and genuinely tries to teach her class. BUT, it takes here weeks to grade the midterms, and here lectures feel all over the place. While she recently started teaching, I hope she improves, as she can be a wonderful prof., if she gets slightly more organized with here content.
Incredibly nice person but the lectures were all over the place and incredibly hard to follow. There was no structure to the class and you were basically left to learn on your own.

It doesn't help that this was her first time teaching this class, but Dr. Bond tends to be all over the place during lectures. I assume that if she teaches this class again, she will be better just from experience. She was willing to move deadlines and even the midterm dates if people needed it, and overall she is very friendly.

I liked Professor Bond for STAT300. She's a very nice person, but her teaching style is very all over the place and gets confusing. There are 4 midterms and a final, along with weekly homeworks. She does a good job of explaining things and is very smart, but the structure of the class could use some work.

Only have to go to lab to get the code but not the lectures. Going to the lab and doing them with others makes it doable. The exams are pretty easy and are taken during lab so you can use your own computer and you get a cheat sheet. The lectures are insanely boring and not helpful. Your 2 lowest labs, homework's, and introductions are dropped.

Although she is quite unorganized, she is still good at explaining the material relatively well, but her lectures can still be quite iffy and sometimes hard to follow. She can also be either a light/tough grader depending on the test or assignment. Which can wreck grades if you're not careful. She is still kind and helpful, going to OH should help.

Don't listen to the other reviews. Its an easy course, but that doesn't make the prof good. She is very unorganized, but can improve since she hasn't taught in many years. She is very inconsistent with whether she is able to complete a problem because she just wings it in class. Very talkative and tends move from topic to topic will no transition.

Class is simple, she has weekly quizzes for you to practice, but they count toward your grade (unlimited time, multiple attempts) so you can do well. The homework assignments can be tough, but if you need help she'll work with you and give you the answer. Exams are a little tough, but not impossible, I'm just not great at math. Awesome professor.

Professor Bond is the greatest college professor. Her lectures make me feel like I'm back in elementary school which is a nice break in my day. She's not very tech-savvy and makes mistakes occasionally, shes very generous with grading, and her assignments are doable.

Probably the worst professor ever. Math is about accuracy but she often makes mistakes in her solutions which confuses her studenst even more. Do not take her if you do not want to self-study skipped slides and uncomplete lecture notes. Someone who does not teach well is at least expected not to be a tough grader. She does not meet this expectation

Arguably the hardest teacher I have had in my entire life. The nature of the class itself is very complicated, especially during your first semester. Expect long HW assignments that take a few hours and lectures that don't make sense. You will have to teach yourself practically everything and cross your fingers that you have good TAs.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He's caring & helpful, but the lectures can be boring or difficult to understand. The class introduces a lot of new material, and the diagrams are especially important for understanding the concepts. It was overwhelming, but I found the course more manageable with a solid chemistry background. HW is tough, but remember ai policy.

Just not an enjoyable professor and he makes class seem like it's 2 hours long with his way of teaching. He is not the best at explaining things and if it wasn't for the TAs and LAs I would have failed. I would take Gardner is you could he is the man.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took CHEM 112B. His lectures were kind of boring, mainly bc it was at 8 am, but he actually wants to help you do well in the class. Attendance is only through TopHat, and the exam extra credit helps a lot. As long as you follow along during the lecture's TopHat questions, you'll do fine. Final exam had some difficult questions though.
Good professor, probably would've been better if it wasn't at 8am. Chemistry is always gonna be hard but he does his best to teach it as well as possible with limited time.

Could perhaps smile/joke around more (did have him at 8am tho), but clearly knowledgable and passionate about the subject he teaches. Appears a bit unapproachable when you first meet him, but genuinely wants his students to do well and provides great help/advice once you get to know him. Practice exams are pretty helpful and count for extra credit.

A great professor who appears a bit unapproachable when you first meet him, but genuinely wants his students to do well and provides great help/advice once you get to know him. Could perhaps smile/joke around more but clearly knowledgable and passionate about the subject he teaches. Practice exams are really helpful and count for extra credit.

Super chill professor, lectures were filled with practice problems so if you showed up to class it was easy to do the HW and the exams. Completing the practice exams can give you extra credit, plus if you do the practices the exams should be way easier.

One of my harder classes, passed with C+. He's understanding and a very relaxed guy who understands the material. Maybe it was my mistake taking the 8 am lecture, but I found his lectures very boring and someone who would just do problems instead of explaining them, very fast paced through the lectures. Go to every class or you'll be confused.

Dr Boehr subbed in for my CHEM112 professor a couple of times and I was always so happy when he did. He understands this course inside and out and is the best CHEM112 professor by a mile. Would definitely recommend
hes a chill guy, thanks
Dr. Boehr cares about the students but chem is still going to be difficult. He is a good choice for a chem.

Dr. Boehr was an awesome professor. He truly wants you to grasp the material and will explain everything thoroughly if you have questions. His lectures are super helpful. Exams were difficult, but there were a ton of outside resources. Dr. Boehr also offers a lot of extra credit if you feel like you're falling behind.

Dr. Boehr is a good professor. That's about it. He doesn't strike me as an incredible once-in-a-lifetime prof (cough-cough, Dr. Pontius) nor an awful, avoid-at-all-costs one either (I won't mention any names). He seems pretty average: nice enough, fair enough, cool enough guy. Nothing to write home about, but certainly not one to be avoided.

I sent my emails about my chem questions to him. He always type a lot of words and details to make sure I can understand the questions. And his class is really nice. You will not feel bad if you join it. Very nice man

Boehr is truly the best chem professor I've experienced thus far at PSU. I struggled through Chem110, but everything from 112 made sense thanks to the way he teaches. You have to show up to lectures and recitations if you want to understand the materials for the tests, but it's def possible to get an A if you put in the work.

Terrible professor, he is obviously a research hire that is required to teach the course. He overcomplicates practice problems and the exams are based on things he doesn't even teach you, the class average for the last exam was a 45% and he did not curve! The other teachers had an average of 61 percent, just awful!
Lectures are easy to follow & take notes in. He was easy to understand & made Chem112 fun. Exams are awful, but he provides tons of extra credit. He was the reason I understood Chem112
Has a nice way of explaining chemistry lessons. Although the lessons may feel unconnected at times, they all connect at some point.

He was an okay lecturer, pretty dry but understandable. I thought 112 was definitely harder than 110. He prepares you well for assignments outside of class but when it came to exams, a lot of it was stuff he didn't really cover so I personally struggled with them.

I had a really hard time in Chem 110B so this class was a much better experience! Dr. Boehr's lectures are so much better than a flipped classroom! If you do well on everything you have a lot of wiggle room to do poorly on the exams. Exam averages are super low though so be warned. Tons of extra credit, go to the extra credit help sessions trust me

Dr. Boehr is amazing at explaining concepts in class, and taking problems step-by-step. In my opinion, the content covered in CHEM 112 was much easier than the content from CHEM 110. If you do the homework problems with purpose, you should be fine. Most of the questions on exams are similar to those on homework sets. Just stay on top of things.

He is a nice guy and I enjoyed his lectures. In general, chemistry tests are not easy at Penn State, so I do not want to blame my grade on him, although I do not like the small percentage of extra credit. I also wish the exams were more similar to the practice exams with similar concepts. He is pretty dry, but understandable.

Loved attending Dr. Boehr's lectures. He is a good public speaker and teaches the subject very well. The tests were not hard, but not easy. 100% go to TA sessions and his Sunday homework session (extra credit from these).
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr Boehr is a fantastic chemistry teacher. He may be a bit dry in lecture, but you will understand the material if you attend his lectures. He really cares about his students and wants you to succeed. He instructs Chem 112 in a hands off manner with no HW collected and optional extra credit worksheet sessions. This learning may not be for everyone

Dr Boehr is a very good professor, he is open to helping students all the time, he believes that chemistry is all about practicing instead of memorizing. His lecture class is very good. I understand everything in class.

Dr. Boehr really tries to do the best for his students. To be honest I think that his lectures are really dry. I took this as an 8 AM and it was so hard to stay awake. Although he is no Todd Pontius in the classroom he cares about his students and is very accessible outside of class to help any of his students out.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He seems like a good guy. Chem 110 is hard at Penn State and he really didnt make it easier. Its hard to say if thats really his fault though, like previously stated, the class is very hard.

Dr. Boehr is an amazing professor! I hate chemistry, but he's really great at his lectures and you can tell he really cares. Chem 110 sucks, but Boehr is probably the best professor you could have for it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Caring

reviews.comment: Great professor, he explains concepts very well and makes the lectures interesting. There are weekly homework and online quizzes which gets annoying but they really offer great practice. Clicker questions are included in ever lecture and are worth 2 points each, so attendance is mandatory.
Great chemistry professor. Explains concepts well and offers tons of practice and help outside of class. Put in effort and you will succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: His class made me love chemistry in a way I never thought I would. Dr. Boehr went out of his way to help his students both in and out of class. He held small study sessions outside of class to provide help to. He was very clear about his expectations for us and also explained concepts in ways that made them easy to understand.
great guy, clear lessons, chem 110 kinda difficult but dr boehr explains everything really well

Chem 110 is the same across the board for most professors Participation is graded by clicker questions, but you only need 75 to get full credit Chem 110 is a difficult class, but I feel like what professor you chose won't have much effect on the grade you get So Dr Boehr is a solid choice, but I think its just a tougher class no matter what

Dr. Boehr really cares about his students. About a week before each exam he emails the class with a study plan that he recommends following. He really wants to see everyone succeed, and after exams he sets up opportunities to reflect on your exam. His lectures are kind of boring, but there are clicker questions, so it's mandatory.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Boehr is a really good professor. He explains conceptual ideas very easily. You can actually learn during his lectures. The homework and practice exams will help you dearly for the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Come class. Do all hw. Do pratice test, time practice exam --> success
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He's a diamond in the rough. Don't shy away b/c its an 8am. Good lectures, although when he makes a mistake he gets all rattled. Can get extra credit from doing a question site. Lots of clickers so don't skip class but you really can't for chem110, it's hard. Nice guy and helpful too. Make sure to attend the timed practice exams. Also sweats a lot
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: CHEM110 is not difficult if you took AP Chem with a good teacher. Dr Boehr is very nice and was very good at answering all my questions. You have to come to class (at 8AM, I might add) for clicker points, but he is a very good lecturer and does some fun demos. Lots of practice exams to help you study. Overall, I thought he was a great professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: If you are willing to put in the work in the class, he will go out of his way to make sure you receive the grade you want. Don't waste your time reading from the ebook, just pay attention to the lectures and study the lecture notes really hard. He puts all of his lectures online so you can print them out and study them whenever you want
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Not sure what what the person below is talking about. Dr. Boehr is a very caring professor who is always willing to help students clarify any confusion. He even offers extra credit to help your grade. You do have to show up to class to earn clicker points, but they aren't difficult if you put in the time to learn the material. He is a good prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Please do not take this guy. He'll put you through hell and back. The guy thinks we know everything and his clicker questions are hard as rocks.

I feel Dr Boehr is a very underrated professor. He is very organized and clear with his lecture notes and gives lots of clicker questions to make sure you understand the material. He also has lots of practice exams to help you study. He genuinely wants you to do well and understand chemistry. He's also a Canadian which makes class more interesting.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Really cares about the class doing well. He is very nice and tries to make the material which is pretty tough, fun.

Best Chem 110 professor. His lectures are really helpful and explanatory. He has a lot clicker questions which count towards participation grade but thwy were helpful as well. He is always willing to meet with you and clarify any confusion. He cares about his students and wants the best for them. You would really love his class.

A lot is covered during lecture but he uploads his notes from lecture after class. He is always happy to help students. A bit boring, but a nice professor and not too strict a grader.  Tests aren't difficult.   Skipping classes will result in lower test scores.  Not a great class, but not a bad one.
Real laid back, very easy to get along with. Sees eye-to-eye with almost everybody. Listens to jam bands if that gives you any idea. Super cool bro.
Mr.Morris is extremely nice and very accommodating to the students. Some of the lectures were definitely very confusing, and I often left class thinking, "What did I even learn?"

Professor is passionate and engaging during lectures, young but understanding of being a student. may include hidden instructions in rubrics or assignments, so be sure to read everything very carefully
