reviews.comment: Genuinely my favorite professor I've had at Penn State so far. He really cares about what he teaches and his students. You do actually have to put in work, and attendance policy of no more than 3 is annoying. But he makes up for it by having a very engaging class.

Killen is the worst professor you could get for 202. You are made to go to a play that is $19, print your own textbook, and miss no more than 3 classes. He count's attendance twice by giving you 5/5 a week for attending all 3 classes, and then takes a percentage deduction at the end of the class. My friends in other 202 classes had none of this.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Killen is one of those professors who is in love with the sound of his own voice. He takes any chance he can to use vocabulary that seems like he picked up yesterday to impress 21 year olds. He makes you write hand written drafts before writing your final one and will not grade the final if you don't. No other English class does this, save yourself
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: He reported me for AI integrity violation when I did not use it, he was also unwilling to discuss the violation before submitting the report

Prof Killen is great. His readings are very interesting and his lectures and discussion are very engaging. You can tell he wants us to learn and gives good feedback on essays. If you have any questions his office hours are super helpful, or he always talks to students after class. If you can take any version of 202, I recommend 202B with Killen.

Prof. Killen was a very good english teacher. You have 4 main papers throughout the semester. He offers optional conferences for your papers, DO THEM. He pretty much tells you exactly what he wants to see in your paper. He provides color commentary during his lectures which make the class enjoyable.

Extremely harsh grader.I've gotten A+ in every English class I've taken, 5 on the AP exam, yet couldn't get higher than a 90% on any essay.Only grades on the letter (ex: 85, 90, 94) + doesn't believe in grading by a specific percentage nor does he give 100s either so the highest grade you can receive is a 94 (which is nearly impossible to attain).
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: The 4 essays are weighed so that each one further into the semester matters more for your grade. After each essay he schedules a conference with you to go over how to improve your writing. Lectures can get boring but I had 75 minute classes which are always long. He tries his best to be energetic and youthful, and gets that we're not English majors
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I loved professor Killen. After every major essay assignment he met with every student to discuss our grade and discuss how we can improve. It was incredibly helpful. You can tell he truly cares and wants us to do well. You just have to put in the work and show that you care. I thought he was great and he definitely helped my writing improve.

He is a great professor. He is a tough grader, but he offers many times to meet outside of class and it is very useful to do so! as someone who does not really enjoy english classes, he made it enjoyable and he really improved my professional writing

I loved Professor Killen's class. The poor ratings here are completely unfair. Killen was always willing to meet with students, give in-depth notes, and even allows rewrites on the four major essays. If you want to get patted on the back, don't take this class. If you want to grow as a writer and critical thinker, take Killen for English.

You write 4 essays that slightly change each year; these 4 are the primary grades for the class. After each essay he offers a rewrite where you change your essay to his comments for extra points. Overall, I didn't felt engaged as I usually do for his class but he didn't say anything when I dozed off.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: The classes mostly consist of lectures to prepare for each essay or to discuss readings. He is very open to extensions on due dates and allows you to rewrite each paper if you don't like your grade. He is also always willing to help when needed.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Very accessible outside class, very helpful

A great guy; he's extremely flexible in his dates if you want office hours with him. He allows rewrites a week after grades are published. A bit monotone sometimes, but can crack a good joke or two every once in a while. Genuinely a kind professor!
He definitely wants the best for his students!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: When I came across prof Killens rate my professor I was scared going into the class and thought I was going to do bad. If you are a pretty good writer and put in effort you are good.

You have to try hard on the daily In-class writing activities in order to get a good grade in the class. He is an okay professor depending on the way the class is as a whole. He acts all oppressed too, make your life easier and don't take.

Prof. Killen is a notoriously tough grader and is relatively vague on his feedback. Throughout the semester you are graded on 4 major papers. reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Killen is just not a nice guy. I was in his English 15 for two days and we had a 50 page reading assignment assigned on the first day and then had a reading assignment on it the second day. I dropped and added a different english 15 after the first two days and it was the best choice I've ever made. It's not that he's just hard, hes mean!

I got A's in all classes and B- in this just because he is mindlessly a tough grader. Grading criteria are not clear and he expects us to write essays as if we are Ph.D. students. Please do not take him, I wish he was on rate my prof when I took it :(

Killen is tough but not impossible. Anyone who says he is just didn't work hard enough guaranteed. I went to the writing center to get feedback on all my assignments (which were only four so its not like it was time consuming) and got good grades on all of them. At the end of the semester my grade was on the brink and he rounded up, which was nice.

Toughest grader out there. Four assignments make up most of your grade. All of which I have gotten one of the best scores (if not the top score) for each assignment and I'll likely end with an A- because a 94% is an A. Not trying to be "that" person, but it goes to show that his grading is bs. We are first semester freshmen, not graduate students.

Professor Killen is a terrible grader. He grades incredibly harsh and does not even explain why you got the grade you did. The feedback he gives does not correlate to the grade you received. I would not take this professor again and I wish he had a rate my professor page earlier.

Professor Killen is such a harsh grader. All of his grading is based off of what he specifically would write, not the rubric or directions. Dont take him for english 15 all of my other friends professors graded much easier. It is practically impossible to get an A on papers

75% of the grade is 4 papers where you have no option to get help before or after turning it in. I had a friend, who had an A in the same class for another prof, review my essay, and said it was an A and I consistently got low Bs. Unfair grader and unclear rubrics.

The instructor's teaching style was unclear and made the material difficult to follow. Communication was very poor, with emails often going unanswered. Grading was extremely strict with little to no flexibility, even in situations involving a family emergency. This made a class that's supposed to be useful, unnecessarily stressful and difficult.

Inconsistently released the week's asynchronous lectures and often released the HW assignments late for no reason with minimal days to complete (instead of the promised week in advance in case you needed to consult TAs). HWs felt like busy work, very repetitive extensive solidworks simulations with confusing HW instructions.

Margaret Busse is not a great professor. Her homeworks don't supply instructions as to what she wants you to do and submit, leaving you to guess what she wants from the comically long pdfs (80+ pages) or the videos that need to be played on at least 1.5x speed to get your work done in a timely manner

It is a surprise to many that Mary Bojan is not in the Agriculture department considering how much of a vegetable she is.

This class is heavily dependent on how your TA grades assignments, and you will learn much more in recitation than in lectures. Lots of HW, but make sure you do them thoroughly so you are prepared.

as long as you pull your load and do your work you will be fine, she explains content very well. Overall a caring professor who wants her students to succeed, while teaching them to learn content on their own

Should've started studying 30 years ago. DO NOT TAKE WITH HER!!!!!!!

I seriously could not recommend her any less. You could honestly learn Mandarin faster than you could learn Chemistry if being taught by her. Don't recommend!!!!

Hard Teacher for a hard course
Incredibly rude and would shut down students mid class when they asked questions. Don't take her she's mad unpleasant to be around.

do not take this course if you don't have to, and don't take it with Bojan, her voice is grating and annoying which makes it hard to listen to lectures, way too much information and work for an intro level class, learn how to study quick with this course

Way too many assignments every week, I constantly felt overwhelmed. Would not recommend. Every other teacher I heard about was much better.

All she does is yap about studying, she will not teach anything that you need. Also attendance is mandatory so enjoy the waste of an hour in a building that's almost 20mins from your dorm

Dr. Bojan definitely cares about students' grades in her class and hosts numerous study sessions. If you are not religious pick a religion and pray.

If you want to succeed in chem110, do not take this class. The workload is crazy considering the difficulty of the content, which makes it so hard to keep up while digesting the material each week. there is more time spent in class talking about "study habits" than actually practicing the content. horrible

This is the only professor I would willingly write a dissertation about how much I dislike her. She spends every week talking about study strategies and she does not teach lessons. She said that the big notebook was mandatory for the class, never wrote in it once. She is not engaging during class. DO NOT TAKE WITH MARY BOJAN!

Talks like a toddler and explains things like we're already experts. Spends most lectures going on about how to study instead of actually teaching. Exams are brutal and barely match what's covered. Attendance is mandatory, so you're forced to sit through the chaos. Take literally anyone else if you value your sanity.
Its too big of a class as it is to learn chem in, that being said she moves at a very fast pace and expects you to already know what shes teaching.

Took this class 2 years ago and its still one of the hardest/worst classes I've taken. Content and lectures are made way more complicated then they need to be. Brutal exams and more homework than all of my other classes combined.

The packet used is very beneficial for summing up the information you need to know from the textbook and lecture. She spends too much time talking about studying and then tries to cram the entire lecture in the last 20 mins of class. Completely blames you if you are not doing well. She might be better for those taking the course again.

A good professor if taking the class for your second time around. The binder is very useful for summing up the information for the important parts. She spends a lot of time talking about studying and than tries to cram the lecture in for the last 25 mins. TA office hours and good study habits are the best and maybe the most influential way to pass.

Mary Bojan just does not explain things at all. She spends more time talking about how to study but you can't study if you don't know the content. Most of her class is a waste of time but attendance in mandatory. However the lady that does the GSG sessions is rly good and knows what she is talking about so make sure you go to that.

Whole CHEM 110 department needs a culture shift IMO. If Bojan wasn't the coordinator, I guarantee chemistry would come so much easier to more students. Literally just PhD narcissism. All the exams and hw are created by her. Take Lisa Funari if you can! Only sane person.

I took Chem 110 my first semester at Penn State, and it was difficult (that is just the nature of a Chem 110 as a weed out class) but it is very doable. However, Dr. Bojan is just not a great teacher- lectures were unengaging and boring, and I primarily relied on myself for learning content. Take another professor if possible.
saw that girl sobbing on tiktok because of this class and other people in the comments had similar experiences

Literally could not take a day off without having to do some work for this class. I retook this class over the summer at my community college and it did not have as much topics she personally choose to add.

The lectures are awful and she expects everyone to just know things with no explanation. Do NOT take chemistry with her if you can. do not. take chem. with her. literally choose anyone else. save yourself. big curve at the end of the semester that can save your grade. but other than that there is nothing good about this class.

HORRIBLE PROF! Does not teach, difficult to communicate with, and beyond boring with such a shrill voice. If it was not for TopHat questions, attending her class would be useless. reviews.comment: Chem110 with Professor Bojan can be challenging, but with the right approach it can be manageable. The lectures can be fast-paced, so staying engaged and using study aids like unstuckstudy ai can really help. Overall, a tough but rewarding class.

I've noticed a lot the students who are saying poor things about Dr. Bojan are the same one's who put in little to no effort, or just aren't ready for academic discipline. I've been her LA for two semesters now, and I always see the same divide among students. Put in the work and you'll be fine. This course builds great long-term skills.

Chem110 was the toughest course ever, proff bojan is a tough grader when it comes to recitation and she has her own method of writing the solution which you need to follow, which other proffs don't do the same. She keeps talking about the study guide, it shows problems and description of the topics but it wasn't helpful at all.

Truly the most patronizing, condescending, & arrogant teacher I've ever had. Don't take her if you can't handle being talked down on all semester or if you want a strong foundation in CHEM. She often wastes HALF the lecture yapping about the inferior low exam scorers, & doesn't take time to teach challenging problems. Truly no redeeming qualities.
She was a great professor. The lectures go off the work book you have to buy in the beginning of the year. Her lectures are really well put together and she cares about her studetns.
Mary is very nice and wants her students to do well, she definitely has a passion for chemistry. The only issue I found is she is very disorganized and will get side tracked during lecture.

Absolutely terrible class. She went through material too quickly and expects you to know it immediately after she "explains" it. The exams were tough and the homework during the week took up the majority of my time (6hrs) that I couldn't give to my other courses due to hers. Take this course with anyone other than Bojan, or take it through a CC.

Most of the negative ratings come from people who hated coming to terms with the fact they actually have to put in effort to achieve something. Dr. Bojan is aware most of her students are premed/engineers, she knows these careers require discipline. If you can't put in even 15-30 minutes a day to practice chemistry, you may want to rethink.

Bojan is genuinely a nice lady, and is knowledgeable in chemistry. She definitely is passionate about what she teaches--but she is overly concerned with teaching methods to succeed (~15 minutes of a 50 minute lecture) and not so much actual course content. We are adults, and people who can't figure out how to study by now don't need to be coddled.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Chem 110 is a hard course, and that is not the professor's fault.  The course curriculum is not set by them.  That is what most of the people on here get wrong about her.  If you sit in the front, she will make an effort to try to get to know you and she is really a great person and will answer all of your questions.  She is a good choice for CHEM.

This class is taught by a TA (mine was Delaney Link), the class consists of doing group work most of the time, solving exam like problems, and a turn in sheet which your group hands in at the end of class for credit. Dr. Bojan would be a much better professor if it weren't for two things. She feels it is her job to teach us how to study rather than teach us chemistry. She wastes too much time doing this in class. She also is completely unwilling to answer questions if they have already been mentioned in class.

reviews.comment: Not the best at explaining hard concepts in an easily understandable way and not very engaging. Clearly passionate about her work, but a little insensitive.

She cares about each student being successful in her class, however, she will not make it easy. Her pre-lecture videos and in-person lectures are the exact same. Pre-lecture hw and in-person lectures are the exact same. If you only need this class for the credit, I would take someone else.
She teaches loosely based on the textbook. She assigns questions in class and instead of explaining them afterward, she makes everyone complete a top hat.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Bojan really cares about her students, has a passion for what she does, and provides endless resources. I think a lot of these bad reviews come from this class being hard- there's a heavy workload and a lot of time is required outside of class, but I assure that if you put in this hard work, you'll find success and appreciate this class.
Awful at explaining this, makes everything 10x more complicated. Chemistry is hard to begin with, but she makes it worse. Take any other professor if possible

This lady is a gem! I'm a freshman and I was scared to take the class, reading the awful review she had. I honestly was terrified but she is an amazing prof who truly cares and wants us to love and learn chemistry. The class is hard def but they are soo many resources. Work hard and ask for help and you will do well in this class. Don't skip class!

Everything that is assigned in this course is meant to help understanding of the material, and it all does help if you actually do it. Your allowed to have a front and back cheat sheet on exams. She does not want you to fail, she does as much as she can to prepare you, it is just a difficult course already so you have to do your work.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This course sucks regardless of what professor you take it with. I did well, but it wasn't because of Dr. Bojan. She requires an extra workbook that other profs don't, but I found it very helpful. If you keep up with the work you can do well. Dr. Bojan answers emails and is willing to help outside of class. This course is mostly self taught.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: There is a lot of work for this class, but the resources for success are almost unlimited. Additional videos, office hours, text book readings and activities are all available. A lot of time and effort goes into the class, but you will definitely learn chemistry and genuinely know it if you try.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: I really liked Bojan even though most people didn't. I read the lessons before lecture and did all of the practice and homework she gave and did well on every exam. You have to be proactive in this class and actually try, get help from LAs when you don't understand, and do what she asks of you. I think she's a good teacher if you are a hard worker.
Organized, all materials and help are provided. As long as spend time to study we can pass. Heavy workload.

If you want a professor who will teach the material in class, don't taker her class. She assigns lecture videos to do outside of class, so you will have to learn the material on your own. In class you will answer questions that she gives you barely anytime to answer, and half of the time she doesn't even know the answer.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: There's a lot of work to do outside class (reading the textbook, watching videos, pre-lecture quizzes). The lectures are mostly going over topics from the previous day's reading/quiz, but Bojan brings in a lot of experiments/demonstrations, so going to lecture did actually help me understand the topics better.

College chem is really tough no matter what prof you have. Dr. Bojan has an expressive and enthusiastic voice that makes it easier to stay awake in the morning class, which is nice. The lectures are primarily solving problems in topics that you have to learn beforehand with online materials, but I do not know if it is different in other sections.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Not an easy class being a weed-out but not extremely hard either. This course has the best syllabus I have ever seen, and is very well-structured. Dr. Bojan assigns what seems like an overwhelming amount of assignments, but they are all mostly short and are easy points. Exams allow a single-page cheat sheet which makes them much less intimidating.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Not the worst professor but not the best. CHEM 110 in general is bad no matter the professor. Make sure you have a lighter schedule when taking this class, LOTS OF WORK. She doesn't know how to explain concepts in a way that first time chem students to understand. You mostly teach yourself which is jarring for a freshman class.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: I need CHEM for my degree, but she is the worst professor I've ever had. All work is done outside of class and in class you just work on a required workbook (that is not required for other professors) and she explains concepts with "because I just know these things." If you can take CHEM 110 with another professor, do it.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--So many papers

reviews.comment: She can come off as condescending, but she really isnt the reason why this class is difficult. Its meant to be hard. She gives a lot of work. A lot. The work is very helpful and is the reason why her exam averages are higher than other sections.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--So many papers

reviews.comment: Professor Bojan is not a good prof. She is very lecture-heavy and does not like when you ask questions. When you ask a question, she will not give an explanation and tell you that it is not a good question to be asking right now, but does not give a time for when you can ask it. Her exams are insanely difficult, so make sure you do the homework.

I don't know if it is like that for other CHEM 110 sections or not, but there are A LOT of tasks. She gives good summaries in her slides. It feels like it is the only course you are taking the whole semester, for your calendar is full of CHEM things to do. Expects a lot from students. The method of reinforcing the huge material is hard to deal with
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Literally, just not it. Even though I'm doing well in the class, it has absolutely nothing to do with her. She literally spent the final class not reviewing for the final but decided to talk about irrelevant material. Although, if you have her, this does not mean you can't succeed in the class, you can still do well!!!
Super hard, tons of work outside of class. Spent most of my time last semester doing work for this class.

BE PREPARED FOR A LOT OF WORK!!! CHEM 110 is a very strenuous course, however, you will be provided with all of the resources you need to be successful. My best recommendation is to take all of the practice exams and go to every review session. My only problem with Bojan was that her responses to questions can be very snippy and condescending.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Overall, Bojan was a mediocre professor. Chem 110 is a nightmare despite who you take. She assigns a tremendous amount of homework which is very overwhelming but you will get the hang of it. Her lectures were decent but you have to do a ton of outside work. I spent 90% of my first semester doing chem, but is doable if you put enough work into it.

There is a very strict syllabus so asking for extra credit or extensions won't really get you anywhere; however, this woman is an amazing teacher. Just make sure that you do all the assigned out of class work and you'll be good. I was not so lucky, but I have hope that if I were to take her again in another semester, I could be more lucky
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Mary Bojan is an ok professor. However, the amount of work you do outside of is ridiculous. Every week you do homework, recitation, at least 2 PLQs and a CAT quiz and in the end it is less than 20% of your grade. Her exams her much harder than anything you will ever learn and sometimes there are equations you never have talked about. DONT TAKE IT!!

CHEM110 is not an easy class and it is extremely demanding outside of class. Although she cares about her students, she goes very fast and her exams are extremely difficult. You can show up to class everyday and do all of the homework and still not do too well in the class. Make sure that you pay attention and study at least a week in advance.
terrible.

The grading system is very confusing and she isn't flexible AT ALL. The entire class can average a 65% test score and curving is still out of the question. During lectures questions are limited and frowned upon, she makes you feel like its a stupid thing to ask about it and if it is relevant than her explanation will throw you off. All around bad.

She is the worst professor i have ever had. Does not effectively explain the material and is even worse with online school. Does not care about students. Effectively ruined my gpa. Do not waste your time with this class or professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor Bojan is the hardest professor or teacher I have had. Save yourself the trouble, when you schedule yourself for the semester, take a different professor for Chem 110. Harsh grader, Terrible at explaining the material, and very hard to get a hold of. She is very arrogant, and you are going to have to learn all the material outside of class
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Wow. I don't even know where to begin. Don't waste your time

Hands down the worst professor I have ever had. She would begin explaining a problem in class, pause and allow us to solve it on our own and then NEVER GO BACK TO IT. I went to her office hours to get extra help and she told me basically I wouldnt pass so dont get my hopes up. I DID pass so thanks for that Bojan.

One of the worst professors I've had. She would always go over lecture time and would give you three seconds to complete in-class worksheets. The stuff she teaches makes no sense and she expects you to know everything and skips lots of information expecting you to figure it out. Only got a decent grade because of my TA.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She literally doesn't teach any material and expects you to teach it all to yourself. Absurd amount of homework, literally spent all my time on this class. would not recommend.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: She doesn't even teach, she just expects you to magically learn things from the readings that make zero sense. The last time I took chemistry was in high school and it showed. She expects you to have a lot of background knowledge for a 100-level course. She doesn't curve and thinks its positive when the class average is in the high 60s/low 70s.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This class could not be more frustrating, she assigns absurd amount of homework each week that you must invest all your time into. Not to mention, in lectures she will spend HALF the class ranting about why her teaching strategy is the best when SHE IS NOT EVEN TEACHING. My least favorite class taken at PSU.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This class honestly makes it hard to succeed in chemistry in general. Bojan does not care about her students, and swears by the textbook that SHE wrote but is honestly awful. This class will be extremely challenging for no reason, so get ready to dedicate almost your entire semester to it. Would NOT recommend Bojan, take anyone else!!!!!!!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Bojan is a good professor in my eyes. The weekly quizzes and homework get a bit repetitive, but manageable. There are plenty of TAs in class if you have questions. She had lots of demonstrations and even gave us a break for on in-class skit involving reactions. Overall, make sure you understand the topics, get help if needed, and you'll be fine
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: If you want to teach yourself everything and be rushed through class, take her. She is by far the worst professor I have ever had. She must have been messed up by some professor in the past to be as rotten as she is. Gives a lot of work and the least amount of explanation possible. Love chem in high school but now I HATE it...
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Really solid professor who knows the material. CHEM110 was definitely easier than my chemistry class in high school. Make sure you study for the finals (Bojan is the only one with free response), but they're really not that bad.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Hands out a lot of homework, yet doesn't assign many points to it. Tests are tough but manageable if you do the practice exams beforehand.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Bojan is an average prof. Chem 110 is not a hard course, it just requires a lot of conceptual understanding. My only problem was that she included 2 pages of open ended questions instead of 4 MC questions that other sections had. They were very time consuming and cut down a lot of your MT time. The OE section was graded in tough manner.

Definitely an odd teaching style. Personally I wasn't a fan. Not enough lecturing too much in class activities. Every week there are online quizzes, topics, definitions, and Multiple Choice and Open Ended HW. Tons of homework. If you take her be sure you talk with your TA and make friends with the LAs they are more helpful during the lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She is a great professor. I would recommend if you are really trying to understand chemistry and your major requires understanding of it. She really cares about her students and is willing to help. She is a tough professor, but she will help you learn.

Mary Bojan is actually quite a fabulous professor. Very fair grading/learning system and quite organized as well. AS LONG AS YOU READ AND LEARN BEFORE THE LECTURE YOU WILL PROBABLY GET AN A. Don't even fall behind one class on the reading cause you will get run over by how quick Mary Bojan moves. If you learn how to do the material, you'll get an A
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Everyone says that Bojan is a bad teacher but they're all the same. She's very enthusiastic but the real way you learn stuff is by reading the book before class which isnt too bad. Theres a decent amount of homework but you can just copy every question and its all online. Same with the quizzes. The tests are kind of hard but if you do the practice
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Everyone says Dr. Bojan is impossible but honestly it wasn't that bad. You can tell she loves what she does and she isn't that professor that tries to fail everyone. Clicker questions do count as a grade so you really shouldn't skip and you might end up confused if you do. I enjoyed Dr. Bojan's class despite the effort needed to be put into it.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This was a unique class. She doesn't lecture and instead you do worksheets in class. Sounds strange right. In reality, you are getting your hands on hundreds of practice problems, a luxury most classes don't have. I would recommend this professor if you are willing to do the work, you will get a good grade if you grind.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: good luck lol
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Dr. Bojan has a reputation that she is a tough professor, but she just really cares about the material. She wants you to learn it and is disappointed if the class doesn't do well on a clicker question. I never read the textbook, I only ever watched youtube videos the day before class and I never felt behind. Highly recommend her. Just watch videos.

Like others have said, reading and comprehending the prelecture notes is a MUST. If you don't, you will never know what is going on in class because all you do in class is work on examples. I honestly didn't mind this however as it was a nice change from the usual lecture.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: There really are no lectures. Instead, you are expected to read the pre-lecture notes (which are really just notes that any normal professor would give during lecture) and textbook before class. Then, when you arrive at class, she will do a few demos and then you spend the rest of class doing activities related to the material you read before class

First of all, I want to say she's a pretty nice person and always willing to help, but she does not teach. There is a lot of reading required if you want to learn anything and do well on the exams and you have to do quizzes before every class. In class, she does not lecture and only gives you worksheets. Exams are very hard
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: She has an interesting way of teaching that does not work for a lot of students. You have quizzes before every lecture and you are required to do a lot of work outside of class. Very difficult information to learn and her way of teaching does not help.

She is the worst proffesor ever, lecture are unclear. There is not even a lecture, she gives you problems and expects you to know it all from just reading the textbook. The tesr are nothing like the practice exams or homeworks at all. I passed all the practice exams but still manage to fail the actual exams. Honestly, just awful.

Most of the reviews on here are completely wrong, probably one of the best out of all chem110 professors. Bojan's class is straightforward and tells you exactly how to get an A. Doing the weekly homework is necessary and tedious but as long as you do that, getting a good grade does not require much effort at all
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Her teaching style is different but is still effective. The people that complain that she doesn't teach are the ones who probably would still do badly if she just spat information at us. HW is annoying but helps you prepare for the tests.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Absolutely the worst professor to have your first semester freshman year. She doesn't actually lecture but rather makes you learn by using activity workbooks and reading the eBook. She's not understanding and she's certainly not helpful and just an all around terrible professor. Would've preferred a lecturer who actually lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Going into this class, I had heard a lot of negative things about Bojan. However, to my surprise, I ended up really liking how they taught the class and I found her to be very helpful if you took the opportunity to ask questions and act interested. She loves what she does and she wants her students to succeed. Just make sure you study for the exams
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--Caring

reviews.comment: Dr. Bojan has a different teaching method that works for some students, and not for others. She gives out lecture notes ahead of time, and has you practice what you learned during lecture where you have a chance to ask questions. I loved it and very much recommend her. Clicker questions every day so you MUST go to class!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Worst professor of my college career. Was never able to fully prepare the class for the tests. I attended nearly every lecture and left each time more confused than the last. Bojan runs this class as if you do not have any other class going on simultaneously and expects way too much from a 100 level course. If you can avoid her and this class do it
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: Mary Bojan seems to be really tough for some, but i thought her class helped me ALOT. She does class activities during lecture so you have to put what you learned in the notes to use which helps prepare for exams. If you learn better by listening to lectures rather than applying work though, i wouldn't recommend her.

I love Dr. Bojan! You do need to be prepared to put in a lot of effort but she is very clear when lecturing. She pairs activities with lecture so you better understand material. Super sweet and amiable lady. Her love of chemistry is infectious!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational

reviews.comment: I can see why a lot of people don't like Dr. Bojan. She makes you read pre lecture notes before class, essentially learning the material before class and printing upwards of 100 papers for her class (yikes).However, she's very passionate about chemistry. If you take her class, pray to whatever deity you believe in that you get an engaging TA.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: I hadn't taken chemistry for two years prior to taking Chem 110. She will tell you to drop if she thinks you can't handle it. She went over the lectures with a lot of content in a short amount of time and having the right TA's are what you need to rely on. She will not really help you with any questions you have. If you can, take a different prof.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Regardless of what a lot of people say, Bojan is a lovely old lady, willing to help you out, answers all of your questions. She gets so excited about Chem that sometimes she'll go off topic, but she makes this really tough course VERY understandable. If you miss class you'll have a hard time, and bc she is 8am lecture, it makes it harder to attend.

As someone who sadly had to take chem 110 twice because I had a terrible professor first semester I would highly recommend her! She really cares about her students if she sees that you put in the effort! And at the end of the course the final was curved which was amazing for my grade! Also look into chem 108 with this class.

I had taken AP Chem in high school and excelled! Just missed passing my AP test so I figured basic chemistry would be easy. I can say that was one of the hardest classes ever and Dr Bojan doe a horrible job explaining basic concepts. If you do take this course be sure to look into Chem 108 and expect to go to class a lot for the participation point

Bojan is tough. She goes off topic in lecture and is most likely crazy. My advice is to take chem 108 along with 110. Its a 1 credit class that'll help you a lot with the material. It extra work but it makes Bojan's lectures a lot clearer. Chem 108 definitely made a huge difference in my grade for 110. Take it

Unfortunately this is a class where no matter what professor you have, you will need to work extremely hard to get a good grade, even if you have a lot of experience with chemistry. Bojan really does not do anything for you. If you have questions she will usually refer you to your TA. If you want to do well, go to class AND learn on your own.

Bojan is tough, but it's possible to get a good grade if you put the work in. Lectures are often confusing and tough to follow because she moves thru material very fast, and she's a little crazy at times. 3 exams + cumulative final, homework is what helped me learn. When you do it make sure  you learn HOW to do each problem not just get it done.

It doesn't matter if you took chem in high school. Trust me, your understanding is going to mean nothing. Having this professor will be the worst decision you can make. Only way to get thru this class is countless number of hours of hard work. Reviews and a good TA get you through. She wrote the ebook, so just know, stay away.

Tests are tough. Lectures are hard to follow, goes through mass amounts of material in short time. Do and understand all homework before test, got to reviews and find a good TA. I took AP Chem in high school with a final grade of an A and I found this class challenging.

No. No no no. Do not take a class with Mary Bojan. She was the worst professor I have ever taken in my life, bar none. I had chem with her in freshman year (now a junior) and I made a RMP account JUST NOW to warn others. Her lectures were 90% telling us how we'd need to study or we wouldn't pass, and 10% rushed-through material. Take another prof!

She's absolutely awful. The class average was less than a 60% all semester long and she just blamed us. This professor is only here for research. This was the worst experience I had in all my 4 years of undergrad, DO NOT TAKE.

Bojan is underrated, people give her hard time but I find her a good teacher, she does what she is supposed to do during the lecture and she explains examples during the lecture which helps to understand. When you take chem 112 you need to work hard, study constanly, do  homework questions and practice exams to get an A in the class.

If you can, take another professor. She messes up frequently, and barely clarifies when she does. She also is not very good with technology. She is a good person and you can tell she loves chemistry, but that isn't enough to make it a good class.
I only went to lectures for the first two weeks, and I decided to study myself with e-book. I probably should not rate her because I do not go to lecture, you know.

Take Chem 112 with another professor if possible. Dr. Bojan is in charge of designing the course material, but I felt she did not have a good ability to explain the material within the course.   When "explaining" topics, she mostly repeats the answer expecting students to experience an "ah-ha" moment, instead of explaining topics in new ways.

Bojan is a disaster. Before each test, she holds a review session where students can ask questions, and she never knows the answers! I remember the day before a test, she was doing a math problem in class and couldn't figure it out so she said it didn't matter bc we were testing and she'd email the answer. Boring and annoying lectures

Contrary to many of my classmates, I liked Bojan. She is teaching a weed out class, so I think many don't like her because the course is difficult. Sometimes lectures weren't 100% clear, but she had a lot to cover in a short amount of time. She will make herself available to help you and is quick to answer e mails. She's not as bad as everyone says

Dr. Bojan pushes the idea of independent learning, "Read the book and do your homework a week before lecture!" However, she spends more time talking to us about our learning habits than teaching Chemistry. She skims over topics in lecture, under the assumption that we already learned it ourselves. She does help if you ask, but I didn't learn much.

First of all, Mary is "all over the place". Her lectures are useless of going to because of her unorganized slides. Throughout her lectures she writes notes in the slide which everybody can't read or understand it. Although she is a terrible teacher, the TA's are great help. In fact, I most of the TA's get confused in her lectures.

The lectures consist of her either blowing up balloons, doing a problem wrong, or telling us that we should "already know the material". She moves quickly through her slides and her exam review sessions are a complete waste of time.

Dr. Bojan really wants you to understand chemistry but she doesn't understand it. She makes a lot of mistakes in class. My TA would email us if we should go to lecture or if she would just confuse you more than you already were. Attendance was optional but if you didn't go you'd be ok if you talked to a TA.

Dr. Bojan means well. However, that means nothing to me. She would not teach a lot of material because "we should know it". Most of us did not know it. After scheduling an appointment with her she told me that she didnt think it was possible for me to do well on the upcoming exams bc i did poorly on the first. But hey, she means well.
She is terrible!!!!!! Worst teacher at Penn State

For startes she is not going to motivate you. The day before exam 3 she came in and said if you want to drop the class after you take the exam tonight you have to wait untill we the get the scores, Like what the Frack? We have an exam instead of motivating you she is prophesizing your demise. She is a good professor she is not bad,

Bojan gets a bad wrap for being goofy during lectures, but people going into the class expecting her to spoon-feed them information so they can regurgitate it on the exams will be VERY disappointed. You need to read the textbook, do the homework, and study hard for the exams.

It is currently my second week of class and I've never been more frustrated in my entire life. Bojan writes on her prehistoric projector and talks to herself for the entire 50 minute lecture. There's no doubt in my mind that I'll fail this class because of her so called "teaching." Knock knock. Who is it? Retirement here, knocking on Bojan's door.
Confusing and makes it hard to pass the course

Bojan is an acquired taste. You either love her or you hate her. Her eccentric personality, in my opinion can be very grating at times. This does not mean she's not a good professor. Bojan has taught me the most of almost all of the professors I've had at Penn State. She takes teaching very seriously, but if you don't try, she can't help you.

She just left everyone to do ALEKS assignments without helping us. She just came to the first day of class and sent us bunch of emails basically saying 'ALEKS will do all the teaching so she won't be coming to class'. Let's not even start talking about the stupidity of her online assignments.

Bojan means well... but doesn't teach well. She will not simplify any information, so prepare to do some work. Do the homework every week, do the practice exams, learn from your mistakes, and you'll do fine. Although she's not a great professor, still attend class. She will supply you (occasionally) with the formulas and charts you need to succeed.

Spends entire class time doing practice problems and does not focus on teaching problem solving skills or the underlying concepts behind the problem. Makes learning extremely difficult and going to lecture a waste of time. You are better off teaching yourself from the textbook and going to lion tutors. Take any other 112 professor.

Absolutely terrible, didnt go to class for half the semester. I took her at 8am and it was a waste of my time. All she talked about was how we will fail. She shows no competence in teaching chemistry.Go lion tutors, do the homework, or get someone else. I'M SERIOUS IF YOU TAKE HER YOU WILL TEACH YOURSELF.

An awful instructor. She spent more time telling us we were all going to fail instead of actually teaching us. She is extremely disorganized and her methods of attacking problems are long and exhausting that set you up you fail. I am lucky I had a great TA too, as thats what saved me. Also, I ended up going to another profs class to get an A.

Her voice is so annoying. She spends about 50% of the lecture actually lecturing, 30% telling you you're going to fail, and 20% blowing up balloons. Also, most of the time she does a problem in lecture she does it wrong, according to my TA. I didn't really pay attention. Just do a bunch of old exams when you study. I got excellent grades that way.
Awful instructor , wastes a lot of the lecture time on useless things , plus being unclear at all.

Squeaky, annoying voice. Not very helpful, doesn't clarify, expects you to know everything before class, plus read the textbook nightly. Probably one of the better teachers in the chemistry department, but didn't make things very clear for me. Unfortunately barley passed the class.

Dr. Bojan was the greatest chemistry teacher I have ever had.  Yeah, she is really tough, but I learned a great deal from her.  She was always willing to help and totally approachable in her office hours.  Pay attention and do the homework - you do ok.
I swear one day she was ****.  She is usually pretty hyper, and you can't keep up.  She knows what's going on but just doesn't teach it well.

um nevermind the fact that chem 12 just sucks in general.. but having a professor that "teaches" and gets paid to "teach" when i learn nothing from her is pretty pathetic. the ta's should be receiving her salary! thumbs down to bojan!

Dr. Bojan needs to learn that popping balloons does not qualify as teaching! She goes too fast, has little regard for the degree of comprehension and jumps around. The TAs are SOOOO much better. Unbelievable...
Class is very boring and not much can be learned.  The good news is that she pops Hydrogen balloons, the bad news even that gets boring cause it happens almost every day.  Teach already!

Dr. Bojan is a very good lecturer who wants her students to learn, but they also have to put forth the effort themselves. Her class was very enjoyable, even if her level of lecturing may seem as if she's speaking to young children at times.
This professor is no good.  Her TA's were better.  The exams were brutal.  Who the hell hired her?  Thank god i've transferred to Pitt.
Dr. Bojan is an idiot.  Her TA's were so much better than her for general chemistry.
Literally holds personal vendettas against students. Do NOT take her course I BEG OF YOU RUN FOR THE HILLS. She has like half your grade worth three essays and rips them to shreds.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Makoni provides clear rubrics for the essays. It is important to take detailed notes on the lecture to do well on the quizzes. Although she is a tough grader, her class is not hard if you start assignments early, ask questions, and are receptive to criticism on assignments. She is a strict professor but I learned a lot from her class.

Dr. Makoni is  very intelligent and passionate during lectures. She is kind and cares about her student's wellbeing; there are no exams & only 2 open book online quizzes. Textbook readings are online and rarely used inperson. I would NOT take this gen ed without any prior knowledge in linguistics, she grades harshly and gives very specific feedback

I am very angry. Although this is a web class and is supposed to be "easy" I find that extremely misleading. The essays have 0 guidance. When emailing her for help all she does is roast your draft. After you fix it and follow her advice, she fails you out of pure enjoyment. I stg the grades are created with a random generator. DO NOT TAKE BUSI.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Busi Makoni is one of the worst professors, if not THE WORST. If you need a GH ged-ed I beg you to look elsewhere. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. You basically are only graded on three essays and have quizzes  that have nothing to do with the notes. Her advice on essays is absolutely terrible. I have never had a prof. that wanted me to fail.

reviews.comment:
doesn't give out extra credit. 
very harsh on grading papers unless you go by her rubric.
tests are tough even if you read the chapters!

Through the semester there are 3 essays which are basically your whole grade, a graded discussion and about a quiz each week. The quizzes are sometimes difficult even if you read the whole chapter, and she does not give extra credit. To do well in the class follow the rubric on the essays because she will take off points for small reasons.
GOAT. thats all i have to say

he is a very good professor and constantly improving his quality of teaching even further . i noticed that at the start of the course he was a bit fast and someone i guess told him and then he adapted to the perfect pace . such a soft and caring guy just an awesome personal overall unfortunately i couldnt take his class for spring due to schedule

Sebastian is a fantastic professor! I've never met someone who cares so much about their students. He's always willing to explain things multiple times to ensure everyone understands. He is the GOAT. I Highly recommend him. If possible take Math 141 with him too

Professor Burgos is the absolute goat. His way of teaching allows you to actually learn the topic. His quizzes are not hard but if you study you will get 100%. He always gives extra bonus questions. He's also very open with his office hours and is always ready to help you with anything.

Sebastian is a really cool guy and a great professor. I've taken calculus AB in high school, so his class was pretty easy, but he was a thorough teacher with an easy-to-understand lecturing style. He is super upfront about what will be on quizzes and even exams. I appreciated how he taught us how to get the most partial credit on exams, too.
theres nothing more you could ask for in a professor.
What a goat. That's all.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Such a chill guy and cares about his students. The class moves at a good pace and always takes time to answer questions and explains topics thoroughly. Super easy class if you took Calc AB in high school or an equivalent, if not he provides TONS of exam material that is super helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He is very good at teaching the math material giving definitions and equations throughout the class. Answers questions and is clear about homework and quizzes.

Sebastian is a great guy. He's very patient and is always accessible outside of class. He reschedules his office hours consistently to make sure that he is able to answer questions students have before weekly quizzes/midterms. I used to sit there for almost the entire 1.5 hours and have him ask me questions and explain concepts to me. Recommend!!!
After taking more stat classes at penn state im writing this because I wish all prof's were like her. Take her for any class if you can!

Dr. B is great, by far my favorite Stat professor so far! She takes time to learn the students names and is more than willing to help you, she wants you to succeed. She is an excellent teacher and STAT300 is very well organized.
You will learn a lot in this class if you complete all the homework and pay attention to lectures. She is very knowledgeable on the material and could explain any question.

This is for Stat 300. Do NOT take this class with her. Her lectures are not similar to her pop quiz content and is a very harsh grader. She is very smart, but has difficulty explaining basics. No half credit ever. Also, why are my exams on paper if it is a coding class? Make it make sense.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This is for Stat 300. She's a very good professor. If you have strong foundations in Stat 200, you will be fine in this class. We spent a month on linear regression. She is nice and funny and learns everyone's names. She takes attendance but it's not for points. Homework is in R, exams are fair if you attend class and take the notes in the packets.

Dr. B is an excellent instructor. She makes use of World Campus' STAT 500 online notes, which are incredible on their own, but also holds optional weekly Q&A sessions where she basically runs through all the key concepts. Feedback on homework is helpful, and nothing was ever a surprise. Anyone doing poorly in the course is due to a lack of effort.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Incredible teacher. This class was so good it inspired me to take Stat 501. Genuinely awesome and caring teacher who knows her stuff and will help you if you need.

Her "classes" (she called them Q&A sessions) were once a week at 8pm, and completely optional. Attending them was super helpful. The class is exam heavy, but that is for all STAT 500 courses. You're allowed two pages, front and back, worth of hand written notes for every exam. Make sure you do the practice problems. I didn't use the textbook.

80% of your grade comes from exams (4 of them) with her and she doesn't believe in rounding up as stated in the syllabus, so make sure you do well on the exams. I have a mixed math background and this class I struggled with. The material was confusing and the questions in exams & homework were simply much harder than the lesson questions.

Dr.B is one of the professors who really care the students in the school. If you pay attention on the class and do the homework carefully you will get a good grade. The quiz is easy, the exam is not hard but might be a little bit tricky.

Always engaging the class by asking questions during lecture. Very open to answering questions that people have. Does clear examples during lecture that are very similar to homework and exams. There's a final group project instead of a final exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is good professor but very hard exams and heavy homework for only 10% of the final score. I wouldn't take her again.

She is a very good professor. The lectures are great, learned a lot. However, she took all the exams on canvas and they had a lot of MCQ questions, which is not fair for a math test. For a good grade, you have to work hard, you would learn a lot as well.

Took her class during COVID. She had required attendance which could have been difficult for those in different time zones but she was very accommodating for test and quiz time frames. Amazing lectures and notes. Friendly and approachable, has office hours and replies to questions quickly. Made my first PSU stats class very enjoyable.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Priyangi is one of the best professors I've had at Penn State. She truly cares about all her students and is easy to talk to. A lot of times she let us work in group for homework or quizzes or labs. The only thing to watch out for is pop quizzes. Also, attendance is mandatory like half the time so watch out for that too.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Beware of pop quizzes--Caring

reviews.comment: Priyangi is amazing. Very clear lectures and no surprises on exams. She makes sure you understand material before moving on. Would 100% take her again for any class she teaches.
An awesome prof. Gave me a first impression of a strict one but turns out to be fair. Explains everything clearly and doesn't mean to trick you on exams. Only thing I don't like is pop quizzes.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Pri has a super nice personality and does her best at helping the students. Weekly homework and pop quizzes. A tough subject to teach but the lesson packets to print out are great. Just be prepared to work. Also the final was roughhh. But it's a 400 level stat class so, ya know.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES

reviews.comment: She doesn't listen to you even though you are not wrong. Better to avoid her, if you need to pass this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: One of the best profs I have ever had. She has that caring mother vibes because she learns everybody's name and really care if you're doing okay. Lectures are also great because she really makes you understand the material

Good person who loves her job. But.. Very confusing lessons. The only way to learn what she is teaching is to do lots of homework, tests, and quiz's. Fair grader. Lessons need to be refined and delivered better.

She does not use the way that the textbook teaches. You have to go to class and make sure you print out the handouts. The class was not hard at all. If you show up and listen you will get a good grade. The only thing I don't like is that the homework is only 10% while you have to spend hours doing them.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Caring

reviews.comment: I'm not a big fan of keeping lecture notes offline, which feels like an admittance that the material doesn't actually need to be presented so much as delivered, but is being used to enforce attendance anyhow. Besides that, she knows her material and wants her students to succeed. Reasonable difficulty.

Class is laid out really nicely. She doesn't move on with material until everyone understands. Doesn't post all notes online so must go to class and do homework to do well. Exams are straightforward. Weekly pop quizzes (mostly fridays)

I don't usually attend classes (which has been incredibly manageable in the past), but with STAT 319, none of the lecture notes are posted online and the textbook is horrendous. It's easy to find good online resources, but her definitions differ from online sources on many occasions. In summary, attendance is very important, unfortunately.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Pri is a great professor. Notes for the course were well structured. Her lectures would be used to fill out these notes. Weekly HW assignments and quizzes helped to keep me on top of the material. Exams were pretty straight-forward! Definitely would recommend you take her course(s)!(I'm actually taking her again right now for MATH/STAT 319)
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Very Good Professor. Lectures are good. A lot of quizzes
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Her lectures are impossible to follow and everything is self-taught. She goes on a lot of tangents and you need to dedicate a lot of extra time to this class based on how unhelpful the lectures are.

She was such a kind lady and was incredibly helpful. The lectures could be hit or miss but overall they were pretty good. She is no longer teaching STAT200 because she is fed up with the curriculum. She gave reviews for the exams that were VERY helpful. She was always staying up super late to make review videos for us; proof that she really cares

It is so hard to do well that you can't even understand what she is saying. You have to teach yourself everything, and everyone I know had to buy lion tutors because you don't even learn anything in class. If you have to do STAT 200, just take it online; it's not even worth taking in person with her because you teach yourself everything anyway.

In all honesty, she is a great professor, but the statistics curriculum here is horrible. She is really sweet and is switching out of Stat 200 because she believes there are better ways to teach the students. She isn't the problem, it is Stat 200 in general. Take Stat 250 if you can; the curriculum is way better.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She cares a lot about her students. The lectures are useless. She just reads off of the slides but is hard to understand. The lab and HW are a big part of your grade. She does in class questions for participation credit. Take a different prof if you have the choice.

I read the reviews before the first day of class. This course is easy to pass if you get the work done, but I cannot stand the professor. She's caring,but one of the reviews is right. Not only it's like listening to Joe Biden giving a lecture, but she will take forever to respond through canvas/outlook(maybe never). Lecture&HW heavy, quiz after lab

Professor Buchanan really cares about her students and is helpful when asked questions after or outside of class but her lectures are hard to follow and she goes on tangents about random things which can make it difficult to decipher what the main point is

If you fail this class that's on you. Genuinely one of the easiest classes I've taken. There's clicker questions but it's only for participation. Her slides are uploaded. Just do the labs before class, if you want to get out early. The tests are incredibly easy.

She is so sweet and this class is a breeze. Compared to stat 200, this is cake. If you're a bio major and only need one stat class, stat 240 is such a win. She really just wants you to engage and you get to do these awesome little scratch cards in class which is the best part. Homework isn't bad and no exams. Most of the grading is in-class stuff.

Class is very lecture heavy, and the homework is done through achieve. There are no exams which is a plus. The course load isn't that bad compared to other STAT classes. The lectures are read directly from the slide which can get pretty mundane and at points you might be teaching yourself the material.
Buchanan cares about her students, but her lectures can be hit-or-miss. Labs are key for learning the material. unstuckstudy was super helpful for preparing for exams alongside the course materials.

I feel bad for the professors in the stats department because they really have no control over their students' grades. Labs are what's helpful for learning in this course- not the lectures. If you need help on any concepts, go directly to Prof Buchanan's office hours! Nobody's ever there and she is so kind and will help you with anything you need.

Pat is a great professor, her lectures are very straightforward and she is very good with the technology that we use for class. she cares a lot about her students and wants them to do well, and often takes feedback into consideration. the homeworks/tests really weren't that bad and there is a lot of help available.

Dr. Buchanan is a gem! Pat cares a lot about her students and genuinely tries her best to help you succeed. Her class was by no means easy, but it was intellectually challenging and she was a reasonable grader. There are many homeworks, labs, and participations that make up the grade. Lowest lab dropped. Lowest 4 participations dropped as well.

This is a sassy elderly woman. Im not sure why she hasnt retired but homegirl needs a break BAD. 2 homeworks a week and a weekly lab worth 30 points. Attendance also plays a huge part in your grade and you HAVE to go. Class itself is not complicated she just doesn't make it fun or interesting

Dr. Buchanan was very nice and tried her best to interact with students. The lectures were not great though. Uses repetitive words like "um", "and again." Attendance was taken from Canvas quizzes and were not graded on correctness. Exams were not overly difficult but labs could be tough at times. Overall wouldn't recommend but not unmanageable.

Class has no tests, and homework is very easy and takes about 20 minutes a week. Weekly lab quizzes on Friday that are strictly multiple choice and you can work with a group. I think the whole class has an A halfway through the course and there is no final.

She is a lovely person but she is unless when it comes to giving a halfway decent lecture, it is basically the equivalent of trying to listen to Joe Biden give a lecture on Stats, try to take on online version because you will get almost nothing from coming to lectures

I cannot understand her. No exams, her class is kind of easy. Make sure to go to class; attendance was taken for points, 10 points per class. Labs were very important and we had to do the work before class, which was annoying.

Professor Pat is a very nice lady but a horrible instructor. She just reads off a powerpoint and doesn't actually go step by step through each problem. It's almost like you're expected to already have some sort of knowledge to do well in this class. Labs are annoying and exams are hard but i HATE math so if i can do it, you can lol.

Buchanan definitely cares about her students, she does small participation quizzes on canvas during lectures to give us points, and often times they ask about our well-being and how our semester is going. She will always be willing to answer questions in and after class. Labs are hard and WP homework barely even connects to lectures.

So overall Professor Buchanan is a nice lady and means well. Her lectures honestly don't help too much but definitely attend them. If I did not attend lab I would have failed. This class is hard and a ton of work. However, coming from a person who hates math and is not good at it, attend lab, stay on track and you'll be good!!!!

I don't understand how Buchanan is a professor at Penn State. She is unable to go in-depth and explain the material that is being "taught" (quotations because she does not teach rather you have to read the textbook, or you will fail). The TAs are useless however if you do not go to lab and hand in all assignments, you will fail. DO NOT TAKE W/ HER.

She is a very nice prof and helpful if you try and seek help. Her lectures almost aren't worth going to because she pretty much just reads off the slides, teaching it to you as if you already know what you are doing. Attend the GSGs, every single student teacher that does GSGs is better than her.
It's a hard class but she is the worst professor I have ever had at PSU. She is nice, but that's about it. Her lectures only confused me more. DO NOT SKIP LAB. Good luck.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: I'm sure my experience in STAT200 would have been the same regardless of the professor lots and lots of homework and graded heavily on the exams. Professor Buchanan is a kind and funny person, but she often just reads off the slides instead of explaining in detail. However, the labs, guided study groups, and online textbook were lifesavers.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She had useful lecture presentations that were easily accessible so you really didn't have to go to class as long as you looked at her powerpoints.

Possibly worst professor I have ever had. Confuses herself regularly trying to explain things to the class. Doesn't teach, just reads off PowerPoints. Doesn't answer questions in class and never responds to emails. Graded primarily on labs so make sure you're in a good lab group since the TA's are also useless. Liontutors saved my grade

She gets a bad wrap due to her fast-paced lectures that essentially just read off the slides. However, if you ask questions in class she will take the time to explain and at the end of the day, she wants her students to be successful. Office hours are the key! After an exam you can review every question with her, and she will even give back points.

Ok, she's infamous for being the worst STAT prof but shes sweet and means well. but she just reads of the slides and i felt like I was teaching myself. i will admit though I did not study a lot and could have tried harder. also the TA's just are not that helpful in this course in general... if you have to take Prof B like i did go to office hours
Would not take this class again. Lecture was disorganized. Never answered my emails that I sent back from January (it's now May). This class was stressful.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: This course wasn't challenging. You are graded primarily through labs and homework, which aren't difficult at all. I enjoyed this stat elective and would retake it.

She isn't great, but it's also not horrible. STAT200 is just a tough class, and she is definitely trying to make it all make sense. GO TO YOUR LAB AND USE THE TA. The TA will help clear any confusion.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She is super nice and wants to help students as much as she can. If you pay attention in class and take good notes you should be good, make sure you go to lab as well as it is super helpful to work with others. If you go to her office hours after an exam sometimes she will give you points back!
Possibly the worst prof I have had at psu.

This semester Dr. Buchanan has been extremely hard to reach. She doesnt respond to emails at all and has been unwilling to help students. I would do yourself a favor and pick a different prof. Maybe its just zoom university that caused this? Either way, I would avoid at all costs.

Pat is a good teacher, but a bad lecturer, don't expect to learn anything in them. The textbook will get you far, GSGs are really helpful. If you're having personal issues, she's very understanding, and will work hard with you to help you get back on track, so if you feel good about the class but stumble bc irl, don't worry. Tests are pretty easy
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: She picks up phone calls during class. Her slow speech and lack of enthusiasm toward the material makes it very difficult to focus and stay engaged during lecture. No curves. Quizzes on class material multiple times a week. Expects students to understand the material when she barely clarifies it herself.

IMPORTANT! Some things you should know about Prof. Buchanan is that she is a lovely person & very kind. However her class is literally hell. She is awful at explaining concepts and expects you to understand all the material. Her homeworks are insanely long and she curves NO tests. Would not recommend. Also u have quizzes on content covered in class
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She does not know what she is talking about half of the time and is not good at explaining the examples which makes it harder once you get to lab.
Patricia is a nice lady but not the best at explaining. We are only graded on homework and Lab quizzes (in groups) so make sure you're in a good one or it'll suck.

The material was easy in my opinion, but she sped through the lectures. Definitely either print out or download the powerpoint prior to class because you can't write everything that's on the slides in time. Go to class to take notes, and study them after to actually learn the material. Tests are pretty easy, labs are hit/miss depending on TAs.
If you haven't taken a stat class before this class will be hard for you. She rushes through the. material and doesn't explain things well.

Lectures are boring, but not her fault due to all the info that is needed to be covered. A lot of different opportunities to get your grade up (homework, labs, reflections). She offers a lot of different resources to do well on exams. You need to put in effort to do well, but she is a very kind lady and she genuinely wants her students to succeed.

While the lecture/material in general isn't super exciting, Professor Buchanan gives you the tools that you need to succeed and cares about her students. My biggest advice is to go to guided study group exam reviews, they are the best way to study and make sure that you are prepared for the exams.

Prepares good lectures with lots of information and help on them. She cares about her students, and is very accessible outside of class. She gives lots of test preparation and assignments (homework/labs/reflections,etc.), but if you try on them, it will end up helping you understand more and do better on the exams. Worth it to take her, kind lady
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She's a very nice woman and if you go to office hours and spend time with her and get to know her she's a very nice person. She'll go over exams with you and help you earn points back. The stat department as a whole is disappointing and although her lectures can be boring Prof. Buchanan is not the one to blame. Do what your supposed- it'll be okay

People complain about her, yes, super boring lectures, but her slides are actually helpful. Honestly I think people focused on wrong materials, for example, just do lab quizzes and clicker questions (what I did), didn't even use textbook or other stuff, that's enough. Straight A.

PSU has generally pretty cool professors who do their job. Some are hard, yeah, but not many are just plain horrible. This woman will not teach you anything.
