reviews.comment: Mr. Cesar is very chill and is willing to help students during office hours. He is willing to clarify difficult concepts. The class may be somewhat difficult, but he makes it very manageable. I would take him for all my Spanish courses if I was able to.
Snarky, arrogant, disrespectful, and awful at teaching. About half the class dropped within the first week.

I could tell Dr. Cervone cares about the course and values student participation, even in the form of simple questions. He adjusts the pace of teaching to suit the slowest learners, and offers tons of office hours. Grading for the exams was somewhat arbitrary and homeworks were assigned with less than a week's notice. Impossible to fail the course.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Accessible outside class--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Cervone is a great and enthusiastic professor who is incredibly knowledgeable in the field of remote sensing. Grading scales are very small though (labs are 3 pts, exams and project are out of 10 pts.) so it is easy to get a low grade, but he curves.

He is a very good professor. I learned a lot from his class and I plan on taking at least one more class with him. If you put in effort you will get an A in the class. He is not a hard grader. He wants everyone to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Class is based on the book, and slides are pretty much from the book.  7 labs assigned throughout the class, some of which require R.  Final group project with a poster presentation and written paper.  Both the professor and the TA were very helpful with R, although often it was over the head.  The final project requires some research.

Guido is awesome! He's super passionate about his work, and sometimes he talks a little over your head (but not on purpose, and he's happy to explain). His background makes the class interesting. The structure is suited to the student, a poster, some journal entries. The exams are easy as long as you go to class. And he shows you opportunities

MGMT 451W was the perfect way to end my time at Penn State. This class was more than just coursework—it was an eye-opening, thought-provoking experience that challenged how I see business and ethics. Every discussion pushed me to think deeper, question assumptions, and connect real-world issues to decision-making. It was truly an inspiring class.

Professor Celeste Newcomb has been more than a teacher—she's been a mentor and a constant source of support. In her class, we explored leadership, ethics, and culture through case studies and discussions. Her guidance led me to become her Teaching Assistant, and years later, I still value her support. I am honored to have her as my mentor.

I had Celeste's PSU6 class and cannot speak more highly of her and the course. Celeste's PSU6 class is incredibly helpful for new Penn State students, you will learn about so many resources that will help you succeed at Penn State and after graduation. It is clear that Celeste wants her students to succeed, I cannot recommend her enough for PSU6.

I recently reconnected with Professor Newcomb when she served as a reference for me post-grad. I enjoyed her classes greatly (MGMT326 and 461). She lectures some, but not too much that it's exhausting. I enjoyed the group projects in her classes, and the feedback she gave was always specific and constructive. I loved her and I highly recommend!
This final assignment and class in general were such an inspiration to me. I am so grateful to have taken this course! Ms. Newcomb has a true love and dedication to students learning and success.

I'm shocked Professor Newcomb doesn't already have a 5/5 rating. She is so sweet, caring, and super helpful. Her lectures were always interesting and she incorporates real world stories and examples and relates them to class material. This was one of my favorite classes at Penn State and I would 100% take it with her again!

Professor Newcomb is one of the best and nicest professors at PSU. She does the most to set students up for success. Her grading criteria is extremely clear, which is extremely helpful for assignments. She is more than willing to answer questions and provide additional help outside of class hours.

She's a good person and means well, but she's kinda annoying and really redundant. She throws tons of pop quizzes at you and expects you to participate A LOT. The assignments are pretty straightforward, but it takes a lot of work because she makes you write a bunch of pages about boring stuff.. overall: she's pretty mediocre.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Course used synchronous and asynchronous methods. Modules focused on organizational behavior, leadership, emotional intelligence, managing conflict, and understanding varying perspectives. Prof was able to leverage managerial experience to facilitate discussion among students, and share relatable examples from personal experience.

Celeste gave very detailed and helpful feedback on each assignment. She told which parts can be improved. The knowledge learned in the class can be used in the future work. What is more valuable is that Professor Celeste has a high respect and understanding for students, arouses the enthusiasm of students, and helps students.

Dr. Newcomb gave all of her students her personal cell phone number for us to reach out to her in case of questions, emergencies, or just someone to talk to. This really stood out to me because it showed how much she cared for her students and wanted not only to be there for them while in class, but outside of class too.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I think 451W was a different teaching mode compared to other courses. There were lots of discussions during class. Sharing opinions is so great for each students. Besides that, as for me, I spent lots of time on reading course materials and writing feedback after each classes, finally I got a high score.

I learned a lot of knowledge in your classes last semester about international business. Your classes were interesting and detailed. What impressed me most was the point of the diversity part. What's more, while sometimes I felt confused after class and I chose to email you about my questions, you replied as fast as you could and patiently answered
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Newcomb is one of the best professors Ive had, as she truly cares about her students and the course material. Shes always there to help if needed. If you actually take the time to do the readings and participate in class, you will do well. It really is an interesting class too!!

I thoroughly enjoyed the encouragement of participation the most. In many classes, we sit there as students listening to professor's lecture, study on our own, and take exams. In this class, I was able to have fun, do a lot of thinking, and build relationships with my classmates. Prof. Newcomb is caring, kind, encouraging and inclusive.
She's a pretty clumsy prof but she's pretty nice, and as long as you attend the lectures and read the textbook you'll do well on the exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Not difficult but many tedious assignments given. Most Sundays there are at least 3 things due if not more. She forces you to have your camera on and calls you out if you turn it off at any point. She also does not give very clear criteria for projects but then picks them apart and takes points off for small things such as using an incorrect word.

AVOID THIS PROF I don't know why she has such good reviews on here. Honestly the worst prof I've ever had. She doesn't know what she's talking about because she reads directly from her notes, makes TA do all the technology work, makes you work in groups of 7 people, has so many assignments due sundays & makes you keep camera on for zoom lecture.

Prof Newcomb is really nice and approachable, and she has diverse experience in mgmt and teaching. The content is standard for mgmt but she explains concepts well and provides current real-life examples, which helps with application and engagement. You should definitely buy and read the textbook because the homework and exams rely heavily on it.

I had this prof for an in person class last year and she was wonderful, but taking her classes over Zoom is awful. Her tech issues take up hours of my time, but she's unsympathetic to any tech issues students happen to have. It's frustrating and occasionally detrimental to my grade. Wait to take this class until you can do it in person.

I had Professor Newcomb for MGMT 461 and it was a great class. It was, by far, the best class I took last semester. Professor Newcomb made the class really interesting and created assignments that allowed me to become a much improved writer. I wish I could take the class again!

Newcomb was probably one of the most approachable teachers. She cared about her students and made a real effort to help them succeed. Although most lectures are always boring, she did integrated case studies and guest speakers which I enjoyed. There also were a lot of clicker questions which forced you to pay attention.

I was in your MGMT461 last year. I really enjoyed your course and learned a great deal in MGMT 461, International Management. The Cultural Interview assignment helped me to prepare for an international business career. I also enjoyed learning about business theories.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Professor Newcomb is truly such an amazing professor. As someone who was nervous to enter into the entrance to major business classes, having her as a professor was comforting and made me feel welcomed into the Smeal environment. I also had her for PSU 6, which made the beginning of my freshman year amazing. Professor Newcomb is amazing!

Newcombs class is easy but she will offer you no actual educational value. She is about as confused about the material as any of the students in her class are and you can tell she does little to prepare. I honestly felt like I was in a middle school class. Should have let the TA take over. Poor communicator and very very poorly organized class.

Professor Newcomb truly cares about her students. I had her for MGMT301 and she was extremely passionate about the material. She also tries her best to make the content interesting and engaging. However, there are pop quizzes and in-class assignments so you have to go to class. The 2 lowest grades from the pop quizzes drop however. Def take her!

You should definitely take Management with this professor. Ms. Newcomb is awesome and my recommendation is that you just go to class. There is never homework and Test are on class material. If you take good notes and go to class you should do great.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Beware of pop quizzes--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Professor Newcomb is awesome! She genuinely cares about your success, and she will take time out of her day to get to know you and listen to your questions/concerns. She makes the class enjoyable with her fun personality and makes you want to be there! If you do all the work, you will succeed no doubt. Gives you very good advice for business world!

This lady wants you to succeed!! While there are a lot of assignments, they arent hard and prof Newcomb is super accesible and happy to help. I also appreciate aire the fun activities she does in class that keep it engaging.

The course has 3 exams, two group presentations, two papers, e-homework and a quiz for every chapter covered. Big workload but it is not challenging. Prof. Newcomb improves her students' communication skills and understanding of the global business environment. No preparation needed for classes but work ethic required. She wants to give you an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She is a fantastic professor, not only the best management prof at PSU but one of the best in Smeal as well. She really cares about her students. I would for sure take her class again!

Worst professor Ive ever had. Rate my professor wont let me give her 0/5 stars so I settled with 1/5. She reads straight from the slides and doesnt know the content. Her TA is always sitting by her side looking through the textbook so when she doesnt know something she looks it up in the book. Hard pass.

She's the best professor I ever had in college. Her class is way too fun and she care a lot. Prof. Newcomb way too cool. I love her class so much and I am taking her again for sure, willing to help. If you ever need help just go to her office hour or email her, she get back very quick.

She is super nice. Don't listen to the other reviews. If you study for the test you'll get an easy A- or A+. Do the extra credit the business school offers its a nice 3% boost to your grade. Yes the exams are worth 80% of your grade, but again if you study.....should be no issue.

She is the sweetest! Her lectures were engaging and easy to follow along. I do have to say that there are few grades in this class so it is test heavy, but if you study for the exams you will easily get a high B or A. She's has plenty of resources for help too if you are confused! Definitely take this class with her.

So upon looking over the reviews for her for the past few years, it looks like she is genuinely inflating her rating with false rankings. The same pattern of speech appears to come up over and over every semester in her 5/5 ratings, with every ranking that is low being actually genuine and unique. Check for yourself if you dont believe me.

VERY test heavy. 80% of the total grade is just exams. She's not a bad teacher, but the issue stems from how exam heavy the course is as a whole. She offers extra credit, but due to the extremely high exam weight of the class, a 90% is required on every single exam (even with the extra credit (3%)) to get an A. Not the best, not the worst
Exams make up the majority of your grade, but if you go to class, exams should be no issue. 3 homeworks throughout the semester and you get to earn extra credit.

Good professor, learn a lot in class. The class is very test heavy, only 3 homework assignments and they're all during the unit that you will be tested on. Exams are tough, she uses a lot of example from class on exams so it's important to go to class. She does offer a lot of extra credit, and it helps your grade a lot to do it.

One of my favorite professors! She gives you many opportunities to succeed in the class with TA reviews, a bunch of extra credit, and helpful slideshows. A lot of what is reviewed appears on the finals. It is helpful to go to class because there are a few references to lectures on the exams.She explains concepts in a way thats easy to understand.

Material is super interesting, and Coupland goes through it with many helpful examples. 90% of the class grade is from 3 exams, which aren't difficult, but you need to study. A couple of checkpoint homework, which are basically free, and 3% possible extra credit via 30-minute research studies, and you only need 6 to get the full credit.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Coupland is a nice person who means well. I believe she wants her students to do well, but the course is so poorly set up. There are a total of six grades throughout the entire semester with a small bit of extra credit available. Three 50 point exams and three 10 point homework assignments. Exams are also very tricky. Wouldn't recommend.

Super kind and caring professor. Lectures are not mandatory, but I enjoyed learning the material through her engaging presentations. She is most definitely very knowledgeable in her field. There aren't many graded things that go into Canvas, so every assignment counts. Wish there was more tolerance on that; my grade would've been better.

Showed up for the first 3 weeks then stopped. For the times I did show up she was actually really amazing and sweet and you could tell she cares a lot about her students and drilling in the material to help them succeed. She's very engaging and honestly if u put in effort you should be able to get an A

I stopped showing up to class after week 3. Attendance was not mandatory but she gave interesting lectures when I did show up. Very easy class to pass if you put in just a little bit of effort. I did not go to class and started studying a day before the exams and ended with an a-. If you put in a tiny bit more work an a is not hard to achieve.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: shes just as awesome as prof roth, dont believe the bad reviews! they use the same slides and teach the same stuff. coupland knows a lot about the topics and has real world experience. shes super super nice. use her test prep review its always similar to the exams. do the extra credit it boosts ur grade like 3 percent.

great professor!!! she knows so much about marketing and truly just wants students to succeed. she got ratemyprof bombed from her last semester of students because they never showed up so they did terrible. if you go to class the exams aren't hard, and the review screen cast she posts and the TAs post is so much like the exam. SHES GREAT! SHOW UP!

My favorite professor at Penn State!!! She is so knowledgeable and cares about her students. Her lectures were informative, and attending class is definitely necessary. Any bad reviews are from students that are probably mad that they got a bad grade when they didn't go to class or study.
Professor Coupland makes lectures engaging. Exams aren't too hard if you read the textbook and use study tools like Unstuckstudy. Earn extra credit to boost your grade. Overall, an enjoyable class.

Professor Coupland is genuinely one of my favorite professors at Penn State both from MKTG 301 and now MKTG 422. She decided to approach this semester with a mostly tech-free classroom and actively encouraged discussion which made the class worthwhile and interactive. She is honest with grading, but wants you to succeed and keeps office hours free!

3 exams worth most of your grade. Questions are made to trick you. Take Roth if possible. This professor blames students for her bad teaching. Median score was a 70% but blamed attendance as the reasoning for her terribly taught class. Answers were never found in her slides or textbook.

In previous years this class had tests take home on Canvas, but they are in the testing center now. The exams are full of questions meant to trick you. There are three exams worth 90% of your grade and two homework assignments. Very difficult for an entrance to major. If you do bad on one exam, you won't get a good grade.

Honestly, this is one of the hardest courses I've taken; she literally wants to trick you on the exam. She won't tell us what is on it. Content is straightforward, yet the exams are nothing like the lectures. Blamed 500-person lecture for getting averages in the 60s and 50s for exams. Terrible, does not share slides. Do not take marketing with her.

Ms. Coupland is the best teacher at Penn State. She cares so much about her students, and after taking MKTG 301, MKTG 495A, and now MKTG 422 with her I can honestly say she has changed my life! She has helped me with so much more even beyond the classroom, and has made me love my major tenfold. Highly recommend!

My major is marketing and this is the hardest class I have taken. Her exams used to be online but now they are in the testing center. they are very misleading and tricky and she admits that, but offers no extra help or curving. you have 3 exams and 2 HW assignments so theres no points to save your grade if you do bad on one exam. do not take
terrible professor do not to take. does not care about your grades, if there were a worse rating i would've done that.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Her teaching style is not great. Kahoot answers are always wrong. Changes assignments dates all the time. Course material grading is disorganized and many of the things she teaches are opinion based.

Just dont take her. She is the worst professor I have had at Penn state. Blames students for everything- she said because two people got 100s, everyone should have gotten 100s- The class size is around 400-500, and grades for both exams 1 and 2 were in the '70s and '60s. Just dont take her.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Terrible professor who blames students for her faults. She tries so hard to trick her students and does not tell us what the test is. It is hard to succeed, especially when this course is an entrance to major requirements. She's also OBSESSED with AI, never seen a professor as obsessed as she is with AI. Save yourself the pain, and do not take her.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Absolutely awful professor and awful class. Tests were open note on canvas last year and their in pollock this year. their also incredibly hard. She crashed out at her 600 students for test average being a 60 for both tests and blamed us and refused to curve exam. does not want students to succeed or be able to declare their major. DO NOT TAKE!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Terrible class blamed class of 400 for poor exam results for both exams 1 and 2. Tests were on canvas in prior years, but now they are not making class averages terrible. Does not want students to succeed and talks about how ppl should drop the class after every exam. Gatekeeps what is on the exams and the notes. Exams are terrible. Do NOT take.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Tests before the fall 2024 semester were all online and on Canvas that is the reason why everyone in previous years had such high grades. She now switched to the pollock testing center. Exams are BS and she blames terrible class averages on the students. DO NOT TAKE.

When the majority of the class performed poorly on the first exam, she spent the following class explaining that there would be no curve because it was the student's fault. Exam practice materials are lazily prepared with confusingly mismatched questions on the answer key. Get ready to spend $150 on Lion Tutors this semester if you want to pass.

One of the nicest professors I've had at Penn State. Lectures are entertaining and I learned a lot from them. Very few assignments and they are easy to complete. Exams aren't difficult. I looked forward to going to this class.

I you find marketing interesting you will this class. If you don't, you will still manage to by. Not hard content. If you understand you will get an A. Extra credit opportunities are easy and up 3%. Very great and knowledgeable professor. She is very experienced in the field and it shows in her lectures.

reviews.comment: I loved professor Coupland! She is so passionate about marketing which always made me excited to go class.(which is saying something since my class was at 9AM) Highly recommend!

Pretty easy class. Graded by very few things (3 exams worth 90%). You don't have to go to class but you NEED notes. Write notes on Docs or Word and use control F on exams. Don't buy textbook or notes packet (waste of money IMO). Get the notes and study a bit and you'll do well.
professor coupland is gas, bussin bussin fr fr no cap

She is awesome, but you need to READ THE TEXTBOOK in order to do really well on the exams! Offers extra credit that can bump your grade up 3% or 30 points. Her lectures were actually very entertaining and she loves interacting with students!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Inspirational--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Overall she's a really nice professor but a bit boring. There are 2 homework assignments and 3 exams. The exams make up 90% of your class grade. In order to do well you need to take lots of notes and pay really close attention in class. There's a lot of opportunities for extra credit though that can bump your overall grade up 3%.

reviews.comment: 90% of your grade is made up from 3 exams. The other 10% is made up from 2 homework assignments. Pretty straightforward class, but do not underestimate. Lots of information can be missed even from skipping one class. Pretty boring lectures but the information is to the point.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Really a super nice prof, she makes lectures interesting and keeps it fun. Definitely my favorite class and prof I've ever had. Graded only by the three exams which aren't too difficult if you read the text and study, and two homework assignments which make it hard to not get full credit. You can also earn up to 3% extra credit for a grade boost.

Marketing 301 with professor coupland was my favorite class I took this semester. The class was very do-able and easy and Professor Coupland was so nice and made class interesting and relatable. I would definitley reccomend taking this class, there were only 2 homework assignments and 2 exams plus the final that were very easy if you went to class.

Prof Coupland is a really wonderful professor, you can tell how much she cares about the material and her students' learning. Gives 3% extra credit, exams are 90% of the grade but are pretty common sense concepts. Only way to not get a good grade is to not watch lectures or not pay attention. Would recommend Coupland 1000%!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Assignments: 3 exams, 3 hw, and extra credit opportunities. Extremely manageable. Lectures: nonmandatory, very lively, and engaging. Informative and interesting. Fun and realistic/relatable examples to help make concepts more tangible. Professor: a real-life angel. So sweet and full of life. Brightens your day. Funny, bubbly and happy. So smart.

Professor Coupland is genuinely nice and caring. I can't say marketing is exactly my cup of tea, but she made it a little easier to bear. The tests (granted I took them online because of COVID) were super easy. You should have no problem getting an A if you put a little bit of effort into this class.
Mrs. Coupland is a very nice lady who is passionate about what she teaches. Exams can be difficult. Make sure you understand how to apply the topics and you should be good.

She is just good. The contents can be boring, but it is not her fault, it is just the content it is. She gives a lot of interesting examples when she teaches. The tests, however, take a big portion in the grade, but the questions are pretty straightforward and reasonable. There are 3 p/f homeworks and if you do all of them, you get an extra credit.

She is a good professor. She keeps class as interesting as possible and uses modern examples in class. Reading the book isn't mandatory, but I did and it helped me a ton with exams and understanding class. There are a few pass/fail homeworks, 3 tests, and some bonus opportunities. She uses clickers, but there aren't any participation points.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Lectures were very boring. The grade is based on the exams and three homework assignments so if you don't do well on the exams, you're screwed (but that's true of any mktg class not just Coupland) She is super nice and helpful, wants to see you succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Lectures are boring, but she is such a nice and caring professor. Truly wants students to succeed. Material is fairly easy too. Lectures aren't mandatory, but the exams are CAKE if you go to class and have detailed notes. The examples she gives help to learn the topics. I bought the book, read it for the 1st test, then realized it isn't necessary.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Lecture heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Genuinely one of the most caring professors I've had in my Smeal ETM courses. The few people that had bad things to say are clearly not meant for Smeal or anything that requires any effort. Class is not meant to trick you and she gives great examples to make lecture more entertaining and remember material. I've heard both profs are great though.

Really nice person that is extremely passionate about Marketing. Although class is boring, I feel all twice a week classes drag on a bit. Make sure to study a week or so before the exams and you will do fine.

You technically don't have to go to class, she treats attendance as chances to bump up your grade(89.5 to 90). She is very nice and uses lots of relevant examples while teaching, sometimes it does get a little boring because it's all memorization. I didn't go to more than half of the class and used nittany notes and her book, did fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: This class will put all of your marketing knowledge accumulated from undergrad into practice with a big group project. Great experience!

Prof Coupland is such a sweet lady who knows her stuff. She doesn't read off the slides, instead, she shows examples that help you remember the material. She clearly wants her students to succeed. On Halloween, she brought us all Kit-Kat bars. There weren't enough for everyone, so the next class she brought KING SIZE Kit-Kat bars for those people.

She is so sweet and passionate. Her lectures can drag on but it's worth it to go to class because she covers everything and with lots of great examples. She also considers clicker credit for your final grade. Textbook isn't really necessary. Study from her course packet and you're set for the test. Fair tests, helpful homework, great teacher/class

Professor Coupland is one of the best professors I've ever had! She truly cares about her students and is extremely passionate about marketing. Make sure you do the extra credit & attend class because it really helps your overall grade in the end. Exams weren't bad and you don't need the book. I really learned a lot, and I have her to thank for it!
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Amazing lectures--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Class is so boring. The hour & 15 minutes go by so slow because she just reads off the slide. Don't buy the textbook, she covers everything in class. If you memorize the notes, the exams are easy. Do all extra credit, it's worth it. She is the nicest lady in the world & so caring but the class is not fun. Same as MGMT. Just put in time and effort.

Prof Coupland is an AMAZING professor. I've never had a professor as passionate about their subject as she is, and it makes it so much easier to sit through lecture. Homework is so easy and worth 10% of your grade. Exams are fair and with the 3% extra credit she offers, getting an A is no problem.

Professor Coupland is a really nice lady, but her class is very boring. Compared to MGMT 301, however, I much prefer this class. While it is not very entertaining to attend, at least the exams are fair. Overall, I was fine with taking this class with Coupland, but you're probably not going to have a great time.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Coupland was one of the best teachers I have had at Penn State. She explains things in great detail during class and gives you hints to certain things that will be on the exams. The exams are very doable if you put a little bit of time in and study. 3 exams and up to 3% extra credit. I look forward to taking upper level marketing classes with her.

Has no idea what she talking about. This woman's been in academia for her entire life and has no real-world experience in marketing. Tests are basically your entire grade and they're long and vague. Frequently uses examples she doesn't know anything about. Also annoys students about her "technology policy" constantly. Would take another teach

Professor Coupland was a great Professor! Her tests were straightforward and exactly as she described in class. If you take notes (I used her course packet) and pay attention in class, you will be prepared for the tests. Professor Coupland is also extremely caring, and will make time to meet with students outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria--Would take again

reviews.comment: Absolutely amazing professor. There is a lot of information you're expected to know but as long as you study you will do well. It's clear exactly what you need to know for exams and the amount of homework is minimal. I love coupland and would 100% take another class with her.

Prof Coupland is not only a great teacher but a great person! The material is understandable and her personality really adds to the class. She uses great examples from the real world as well as her own professional experiences to explain every topic in the lectures. She is inspiring, respected & caring towards students. All around a great class!
You will learn so much about important topics and current events.

Great Professor, Interesting lectures however I feel like they drag on for a bit too long. Not a lot of HWs. Good amount of extra credit, I recommend getting the book but not marketing lab. The tests are moderately challenging, an A is not impossible but you need to work for it. Show up to class, a lot of the questions in the tests are from there

Coupland herself is very nice, so my problem is just with the course. I can only describe the material we had to learn as stupid. The "concepts" were boring and repetitive and the names for them sound like they were made up by 5 year-olds. The HW's were unnecessary, there were 3 of them with 5 questions each and there was nothing to figure out.
I was very impressed with Prof Coupland this semester. She is so so passionate about what she teaches and that is apparent in her lectures.
Easy
very easy class i showed up two times all semester and got an A. as long as you understand the material on the study guide she gives you you'll be fine its all memorization
She is a very fair teacher. She is also very approachable. This class was interesting and she is one of the best professors I have had at Penn State.
3 Tests that aren't too hard. I didn't do well on the second one and that's what prevented me from getting an A. Class isn't mandatory but is very helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Coupland rocks. She made me love marketing so much and made me sure about majoring in it. Her class is very clear, she seems like a super hip mom who is always willing to help students out. Her exams are easy and the packet of slides in her class is super helpful.

I have to say that Professor Coupland is the best professor I've had so far. Even though the class consisted of a lecture, she was able to make it interactive, and her slides involved the use of moderate incongruity. The class is not too difficult as long as you attend class, and refer to the textbook whenever needed, though not required.

Coupland is the best! Loved her class, very easy to understand and it was fun to learn. She makes sure to provide relevant examples for each concept. The tests are super easy, there is little homework and you only have to go to 70% of the classes. She is a really nice woman and I hope I can take another class with her.

Her lectures are long, BUT her exams are doable. Just memorize her course packet and definitions. Make sure you write all the clicker questions and remember the example she gives you. They will be on your test! Easy Homework and do your extra credit!

Coupland is a great Marketing teacher. Her lectures are engaging & interesting. For every exam she gives a detailed outline, practice test, and review screencast. The exams are very example based, so be sure you know the material rather than memorization. Do the extra credit. Also, read the book chapters before class. So very helpful for exams.
The lectures are long and sometimes boring. If you put a normal amount of effort into this course you will get a good grade. Its important to go to class so you know the notes for the exams.

Professor Coupland is one of my favorite professors. Go to lectures because they help a lot and she uses a lot of examples. Attendance counts but if you miss 5 you still get 100. She gives a ton of opportunities for e.c. which really help. Tests are pretty straight-foward and she gives you study guides and practice exams but you need to study!

Professor Coupland is a nice lady who will help anyone who needs it. She gives 3 exams. which are worth most of your grade, but she does a quick online review which tells you what to study. Just pay attention in class at why the examples she uses work. Only bad thing is she loves her examples and can go on for 45 mins about a McDonald's commerical

Dr Coupland is an amazing teachers. I highly suggest going to class because A) she makes the lectures interesting and B) her lectures make it easy to remember certain information on the exams. Tests aren't a walk in the park, but they're honestly not terrible either. Highly suggest this professor. She is awesome.

Professor Coupland was a great teacher.  She taught very clearly with a lot of good examples so you can understand everything.  90% of the class was three tests so be careful to study really well on all of them or you might just be out of A range after one bad test.

Dr. Coupland was an amazing professor! I really enjoyed being a part of her MKTG 422 class. It was definitely not easy, but I learnt a lot. The group project was challenging but fun! Her tests aren't easy, they actually make you think but in my opinion, that was better than having to memorize a ton of stuff and not use it later in life.

She is nice and her lectures are easy however I dreaded the group project and it is mostly 80% of the grade. She focuses a lot on this and all lectures end up being around group project so if the subject is boring, like the library, the class is going to suck. Take it only if you love group projects if not skip it completely. Lots of work

I really loved Professor Coupland! I learned a lot of valuable information about the marketing world and she gave a plethora of great examples for each concept that we discussed. I would definitely recommend this class. There is also opportunity for 3% extra credit and there are only 2 tests.

She's a great professor and is very smart but expects way too much of individuals in her class. Every week there are a few things due for the class material itself and then a few things due for the group project that she assigns. It's like taking two classes with all that she expects of you. Often very vague instructions.
She's very sweet and wants to see students do well. The material wasnt difficult at all. Go to lecture and study and you'll do fine

Coupland's class is by far the most boring and disappointing class I have taken at Penn State. She seems to have a pretty good understanding of the material, IF she was teaching us in the 1990s. She has no experience outside of academia, making the exams next to impossible. She is a very nice person but she wasn't helpful when I needed her.
LOVED LOVED this class. I recommend that you attend lectures because her examples help you succeed on the semi-challenging exams. Up to 3% extra credit available.

Coupland has been by far one of my favorite professors at Smeal.  Her lectures are up to date and she honestly wants to get you engaged.  That being said, the tests ARE conceptual on the material she lectures on, but those real life examples are a big part of the exams as well.  Go to her office hours because she WILL help you.  Great class.

Her tests can be a little tricky, and reading the textbooks is a must if you want to do well on the tests. The class overall was fair, class attendance is a small portion of the grade and extra credit is offered through marketing research studies. Professor Coupland is very helpful during office hours and it she seems very invested in the course.

This class is really hard, you need to understand everything inside out and study and a lot. And her class lectures are pretty boring. Make sure you go to class, make sure you do the extra credit research studies and just try your best to study. and Deff read the textbook.
she is very confusing at times. Specially in her exams.

I loved Dr. Coupland. She gave great examples and was interesting in lecture. If you stay until the end, she gives you "study tips" that are almost word-for-word exam questions. She was super interested in students and was helpful when you needed it, and her clicker policy is relaxed. Take her for sure!!
Not very challenging, but she's boring and her lectures seem to drag. Easy exams, homework is a gimme, and you can get 3% extra credit.

Has no idea what shes talking about.  This woman's been in academia for her entire life and has no real world experience in marketing.  Tests are basically your entire grade and they're long and vague.  Frequently uses examples she doesn't know anything about.  Also annoys students about her "technology policy" constantly.  Would take another teach

Jennifer is a very nice woman.  She teaches advertising concepts very well using many real world examples which keeps class interesting.  Her exams aren't bad but you definitely need to study and should read the textbook.
For what she has to teach, she does great! If you have survived Ron John's class, this should be a piece of cake.
AWESOME! I loved Dr. Coupland. She was fantastic - very engaging, very clear and very helpful. Definitely recommend. Not a marketing major.

Boring professor, she tries to be as interesting as possible. She enjoys the material and genuinely cares about teaching her students about marketing. This class isnt the easy A I was expecting, you have to work for it. If you want an easy A take Carter

She's quite a good teacher barely any hw, you hav 3 checkpoint hw the 3rd one is ec. I would like more practice question from her actually. use cliker for attendence; 20 out 24 is full score. recommand listensing to class podcast and read book for preperation
Marketing 301 is easy no matter who you take the class with. Coupland does the best she can with a vague and to be honest useless class. Go to class, take good notes, and read for an easy A
Nice lady but the exams are pretty hard because of how ambiguous the questions tend to be.  Not an easy class.
Coupland may be slightly more difficult than Carter, but I found class interesting. Extra credit was available and each exam was easier for me. No real homework. I suggest taking course with her

She was such a great teacher. Although I had her at 8am class was always some what interesting. She uses tons of examples in class that clarify what she is teaching. Definitely recommend her over the other professor

Buy nittany notes for her class, she goes really fast so you wont be able to pick up on every detail in class. Use nittany notes for exam, and read the chapters. Youll be fine if you really put effort in.

Prof Coupland is an amazing, down to earth woman that loves what she teaches. You really see that while shes teaching and she is always willing to further explain and help you.  Would definitely recommend taking her, I also had her for BA 304.

Shows tons of clips and has great examples to back up her strong lectures.  If you put forth effort you can obtain 3.5%  added to your grade with extra credit. Exams are not bad if you memorize notes and glance over the textbook to understand additional concepts.  Take marketing with her you will enjoy class.
As long as you study the notes and study guide, the class is easy. There are lots of extra credit opportunities. Clicker questions in class for attendance so you have to go to class.
Professor Coupland is a sweetheart. She really cares about the students, is extremely easy-going, and the class is not hard at all. I am a Finance major, and this class was no problem.

Dr. Coupland was an EXCELLENT lecturer and always taught us things that were relevant. However, her exams were MURDER. They were far too hard for an introductory course, and seemed to test on memorization, not understanding. Sadly, the bulk of your grade rides on your exam grades. You will "get your money's worth" for a lower grade.

Professor Coupland is very nice, funny, and trys to keep class interesting. Shows a million commercials which are always fun to watch and definitely gives you a good introduction to marketing. 3 Exams and extra credit via in-class activities and marketing studies. Not a hard class, but definitely study her PP & skim the book before exams. Got an A
Not difficult. Class got boring but exams can be tricky.

Hands down the best professor I had at Penn State. Entertaining class, fun lectures, and fun project. Her exams were semi-difficult, you just have to study. To be expected for a 400 level marketing class. Definitely reccomend!

I thought this was a great class. I only took it because it was required by my major, but she made it a lot of fun. And the tests actually aren't bad at all...if you just study the notes and read the chapters she laid out in the study guide!

I am a marketing major but I absolutely loved this class. The exams were not challenging if you studied a reasonable amount and read the textbook before the exam. Class is very entertaining. Coupland was one of my favorite professors at Penn State.

Your grade depends on your exam scores. Not too much extra credits so you have to study very very hard. The class is fun but you do not earn points for your attendance and participation. Will not choose it again.
Her class is fun to go to but when you take the test its a different story. I never took tests this hard. If you think you studied enough, study twice as hard. Its no joke!!

Easily the best professor at Penn State.  Classes are fun and interesting and go by fast.  She cares about her class and students and it shows.  If you go to class and put in some effort, an A is definitely obtainable.
Great prof. Keeps class interesting. would take again

She made class fun and interesting - I actually looked forward to it.  The exams aren't hard at all, making it a pretty easy A. She's also very nice and will try to help if you need it. I highly recommend!
Great professor! Makes class interesting with lots of videos and real-world examples. In-class review sessions before exams are very helpful. I would definitely recommend taking her section!!
For a junior core, she isn't hard at all. Three exams and that's it. Weighs top two as 40% and worst one as 20%. She offers Extra Credit. I'd recommend over Bergstein.
Best teacher I have had at Penn State.  She makes class interesting with relevant examples and the tests are very fair.  Extra credit to boost your grade.
A great class with great discussions. Extremely interesting.
No Comments

NOT A GOOD TEACHER. She blabs on about useless marking projects already shown in the media. She doesn't get into any details on marketing advertising assembly. Her class doesn't help in the real world.
GREAT TEACHER.
an excellent professor. knows what she's talking about and very helpful. i recommend all mktg majors to take this class!!
One of the best professors I have had at this school. Plus her exams are very easy. If you are a marketing major, this class is a must!

This has to be one of the worst classes I have ever taken. The weekly lectures don't actually teach anything and just go over practice problems, so you are required to read the Pearson text or learn on your own. You are also not allowed any formulas on exams, so have fun spending hours memorizing everything.

The "annotated" study guides were not fully annotated. The final exam had nothing that was on the study guide. She would not allow any notes to be used during exams and required us to remember an entire semesters worth of calculations and functions. Wouldn't take her again and wouldn't recommend her class.

Will not take a class with her ever again. She doesn't like to help any of her students and when I had problems on my proctored exams, she said that it's not her problem. Worst teacher I've had yet. Don't bother taking this class if you want a teacher who likes to help students. She's also rude in emails.
She hosts zoom lectures through worldcampus which most math professors don't want to do. She is a fairly easy and nice professor if you have any questions just contact her.
Professor Chopra is a caring instructor who makes a challenging course more manageable. Attending lectures and utilizing resources like Unstuck study helped me stay on top of the material.

Good class, she really helped me understand math and come to enjoy it.  I've always hated math in the past, but her course really helped me understand.  It is a lot of work, but if you do everything, it will help you a lot in this class. Make sure you do the extra credit.  It'll help you enormously for the exams.

The class was online which was good. Class was not required but there was a zoom and paced really well. I think she is a great professor. Just hard to reach with questions unless you go to class and ask.

One of the worst professors.  How is this person being paid money to teach students.  Do not expect any feedback (even if you ask for it).  Do not expect her to answer any questions.  Do not expect her to show up to her own lectures LOL.  She hardly speaks English.

For starters, the 5 ratings on here are not of actual students of classes. 
If you already understand the material then sure, take this class. If not, this is by far the worst professor. Cancels study sessions, only uploads poorly created notes, hard to reach. Penn State is a worse institution by employing her.

This professor is hard to reach and takes days to get back to you. Her homework is difficult to understand. She does not give feedback, explain anything, or communicate much throughout the semester. I did not enjoy this professor.

Neena Chopra does not do any extra explaining to make this very hard class any easier to understand. She scribbles math on the board for 50 minutes. You're better off teaching yourself. Teaching aside, very nice lady. Will bump up grade at end if you show up to class.

Professor Chopra is by far my favorite professor at PSU, I've had her for both Math 140 and Math 141. She does move pretty fast in her lectures, so if you're feeling overwhelmed in class just write what's on the board and make sense of it later. She is very transparent about what will be on quizzes/exams and actually wants you to succeed.

Neena was one of my favorite professors I've had so far. I had her for MATH 140 and 141. Those subjects are difficult in themselves, so the class was not what I would consider "easy," but Dr. Chopra definitely made the experience as enjoyable as it could be. She was very caring and cancelled class the week before Easter. She wants you to do well.

Her lectures are not perfect but they are still very good and definitely better than some of the other math professor's. She actually answers student's questions when they ask for help or clarification and is pretty much always available outside class. She also goes out of her way to make review and study materials for exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Chopra is such a nice woman and is probably the best professor to have when taking math 140. She gives extra credit and cares about her students. She does not teach the material very clearly but she is always available for questions. However, Math140 is the worst structured class. There is so much homework and ZERO study guides for the tests.

If you did not already take Calculus, DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. The majority of the class dislikes her style of teaching and incompetence. She will never fully answer your questions if you ask them in class, and covers new material in a manner that you wouldn't understand unless you already learned it before. The Zooms also suck, a lot.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: While Neena Chopra may be a great lady, she isn't a very good teacher. Her lectures aren't interesting and don't have much to do with the exams. There is a lot of homework each week. When you ask her questions about the exam she responds with "I don't know." Do not take this course with her.

Content makes no sense, homework does not correlate with the class lectures, reads directly from the slides and has no clue what she is teaching, if you ask her a question there is a chance she will tell you she doesn't know how to do the problem, honestly no point in going to her class, better off finding friends in other 140 classes to learn from

A lot of times she'd make the material more confusing than it needed to be and made mistakes in notes in almost every class. Only way I got through is cause I took it in high school. Extremely similar problems in notes and reviews to exams/quizzes. Not the worst option for 141 but definitely not the best either.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Chopra is a great professor for Math 141. She cares about her students and is very personable. She is a fair and sometimes lenient grader. She can be a bit disorganized and rush through certain examples. However, as long as you attend lectures, take notes, and complete HW/exam reviews, you should be fine. I definitely recommend Dr. Chopra.
141 by nature is not the easiest class, but for me it was easier than 140 because of Dr. Chopra. She is extremely helpful, good at explaining, and a caring professor.

I had Professor Chopra for MATH22 in FALL2020. It was an online class. She had a zoom meeting every Tuesday night which was optional. She would go over any questions that anyone had during the meeting. She also responded to each message that i sent her. The class was through ALEKS and self taught with tough deadlines. Lots of work but she was good.

Very attentive to student needs, Professor Chopra works hard and adjusts her teachings to accommodate the students as best she can. Math 141 is a hard course by nature, but she does an excellent job explaining exactly what you need to know and provides ample resources to excel in the class.

Neena Chopra is a GREAT professor. She genuinely wants to see her students succeed, and she provides lots of help if needed. Math is definitely not one of my favorite subjects, but Neena has made her zoom class my favorite part of the day! Definitely pick her if you don't want any unnecessary homework assignments like other prof. & fair grading!
She is a nice person but not a nice Professor. I don't mean that her teaching skill is not good but she just makes the course extremely hard. No extra credits, never reply to e-mail.

Live guided study groups are very helpful for quizzes and exams. They're also recorded if you can't make it, but that's your best opportunity to ask questions. There's a lot of ALEKS work. Very responsive to questions if not during a study group. I hate math but they want you to pass and are helpful.

Avoid this professor if you can. She puts topics on homework and even exams (including the final) that were not covered in class. She frequently cancels or delays lectures due to "personal issues". We were halfway through a Unit before she posted the first lecture on the material. She also ignores messages from students asking for help.

Neena is a very good teacher. The projects she using to calculate the grade is very few. And you don't need to worry about the tests because she has some sample exams which help you perform well in the exams. Don't hesitate, just enroll her class! Lucky all of your math 140!
Solid class overall despite the department making the exams overly difficult this semester. It isn't her fault, great teacher.
easy class with a right professor

I made an account to specifically warn people about her. She is a terrible teacher. I took Honors Calc in high school and got 100 and because of Neena have a B. She cannot explain anything for her life, she reads off the slides which are straight from the book, and the homework is so random that she has told me she doesn't know why she assigned it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I was really hesitant going into MATH141 given I barely got a C in MATH140. However, Chopra was an amazing professor in terms of notes and preparing us for exams; the notes are clear and concise and actually match the tests. At first she may seem slow and possibly behind the syllabus, but her style and pace for teaching works out in the end.

Good professor with easy notes to follow and she gives you great tricks to solve problems. She helps you understand what the midterms will look like through her quizzes. Best Math prof I've had in PennState. Math 141 is not an easy class by any means and requires and a lot of individual work. But Chopra will make it easier for you.
Class wise, the only grading is homework and quizzes which are weekly. She gives out notes for each lecture which are very helpful. She tells you exactly whats on the tests, she is very helpful.

Definitely one of the good professors to take Math141 with. She's very sweet, doesn't go fast, and isn't rude. Her explanations are clear. This class is still Math141, so it's not a piece of cake, but Prof. Chopra's the best one to take with. Only 1 thing: she's pretty quiet sometimes, try to sit in the front 2 rows.

Fantastic Professor. Math 141 was even easier than 140 with her teaching. Don't listen when kids say this is the "hardest math class" because it is not. With Prof Chopra and a little extra time outside class and homework you will succeed. I lost only 5 points throughout the entirety of the class, thanks to her.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Excellent teacher. I would strongly recommend her for both math 140 and 141. One thing that you will notice is that her ratings are poor for basic math classes but great for higher math. This is because she is passionate about calculus and it really shows. She wants you to succeed and might even help you during tests, (something I wish I used.)
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Excellent professor. Helped whenever was needed and was open to questions. I wish I had her in every math class
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: looking here before meeting her scared me, but she is excellent. Has said before how she always wanted to teach (can see the passion in her). Very open to office hours and extremly helpfull. Her accent is completly understandable but lacks in keeping the class interesting (Her voice is very monotone). Bad grade is my own fault. Gives extensions.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: Neena honestly cares about how you do. She does everything in her power to improve your grade through lots of quizes and and homeworks. Unfortunately, the way the department is set up, the tests make up pretty much your whole grade. Overall, she gives great examples in class and is always available outside of class

She is hilarious and makes me smile, but as for teaching goes, she goes by the book, and the book makes everything much more complicated. It is sometimes hard to follow the lectures and math problems she presents.

Neena is a really nice lady. Take the time to talk to her and go to her office hours and she will help you tremendously. Class was based off of homework that was graded on completion and exams. I was skeptical about taking her class because of the reviews on here but I'm glad I ended up taking it with her.

Best Calculus teacher!! I took Both Math 140 and 141 with Neena. She knows what she is teaching, very experienced. Gives lots of problems to work on  which really helps prepare for exam.  Office hours were really helpful. Very nice person too.

She is a great professor if you have her for calculus. She goes over dozens of examples to make sure you know the problems. She wont give you problems that would never be on an exam. She has plenty of office hour time to get extra help. She is very quiet but she is very nice and willing to help you succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Great Teacher! Care about students to perform well. Quiz every week, but it helps prepare for exams. No Final exam. I like that class is only once a week

Nice lady but bad teacher. Not engaging at all, all she does is read over her powerpoint slides straight from the book and she can be hard to understand. I got nothing out of the class and only went for clicker points. If you didn't take calculus in high school and are taking 110 for Smeal you better go to a lot of tutoring.

I hate this lady more than anyone i have ever met in my life, you have to answer every clicker question for the day just to get 1 clicker point, miss one and it doesn't count. If you miss the clicker point there is no point of sitting in the class because this lady doesn't talk she just sits there and mumbles in some foreign language. STAY AWAY
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: For the love of all that is holy stay far away from Neena Chopra's class. She speaks quiet, monotone, broken English which makes class impossible. The only reason people show up is the clicker questions. Every PowerPoint is straight from the book. She doesn't explain things, she has no enthusiasm and overall my day is better without her in it.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: First of all, this woman's English is not even close to coherent. Went a whole semester without hearing the word "the" come out of her mouth. Class is useless but part of the grade is clicker questions so attendance is necessary. Don't worry about watching Netflix in class, she may get upset but her lack of a spine prevents her from retaliating.

Terrible overall professor. All she did was narrate the problems she was doing and didn't go over them at all. My grade in the class got drastically better when I stopped trying to pay attention to her in class and just taught myself. The only reason I went was for the clicker points. None of the Math110  professors are great but she is the worst.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: If you haven't taken Calc before, do not take this class. She was so confusing in her explanations and she didn't know how to handle a large lecture. However, if you have taken Calc before, it's the easiest thing you'll ever take. I watched Netflix in class and still passed. Nice lady though.
Did not learn one thing in class but went to lion tutors and did fine on every test. She really can't keep a whole class quiet and ends up just kinda babbling.

She doesn't know what she's doing. She isn't approachable and goes through concepts quickly without caring. Luckily I took Calc in high school which helped dramatically or else I'd be completely lost!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Whatever you have to do, make sure she is not your prof.

If zero stars could be given thats really what is deserved. Neena Chopra is a nice person but is not at all fit to be a professor. I do not know what her teaching qualifications are, but she is the worst at connecting with students. She starts problems and halfway through erases her work because she realizes she is wrong. She goes several steps into a problem without explaining what she is doing and expects students to know. I took calc in high school and aced it, but she has completely confused me. I would say even if she is the only option because all other teachers fill up that you should wait until next semester to take this class. I have never had a worse teacher in my life and it saddens me to say that because she is a good person.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Classes don't matter as powerpoints and examples were just copied from the book. Homework was due every friday (absolutely impossible to complete in one night) as well as a quiz on the same material. However, quizes were low number of questions/high points and usually tricky. If you're not confident in math now, you wouldn't do well with her
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Absolutely hate this teacher. Literally would not go to class if clickers did not exist. Find another teacher. Sp hard to focus in her class. Does not engage with students. Nice lady but terrible teacher. She doesn't even know what she is doing half the time and the students correct her.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Awesome teach and very nice lady! Highly recommend!
She is great! If you go to office hours she will help you a lot! Very nice lady!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Worst teacher I've ever had. If it weren't for clicker points I wouldn't even bother showing up.

Neena Chopra is not a good teacher. I have an A in her class but it is only because I learned most of the material in high school. She has not enhanced my learning process in one bit. She goes over everything way too fast and doesn't explain much because it makes sense to her. In my opinion, you are screwed if you haven't taken calculus before it.

goes way too fast over new material, just does the problems and doesn't explain them.  you're better off teaching yourself or grouping with classmates.  worst teacher i have probably ever had in my life. her tests aren't hard if you can put up with her.

Highly Recommend her, great teacher, loves answering questions really wants you to pass. Do the homework, do well on the quizzes and study for the exams and you'll do fine. She really cares about her students and tries to help you as much as possible whenever she can, even on exams!
she trash. Shes mono tone and is no help. never engages students

People say that math 141 is a tough course. It was honestly a cakewalk for me, and I can say its because of this professor. If you actually wanna learn stuff, and score well, take her. There's one hw and quiz every week. Make sure you don't mess them up. Easily the best math professor I've taken until now.

One of my favorite teachers. She talks slowly and clearly and explains very well. She gives quizzes and homework every week but it really helps you practice the material. I don't think her quizzes are difficult. She usually just puts problems straight from the homework or notes on the quiz and I just did the homework to study for them.
I had Neena for Math 140. Not the best but also not the worst. The quizzes are hard and the exams. The second exam is the hardest.

Neena is FANTASTIC. She is very thorough, provides detailed notes, and always offers chances for help. Before every exam she'll take the time to make her own review sheets and hold review sessions. She talks slow, which I like, but sometimes works quickly. If you go to class and do the work, you will be fine. I'm so glad I took her. Also very sweet

Mandatory homework and quiz every week.  It gets annoying but making it mandatory is also extremely helpful.  If you skip class, things will get confusing fast.  There's 2 tests and a final, and they are extremely tough.  Just make sure to always go to class and do all of the homework.

Okay teacher.  Speaks softly.  Like the dude above said, wastes time at beginning answering homework questions which can be a huge waste of time and frustrating if you are better at the material than your classmates who are stupid and don't get it

Quizzes every Friday are pretty hard, Homework is due on Friday as well. Hard to understand her when talking and spends the first part of the lecture just answering homework questions which if you didn't do them yet, is just a waste of time.
Overall a pretty good prof. Her lectures can be boring if you already know the material. she has a slight accent but is very easy to understand. Very nice lady.

Would take again. I signed up for her Math141 class because I liked her so much. Very clear and helpful. Must ask questions!!!! Math at Penn State is difficult. The quizzes she had were fairly straight forward. tests (by the department) were more difficult and you need to study. However, she prepares you for them pretty well. Very chill person.

Chopra was great! Always willing to help. She curved the quiz and homework grade to help us all out. I wen tot office hours and she was very willing to go over every single question. She is flexible with quizzes but be respectful. She expects you to come to class! The math program at PSU is out to get you! All math at PSU sucks. Prep for EXAMS!!!!!

Ms. Chopra is a thorough teacher of MATH 140 and an extremely sweet woman. She is very understanding about missing an in-class quiz and will often let you make it up. She is very available and willing to help. Overall, her teaching style is traditional chalk-and-blackboard notes. She sets aside time to review a week in advance for exams too!

Professor Chopra is incredibly kind. She was prepared to give us both our last quiz and our Final Exam in the same week, but because a student spoke up she gave us an extra five days to study. Her notes are PPT's, which are CRITICAL to passing this class. A total of 8 quizzes were given to go along with three 20-question  exams and 11 homeworks.

The class was pretty easy. Her quizzes are almost taken directly from the homework and she gives you time to go over some homework questions before you take turn it in (and take the quiz). She covers the material fairly easily but she is rather soft spoken so you want to get there early and sit near the front.
UNHELPFUL    AF

She goes out of her way to make sure you do well on exams. She gives up her free time to give us review sessions. She's hilarious and I really grew to love her as a person. Would take her again 100%. Her quizzes are straight from the notes and graded easily. I love Neena

I had Neena for math 140. She is very clear in her lectures and will help any student with any questions. Having said that, you must ask questions. Her class is her lecturing and you asking questions. I would highly recommend her if you have taken Calc 1 before in high school because she is very chill.

I took Neena over the summer for Math 110.  She was amazing! Easily the best math class I've taken at Penn State.  She is a very fair grader and doesn't test on things she didn't cover in class.  One of the best math teachers I've ever had!
She isn't helpful and messes up examples all the time. She also makes us seem like a burden for asking questions. She is also soft spoken and hard to hear. I would definitely not recommend her.
Ms. Chopra really is a great math teacher. She does give a lot of book work, but that is exactly why and how you will learn the material for her classes.
She is a great instructor! She's been teaching this class for over ten years, very experienced!

This was the second class I took with Neena, and I must say, she is DEFINITELY better at teaching 141 than 140. Also, make sure you sit towards the front of the class and ask questions, that way she gets to know you, and she talks softly. She's one of those professors that will help you out in the end if you go to class and put in effort.

The best math teacher I have ever had. She is extremely friendly and helpful both during class and during her office hours. The homework and quizzes are very helpful for the exams, also give practice problems. If I took the class again I wouldn't want any other teacher. Helped me get an A in the class.
Very helpful in and outside of class. Knows the material very well and does a good job at explaining it. Her quizes are a little hard, but she makes sure you know exactly what will be on the exams.

I loved Neena. She was clear and made all of the concepts easy to understand. She would never hesitate to go over any concept even if only one person was having a problem. Very sweet lady who really cares about her students. I would take her again in a heartbeat!

She's super nice and very willing to help you. I had her for a night class and we were never there longer than an hour and a half at most, normally it was only an hour. She's really flexible and tells you exactly what to study for the test. As long as you go to class and do the homeworks you'll be golden

Neena Chopra was seriously the BEST professor I have ever had at Penn State. Her notes are very neat and organized. She is the sweetest woman ever and is willing to help out her students in any way. I would definitely recommend her for any class! Especially for Math 141 which is one of the hardest math classes at Penn State.
The class is defiantly one of the hardest, but she make it really easy. you have to go to class. one HW and one Quiz every week. doing the homework is studying for the quiz.

Neena is a smart, sweet woman and is always willing to help you out.  Sitting in the front definitely helps when it comes to grading.  The class is difficult, so go to class and do the homework. I would take another class with her in an instant.
She was really helpful and always made extra time when I needed it! She is really flexible and willing to change dates as well as classroom structure. FUN AND EASY! SHE WAS GREAT!
Dr. Chopra does lots of examples in class. This was helpful to me but maybe not for all students. She tries her best to make students understand.
i dont like her. her quizzes are harder than other classes...
always gets her example problems wrong and tells us to figure it out ourselves. nice.
you cant understand her accent at all, ive had her for one day and already hate her. she messes up her examples in class

Good Teacher.  She does do alot of examples in class and ocassionally gets answers wrong.  I think she does this to make sure everyone is paying attention. She's will to work with you if that's what you need.  Will meet with you at your convience in most cases unless she has a class at that particular time.
Very bad teacher.  Skips steps then gets answers wrong.  Doesn't get back to emails or says we'll talk about it in class.  Save yourself some time and quickly change teachers.
The class was hard, but more practice problems meant better grades on the test for me. I don't know how else anyone would study for math

Im not going to say that she was a bad teacher but not everyone can learn under this environment. All she does is examples in class and I couldn't really grasp the topics so unfortunately I bombed it. Doesn't help that this is the hardest class at psu
Please save yourself and just switch out of her section. Lectures are not very helpful at all
I thought the class would be okay but in all honesty, that was one of the worst experiences of my life in a classroom setting.
She is not very enthusiastic about teaching this class and the lectures are hard to understand.   Lion Tutors really helped me pass the class.

She takes some getting use to, but overall a very reliable math teacher. Took Math 021 and 022 with her during the summer. Didn't do so well in 021 because I had been out so long. I passed though with a B+. Ended up passing Math 022 with ease. She's very reasonable and tries not to overwork her students.

I took this during a 6 week summer session and she did essentially nothing but read some notes, fail to explain anything and give quizzes to students who felt unprepared despite study group efforts. The class met for 8 1.5 hour classes and twice for exams. There was  a quiz every time and the way the class was run set students up for failure.

Took this class once and failed, took it again with her and got an A. She has more control over the course content than if you take from a graduate student, meaning less tricky questions and math department exams. She was very helpful. This is the only math professor that I feel truly wanted me to succeed.

She told the class after mine that she did not teach my class well because it was a morning class.  Also she would tell my class that she prefered MATH 141 to MATH 140. Enough said.  If you are in Math 140 and have never taken it before RUN as fast as you can
Learn how to do the problems and you'll be fine..no surprises on the quizzes or exams. Straightforward and simple
The math dept is terrible, but shes pretty much the best you can get

go to class and you'll be fine. quizes are once a week and theres no homework. she gives you problems to practice everynight and if you keep up with those the exams wont be half as bad. the math department sucks. shes good i would recommend her.

One of the best! Get her! She's extremely helpful and will answer any question you have. If you go to class she will really like you and you will get the benefit of the doubt when it comes to grades. She's putting a curve on her sections. Math department makes reallllly hard exams but she does her best to give hints and prepare you ahead of time.
love her shes so great! nicest lady ive ever met and such a great teacher! highly reccomended =)

I always give people the benefit of the doubt, but not her. Prof. Chopra didn't stop some of my classmates from blatantly cheating on the exams, and she often made major mistakes during the lessons. To top it all off, she didn't hand out SRTEs, so it seems impossible to get the word out about her. Everything about this class was appalling...

if you have never taken calculus before, you will find this class near impossible with her as the instructor. it seemed that almost every problem she attempted to explain she made big mistakes in and just wrote them off like it was nothing and some questions she couldn't answer at all. i had an overall terrible experience and now despise her.

The class itself is very difficult but she does a good job of presenting the material. Apparently, its the department that makes the absurd tests, but she will give BIG hints about questions on the exams if you listen to her. There's 1 Quiz a week and you'll notice they tend to be similar to the exam problems. She does a good job of helping us out
Easy A if you do the homework, provides practice sheets and exams that are very similar to  the actual tests. Nice and helpful teacher also.
Doesn't explain topics well. If I didn't have calc in high school,I would be soooo lost!
she is a decent teacher and will go over any questions you have, ever. the class is hard, much more so than 140.  i never did the homework, i just prepared for the weekly quizes and it worked out.
