doesn't use any examples when lecturing... gets too caught up with the theories. wastes too much time in begginning of class taking care of miscellaneous issues. there is a lot of hw, which is good for reinforcement, but takes a while (1-2 hrs). nice, sometimes funny

She's a really good proffesor. She really makes you learn the material through the homework, but it really engrains the problems in your head. She also makes an amazing class environment (everyone loves the beuracratic questions!), and everyone gets to know everyone else really well with the few minutes she gives us before each class.

I like her style of teaching, she gives a few examples and thet sets you loose to make sure you know it yourself.  She makes you learn the material through the homework so you can iron out any insecurities you may have.

If you're in for real college learning, CJ is the professor for you.  She gives you just enough information, then the rest is up to you when you put in the time for the homework.  I had no interest in math until I took 140/141 with her.  By the time you mow through the problems she assigns, the computer-written exams are an utter joke.  I love her!

First off, I hate this class. I think she does, too. However, she did a great job teaching the class. Most importantly, she gives out homework which is a great tool to force you to learn this boring stuff. Come test time I was suprisingly prepared due having these assignments almost each night. If you have to take 141 and like HW, take it with her.

I'll admit I was uneasy about having Dr. Parsons before taking 141 because of what I'd heard, but 1 semester later she is undoubtedly the best math prof I've ever had in any course in any level of math ever. She is very helpful. Make no mistake, 141 is not easy in the least. But shes tries her best to make it so you FEEL it's easier. Great prof.

Dr. Parsons is interested in making sure you understand why you perform operations; rather than just blindly plug + chug repetitiously. She is always concerned for her students, and often, is misunderstood for someone who is disconnected. Everything she does is done with good intent. Her style is the only reason why I'm passing (for both 140+141).

alright she is the anti christ haha, she pretends that she'll take care of you and help your grade at the end of the semester if you work hard, well i did all my homework, showed my face at office hours, participated in class and still got a c, mind u i got an 84 83 and 69 on the tests, but she still could of gave me a b or b- for doing all my work

This lady was nice but not fair. The hw will run u about 2 hours every night. The class is killer i had it at 8am and 9am almost killed me. Overall calc is a tough class. And listen to me peopel on this. If you have never had clac before like me U will not get an A or B trust me. U will either fail like my friends or pull a C like me. TRUST me

RUDE and DISRESPECTFUL when i had a death in the family and had to miss the first midterm. she made a joke about it and made me bring in an obituary. i was not laughing. she speaks english thats the only good thing about this class. problem is she wont shut up once she gets off topic. try learning the formula for an equiangular spiral in 5 minutes.
its an easy class, sometimes gets a little confisong and the tests are somewhat challengng, but if you like math it is easy
don't listen to these crazy people! our class went from about 50 to 15 people by the end of the semester...not kidding

She is a great teacher.  She does leave little time for lecture, but she is good when she does lecture so it works out.  She is helpful, and knows what she is talking about, and how to explain it.  Two thumbs up!
the homework will make or break you, but she's really thorough and easy to understand.  i loved her class
Dr. Parsons was one of the best professors I've ever had. Gives a lot of homework so if you don't like that you might wanna try something else. But she's great.

10-15 minutes of actual lecture every class period, and she collects HW almost EVERY day so you have to go to class. HW takes 2-3 hours a night easily. Accidentally skip one problem? No credit! This class is supposed to be easier but it won't be with Parsons. More than half the class dropped by deadline. Horrible experience.
I took this class before and didn't understand a word the teacher said.  Mrs Parsons made it a lot easier.

Dr. Parsons is a great teacher for 1 on 1, but usually wastes most class time talking about other things and homework.  This usually leaves about 10-15 minutes for teaching, but I didn't mind because I understood everything.  I would not recomend her if you can't learn at a fast pase.
No Comments
No Comments
Are you kidding me?  Does this lady seriously have a job here?  I'm sorry... not a democratic socialist or a bureaucratic supporter so I don't like her one bit

I have never been in a more disappointing class. DO NOT TAKE esp if you have not had calc before or are expecting a review if you have had it. She often does not begin teaching a new lesson until there are 15 minutes, or even 5 or 10 minutes, left in class. HW every night that takes 2-3 hours EASILY

I seriously Love CJ Parsons, the best proffesor in PSU but not as a calculus professor. She has good stratergies to build relations in the class. Class is interesting, He burocratic sessions are amazing and her jokes are awful but she is a good PRO over all.
No Comments

Dr. Parsons is a genious when it comes to calculus, but cannot teach the material at all...everything is theory with her, no examples...she also goes on tangents with her bureaucratic questions and wastes lecture time...do not take this class if u havent taken calc before!!!

Had for both Math 140 & 141; wastes almost entire class time talking about random things, lecture is 15 min; HW every night; her examples are more theorem based, not practical; knows what she's talking about; will make you work; hard class, but survivable if you do the HW.. i got an A and an A-

Wastes lots of class time on nonmath issues. Lectures for about 10 minutes every class. Refuses to go over more than 2 homework problems when the entire class is clearly having trouble. If you don't understand something then it is your fault and not hers. You will be teaching yourself this material!

Very Humuous Person. Incapable of Math. Graduated in Elementary School. Hot as a Bomb from the back side. Stupid Ideas and idealogy. Stupid Jokes. Screwed Up bureaucratic Question Session. This Is not a math class. Its is a Bureaucratic Conference. Take this class if you like 3 hours of home work.

She's just plain annoying and thinks she's doing a great service to humanity by teaching calculus! If you like her teaching style you probably need/want to spend more time at high school. Treat us like adults, will you, Cindy?
Easily the best teacher I had in 4 years at Penn State.
She's awesome. She's hard as hell tho but she's worth it. MAKE SURE TO DO THE HOMEWORK!!!!!!!!!!!

Take this class with Dr. Parsons if you a.) like to do 2 hours of homework every night b.)like to BS in class for 40 mins and then have a 10 min lecture c.) don't need examples to be given during lecture to understand material.

Dr. Parsons is probably my favorite teacher at PSU.She makes you work hard and do homework EVERY night, but it pays off when test time comes.She always answers questions and is helpful during class.I would recommend her to ANYONE!!She speaks 100% english!

I had Dr. Parsons for the first 2 semesters here at Penn State for Math 140 and Math 141. She is by far the best teacher i have had in my life. I enjoy math a lot and having a great teacher like her makes me like it so much more.
Dr. Parsons is wonderful.  She is a great teacher and always has a good example for any question.  Her class is difficult, but she is probably the best teacher I have had at Penn State.
Gives too much homework and embarrasses students with questions!
awesome teacher! One of the best calc profs on campus. Her lecures are so funny, she gets off topic easily. The class itself is fairly easy and her homework dure every day helps.
Awesome teacher. Really knows her stuff and is very helpful, even with non-math topics.

Math 140 is a hard class but she's a good instructor. Sometimes doesn't explain everything b/c of lack of time. Homework due every class, usually an hour minimum every night required. Assigns more homework than other professors but it's only to help ...
very good.  really cares.
she knows what she is doing, but she doesn't know how to explain it so that we can understand.

She's like a mom. Requires homework turned in everyday, but all the work pays off! Only take this class if you're willing to put in about an hour a day. Also, don't attempt to cheat during tests, you'll see why. haha
No Comments
Very good instructor, a bit tough, but more than worth it
Always willing to give extra help; hard but an excellent instructor
grades every homework due every day

He's a bit eccentric, but the more I had him the more he grew on me. The only way to not get a 100% on an assignment is to not do, and if you don't do it or if you miss class, he will chase you down and give you options to make it up. This can be nice and helpful, but can get annoying if you personally don't care about getting that assignment done.

Was not the biggest fan of him at first but he grew on me. I had a small class with him, but he really tries to get to know his students and encourages engagement very well. A really understanding professor who my peers and I were able to have some meaningful conversations with by the end of the course.
Best Professor at Penn State one of my favorite classes.

This was one of my favorite classes this semester by far. We got to create the basis for a paper that will potentially be published, but it was super interesting work. The class mainly focused on sustainability and how the everyday person can be net-0-carbon. Just do the opportunities that he gives you sooner than later, and you'll pass.
Best proffessor in Penn State. I took him for EMSC 100S, and he is the best. You will definetely get A+!
a real gem
Such a wonderful teacher who will do anything to make sure you are doing your best.

Dr. C is the most laid back and understanding professor. If you tell him that you have a ton of work to do in other classes, He'll possibly give you an extension. His goal is for students to succeed. He wants people to get stuff out of the class. He's also very helpful and can be hilarious.

Very good professor and extremely helpful. He should have spaced his lectures more and taught more MATLAB though or let Andrew teach more. Overall, a solid class to get me off the ground in programming knowledge.

One of the best professors I've had. He's always willing to help you and make sure you know what's going on.  Hell, this year he had office hours from 9-11 at night because that's what worked for his students. Overall, a great guy and a great professor.

If you have the chance to take Dr. C. for any class, DO IT! This man is truly one of the most caring and compassionate men you will ever meet. He'll help you for hours on assignments and even give extensions if you need them. You learn a lot too!

If you ever have the chance to take Dr. C, take him!! I went into the class with zero knowledge of FORTRAN and walked out of there feeling like a genius. He always goes out of his way to help people and even hold office hours till midnight sometimes!
Very Helpful if asked

Dr. Clothiaux is a very nice guy who really wants his students to do well.  The material and exams are difficult, but he is willing to help at any time, and scheduled numerous help sessions throughout the semester.  The homework at times was very hard, but I feel that I learned a lot.
