Took BIO430 as a combined course with her and Dr. Sutterlin. I got 60s on the first exams (Dr. Thomas' exams) and when the instructors switched I started getting 90s. Dr. Thomas does not seem to understand how to teach new material, and assumes we already understand the content. Uses big words without defining them. Dr. Sutterlin was amazing tho.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: If I could put a rating below 1 it'll be in the negatives. Material not difficult but she should NOT be allowed to step foot in a classroom.From the way she grades to the way she teaches her mission is to trick you and make you fail.Averages were barely D n when we switched to diff. prof. exam averages magically were A's. DO NOT DO IT TO YOURSELF.
Very difficult class and flipped classroom was not productive. Heavy on textbook readings and almost no in class lectures.

Do not take this course if you are unprepared to teach yourself all content that you will need to know. Dr. Thomas's classroom is flipped, so she essentially teaches you nothing, yet expects you to come into class already understanding incredibly complex topics. Save yourself while you can!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: I couldn't believe this class was real life. I thought I was on an episode of impractical jokers for the first half of the semester. This is the worst classroom experience I have ever had (by far). She refuses to teach you. Class averages on exams were consistently terrible. She refuses to curve or provide any extra credit. She wants you to fail.

This is the worst class I have ever taken. Dr. Thomas rarely gives lectures, is extremely defensive about feedback, and has terrible exam averages. She does not take any accountability for her averages as she blames them on people not buying into her teaching style. Also, she claims to have "never curved in 30 years." Avoid her at all costs.

Awful teacher. She was terrible at explaining any of the concepts. The lab was equally terrible because she made it her mini-lab. My class had very low averages on most of the exams, and she said that was "normal for the course" which should speak volume about her teaching. Exams weren't weighed heavily, so failing some wouldn't tank your grade.

We only received one grade the entire semester and it was our final grade for the semester.  We took multiple exams and prepared a presentation for the class.   There was absolutely no opportunity for betterment.

This class is not taught to you. Be ready to read and memorize a whole textbook. The exams are open ended and you need to be ready to know even the smallest of details from the textbook. Do not take this class if you are not ready to work for your A. I barely made it.

this class is super hard. most of the work is reading and memorizing huge chunks out of the textbook, and in class u have to be prepared to answer challenging questions. tests are extremely hard but they have little weight, so its still completely possible to get a good grade.

Thomas is very clearly really smart, but she is almost too smart to be teaching this class. The problem solving sessions are not weighted enough considering how much attention is given to them in class. The exams are near impossible to get a good grade on, but they are only 25% of the grade. Standards unclear. She's very nice but a poor teacher.

I guess he wasnt a good BIOL 230W professor, but 230M was the best class I've ever taken! It was a lot of work but each exam during the year is only 5% of your grade. Definitely a worthwhile class because of the activities done in class. Participation was a large amount of grade.
Smart teacher just doesnt know how to teach it to students. class was just an absolute ton of memorizing.  Learned absolutely nothing! If you can skip taking it DO IT!!
Very bad professor. Does answer questions if apporached at the end of class. Have to learn everything on your own.

One of the worst professors I've had. Doesn't explain anything, and doesn't care if you understand the material. He's to busy focusing on his own research. I honestly don't know why he teaches. Made me hate a class I use to have interest in.

I honestly can't stand the guy.  He is so boring and yet expects everyone to be so interested and understand ridiculous details that he might mention once.  I emailed him multiple times, and his responses are always so unhelpful.  It's an important class for biology majors, and he ruined the chance of me liking it and doing well.

One of the worst classes i've taken here at penn state. Graham is one of the most boring people I have ever been forced to listen to. The lectures are essentially pointless, if you want a good grade in this class read the book and do yourself a favor by not going to class and sleeping in (chances are you'll fall asleep in there anyway).
HE IS HORRIBLE!

Doesn't teach you anything, you have to learn it all on your own, if you're willing. The only reason I go to class is for clicker points, otherwise it's useless. Can't understand him and he spends about 10 minutes every class trying to get the powerpoint to work and never stays on topic - we're way behind on the syllabus.
WORST PROFESSOR EVER! You HAVE to teach yourself!

If you can stay awake and make sense of what he's mumbling about enough to take notes, then you might have a chance at passing.  No consistency between topics.  He comes off as very snobish and is hard to approach.  I might go to him if I ever wanted my DNA sequenced, but never again as a teacher.

HORRIBLE PROFESSOR! The material has potential but he teaches it badly! Mumbles to the floor and has a monotone voice that just puts you to sleep. Test Banks don't help that much. The class average was barely over a D (that should tell you plenty)! I'd say don't take him but he's the only who teaches it so good luck! GET A TUTOR!
Ochem was better than this..I studied like crazy and pulled off an A- in the end..i guess its easy to get a B or C if you memorize the test banks, but good luck getting a true A.

Honestly, no matter how hard you try you cannot get an A. I tried so hard. He is the worst professor I have ever met and I learned absolutely nothing in this class. He is an arrogant, demeaning teacher solely there for research who doesnt care about his students. My friend asked him for help and he told him to draw pictures. Are you kidding me?

horrible teacher. very boring and the tests are impossible. test bank helps out less and less on the exams. his lectures are incredibly boring and he had no clicker this semester. his powerpoints are filled with little information...a lot of pictures. if you are looking for an A, you won't get it with this class. AVOID THIS TEACHER!

Worst prof I've ever had. His tests are designed so everyone gets between a 65-85%. He is impossible to pay attention to and goes off on tangents about useless things. No matter how hard you try, you will not get an A in this class. Every exam has 7+ questions that are completely random which makes it so no one gets an A.

Tries to pack in too much detail and is extremely confusing- even if you do tutorials before lecture (but still do them, it's the best chance you have).  Had to do a lot of self teaching, so glad I'm paying tuition for this class.  Watch out- memorizing the test bank no longer works!  He only takes a couple of questions from them now

He is a bit dry, but very helpful. You'll get what you deserve in this class. If you put in a lot of work, you will do well. If you don't do anything, you won't be happy with your grade. Nice guy! He uses a lot of real world examples.
Lab should be separate from lecture for these bio classes..that way we could get a legit curve like in ochem with Maslak. Test averages are <70 but lab buffers grades to B's but no A's

I think it's pathetic that a class is based off memorizing a test bank, which isn't learning. In addition, either he changed the class or something because each test only contained about 60% test bank. So far, the class averages on the test have been below a 70%. He is the worst teacher I have ever had, and it's not because the material is hard.
He's really smart, and is very helpful if you email him questions. The class was a fairly easy B with the test bank he gave out
I agree with the previous persons comments. The grades aren't distributed at all but the class average is still a solid C. Getting an A doesn't seem feasable

It seems like he changed his class from previous semesters. There are no clicker points, tests (70% of your grade) are about 75% from the bank and the non-bank questions are very hard. It ends up yielding a class average of a C, but hardly anyone gets an A. With lab, this class is an easy B with lab, but nearly impossible to get an A

Lectures aren't necessary, he gives test banks before every exam, go to the library with your class and check over all the answers then just sit there and memorize for the night and you'll be fine. Usually the tests are about 90% directly from the test banks.

Brilliant researcher but dry as a teacher. He lectures on a lot of unnecessary information (his student's research is a primary topic)but the tests are easy even if you just sit through class, which was required because of the clicker questions.
Smart, will help in office hours, but stubborn. never can admit he's wrong. cares about the material, not the students.

The class itself has the potential to be interesting, but Dr. Thomas mumbles to the floor about worthless information. Its obvious that he was hired for his research, NOT for his teaching skill. Use the book and understand the test bank questions. Stay awake in class to copy the scribbles he puts on the overhead they end up on the test. Lab is easy
Nice guy, and his droning voice just wants to make me sleep
No Comments
Honestly - the class is boring, but I don't really think its because of the professor. The material is just pretty dry. Dr. Thomas is a nice guy and is definitely willing to help if you need it.

I heard bad things about Thomas going into his class, so I was expecting the worse... but he actually isn't that bad. As long as you go to class, take some light notes, answer clicker questions, and memorize the the test banks for exams, you can get at least a B, if not better. He actually is a pretty nice guy too.
good class, it was kind of boring, but overall if you memorize the test bank its pretty easy. nice guy as well

I agree partly with these reviews. yes his lectures are boring but he does try...or at least he did in my class. the only thing you need to study are the test banks, he goes more indepth than necessary but i'm sure it's interesting to SOMEONE...just not me. the lab is ridiculously boring, and it no skill to my technical writing.

One of the worst professors I've had.  His lectures are boring.  His tests cover mindless info rather than important concepts, and he almost never allows time to ask questions.  If you can avoid him by all means avoid him.  If not, good luck.
This professor is horrrrrrible! He is so boring and there is too much material that is fair game for his tests.  Avoid him at all costs.
Its a tough class, but come to lectures, read the book, and ask for help when you need it and you will be fine.   Dr. Thomas makes such a boring topic interesting and even humorous at times.

Unhelpful, inconsiderate. Obviously more interested in his research than being fair to his students. Barely coherent in his lectures, and lacks that ability to even make you want to pay attention. Good luck kids, this guy's a jerk.

He is one of the worst teachers I've ever encountered.  He is unhelpful in explaining concepts, typically only grazing over key vocabulary terms found on the exam in detail.  Most of the terminology isn't found in the textbooks, doesn't talk about them in lecture and aren't in the tutorials either. Find a good supplement to the material bc ull need

la de da de da.. zzzzzzzz.. That's all that I think while I'm sitting through his lectures. The most boring prof I've ever had. When I've stayed awake, hasn't really explained anything, reads practically straight from the tutorials. One good thing is the word banks, complete these, and know the info before an exam, guarenteed easy grade (A or B)

he's one of the worst teachers ive ever had. even if you understand a topic well, he'll find a way to make it sound much more complex than it really is. the class is easy though, and the material is interesting. just dont go to class cuz its a waste of time.

not really a good professor. i've never been a fan of british profs and he is the prefect reason why. lectures are boring as hell.  no matter how well prepared you are for tests, you won't be. lab is the worst thing in the world. if you don't have to take him, then don't.

I do not understand either where the above comments are from.  Are you going to take molecular biology and expect it to be cake.  If you have any interest in science it's a decent course, and he is a very intelligent man who explains difficult concepts well.

he's a HORRIBLE teacher... i really liked bio before this class and he made me hate it... i emailed him once to ask him a question about whether a topic would be covered on the test (since it wasn't listed in our syllabus) and he basically said whether I knew how to use an index.. he completely insulted me and was just plain RUDE!! DON'T TAKE HIM!!
honestly..hes not that bad and the class isnt so bad..however i suggest skipping lecture all together bc it doesnt help..just DO THE TEST BANK and memorize it!!

Class is pretty tough.  He gives you a test bank to study for each test which is helpful.  None of the labs we did this semester worked, always something wrong with the way they set the lab up.  Waste of time.

One of the worst lecturers ever.  He says umm, or uhh every 4 words and it will put you to sleep and rob you of any interest you had in the subject in the first place.  Shame on you PSU for hiring such an incompetent public speaker, let alone for a 300+ person class!

I don't get the complaints...he's very easy to understand and explains difficult concepts quite well.  I'm really enjoying the class.  (Someone complained they had to do the reading before class!  Give me a break and take some responsibility!)

TERRIBLE PROFESSOR!  He mumbles and talks softly.  I sat in the front row and still had trouble hearing him.  I stopped going to lectures because he bore me so much that I lost interest in the material, and as soon as I stopped going to lectures, I improved and was more motivated to study.
DO NOT take this class if you can help it. WORST professor I have ever had. Lectures are pointless and extremely boring. NOT RECOMMENDED
Awful Class. Professor is boring
This class is very annoying, and the exams are fairly hard. It doesn't help that lectures are not helpful.

This class SUCKS! Do not go to lectures, they are a waste of time. He doesn't really explain things well, and you'll be totally lost if you dont read before each class. He tries to make it interesting sometimes, but it is impossible. If you can avoid this class/prof, your in good shape.
Dr. Clark welcomes feedback and tries to implement it throughout the class. His lectures and practice problems are clear and he gives many opportunities to practice the material learned in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Homework 6 Problem 2b sucks

Despite messy handwriting, Dr. Clark gives useful Top-Hat questions to make students learn. While he has a lenient grading scale, the first quiz is impossibly hard: the questions required us to derive equations that were not covered in class. Exams are closed book, though equation sheet is given. Good news is he welcomes any feedback students give.

This professor was amazing. He always came to class with fun, interesting stories to start the conversation off, and he was always willing to help out and give genuine advice. He was lowkenuinely my favorite professor, and made the transition from high school into my first semester great! I was nervous coming into this college, and he was awesome!
So funny and so much energy!
Great Guy. Would suggest choosing him form English 15 if possible.

Its honestly hard to not get an A in this class. There are several outlines you must complete and several more you can do for EC... which by the way there are TONS of EC opportunities. Its easy to stop going to this class over the year...don't do that as he gives out test questions/answers in class and does not post notes/slides. Would take again.

While the class was unconventional (7 handwritten outlines), it was not hard to get an A if you went to class. Lectures are pretty straightforward and not too boring bc he tends to relate them to his life. Exams were exactly like he says they will be, and he preps the class well. Overall, a laid-back guy who wants students to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: need to go to class as slides are not posted, concepts are easy to understand when you go to lecture, outlines are very long, surprise pop quizzes for extra credit

Bo was pretty funny and he relates a lot of the class material to his own life. Class was pretty laid back and there are a ton of opportunities for extra credit. Outlines can get annoying but if you don't wait last minute to do them they arent that bad
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I really liked Bo. His lectures are interesting and he gave a lot of personal anecdotes which helped keep my attention. He explains the concepts very clearly and does a great job at answering questions. The tests are laid out pretty clearly, and as long as you use the study guides you should do well. Only downside are the req. chapter outlines.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Bo is cool. Sometimes he explains things in a more scientific than basic-english way, but thats the point of the class. He is a funny guy and genuinely cares about his students. Attendance technically is not mandatory, but you can only get the notes in you attend, and those notes are necessary for success in the course.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: SO many opportunities for extra credit (pop quizzes for EC, extra homework, exam questions). Open ended questions on the exam were easy to BS for partial credit and he reviewed everything you need to study the class before the exam. Super nice and approachable, just get through the textbook homework and it's an easy class.

I would not take this class again. He talked the whole time and it wasn't interesting. Every week there is a 10-20 page written outline due. He requires 6 out of 13 done for full credit and the rest are extra credit (only worth 1 point each). Tests are hard and impossible to pass if you don't study the slides, study guide, and your notes.

Professor Cleveland is a great professor! His lectures are informative due to the relevance of the material to oneself but still manages to make them comical from time to time. Definitely take this class, an A isnt hard to get!

3 tests make up most of the grade, but professor cleveland does a great job preparing you for them. 6 required outlines and 7 other for EC but they take a very long amount of time to complete. With that being said, they arent difficult, just time consuming. Last 10% comes from an informative mental health training. Prof Cleveland is the man!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: It's hard to tell what kind of prof Bo is. He's a hard ass about asking for a roundup of a grade but is also hilarious and engaging. Only three tests and extra credit chapter outlines are grades, so READ! Tests are short and easy as long as you go to class. He cares about the subject and you can see the passion through his lectures.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Class is super easy but his lectures are very confusing. gives out a hard copy of lecture outline before class starts. doesn't post slides online. There is a lot of writing assignments. TA's were more helpful than the professor and lab every Friday is very helpful. the exams are in class with about 10-12 open ended questions. no technology allowed

although he doesn't take attendance, u won't get any of the information that is on the tests if you don't go to class. doesn't upload slides. no homework or quizzes, but assignments that can be done each unit for extra credit. the only thing that makes up your grade are tests, so make sure u study & pay attention and definitely do the extra credit
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests? Not many--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Hobart is a generic professor. He is sometimes funny, but he's just your basic professor. He allows you to do extra credit, but that consists of a 20 page outline for each chapter for 2 points. He often gives pop quizzes, but they count for extra credit. Besides the few points of extra credit, there are only 3 exams that define your grade.
reviews.rating_tags: BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Bo is a great guy. His class is set up in to 3 exams and everything else is extra credit. He has a very dry sense of humor which makes me laugh a few times per class. The only complaint I have is that his exams are very short so every question is worth a lot of points.

Hobart is a chill guy, a little boring at times, but class expectations are clear and it isn't difficult to get an A. He doesn't take attendance but the test questions come straight from the lecture so might as well go.

go to class to get extra credit points form the in class pop quizzes. Doesn't take attendance. if skip class then miss the notes. He does not post the notes online. exams are about 25 multiple choice questions and 2 open ended responses but tells you what the questions will be the class before the exam.

Great and Nice guy. powerpoint slides are boring and can be confusing. reads right off the slides and gives an example. Do a written outline after every chapter on the new chapter for extra credit. the class before the exam will give a review quiz that will also count as extra credit. Also goes over questions that will be on the exam the class befo

Outline on the chapter is due every other week for extra credit. Easy in class pop quizzes count as extra credit. His lectures can be boring along with his powerpoints. Exams are about 25 questions and goes over the class before of what will be on the exam. Exams are in class multiple choice then 2 open ended but are easy. No cumulative final.

Bo is funny and engaging. He can be rude at times, but the class is relatively easy and mostly common sense. He offers bonus points through in-class quizzes and outlines. If you do all of the outlines and go to class, it is an easy A!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Awesome professor! Lectures are easy to understand and Bo is hilarious. Added bonus, he brings his kid to class sometimes. Exams are straight forward.
Bo is extremely funny and occasionally brings his child to class and keeps him in a teepee. His child pops out at random times and gives everyone a good laugh. Easy grader. V good class.

Although his class is mainly based on exams  he gives you so much EC opportunities. His exams are only 20-30 questions (good and a bad thing), but the class before the exam he goes over the exam and literally gives you questions from it. There's no papers or home works. He's a great professor highly recommend!

AMAZING. Yes, his lectures can get very boring. However, there is so much extra credit in class, which doesn't count against you-- only for you. There's also extra credit every week outside of class. his exams are very straight forward--he's not trying to trick you. all in all, amazing professor id take him 100 times over.

Hobart is amazing. He's hilarious and makes the content fun. Quizzes and chapters outlines serve as extra credit towards exams,  which is very helpful. I can't say enough good things about this professor. The lectures are interesting and the content from them is direct to the test. Great teacher, great class.

Honestly, this professor is amazing! He is funny and he does his best to explain any difficult concept. His class was easy and the test was straight forward.  I never owned a textbook for that class and did pretty. Just be prepared to show up to class if you do not want to read the textbook and take good notes and you are set.
An awesome dude who really makes the class environment comfortable. The exams are straight forward, and based off of the text book chapters and lecture notes.
Bo is a good teacher. Funny and engaging, as well as knowledgable. Feels pretty long at times though. I wish there had been more assignments than simply the exams.

Bo is an amazing professor! Although his lectures can be a bit boring at times, it is an easy A and he is by far one of the funniest professors I've had to date! I would highly recommend taking HDFS with him!!
Terrible! Not knowledgeable about course information, very unclear, and very boring.

Great Professor. He's interesting and doesn't baby his students. Don't get me wrong, it's an easy class, very easy, but he actually treats his students like college students, not children. if you want to be treated like a child, your hand held the whole way through, you might not like the class. If you are here to learn, he's an amazing professor.

Awful instructor.  Very full of himself and not very knowledgeable or interested in teaching.  Exams aren't too difficult but 3 chapters are covered in 20 questions...so there's a lot of info that never gets tested.

It's your usual lecture class but he's not boring. A lot of the information comes across as common sense which makes learning it simple. Attendance is not taken but he gives in class quizzes sometimes and those count as extra credit to your exam grades. Exams can be tricky so study and definitely worship your text book!
If you can take this class with another professor please do. He is the worst professor that I have ever had here at Penn State.

SO CONFUSING! Material in this class isn't hard but his teaching is so round-about. Read the book, have good background knowledge, & go to class to copy from the slides he decided to no longer post mid-semester. Oh yeah and hope you get a good TA, not one that takes it upon herself to remind you that you are in a college class. Yeah.. thanks.

He is the worst professor I have had so far in my career at Penn State.  He stutters, is incomprehensible, and is so confusing.  I don't even pay attention in class anymore because the stuff he does manage to get out of his mouth makes no sense.  His slides are confusing and are poorly written.  Do not take this class unless it is required. AWFUL!!

The class material can be a little difficult, but he teaches really well and makes the stuff interesting and relevant for social science majors. I'd really recommend him. If you miss a class, it's okay but attendence is important for the labs. This class was not nearly as hard or as boring as I thought it would be because he's a good prof

Seriously the best professor I have ever had. I was at a tough spot with my major and second guessing myself and he 100% helped bring back my love for architecture. Great lectures, personable, and hilarious.

Jamie is a mixed bag of fun. Although he's hilarious at times, there's also moments where you're left begging for mercy hoping he'll eventually stop talking. Our TA literally had to stop him several times throughout the semester. He also tends to change assignments on a whim, so be ready for that. Oh and most importantly hope you like Italy

There is a lot of work for Jamie's class for it being only 2 credits but 6 hours a week. If you are a first year do not take away studio time to work on viscom but still try your best nonetheless. Jamie loves to take class time to talk but will be understanding with studio work and is always willing to give you an extension. TA grades the work.

Jamie is easily one of the best professors at Penn State. He cares about his students, pushes deadlines back and will be there to help you 24/7. He truly cares about the mental well-being of all his students. The class can be difficult and time-consuming but that is just the class, not the professor (look at NCARB requirements).
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Jamie Cooper is amazing! I took this as a required class for architecture and I learned so much. He cares about his students and even had an extra study session for us before the exam.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Jamie Cooper is the kindest and most knowledgeable professor I've ever had. He genuinely cares about all of his students and wants them to succeed.

I honestly believe Jamie has been one of the best professors I've ever had, he is really funny and truthfully cares for his students. Yes, he has a deep love with Michelangelo (Mike), Leonardo da Vinci and the Pantheon but you'll grow to love them too.

Honestly, the professor is good but do NOT take this class if you are not an architecture major! I mistakenly took this as a gen ed.... it is boring and pretty difficult. There's hardly any grades per semester so if you don't do well on a couple assignments it tanks your grade and is hard to recover.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: All-around a pretty good prof. A bit scattered with deadlines, but very caring and willing to help. Totally full of himself to the point that it's hilarious, but still a nice guy. Great at drawing, he has good reason to be cocky. Probably has a Michelangelo poster in his room. Lectures are informative usually, goes on tangents a lot but it's funny.

Jamie gives very long, yet very informative, lectures. He's a fantastic artist, but sometimes this works to a disadvantage to his students since he expects so much. He is a very nice guy who will help you to an extent. BEWARE OF HIS TEXTBOOK. IT'S NEARLY UNREADABLE!

Jamie is by far my favorite professor this year. His lectures are informative, aside from the occasional tangent, useful, and entertaining. The only thing he loves more than the Pantheon, Michelangelo, and the Empire State Building is himself; however it's entertaining. He cares deeply for his students and their wellbeing.
Jamie is super nice if you just do what he asks. If you need help, ASK HIM! Trust me, he loves the attention. He is  amazing at what he does and is pretty interesting.

Jamie is an absolutely phenomenal professor. He knows what he's doing and is fantastic at is, so he'll be pretty hard on you, but just don't be afraid to ask him for help. He's always willing to put in extra time for his students, even if it's seven hours on a Saturday. Definitely one of the best professors I've ever had by far.
No Comments

High expectations, smart, lots of experience, positive, helpful, dedicateddd... Will do anything to help his students and really CARES about teaching. Hope he stays at PSU. He has high expectations but he's not impossible, he just motivates you to work hard. Some people have petty complaints, of course, but overall he's a great guy/professor.
unbelievably painful class structure

Excellent professor, really tough class. Grades are exams, quizzes, and projects. Quizzes are based on the homeworks (not graded) and straightforward enough. Projects are fun but tedious, graded very leniently. Exams are rough, but the curves are strong. Dr. Coder is very knowledgable and answered questions well. Very nice guy, pretty funny too.

AERSP312. Dr. Coder's lecture is clear, but the exams are difficult with an average of 45%. However, he gives a 25 point curve, which is a lifesaver. Exams are mostly multiple choices, with three open-ended, plus a 5 point bonus riddle. Make sure you look up some popular riddles before the exams. Quizzes on Fridays are based on hw (No Submission).
Fantastic professor. He is highly knowledgble, and his lectures are phenomonal; some of the best lectures I have had in college so far. His exams are quite rough, but he applies a very fair curve.

Dr. Coder is great at explaining  complex topics in a  digestible manner. You can tell he appreciates students who work hard and go to OH with questions. Only complaint is exams were too long for the time given in class. They're extra hard in terms of difficulty (which was fair imo), but the length/number of problems were too much for 50 minutes.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: EXAMS SUCK. No practice exam, not enough time, overly difficult problems. No one finishes on time, and the averages are under 50%, which means he has to curve a ton. He needs to provide more study material for exams and make them shorter and less complex. They are 70% of the grade and I feel like Im learning nothing and just guessing on them

Dr. Coder is clearly a very intelligent professor who has a firm understanding on the contents of the course. So long as you come to class intrigued, occasionally attend office hours for clarification on more complicated comprehensive materials, and actually complete assigned homeworks, you will do fine.

His exams have 12 multiple choices, 1 short answer, and 2 super complicated computation problems. You have 50 minutes and you can never finish them. There are no sample exams, and the examples did in class are very simple. The grade of the class follows the normal distribution pattern and there will be a huge curve based on the average.
Dr. Coder knows his stuff but you have to put in the work to understand the material. Even if you don't get an A you'll learn a lot.
Great professor. Very respected
Good professor but will repeat verbatim the same policies for an hour once a month. Very annoying as if we didn't hear you the last 4 times, Costello. Wasting my time. But lectures are good.

Honestly this class is so easy, so if you do bad thats on you. The only reason I can think of for doing poorly is if you don't show up to class because then you can't take notes, but if you're taking the notes you should be all set for the exams (very comprehensible). The only thing that sucks is we have to take them in the Pollock Testing Center.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class is very different from other IST courses. This class requires a lot of reading and comprehension. You have to study a lot by yourself outside the class to earn a good grade on the exams. Make sure to create a very good notesheet; only then can you pass the exams. They are conducted in the Pollock Testing Center, but they're manageable.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof. Costello was awesome!! Her lectures are very clear and she explains things in such a way where even if you have no idea what it is, you'll understand it by the end of the class. Midterms are weighted a little heavier but as long as you show up and pay attention, it's an easy A.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is good at explaining stuff but is confused and unclear about grading exams. Her class is based on these midterms, but her expectations with written questions are too high. Not satisfied with her grading at all as she made stuff to justify her grade up while my answer had everything she mentioned, still she didn't change it.

She isn't mean and the class isn't hard if you read the cases and study for the exams. She's qualified and intelligent, however, class is plagued with boring lectures, she never even learned the names of people who participated, and she's a control freak in every sense of the word (she wouldn't even tell us how many questions were on our exam).

I cannot bare to listen to her speak every class and her lectures are exactly as she posts on the in case you missed it at the end of every week, so there's really no reason to attend class. Her lectures bore me to death and I learned the same by just watching her posted lectures online.
reviews.rating_tags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Professor Costello's teaching style is highly ineffective and her attitude towards students is very wrong. 3 exams are 45% of the grade and you will never know why you lost points. I got an A on the class but I will still say this was the worst class I took at Penn State. She makes no exceptions, I had to take my last exam while being sick.

Professor Costello is a very engaging professor and she does her best to explain the legal terms and why they're important. As long as you show up, understand the lectures, and the details of the cases for the unit, the exams are not that bad. At the end of each week, she posts a video explaining what information we learned that week.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Don't understand the negative reviews here. Prof C is passionate about what she teaches and tries to make the content fun. Lectures can get kinda boring tho, 4 exams make up ~80% of your grade; as long as you read the cases, watch review videos, take solid notes, make a good note sheet, you're set for the class. Exams are in the testing center.

lovely professor but tougher class! Exams count for a huge chunk of your grade so u don't wanna mess them up. You get a note sheet but they're in the stressful testing center. Sweet person though and very available / easy to talk to. Great lectures.

10/10 recommend her for this class! Attendance is not mandatory although her lectures are fun & interesting. Grade is mainly exams but she lets u have an entire page of notes and provides videos EVERY WEEK recapping lecture topics which u can watch and take notes on for exam. These videos are amazing & if need be could get u through the whole class

This class was not easy. She actually cared about us though, she really tried. Exams are not easy and are in the testing center. There definitely is a curve because horrible exam grades raise your grade even when you are in the 80s. Old ratings make her out to be mean but she is not, easy to talk to and she wants students to succeed.

Professor Costello is a nice lady. She is passionate about what she teaches and tries to make everything as clear as possible. The tests are pretty easy if you read over the powerpoints and you get to use an index card of notes on all of them. If you show up to class and go to office hours a few times it's pretty easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Loved this class!! Easy A. You can tell that she loves teaching. The only assignments are pretty much a group project you work on throughout the semester where you build an app interface. Every week she provides the groups with very specific feedback. I also loved the guest speakers who presented to our class quite often.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: She was, unfortunately, the worst professor I've had. She was strict in regards to everything and it was just over the top in most cases. She has a really hard time getting to the point and misses the point. Most professors in IST tried to help us during the pandemic and she was the only one that didn't ease up. I feared for my grade all semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Worst Prof at PSU

Professor Costello is one of the worst professors, she makes that class tough even if its a 100 level class for no reason at all. She gets some sense of pride in saying it is tough, not accessible outside of class, grades very very late, and is not flexible with students. To top it off she never creates assignments in the upcoming section of canvas
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Tough grader

reviews.comment: She's a really good professor who really cares about the class, and works really hard to make sure everyone understands the material. Definitely try to take IST 432 with her- you'll learn a lot. The textbook is free and really only necessary for looking at case studies before the exams. The grading is tough but it makes you better.

This professor is hands down one of the worst at psu. Lectures and assignments seem beneficial but don't reflect the material on the exams at all. She reads off her slides and says "kinda sorta" every time she tries to explain something. Attendance not mandatory but she will hate you if you don't go to class and treat you differently.

She was the best professor I had so far! Her class materials are very comprehensive and straightforward. I learned a lot and enjoyed every single assignment as she sincerely gave a feedback to each of them.
Wouldn't recommend this class unless it's required.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Although Prof Costello has the right intentions, in the end, she does NOT deliver her class successfully. This being an entrepreneurship class should promote creativity and out-of-the-box ideas, but the class ends up being very bureaucratic and most assignments are pointless. Costello is super strict and there are mandatory events outside of class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Costello was underwhelming as an instructor. Her homeworks/lectures were clear but extremely broad and never helped guide you towards material that was important for exams and quizzes. On top of that she thinks her class is the only thing that matters. (Your going to have to skip interviews/career fairs if they happen to fall during tests) :/
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--Group projects

reviews.comment: Awesome course and awesome professor, I learned a lot in this class. Megan is super caring and actually wants you to do well, all of the content she posts is straight forward and interesting. She definitely tries really hard to make her content accessible and easily understandable for students. Would recommend!!!
The course content is very up to date, will learn many case laws that are interesting. Tough grader but fair to everyone in class. Participate in many discussions and enjoy the class!

For me so far, Megan is caring and is willing to help her students. She helped me scheduled people to solve my quiz answer disappeared issue. It meant a lot! The lectures are fun, in my opinion, she tried to make it as engaging as possible.

Professor Costello is energetic in class and you can do well if you do all of the reading she assigns which is usually a ton. The main problem with the course is the grading is really harsh especially for exams as there is no partial credit for essay questions and matching. On top of that she really doesn't know the material well either.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: Very nit-picky when it comes to grading. If you miss a tiny thing (even a question mark) yoru grade can be drastically reduced in that category of the rubric. The group project is especially harshly graded, dropping my score an entire letter grade.

She is a tough grader always taking points off. I skipped class a ton because there were in class activities like once every two-three weeks (Which you can miss three without grade-damage) She posts her lectures which is nice. But the group project is drawn out way more than it has to be.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Gives good feedback--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Costello is the toughest grader in IST, if you have a interview for a job and an exam the same day you'll have to skip your interview. She doesn't compromise with anything or anyone. Her lectures are decent though and the material is good. Also she grades extremely tough on the exams she gives.

She is one of the weirdest teachers ever!! She does not hand quizzes back and will not let you hold one if not under her sight. She is super strict unless you take her class online. She grades the rough cut video as if its the final cut, then if you hand anything in late its an automatic 0. Don't think it is an easy A, but it should be as a gen ed!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: I dont recommend this class at all. It is incredibly boring, and you will only learn if you read the copious textbook reading assignments each week. Her grading makes no sense and she refuses to clarify what she want on the group project that makes up a large chunk of grade. Quizzes are super easy and you already know it all before the class starts
She provide detail and clear guidance to class. Many reading/video assignment but help to understand.
She has the most organized and comprehensive course content video collection/library of any of the IST/SRA courses I have taken through World Campus.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: If you have to take SRA111, do not take Costello. The two pros about taking her class are that there's no final exam, and your lowest quiz grade out of 6 throughout the semester gets dropped. When it comes to grading, the criteria are unclear. Even if you clarify them with her, some points are deducted one way or another. Textbook not necessary.

Professor Costello does her absolute best to make class fun and worth coming to. She was able to make the best of some dull content with fun videos and exercises. As an IP Lawyer, her unit on IP was very informative and interesting. Great new professor, I wish I could have had more opportunities to have a class of hers.

Her lectures are heavy on things like patent and copyright law, but she doesn't seem that well versed in the more fundamental aspects of security and risk analysis.  The classes are bland and not very explanatory.  Also, she is not very helpful in providing clear feedback or in some cases even responding to queries at all.

For this class all you have to do is watch her lectures which are fun to see on youtube and are short. She makes everything easily understandable.  You could use her lecture during homework assignments to get it done. I highly recommend taking her for this class. She is amazing and its only week 6 and I still have a A.
Megan is a fair teacher. Do not expect any special treatment for missing class or deadlines. Overall, it was a very enjoyable and informative course.
Won't excuse absences even for interviews, lectures are incredibly dry and not all that insightful, although the websites and tools we used were pretty cool.
Very fair to everyone in class. Material is very up to date. Not an easy class but it is 400 level.

Megan is a new professor so it's understandable that she is not the best professor. Repeats herself a lot and lectures are commonly redundant and dry. She also has a very confusing attendance policy and will excuse University approved absences yet still assign a grade of 0 for any in-class assignments or pop quizzes. Also tries too hard to be funny

Took her SRA-111 online through World Campus. Megan is very fun and engaging. Class was straight forward, it's an easy A if you are good with computers. There were 5 quizzes (you get two chances) and one group project which wasn't bad. If you have a tight schedule and need to take this class online, I would definitely recommend this instructor.
He is very knowledgable and cares. His exams are difficult. A lot of written response questions and for a PLSC class, way too much economics and hypothesis scenarios involved.

Very easy 200-level political science class. Exams in pollock testing center, but online final. Lecture notes posted, weekly Canvas quizzes and exams follow lectures perfectly. Concepts all explained very well and you get 5 free absences.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This class was easy, but boring. There were two exams that were very easy, but covered a lot of content. There were a few easy assignments and one final project that was graded very easily. An easy grade, but boring lectures. Justin is knowledgeable, but often went way too deeply into graphs and figures rather than focusing on content.

So many slides and information to learn, but slides are posted on Canvas. Very lecture-heavy and the class was very boring. Super nice and caring professor just kind of made the lectures boring. Weekly discussions which are super easy and the exams are on canvas and are super easy if you study the slides. Lots of material but easy to get an A.

I really enjoyed this course. Most of the class is participation-based, and him asking the class questions. There is also a ton of reading/research papers that make up this course. If you haven't taken PLSC10 yet, I would not recommend. Professor Crofoot is very kind and wants you to succeed though.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very engaging for a guy who is giving a lecture to 200 people. Very important to show up to class for the participation points.

GO TO CLASS!!! I kept an A all semester and when he put the attendance grade in it dropped to a B, but it was like 9 points, so it's weighted heavy. Over than that class is easy, had him for two classes and both were very easy. make sure to GO TO CLASS
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: He is very understanding and helpful but unorganized. He is fair and will give points back if he feels your grade does not reflect his teaching. The main negative is that he will restructure the course or change assignments last minute if he is behind.
Professor Crofoot was my favorite professor last semester. He is very calm and funny. He is very approachable for help. This class is easy to pass as long as you do the work. All exams are open note.

Really loved his lectures. Attendence was mandatory, really improved grade if you went every time. Gives you a study guide you can complete for extra credit before the exams. The exams are online on canvas. 100% would recommend taking him.

Easy class, all assignments online. Only complaint is lectures are long and late in the day. Never bought the required textbook because all the material was on the slides. Exams were online instead of pollock this semester which was nice. He does do tophat questions for attendance throughout class. Good professor and very passionate ab the class.

Gets along with students well as a younger professor - gives really good analogies on various topics to help understand some of the more difficult things we learn in class. All assignments, including tests, are online. Very personable as well and gets back to emails quickly.

This isn't hard class and the exams are online. He gives a lot of extra points. only thing is that attendance is graded so it can help boost your grade, learn from me and go to class because if I had went my grade would be higher, so take those easy points.

I enjoyed PLSC1 so much,I decided to take another PolySci course with Dr. Crofoot next semester. If you read the textbook and attend lectures, there is no way you will not do well in this class. You are graded by weekly quizzes and three exams, all online. His lectures are also all posted ,easy to follow, and he always tries to keep you engaged.

I really enjoyed Dr Crofoot he's very charismatic which helps lectures be less boring. He uses top hat for attendance so make sure you show up because it is a very good grade booster and also gives extra credit everytime we have an exam. He posts all the lecture notes on canvas as they are a lot of information. Exams aren't too hard if you study.

He's a really nice person. He allows notes while taking the exams and provides study guides that helped me so much. Some lectures were long and boring, and sometimes attendance was taken by writing your name down on paper and participating in an activity. His TA was NOT a sufficient grader, but when he graded he gave great feedback.

You don't need to take notes he gives slides that have everything you need to know for tests, don't bother buying the textbook. He also gives numerous extra credit assignments that boost your grade tremendously. Best professor for polysci, if you like politics then you'll be motivated to study for this class. Only study his slides, do extra credits

Prof. Crofoot is a good guy. He takes the time to get to know his students and answer their needs. I think his class is totally fair in terms of the amount of material and the time it takes to complete his assignments. The tests can be a little tricky but he allowed a page of notes which is a huge help. The final is open-note which helps too.
He is a great professor and very helpful, but his exams are way too difficult.

This professor was super new. The class consists of lectures, quizzes, and exams. A basic level course, but the exams are very hard. I'm a senior and I took this class and there was no way I was getting anything above a C in this class because of the exams. Be ready to go to Pollock to take the exam or just take it with another professor.

Prof. Corfoot is super caring and a funny guy. the lectures were interesting but 2 days a week the 75min lectures felt very long. he used tophats as attendance, and there was extra credit for it at the end of the semester. the exams weren't horrible and if you do a study guide for it and submit it you could get 5 points extra credit on the exam

Very sweet guy. Caring and wants everyone to pass. The class is basically a history class, lots of note taking and reading. He gives extra credit and study guides, which is nice. If you don't take notes or study a copious amount before an exam, you won't pass. Attendance definitely mandatory.

He was a great professor that I would take again. Great lecture slides and helpful study guides. Extra credit is everywhere, so it is easy to bump your grade up. The tests can be challenging, so look over all the quizzes and review slides.

This was a great class, Professor Crofoot offered a lot of extra credit, and the class was graded on 3 exams, 2 article reaction papers, and easy weekly online quizzes that were due by 11:59 pm every Friday. The exams were multiple choice only and while they were a little tough, nothing about them was unfair. One of my fave 400 lvl PLSC classes :)
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: any bad reviews for this class are from people who didn't put any work into the class. lectures felt long, but you get a ton of extra credit just for showing up to every class. tests aren't the easiest but you should be fine as long as you review the lectures and quizzes- the amount of extra credit provided makes up for it. not a bad class at all.

I really liked this class! The class is reading and lecture heavy but it is definitely one of the easiest 400-level classes I've taken at Penn State. Dr. Crofoot is very kind, funny, and I think has excellent potential to be a great professor.

Don't listen to the negative comments, too many inexperienced freshmen thought this class would be an easy A like high school. Expect 1-2 hours of work a week. Overall easy class, with plenty of EC available as well as EC for attending class! Exams are challenging (Average in high 60s) but if you read the textbook and review, it should be a breeze.

Crofoot is an awesome professor. He is very knowledgeable in Politcal Science. I found him to be very funny during our lectures. He gives so much extra credit! Political Science is a tough subject as is. Just do the readings and review your notes after class and do the exam study guides and you should be fine. Very easy going guy.

Professor Crofoot was very nice, and this was his first semester at PSU, but the exams were extremely difficult with averages in the lower 60s on each one. He did curve them a bit, but not nearly as much as he should have. MAKE SURE YOU DO THE EXTRA CREDIT. It can raise your grade by 4-6%. Also, make sure you attend class because he does use Tophat
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Crofoot is a really nice guy! This is his first year teaching at Penn State, so I give the guy a lot of slack. He really tries his best to make the lectures enjoyable, but sometimes they can be quite boring. The tests suck and have nothing to do with much of the long lectures. Just do the extra credit and you should be fine!

He's a great guy and explains the content well. Since this was his first year he didn't make the best tests. They are incredibly hard even for someone who took 3 AP history classes. However, he offers a copious amount of extra credit. At the time of writing (pre-final,) I have a 102% in the class.
this was the worst class to take my first semester as a freshman. do yourself a favor and find either a better professor who teaches the same course or just don't take this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Great teacher and pretty easy test. Would definitely take again. Very easy-going guy.

It's his first year teaching as a professor. He tries his best to connect the content to the students though unfortunately he doesn't succeed at this. His lectures can be boring. Sometimes he is reading off of the slides  The TA's are there present but they don't offer much help. He has charisma and does make the class laugh. Textbook is "required"

Do not take this class. He is an awful professor. If you think you are going to get anything above 70% on the test, think again. He is just not great, not enough extra credit points to make up the horrible test grades. Never takes accountably for his horrible tests even though the average is super low. Mega Gaslighter. Beware.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Makes the tests very hard and with little to none of the material that he has presented in class. You need to read the book despite him never telling you to. Attendance isn't completely mandatory though he does do top hat. I think he has the potential to be a good teacher someday, as long as he starts to take accountability for his actions.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I will never forget the final lecture; the class was packed to the brim. Some people even sat on the aisle. After his lecture, I went to meet him while everyone applauded him. I don't remember what i said to him while I shook his hand but I remember that I was in tears. His stories were deep, life-changing and perspective-shifting.
Most entertaining story teller I have ever listened to. Class really prepares your for life, not just prepares you for a test like other classes.
For all of you who never got to have this man as a professor in your life.... Remember the Buffalo
The Mr Feeny of Penn STate

Best professor PSU had to offer! I graduated years and years ago, but his class is the only one I remember. Amazing man who taught me more in 1 semester that all the other classes I took at PSU combined.

Frank is a wonderful man. He taught the way teachers SHOULD be teaching--life lessons instead of copying from a book. He made me think about things that I will continue to think about and tell my kids to think about. He definitely influenced what I see as important in the world today. Thanks Frank!

I will remember Frank's lessons for the rest of my life. I often tell Frank's stories to my friends that don't even go to Penn State. He is the best professor I have ever had. During his annual last lecture, you'd look around a room of 1000 people and not a single dry eye.
love frankie... makes you think... its like listening to a good movie

One of the best, if not the best class taught at PSU. He teaches real life lessons, and not random data you'll never use. Sad to see him retire, but he said he'll be around somewhere on campus next semester.
Taught things about life that you never expected to learn in a class.  He wasn't afraid to say what he felt needed to be said.  Best Professor Penn State offered... we'll miss you Prof Clemente!!!
Amazing Prof. Best class I took at PSU.

I graduated in 2003 and I still speak often of this class and Frankie Clemente.  He teaches lesson that you would never expect to learn from a class.  The class is fun and many people sit in to listen even if they are not taking the class.  It's definitely worth taking!  One of the best classes at PSU when taught by Clemente, if not the best.

Best and most interesting professor at PSU.  By far the best class that I have ever taken.  If you don't take this class, you will be seriously missing out.  Of course attendance isnt mandatory, but you will want to go.

TAKE THIS CLASS. I was a freshmen and stalked my way into it this year, best idea ever. He's only teaching one more semester (for real this time) so just keeping watching everyday until you get in. The class is amazing and you actually want to show up for it. Frankie is by far the best prof here at penn sate.
The best professor I have had.  Do not leave Penn State without taking his class..unless he retires...then you missed out..

This is one of the best classes anyone can take.  People say he brags about his life, when in reality, he tells his own stories so that students can both relate and learn from his experiences.  He is a wonderful professor and person, don't leave PSU without taking it!!
Can't really add anything to what other have said.  Bottom line, his class should be required.  TAKE IT! Point blank period.

I would love to know the majors of whoever gave this a 1 easiness. I doubt they finished their degree at Penn State. Frankie is the man, very motivating & uplifting class. Listen to his stories & don't worry about taking notes. It is a joke of a class, an easy A, but most people take some life lessons from it. Don't be fooled by the failing idiots!

I should have gone to class.  I only went about six times, total (including for exams).  Now I'm kicking myself.  Some of the things he said might just have changed my life.  Don't make the mistake I did and skip class.  And grades?  You'll get an A.  Just go.

He is the best professor in the world. I can only aspire to be half as good a man as he is. His life is unbelievable and his stories and lectures will change your life forever. Take this class, you will not regret it.

Most amazing class- i have never enjoyed going to class so much this is a class everyone should be required to take at Penn State because it is so helpful in the long run-i recommend every person take this class- attendance is not mandatory but you are going to want to go to every class trust me- best class ever

this is THE best class you will ever take. frank clemente is the most inspiring human being i have ever come across. he is teaching again fall 2010.. TAKE HIM!!! it will be worth your while, and your grade in the class will not even be a concern

Frankie is the man. I never felt that I was actually in class, just going to listen to some great stories a couple of times a week. The exams test the stories he tells in class, some statistics, and some vocab terms. There are also two papers graded by the TAs. Go to class and he might just give you a new perspective on some things in life.
Felt moved after class.
BEST CLASS. you must take it, it teaches you life as it is. makes you become more positive and more understanding of people.
Great guy, great class, but I have no idea what to expect on the tests? What do they cover, etc? Similar inquiries regarding the essays.

Fall '09 is his last semester so take him NOW!! Professor Clemente is amazing! You'll never want to miss a class! Frankie's not like other professors-he's understanding and respects that you have a life outside of his class which at times is more important than school. He's a real person, not just some guy who talks at you and gives you a grade.

I laugh when I see people complain about how hard the tests are - odds are, they probably failed out of PSU. You must be a moron not to get an A in Frankie's class.  And in reality, you can be a moron and still get an A.  The only skill you need is listening and if you don't have that, you will fail at life. Do yourself a favor and take this class.
best class ever!!

I loved this class. I took it out of recommendation of a friend and wish I could go back. This is one of those classes and one of those professors that will change your life. It changed mine and helped me get a better perspective on life. He truly is my favorite professor and someone i'll remember for the rest of my life.

Frank Clemente is an amazing, inspiring man, and I feel so lucky and honored to have been in his class and to have heard what he had to say. Soc 005 was the best course I've ever taken, and I learned the most valuable lessons from him. He inspired me and changed me, and I'll never forget him or his class. Don't leave Penn State without taking it!

The most inspirational professor I have ever met. It was a shame that I could not make many of his classes due to family problems, but he was very understanding and I still received a good grade. This is a class that must be taken before you graduate. It doesn't teach things that you can learn from a text book. Learn about the beauty of life.
Best Class I have ever taken. You need to take it before you graduate!

He is fantastic! I never had a professor as good as this man. I am honored to be in his class and he truly tells life how it is. I enjoyed hearing about the things he went through in his life and it's unbelievable. I don't know how he did it. He is a very inspirational man. Thank you Frank Clemente!

You will learn things in this class that they don't teach in "academia".  Very interesting and he really puts life in perspective.  If u get a bad grade u should be hit in the head with a tac hammer b/c you are a moron

One of the greatest classes taught by one of the greatest professors I have ever had in my entire life. Clemente is awesome. If you have the chance to take this class and you don't, then you're a moron.
great story teller although the information and morals he delivers are far less insightful than he thinks.  class is not to be taken seriously.  A monkey could get an A in this class.
i love him. says he is going to retire but when doesn't he say that? go to class... it will change your life.
Best Professor alive! I learned more in his "storytelling class" then I learned in my past two years of college combined. Simply easy but life changing.
Favorite teacher ever!!! This was the best class I have ever taken!!
Easy Class and super nice. Lots of extra credit.  Its an entertaining class, but if you're busy just buy nittany notes and do the EC and you will get an A.

Great and caring professor.  Loves to teach and loves all of his students.  He teaches based on experiences, so you don't ever use any textbook.  Class is extremely easy and he DOES offer extra credit that is worth a lot.  15 points just for giving blood, 5 to talk to a grandparent for v-day, and 8 for a survey.So 28 EC pts (and 260 regular points)

Obviously you guys that are complaining are just slackers and never go to the class...this guy is amazing absolutely love going to his class, listening to his stories, it just makes my day everyday...should def. take his class only teaching one more semester in the fall of '09

Good guy,but Im a little confused about his grading methods.He has his TA's(which are complete jerks by the way)grade the papers.I dont know about anyone else,but I have a problem with someone with no teaching experience who is my age grading my work.A woman in my class recieved a failing grade from her TA.Clemente re-graded it and she got an A.
The EC is 15 points on your FINAL grade, not 15 points tacked onto a test grade... At least that's what he told me.

Please wait until AFTER a semester to comment on how hard his class is.  You can have a 77 average and as long as you give blood during the semester you will come away with an A.  I don't know about you, but that sounds incredibly easy to me.  Also, Nittany Notes are great for this class.

Clemente likes to brag about himself and act like his class is so much special than the rest offered at Penn State.Newsflash.It isn't.This class only proves furthermore that grades are the only thing that teachers care about.This class is far from easy.Frank is nice to listen to,but his tests are impossible and thats the only thing ur graded on.

I must say that i agree with the rater below.This class isn't as easy as it is hyped up to be.Clemente claims that his class s the easiest class on campus.LIE!For a guy who sas every class that he doen't care about grade,He sure gives a lot of tests,and theyr'e hard too.Tests are basically about his life.Only take if you want a bad grade.

This is the best class I've ever taken!!!  I look forward to lecture all week!  He is an amazing professor and an even more amazing person!  TAKE THIS CLASS... I have learned more memorable things in this class than in all other classes combined.

Frank is the coolest guy ever. This is the kind of guy that you would want to sit down and drink some beers and just talk to him. His stories are great and each has a lesson to be learned. This class is like something i would watch on tv and love it. Take this class!
Fabulous instructor, teacher, and human being!  His class will teach you more than anything else in undergrad.

This Prof. changed my life. Class was like sitting on your grandfather's lap and listening to all his extravagant adventures. Clemente was an inspiration, a solid guy and an example of what a good educator is.
AWESOME
A class you'd get up at 8am for.
To put it simply, Clemente changed my life.

This class is awesome and I would recommend taking it. No attendance, no final. Most of the questions on the exams are from the stories he tells and they are very interesting. This was one of my favorite classes and it's easy. Take it if you can

He was awesome!!!!  This teacher has so much heart. He wants you to do well.  His stories teach you the material in a way that you can relate to everything - funny too!  He will test you on names of people, etc so pay attention.  If you go to class and listen, take notes.., you will do well.  He is, by far, one of the best teachers I have ever had!

the best class i have ever taken, ridiculously hard to get into he is coming back for fall '08 so try IMMEDIATLEY!!! and if you don't get in right away keep trying every day i'm sure you'll be able to or even email him--he is the NICEST man ever! BEST CLASS AND PROF AT PSU!!!!

Well, he is teaching again next fall so reserve your seats now..seriously, this man can change your life if you let him. You will not want to miss a class. The last class it was horrible outside and still the place was filled.

That standing ovation was really something, and how about the fact that over 100 people stood outside the class 25 minutes before it even started? AND the class wasn't even required since the final was already taken. This class is NOT a waste of your time and money.  In fact, it will be one of the most important classes you every take. Period.

Have you ever given one of your teachers a proud standing ovation at the end of a lecture? You will with Professor Clemente. His lectures are motivational, touching, & inspirational. Soc 5 is an easy class (he says so himself), but the purpose is to build yourself in addition to your perspective. I wish all my teachers were like Professor Clemente.

Frank is pretty much everything you could want out of a professor and a human being... he trusts his students and is even willing to write letters of recommendation for any of them even though his classes have hundreds of people in them.  he is thinking about coming back fall '08; if he does, definately take soc 5!
Clemente has amazing stories, that relate to life so much. Taking it as a freshman gives me such a head start because I get the advantage of hearing his wisdom before I head off to the real world!
Best prof. ever!  Changed my life for the better, Prof. Clemente is by far the greatest person I have ever met, and it would be a shame if he decided not to teach again.
We love Frankie!  We're reevaluating our lives because of his class.  The best class that you'll ever have at Penn State.

Excellent professor! Funny! Great stories, but listen very carefully to his stories because they are always on his tests.  Show up everyday, you are bound to pass the class and atleast he is interesting!

Very easy class, that is the reason there is very high enrollment in Clemente's class.  However, if you are interested in actual learning I suggest you invest your hard earned money in a more useful class.
What a waste of time, the lessons Clemente teaches should already be learned by now, and should not be life changing.  For entertainment value only.
He is understanding and kind, I wish i could take his class every semester

This Professor is just wonderful. Probably the only FULL professor you will get to see on this campus. He will make you crave the next class. I cant say enough about him. Take this class if you are lucky enough to have the opportunity!
the best teacher i have ever had

He is the most amazing prof you will ever have.  He is very inspirational and I know that if I accomplish just half of the things that he did it my lifetime, I will be satisfied.  He makes you want to attend every class and his lectures gave me chills!  Very easy to get an A and tons of exra credit is available but not even needed!

I know Frankie's not teaching the fall (I think he is in the spring) but get into this class. Plain and simple. Yea it's easy by just reading a little and Nittany Notes, but it's cool to just listen to the guy talk. He probably won't change your life, but to see life from the perspective of someone who's gone through it all was worth every class.

Yes it is easy. However, there is nothing in his lectures that will better prepare me for the real world that I didn't already know.  Life lessons are better learned by experience rather than in lecture. If you need this class to know  not leave a friend behind than it will be good class for you.
This man is amazing! There isnt a class that will give you more useful information for your life. I get chills just listening to him speak!
great class, great guy, you should have this class if you go to psu no matter what

I took this class hoping it would be amazingly easy. It absolutely was correct. Not only that but its very interesting. I didn't buy the book or go to class often and my test scores weren't fantastic. Somehow I got an A anyway.... all I can say is... THANKS FRANKIE!
He is the man bceuse he thinks of his students as people not as subordinates.

prg clemente is awesome. i loved this class. it was so easy and interesting. he didn't just teach book content, he really talked about life lessons. it was the best class i could have taken during my last semester at college, as i go off into the real world.
Great class and great teacher. grades dont mean anything to him, he just focuses on the students really which is cool. take this class

This class was very interesting and rewarding.  Its a class that means more in your life than in academics.  You will certainly learn alot.  Take it now!!  Fall 2006 is potentially his last semester teaching.

Clemente is the man.  His stories are interesting and you will definately want to go to class.  I didn't take a single note the entire class but with Nittany notes it was an easy A.  Easily the best professor at PSU.  Believe the hype.
Your Penn State experience is incomplete without Frank Clemente's Soc 5! Amazing man.

The class is a very good at relating things to real life situations. It's designed to make you think about where you stand on a lot of different social issues. The stories are great and I encourage everybody to take this class.

Clemente is awesome! He is a great teacher and I couldn't have skipped a single class. He taught me so much and my penn state experience wouldn't have been the same without him. By far one of the best teachers I have ever had. Every student should take it.
Very fun and easy.

his presence and ability to lecture important issues in life cant be matched. Graduating 5 yrs ago from penn state, I distinctly remember most of his remarkable lectures. If personally, you have problems then this class will really get you to think on a relative scale about human nature. This guy cant be matched
He tells you everything you need to know in life...I wish I could take it again. So very entertaining, you will WANT to go to class.
Awesome guy!  Great teaching method....very entertaining.  My favorite class at Penn State by far.  Everyone should take Soc. 005 by Clemente.

Finally in my senior year I was able to get into this class. By far the best class I have attended in my life. I learned more in this class then I ever will. Who knew you could have so much respect in a person as I do for Clemente. This guy is the man. Great teacher, great class.

By far, the best class I've ever taken at PSU.  Clemente should be awarded.  Students actually WANT to go to his lectures.  His stories are life-changing and emotional.  I found myself on the verge of tears a few times, literally!  If you go to class and read the pages he tells you to, tests are cake; 2 easy 2-page papers; and extra credit! TAKE IT
Great class, listen to everybody else here and take it

I've never had a professor who has made such an impact in my life. The stories he tells you are ones that you can relate to your own life and relate to. Take this class, not for the easy A but to figure out what type of person you want to be and how you want to live your life.

The best class i've ever taken.  Dr. Clemente really works to help put things in perspective for us with his stories and simple nature.  You'll always want to come to class and just listen to what he has to say. His stories helped me to realize that everyday really does count . . . not just what we do after penn state.

Excellent and caring professor.  Tells great stories and really has a passion for what he is doing.  Tests can be a little bit trickier than what he makes them out to be, but get the Nittany Notes and read the book (look for small details!) and you will be fine.
most unbelievable teacher...made everyday worth going to.
Not only was this the best, most interesting class I ever took, but he also helped me get into Graduate School........Best professor ever

Great class, easy to get an A, and overall a great experience. Take this if you can.
He tells stories about his life the entire time.  They are interesting and make you want to come to class and make you think about your life.  Good class
