reviews.comment: Attendance every day, no tolerance for being a min late. Grades extremely harshly (got a worse grade on assignment after making changes she asked me to?). Should teach kids (makes us take turns reading paragraphs out loud in class and demanding we put our phones away). Runs thru lectures too fast and has little regard for people falling behind.

Danielle was really good with how she taught the concepts in R SOC 011. To some it may seem like a lot of work, but it may be simply because she grades you in different ways other than tests such as papers, group projects, quizzes and even extra credit and help with the final. If you have questions about projects, just go to office hours! Very nice
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--GROUP PROJECTS

reviews.comment: She is an incredibly smart woman who will give you an A if you put in the work. Every assignment was extremely straight forward and well explained. Her lectures were interesting and she is so passionate about the material. If you respect her, she will respect you. You just have to read the articles and participate.

Way too much work for a 0-level class (more work than in my 300-400level classes). Professor is not helpful at all. Constant group work in almost every class. Slides are not posted online and she rarely actually lectures, so it is hard to learn anything. The only good thing was the multiple choice was pulled from weekly quizzes.

Dr. D is genuinely the best professor I've ever had. She's the nicest lady and is so incredibly knowledgeable. I've learned so much from her in 5 weeks and wish she could teach all of 101. Her lecture notes are very helpful and easy to follow. Show up, pay attention, take good notes- you'll be fine. She explains everything so well. She's the best!!
She is very interesting to listen to and is engaging during class. She genuinely wants her students to do well. 10/10
Love her sm

She is absolutely amazing. Clear expectations and explains concepts so well. 3 take home quizzes and 1 exam. I studied my butt off and the exam was still difficult, so study A LOT, dont ignore hard material, and do all of the practice quizzes (they're many of the exam questions) Excellent professor, but you def need to put in the work to do well.
She has an amazing personality and is easy to understand. The material is a little difficult but she always explains concepts.
Love this women!! She deeply cares about her students and understands what it's like to have struggles. She will work with you to overcome anything!

I enjoyed Dr. De Souza for 101, but not so much for 454. She is very kind and absolutely loves the material for this class. If you like the Female Athlete Triad, then you will like this class. Overall, I personally didnt find the information to be my favorite topic ever. There are 3 exams as well as a few projects and the expectations are clear.

Dr. De Souza was my favorite prof this semester. She is very personable and makes her lectures very enjoyable. She went out of her way to form relationships with us through zoom and worked hard to help us succeed. I'll miss her class but look forward to taking her again for KINES 350.
Good professor with easy to follow lectures slides and a clear care for the success of her students

Prof De Souza is an amazing prof! She's a fantastic teacher and you can tell that she really cares about her students. Definitely one of my favourite lecturers. We had a great chat about tennis after one of her lectures and she was so lovely! haha

My favorite professor of the semester! Lectures are interesting and easy to understand. You have to go to class because clicker questions are for attendance. I looked forward to going to this class. You can tell she genuinely cares about all her students and wants everyone to succeed in the class.
She's a great teacher but her exam included very specific things. You need to study up to the exam and not wait until the last minute. She is super passionate and care about her students.

She was good at teaching her portion of Kines 101. She cared about our success, especially the iclicker questions. Her test was a lot harder than we expected because it had more specific details than we expected. To do well in her section, you should keep up with the materials and don't cram. She is passionate about what she teaches.

Dr. De Souza is an amazing professor! She makes sure all of her students know just how much they are cared for. She treats her students like they are her own children. She is very clear when she is teaching. Definitely looking forward to taking Kines 350 with her!
One of my favorite professors. Is very clear on what she wants you to learn and memorize for her exam. Attendance is mandatory due to clicker points

Great prof.  Super engaging and very knowledgeable.  Really makes class enjoyable.  Her section is probably the easiest of the 3, but you still have to put in time and effort.  Show up to class and fill in the notes and you'll manage.

Quizzes on canvas but were easy to find answers on quizlet. Lectures were interesting and filled in the powerpoint blanks during class. Did clicker questions that were easy and counted as attendance. Exam was about 90 questions. Pretty difficult. consisted of all multiple choice and T/F. She had to bump up everyones exam grade by 5 points.

Dr. De Souza is amazing. She genuinely cares about what she is teaching as well as how the students understand it. Her lectures are amazing, she explains everything so in depth and if you go to her she will do everything to help you understand the material.
Great teacher who really makes lectures interesting. You can tell she really cares about what she is teaching and is very helpful.

Great class really interesting. Guy is really a funny character and makes course really enjoyable. Do need to study and there are pop quizzes but they're used more as to track attendance than a graded assignment.

Nice guy, but the class is extremely frustrating. Lectures are unorganized and mostly rambling, and they do not prepare you for the exams at all. You are expected to teach yourself nearly everything, and communication and expectations feel inconsistent. Overall, not a reliable or effective learning experience.

One of the worst experiences I've had with a professor at Penn State. The lectures are very surface level, but the exams are much more in depth. There is no textbook, and no materials posted to canvas. If you want to do well you will have to do a lot of work on your own time. Figuring out how to do the problem sets will help you on exams.
Great guy, horrible professor. Covers the basics of the material, then tests you on super advanced stuff that you never really learned how to do.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Interesting lectures, tough exams, sort of hard homeworks and labs. Clicker questions help your grade.

Great guy! Very funny, very helpful and wants his students to do well. Homeworks and clickers boost your grade BIG TIME so be sure to do well on those! Im not a fan of genetics but I really did enjoy his class because hes such a character! =D
Hates his students and does not want them to pass his class, last 2 midterms are impossible and he offers no help, all you can do is pray

There is no way to avoid taking 305 with him. he will not answer emails or work with students. there is no practice exam. there is no hope. there is no help. it is randomly decided each semester if he curves a whole letter grade or none at all. it is the worst class possible and he is a meanie and doesn't care if his student is a vet :(

One of the most frustrating professors I've had. Midterm 2 and Final are very hard, and little to no test prep questions are given. Labs are graded fairly easily. Do well on the first midterm so you can cruise the rest of the course. Lecture is just him reading off of the slides.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Ed is the epitome of tenured professors in America: doesn't care for his students, rude and disrespectful, can't teach, and has his TA's do everything. Literally impossible to get an A. Labs are graded fairly easily (By the TA), and the exams are impossible, even if he gave you the exam a week prior. pray.

He's by far the worst teacher I've ever, including grade school. I stopped attending lectures after week 5 because I didn't learn a single thing. He just reads off slides. Over half your grade is labs, which get increasingly more difficult and eventually require Excel and/or MATLAB. There is a nice curve at the end. Midterm averages were 68 and 45.

This professor is intelligent, but cannot clearly explain his lecture to students. I learned more from the labs than the actual lectures. He also takes a long time to explain each slide during lectures, so everything gets repetitive and monotone.

I would HIGHLY recommend focusing on the labs which are the largest percentage of your grade. The only good thing about this professor is he gives a great curve at the end.

The class is not easy at all, but if you watch the lectures and show up to office hours, it will become manageable, many have different opinions on him, but I came into this course scare and gave my all, and walked into the final needing almost nothing to pass. He curves the final grade and his TAs are amazing.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Avoid him at all costs, if I could find this class elsewhere I would pay top dollar to do so. Projects are the same except last year they were all group projects(the students still struggled)but this year he made them individual which is 10000x worse. Nothing is understandable and the feedback is terrible. Matlab is used but you arent taught that.

This was a really hard class. Matlab is not a pre req for the class but was used for most of the Lab assignments.  The tests were impossible the averages were very low. The lectures were very boring and hard to understand. Extensive use of powerpoint presentations. Gave a huge curve at the end because everyone in the class was doing so poorly.

Demeter is smart but can't teach. In addition to not having clear grading or helpful comments, the entire class noticed he was using all his PowerPoints from 306 for our 305 class. The PowerPoint slides he presented were impossible to understand, and he gave no textbook, just the one the extra credit was meant to come from (which there was none).

reviews.comment: Dr. D was a terrible professor this semester. He promised extra credit opportunities due to him being "known for hard exams", but they never happened because he didn't have time to make the assignments. Additionally the exams were incredibly hard and unclear what one could do to prepare and grading on labs was harsh with no rubric provided. Beware.

Dr. D did not do a good job teaching this class. 

He did not follow the syllabus, there was a 10% extra-credit project grade that he never mentioned.  

His lectures were impossible to follow, and his exams were impossible. 

Grading was horrible, didn't get the grades of exam 2 before the final, so we did not know what grade we needed to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. D is incredibly smart, but his lectures and labs are very hard to understand. He's not good at communicating information at a level students can grasp, and you'll have to spend hours going over the lecture slides and translating them into human-level English. Labs and exams are relatively doable, just start studying/working at least a week out.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: His lectures are basically useless. The tests are nearly impossible to study for because he gives you no resources so you basically need to memorize everything. Labs were very time-consuming every week but the office hours with the TA were helpful and the only reason I passed the class. Avoid taking at all costs

Eddie Demeter (yes I respect him so little as to say first name) may not be the worst prof I've had but he's still awful. He is as abrasive as they come, gives pretty terrible feedback, and grades as if the department will discredit him if he gives above an A.

The guy is a good prof, an expert in the field and could talk for DAYS about machining and tool wear. He makes you work HARD for your grade; few but tough homework, WEEKLY group lab report which can suck if you dont have a good group. This class will keep you BUSY and in my opinion is not worth the trouble if you dont plan to follow a career in it.
Boring lecture, couldnt figure out that half the class had the exam before hand and did nothing about it.  Lots of HW

Not an entertaining class at all. All exams you are allowed to have some note sheets though so that helps but they are difficult. The exams are the same from semester to semester so if you could get your hands on one that would be ideal.

DeMeter is a knowledgeable guy but the way he presents material is awfully dull. What makes his class hard is the course structure. Instructions for labs and assignments are vague and DeMeter doesn't give two poos. Is the curve for this class even significant? Oh and don't copy old labs word for word, dudes got a "turn-it-in type" program.
I came in hating this class because of the bad word of mouth people had about him, but I came out having learned a lot. Take it with him if you want to actually learn something in your life.

Worst teacher ever!!!!!!!!!!!! GD&T was not taught and it was the most important concept in the course. Dude had us watching self help videos and gave us ridiculous amounts of hw; hw based on GD&T concepts of course. IE 312 is terrible, luckily he curves at the end.

Not as bad of a prof as the reviews here will lead you to believe. He will make you work in IE 306, but if you put in the effort for the group lab reports, you will come out of this class fine. Don't take the class if you're going to slack though.

He has really improved as a teacher.  He will make you work for your grade, but he will make sure everyone knows what is going on before he continues in his small classes.  During office hours when you ask a question, he may look at you like your crazy, but will answer you thoroughly.  I took this course because I needed to, but I really enjoyed it
I really can't dignify this guy by calling him a professor... he sucks and everybody who has ever had him says he sucks... keep away from him if at all possible!!
the worst teacher i have ever had in my life.. the first guy assigning hw thats due in 2 days. and another on the same due date which is due in 3 days.. perfect torturer.. WORST WORST WORST EVER!
No Comments
worst teacher possible for ME54.  Every class period was pure torture

Used a test from another teacher the semester before.  Half the class had access to the old exam and half the class didn't so the curve on the exam was thrown off.  There was a huge deviation in grades with 18 100s.  The avg. was 70! Can you say unfair&#6

Great professor, really knows his stuff. I've taken 2 classes with him and really enjoyed them. He goes above and beyond to help with extra time to complete tasks. If you just show up and do the bare minimum, expect a bad grade. But if you're committed and complete the tasks, you'll really enjoy the course.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: An effective applied GenAI professor provides engaging explanations and hands-on projects, using n8n automation and coding practice for real-world applications. Despite the initial challenge of token costs, the course was effective. Numerous group tasks and quizzes require regular attendance in class.
Prof Singh is kind, but he didn't seem to understand how the technology worked, which was very frustrating. This class was very confusing for a freshmen seminar.

He does have a heavy accent but uses captions. Easy class you do have to come for the quiz codes. I wouldn't recommend because he's  not easy to understand which causes many misunderstandings. Group work is the final

This is one of the GenAI courses that has taught me the most. Lectures are well-organized and easy to understand. The only thing that worries me is the grading. It's harder than other classes, and there are so many assignments that it can be hard to keep up with. Even so, I learned a lot.
He is the worst professor I've ever had to take a class with a Pennstate. He should be fired
Please ask yourself if you love yourself.

I want to give a serious warning that this may be the worst class you take. The professor is unclear on assignments, changes rubrics and instructions after work is submitted, and behaves unprofessionally. The workload is heavy and constant. The syllabus is not followed and we were required to buy materials that weren't listed at the start.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: It's clear that he's very intelligent but not every intelligent person should be a teacher, in this case it applies. His lectures don't help with the assignments and he assigns a ton of stuff with them all being due the same day. It's really stressful because the assignments can be quite time consuming and he is not clear with his instructions.
Avoid if you can, grading is very confusing, categorization makes no sense, assignments are entirely self taught.
DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASS!

Do yourself a favor and do not take this professor. There are like 4 assignments due every week with multiple sub parts and the problem is both the professor and the assignment are not clear. The assignment instructions are very vague and also he barely teaches anything

The worst professor/ teacher/ class I have EVER had. Teacher doesn't know what's going on and neither will you. Grades assignments 4 weeks late. Can barely understand his English. Minimum 2 projects a week with multiple assignments inside each one. TA runs the class and also barely knows what's going on. Worst class ever. He should be fired.

He is not prepared whatsoever; most assignments are given the day of class, likely an hour prior. This includes quizzes as well. He's also a big fan of assigning 3-5 assignments on Thursday, with half of them due the same day and the others due on Sunday.
If you like to get your work done ahead of time or prepare for class at all, he's not for you.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: The class was run by the TA's who had an attitude or would ignore you if you had questions. The professor barely contributed anything to the class and when he did, it was an AI chatbot to help us with our projects instead of him helping his students out. I would not recommend this class to anyone if you have no previous experience with web dev.

Basically a group project that is graded by the TAs. If your group decides to stop contributing you will get screwed and the Professor does not give grace. If you are confused there is not much help provided.

This professor doesn't actually contribute anything to the class. The TA's run the class and they are ill experienced at it. The lectures give basic knowledge that don't align with what the projects are asking for. You have to do alot of your own research to be successful. Grading is inconsistent. I wouldn't recommend this class to anyone.

Lectures are just presentation slides. Try memorize them to do good on exams. It was not fun we have to do class activities, but end up being extra credit according to the final week announcement. The LAs led some of the class assignments. Learn to make different diagrams, will help on the group project & exam.
There is no final exam in the class. All the assignments are easy and easily graded. Also, there are good group activities during the class. It's super fun to be in there and I'd take it again.

The course is very easy as there's no finals and only a final project. The professor is very good and doesn't grade strictly so study a bit and you'll definitely get an A or A-
Would definitely recommend him!
The best professor! Would definitely recommend again
Easy subject. No exams and there's  only a final project
easy class to take and no quizzes. only group activities
No quizzes and interesting lectures. Would advise to take him 100%

Online lecture videos only teach basics and not any of the actual skills. Could never grade assignments right, and didn't fix and of their own mistakes. Final assignments came out of nowhere, with instruction in random announcements and not the actual assignments. You'll get a good grade if you can code, but you will lose your sanity.

I took IST 420 with him. Dhananjay is a nice guy, and he's relaxed about deadlines if you reach out in advance. However, the class had no structure, and the material had to be learned outside of class. The exams were interesting to say the least. They were easy questions but graded very harshly. I wouldn't take him again.

Disorganized and rarely taught anything. Lectures consisted of basic explanations of concepts and lecture tasks with confusing directions. I had to learn everything on my own outside of class. Assignments were easy, but do not take if you want to learn.

Not good lector, you have to learn by yourself after class. Accent is hard to understand. If class is confused by an assignment he posts the answers instead of teaching. Easy class and grader, but don't take him if you want to learn.
Great Professor! Take him in the spring! He likes to help students and give out opportunities.

Most lenient professor at Smeal. For Spring 2021, he regraded the first exam, held an attendance policy that only required students to show cameras for the first 5 minutes of lecture, and was always accessible for content and simulation questions. Read the textbook and complete classwork and homework after. Study a few days before exams for math.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Professor Dhanorkar is a great professor. He is super laid back and cares about all students. His lectures in class can be hard to pay attention to but the homeworks/classworks/exams aren't bad at all. Overall he's a really good Supply Chain professor and I'd definitely take him again.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Suvrat Dhanorkar is the best SCM professor I have seen in PSU. He makes the lecture very clear and willing to explain the concepts over and over again. If you messed up the project, he will tell you which part you got wrong and find a way that you could receive points. Go to the class, do works. He is the best. Definitely take his class.

At times he can be hard to understand and his lectures are a little confusing but he is really laid back. He cares for his students. The class has a good amount of work and studying that you will have to do but he will answer any questions you have.
Great professor. Very understanding and entertaining!
Great guy. Very understanding and just wants you to succeed.

He's literally the most easygoing professor at Smeal. I love him so much! 10/10 would recommend. Easy class. He's also an extremely fair grader, and is very understanding if you are having a busy week.
Best professor at Smeal!

Probably the best SCM prof Ive taken at Smeal. He was such a nice guy and genuinely cared about students success. He made it clear what he expected from you, so the tests were very manageable if you go to class. Definitely reccomend!
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Best professor I had so far at Penn State. Homework and tests are similar to homework. Go to class and understand the classwork you should be fine for the class.

Honestly the best SCM professor I have had because he is fair in his expectations of the class. I never felt overwhelmed by the workload and he is very understanding that his students have other things going on so he doesn't bombard you with hard assignments. Also, he is very helpful if you need clarifications on topics, assignments, etc.

TAKE THIS PROFESSOR!!! His accent was hard at first, but you get over it. He has classwork that are the exact same questions as the homeworks and exams, but different numbers. He really cares about his students and will change the curriculum to help us whether it's going over something again, or changing the second exam to make it easier. TAKE HIM!

Great guy. The first few lectures you may feel confused because he does have an accent, but you quickly learn to ignore it and focus.  I think he was a new professor so lectures improved as the year went on.  Very fair grader and tests are not that hard.  I took the class a semester before with another teacher and Suvrat was much better.

Alright... To anyone considering this guy just know you will leave class more confused then you went into it. USUALLY. The key to do well is to follow the clear, excellent instructions in the book to learn how to calculate equations. He's not the best lecturer. BUT THE MATERIAL, EXAMS, AND HIS HW IS EASY. TAKE HIM. Go to class for his classworks.

Never thought I would ever be able to get an A in calc but he is seriously the best teacher ever. As long as you watch the videos he makes, go to class, and see where you went wrong on the learning targets you will be fine. Have nothing but good things to say about him considering I've had go retake 140 and know what it's like to have a bad teacher
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Deforest is a great professor. The course outline is very clear, and it's easy to understand what is expected of you. The course has grown and improved, and expectations are now much clearer. This class uses specs grading! Lectures are a great learning experience, and he always takes feedback. Bonus points because he learns his students' names!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I took this my first semester as a freshman. I really enjoyed Dr. Deforest. It's obvious that he really loves math and wants us to love it too. He facilitated an environment where we learned a lot but also enjoyed class. I was concerned about the class being too biological, but it was actually very interesting and didn't distract from the math.

he's a good guy but bad teacher. the only thing that determines your grade is the LTs. sure you can retake them, but if you make one minor mistake you fail the whole thing. PLAs and hw are useless, all you get is XP that counts toward an extra success if it helps. on top of it all they take forever to grade. my list of complaints is never ending
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: It seems easy at first because you can retake any of the quizzes. Until you have to retake an entire quiz because you make an itty bitty silly mistake on a PART of a problem that if he gave a numerical grade would result in an A- on the quiz. But because he gives you a "Not Yet" instead, you will need to retake the entire quiz. Every question.

He takes forever to grade anything… it can take up to 3 weeks after your exam to even know what you got on it. He also locks your grade from canvas so you don't know your grade the entire semester until a couple days before late drop. Avoid taking him unless you want to teach yourself the entire semester because he cannot teach whatsoever.

Super nice guy, but horrible teacher. He has a flipped classroom so he can get out of teaching the class, but forgets to post the material. He gives up on plas two weeks in and refuses to begin grading until after finals. His organizational skills are worse than a kindergartener's and he has the memory of a pea. don't take him unless ur a math god
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Never posts anything, will stop posting PLAs before halfway through semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Take Russ if you plan to be the professor. I originally had a different professor, but Russ subbed in and he was so confusing. His writing was sporadic, his lessons never made sense, and his comments on lts/writing assignments gave me little/no helpful feedback. He also posts videos, but they don't help for completing lts and are a waste of time.

Homeworks are doable but some questions can be a bit challenging at times. Review the lecture videos and ask for help on Piazza if needed. Quizzes/Exams similar to homeworks. Only negatives are that he posts announcements on Piazza instead of Canvas and doesn't post grades on Canvas at all, this could change when final grades are calculated.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. deForest loves to meet students and does his best to make sure people stay on track with the course. Lectures are a bit of a drag sometimes, but he does keep the course easy to follow.

Russ is so nice and as a comm major, this was an easy math class for a gen ed. All group tests and some writing assignments throughout the semester. You'll get an A and Russ is super helpful if you have any questions. Would def recommend it!

Prof DeForest is really nice, and this class isn't that bad. It can seem confusing at times, but he'll basically give you the answer if you ask a question. Exams are taken as a group, and he's a really reasonable grader so just try your best and you'll do well. Coming from a Comm major who sucks at Math, it's not a bad way to finish out your GQs.

Not an awful class if you need another math credit. A lot of homework which are pre lecture assignments and writing assignments. Exam are taken in a group and get to use in class assignments for it so not bad at all. He offers so much extra credit which helped my grade too. Overall, not bad but not my favorite class or professor I have ever had.

It was fine. Just trying to finish up my GQ credits. Overall he was fine. Group tests (5 or 6) Pre-Lecture Assignments (don't count for much) No exams. Writing Assignments (If you have a cool TA you'll get a 10/10) Overall it was an easy gen ed that I'm happy to be done with.

Dr. DeForest truly cares so much about the well-being of all of his students. This class was amazing because he teaches the content by mastery, so we were able to retake the quizzes as many times as we wanted (quizzes make up your entire grade). He's a little hard to understand in class, but his pre-lecture videos alone are great for learning.

This class is set up different than other courses. You're graded on quizzes every week and your ability to 'master' them. At first it's confusing but it's easy to get an A if you stay on top of quizzes and retake them. Go to office hours to go over quizzes. Don't be afraid to ask for a regrade on quizzes. Keep track of the quizzes and your totals.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I really enjoyed this class. The setup of this class is different, where you have to complete mini quizzes to master learning topics, and how many you complete decides your grade so it is easy to tell how you are tracking. Understand the setup of the class and plan ahead. If you do that you will be totally fine. A little slow of a grader sometimes.
The most reliable, responsible, efficient professor I have ever had.
Easiest class ever. The materials were easy and the homeworks were also very very easy. Usually spent around 30 minutes to finish his weekly homeworks.

He had pretty decent explanations for the lessons and was nice enough to give us revisions for the homework we turned in each week. He gave us a week to each of the exams. However, he isn't the best because his lectures do not help exactly for the homework problems given in class but I would take him over a lot of professors for this course.

Seems like an all-around genuine person. Homework was a little difficult but he gave second attempts and always explained the answers. Some opportunities for extra credit and exams were decently challenging. One of the only courses where I felt that the teacher truly wanted us to learn the content and work with us instead of against us.

He is an amazing professor, genuinely cares a lot about his students and wants them to pass the class. Grading is based on quizzes that you can retake till you get a good grade same goes with the homework you get to redo it once following a video of him solving it. You do have to learn outside the class but go to lion tutors on campus(free).

This class seemed easy at first, but lectures do not correlate with the weekly quizzes and I really did not know what was going on most of the time due to this. There was not really much feedback on quizzes unless you went to office hours. Mr. deForest is good at explaining concepts one on one, but during class it was a lot harder to grasp concepts

The way he structured the class was by breaking up all the topics into different "Learning Targets" and each week you take a couple quizzes. You can retake the quizzes as many times as you need. He does really care about his students and their understanding of the material. I would recommend this course with him if you are debating 140 vs. 140B.

great guy who genuinely wants you to do well. easiest calculus class ive taken. allows you to retake learning targets as many times as you need, but study guides and written homework take forever to do. buts it math, thats how it goes. very helpful guy, just make sure you know your stuff for exams.

If you are not a strong test taker do not take this class. The only things you are graded on are your ability to master a certain topic multiple times. Seems nice at first but is. a nightmare when you don't understand what you did wrong and only have 4 weeks left to finish a bunch of quizzes in a 50 minute period once per week. Russ was nice tho.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The lectures he posts are pretty basic and easy to follow along with. He does pretty simple problems and explains them fairly well, but then on the homework, he gives very long and hard problems. The homework problems are nothing like the ones he does in the lectures. Professor DeForest is a really good guy, but his class is run pretty weirdly.

Dr Deforest is a good professor, but is a very slow grader. His classes are flipped, so you watch his lectures on your own and do practice problems in class. There are no exams, only learning target quizzes which you can take as many times as you want until you master, and your grade is based on how many of those you pass.

Horrible way of taking tests, would much rather take an exam rather than doing nit picky problems every week. Doesn't teach in any of his lectures and instead makes you watch them separately. Would not recommend this professor
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: For the most part, deForest's lectures were easy to grasp, although you definitely need a strong calculus basis before coming into his class. Class was based completely on topic completion and mastery, which made it easier to achieve the grade that you wanted in the class. He's not great about sticking to timelines and doesn't grade the fastest.

Even though it's a MATH course, there's a surprisingly large amount of writing involved, so be prepared for that. None of the math is too difficult at all, you get to work in groups and Russ and the LAs are all super helpful. I would definitely recommend NOT skipping this class as the information and worksheets are essential to learning and tests
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr. DeForest is one of the nicest and most caring professors I have ever had. I had a lot going on in my personal life, and he was so flexible and granted me extensions without hesitation. He is always willing to help at office hours. His lectures I think are really helpful. He also gets that class is long and gives breaks. His grading isn't strict

He loves using the textbook and teaches the class using definitions. Lectures heavy and not enough practice problems but he is very nice and will try his best to explain the concepts if you don't understand. He has a lot of office hours

If you don't like word problems, then this isn't the class for you but the GSG really helps! Also, if you go to his office hours you will find that Russ is one of the sweetest people ever. He believes failing is a learning experience, and lets you redeem yourself many times. You will find that he cares for his students and the world around us!

Russ is one of the rare professors. He genuinely cares about each student's success and is more focused on you understanding the material than worrying about your grade. He is a very lenient grader and gives you a chance to redeem yourself. He believes that failures are learning experiences and awards you for trying your hardest.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: Russ is a really great guy who definitely wants his students to succeed, but his approach is a little odd. His lessons are often textbook definitions - which can be really hard with Calc, so definitely go to office hours and LA sessions (LA sessions also help you drop lowest quiz and homework). If you put in the work, an A is attainable.

I really didn't like this class. deforest is a good guy but can be condescending at times and seems surprised when people ask basic questions, which contradicts the fact that he INSISTS we ask questions. Homework, quizzes, and tests were extremely complex and time consuming, and were far more advanced than examples he gives in class.

Russel was a great professor; some of his answers can be unclear but he really cares about you understanding the material and will do his best until you understand! His grading is super easy, and overall if you try your best to understand you can easily get an A in his class. Recommend him for sure!!!!
Is a very caring person and wants you to learn. In-Depth explanations.. take him for sure!!

This is by far the worst class I have ever taken at Penn State. The outside of class work is super excessive and confusing and feels as if it has nothing to do with what you learn in class. Three confusing irrelevant quizzes a week(That count for a lot), attendance every class and multiple blog posts a week sometimes. AVOID THIS CLASS
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Hes a good teacher and nice person. Never took calculus before and he was always available to help. Cares about his students and wants them to do well, always go to his office hours and get things clarified when needed. Take his class if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Russell was a great teacher. He was really good at explaining concepts beyond just the computations. I finished the class with a really good handle on the material. He was always very helpful at office hours.

Lots of work but the math was super easy, and I'm an art major. Cool subject matter, learned a lot, and there were nearly infinite opportunities to fix or improve a grade you weren't satisfied with. If you're concerned about the environment, or if you just need to take a math class to graduate, this is the class for you. Lotta whiners here lol
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: This class was the hardest class I have ever had at Penn State. The material is actually really easy but the quizzes and homework are made to be very hard and confusing. Even though most of the graded assignments were online, they were extremely difficult to do well on. Just don't take this class.
The lectures are incredibly boring and his slides are full of mistakes and typos. Content is presented in terms of formulas/plugging in numbers rather than concepts.

I'm sure Russell has good intentions and tries to help out his students, but he just really is not a good professor. The examples he goes over in class are rarely like the online homework and quizzes. He speeds through slides during class, giving little time for questions to even come to mind, let alone for them to be answered.

Professor Deforest has good intentions and tries to help as best as he can. But the class is way harder than it should have been, with problems often difficult for the sake of being difficult. From what I've heard about other Math 034 instructors, I'm going to assume the department made the class this way. Think carefully about taking this class
The class itself was only moderately difficult but he was completely useless and it always felt like he wanted us to do poorly. Avoid at all costs.

Class was confusing at times, with errors on some of the handouts and videos.  Course was very fragmented, though.  He kept pushing back, or adjusting due dates, which screwed with my schedule on a regular basis.  Do the work, and you'll get by -- don't do the work, and you WILL suffer.  Nice enough, but bad at answering email.

Russell is a cool guy,really understanding. He's not the best teacher and sometimes makes mistakes, but from what I hear about all other MATH220 teachers, Russell is the best there is. This class is just a pain in the ass to take, somewhat unnecessary, but Russell had me well prepared for the exams. He gives a decent amount of HW, but it helps.

Very nice person, bad professor. Probably the heaviest workload I've ever received in class along side some of the worst instructions ever. It honestly seems like she doesn't even understand her own work. Do not take this class.

Not a bad class at all, just a lot of busy work. The first half of the semester is a basic HPA class with lectures and busy work. The second half focuses on the policy brief. Complete all your assignments on time, and you will be perfectly fine. She is always willing to help you out and is one of the nicest people I have ever met. Test was not hard
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Favorite professor at Penn State.

Dr. Spokus is a great professor! I was nervous about taking this class after reading the reviews, but the class wasn't bad. Since it's a writing class, expect a lot of writing. She's well-connected with clubs and offers great networking advice. If you take advantage of the resources she shares, they can be really helpful. Don't buy the textbook.

What made this course hard was that the topics were boring to me. There's so much writing that I dreaded every single assignment. There's a group project in the beginning (good luck w/ the group you land in), weekly discussions/case studies with a 75-word count for EACH question. Most of them had 8 questions + respond to 2 peers. Too much work!!!!

Class is easy but the lectures are so boring. There is only one exam in the class and that's not super difficult. The policy brief at the end of the semester also isn't bad because we work on it for a while before the last week of classes. The class ends smoothly at the end of the semester.

Lovely professor who gives grandma vibes, pay attention in class because that mid-semester test (your only test in person) will hit way to hard on your grades. Lectures get a little boring and she can ramble, but if you listen its good information for your policy brief assessment. Not a hard grader, class participation will go a long way.
I like her in other classes but not HPA 301W. I wish it were not a required course for a degree.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--So many papers--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Spokus is a legend. I had this class at 9 am and surprisingly made it (most of the time). In the beginning there are group projects and case studies which are kinda annoying, but it is a writing class. The final paper is the other half of the semester and you get so much time and she helps you edit it that by the time you turn in the draft ur good.

Professor Spokus is really understanding and accommodating. She wants all of her students to do well so she is very helpful and gives clear directions. She checked in on the class multiple times to see how our projects were going. Overall, she is very sweet, and class is easy as long as you put in the effort.

Dr. Spokus is definitely one of the sweetest professors I've had so far. You can tell that she genuinely wants her students to succeed. Coursework is not too heavy, and tests and quizzes are also manageable. The biggest assignment is the policy brief at the end of the semester, but if you stay on top of due dates and work, it's not daunting at all.

Dr. Spokus seems to get a bad rap for no apparent reason IMO. She is one of the sweetest people I have ever met and truly wanted us to succeed. She gave feedback on all assignments and answered emails within an hour in most cases. Just show up to class and TRY!!!

Dr. Spokus isn't a bad professor but gets sidetracked super easily, she will rant on and on about things that do not have to do with the class and repeats herself constantly which can be a tad bit annoying. She leaves comments on assignments that are not helpful at all so if you have a TA who leaves good feedback you'll be okay, just work for it
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: I have taken Spokus for two different HPA courses, and I have had no problems with her ever. She is a very caring professor that is always accessible outside the class. There are quite a few case studies, discussion posts, and a final paper - but this is a W course after all. She is easy going and an overall great professor.

No clue why people give her negative reviews. She is an extremely caring and kind woman who is always available for help. The work is normal for a college course and as long as you don't wait until the last minute and put the time in, there shouldn't be a reason you do poorly. I really enjoyed this class.

I am not a good writer and I do not like to write so do not take if you do not have to. Gives attendance quizzes during zoom. Almost quizzes are on quizlet so don't let them stress you out. She is a nice person, old and talks a lot but nice. I probably would take another one of her classes. This is an okay class.

Although this review is for HPA 301W the course is no longer writing intensive. Seems like the professor forgot this. Assigns homework due the next day and the next class. Does not know how to use canvas and the notes are very boring and hard to follow. Told us to buy a textbook and we didn't use it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--So many papers--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Spokus is really caring and an amazing woman. Her quizzes are sometimes difficult but other than that all she asks is that you show up and participate. I defiantly will take a class with her again just to be around her more lol.
APA stickler. Almost the whole semester is a group project. Really caring professor, but is tougher than most.

Easy A as long as you do the work assigned with some effort. She is the nicest professor ever and she will bring donuts and candy to class for the students. She does like to talk in anecdotes frequently. She is lenient with attendance and allows for 4 absences without any penalty, the 5th one and on is when it counts.

HPA 301 online: Solid professor with reasonable assignments and grading criteria. Course consist of 10-question weekly quizzes and 1 exam; course then switches to policy topics which include a couple of 1-page papers, 2-page policy paper, and infographic. Overall, easy A or B and doesn't require an overwhelming amount of time or studying.

literally just go to class i took her class 6-9 pm on Thurs she doesn't even go past 8 pm its so worth it taking it that time trust me i like to go out! Also there is one group project and its so easy i did it in 10 minutes. Just do all the easy assignments and you will get an A. Also all exams are open laptop (except final you get a card).

reviews.comment: Class can be a bit boring (lecture was 3 hours 1x week), but Dr. Spokus is a sweet lady. Exams were open note, weekly assignments weren't hard at all just set a reminder on your phone to do them every week. Class never really lasted the full time and exams you leave when you're done.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. Spokus is a really nice professor, she really cares about the material she's teaching but her lectures are a little dry and boring. Exams are open note and there's weekly assignments due on canvas but it's all easy and very doable, easy A.

She's a very nice lady. She tends to get off topic, but a lot of it has to relate to healthcare. Spokus really strives for everyone to understand the material. The class wasn't bad at all. Show up on time and you're golden. There is one exam that goes directly off of quiz questions, a bunch of mini quizzes, a policy brief paper, infographic -easy

If there are any other professors for HPA460 take them instead. Her power points are boring and hard to follow. Her tests are a shot in the dark. She overall is just boring and rambles on about a lot of unrelated material. Bring your laptop and be prepared to do anything but pay attention
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--GROUP PROJECTS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: If you need to take HPA 101 def take it with Dr. Spokus. 3 exams(no final) and they are open note, online quizzes & a 1 page reflection every week that are both graded very lightly. Only downside is that its a night class and attendance is mandatory(can miss 2), but you get out 2 hrs early on exam nights and usually 1 hr early on lecture nights.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: I did not like the class at all and do not recommend if you are able to take with another professor.  Nice lady but randomly gives assignments/readings that are due for the next class and is easily upset by the stupidest things.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr Spokus can be somewhat repetitive and her lectures get off track, but she is still a really good professor.  She has years on years of experience and her goal for all of her students is to prepare them for the work force.  If you need to come to her office hours she is extremely helpful and will always do her best to help get us all internships.

reviews.comment: This lady never shuts up!!! You have to go to class for attendance but you literally learn nothing except her entire life story, it's a complete waste of time. She claims she only gives 3 A's but that's BS bc everything is graded so lightly. Don't buy the text, bring laptop to class so you don't have to listen to her, do the assignments well.

in 460, you had 4 exams, 2 case studies (15 pages+), 1 training project, and an interview project. You better like group projects. Her tests are do-able. I got an A and then a B on the last three exams. She does curve the exams but they aren't that easy. Go to lecture and listen (shes boring tho!) and read the book. I did learn a lot tho.

You'll probably only use the textbook to study for exams. Attendance is required. You can miss up to 4 a semester without failing. However, she does graded in-class exercises, so it isn't really worth missing. Tests aren't extremely difficult. The group projects can be tedious and annoying. Sometimes the instructions aren't clear. Overall, worth it

This class had 2 2-page papers, 1 5-8 page paper, and 1 10-page paper. None of the papers were exactly difficult to write, but she'd make different parts of different papers due all intermingled. It was a little difficult to keep straight what was due when, but overall the grading is pretty easy. Class is mandatory but pointless.

The class is easy as sin and attending doesn't help.  Most unfortunately she takes attendance everyday so I suggest you bring something to do during the lectures.  Quite a few people have taken to leaving to go to the bathroom after the quiz and just not coming back.

Very easy course. Doing minimal effort will get you at least a B+ in the course. Can be dry/boring at times but doing Soduku or studying for another course will help pass the time. Very friendly and willing to help students.
SHE IS SUCH A NICE TEACHER!!!! THE CLASS CAN BE BORING BUT VERY EASY, THERE IS NOT A LOT OF HOMEWORK....JUST 4 PAPERS AND 4 TESTS WHICH ARE EASY AND SHE CURVES. TAKE THE CLASS.
Very boring class, bring something to do. There are a lot of assignments that are mostly just busy work. There are a lot of tests too, but they're easy as long as you study the study guides.
Omg please just take a different professor or take online

Don't take if you do not have to she is terrible and it's so exam heavy

Didn't enjoy this class with this teacher, at all. Grading was very inconsistent, especially participation grades. Almost felt like she put numbers in a random generator and made that the participation grades for each week.

Don't like the way she teaches class. Speaks in all Spanish so it's very easy to get lost in class. Not very understanding about being absent either and is a very tough participation grader. Exams are difficult and are in Pollock so studying is very important. Graded on a lot though.

The teacher is alright, I personally just hate the way these spanish classes are set up. She takes little points off here and there but decent feedback. Group projects. Due dates friday and sunday. uses myspanishlab which gives zero correction feedback. proctured exams closed book. lots of work which makes it easier to pass because exams are TOUGH.

She blamed me for internet issues she was having for exam 1. I had called IT 3x and they all told me it was the way she set it up. Overall, this professor cares about his students. His teaching styles are questionable for sure. There was a day we had class outside in the cold and pouring rain. I think he means well, but it definitely makes for an interesting course.

Great professor. Other people within SHM come and speak. You write a reflection afterwards, also have two other semester-long assignments, so don't procrastinate them. Super nice and chill professor.

She's literally so nice. I think I skipped over half the classes, but she gives so much extra credit and simple projects that I passed with a 97%. She truly cares about you and wants to see you succeed.
Best professor ever! She's so nice and always willing to help. She gives plenty of time to do projects and assignments and it's all very straight forward. She's also very funny. 100% recommend!!!
Easy on grading, understanding
She's very nice and try's to make her presentations engaging. The group project lasts all year and you get randomly assigned a group, which was very frustrating. But she is a good professor overall

Such a sweet professor but the group project was a little difficult. If you dont have a good group it can be frustrating but the project wasnt too bad. The assignments are just discussion posts, quizzes, exams that are taken from home, and reflections on the different speakers who come in. The class was overall enjoyable.
Dr. Ding is so understanding and always wants you to be engaged. Most HM majors will try to take her class and speak really highly of her. If you can take her class, do it.
She is the best teacher and she's so nice. Her class was so easy and she really cares about her students. Take her class!

Professor Ding was the best 271 teacher she was so fun and amazing at teaching. She makes the classroom feel homey and comfortable! Assignments are not hard and she covers all the material that are on the quizzes.
